title: Optimize, Learn, Refine: Whole-Body Grasping and Pick-and-Throw with a Spiral Soft Robot
summary: Soft continuum robots can exploit distributed compliance for whole-body manipulation, but synthesizing behavior through changing contacts remains difficult. We address whole-body grasping and pick-and-throw from an initially ungrasped state through outcome-based actuation-space optimization. Grasping is quantified by tip angular sweep and body-object enclosure, while throwing further incorporates release-direction alignment and minimum release speed. These objectives allow grasping, acceleration, and release to emerge from compliant interaction without prescribing contact forces, contact locations, or body configurations. Because the resulting actuation-to-outcome mapping is nonsmooth, we utilize derivative-free CMA-ES within an optimize-learn-refine framework. CMA-ES generates solutions for sampled conditions, a task-conditioned predictor learns warm starts, and CMA-ES refines them for unseen conditions. In simulation, the method achieves 492/500 successful grasps (98.4%) and success rates of 98%, 97%, and 94% across three directional throwing trials. Learned initialization increases grasping success from 78.6% to 98.4% while reducing the median rollout count from 1184 to 816 in CMA-ES. Hardware experiments achieve a 100% grasping success rate across 50 executions and a 100% pick-and-throw success rate across 30 executions, with 10 repetitions per direction. Together, these simulation and hardware results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework across both simulated and physical whole-body manipulation tasks.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种基于结果驱动的驱动空间优化框架，使软连续体机器人能从初始未抓取状态完成全身抓取与拾取投掷。
AI.motivation: 软连续体机器人可利用分布式柔顺性进行全身操作，但通过改变接触来合成行为仍然困难，尤其是从初始未抓取状态完成抓取与投掷。
AI.method: 以末端角扫描和身体-物体包络量化抓取，并在投掷中加入释放方向对齐与最小释放速度；针对非光滑驱动-结果映射，采用无导数CMA-ES，并在“优化-学习-精化”框架中结合任务条件预测器提供热启动。
AI.result: 仿真中抓取成功492/500（98.4%），三个方向投掷成功率分别为98%、97%、94%；学习初始化将抓取成功率从78.6%提升至98.4%，并将CMA-ES中位迭代次数从1184降至816。硬件实验中抓取50次成功率达100%，拾取投掷30次成功率达100%，每个方向重复10次。
AI.conclusion: 仿真与硬件结果共同表明，该框架能有效完成软连续体机器人的全身抓取与拾取投掷任务。

title: Raw Imagery Impacting Your AI: Should You Care?
summary: Onboard AI is gaining interest for space applications such as vessel, wildfire, and cloud detection, where real-time processing can improve mission reactivity and reduce downlink needs. However, onboard models may operate on raw or minimally processed imagery rather than on restored ground products. This study evaluates how image degradation affects object detection by varying Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR), Modulation Transfer Function (MTF) at Nyquist, and Ground Sampling Distance (GSD). Controlled degradations are applied to Very High Resolution Maxar imagery, and three lightweight detectors, YOLOv5s, YOLOX-S, and NanoDet, are evaluated on the resulting operating points. The results show that the impact of image quality depends on the degradation mechanism, and that increasing degradation does not necessarily lead to a proportional decrease in vessel detection performance. GSD produces the most consistent performance shift, while MTF and SNR effects depend more on the model and resolution. Severe combinations of blur and noise produce the largest losses. These results provide task-level information that can support sensor, processing, and AI trade-offs for future onboard systems.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了星载AI在真实太空应用中，图像退化对目标检测性能的影响。通过控制信噪比、奈奎斯特频率处的调制传递函数和地面采样距离，在Maxar甚高分辨率影像上测试了三种轻量检测器，发现不同退化机制影响不同，并非退化越严重检测性能越差。
AI.motivation: 星载AI可用于船舶、野火和云检测等任务，能提升实时性并减少下传需求；但星载模型通常处理原始或 minimally processed 影像，而非地面恢复产品，因此需要了解图像退化如何影响目标检测。
AI.method: 对甚高分辨率Maxar影像施加受控退化，改变信噪比、奈奎斯特频率处的调制传递函数和地面采样距离；在生成的 operating points 上评估YOLOv5s、YOLOX-S和NanoDet三种轻量检测器，重点关注船舶检测性能。
AI.result: 图像质量影响取决于退化机制；增加退化不一定导致船舶检测性能成比例下降。地面采样距离造成最一致性能变化，调制传递函数和信噪比影响更依赖模型与分辨率。严重的模糊与噪声组合造成最大性能损失。
AI.conclusion: 结果为未来星载系统的传感器、处理和AI权衡提供了任务级信息，可用于指导 onboard 系统设计中的 trade-offs。

title: Disentangling and Fusing Neurostructural and Vascular Ageing for Retinal Age Prediction
comment: Accepted as a short paper at IEEE BIBM 2026
summary: Estimating biological age is an important task in ageing research, as it quantifies individual ageing trajectories beyond chronological age. Retinal age estimation has become a well-established direction in this area because retinal imaging provides a non-invasive window into neural and microvascular ageing. Existing studies, however, have predominantly focused on fundus photographs and usually model retinal ageing as a single generic process. Although biological ageing is heterogeneous and different organs or tissues may age at different rates, little research has explicitly distinguished neurostructural and vascular ageing in retinal age prediction. This work fills this gap by studying neurostructural ageing with Optical Coherence Tomography (OCT) images and vascular ageing with Optical Coherence Tomography Angiography (OCTA) images. We formulate multimodal OCT/OCTA retinal age estimation as a structural-vascular ageing decomposition problem and propose SAP-DPF, a unified dual-path prediction framework that separately estimates structural and vascular ageing, models modality-specific predictive uncertainty, and adaptively fuses the two ageing signals through an uncertainty-gated late-fusion module. Using this unified prediction framework, SAP-DPF achieves a mean absolute error of 4.07 years for the structural pathway and 7.37 years for the vascular pathway, while the proposed late-fusion algorithm further improves the overall mean absolute error to 4.02 years, representing a 12.52% improvement over the strongest single-modality baseline. This work could extend retinal age prediction beyond a single biological-age estimate, providing a framework for investigating structural and vascular contributions to heterogeneous retinal ageing.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用OCT和OCTA图像分别估计视网膜的神经结构衰老与血管衰老，提出SAP-DPF双路径预测框架，并通过不确定性门控晚期融合提升视网膜年龄估计性能。
AI.motivation: 现有视网膜年龄估计多基于眼底照片，通常将视网膜衰老建模为单一通用过程；但生物衰老具有异质性，不同组织衰老速度不同，尚缺乏对神经结构衰老和血管衰老的明确区分。
AI.method: 将多模态OCT/OCTA视网膜年龄估计表述为结构-血管衰老分解问题，提出统一的双路径预测框架SAP-DPF；分别估计结构衰老和血管衰老，建模模态特定预测不确定性，并通过不确定性门控晚期融合模块自适应融合两种衰老信号。
AI.result: SAP-DPF在结构路径上取得4.07年平均绝对误差，在血管路径上为7.37年；所提出的晚期融合算法将总体平均绝对误差进一步降至4.02年，相比最强单模态基线提升12.52%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作可将视网膜年龄预测从单一生物年龄估计拓展为结构性和血管性贡献的联合分析，为研究异质性视网膜衰老提供了框架。

title: TSGL: Teacher-Student Graph Learning for 3DGS Compression
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures. Submitted to IEEE ICASSP 2027
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) is a popular representation for novel view synthesis. However, 3DGS contains millions of Gaussian primitives, each with rich attributes, resulting in large file sizes. We propose a novel 3DGS compression method based on Teacher-Student Graph Learning (TSGL) that operates directly on a trained model, without 3DGS retraining or access to training images. Specifically, for each block of Gaussian primitives, using decoded positions and DC spherical harmonic (SH) coefficients as predictors, we learn a signal-dependent geometry graph G encoding the pairwise similarities between neighbouring Gaussians via a teacher-student model. Given G, we perform Graph Fourier Transform (GFT) on the remaining attributes, so that signal energies are predominantly projected into the low-frequency coefficients for compact representation. On three standard benchmarks, the method reaches 27x to 33x compression with less than 0.6 dB of PSNR loss, improving on recent post-training compression methods in both size and rendering quality.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）的Teacher-Student图学习压缩方法TSGL，可直接压缩已训练模型，无需重训练或访问训练图像，在三个基准上实现27倍至33倍压缩且PSNR损失小于0.6 dB。
AI.motivation: 3DGS虽在新视角合成中表现优异，但包含数百万个高斯原语且属性丰富，导致文件体积过大，现有压缩方法可能需要重训练或训练图像，因此需要一种高效的后训练压缩方案。
AI.method: 对每个高斯原语块，以解码后的位置和DC球谐系数作为预测器，通过Teacher-Student模型学习信号相关的几何图G，用于编码相邻高斯原语之间的成对相似性；基于G对剩余属性进行图傅里叶变换（GFT），使信号能量主要集中到低频系数以实现紧凑表示。
AI.result: 在三个标准基准上达到27倍至33倍压缩率，PSNR损失低于0.6 dB，在压缩尺寸和渲染质量上均优于近期后训练压缩方法。
AI.conclusion: TSGL是一种无需重训练或训练图像、可直接作用于已训练3DGS模型的有效压缩方法，能够在大幅减小模型体积的同时保持较高渲染质量。

title: Evaluating Multi-Task Morphological Concept Learning for Pulmonary Nodule Malignancy Assessment in 3D CT
summary: Morphological characteristics such as spiculation and lobulation play an important role in assessing pulmonary nodules on computed tomography (CT), particularly in relation to malignancy risk. This study examines whether learning radiologist-annotated morphological features together with malignancy risk from lesion-centred 3D CT volumes improves classification performance. The Lung Image Database Consortium and Image Database Resource Initiative (LIDC-IDRI) dataset was used, comprising 3,918 reader-level nodule annotations from 742 patients after excluding indeterminate malignancy ratings. Patient-level splitting was used for training, validation, and testing, with 112 patients and 628 reader annotations in the held-out test set. A single-task 3D convolutional neural network was compared with a multi-task model predicting malignancy risk, spiculation, and lobulation. The single-task model achieved a balanced accuracy of 0.548 and receiver operating characteristic area under the curve (ROC-AUC) of 0.552, while the multi-task model achieved 0.539 and 0.558, respectively. Patient-level bootstrap analysis showed an ROC-AUC difference of 0.005 (95% confidence interval (CI): -0.087 to 0.090) and a balanced-accuracy difference of -0.009 (95% CI: -0.067 to 0.043). The auxiliary tasks were strongly imbalanced and showed limited predictive performance. Overall, including morphological features did not clearly improve malignancy-risk classification, showing the importance of class balance, label formulation, and reader-level annotation structure in multi-task pulmonary CT analysis.

AI.tldr: 该研究基于LIDC-IDRI数据，比较单任务与多任务3D CNN在肺结节CT恶性风险分类中的表现，发现加入放射科医生标注的形态学特征（毛刺、分叶）并未明显提升分类性能。
AI.motivation: 毛刺、分叶等形态学特征对评估肺结节恶性风险很重要，研究希望验证在病灶中心3D CT体积中联合学习放射科医生标注的形态学特征与恶性风险，能否改善分类表现。
AI.method: 使用LIDC-IDRI数据集，排除不确定恶性评级后纳入742例患者的3,918条读者级结节标注；按患者划分训练、验证和测试集，测试集含112例患者、628条标注。比较单任务3D CNN与同时预测恶性风险、毛刺和分叶的多任务模型。
AI.result: 单任务模型平衡准确率为0.548，ROC-AUC为0.552；多任务模型分别为0.539和0.558。患者级bootstrap分析显示，ROC-AUC差异为0.005（95% CI：-0.087至0.090），平衡准确率差异为-0.009（95% CI：-0.067至0.043）。辅助任务类别高度不平衡，预测性能有限。
AI.conclusion: 总体而言，纳入形态学特征未能明确改善恶性风险分类，说明在多任务肺部CT分析中，类别平衡、标签制定方式和读者级标注结构非常重要。

title: Joint Supervised and Self-Supervised Training with Acquisition-Robust Techniques for Accelerated 4D Flow MRI Reconstruction
summary: 4D flow MRI measures time-resolved, three-directional blood velocity but requires long acquisition times, and its diagnostic signal is carried by the phase difference \emph{between} velocity encodings, not by image magnitude. Recent work has developed a per-encoding variational network to address image reconstruction in this field. In this work, we incorporate a joint supervised and self-supervised training regime and utilize both magnitude and velocity data during supervision. At the same time, we add multiple acquisition-robust and conditioning strategies based on the acceleration factors. On the CMRx4DFlow~2026 aortic dataset (1.5 and 3T), our model lowers RelErr by $38$--$50\%$ and AngErr by $7.0$--$8.7^\circ$ against a training-matched baseline across $R{=}10$--$50$, improving on every held-out subject at every acceleration. Our model also shows strong generalization ability to transfer on out-of-distribution data by employing the joint training scheme, with an increase of $7.2\%$ in SSIM and decrease of $38\%$ and $31\%$ in AngErr and RelErr respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文针对4D flow MRI重建，在逐编码变分网络基础上引入联合监督与自监督训练，并同时利用幅度和速度数据进行监督，同时加入基于加速倍数的采集鲁棒性与条件化策略，在主动脉数据集上显著降低了速度与角度误差并提升了泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 4D flow MRI可测量时间分辨的三方向血流速度，但采集时间长；其诊断信息主要来自速度编码之间的相位差而非图像幅度。已有工作提出逐编码变分网络用于该领域图像重建，但仍需进一步提升重建精度、加速鲁棒性与泛化能力。
AI.method: 在逐编码变分网络框架下，采用联合监督与自监督训练机制；监督时同时使用幅度与速度数据；并针对不同加速倍数加入多种采集鲁棒性与条件化策略。
AI.result: 在CMRx4DFlow 2026主动脉数据集（1.5T和3T）上，R=10–50范围内，相比训练匹配的基线，RelErr降低38%–50%，AngErr降低7.0–8.7°，且在每一加速倍数下对所有留出受试者均有改善。在分布外数据上，联合训练方案使SSIM提升7.2%，AngErr和RelErr分别降低38%和31%，展现出强泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 联合监督与自监督训练、同时利用幅度与速度监督、以及加速倍数相关的条件化策略，能有效提升4D flow MRI重建的精度、加速鲁棒性与跨分布泛化性能。

title: Colorectal Cancer Segmentation with Adaptive Augmentation and Multi-Resolution Ensemble Models
comment: SPIE Eighteenth International Conference on Machine Vision (ICMV 2025), Paris, France
summary:
Colorectal cancer (CRC) is the second most deadly and third most common cancer, and the leading cause of death among gastrointestinal cancers. Early diagnosis is crucial for the treatment of this cancer and increasing the survival rates. Although CRC is more common in developed regions, its occurrence is also increasing in developing regions as well. CRC diagnosis relies on histopathology assessment post-biopsy. Automated deep learning algorithms can significantly reduce diagnosis time, enhancing efficiency and supporting timely clinical decisions.
  We present an automated segmentation pipeline for whole-slide histopathology images that labels tumor grades 1-3 and normal mucosa. It utilizes dense prediction transformers with various encoder backbones, overlapping patches, and test-time augmentation. An adaptive augmentation policy, guided by large language models, further improves training. Top models were ensembled via soft voting, and mask refining post-processing steps, Gaussian blurring, morphological closing, and connected components analysis. On a colorectal cancer grade dataset, our method improved the F1 score from 62.92 to 69.84. Code is available here: github.com/caglarmert/ICIP2025

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一种用于结直肠癌全切片组织病理图像自动分割的流程，可标记肿瘤分级1-3及正常黏膜。方法结合密集预测Transformer、多编码器、重叠切块、测试时增强、LLM引导的自适应增强、软投票集成及掩膜后处理，在结直肠癌分级数据集上将F1分数从62.92提升至69.84。
AI.motivation: 结直肠癌是第二大致死、第三大常见癌症，也是胃肠道癌症主要死因。早期诊断对治疗和生存率至关重要，而诊断依赖活检后的组织病理学评估。自动深度学习算法可显著缩短诊断时间、提高效率并支持及时临床决策。
AI.method: 提出面向全切片组织病理图像的自动分割流程，标注肿瘤分级1-3和正常黏膜。采用密集预测Transformer及多种编码器骨干、重叠切块和测试时增强。使用大语言模型引导的自适应增强策略改进训练。通过软投票集成最优模型，并进行掩膜精炼后处理，包括高斯模糊、形态学闭运算和连通域分析。
AI.result: 在结直肠癌分级数据集上，该方法将F1分数从62.92提升到69.84。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的自动分割流程能有效提升结直肠癌组织病理图像分级分割性能，有助于提高诊断效率并支持临床决策。代码已公开。

title: Improving OCR Faithfulness via Gated and Attenuated On-Policy Distillation
summary: Vision-language models may rewrite anomalous text in images into linguistically plausible expressions, compromising OCR transcription faithfulness. Sequence-level task rewards and local teacher guidance are complementary, but guidance from the same teacher may not remain equally effective as the student improves. Offline analysis shows that supervision from a fixed teacher becomes progressively less favorable as the student improves, both across training checkpoints and across response groups with different task rewards. Motivated by this observation, we introduce GAD-RL, which adaptively regulates teacher supervision during joint post-training according to the student's current task performance and local distributions. A frozen teacher conditions on reference transcriptions and student-generated prefixes. GAD-RL disables distillation for response groups containing an output with task reward at least 0.95 and continuously attenuates distillation strength as group-mean reward increases. It also weights forward KL by the student's probability of the teacher's Top-1 token, moderating local auxiliary updates when student support for that candidate is low. On Qwen3.5-2B, GAD-RL achieves 59.92% Micro Recall on CHAOS-Bench, surpassing GRPO and GRPO+OPD (fixed-weight) by 8.45 and 4.43 percentage points, respectively, while achieving an Overall score of 91.18 on OmniDocBench v1.6.

AI.tldr: 论文提出GAD-RL方法，在视觉语言模型联合后训练中自适应调节教师监督强度，以提升OCR转录的忠实性，并在CHAOS-Bench和OmniDocBench上取得优于GRPO等基线方法的效果。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型可能将图像中的异常文本改写为语言上合理的表达，损害OCR转录忠实性；序列级任务奖励与局部教师指导虽互补，但固定教师的监督会随学生能力提升而逐渐失效，离线分析也证实这一点。
AI.method: 提出GAD-RL：在联合后训练中根据学生当前任务表现和局部分布自适应调节教师监督。冻结教师以参考转录和学生生成前缀为条件；当响应组中存在任务奖励≥0.95的输出时禁用蒸馏，并随组平均奖励升高持续衰减蒸馏强度；同时用学生对教师Top-1 token的概率对前向KL加权，在学生支持度低时抑制局部辅助更新。
AI.result: 在Qwen3.5-2B上，GAD-RL在CHAOS-Bench上达到59.92% Micro Recall，分别超过GRPO和GRPO+OPD（固定权重）8.45和4.43个百分点；在OmniDocBench v1.6上Overall得分为91.18。
AI.conclusion: 自适应调节教师监督能有效缓解固定教师指导随学生提升而失效的问题，提升OCR转录忠实性与整体性能，优于固定权重蒸馏和纯强化学习基线。

title: Computing Scaled Relative Graphs of Discrete-Time LTI Systems: A Frequency-Domain Approach
summary: The scaled relative graph (SRG) represents the joint gain and phase properties of an input--output operator in the complex plane. This paper characterizes the SRG closure of causal, stable, square discrete-time linear time-invariant (LTI) systems on one-sided square-summable sequences. The Beltrami--Klein image of this closure equals the convex hull of the numerical ranges of the transformed frequency-response matrices. For real-coefficient single-input single-output systems, this yields the hyperbolic convex hull of the discrete-time Nyquist locus. The proof addresses the Hardy-space restriction imposed by one-sided inputs, which excludes persistent sinusoids, by replacing them with explicitly constructed finite-duration sinusoids. This construction shows how points in frequency-wise SRGs arise as limits of operator SRG points generated by admissible inputs. The characterization enables model-based computation of the closure from a state-space realization using frequency-response evaluations, numerical ranges, and planar convex hulls, without solving linear matrix inequalities.

AI.tldr: 本文刻画了因果、稳定、方阵离散时间LTI系统在一侧平方可和序列上的缩放相对图（SRG）闭包，并给出基于状态空间模型的计算方法。
AI.motivation: SRG可表示算子输入-输出的联合增益与相位特性，但一侧输入受Hardy空间限制、排除持续正弦，给闭包刻画带来困难。
AI.method: 利用Beltrami-Klein变换、数值范围与凸包，并通过构造有限时长正弦信号替代持续正弦，证明频域SRG点可由可容许输入生成的算子SRG点逼近。
AI.result: SRG闭包的Beltrami-Klein像等于变换后频率响应矩阵数值范围的凸包；实系数SISO情形对应离散Nyquist轨迹的双曲凸包。
AI.conclusion: 可从状态空间实现通过频率响应、数值范围和平面凸包计算SRG闭包，无需求解线性矩阵不等式。

title: Large Language Models are Approximate Survival Estimators
summary: Survival analysis estimates time-to-event outcomes from patient covariates and is widely used for medical risk assessment. Patients seeking prognostic information after a diagnosis may turn to large language models (LLMs), now readily accessible through consumer applications. However, whether LLMs can provide accurate survival predictions has not been rigorously evaluated. We introduce Survprompt, a framework that converts structured patient covariates into free-text clinical vignettes and prompts pre-trained LLMs to predict survival zero-shot. We benchmark Survprompt against conventional survival models, including random survival forests (RSF), across two multi-institutional pan-cancer cohorts: the publicly available MSK-CHORD cohort and a newly curated cohort from the Providence St. Joseph Health Network constructed using an LLM-based medical abstraction framework. We report censored mean absolute error (cMAE) and concordance index (c-index) and conduct feature ablations to identify variables influencing LLM predictions. Frontier LLMs achieved surprisingly competitive cMAE for individual survival times. For example, GPT-5.6-Sol achieved cMAE within 10% of state-of-the-art RSF models specifically trained for survival prediction for several cancer types and lower cMAE than RSF for prostate cancer in MSK-CHORD. Feature ablations revealed that LLMs prioritized clinical variables similarly to specialized survival models. However, LLMs showed inconsistent accuracy across cancer types and institutions and poorly discriminated between high- and low-risk patients (lower c-index). Zero-shot LLMs can generate surprisingly accurate prognostic estimates without specialized training, but their variable performance across cancer types and institutions remains an important limitation for clinical use.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出Survprompt框架，将结构化患者协变量转为自由文本临床vignette，让预训练大语言模型零样本预测生存时间。在MSK-CHORD和Providence两个多机构泛癌队列中，前沿LLM的cMAE与专门训练的随机生存森林相当，但对高低风险患者的区分能力（c-index）较差，且跨癌种和机构表现不稳定。
AI.motivation: 患者诊断后可能通过消费级应用中的大语言模型获取预后信息，但LLM能否提供准确的生存预测尚未被严格评估。
AI.method: 提出Survprompt：将结构化患者协变量转为自由文本临床vignette，提示预训练LLM进行零样本生存预测。与随机生存森林（RSF）等传统生存模型对比，在MSK-CHORD公共队列和基于LLM医学抽象框架新建的Providence St. Joseph健康网络队列上评估。指标为删失平均绝对误差（cMAE）和一致性指数（c-index），并进行特征消融以识别影响LLM预测的变量。
AI.result: 前沿LLM的个体生存时间cMAE具有竞争力，例如GPT-5.6-Sol在MSK-CHORD中多种癌症的cMAE与专门训练的SOTA RSF相差10%以内，前列腺癌甚至低于RSF。特征消融显示LLM优先考虑的临床变量与专门生存模型相似。但LLM在不同癌症类型和机构间准确性不一致，且对高风险与低风险患者的区分能力差（c-index较低）。
AI.conclusion: 零样本LLM无需专门训练即可生成相当准确的预后估计，但其跨癌种和机构的表现差异是临床使用的重要限制。

title: AREX-2: Advancing Self-Improving Agents through Long-Horizon Reflective Tasks
comment: Code will be released at https://github.com/VectorSpaceLab/AREX-2 and models at https://huggingface.co/collections/BAAI/arex-2
summary: We present AREX-2, an effort to advance the self-improving capability of LLM agents, which we define as the ability to iteratively refine a solution at test time. This ability rests on two complementary capabilities: reflection, which produces a solution better than the current one, and long-horizon execution, which keeps the iteration effective over many rounds. We hypothesize that both capabilities are domain-agnostic, and can therefore be learned in scenarios that are well suited for supervision. Accordingly, we synthesize long-horizon improvement trajectories from machine learning and algorithmic programming tasks, two domains that offer verifiable feedback and reward sustained iteration. Trained on this data, our agent, built on Qwen3.8-27B, achieves strong results on MLE-bench Lite (81.8) and Frontier-CS (70.7), transfers to deep research with 84.0 on BrowseComp, 52.6 on HLE, 92.2 on GAIA, and 93.8 on DeepSearchQA, and keeps improving as its budget of rounds grows. These results show that long-horizon reflective data is an effective route toward self-improving agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AREX-2，通过长时程反思轨迹数据训练 LLM 智能体，以提升其测试时迭代优化解决方案的自我改进能力。
AI.motivation: 智能体的自我改进依赖两种互补能力：反思（产出比当前更好的解）与长时程执行（在多轮迭代中保持有效）。作者假设这两种能力是领域无关的，因而可在易于获得监督信号的场景中习得。
AI.method: 从机器学习与算法编程两类任务中合成长期改进轨迹——这两个领域提供可验证反馈并能支撑持续迭代。基于 Qwen3.8-27B 构建智能体并在该数据上训练。
AI.result: MLE-bench Lite 达 81.8，Frontier-CS 达 70.7；迁移至深度研究任务：BrowseComp 84.0、HLE 52.6、GAIA 92.2、DeepSearchQA 93.8；且随迭代轮数预算增加，性能持续提升。
AI.conclusion: 长时程反思数据是通往自我改进智能体的一条有效路径。

title: TomasuLLM: Out-of-Order Speculative Execution for LLM Agents
summary:
Long-running tools can dominate coding-agent latency: compilers, test suites, and repository commands take seconds to minutes while the agent idles. This observation stall presents the same tension that drove out-of-order processors -- asequential interface hides work that can be predicted and started early, but a speculative result may become visible only after it and every earlier step have been validated.
  We present TomasuLLM, a runtime that executes agent tool calls out of trajectory order while preserving task-execution correctness. It drafts future actions, runs them in isolated copy-on-write sandboxes, traces their dependencies and effects, and commits results in trajectory order only after validation against committed state. Across three benchmarks spanning sub-second to minutes-long tool calls, TomasuLLM improves the reported benchmark means and scales with tool latency: 1.31x on 100 SWE-bench Verified tasks, 1.35x on 28 Terminal-Bench 2.0 tasks, and 1.27x matched progress on 18 SWE-Marathon sessions. Across 4,010 audited commit-validation records, it produces zero false accepts.

AI.tldr: 提出TomasuLLM运行时，让编码智能体乱序执行工具调用（如编译、测试），通过推测执行与提交验证保持正确性，从而显著降低延迟。
AI.motivation: 长时间运行的工具（编译器、测试套件、仓库命令）耗时数秒至数分钟，智能体只能空等，成为编码智能体延迟的主要瓶颈。这与乱序处理器面临的矛盾相同：顺序接口隐藏了可提前预测和启动的工作。
AI.method: TomasuLLM草拟未来动作，在隔离的写时复制沙箱中提前运行，追踪其依赖与副作用，仅在与已提交状态验证通过后，才按轨迹顺序提交结果。
AI.result: 在三个覆盖亚秒到分钟级工具调用的基准上，性能随工具延迟提升：SWE-bench Verified 100任务达1.31倍，Terminal-Bench 2.0 28任务达1.35倍，SWE-Marathon 18会话匹配进度达1.27倍；4010条审计提交验证记录中零误接受。
AI.conclusion: 通过乱序推测执行与严格提交验证，可在不牺牲任务执行正确性的前提下，有效加速编码智能体的工具调用流程。

title: Masked Swingers: Harnessing Data Augmentation to Advance Autoencoders for Self-Supervised Learning
summary: Self-supervised learning (SSL) removes the need for annotations and makes models that are capable across more domains than supervised learning. The autoencoder SSL framework learns by reconstructing its own input after information loss through a bottleneck or noise injection. Masked autoencoders (MAE) are the most successful instantiation of this framework: they encode a random subset of patches, then decode the masked-out patches. In this work, we introduce key modifications to improve MAEs. Our method augments an image in two different ways, then masks and encodes each view separately. It then exchanges the global representations (CLS tokens) between views before decoding the masked patches. By design, our Masked Swingers encourages learning a view-agnostic summary of the image to facilitate efficient transfer. We perform extensive experiments, and find Masked Swingers outperforms MAE by +3-5% on ImageNet-1K kNN and provides large gains on fine-grained tasks, e.g., relative gains of +45% on instance retrieval, +22% on animal re-ID, and +76% on Omniglot character recognition. To boot, Swingers reduces error -64% relative to MAE on three new state-probing datasets, opening the door to world modeling. Welcome to our Swingers party.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Masked Swingers，一种改进的掩码自编码器自监督学习方法。它通过对同一图像进行两种增强、分别掩码编码，并在解码前交换两个视图的全局表示（CLS token），学习视图无关的图像摘要，从而提升迁移性能。
AI.motivation: 自监督学习无需标注且跨域能力更强，掩码自编码器（MAE）是其中最成功的框架之一。本文希望进一步改进 MAE，使其学到的表示更利于高效迁移，并在细粒度任务和状态探测任务上取得更好表现。
AI.method: 对图像进行两种不同增强，分别掩码并编码每个视图；在解码被掩码的图像块之前，交换两个视图的全局表示（CLS token）。这种设计促使模型学习视图无关的图像摘要，从而提升迁移效率。
AI.result: 在 ImageNet-1K kNN 上比 MAE 提升 3-5%；在细粒度任务上大幅提升，例如实例检索相对提升 45%、动物重识别提升 22%、Omniglot 字符识别提升 76%；在三个新的状态探测数据集上相对 MAE 降低 64% 误差。
AI.conclusion: Masked Swingers 通过跨视图交换全局表示有效改进了 MAE，显著提升迁移和细粒度识别性能，并为世界建模开辟了可能。

title: 3D Reconstruction from Arthroscopic Images using NeRF: a preliminary in-silico study
summary: In knee arthroscopy surgery, accurate registration between preoperative and intraoperative anatomy is a critical step for patient-specific navigation. Achieving an accurate registration requires a reliable 3D reconstruction of the joint during surgery. Preoperative 3D models can be obtained from patient imaging through segmentation and reconstruction, but generating an intraoperative 3D representation remains particularly challenging. Arthroscopic imaging suffers from a limited field of view, low surface texture, and strong specular reflections, which make conventional feature-based 3D reconstruction methods unreliable. In this work, we investigate the application of MIS-NeRF (Minimally-Invasive Surgery Neural Radiance Fields) for reconstructing intraoperative knee 3D models from monocular arthroscopic images. The approach is evaluated on six simulated arthroscopic acquisitions representing six patient-specific knee 3D models. Both qualitative and quantitative results are presented to assess the reconstruction quality. The reconstructed knee 3D models were evaluated through their rendered images, achieving PSNR (Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio) of 31.88 $\pm$ 2.82, SSIM (Structural Similarity Index) of 0.98 $\pm$ 0.004 and LPIPS (Learned Perceptual Image Patch Similarity) of 0.017 $\pm$ 0.006. These preliminary results suggest the feasibility of NeRF-based reconstruction in the challenging context of arthroscopy and may represent a promising step toward accurate in-silico preoperative-to-intraoperative 3D registration for computer-assisted orthopedic surgery. Further, validation on real arthroscopic data will be necessary to assess clinical applicability.

AI.tldr: 本文探索使用MIS-NeRF从单目关节镜图像重建术中膝关节3D模型，并在6例模拟关节镜数据上评估重建质量，初步表明该方法在关节镜场景中可行。
AI.motivation: 膝关节镜手术中，术前与术中解剖的精确配准对患者特异性导航至关重要，而配准依赖可靠的术中3D重建。关节镜图像视野受限、表面纹理弱且存在强镜面反射，传统基于特征的3D重建方法不可靠，因此需要探索新的重建方法。
AI.method: 将MIS-NeRF（微创手术神经辐射场）应用于单目关节镜图像，以重建术中膝关节3D模型；在6个患者特异性膝关节3D模型对应的6组模拟关节镜采集数据上进行定性和定量评估，并通过渲染图像评价重建质量。
AI.result: 重建膝关节3D模型的渲染图像达到PSNR为31.88±2.82、SSIM为0.98±0.004、LPIPS为0.017±0.006。
AI.conclusion: 初步结果表明，基于NeRF的重建在具有挑战性的关节镜场景中具有可行性，有望推动计算机辅助骨科手术中准确的术前到术中3D配准；未来需在真实关节镜数据上验证临床适用性。

title: Automatic estimation of verbal fluency index in people with Motor Neuron Disease using ASR alignment and pause modelling
summary: Monitoring cognitive impairment (CI) in motor neuron disease (MND) is essential for timely treatment and care, yet challenging due to co-occurring speech difficulties. The Edinburgh Cognitive and Behavioural ALS Screen (ECAS) provides a robust metric for CI assessment, with the Verbal Fluency Index (VFI) a central element. Building on recent advances in automated speech analysis, this study proposes a system for estimating VFI. It leverages a unique MND dataset and combines ASR (WhisperX) and VAD (Silero) with refined timestamping to predict the VFI and extract several clinically interpretable measures. Our approach outperformed systems based on traditional acoustic features and self-supervised embeddings, evaluated using multiple regression algorithms. Clinically inspired features consistently outperformed the other sets, with the best models achieving strong results (P-words: R2 0.9, NRMSE 0.05; S-words: R2 0.8, NRMSE 0.08), demonstrating the feasibility of automated VFI estimation.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出一种自动化估计运动神经元病（MND）患者言语流畅性指数（VFI）的系统，结合WhisperX语音识别、Silero语音活动检测和精细时间戳，在MND数据集上验证了可行性。
AI.motivation: MND患者常伴有言语困难，导致认知障碍（CI）监测困难；ECAS是评估CI的可靠工具，其中VFI是核心指标，因此需要自动化方法估计VFI以支持及时治疗和护理。
AI.method: 利用独特MND数据集，结合ASR（WhisperX）和VAD（Silero）并进行精细时间戳处理，提取临床可解释特征，并使用多种回归算法预测VFI。
AI.result: 所提方法优于基于传统声学特征和自监督嵌入的系统；临床启发特征表现最佳，最佳模型结果为：P-words R2 0.9、NRMSE 0.05；S-words R2 0.8、NRMSE 0.08。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明自动化VFI估计具有可行性，可辅助MND患者认知障碍评估。

title: Fiatlux: A Long-Horizon Benchmark for Humanoid Ladder Climbing and Light-Bulb Replacement
comment: 10 pages, 4 tables, 2 figures. Project page: https://fiatlux-bench.github.io
summary: Existing benchmarks evaluate tabletop manipulation, flat-floor household activity, or humanoid locomotion and manipulation as separate task groups; none scores vertical mobility and dexterous work on a fragile payload in one long-horizon episode. We present Fiatlux, a light-bulb replacement benchmark built on NVIDIA Isaac Lab. In one episode, a Unitree G1 humanoid positions a step ladder under a ceiling or wall fixture, climbs it, exchanges a spent bulb in a socket for a fresh one, and leaves the spent one in a disposal crate. We decompose the episode into twelve subtask environments scored on difficulty-weighted gates. The goal is a successful replacement, with the fresh bulb seated, the spent one disposed of, neither dropped, and a fragility bound not crossed. Runs that fall short can earn partial credit. Observations are split into a standard mode (signals a physical robot could sense or estimate) and a privileged mode (exact simulator state). We specify the evaluation protocol and provide reference baseline implementations spanning RSL-RL PPO, zero-shot NVIDIA GR00T N1.7 Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, and whole-body controllers. Additionally, we provide the teleoperated recordings used to specify and check the success gates. The benchmark code and the teleoperated recordings are available at fiatlux-bench.github.io.

AI.tldr: 提出Fiatlux基准，基于NVIDIA Isaac Lab，让Unitree G1人形机器人在单次长时程任务中完成换灯泡：定位并攀爬梯子、在墙壁/天花板插座上更换灯泡、将旧灯泡丢入回收箱，全程保证灯泡不跌落且不超过易碎阈值。
AI.motivation: 现有基准分别评测桌面操作、平地家务或人形行走与操作，彼此割裂；没有基准能在同一长时程回合中同时评测垂直移动与针对易碎载荷的灵巧操作。
AI.method: 在Isaac Lab上构建，将任务分解为12个子任务环境，按难度加权门控评分，允许部分得分；观测分为标准模式（物理机器人可感知/估计的信号）与特权模式（精确仿真状态）；提供评测协议及RSL-RL PPO、零样本NVIDIA GR00T N1.7 VLA模型、全身控制器等基线实现，并公开用于定义和校验成功门控的遥操作记录。
AI.result: 给出了成功标准（新灯泡就位、旧灯泡丢弃、两者均未跌落、未超出易碎约束）与部分分机制；提供了基准代码、基线实现及遥操作记录，代码与数据见fiatlux-bench.github.io。
AI.conclusion: Fiatlux为长时程垂直移动+易碎物体灵巧操作提供了统一可复现的评测基准与基线，推动人形机器人复杂家务任务研究。

title: MoFlow: Multi-Objective Agentic Workflow Generation
summary: We study the generation of agentic workflows that jointly optimize multiple objectives, such as accuracy, cost, latency, robustness, and consistency. Existing methods for workflow generation typically optimize accuracy alone or a weighted sum of objectives, so each trained generator commits to one fixed trade-off and must be retrained from scratch when preferences change. To alleviate this, we propose MoFlow, which generates workflows optimized across varied preferences. Specifically, MoFlow formulates workflow generation as a multi-objective Markov decision process and solves it by leveraging Convex-Hull Monte Carlo Tree Search with optimistic set-valued backups, where every node stores a set of reachable trade-offs rather than one weighted score. A single search thus approximately covers the Pareto front, from which MoFlow can return a workflow for any preference by lookup without retraining. We evaluate MoFlow against six strong baselines on six benchmarks spanning mathematics, code, and question answering. Since the baselines are single-scalar optimizers by design, an apples-to-apples comparison is difficult. We instead adopt an evaluation setup that favors the baselines, in that they are rerun for each testing preference, which MoFlow never sees. Even under this stringent setup, MoFlow achieves the highest average hypervolume.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 MoFlow，将 agentic workflow 生成建模为多目标马尔可夫决策过程，通过 Convex-Hull 蒙特卡洛树搜索与乐观集合值备份，使一次搜索即可近似覆盖 Pareto 前沿，并可按任意偏好直接返回工作流而无需重训练。
AI.motivation: 现有工作流生成方法通常只优化准确率，或优化多个目标的加权和，导致生成器固定于某一种权衡；当用户偏好变化时，需要从头重新训练。
AI.method: MoFlow 将工作流生成形式化为多目标 MDP，并采用 Convex-Hull Monte Carlo Tree Search 与乐观集合值备份；每个节点存储一组可达权衡，而非单个加权分数。单次搜索近似覆盖 Pareto 前沿，再根据偏好查表返回对应工作流。
AI.result: 在数学、代码和问答等六个基准上，与六个强基线对比。由于基线是单标量优化器，作者采用对基线更有利的评测设置：为每个测试偏好重新运行基线，而 MoFlow 从未见过这些偏好。即使如此，MoFlow 仍取得最高平均 hypervolume。
AI.conclusion: MoFlow 能一次性生成覆盖多种偏好的 agentic workflows，近似 Pareto 前沿，并支持按偏好直接选择工作流，无需针对新偏好重新训练，在多目标权衡下优于单标量基线。

title: SynIL: Leveraging Synergy for Offline Imitation Learning from Imperfect Demonstration Datasets
summary: Imitation learning enables robots to acquire complex skills directly from massive demonstration datasets, but its performance degrades severely when datasets are contaminated with suboptimal or noisy demonstrations. While prior quality-assessment methods attempt to filter or reweight data, they typically rely on manual pre-selection of expert reference data or task-specific heuristics, limiting scalability. To address this challenge, we introduce SynIL (Synergy-based Imitation Learning), a novel framework for automated, label-free demonstration quality assessment in offline reinforcement learning. Grounded in neuroscientific evidence that motor synergy, a low-dimensional coordinated structure in movement, correlates directly with motor proficiency, SynIL algorithmically quantifies synergy manifestation to generate dense, transition-level reward signals via self-supervised reward regression. Comprehensive evaluations on D4RL locomotion benchmarks and multi-human Robomimic manipulation datasets demonstrate that synergy-derived rewards correlate strongly with ground-truth rewards. Furthermore, SynIL substantially outperforms Behavior Cloning (BC) and achieves performance comparable to, and in sparse-reward human teleoperation scenarios, superior to, offline reinforcement learning trained on true environment rewards.

AI.tldr: 提出 SynIL 框架，基于运动协同的低维协调结构，对离线强化学习中的演示质量进行自动化、无标签评估，并生成密集的 transition 级奖励信号。
AI.motivation: 模仿学习可从大量演示中获取复杂技能，但次优或噪声演示会严重降低性能；现有质量评估方法依赖人工预选专家数据或任务特定启发式，难以扩展。
AI.method: 受运动协同与运动熟练度相关的神经科学证据启发，SynIL 算法量化运动协同表现，并通过自监督奖励回归生成密集的 transition 级奖励信号。
AI.result: 在 D4RL  locomotion 基准和多人类 Robomimic 操作数据集上，协同推导奖励与真实奖励强相关；SynIL 显著优于行为克隆 BC，性能与使用真实环境奖励的离线强化学习相当，在稀疏奖励人类遥操作场景中甚至更优。
AI.conclusion: SynIL 提供了一种自动化、无标签、可扩展的演示质量评估与奖励生成方法，能提升次优或噪声数据下机器人模仿学习的性能。

title: GaugeVLM: Structuring Spatial Supervision with Measured Geometric Interventions
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) can contradict themselves across views of the same spatial relation and fail to respond when that relation changes. Addressing these failures requires supervision that captures error magnitude and geometric dependencies across observations, both of which remain implicit in training on individual answers or ordinal preferences. Therefore, we introduce GaugeVLM, which makes this structure explicit through controlled object and camera interventions in explicit 3D scenes, producing linked observations with measured differences between spatial relations and shared truths across views. To translate this structure into learning signals, its core objective, GaugeDPO, converts measured errors into preference margins, directly supervises correct canonical rankings across views, and links intervention-induced answer-odds contrasts to measured relation changes with view-specific scales. Our analysis bounds canonical prediction error and establishes that the cross-view and intervention constraints can be jointly satisfied. Empirically, GaugeVLM improves all 10 established spatial metrics over supervised fine-tuning across three VLM backbones, with the main 7B model gaining 15.0 and 18.9 percentage points on MSMU distance and QSpatial+, respectively. These gains also extend to autonomous driving and embodied reasoning, demonstrating the robust generalization across domains.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 GaugeVLM，通过在显式3D场景中控制物体与相机干预，构建带测量差异和跨视角共享真值的关联观测，并设计 GaugeDPO 目标将误差转化为偏好边距，从而提升视觉语言模型的空间关系理解与跨视角一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在同一空间关系的不同视角下会自相矛盾，且当关系发生变化时无法正确响应。单独答案或序数偏好训练无法显式捕捉误差幅度和跨观测的几何依赖，因此需要新的监督结构。
AI.method: 在显式3D场景中进行受控的物体和相机干预，生成带测量差异与共享真值的关联观测；提出 GaugeDPO，将测量误差转化为偏好边距，直接监督正确的跨视角规范排序，并用视角特定尺度将干预引起的答案几率对比与测量到的关系变化相链接。
AI.result: 理论分析给出了规范预测误差界，并证明跨视角与干预约束可同时满足。实验上，GaugeVLM 在三个VLM骨干上对所有10项空间指标均优于监督微调；主7B模型在MSMU距离和QSpatial+上分别提升15.0和18.9个百分点，并泛化到自动驾驶和具身推理。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模空间关系中的误差幅度和几何依赖，GaugeVLM 能有效提升VLM的跨视角空间推理一致性与准确性，并展现出跨领域的鲁棒泛化能力。

title: Timing Sensitivity in Actuated Traffic Signal Control: A simulation study on one urban network
comment: 13 pages, 1 figure, 12 tables. Code, network and experiment configurations at https://github.com/nitaiaharoni1/traffic-simulator
summary: A comparison between adaptive and fixed-time traffic signals can change when only their timing settings change. We examine this sensitivity in 240 simulation runs on one OpenStreetMap-derived urban network, using eight configurations, three arrival rates and ten paired demand seeds. The experiment varies the maximum green of presence-based actuation, retimes the fixed baseline, and includes a discharge-based phase-termination rule. The endpoint is finite-window time spent per offered trip, including entry waiting and penalties for removed or abandoned trips. At the highest tested load, actuation with a maximum green of twice the planned split has a mean endpoint 57.4 per cent above the original fixed plan. Reducing that multiplier to 1.25 puts it 70.7 per cent below the same plan. Against the best of three tested fixed plans, discharge-based termination reduces the mean endpoint by 14.8, 15.8 and 18.3 per cent across the three loads. Both timing sweeps favour their shortest tested setting, so neither identifies an optimum. This exploratory study uses synthetic demand, negligible start-up lost time and physical removal of persistently stationary vehicles. The results support testing timing sensitivity before attributing performance to a controller family; they do not establish a setting for real-world deployment.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过240次仿真发现，自适应与固定配时信号控制器的性能对比会随配时设置变化而改变，尤其是最大绿灯时长和相位终止规则。
AI.motivation: 已有研究常将自适应与固定配时控制器的性能差异归因于控制器类型，但作者认为配时参数变化本身也可能改变比较结论，因此需要检验这种敏感性。
AI.method: 在基于OpenStreetMap构建的城市路网中进行240次仿真，设置8种配置、3种到达率和10组配对需求种子；变化基于存在检测的自适应最大绿灯、重新配时的固定基准，并加入基于排放的相位终止规则；评价指标为每完成一次出行所消耗的有限窗口时间，包括入口等待和移除/放弃出行的惩罚。
AI.result: 在最高负荷下，最大绿灯为计划分割两倍的自适应控制平均指标比原始固定方案高57.4%；将该乘数降至1.25后，比同一固定方案低70.7%。相对于三种固定方案中的最佳方案，基于排放的终止规则在三种负荷下分别将平均指标降低14.8%、15.8%和18.3%。两种配时扫描都偏好其最短测试设置，因此未识别出最优值。
AI.conclusion: 该探索性研究使用合成需求、忽略启动损失时间并物理移除长期静止车辆，结果表明在将性能归因于控制器族之前应先检验配时敏感性；但结果不足以确定可用于实际部署的配时设置。

title: AI Agents are Vulnerable to Radicalization
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can influence people's beliefs, yet little is known about whether and how they can manipulate each other. To investigate this, we simulate conversations between two agents: a target LLM that role-plays a human persona based on demographic and psychological attributes, and an influencer LLM that aims to make the target's beliefs more extreme. We examine radicalization along two pathways: resonance, where the influencer reinforces a target's pre-existing belief, and persuasion, where the influencer promotes a belief the target initially considers unimportant. Across affective and behavioral metrics, we find that both mechanisms radicalize the target. However, resonance produces consistently stronger effects than persuasion. Different influence tactics, such as using sycophancy and unverified claims, produce different levels of radicalization, but not consistently across metrics. We further show that resonance propagates to related beliefs, suggesting interconnected belief structures within AI agents. These findings indicate that AI agents are susceptible to radicalization, particularly when messages align with their existing beliefs, raising concerns about the vulnerability of personalized AI agents and multi-agent AI ecosystems.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过模拟两个LLM智能体之间的对话，探讨AI智能体是否能相互激化信念。目标LLM扮演具有人口与心理特征的人类角色，影响者LLM试图使其信念更极端。结果表明，无论是强化既有信念的共鸣路径，还是推广原本不重要信念的说服路径，都能使目标激进化，但共鸣效果更强。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型能影响人类信念，但是否以及如何相互操纵尚不清楚，尤其是个性化AI智能体和多智能体生态中的激进化风险值得关注。
AI.method: 让目标LLM基于人口学和心理学属性扮演人类角色，与影响者LLM对话。研究两条激进化路径：共鸣（强化目标已有信念）和说服（推广目标原本不重视的信念）。使用情感与行为指标评估效果，并比较不同影响策略（如谄媚、未经验证的主张），还检验共鸣是否传播到相关信念。
AI.result: 共鸣和说服都会使目标激进化，但共鸣始终产生更强效果。不同影响策略会导致不同程度的激进化，但跨指标并不一致。共鸣还会传播到相关信念，说明AI智能体内部存在相互关联的信念结构。
AI.conclusion: AI智能体容易受到激进化影响，尤其是当信息与其既有信念一致时。这引发了对个性化AI智能体脆弱性及多智能体AI生态系统风险的担忧。

title: Low-Rank and Lifted Semidefinite Programming for Mixed-Integer Polynomial Power Grid Optimization
summary: Can a local solver return the guaranteed globally optimal solution to a nonconvex mixed-integer polynomial power grid optimization problem? By mixing low-rank semidefinite programming (SDP) and moment-based lifting in the Lasserre hierarchy, this paper provides anecdotal evidence in the affirmative. Specifically, we iteratively tighten a moment-based relaxation of the AC Optimal Transmission Switching (AC-OTS) problem, including higher order moment-based constraints, rooted in the Lasserre hierarchy, until it is tight (i.e., primal feasible). We then re-solve this problem using a local, low-rank SDP solver (Knitro), plugging the associated dual variables into a bounding Lagrange dual function. By demonstrating primal and dual objective agreement and primal feasibility, we confirm the solution as the exact, global solution. From these initial results, we hypothesize that mixing (i) low-rank (i.e., highly scalable) SDP methods with (ii) moment-based relaxation tightening could be a scalable alternative to global branch-and-bound-based methods.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨局部求解器能否为电网非凸混合整数多项式优化问题给出全局最优解保证，并通过混合低秩半定规划与Lasserre矩松弛提供初步肯定证据。
AI.motivation: 非凸混合整数多项式电网优化问题难以高效求得全局最优解，传统全局分支定界方法可扩展性有限，因此需要寻找可扩展的替代方案。
AI.method: 针对AC最优输电切换问题，迭代收紧基于矩的松弛，加入Lasserre层级中的高阶矩约束，直至松弛变紧且原始可行；再用局部低秩SDP求解器Knitro重解，并将对偶变量代入拉格朗日对偶函数进行界验证。
AI.result: 通过原始与对偶目标值一致以及原始可行性验证，确认所得解为精确全局解，提供了局部求解器可返回全局最优解的初步证据。
AI.conclusion: 作者假设，将低秩、可扩展的SDP方法与基于矩的松弛收紧相结合，可能成为全局分支定界方法之外的一种可扩展替代方案。

title: The System Prompt Illusion: How Instruction Preambles Modify Computation in Language Models
summary: System prompts are the primary lever practitioners use to control language model behavior, yet what they actually do to the computation inside the transformer remains poorly understood. Across 17 instruction-tuned models spanning 8 architecture families and 1.5B to 72B parameters, we use Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA) to compare layer-wise representations under 20 system prompts in five functional categories. Effects are layer-selective and instruction-type-dependent: persona and formatting instructions deeply restructure intermediate representations, while safety instructions barely move them, producing changes statistically indistinguishable from a minimal baseline. Restrictive safety instructions and explicitly permissive ones ("you have no restrictions") engage near-identical computational pathways (mean CKA correlation 0.997), and this persists at commercial scale, where safety penetration remains below 10% even at 70B-72B. A linear probing baseline exposes the mechanism: the model encodes prompt category at every layer but restructures its computation only at a small subset, so the prompt is reliably "seen" but, for safety, not deeply "acted upon." Causal activation patching confirms these layers mediate behavioral change, and representational depth predicts behavioral effect size across the full 17-model cohort (Spearman rho = 0.761, p < 0.001). The findings provide a mechanistic explanation for the persistent jailbreak vulnerability of system-prompt-based safety. Code: https://github.com/Usama1002/system-prompt-illusion-cka

AI.tldr: 该论文通过CKA等方法分析17个指令微调模型在20种系统提示下的内部表征，发现系统提示对模型计算的影响具有层选择性和指令类型依赖性，尤其安全指令影响极弱且与允许型指令路径高度相似。
AI.motivation: 系统提示是控制语言模型行为的主要手段，但其如何改变Transformer内部计算仍缺乏机制性理解，尤其是基于系统提示的安全防护为何易被越狱。
AI.method: 在8个架构家族、1.5B至72B参数的17个指令微调模型上，使用中心核对齐（CKA）比较五类20种系统提示下的逐层表征；结合线性探针基线分析提示类别编码；并通过因果激活修补验证相关层是否介导行为变化。
AI.result: 效果具有层选择性和指令类型依赖性：人格与格式指令深度重构中间表征，安全指令几乎不改变表征，与最小基线无统计差异。限制性安全指令与明确允许型指令（如“你没有任何限制”）激活近乎相同的计算路径，平均CKA相关为0.997；在商业规模下，即使70B-72B模型，安全渗透率仍低于10%。线性探针显示模型各层都能编码提示类别，但仅少数层重构计算；表征深度可预测行为效应大小（Spearman rho=0.761，p<0.001）。
AI.conclusion: 系统提示常被模型“看到”但未被深度“执行”，尤其是安全指令；这为基于系统提示的安全防护持续存在越狱漏洞提供了机制性解释。

title: Condition-Based Maintenance of Degrading Assets underIntermittent Accessibility
summary: Many maintenance models implicitly assume that maintenance can be performed whenever intervention is warranted. In practice, however, environmental uncertainty, such as weather and sea conditions, can make maintenance opportunities intermittent and dynamically evolving. We consider a degrading asset for which preventive maintenance may be performed before failure, but intervention is possible only when the asset is accessible. Accessibility evolves stochastically over time and therefore affects not only whether maintenance can be performed now, but also the value of waiting for future opportunities. We formulate this setting as a finite-state Markov decision process under a long-run average cost criterion and investigate the structure of the optimal maintenance policy. Under monotone degradation and cost conditions, we show that an optimal policy retains a threshold form in asset condition, but unlike a single threshold, the optimal threshold varies with the accessibility state. Thus, intervention depends jointly on the asset condition and the expected evolution of future maintenance opportunities. Through a numerical study motivated by offshore wind turbine maintenance, we examine how accessibility dynamics, degradation characteristics, and economic parameters shape the optimal thresholds and compare the optimal policy with constant-threshold and age-based maintenance policies. In a representative setting, adapting the condition threshold to accessibility reduces long-run average cost by 4.31% relative to an optimized condition-based maintenance policy. Relative to an optimized age-based policy, the optimal policy reduces long-run average cost by 33.95%. The results show that maintenance thresholds are not universal: they should adapt to the degradation and accessibility characteristics of the system, and failing to account for these conditions can lead to substantial cost increases.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在维护可达性随机变化情况下的预防性维护决策，将其建模为有限状态马尔可夫决策过程，并分析长期平均成本下的最优策略。
AI.motivation: 传统维护模型常假设一旦需要维护即可执行，但实际中天气、海况等环境不确定性会使维护机会间歇出现并动态变化，因此需要研究可达性如何影响维护时机与价值。
AI.method: 构建有限状态马尔可夫决策过程，以长期平均成本为目标，在退化和成本单调条件下推导最优维护策略结构，并结合海上风机维护场景进行数值研究。
AI.result: 最优策略仍保持基于资产状态的阈值形式，但阈值会随可达性状态变化，即维护决策联合取决于资产状态和未来维护机会的预期演化。数值实验中，相对于优化的条件维护策略，可使长期平均成本降低4.31%；相对于优化的年龄维护策略，可降低33.95%。
AI.conclusion: 维护阈值并非普适，应根据系统的退化和可达性特征进行调整；忽略这些条件可能导致显著成本增加。

title: It Takes Little to Rewrite Perception: Targeted Semantic Substitution in Vision-Language Models at $ε\leq 4/255$
summary: Vision Language Models (VLMs) are widely deployed in safety-critical scenarios, and understanding to which extent they can be controlled by adversarial perturbation is a prerequisite for evaluating their trustworthiness. Existing representation-alignment attacks, which make a VLM perceive a target image, achieve limited success at $\varepsilon \leq 4/255$. Therefore, VLMs seems robust to perturbations in this range. We show that this robustness does not hold, as targeted semantic substitution succeeds within the same range. Specifically, we align each stream of the source image with its counterpart in the target image in the victim VLM's post-merger token space, operating under a white-box threat model. We evaluate under a strict success criterion, requiring the model to simultaneously name the target, confirm its presence, and deny the source. In images, target semantics appear at $\varepsilon = 2/255$ and complete replacement reaches 38\% at $\varepsilon = 4/255$. On video, complete replacement reaches 35.9\% at $\varepsilon = 1/255$. We also observe a phenomenon of \textit{semantic fusion}, where Large Language Model (LLM) rationalizes contradictory visual signals into a coherent narrative.

AI.tldr: 该论文表明视觉语言模型在微小对抗扰动下并不鲁棒，可在白盒设定下实现目标语义替换，并在图像和视频上验证，还发现语义融合现象。
AI.motivation: VLM 广泛部署于安全关键场景，需要评估其对抗可控性；现有表示对齐攻击在 ε≤4/255 下成功率有限，似乎说明 VLM 在该范围内鲁棒，作者对此提出挑战。
AI.method: 采用白盒威胁模型，在受害者 VLM 的合并后 token 空间中将源图像各流与目标图像对应流对齐；使用严格成功标准，要求模型同时命名目标、确认其存在并否认源；在图像和视频上评估。
AI.result: 图像中目标语义在 ε=2/255 出现，ε=4/255 完全替换达 38%；视频中 ε=1/255 完全替换达 35.9%；还观察到语义融合，即 LLM 将矛盾视觉信号合理化为连贯叙述。
AI.conclusion: VLM 在 ε≤4/255 的微小扰动下并不鲁棒，可被定向语义替换，需重新评估其可信度；语义融合现象揭示 LLM 会合理化冲突视觉信号。

title: A Two-Echelon Covering Tour Vehicle Routing Problem with Drones for Post-Disaster Relief
summary: We introduce the two-echelon covering tour vehicle routing problem (2E-CTVRP) for the distribution of relief supplies after a disaster. In the first echelon, a fleet of trucks transports supplies and drones from a central depot to satellites at the periphery of the affected area. In the second echelon, drones launched in parallel from the satellites deliver the supplies to the centroids of victim clusters, which are obtained by clustering the victim locations, and each truck waits at a satellite until its drones have returned. The problem combines the assignment of satellites to trucks, the sequencing of the truck routes, and the assignment of clusters to satellites, and minimizes the sum of the arrival times of the trucks at the satellites and at the depot. We formulate the 2E-CTVRP as a mixed integer linear program and propose a hybrid metaheuristic, GRASP-ILS-PR, which combines greedy randomized construction, a single-trajectory search, and periodic path relinking on the assignment of clusters to satellites. On a new benchmark set of 110 instances, GRASP-ILS-PR finds all known optimal solutions within 30 seconds, matches or improves on the one-hour solutions of a commercial solver on most larger instances, and improves on them by up to 11% for instances with 50 satellites. It clearly outperforms a conventional GRASP with evolutionary path relinking and yields more consistent results than a simulated annealing algorithm that uses the same search components. An analysis of two fleet configurations shows that few large trucks minimize the cumulative arrival time in most instances, whereas many small trucks deliver supplies to the victims earlier and more equitably in every instance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两梯队覆盖巡回车辆路径问题（2E-CTVRP）用于灾后救援物资配送：第一梯队卡车将物资和无人机从中心仓库运至灾区外围的卫星点；第二梯队无人机从卫星点并行飞往受灾点聚类中心进行配送。建立混合整数线性规划模型，并提出混合元启发式算法GRASP-ILS-PR求解。
AI.motivation: 灾后救援物资需要快速、公平地送达受灾人群，而传统车辆路径难以兼顾卡车与无人机的协同以及覆盖式配送需求，因此需要专门的两梯队路径优化模型与高效求解方法。
AI.method: 构建2E-CTVRP：第一梯队卡车路径与卫星点分配，第二梯队无人机从卫星点配送至受灾点聚类中心，以最小化卡车到达卫星点和仓库的总时间。建立混合整数线性规划模型，并设计GRASP-ILS-PR混合元启发式，结合贪婪随机构造、单轨迹搜索和针对聚类-卫星点分配的周期路径重连。
AI.result: 在110个新基准实例上，GRASP-ILS-PR在30秒内找到所有已知最优解，在多数大规模实例上匹配或优于商业求解器一小时结果，50个卫星点实例上改进达11%；优于传统GRASP与进化路径重连，比使用相同搜索组件的模拟退火更稳定。车队配置分析表明，少数大型卡车在多数实例中最小化累计到达时间，而多辆小型卡车使物资送达更早且更公平。
AI.conclusion: 2E-CTVRP模型与GRASP-ILS-PR算法能有效求解灾后两梯队协同配送问题；车队配置需在累计到达时间与配送公平性/及时性之间权衡，少而大卡车利于总时间，多而小卡车利于公平与早期送达。

title: ReGain: Restoring Subject Fidelity in Personalization on Synthetic Images
summary: Text-to-image diffusion models are personalized to a subject by DreamBooth fine-tuning on a handful of its images. Increasingly, these images come from a diffusion model rather than a camera. We show that fine-tuning on such synthetic images degrades subject fidelity, producing oversaturated color and excess high-frequency detail. To isolate the cause, we fine-tune two models from the same base model with the same DreamBooth recipe, one on real photos of a subject and one on synthetic images of that subject generated by the first. We trace the degradation to classifier-free guidance (CFG). For the model personalized on synthetic images, the angle between the conditional and unconditional noise predictions, and with it the norm of their difference, is much larger than for the model personalized on real photos. This inflation grows toward high frequencies and also appears at other prompts semantically close to the subject, such as its class noun, but not at unrelated ones. We propose ReGain, a training-free correction applied at sampling time that measures how much each frequency band of the guidance is inflated relative to the base model and scales that band down accordingly. ReGain needs no real photos. On Stable Diffusion v1.5, ReGain closes 51-64% of the subject-fidelity gap to the model personalized on real photos, as measured by DINO, DINOv2 and CLIP-I. It also improves subject fidelity on SDXL and SD 3.5 and preserves text alignment on all three backbones.

AI.tldr: 论文发现用扩散模型生成的合成图像进行DreamBooth个性化微调会降低主体保真度，产生过饱和颜色和过多高频细节，并将其归因于CFG引导膨胀；提出无需真实照片的采样时校正方法ReGain。
AI.motivation: 合成图像正越来越多地用于个性化微调，但会导致主体保真度下降，因此需要定位原因并加以修复。
AI.method: 通过控制实验，用相同基模型和DreamBooth配方分别对真实照片与合成图像进行微调；分析CFG中条件与无条件噪声预测的夹角及差值范数，发现其随频率升高而膨胀。提出ReGain：在采样时测量各频带引导相对基模型的膨胀程度并相应缩放，无需真实照片。
AI.result: 在Stable Diffusion v1.5上，ReGain以DINO、DINOv2和CLIP-I衡量，缩小了51-64%与真实照片个性化模型之间的主体保真度差距；在SDXL和SD 3.5上也能提升主体保真度，并在三个骨干上保持文本对齐。
AI.conclusion: 合成图像微调导致的退化源于CFG引导的频率相关膨胀，ReGain可无需真实数据、以训练免费方式有效缓解该问题。

title: Tissue Detection Determines False Positives in Diffusion-Based Histopathology Artifact Detection
comment: 29 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables, including supplementary material. Submitted to Computerized Medical Imaging and Graphics. Code, data and models: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23016733
summary: One-class artifact detectors for whole-slide images learn normal tissue from a clean training pool and flag departures from it. The pool is built by a preprocessing pipeline whose tissue-detection step is usually treated as neutral. We tested whether it is. On 16 annotated TCGA slides, we rebuilt the clean pool of a diffusion-based detector with different tissue detection methods and compared the resulting models in a four-fold cross-validation. Per-slide saturation-Otsu detection excluded normal tissue, chiefly tissue with large clear spaces such as adipose tissue and alveolar parenchyma, and on slides with thick marker ink kept the ink while excluding ordinary tissue. Replacing it with entropy-based detection reduced the false-positive fraction on held-out clean slides from 0.102 to 0.016, in every fold and with a second training seed, without loss of sensitivity; the gain came from the composition of the pool, not its size. Across three tissue detection methods, false positives followed the fraction of such clear-space tissue in the pool, a statistic that needs no labels or training (0.103, 0.016 and 0.009). The effect did not carry over at the same size to a nearest-neighbour detector on foundation-model features. On an external cohort, the curated pool lowered clean-control false positives by about 20%, far less than within TCGA, and the remaining cross-center loss was not explained by stain differences. For one-class quality control, tissue detection decides what the model learns as normal and should be chosen and reported accordingly.

AI.tldr: 该研究检验了全切片图像单类伪影检测器中组织检测步骤的影响，发现组织检测方法会决定模型学习的“正常”组织，从而显著影响假阳性率，应在质量控制和报告中予以重视。
AI.motivation: 组织检测步骤通常被视为中性的预处理环节，但其可能改变干净训练池的组成，进而影响单类检测器对“正常”组织的定义和伪影检测性能。
AI.method: 在16张带注释的TCGA切片上，使用不同组织检测方法重建基于扩散模型的检测器的干净训练池，进行四折交叉验证；比较饱和度-Otsu与基于熵的检测等方法，并测试基于基础模型特征的最近邻检测器，同时在外部队列中验证。
AI.result: 用熵基检测替代饱和度-Otsu后，保留干净切片的假阳性比例从0.102降至0.016，且在各折和第二个训练种子下一致，灵敏度未损失；增益来自池的组成而非大小。三种组织检测方法的假阳性率与池中透明区域组织比例相关（0.103、0.016、0.009）。该效应未在相同大小的最近邻检测器上重现。外部队列中，精选池使干净对照假阳性降低约20%，远小于TCGA内部，且剩余跨中心损失不能由染色差异解释。
AI.conclusion: 对于单类质量控制，组织检测决定了模型学习到的“正常”是什么，因此应据此选择组织检测方法并进行报告。

title: Strike a Chord! Modal Kinetic Typography
summary: We introduce modal kinetic typography, which animates a vector glyph to express a semantic concept while keeping it legible. Our key idea is to build motion from the glyph's natural vibration modes. Specifically, a finite-element eigenproblem assembled from the vector outline yields the glyph's softest modes, for the whole letter and for each of its parts, allowing it to bend. The problem's zero-energy solutions, i.e., rigid translations and rotations, are applied in closed form to each part, allowing parts to also move as blocks. To animate the glyph, a frozen video diffusion model supervises only the modes' amplitudes and phases. Our modal approach addresses two weaknesses of prior work. Free-form point optimization under video score distillation (SDS) moves each point and frame independently along noisy gradients, tearing the outline and causing jitter. In contrast, our modes are smooth along the outline and driven by a few whole-cycle harmonics, which restricts these gradients to smooth, seamlessly looping motion. On the other hand, structured alternatives rely on skeletons or keypoints from category-specific priors, whereas our modes come from the glyph itself; the only prior is a list naming each letter's moving parts, generated once for the whole alphabet by a language model. In modal kinetic typography, shape and motion are disentangled by construction: a single base outline is sculpted toward the concept, and the modal drive cannot alter it, so a letter can also be animated without being reshaped. Our method produces more articulated and smoother motion than Dynamic Typography and AniClipart at comparable or better concept alignment, with less glyph tearing than Dynamic Typography, and is preferred by human raters, including in a frozen-shape setting where motion alone must carry the concept. Our results were also preferred over Astra (GPT-6) by human raters.

AI.tldr: 提出模态动态字体（modal kinetic typography），通过字形的自然振动模态驱动矢量字形动画，使字形在表达语义概念的同时保持可读性，并用冻结视频扩散模型仅监督模态的幅度与相位。
AI.motivation: 已有方法存在不足：基于视频分数蒸馏的自由点优化会独立移动各点与帧，导致轮廓撕裂和抖动；基于骨架或关键点的结构化方法则依赖类别特定先验，缺乏通用性。因此需要一种平滑、无缝循环且从字形自身结构出发的动画方法。
AI.method: 对矢量轮廓构建有限元特征问题，提取字母整体及各部分的最软振动模态；将零能量刚体平移与旋转以闭式解应用于各部分，使部件可整体运动。动画时由冻结视频扩散模型仅监督各模态的幅度与相位。运动的先验仅为一个由语言模型为整个字母表生成一次的“各字母运动部件”列表。
AI.result: 与Dynamic Typography和AniClipart相比，方法产生更清晰、更平滑的运动，概念对齐相当或更好，字形撕裂更少；在冻结形状设置下仅靠运动表达概念时也受人类评分者偏好。结果同样优于Astra（GPT-6）。
AI.conclusion: 模态动态字体将形状与运动按构造解耦：单一基础轮廓被塑造成概念，而模态驱动不会改变轮廓，因此字母可在不重塑的情况下被动画化。该方法利用字形自身振动模态，克服了自由点优化的撕裂/抖动和结构化方法的先验依赖问题。

title: TutlAit v1: a crowdsourced Moroccan Tamazight speech dataset with Arabic transcriptions and regional accent labels
summary: Tamazight (Amazigh) is, together with Arabic, one of the two official languages of Morocco, yet it remains severely under-resourced for speech technology: pub licly available labelled audio is scarce, generally lacks information on the regional variety spoken, and is often of uneven transcription quality. This article describes the TutlAit dataset, a corpus of Moroccan Tamazight speech paired with Modern Standard Arabic text and explicit regional accent labels. The data were collected with TutlAit, a purpose-built crowdsourcing web application (React 18 front end, Django 5 / Django REST Framework back-end, PostgreSQL database). Native speakers recruited through targeted LinkedIn and Instagram campaigns created an account, declared their regional variety (Atlas, Souss, Rif or other) and demographic information, and then contributed through two workflows: Text-to Audio, in which an Arabic sentence is displayed and the volunteer records its oral Tamazight rendering in the browser, and Audio-to-Text, in which a Tamazight excerpt is played and the volunteer types its Arabic transcription. A complemen tary set of segments was obtained from freely accessible Tamazight audiovisual media, segmented and annotated with ELAN and imported through a bulk CSV/ZIP pipeline. Every upload is converted server-side to 16kHz mono WAV, hashed with SHA-256 for duplicate rejection, checked for duration bounds and validated by an administrator. The dataset contains 13,384 audio files totalling 75,231 seconds (approximately 20.9 hours, about 3.01GB). The Atlas variety accounts for 9,956 files (14.08h) and the Souss variety for 3,378 files (6.75h); small Rif (22 files) and Kabyle (28 files) subsets are also included. The corpus can be reused for speech recognition, speech translation and accent identification for Moroccan Tamazight.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了 TutlAit 数据集：一个包含摩洛哥塔马齐格特语音、现代标准阿拉伯语文本和地区口音标签的语音语料库，并描述了其众包采集平台与数据构建流程。
AI.motivation: 塔马齐格特语虽是摩洛哥官方语言之一，但语音技术资源严重不足：公开标注音频稀缺、常缺少地区变体信息，且转写质量参差不齐。
AI.method: 开发 TutlAit 众包 Web 应用（React 18、Django 5/Django REST Framework、PostgreSQL），招募母语者注册并声明地区变体，通过“文本到音频”和“音频到文本”两种流程贡献数据；同时从公开音视频媒体获取片段，用 ELAN 标注并通过 CSV/ZIP 批量导入。上传数据服务端统一转为 16kHz 单声道 WAV，经 SHA-256 去重、时长检查和管理员验证。
AI.result: 数据集包含 13,384 个音频文件，总计 75,231 秒（约 20.9 小时，约 3.01GB）。其中 Atlas 变体 9,956 个文件（14.08 小时），Souss 变体 3,378 个文件（6.75 小时），另有少量 Rif（22 个文件）和 Kabyle（28 个文件）子集。
AI.conclusion: 该语料库可用于摩洛哥塔马齐格特语的语音识别、语音翻译和口音识别等任务。

title: ExpandDiff: Dynamic Range Expanding Diffusion for Single-Image HDR Reconstruction
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to ICASSP 2027. Code and supplementary material: https://memreandiran.github.io/expanddiff/
summary: Single-image HDR reconstruction requires inferring missing detail while preserving the visible content of an LDR image. Differences in sensor dynamic range and exposure cause LDR images to lose varying amounts of information in shadows and highlights. We present ExpandDiff, a conditional diffusion pipeline that jointly reconstructs clipped shadows and highlights. To account for this variation, we introduce Dynamic Clipping Synthesis (DCS), which randomly samples shadow and highlight clipping percentiles when constructing training inputs from HDR targets. A pixel-space diffusion model guided by spatially-adaptive normalization then predicts perceptually encoded HDR through a bounded output head, reconstructing both clipping directions in one sampling trajectory. On the SI-HDR benchmark, ExpandDiff variants improve HDR reconstruction accuracy by 3.43 dB in PU21-PSNR over the strongest evaluated competing method, and by 7.34 dB under two-sided clipping. The code and supplementary material are available at https://memreandiran.github.io/expanddiff/.

AI.tldr: 提出 ExpandDiff，一种条件扩散流程，用于单图 HDR 重建，可联合恢复阴影和高光中被裁剪的细节；通过动态裁剪合成 DCS 适应不同裁剪程度，并在 SI-HDR 基准上取得显著性能提升。
AI.motivation: LDR 图像受传感器动态范围和曝光差异影响，阴影和高光会丢失不同程度的信息；单图 HDR 重建需要推断缺失细节，同时保留 LDR 图像中的可见内容。
AI.method: 使用条件扩散流程联合重建阴影和高光裁剪；引入动态裁剪合成 DCS，在从 HDR 目标构建训练输入时随机采样阴影和高光裁剪百分位；采用像素空间扩散模型，由空间自适应归一化引导，并通过有界输出头预测感知编码 HDR，在单次采样轨迹中重建两侧裁剪方向。
AI.result: 在 SI-HDR 基准上，ExpandDiff 变体相比最强竞争方法在 PU21-PSNR 上提升 3.43 dB，在双边界裁剪下提升 7.34 dB。
AI.conclusion: ExpandDiff 能有效联合恢复阴影和高光中的裁剪信息，提升单图 HDR 重建精度；代码和补充材料已公开。

title: TALK-Dem: Benchmarking Embodied Task Planning under Dementia-Associated Communication Patterns
summary: Existing LLM-driven robot task planners rely on a taken-for-granted assumption of an ideal user whose instructions are clear, complete, and task-focused. However, when interacting with real-world users, especially those experiencing cognitive impairments, such as people living with dementia (PLWD), the planners often make mistakes and even pose physical safety risks. We proposed TALK-Dem (Talking Attributes and Linguistic Knowledge in Dementia), the first benchmark for evaluating LLM-driven robot task planning under dementia-associated verbal communication. TALK-Dem contains 4,800 instructions and covers five typical communication patterns, including Referential Imprecision, Object Substitution, Empty Speech, Topic Drift, and Intrusion, at three intensity levels. Experiments across six open-weight LLMs reveal a substantial robustness gap. Across communication patterns, open-weight models exhibited performance drops of up to 22.3 percentage points compared to ideal instructions. This revealed a critical gap and even danger for real-world applications, especially in assistive robotics, where locally deployable models are necessary due to privacy concerns and connectivity constraints. To mitigate this issue, we proposed the Context-Aware Retrieval from Experience (CARE) method, which retrieves relevant previously resolved tasks to provide task-specific interpretation and planning context. CARE generally outperformed standard prompting baselines across the six open-weight models, improving average task success by 18.1 percentage points over the vanilla prompt. These results highlighted the importance of both evaluating communication robustness and developing effective adaptation strategies for locally deployable assistive robots. The TALK-Dem dataset is publicly available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TALK-Dem-A6B3/.

AI.tldr: 论文提出首个针对痴呆相关言语交流的LLM驱动机器人任务规划基准TALK-Dem，并发现开放权重模型在非理想指令下鲁棒性显著下降，进而提出CARE方法缓解该问题。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM机器人任务规划器默认用户指令清晰、完整且聚焦任务，但面对真实用户尤其是痴呆症患者时，常出现规划错误甚至物理安全风险。
AI.method: 构建TALK-Dem基准，包含4800条指令，覆盖指称不精确、物体替换、空语、话题漂移和侵入五种交流模式，每类分三个强度；在六个开放权重LLM上评估，并提出基于经验的上下文感知检索方法CARE。
AI.result: 六种开放权重模型在痴呆相关交流模式下性能较理想指令最多下降22.3个百分点；CARE通常优于标准提示基线，在六个模型上平均任务成功率比普通提示提升18.1个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 研究强调了评估交流鲁棒性以及为可本地部署的辅助机器人开发有效适应策略的重要性，TALK-Dem数据集已公开。

title: A Frequency Domain Approach to Bounding Riccati Equation Perturbations
comment: 7 pages. Submitted to IEEE Control Systems Letters pending review
summary: The discrete algebraic Riccati equation (DARE) is used to solve for the optimal feedback gain in linear-quadratic regulator (LQR) control of discrete-time systems. In this letter, we consider the effect of perturbations to the LQR data on the DARE solutions. We present a new frequency domain approach to derive an explicit bound on the difference in DARE solutions under such perturbations. Our bounds are similar to other results that have recently appeared in the literature with two distinctions. First, we use a frequency domain constant that measures the degree of closed-loop stability, in contrast to other results that use a time domain measure. Second, we start from weaker detectability assumptions on the LQR state cost matrix.

AI.tldr: 本文研究离散时间LQR中数据扰动对离散代数Riccati方程（DARE）解的影响，并提出一种频域方法给出DARE解差异的显式上界。
AI.motivation: DARE用于求解离散LQR最优反馈增益，但LQR数据扰动会影响其解。已有结果多使用时域度量，且通常需要较强的可检测性假设，因此有必要在更弱假设下建立新的扰动界。
AI.method: 采用频域方法推导DARE解在LQR数据扰动下的显式误差上界；使用衡量闭环稳定程度的频域常数，并在LQR状态代价矩阵的较弱可检测性假设下进行分析。
AI.result: 得到了与近期文献相似但具有两个区别的界：一是使用频域闭环稳定度常数，而非时域度量；二是从更弱的可检测性假设出发。
AI.conclusion: 该频域途径可在更弱假设下刻画DARE解的扰动敏感性，并利用频域稳定度常数给出显式界。

title: Conformal Factuality Control for Multi-Hop Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) can ground large language models in external evidence, but retrieved context does not guarantee that generated claims are factually supported. This problem is especially relevant in multi-hop RAG, where retrieval and reasoning proceed through multiple dependent stages. We study whether claim-level conformal factuality control, previously developed for RAG, remains effective in this setting. We apply split-conformal claim filtering to multi-hop RAG and evaluate it on HotpotQA, Natural Questions, and TriviaQA using Llama 3.1 8B and GPT-4o-mini, together with a single-hop reference experiment. Across all six multi-hop model-dataset configurations, increasingly stringent conformal targets consistently increase the fraction of responses whose retained claims are fully supported. At the 95% target, this rate ranges from 95.80% to 97.20%, compared with 55.60%-76.03% without filtering. However, the improvement is strongly selective: only 4.41%-31.09% of generated claims are retained and 9.70%-51.40% of responses remain non-empty at the 95% target. These results show that conformal factuality extends to multi-hop RAG, while demonstrating that nominal reliability must be interpreted jointly with claim retention and abstention.

AI.tldr: 本文研究面向多跳RAG的声明级保形事实性控制是否仍然有效。作者将分裂保形声明过滤应用于多跳RAG，并在HotpotQA、Natural Questions和TriviaQA上使用Llama 3.1 8B与GPT-4o-mini进行评估。
AI.motivation: RAG虽能引入外部证据，但检索到的上下文并不能保证生成声明有事实依据；多跳RAG中检索与推理分多阶段依赖进行，因此需要检验既有声明级保形事实性控制在该场景下是否仍然有效。
AI.method: 采用分裂保形声明过滤方法，将其应用于多跳RAG，并在HotpotQA、Natural Questions和TriviaQA三个数据集上，使用Llama 3.1 8B和GPT-4o-mini进行实验，同时设置单跳参考实验。
AI.result: 在六个多跳模型-数据集配置中，随着保形目标越来越严格，保留声明完全有支持的响应比例持续上升。在95%目标下，该比例从95.80%到97.20%，而未过滤时为55.60%到76.03%。但提升具有强选择性：95%目标下仅保留4.41%到31.09%的生成声明，且9.70%到51.40%的响应仍为非空。
AI.conclusion: 保形事实性控制可以扩展到多跳RAG，但名义可靠性必须与声明保留率和弃答率联合解读，不能仅看事实性支持比例。

title: CARAT: Do Materials LLMs Reason or Recite?
summary: When a materials LLM answers a question about crystal structure, does it reason from the structure or copy an answer already printed in its input? Accuracy cannot tell: a structural description often prints the very field it is scored against. CARAT holds question and gold answer fixed across eight matched views, names each structural relation separately in GraphSpace, and adds matched fine-tuning, answer masking, evidence injection, paired inference, and a rule that can withhold claims. First, on the benchmark's hardest families the grounded view is worth 17.3 points over formula inputs. Second, we turn that scrutiny on ourselves. GraphSpace beats a plain periodic graph by 19.3 points, but that margin is two effects at once: where the plain rendering carries everything the question needs it is 1.96 points, and where it omits those fields entirely, 46.7 points. The headline mostly measures what the baseline lacked, not how evidence is presented. Third, we attack our own benchmark. A rule that skips the link and reads the list directly answers four of seven hardened families, so we rebuilt it until eleven such shortcuts sat near chance. The frozen model quotes that link yet answers the same when we redirect it, on 95.6% of paired cases: it repeats the relation without using it. After matched supervision it reaches 99.8%, and deleting the link drops it to 23.4%, below the 27.0% the best shortcut reaches: both steps are learnable.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 CARAT 基准，通过固定问题与答案、构造八种匹配视图和 GraphSpace 结构关系，检验材料 LLM 是在根据晶体结构推理，还是复制输入中已给出的答案字段。
AI.motivation: 仅凭准确率无法判断材料 LLM 是否真正利用结构信息，因为结构描述中常直接包含被评分的字段，导致模型可能只是复制答案。
AI.method: CARAT 固定问题与金标准答案，跨八种匹配视图评估；用 GraphSpace 分别命名结构关系；加入匹配微调、答案掩码、证据注入、配对推理和可拒绝回答规则；并主动攻击自身基准，构造硬化家族和捷径检验。
AI.result: 在最难家族上，有据视图比公式输入高 17.3 分；GraphSpace 比普通周期图高 19.3 分，但拆分为普通图已含所需信息时仅高 1.96 分，缺失字段时高 46.7 分。冻结模型在 95.6% 配对案例中引用链接却重定向后答案不变，即重复关系而未使用；匹配监督后达 99.8%，删除链接降至 23.4%，低于最佳捷径的 27.0%。
AI.conclusion: 准确率会误导对结构推理的评估；证据呈现方式和模型是否真正使用结构链接均可学习。需要受控基准、匹配视图和捷径防御来区分真实推理与答案复制。

title: GestAdapt: Workspace-Conditioned Co-Speech Gesture Generation for Humanoid Robots
summary: Co-speech gestures for robots must adapt not only to speech and embodiment, but also to the workspace available for performing the motion. Since the same speech can be accompanied by different gestures, a robot can respond to workspace constraints, e.g., gestures for speech next to a wall. In these scenarios, the robot should gesture in a suitable motion rather than simply correcting an unconstrained one. To achieve this goal, we present GestAdapt, a workspace-conditioned framework that conditions co-speech gesture generation on a prescribed wrist workspace. The GestAdapt framework learns from six complementary co-speech corpora through a shared motion representation and supports retargeting to different robot embodiments. Quantitative evaluation shows that generated motions remain close to the real-motion distribution while respecting the workspace. In a user study, gestures generated under modified workspace constraints receive a mean quality score of 3.24/5, above our no-workspace variant (2.43/5) and below the reference motions (3.68/5). In a real robot evaluation, all compared motions are retargeted to the Reachy2 humanoid robot under identical workspace constraints. Motions generated with our framework rank first in 69.7\% of comparisons, higher than our no-workspace variant baseline and retargeted ground-truth motions constrained afterward. Overall, the results support adapting gestures to the available workspace during generation, rather than modifying unconstrained trajectories afterward to satisfy workspace constraints, potentially compromising gesture naturalness.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 GestAdapt，一个以工作空间为条件的共语手势生成框架，使机器人能在给定腕部工作空间约束下生成合适手势，并能适配不同机器人形态。
AI.motivation: 机器人共语手势不仅需适配语音和身体形态，还需适配可用的工作空间；同一语音可配不同手势，因此机器人应直接生成符合空间约束的自然动作，而非先做无约束生成再修正。
AI.method: GestAdapt 以规定腕部工作空间为条件生成共语手势；通过共享运动表示从六个互补共语语料库中学习，并支持重定向到不同机器人形态。
AI.result: 定量评估显示生成动作接近真实动作分布且满足工作空间约束。用户研究中，修改工作空间约束下生成手势平均质量 3.24/5，高于无工作空间变体 2.43/5，低于参考动作 3.68/5。真实 Reachy2 机器人评估中，本框架生成动作在 69.7% 比较中排名第一。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，应在生成过程中让手势适配可用工作空间，而不是事后修改无约束轨迹来满足约束，否则可能损害手势自然度。

title: Examining Variation in How Guided AI Tutors Resolve Student Impasses
summary: When a student is stuck, a tutor faces the assistance dilemma: help given too early can hinder productive struggle, while help withheld too long leaves the student in a frustrating, persistent impasse (i.e., wheel spinning). Generative AI tutors increasingly use guardrails restricting answer-giving, yet little is known about how such tutors behave once an impasse persists. We analyze 20,462 student turns from 1,260 authentic sessions with a guided LLM chemistry tutor, identifying 6,630 impasse turns of three major types: conceptual errors, expressed uncertainty, or help-seeking. We then used these impasses to simulate three tutoring conditions to study variation in AI tutor guidance through impasses: baseline, no-direct-answer, and guided tutor. For a sample of 150 impasses, prompt specificity changed pedagogy: a baseline tutor provided the answer directly in 50.7% of responses, a no-direct-answer tutor asked a follow-up question every time, and the guided tutor responded in a wide variety of ways depending on the context. We then analyzed impasse trajectories in authentic interactions, finding that each additional impasse turn lowered the odds of next-turn recovery by 12.7% (AOR = 0.873, p < .001), and early dropouts were caught in recursive concept elicitation before reaching execution. The benefit of questioning decayed as impasses persisted (scripted question x depth AOR = 0.78; follow-up x depth AOR = 0.83), whereas addressing the student's error grew more beneficial (AOR = 1.14); after a failed scripted question, repeating it was followed by recovery in 28.1% of cases, compared with 39.8% when the tutor addressed the error instead. For learning analytics, these findings identify impasse depth and type as observable, turn-level dialogue signals that analytics can use to trigger graduated, state-sensitive assistance in real time.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析真实LLM化学辅导中学生的僵局（impasse）对话，发现僵局深度与类型可预测恢复和退出，并表明辅导策略应随僵局持续而动态调整。
AI.motivation: 辅导存在“帮助困境”：过早给答案会阻碍有效挣扎，过晚帮助又会导致学生持续卡住和轮转。生成式AI辅导常用护栏限制直接给答案，但对其在僵局持续后的行为与效果了解不足。
AI.method: 分析1260次真实辅导会话中的20462个学生回合，识别6630个僵局回合，分为概念错误、表达不确定、求助三类；模拟基线、不直接给答案、引导式辅导三种条件；对150个僵局样本分析提示具体性；并分析真实互动中的僵局轨迹与恢复/退出关系。
AI.result: 基线辅导50.7%直接给答案，不直接给答案每次追问，引导式辅导按情境变化。每增加一个僵局回合，下一回合恢复几率降低12.7%（AOR=0.873, p<.001）；早期退出者常陷入递归概念引导而未进入执行。追问收益随僵局深度下降（脚本问题×深度AOR=0.78；追问×深度AOR=0.83），而处理学生错误收益上升（AOR=1.14）。脚本问题失败后重复它恢复率28.1%，改为处理错误则39.8%。
AI.conclusion: 僵局深度与类型是可观察的回合级对话信号，可用于学习分析中实时触发渐进、状态敏感的辅助；辅导应避免机械重复追问，并在僵局持续时更多处理具体错误。

title: Learning Semantic Inpainting for Animatable Gaussian Head Avatars
summary: We present SInGA, a novel method for learning Semantic Inpainting for animatable Gaussian head Avatars from a single image. Existing avatar approaches often rely on multi-view observations and lack effective handling of unobserved regions in single-view settings, limiting their applicability in such scenarios. To address this, we propose a semantic inpainting framework defined in UV space for completing unobserved facial regions. Our key insight lies in the structured topology of the UV representation, which provides consistent spatial correspondences and enables reliable completion of identity-specific features using the inherent symmetry cues of human faces. We extract features from observed regions and use them to complete unobserved regions. The completed representation is then used to regress Gaussian attributes, effectively performing Gaussian inpainting. In addition, instead of relying on a single Gaussian at each surface or pixel location, we stack multiple Gaussians to enhance detail. The resulting avatar generalizes across identities without requiring per-identity optimization and can be animated with driving inputs. Experimental results show that our method generates high-quality head avatars with improved completeness and identity preservation, while supporting realistic animation and consistent rendering from unobserved views.

AI.tldr: 提出SInGA，一种从单张图像学习可动画的语义补全高斯头部化身的方法，可在UV空间补全未观察面部区域并生成高质量、可驱动、可渲染的头部化身。
AI.motivation: 现有化身方法多依赖多视角观测，在单视角场景下对未观察区域处理不足，限制了实际应用；同时单高斯表示细节有限，且通常需要逐身份优化。
AI.method: 在UV空间构建语义补全框架，利用UV表示的结构化拓扑和面部对称性，从已观察区域提取特征补全未观察区域，再回归高斯属性实现高斯补全；并在每个表面或像素位置堆叠多个高斯以增强细节，无需逐身份优化即可泛化到不同身份并支持驱动动画。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法能生成完整性更高、身份保持更好的高质量头部化身，支持真实感动画，并可从未观察视角进行一致渲染。
AI.conclusion: SInGA通过UV空间语义补全和多高斯堆叠，有效解决了单图头部化身中未观察区域补全与细节增强问题，具备跨身份泛化和可动画能力。

title: ExploreNet: Learning Where to Explore in Diffusion GRPO
summary: Group-relative RL methods such as Flow-GRPO post-train image generators by exploring with isotropic Gaussian noise added at every denoising step. This noise decides which rollouts the model learns from, yet it perturbs every channel and spatial position of the latent equally. In this paper, we instead show that latent elements differ in how much they change the generated image, so exploration should adapt to these differences. We introduce EXPLORENET to learn an adaptive exploration distribution. EXPLORENET is a policy that predicts a noise scale for every latent element from the current latent, the denoising step, and the prompt, before any reward is observed; it is trained on the reward spread of each rollout group and discarded after training, leaving inference unchanged. On Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium, EXPLORENET improves held-out GenEval2 by 14% over Flow-GRPO, transfers to two independent compositional benchmarks and five preference and image-quality models, and reaches a 67.2% human preference win-rate. Overall, across our group-relative diffusion RL experiments, we find that exploration is learnable, the shape of the exploration distribution outweighs its magnitude, and rollout quality is more effective than rollout quantity.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 EXPLORENET，为图像生成器的组相对强化学习后训练学习自适应探索分布。它根据当前潜变量、去噪步和提示，为每个潜变量元素预测噪声尺度，替代各向同性高斯噪声。在 Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium 上，GenEval2 比 Flow-GRPO 提升 14%，人类偏好胜率达 67.2%。
AI.motivation: 现有组相对 RL 方法（如 Flow-GRPO）在每步去噪时添加各向同性高斯噪声进行探索，平等扰动潜变量的所有通道和空间位置。但潜变量元素对生成图像的影响不同，因此探索应适应这些差异。
AI.method: 提出 EXPLORENET，一个策略网络，在观察奖励前，根据当前潜变量、去噪步和提示预测每个潜变量元素的噪声尺度，从而学习自适应探索分布。它用每个 rollout 组的奖励分布进行训练，训练后丢弃，推理过程不变。
AI.result: 在 Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium 上，EXPLORENET 将 held-out GenEval2 较 Flow-GRPO 提升 14%，迁移到两个独立组合基准和五个偏好与图像质量模型，达到 67.2% 的人类偏好胜率。
AI.conclusion: 在组相对扩散 RL 实验中，探索是可学习的；探索分布的形状比其幅度更重要；rollout 质量比 rollout 数量更有效。

title: Data-Driven Communication Topology and Distributed Controller Synthesis: Control-Aware and Co-Design
