summary: In distributed control schemes, the communication topology that defines information sharing between agents must be designed prior to online control execution. Previous data-driven works typically decouple the topology and controller design problems. This paper investigates data-driven approaches to topology design that guarantee the existence of a stabilizing controller, whilst trading off the level of required communication against control performance. We formulate a data-driven co-design scheme that directly co-optimizes the topology and controller over the link costs and closed-loop control cost. When the topology designer does not have access to the agents' control objectives, we propose a control-aware approach that couples the two design problems within a sequential scheme. In both cases, the topology is optimized within a mixed-integer semidefinite program (MISDP). Simulations including the IEEE 14-bus power system test case demonstrate the effectiveness of both co-design and control-aware schemes. Numerical examples show lower computation time for the control-aware case than for co-design.

AI.tldr: 该文研究数据驱动的分布式控制通信拓扑设计，提出在保证存在稳定控制器的前提下，权衡通信代价与控制性能的拓扑-控制器联合设计方法。
AI.motivation: 分布式控制中通信拓扑需在线控制前设计，而既有数据驱动方法通常将拓扑设计与控制器设计解耦，难以同时保证稳定控制器存在并权衡通信成本与控制性能。
AI.method: 提出数据驱动的协同设计，直接联合优化拓扑与控制器，目标包含链路通信成本与闭环控制代价；当拓扑设计者无法获知智能体控制目标时，提出控制感知的顺序耦合方案；拓扑优化均建模为混合整数半定规划（MISDP）。
AI.result: IEEE 14节点电力系统等仿真验证了协同设计与控制感知方案的有效性；数值实验表明控制感知方案的计算时间低于协同设计。
AI.conclusion: 数据驱动的拓扑-控制器联合/控制感知设计可在保证可稳定控制的同时权衡通信与控制性能，且控制感知方案在计算效率上更具优势。

title: Probability-Based Collision Risk Evaluation of Trajectories for Optimal Control Problems with Moving Obstacles
comment: 27 pages, 15 figures, presented 2024 on IFIP TC7, Hamburg, Germany
summary:
This paper presents a method for approximating occupancy distributions, a common probabilistic representation used in trajectory planning for autonomous vehicles operating in uncertain environments. The proposed method employs B-spline surfaces in conjunction with regularization techniques to ensure smoothness and differentiability. Interpreting the resulting approximation as an intensity function of a Poisson random field enables seamless integration of multiple occupancy distributions into a coherent risk representation, while retaining compatibility with the semantics of probability distributions.
  The method is tailored to optimal control problems (OCPs), where solvers benefit from gradient and higher-order derivative information. It also preserves information about the spatial and temporal structure of occupancy distributions, which is critical for handling dynamic obstacles. We demonstrate the feasibility of the approach in a trajectory planning scenario involving autonomous vehicles and moving obstacles with time-varying uncertainty.
  By enabling controlled risk acceptance, our formulation extends beyond conservative "no-collision" strategies and allows for admissible trajectories that would otherwise be ruled out. In our application scenario, we report a reduction in solver computational load of up to 50\% through proper tuning of the regularization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于B样条曲面与正则化的占用分布近似方法，并将其解释为泊松随机场的强度函数，用于自动驾驶轨迹规划中的不确定性风险建模与最优控制。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶在不确定环境中进行轨迹规划时，需要处理占用分布及其时空结构，同时希望保留概率语义、支持风险可控接受，并为最优控制求解器提供梯度与高阶导数信息。
AI.method: 采用B样条曲面近似占用分布，并引入正则化技术保证平滑性与可微性；将近似结果解释为泊松随机场的强度函数，从而融合多个占用分布为统一风险表示，并适配最优控制问题（OCPs）。
AI.result: 在包含移动障碍物且具有时变不确定性的自动驾驶轨迹规划场景中验证了方法可行性；通过合理调参，求解器计算负载最高降低50%，并可允许原本被保守“无碰撞”策略排除的可接受轨迹。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在保持概率分布语义和时空结构的同时，实现了可控风险接受与高效优化求解，扩展了传统保守避撞策略的适用范围。

title: Memorize, Adapt, Ignore: Diagnosing Robot Learning Mechanisms under Training Data Variation
summary: Training data variation, whether through designing a domain randomization (DR) scheme in simulation or curating demonstrations for imitation learning, is a primary lever for improving the robustness of robotic manipulation policies. Yet its underlying mechanisms remain poorly understood, and practitioners typically select randomization parameters through expensive trial and error. We investigate these mechanisms through a series of case studies, randomizing object size, color, and type as well as scene lighting and linguistic prompts across settings including pick-and-place RL in ManiSkill and fine-tuning of vision-language-action (VLA) models on LIBERO and RoboTwin. We examine both model behavior and internal representations, using the empirical neural tangent kernel (NTK) as our primary diagnostic tool. We show that the NTK distinguishes a shift in the internal learning mechanism from \textit{memorizing} different situations with insufficient variation (e.g.\ learning what to do for a large cube, and what to do for a small cube) to \textit{adapting} to the situation at hand with sufficient variation. An NTK-based signal-to-noise ratio also helps distinguish when policies have learned to \emph{ignore} task-irrelevant factors (e.g.\ treating blue and red cubes identically, instead of learning a blue sub-policy and a red sub-policy). We use these diagnostics to develop practical guidance for designing DR schemes, selecting models, and detecting shortcut learning. We further compare different kinds of representations and validate our findings with real-world hardware experiments using ACT-based imitation learning.

AI.tldr: 论文研究机器人操作策略中训练数据变化（域随机化或模仿学习演示）影响鲁棒性的内在机制，使用经验神经正切核（NTK）作为主要诊断工具，在仿真与真实硬件上验证，并给出设计域随机化、选择模型和检测捷径学习的实用建议。
AI.motivation: 训练数据变化是提升机器人操作策略鲁棒性的主要手段，但其作用机制尚不清晰，实践中通常需要昂贵试错来选择随机化参数。
AI.method: 通过一系列案例研究，随机化物体大小、颜色、类型、场景光照和语言提示，覆盖ManiSkill中的pick-and-place强化学习以及LIBERO和RoboTwin上的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型微调；使用经验NTK分析模型行为和内部表示，比较不同表示，并用基于ACT的模仿学习在真实硬件上验证。
AI.result: NTK能够区分内部学习机制：变化不足时策略倾向于记忆不同情境，变化充分时则学会适应当前情境；基于NTK的信噪比还能判断策略是否学会忽略任务无关因素。这些诊断可用于设计域随机化方案、选择模型和检测捷径学习。
AI.conclusion: NTK为理解训练数据变化如何影响机器人操作策略提供了有效诊断工具，并能指导鲁棒策略的开发与评估，且结论在真实机器人实验中得到了验证。

title: Framing the Narrative: Ideological Mimicry in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to answer questions about politically contentious issues, yet evaluations typically treat a model's stance as a relatively stable property. Real users, however, communicate political signals through their terminology, assumptions, and personal context. We investigate whether such signals produce ideological mimicry: systematic shifts in the political stance expressed by an LLM toward the position conveyed by the interaction. If LLMs adapt their responses to these signals, they risk creating personalised political information environments in which users with opposing views receive systematically different accounts of the same issue, potentially reinforcing existing divisions. We build the Poli-SHIFT dataset and evaluation framework and assess seven open-weight LLMs across ten contentious political topics in the United States, United Kingdom, and Australia, systematically manipulating contested terminology, politically valenced premises, and user information, and eliciting responses in both multiple-choice and open-text formats. Across models, we find robust evidence that prompt framing shapes the political stance of LLM outputs. Changing terminology alone reverses which side of an issue a model supports in 16.9% of matched comparisons. Stated political ideology also systematically shifts responses toward the user's position. These findings show that political stance is not a fixed property of LLMs; the views expressed are conditional on the interaction with the user. As LLMs become increasingly personalised sources of information, such interaction-dependent adaptation could contribute to political information environments that reinforce users' existing perspectives.

AI.tldr: 研究探讨LLM回答政治争议问题时是否会因用户措辞、前提和个人信息而发生立场偏移，并构建Poli-SHIFT数据集进行评估。
AI.motivation: 现有评估常把LLM政治立场视为稳定属性，但真实用户会通过术语、假设和个人背景传递政治信号；若模型迎合这些信号，可能形成个性化政治信息环境并加剧分化。
AI.method: 构建Poli-SHIFT数据集与评估框架，评估七个开源权重LLM，覆盖美英澳十个争议政治议题；系统操纵争议术语、带政治倾向的前提和用户信息，并采用选择题与开放文本形式获取回答。
AI.result: 模型普遍存在提示框架效应：仅改变术语即可在16.9%的匹配比较中使模型支持的问题立场反转；用户声明的政治意识形态也会系统性地将回答拉向用户立场。
AI.conclusion: LLM的政治立场并非固定属性，而是随用户互动条件变化；随着LLM成为个性化信息源，这种互动依赖的适应可能强化用户既有观点，加剧政治信息环境的分化。

title: Beyond Mode Collapse: Generating Diverse Synthetic Expert Conversations via Generative Flow Networks
summary: High quality synthetic data is central to post training LLMs for adaptive AI applications that represent the diverse expert strategies and decisions in conversations. Prompting LLMs directly or conditioning them on end use scenarios yields low diversity data that collapses onto dominant modes. We propose a method to generate diverse high quality synthetic data using Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets). We show that training GFlowNets to generate latent conversation structure using a Gaussian mixture density over key interaction features (e.g., confusion episode dynamics, scaffolding directive balance) enables sampling expert strategies in proportion to their prevalence in the training data. Across two structurally distinct domains, tutoring and emotional support dialogues, our GFlow based synthetic data generation approach offers a better balance of fidelity, mode coverage and authenticity than reinforcement-learning and end to end LLM baselines, without copying training data. Evaluated on three downstream outcome prediction tasks, classifiers trained on synthetic GFlowNet generated conversations provide a stronger training signal than competitive synthesis baselines.

AI.tldr: 论文提出用GFlowNet生成多样化高质量合成对话数据，用于LLM后训练和自适应AI应用；在辅导与情感支持两个领域，其数据在保真度、模式覆盖和真实性间取得更好平衡，并在下游任务中提供更强训练信号。
AI.motivation: 现有直接提示LLM或按最终场景条件生成的数据多样性低，容易坍缩到主导模式，无法充分代表真实对话中多样的专家策略与决策。
AI.method: 训练GFlowNet生成潜在对话结构，并以关键交互特征（如困惑情节动态、支架式指令平衡）上的高斯混合密度为目标，从而按训练数据中的流行度比例采样专家策略。
AI.result: 在辅导和情感支持两个结构不同的对话领域，该方法在保真度、模式覆盖和真实性上优于强化学习和端到端LLM基线，且不复制训练数据；在三个下游结果预测任务上，用其合成对话训练的分类器比竞争合成基线提供更强训练信号。
AI.conclusion: GFlowNet可用于生成多样化、高质量且真实的合成对话数据，改善自适应AI应用的LLM后训练，并在下游预测任务中体现优势。

title: Can an AI Agent Rediscover a Blaschke-Curve Invariant?
comment: Accepted for poster presentation at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Mathematical Reasoning and AI (MATH-AI). 8 pages, 1 figure. Code and data: https://github.com/yezeytuncu/blaschke-ai-rediscovery
summary: We study generalized Blaschke curves as a controlled environment for AI-assisted mathematical rediscovery. For one fixed degree-four Blaschke product, an agent receives numerical coordinates of the six pair-lines determined by each of 80 boundary configurations. The target theorem is withheld from the task instructions. The saved research log reports rejected geometric hypotheses and a homogeneous cubic fitted to polygon sides. Its frozen coefficients predict 480 lines from 80 unseen parameter values, with a recorded RMS scale-free residual of $8.88\times10^{-17}$. Discovery-set diagonals provide an out-of-fit consistency check, not a fully held-out test. A separate one-configuration run reports insufficient evidence for invariance. A post-review deterministic degree-search baseline also recovers the cubic, so the experiment does not establish an advantage over polynomial fitting. We present this single-instance case study as a protocol for separating conjecture, numerical validation, and proof, with explicit limitations concerning agent metadata, prior knowledge, and reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 该研究将广义Blaschke曲线作为AI辅助数学再发现的可控环境，智能体在80个边界配置下拟合一个齐次三次多项式，并评估数值验证与证明分离的协议。
AI.motivation: 探索AI辅助数学再发现的可行性，并建立一个区分猜想、数值验证与证明的受控实验协议。
AI.method: 固定一个四次Blaschke积，向智能体提供80个边界配置对应的六条配对线数值坐标，进行几何假设检验与齐次三次多项式拟合，并用80个未见参数值预测480条线，同时进行一致性检查与事后确定性度搜索基线对比。
AI.result: 冻结系数预测的RMS无标度残差为8.88×10^-17；发现集对角线提供拟合外一致性检查；单配置运行证据不足；事后确定性度搜索基线也能恢复该三次多项式，因此未证明优于多项式拟合。
AI.conclusion: 作为单实例案例研究，提出了分离猜想、数值验证与证明的协议，并明确了关于智能体元数据、先验知识和可重复性的局限性。

title: ContextAdapt: Evaluating Contextual Adaptation and Value Alignment in LLMs
summary: Values such as honesty, autonomy, and confidentiality are often regarded as general principles underpinning AI alignment. However, what it means to act in accordance with these values can depend on the context in which a decision is made. In this paper, we ask whether large language models (LLMs) appropriately adapt the application of a value across professional settings, while remaining consistent when contextual changes do not alter the relevant professional norm. To study this, we introduce ContextAdapt, an evaluation framework covering honesty, autonomy, and confidentiality across medicine, law, finance, and national security. Drawing on primary-source professional and regulatory documents, we construct a value x domain framework and use this to develop scenarios testing both default professional rules and recognised exceptions. We evaluate 12 LLMs on both the actions they recommend and the justifications they provide. In our main experiment, models achieve 95.6% mean appropriateness, although the use of the correct domain-specific justification varies substantially across models, from 25.6% to 76.9%. In a separate factorial experiment, explicitly naming the professional domain and changing the role of the model have limited effect on behaviour. Varying stakes, however, reveals severe but localised failures: in some cases, models alter their responses even though the underlying professional obligation remains unchanged. In particular, perceived severity appears to act as a cue for disclosure across both honesty and confidentiality scenarios. These results show that evaluating value alignment requires us to consider not only whether models follow abstract principles, but whether they apply them appropriately across different contexts.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ContextAdapt 评估框架，研究大语言模型能否在医学、法律、金融和国家安全等专业场景中，恰当且一致地应用诚实、自主和保密等价值。
AI.motivation: 诚实、自主、保密等常被视为 AI 对齐的普遍原则，但其具体含义取决于决策情境和专业规范。作者关注 LLM 是否能随专业语境调整价值应用，同时在不改变相关规范时保持一致。
AI.method: 构建 ContextAdapt，覆盖诚实、自主、保密三个价值与医学、法律、金融、国家安全四个领域；依据专业和监管原始文件建立“价值 x 领域”框架，设计默认专业规则与公认例外的测试场景；评估 12 个 LLM 推荐行动及理由，并进行因子实验，操纵领域命名、模型角色和利害程度。
AI.result: 主实验中模型平均恰当率为 95.6%，但正确使用领域特定理由的比例差异很大，为 25.6% 至 76.9%。明确命名专业领域和改变模型角色影响有限；改变利害程度则导致严重但局部的失败，模型会在专业义务不变时改变回答，感知严重性似乎成为诚实和保密场景中披露的线索。
AI.conclusion: 评估价值对齐不仅应看模型是否遵循抽象原则，还应看其能否在不同情境中恰当地应用这些原则；ContextAdapt 表明需要关注语境敏感的价值对齐。

title: Draft: A Parametric Tool for Robot Design Exploration
summary: Robot performance is often limited by the cost of iterating on morphology and control together, since every computer-aided design (CAD) change has to be carried into a simulation-ready model before control work begins. Co-design methods attempt to close this gap, but each uses a model generator written for a single platform or lack the use of real-world data to suggest that designs are plausible. We present Draft, a parametric generation tool whose generalized engine compiles any parametric tree of serial chains into a simulation-ready MJCF model, without CAD. It allows engineers to explore design tradeoffs through easily adjustable models and evaluate how changes influence controller performance. Draft grounds the free parameters of each design using trends fitted to a survey of $114$ actuators and $49$ published robot descriptions, so that a generated robot is anchored to real-world hardware. We validate those trends wholistically by building twins of four off-the-shelf robots, whose masses agree to $1.10\times$ geometric mean fold error. Finally, we demonstrate how Draft exposes design tradeoffs by evaluating three quadrupeds through a two-stage reinforcement learning curriculum.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Draft，一个无需 CAD、可将任意串联链参数化树编译为 MJCF 仿真模型的参数化生成工具，并用真实执行器与机器人数据约束设计参数，以支持形态与控制协同探索。
AI.motivation: 机器人性能常受限于形态与控制迭代成本高：每次 CAD 修改都需先转为仿真模型才能开始控制工作。现有协同设计方法多依赖单一平台模型生成器，或缺少真实世界数据来保证设计可行性。
AI.method: Draft 通过通用引擎将任意串联链参数化树编译为可直接仿真的 MJCF 模型，无需 CAD；设计者可通过可调模型探索设计权衡。其自由参数利用 114 个执行器和 49 个已发表机器人描述的调研趋势进行拟合，使生成机器人锚定真实硬件。作者通过构建四款现成机器人的数字孪生进行整体验证，并用两阶段强化学习课程评估三种四足机器人以展示设计权衡。
AI.result: 四款现成机器人数字孪生的质量与真实值相比达到 1.10 倍几何平均折叠误差；Draft 能够通过强化学习评估暴露四足机器人设计中的权衡。
AI.conclusion: Draft 提供了一种无需 CAD、可仿真、且基于真实硬件趋势的参数化机器人生成方法，有助于在控制性能评估中高效探索形态与控制的设计权衡。

title: Self-Evolving Harness on Multiple Tasks with the Agent as Its Own Optimizer
summary: A harness is the code around a language-model agent that organizes prompts, calls tools, manages context, and controls execution. As models grow stronger, recent work has begun to let agents improve their own harnesses, a line of work known as self-evolving harnesses. In most existing methods, a separate proposer running on a human-designed harness modifies the solver's harness, and a separate harness is evolved for each benchmark. Real-world tasks come from many domains, so both the evolution and the evaluation of a harness should cover a diverse range of tasks. We propose a framework close to recursive self-improvement: the same frozen model, on the same version of the harness, first solves tasks as the solver and then, as the proposer, reads the complete run records and directly edits the harness that runs it. Each evolution batch draws tasks from five benchmarks in different domains. To measure generalization, training and held-out tasks are strictly separated, and we additionally evaluate on five out-of-distribution benchmarks never used during evolution. We frame the evolution process as deep-learning training with two stages, multi-task pretraining and continual training. Starting from a 49-line seed harness, the harness obtained at the end of the first stage improves the average score by 4.48 points on the in-distribution benchmarks and by 12.64 points on the out-of-distribution benchmarks, surpassing Codex on the former and matching it on the latter. In the second stage, continued evolution on Claw-Eval, one of the out-of-distribution benchmarks, further raises the score on that benchmark from 66.17 to 68.06, exceeding Codex. We also provide an in-depth analysis of the mechanisms that emerged during evolution, including output truncation, history compaction, and independent review.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种接近递归自我改进的自我进化harness框架：同一个冻结模型、同一版本harness，先作为solver解题，再作为proposer阅读完整运行记录并直接编辑harness。进化批次从五个不同领域基准取任务，训练与留出任务严格分离，并额外在五个OOD基准上评测。从49行种子harness出发，第一阶段平均分在分布内提升4.48、分布外提升12.64，超越/追平Codex；第二阶段在Claw-Eval上继续进化使分数从66.17升至68.06，超过Codex。
AI.motivation: 现有自我进化harness方法通常由独立的proposer（运行在人工设计的harness上）修改solver的harness，且每个benchmark单独进化一个harness。但真实任务跨多个领域，harness的进化与评估都应覆盖多样化任务，因此需要更接近递归自我改进、且能跨领域泛化的方案。
AI.method: 提出统一框架：同一冻结模型、同一harness版本先作solver求解任务，再作proposer读取完整运行记录并直接编辑该harness。每个进化批次从五个不同领域基准采样任务；严格分离训练与留出任务，并在五个从未用于进化的OOD基准上评测泛化。将进化过程形式化为两阶段深度学习训练：多任务预训练与持续训练；起点为49行种子harness。
AI.result: 第一阶段结束时，harness在分布内基准平均提升4.48分（超过Codex），在分布外基准平均提升12.64分（追平Codex）。第二阶段在OOD基准Claw-Eval上持续进化，使其分数从66.17提升至68.06，超过Codex。
AI.conclusion: 自我进化的harness能跨领域泛化并超越人工设计基线（Codex）；将其类比为两阶段训练（多任务预训练+持续训练）有效。进化过程中涌现出输出截断、历史压缩、独立审查等机制。

title: PneuTac: Tactile Manipulation with Soft Pneumatic Robots via Unified MPM-Gaussian Splatting Simulation
summary: Soft robots and tactile sensors have demonstrated great potential in delicate manipulation tasks. Soft pneumatic robots enable safe contact through compliance, and vision-based tactile sensors offer high-resolution touch perception. However, learning tactile manipulation with compliant robots has been challenging, bottlenecked by the lack of efficient simulation. Existing simulators typically model them in isolation, and exhibit large calibration gaps that are difficult to overcome efficiently. We present PneuTac, a unified framework for tactile-feedback manipulation with soft pneumatic robots. We leverage the material point method (MPM) for modelling the dynamics of the soft robot and the deformable tactile membrane, and 3D Gaussian splatting (3DGS) for rendering. Real-to-sim modelling is done with a simple vision-based method, to then train action and perception networks for efficient simulation with surrogate models. We use the framework to drive a tactile-guided pipeline to collect demonstrations in simulation. Through experiments on a custom-designed pneumatic soft finger with a tactile sensing tip, together with additional cross-device evaluations, we show that PneuTac is capable of accurately modelling soft robots with tactile sensors, and that policies trained with simulation-augmented demonstrations outperform baselines trained on the same real data on three real-world contact-rich compliant manipulation tasks, making it a practical framework for tactile manipulation on compliant hardware.

AI.tldr: 提出 PneuTac，一个面向软气动机器人触觉反馈操作的统一仿真框架，结合 MPM 与 3DGS，并通过仿真数据增强提升真实任务表现。
AI.motivation: 软体机器人和视触觉传感器在精细操作中潜力巨大，但缺乏高效仿真，现有模拟器通常孤立建模且存在较大现实到仿真校准差距，导致触觉操作学习困难。
AI.method: 使用物质点法（MPM）建模软体机器人和可变形触觉膜动力学，使用 3D 高斯泼溅（3DGS）进行渲染；通过简单视觉方法完成真实到仿真建模，并训练动作与感知网络及代理模型；利用该框架驱动触觉引导流程在仿真中收集示范数据。
AI.result: 在定制气动软指与触觉传感指尖上实验，并进行跨设备评估，表明 PneuTac 能准确建模带触觉传感器的软体机器人；在三个真实世界接触丰富且柔顺操作任务中，使用仿真增强示范训练的策略优于仅用相同真实数据训练的基线。
AI.conclusion: PneuTac 是适用于柔顺硬件触觉操作的实际框架，能够有效缩小仿真与现实差距，并通过仿真增强提升软体机器人触觉操作策略性能。

title: TrackFish3D: Self-Supervised 3D Tracking of Schooling Fish from Multi-view Videos
comment: to be published in the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
summary: Quantifying collective fish behavior requires accurate trajectories, yet multi-view 3D tracking remains challenging due to frequent occlusions, visually similar individuals, and the long-standing scarcity of identity annotations. We present TrackFish3D, a geometry-driven self-supervised framework for dense multi-camera 3D tracking of schooling fish. Instead of relying on appearance-based re-identification or manually annotated identities, TrackFish3D turns calibrated multi-view geometry into supervision: triangulation and reprojection consistency provide pseudo-associations, while a geometric encoder and global association transformer learn all-to-all cross-view correspondence within each frame. To make these associations identity-aware, TrackFish3D introduces a self-supervised contrastive objective that separates co-visible individuals in the embedding space, together with a temporal predictor that preserves identities and bridges short occlusions across frames. The resulting model is trained once on unlabeled footage and applied directly to unseen test videos, requiring no cross-view identity labels, temporal annotations, 3D ground truth, appearance features, or test-time optimization. On our benchmark, TrackFish3D improves 3D Multi-Object Tracking Accuracy from 87.7% for the strongest baseline to 95.8%. On the 3D-ZeF zebrafish benchmark, it achieves 81.1% MOTA, compared with 77.4% for the best geometric baseline. TrackFish3D also generalizes beyond fish, achieving strong results on real-world bird tracking.

AI.tldr: TrackFish3D 是一个几何驱动的自监督框架，用于多相机密集3D鱼群追踪，无需身份标注、3D真值或测试时优化，在鱼类和鸟类追踪基准上取得领先性能。
AI.motivation: 多视角3D追踪面临频繁遮挡、个体外观相似以及长期缺乏身份标注等挑战；现有方法常依赖外观重识别、人工身份标注或测试时优化，限制了可扩展性。
AI.method: 利用标定多视角几何作为监督：通过三角化和重投影一致性生成伪关联；使用几何编码器和全局关联Transformer学习帧内全对跨视角对应；引入自监督对比目标分离共视个体；加入时间预测器保持身份并桥接短时遮挡；在无标签视频上训练一次后直接用于未见测试视频。
AI.result: 在自建基准上，3D多目标追踪准确率MOTA从最强基线的87.7%提升至95.8%；在3D-ZeF斑马鱼基准上达到81.1% MOTA，优于最佳几何基线的77.4%；还能泛化到真实鸟类追踪。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明，基于多视角几何的自监督学习可有效实现密集多相机3D追踪，无需跨视角身份标签、时序标注、3D真值、外观特征或测试时优化，并具备跨物种泛化能力。

title: VHF Reconfigurable Intelligent Surfaces for Meteor Burst Communication
summary: Meteor Burst Communication (MBC) utilizes the transient ionized trails left by meteors to reflect Very High Frequency (VHF) signals, enabling long-range, beyond-line-of-sight communication without reliance on terrestrial or satellite infrastructure. Despite its resilience in austere and contested environments, MBC is limited by brief communication windows, low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), and inconsistent channel availability. Recent advancements in Reconfigurable Intelligent Surfaces (RIS) offer a transformative solution by enabling dynamic control over signal propagation through programmable reflective elements. This paper proposes a novel system architecture that integrates RIS into MBC networks, incorporating real-time adaptive control, optimized deployment strategies, and Monte Carlo simulations to refine RIS placement and operational parameters.

AI.tldr: 论文提出将可重构智能表面（RIS）集成到流星余迹通信（MBC）网络中的新架构，旨在改善通信窗口短、信噪比低和信道可用性不稳定等问题。
AI.motivation: MBC可利用流星电离余迹反射VHF信号，实现不依赖地面或卫星基础设施的超视距通信，适用于严苛和对抗环境，但受限于短暂通信窗口、低信噪比和信道不稳定；RIS可动态控制信号传播，提供潜在解决方案。
AI.method: 提出RIS与MBC融合的系统架构，包含实时自适应控制、优化部署策略，并使用蒙特卡洛仿真优化RIS部署位置和运行参数。
AI.result: 摘要未给出具体实验结果或性能指标；主要贡献是提出新架构，并规划通过蒙特卡洛仿真优化RIS部署与参数。
AI.conclusion: RIS集成有望提升MBC的可靠性和链路可用性，但仍需后续仿真或实验验证其实际性能。

title: Which Models Work Well Together? Measuring Heterogeneity for LLM Team Selection
summary: The performance ceiling of an LLM team is constrained not only by individual model capabilities, but also by inter-member error resonance and predictive differences. Although heterogeneous teaming is often observed to be effective in practice, existing approaches lack complementarity metrics that are computable, interpretable, and optimizable, leaving team composition to rely on heuristics. We propose a heterogeneity-driven team selection framework that performs offline profiling to characterize individual capability along with two complementary signals: one captures decorrelation in error patterns to reduce co-failures, while the other measures divergence in predictive behavior to capture strategy diversity. We formulate team selection as a standardized quality--complementarity combinatorial objective and apply an efficient greedy search to select a small team from a candidate pool. Experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that our framework consistently outperforms quality-only baselines under controlled candidate pools and team sizes, establishing reusable selection principles for multi-LLM systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于异质性的LLM团队选择框架，通过离线画像刻画个体能力及误差模式去相关性和预测行为差异性两个互补信号，并将团队选择建模为质量-互补性组合优化问题，用贪心搜索高效选队。
AI.motivation: LLM团队的性能上限不仅受个体模型能力限制，还受成员间误差共振和预测差异的影响。尽管异构组队在实践中常有效，但缺乏可计算、可解释、可优化的互补性度量，导致团队构成只能依赖启发式方法。
AI.method: 提出异质性驱动的团队选择框架：通过离线画像刻画个体能力，并引入两个互补信号——一个捕捉误差模式上的去相关以减少共同失败，另一个衡量预测行为的分歧以捕捉策略多样性。将团队选择形式化为标准化的质量-互补性组合目标，并采用高效贪心搜索从候选池中选出小规模团队。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试上的实验表明，在受控的候选池和团队规模条件下，该框架持续优于仅考虑质量的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为多LLM系统确立了一套可复用的团队选择原则，说明将可计算、可解释的互补性度量纳入团队选择能有效提升LLM团队性能。

title: NinaXander: Feasibility and Limits of Composing Frozen Language Models Across Architecture Families via a Shared Latent Space
summary: In this paper we propose NinaXander, a series of composed language models obtained by connecting layers of frozen language models from different architecture families with a single trained shared-latent adapter. A composed model runs the first layers of one model, converts the resulting intermediate representation once with the adapter, and then runs the remaining layers of the other model. Once the adapter is trained, several composed models that connect at different layers are obtained without retraining. Using the recurrent RWKV-4-Raven-7B and the Transformer-based Tulu-Pythia-6.9b, abbreviated as RWKV and Pythia, this study examines whether frozen models from different families can be recombined post hoc. The composed models answered multiple-choice questions, and those whose generations we examined produced syntactically well-formed text. The configuration that combines the first 5 layers of Pythia with the remaining 27 layers of RWKV reduced the Transformer key-value (KV) cache by 84.4% with accuracy not significantly different from that of RWKV alone. In multiple-choice accuracy, however, no composed model matched the parent model Pythia, and language-modeling performance decreased sharply on WikiText, a corpus of Wikipedia articles outside the training domain. The correspondence between intermediate representations was also obtained in one favorable case, with a shared tokenizer, the same depth, and the same hidden width, and does not show that the models share a general semantic space.

AI.tldr: 提出NinaXander，通过一个训练好的共享潜在适配器连接不同架构家族的冻结语言模型层，构建组合模型；用RWKV-4-Raven-7B和Tulu-Pythia-6.9b评估多项选择问答与语言建模。
AI.motivation: 探索来自不同架构家族的冻结模型能否在事后被重新组合，以及组合模型能否在保持一定性能的同时降低推理成本，例如减少Transformer的KV缓存。
AI.method: 先运行一个模型的前若干层，用单个共享潜在适配器转换中间表示，再运行另一个模型的剩余层；适配器训练后，无需重新训练即可获得不同层连接的组合模型。实验使用RWKV-4-Raven-7B和Tulu-Pythia-6.9b，在多项选择问答和WikiText语言建模上评估，并检查生成文本与中间表示对应关系。
AI.result: 组合模型生成的文本语法通顺；Pythia前5层加RWKV后27层的配置将Transformer KV缓存减少84.4%，准确率与单独RWKV无显著差异；但没有任何组合模型在多项选择准确率上匹配Pythia，且在WikiText上的语言建模性能急剧下降。中间表示对应仅在一个有利情形下获得，即共享分词器、相同深度和相同隐藏宽度。
AI.conclusion: 不同架构家族的冻结模型可通过适配器有限度地事后重组，并可能带来效率收益，但性能保持有限，表示对应依赖特定条件，不能证明模型共享通用语义空间。

title: Inductive Visual Logic for Few-Shot Out-Of-Distribution Adaptation in VLMs
summary: Generative vision-language models (VLMs) such as Qwen-VL and LLaVA achieve strong zero-shot performance on tasks overlapping with their pretraining distribution, yet fail on specialized domains where the required discriminative features were never learned, a regime we term distant out-of-distribution (OOD). Standard adaptation methods cannot overcome this representational absence because they operate within the encoder's existing feature space. However, VLMs retain a robust descriptive capacity even when discrimination collapses: a model that cannot classify a medical scan can still articulate its visual patterns. Exploiting this asymmetry, we introduce Inductive Visual Logic (IVL), a training-free framework that constructs classification knowledge from the model's surviving descriptive ability. IVL extracts visual traits from few-shot support images through dual-mode prompting, combining semantic descriptions with primitive visual observations, and organizes them into per-class trait dictionaries. At inference, hierarchical filtering identifies spatially grounded trait evidence for classification. Across multiple distant-OOD benchmarks, IVL achieves the highest aggregate accuracy under two VLM backbones while producing interpretable, trait-traceable predictions.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种无需训练的归纳视觉逻辑（IVL）框架，利用生成式视觉语言模型在判别能力失效时仍保留的描述能力，从少量支持图像中构建类别特征词典，并在推理时通过分层过滤实现远域分布外（distant OOD）分类。
AI.motivation: 生成式VLM在与其预训练分布重叠的任务上零样本性能强，但在需要特定判别特征的专门领域（distant OOD）会失败。标准适应方法无法克服这种表征缺失，因为它们只在编码器已有特征空间内操作；然而模型即使无法分类，仍能描述视觉模式，论文希望利用这种描述与判别之间的不对称性。
AI.method: 提出Inductive Visual Logic（IVL），一种免训练框架。它通过双模式提示从少样本支持图像中提取视觉特征，结合语义描述与基础视觉观察，并为每个类别组织特征词典。推理阶段使用分层过滤，识别与空间相关的特征证据以完成分类。
AI.result: 在多个distant-OOD基准上，IVL在两种VLM骨干下取得最高总体准确率，同时产生可解释、可追踪特征依据的预测。
AI.conclusion: IVL表明，即使VLM的判别能力崩溃，其存留的描述能力仍可被系统化地转化为分类知识，为远域分布外场景提供免训练且可解释的适应方案。

title: Aligned Data Can Induce Misalignment via Context Confusion
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are frequently updated for various use cases, where filtering out misaligned training samples is a common practice for preventing post-update misalignment. However, alignment is inherently context-dependent: a recommendation that is aligned in one context may be inappropriate in another. For example, in response to the question "What should a researcher do with the research data?", recommending that the researcher preserve the data for reproducibility is aligned. In contrast, recommending data saving in response to "What should a mobile-app developer do with users' sensitive data?" may be inappropriate from a privacy perspective. Starting from this observation, we identify a post-training phenomenon where aligned training induces misaligned behavior in other contexts. We call this phenomenon **context confusion**. We demonstrate context confusion across three domains: (1) Gender Equality, (2) Privacy, and (3) Physical Safety. We further show that context confusion causes narrow misalignment, in contrast to emergent misalignment, and is not effectively reduced by injecting general alignment data, but can be substantially reduced by including targeted alignment data for the misaligned domain or providing in-context learning examples during inference. Lastly, we provide a mechanistic explanation of *context confusion*. We observe that queries from different domains can undergo similar representational shifts during the fine-tuning. Consequently, a query from a different domain may activate the same behavioral feature learned during fine-tuning, which causes the behavior to transfer to a context where it is misaligned. Based on our findings, we argue that it is difficult to predict the alignment state of a model after training by inspecting the training data alone, which highlights the importance of comprehensive post-training alignment evaluations.

AI.tldr: 论文发现大语言模型微调后存在“上下文混淆”现象：在对齐训练中注入的对齐数据，会在其他不同上下文中诱发不对齐行为；研究横跨性别平等、隐私和物理安全三个领域，并给出机制解释与缓解方法。
AI.motivation: LLM经常更新，常用过滤不对齐训练样本的方式防止更新后失配；但对齐本质上是上下文相关的——同一建议在一种语境下对齐，在另一种语境下可能不当。因此需要研究这种跨语境的行为迁移现象。
AI.method: 在性别平等、隐私、物理安全三个领域构造实验，观察对齐训练引发的跨语境不对齐行为；对比通用对齐数据与针对性对齐数据的作用，并测试推理时上下文学习示例的效果；最后通过表征分析给出机制性解释。
AI.result: 发现上下文混淆：对齐训练会在其他语境引发不对齐行为，且属于窄域失配而非涌现式失配。注入通用对齐数据不能有效缓解，但加入针对失配领域的定向对齐数据或推理时提供上下文示例可显著减少。机制上，不同领域的查询在微调中经历相似的表征偏移，导致某一领域学到的行为特征被其他领域查询激活，从而迁移到不对齐语境。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭训练数据难以预测模型训练后的对齐状态，因此必须重视并开展全面的训练后对齐评估。

title: Forward-Invariant Policy Classes for Safe Reinforcement Learning in Multicopter Control
summary: This paper proposes a reinforcement learning (RL) framework for safe gain scheduling based on forwardinvariance-induced action-space design. Under stated nominalmodel and inversion-domain assumptions, rather than enforcing safety through runtime shielding or penalty-based constraints, safety is embedded directly into the policy class. Specifically, we construct a finite library of feedback controllers sharing a common Lyapunov certificate that establishes forward invariance of a prescribed admissible set under arbitrary switching. Consequently, any policy whose actions are restricted to this library, including policies encountered during RL exploration, inherits the same certificate. Policy optimization can therefore focus on closed-loop performance without runtime safety filtering or action projection. The framework is instantiated for quadcopter hover regulation, where a DQN schedules among certified feedback controllers. Nonlinear MuJoCo simulations demonstrate state-dependent gain scheduling and empirically evaluate robustness to wind, model mismatch, sensor noise, and sensing delay. The results illustrate how safety certification can be separated from policy optimization by learning over a forward-invariant policy class.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于前向不变性动作空间设计的安全增益调度强化学习框架，将安全性直接嵌入策略类中，并通过四旋翼悬停调节的仿真验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 传统安全强化学习通常依赖运行时屏蔽或惩罚约束来保证安全，这些方法可能影响策略优化效率或导致保守行为。本文旨在将安全性直接嵌入策略类，从而在探索过程中无需运行时安全过滤即可保证安全。
AI.method: 构建一个共享共同Lyapunov证书的有限反馈控制器库，该证书保证在任意切换下规定容许集的前向不变性。任何限制在该库中的策略（包括RL探索中的策略）都继承该证书。因此策略优化可以专注于闭环性能，无需运行时安全过滤或动作投影。在四旋翼悬停调节中实例化，使用DQN在认证的反馈控制器之间进行调度。
AI.result: 非线性MuJoCo仿真展示了状态相关的增益调度，并经验性地评估了算法对风扰、模型失配、传感器噪声和传感延迟的鲁棒性。结果表明，通过在前向不变策略类上学习，可以将安全认证与策略优化分离。
AI.conclusion: 通过在前向不变策略类上学习，安全认证可以与策略优化分离，为安全强化学习提供了一种无需运行时安全过滤的有效方法。

authors: L. D. M. S. Sai Teja
title: Composition, Not Conversation: VLMs Lose the Scene, Not the Thread
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly reason over visual evidence that is cropped, segmented, retrieved, or revealed over time. Yet most VQA benchmarks present the complete image and question at once. We ask what models lose when the same information is fragmented. We introduce Layered-VQA, with 93 scenes and 300 questions. Each image is decomposed into ordered RGBA layers that exactly recompose the original scene, and each question is annotated with supporting, minimal-sufficient, and distractor layers. We evaluate eleven open-weight VLMs from 3B to 32B parameters and two proprietary models with a scale of 187,200 conversations, graded by 1.74M open-model cross-judgments. We find three consistent failures. Loss in Composition: fragmenting the question has a small effect, but fragmenting the scene substantially reduces accuracy; recomposing the same layers largely restores performance. Oracle Inversion: even oracle-selected sufficient evidence can perform worse than the complete scene. Loss in Grounding: as more evidence is required, grounding degrades much faster than answer accuracy. Together, these results show that having the right visual evidence is not enough. How that evidence is composed and presented determines whether models can use and ground it. The right evidence is not enough: VLMs need the scene it came from.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Layered-VQA基准，将图像分解为有序RGBA图层，并标注支撑、最小充分与干扰图层，评估13个视觉语言模型后发现：碎片化呈现视觉证据会显著损害模型性能，即使证据本身充分，其组合与呈现方式也决定模型能否有效利用和定位证据。
AI.motivation: 现有VQA基准通常一次性给出完整图像和问题，但真实场景中视觉证据常被裁剪、分割、检索或逐步揭示。研究希望探究：当相同信息被碎片化呈现时，模型会损失什么。
AI.method: 构建Layered-VQA，包含93个场景、300个问题。每张图像被分解为可精确重组原场景的有序RGBA图层，每个问题标注支撑图层、最小充分图层和干扰图层。评估11个3B至32B参数的开源VLM和2个专有模型，共187,200轮对话，并由开源模型进行1.74M次交叉评判。
AI.result: 发现三类一致失败：1）组合损失：碎片化问题影响较小，但碎片化场景显著降低准确率，重组相同图层可大幅恢复性能；2）Oracle反转：即使由oracle选择充分证据，性能也可能不如完整场景；3）定位损失：所需证据越多，定位能力比答案准确率下降更快。
AI.conclusion: 拥有正确的视觉证据并不足够；证据如何组合与呈现，决定模型能否使用并定位它。模型不仅需要正确证据，还需要其来源场景的完整上下文。

title: EVOKE: Eliciting World Knowledge in Agents for Transferable Decision-Making
comment: 19 pages. Project page: https://gnonymous.github.io/EVOKE ; Code: https://github.com/Gnonymous/EVOKE ; Models: https://huggingface.co/Gnonymous/EVOKE
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as agents for multi-step decision-making, yet transfer poorly to unseen environments. World-model methods address this by training agents to predict future observations, at the cost of additional training and errors that compound when predictions are used for planning. However, for LLM agents operating in digital environments, much of this world knowledge is already internalized during pretraining, which shifts the problem from acquiring it to eliciting it. We argue that typical post-training provides little pressure for such elicitation, since supervision under a single goal at each visited state inadvertently drives policies to rely on superficial contextual habits. We introduce EVOKE, a post-training method that supplies this pressure through goal diversity at fixed states. Motivated by theory showing that an agent competent across diverse goals must encode a world model recoverable from its action preferences, EVOKE holds the environment state and interaction history fixed and ranks the same candidate actions under alternative goals, forcing action preferences to change, so that a policy relying on contextual habits or single-goal correlations cannot order them correctly. This implicitly elicits the policy's pretrained world knowledge to inform decisions. We evaluate EVOKE across diverse tasks in three backbones, demonstrating improved task performance, unseen environment generalization, and data efficiency. We further conduct controlled analyses to better understand what drives these gains. These findings offer a new perspective on eliciting internalized world knowledge for transferable action through direct decision supervision.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 EVOKE 后训练方法，通过在同一状态下设置多样化目标，促使 LLM 智能体显式利用预训练中已内化的世界知识，从而提升多步决策、未见环境泛化和数据效率。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体在多步决策中迁移到新环境表现差；世界模型方法需额外训练预测未来观测且误差会累积。作者认为数字环境中 LLM 已预训练获得大量世界知识，关键不是获取而是激发，而常规后训练因单一目标监督易让策略依赖浅层上下文习惯，缺乏激发压力。
AI.method: EVOKE 是一种后训练方法：固定环境状态与交互历史，在同一状态下用不同替代目标对相同候选动作进行排序，迫使动作偏好随目标变化。若策略仅依赖上下文习惯或单目标相关性，就无法正确排序；这隐式激发策略调用预训练世界知识来决策。
AI.result: 在三个骨干模型和多种任务上评估 EVOKE，显示任务性能、未见环境泛化和数据效率均有提升；并通过受控分析进一步理解增益来源。
AI.conclusion: 为通过直接决策监督激发 LLM 内部世界知识以获得可迁移动作提供了新视角。

title: Fine-Tuning Diffusion Language Models with Context Selection and Target Weighting
comment: 30 pages, 4 figures, 14 tables. Main text 10 pages, references and appendix follow. Project page with interactive visualizations: https://loaym.github.io/GoldiMask/
summary: Supervised fine-tuning of discrete diffusion language models masks some response tokens and trains the model to recover their original values from the visible context. The masking pattern therefore determines both the context available to the model and the tokens it learns to predict. Uniform random masking does not explicitly account for the interaction between these choices. We introduce GoldiMask, which selects tokens to reveal as context by approximately maximizing a submodular objective. This objective uses model signals to balance the benefit of revealing tokens against their value as prediction targets. GoldiMask then weights the remaining targets according to how they benefit from the selected context and their remaining learning potential. Across three backbones and three training datasets, GoldiMask achieves the highest average accuracy in most evaluated settings, demonstrating gains on both reasoning and code generation. Component ablations show that both context selection and target weighting contribute to the gains. GoldiMask also reduces decoding iterations on GSM8K and MATH-500 under confidence-threshold parallel decoding, while maintaining comparable accuracy at higher confidence thresholds.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GoldiMask，一种用于离散扩散语言模型监督微调的自适应掩码方法，通过选择上下文 token 并加权预测目标，提升推理与代码生成表现。
AI.motivation: 离散扩散语言模型的监督微调依赖掩码模式，但均匀随机掩码未显式考虑“揭示哪些 token 作为上下文”与“预测哪些 token”之间的相互影响。
AI.method: GoldiMask 利用模型信号，以近似最大化子模目标来选择要揭示的上下文 token，在揭示收益与作为预测目标的价值之间取得平衡；随后根据剩余目标从所选上下文中获得的收益及其剩余学习潜力，对它们进行加权。
AI.result: 在 3 个骨干模型和 3 个训练数据集上，GoldiMask 在多数评估设置中取得最高平均准确率，并在推理和代码生成任务上均有提升。组件消融表明上下文选择和目标加权均带来增益。在 GSM8K 和 MATH-500 上，置信阈值并行解码时还减少了解码迭代次数，并在更高置信阈值下保持相近准确率。
AI.conclusion: GoldiMask 通过更合理的上下文选择与目标加权，改进了离散扩散语言模型的监督微调，在性能与解码效率上均展现出优势。

title: On the NP-Hardness of Unconstrained Static Output Feedback Stabilization
summary: In this paper we give a polynomial-time reduction from the Subset Sum Problem to unconstrained static output feedback stabilization, establishing its NP-hardness. The construction uses two scalar building blocks to impose approximate discrete choices and a weighted-sum constraint. Once the problem is encoded, we relate the stability of the $N+1$ decoupled loops encoding the problem to that of a coupled plant. This is accomplished by leveraging frequency separation via a band-pass transformation, and comparing the root counts of the true characteristic polynomial with that of the different blocks in different regions of the right half-plane. The construction then naturally bounds every stabilizing gain and gives explicit modulus-margin estimates, ensuring that the plant data have polynomial binary encoding length.

AI.tldr: 将子集和问题多项式归约到无约束静态输出反馈镇定问题，证明该问题是NP难的。
AI.motivation: 研究无约束静态输出反馈镇定问题的计算复杂性，确定其是否属于NP难问题。
AI.method: 通过多项式时间归约，从子集和问题构造镇定问题实例；使用两个标量构建块实现近似离散选择和加权和约束；利用带通变换进行频率分离，比较右半平面根数，将N+1个解耦回路的稳定性与耦合被控对象关联；并给出增益界和模裕度估计以保证多项式二进制编码长度。
AI.result: 证明了无约束静态输出反馈镇定问题是NP难的。
AI.conclusion: 该问题具有NP难复杂性，且构造自然地界定了每个镇定增益并给出显式模裕度估计，确保被控对象数据具有多项式二进制编码长度。

title: A Reachability-based Safety Certificate for Dynamical System Motion Policies
summary: Dynamical Systems (DS) are reactive motion policies representing vector fields trained with theoretical guarantees of stability and convergence. To ensure safety during deployment in unknown environments they must be locally reshaped, either through modulation or geometric control barrier function strategies. However, depending on the geometry of the obstacles and the complexity of the DS, these local strategies can lead the system to unavoidable collisions or spurious attractors. In this work, we certify safety with a value function drawn from the notion of backward reachability tube, which measures the worst-case safety along a rollout trajectory of the nominal DS. Usually, such a value function is intractable for a controlled system due to curse of dimensionality. We show that in the DS-based learning-from-demonstration setting, the absence of a control input collapses the reachability problem to a deterministic rollout, and the presence of certain stability conditions truncates the infinite horizon to a finite one, resulting in a well-defined value function. We further show that the value function we devised is the maximal forward-invariant subset of the obstaclefree region for the nominal DS flow. The application of this certificate function is validated across five DS constructions - analytical, Neural ODE, diffeomorphic latent space, LPV-DS, SE(3)and validate it on a Franka manipulator. Modulation and geometric CBFs also suffer from saddle point in cases of headon approach towards an unsafe zone. We show that CBF-on-V avoids this pitfall entirely.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种基于后向可达管的值函数安全证书，用于保障动态系统（DS）在未知环境中的安全部署，并证明其在DS模仿学习设定下可计算，且等价于标称DS流在无障碍区域的最大前向不变子集。
AI.motivation: DS作为反应式运动策略虽具稳定性保证，但在未知环境中需通过调制或几何CBF局部重构，而这些局部策略可能因障碍几何和DS复杂度导致碰撞或伪吸引子；同时可达性值函数通常因维数灾难难以求解。
AI.method: 从后向可达管定义值函数，衡量标称DS rollout的最坏情况安全性；证明无控制输入时可达性问题退化为确定性rollout，稳定性条件将无限时域截断为有限时域，从而得到良定义值函数；并验证其为标称DS流无障碍区域的最大前向不变子集。
AI.result: 该证书函数在五类DS构造（解析、Neural ODE、微分同胚潜空间、LPV-DS、SE(3)）和Franka机械臂上得到验证；调制与几何CBF在正面接近不安全区域时会陷入鞍点，而CBF-on-V完全避免该问题。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的值函数可作为DS安全部署的可计算证书，克服局部安全策略的碰撞、伪吸引子和鞍点问题，并在多种DS表示与真实机械臂上有效。

title: Extreme Learning Machine-based Barrier Function Synthesis
summary: Deep learning methods like neural networks have greatly simplified the computation of safety certificates for complex nonlinear systems with unknown dynamics. However, due to the data-driven nature of these certificates and the complex architecture of neural networks, computation time as well as robustness guarantees across unseen data remain a challenge. This work aims to formally verify safety properties of discrete-time unknown systems by synthesizing extreme learning machine (ELM)-based barrier certificates. Compared to neural network counterparts, this approach greatly improves convergence guarantees and computational time due to its architectural simplicity and the convex nature of the underlying optimization problem. By minimizing the Lipschitz constant of the candidate barrier, we present a grid-based sampling technique to formally verify its validity using the minimum number of samples required. We demonstrate through numerical examples the effectiveness of our approach, and compare with traditional deep-learning based certificate synthesis to highlight its benefits.

AI.tldr: 本文提出使用极限学习机（ELM）合成障碍证书，对离散时间未知系统进行形式化安全验证。
AI.motivation: 神经网络安全证书虽简化了复杂非线性系统的证书计算，但其数据驱动特性和复杂网络架构导致计算时间较长，且对未见数据的鲁棒性保证仍具挑战。
AI.method: 基于ELM合成障碍证书，利用其架构简单和凸优化特性提升收敛与计算效率；通过最小化候选障碍函数的Lipschitz常数，并采用网格采样技术，以最少样本量形式化验证证书有效性。
AI.result: 数值实验验证了方法的有效性，并与传统基于深度学习的证书合成方法对比，显示出在收敛保证和计算时间方面的优势。
AI.conclusion: ELM-based障碍证书能够有效且形式化地验证离散时间未知系统的安全性，相比深度学习方法具有更好的收敛保证、计算效率和样本效率。

title: Halluscoring 2026: The first shared task on llms hallucination detection and answer verification
summary: We present HalluScoring 2026, a shared task for evaluating hallucination detection and factual verification in Arabic question answering under challenging generalization settings. The shared task is organized into two main tasks, each comprising two subtasks, for a total of four subtasks. Task 1 evaluates binary hallucination detection, considering generalization to unseen questions (Subtask 1.1) and responses generated by unseen LLMs (Subtask 1.2). Task 2 extends the evaluation beyond detection by requiring the systems to additionally identify the correct factual answer from six related candidates, covering Islamic knowledge (Subtask 2.1) and general knowledge (Subtask 2.2). The shared task is based on two Arabic datasets: HalluScore and HalluTruthQA. A total of 13 teams participated in the shared task, 10 of which submitted system description papers. The results of Task 1 demonstrate that hallucination detection remains challenging under distribution shift, with the winning team achieving AUC-ROC test scores of 0.772 and 0.767 for Subtasks 1.1 and 1.2, respectively. For Task 2, the winning team achieved scores of 0.882 and 0.857 in the Islamic and general-knowledge subtasks, respectively, under assisted evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了HalluScoring 2026共享任务，旨在评估阿拉伯语问答中的幻觉检测与事实核查，重点关注分布偏移下的泛化能力，包括未见问题和未见LLM生成回答。任务分为两个主任务、四个子任务，共有13支队伍参与。
AI.motivation: 阿拉伯语问答中的幻觉检测和事实核查在真实场景下面临泛化挑战，尤其是面对未见问题和未见LLM生成回答时，现有系统性能尚不明确，因此需要建立统一的共享任务进行评估。
AI.method: 构建HalluScoring 2026共享任务，包含任务1二分类幻觉检测（子任务1.1泛化到未见问题，子任务1.2泛化到未见LLM回答）和任务2在检测基础上从六个候选答案中识别正确事实答案（子任务2.1伊斯兰知识，子任务2.2通用知识）。基于两个阿拉伯语数据集HalluScore和HalluTruthQA，共有13支队伍参与，其中10支提交系统描述论文。
AI.result: 任务1表明分布偏移下的幻觉检测仍具挑战性，获胜队伍在子任务1.1和1.2上的AUC-ROC测试分数分别为0.772和0.767。任务2中，获胜队伍在伊斯兰知识和通用知识子任务上的辅助评估分数分别为0.882和0.857。
AI.conclusion: 该共享任务显示，阿拉伯语问答中的幻觉检测在分布偏移下仍然困难，而增加事实答案识别任务后系统可获得较高分数，但结果依赖于辅助评估设置。

title: Team MSU GenText-Forensics Challenge 2026 Technical Report
summary: Document text forgery has evolved beyond simple pixel-level manipulation: modern attacks alter not only the appearance of a document but also its meaning, and increasingly target the OCR & LLM pipelines that consume such documents. The ACM MM 2026 GenText-Forensics challenge therefore requires systems that not only decide whether a multilingual text image is forged, but also localize the point of manipulation, identify the attack type, and produce a human-readable forensic report with supporting evidence. We present our solution, a decomposed chain-of-thought (CoT) pipeline that combines a document tampering detector (DTD) with two Qwen3-VL-32B vision-language models, each LoRA-adapted to a distinct sub-task. DTD produces tampering probability maps that are converted into numbered candidate regions; a first model (the Filterer) validates these regions and assigns a preliminary forgery type, while a second model (the Semantic Detective) merges and re-grounds the surviving regions, searches for purely semantic anomalies that are invisible to pixel-level detectors, and writes the final report. Both models are trained by distilling chain-of-thought traces from a privileged Qwen3-VL-235B teacher that has access to ground-truth masks and reports. Our approach secured third place in the ACM MM 2026 GenText-Forensics challenge. We describe the data preparation, test-time augmentation, region rendering, distillation protocol, and training configuration in detail, and report ablations over detector thresholds, prompt designs, and pipeline decompositions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种分解式思维链（CoT）流水线，用于文档文本伪造检测的多语言图像取证：结合文档篡改检测器（DTD）与两个经LoRA微调的Qwen3-VL-32B视觉语言模型，分别完成候选区域验证与语义异常检测和报告生成，在ACM MM 2026 GenText-Forensics挑战赛中获得第三名。
AI.motivation: 文档伪造已从简单像素级篡改演变为同时改变外观与语义的攻击，并越来越多地针对消费文档的OCR与LLM流水线；现有方法难以同时完成伪造判定、篡改位置定位、攻击类型识别以及生成带证据的可读取证报告。
AI.method: 构建分解式思维链流水线：先用文档篡改检测器（DTD）生成篡改概率图并转为编号候选区域；再用第一个Qwen3-VL-32B（Filterer）验证区域并给出初步伪造类型；第二个模型（Semantic Detective）合并并重定位存活区域，搜索像素级检测器无法察觉的纯语义异常，并撰写最终报告。两个模型均通过从拥有真值掩码与报告的Qwen3-VL-235B特权教师模型蒸馏思维链轨迹进行训练。此外还涉及数据准备、测试时增强、区域渲染、蒸馏协议与训练配置。
AI.result: 该系统在ACM MM 2026 GenText-Forensics挑战赛中获得第三名；论文还报告了针对检测器阈值、提示设计和流水线分解方式的消融实验，并详细描述了数据准备、测试时增强、区域渲染、蒸馏协议与训练配置。
AI.conclusion: 通过将检测、定位、分类与报告生成分解为多阶段思维链，并利用大模型教师蒸馏小型LoRA适配的视觉语言模型，可有效应对针对OCR与LLM流水线的现代文档文本伪造攻击，验证了分解式CoT与语义级检测结合的有效性。

title: BIND: Binding 3D Robot Actions to 2D Image Features
summary: We introduce BIND, a new action representation for visuomotor robot policies that binds 3D robot actions to their corresponding 2D image features, yielding strong data efficiency gains and robustness to out-of-distribution object positions and camera viewpoints. The action heads of current robot policies are typically formulated as an MLP regression from a single global feature vector produced by a pre-trained vision encoder. This global formulation requires the policy network to discover, from demonstrations alone, the relationship between target robot actions and the image features they project onto. The consequence is that although modern image features are semantically descriptive, spatially robust, and even multiview-consistent, the policies built on them are brittle to subtle changes in camera viewpoint and object placement--and surprisingly data-inefficient. BIND closes this gap by supplying the action-feature relationship through camera geometry rather than learning: it discretizes a volume of candidate end effector positions, attaches each candidate to the pre-trained features at its projection in each camera view, and selects actions by scoring each candidate's position and image-bound feature combination. On a real robot, we study data efficiency and out-of-distribution robustness to unseen object positions and camera viewpoints, as well as general long-horizon task execution and dexterity. We find BIND to be highly data-efficient and robust: it achieves near-perfect success on tasks with as few as 5 demonstrations, and degrades gracefully under steep camera-viewpoint shifts and held-out object positions where coordinate-regression baselines completely fail.

AI.tldr: BIND 是一种新的视觉运动机器人策略动作表示，将 3D 机器人动作与其对应的 2D 图像特征绑定，从而在数据效率和分布外鲁棒性上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 当前机器人策略的动作头通常从预训练视觉编码器输出的单一全局特征向量进行 MLP 回归，需要仅从示范中自行学习目标动作与图像特征的关系。这导致策略对相机视角和物体位置的细微变化脆弱，且数据效率低下。
AI.method: BIND 通过相机几何而非学习来提供动作与特征的绑定关系：离散化候选末端执行器位置体积，将每个候选位置与各相机视图投影处的预训练特征关联，并通过评分每个候选的位置与图像绑定特征组合来选择动作。
AI.result: 在真实机器人上，BIND 在少至 5 次示范时即可实现近乎完美的任务成功率，并在相机视角剧烈变化和未见物体位置下优雅退化，而坐标回归基线完全失败；同时验证了长时程任务执行和灵巧性。
AI.conclusion: BIND 利用相机几何将 3D 动作与 2D 图像特征绑定，是一种高度数据高效且对分布外物体位置和相机视角鲁棒的机器人策略动作表示。

title: PhyProbe: Rethinking Physical Consistency Evaluation in Generated Videos
summary: Evaluating the physical consistency of generated videos remains a fundamental challenge. Existing approaches rely on off-the-shelf vision-language models, which can often be myopic to physical dynamics, or fine-tuned evaluators trained on human annotations, which overfit to dataset-specific cues and fail to generalize. A key challenge is that existing supervision sources provide either relative ordering or absolute scores, but not both reliably and consistently across varied settings. To this end, we introduce PhyProbe, an evaluator that extracts features from a frozen pretrained spatio-temporal encoder and maps them to a scalar physical consistency violation score via a lightweight scoring head. PhyProbe is trained through a unified objective combining pairwise ranking, regression on noisy scalar annotations, and anchor-based calibration over a curated set of heterogeneous supervision sources. Experiments show that PhyProbe outperforms prior methods on most pairwise benchmarks spanning real-generated and generated-generated pairs under varying correspondence, with the largest gains in no-correspondence and generated-generated settings where existing fine-tuned evaluators degrade sharply. PhyProbe achieves strong correlation with human judgments, with close agreement between rank-based and linear metrics, indicating that scores are both well ordered and anchored to a stable [0, 1] scale. Further, despite being trained on supervision indicative of physical consistency, without explicit general-preference labels, PhyProbe also performs competitively on human preference benchmarks: consistent with the observation that physics violations are entangled with broader quality degradations.

AI.tldr: 提出PhyProbe，一种基于冻结时空编码器和轻量评分头的视频物理一致性评估器，通过统一目标训练，在多个基准上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有方法依赖现成视觉语言模型，对物理动态不敏感；或微调评估器过拟合数据集线索，泛化差。监督源要么提供相对排序，要么提供绝对分数，难以兼顾。因此需要更稳健的物理一致性评估。
AI.method: PhyProbe从冻结预训练时空编码器提取特征，经轻量评分头映射为标量物理一致性违规分数。训练采用统一目标：成对排序、含噪标量回归、基于锚点的校准，并使用多源异构监督。
AI.result: 在多数成对基准上优于先前方法，涵盖真实-生成与生成-生成对及不同对应关系；在无对应和生成-生成场景增益最大，现有微调评估器显著退化。与人类判断强相关，排序与线性指标高度一致，分数稳定在[0,1]。在人类偏好基准上也有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: PhyProbe能有效评估视频物理一致性，分数既有序又有锚定，无需显式通用偏好标签也能在偏好任务上表现良好，说明物理违规与更广泛质量退化相关联。

title: MetaPersona: Task-Grounded Synthetic Populations from Empirical Social Science
summary: Personas used to seed LLM social simulations face a cold-start problem: existing methods lack a principled basis for deciding which attributes to include and how to assign their values. As a result, synthetic populations may misrepresent the demographic composition, latent attributes, and dependency structure that shape downstream behavior. We introduce MetaPersona-DB, a dataset of 11,000+ empirical human-subjects studies annotated with task-relevant variables, reported relationships, and aggregate-level population statistics. Building on this resource, we propose MetaPersona, a framework that retrieves task-relevant evidence, constructs literature-derived persona dependency graphs, and samples synthetic populations from empirical priors linking demographics, latent attributes, and outcomes. Across three downstream case studies, three baselines, and three frontier models, results vary by task and model: MetaPersona performs strongly on misinformation belief and AI-tool sentiment, while results on income redistribution are mixed. It also reduces persona-construction cost to under $0.5 per task using GPT-5.2. Finally, we present MetaPersona-Studio, a prototype interactive interface for empirically grounded persona generation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 MetaPersona-DB 数据集与 MetaPersona 框架，利用实证研究证据构建有依据的 LLM 社会模拟人物画像，并开发交互原型 MetaPersona-Studio。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 社会模拟中的人物画像存在冷启动问题：缺乏原则性方法决定应包含哪些属性及如何赋值，导致合成人群可能偏离真实人口构成、潜在属性和依赖结构，进而影响下游行为模拟。
AI.method: 构建 MetaPersona-DB，包含 11,000+ 项人类受试者研究的任务相关变量、报告关系和总体统计；提出 MetaPersona 框架，检索任务相关证据，构建文献衍生的人物依赖图，并基于实证先验采样合成人群，连接人口统计、潜在属性和结果变量。
AI.result: 在三个下游案例、三个基线和三个前沿模型上，效果因任务和模型而异：MetaPersona 在错误信息信念和 AI 工具态度任务上表现较强，在收入再分配任务上结果混合；使用 GPT-5.2 时，人物构建成本降至每任务 0.5 美元以下。
AI.conclusion: MetaPersona 为 LLM 社会模拟提供了基于实证证据的人物生成方法，并展示出成本效益和任务适用性差异；同时发布 MetaPersona-Studio 交互原型，支持实证驱动的人物生成。

title: Learning to Fix: Optimisation-Aware Machine Learning for Accelerated Unit Commitment
summary: Unit Commitment is a computationally demanding mixed-integer linear optimisation problem requiring many binary commitment decisions across a scheduling horizon. To reduce this computational burden, machine learning approaches can predict a subset of these decisions, thereby shrinking the search space explored by the optimisation solver. Existing confidence-based approaches determine which variables to fix based on user-defined probability thresholds, which are agnostic to the downstream optimisation problem. We address this limitation by introducing an optimisation-aware framework that yields generator-specific confidence thresholds based on the impact of fixing errors on Unit Commitment solution quality. This approach won first place in the 2025 EPRI AI-ccelerating Unit Commitment competition. The proposed framework achieves a mean optimality gap below 0.5% while also delivering an average speed-up of more than 20x. It therefore provides a general mechanism for translating probabilistic predictions into controlled reductions of mixed-integer search spaces, directly linking learning decisions to their downstream computational and economic consequences.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种优化感知的机组组合加速框架，通过机器学习预测部分二进制决策，并为每台发电机设置特定的置信度阈值，从而在保证解质量的同时显著缩小混合整数搜索空间。
AI.motivation: 机组组合是计算量很大的混合整数线性优化问题，需要在调度周期内做大量二进制启停决策。现有基于置信度的方法依赖用户设定的概率阈值来决定固定哪些变量，这些阈值与下游优化问题无关，可能损害解质量。
AI.method: 提出优化感知框架，根据固定错误对机组组合解质量的影响，生成发电机特定的置信度阈值；将概率预测转化为对混合整数搜索空间的可控缩减。
AI.result: 该框架在2025年EPRI AI-ccelerating Unit Commitment竞赛中获得第一名；平均最优性差距低于0.5%，平均加速超过20倍。
AI.conclusion: 该方法提供了一种通用机制，可将概率预测转化为混合整数搜索空间的可控缩减，并将学习决策与下游计算和经济后果直接关联。

title: Evaluating Language Model Safety Across Long Adversarial Conversations
summary: Conversational safety evaluations often test language models with a single harmful prompt, even though real-world systems interact with users through long, adaptive conversations. This study examines whether models continue to respond safely when an adversarial user persists across multiple turns. We evaluate three open-weight, instruction-tuned models on two harmful prompts across different conversation lengths and random seeds. In each setting, a second language model acts as a persistent adversarial user, while a safety classifier labels every response as safe or unsafe. Across all model-prompt combinations, first-turn safe-response rates ranged from 85% to 100%. By depth 11, they dropped to 38-61%, and by depth 101, to 15-44%. This decline appeared across models and continued well beyond the short interactions typically used in multi-turn safety evaluations. These results provide proof-of-concept evidence that strong single-turn safety does not necessarily persist during sustained adversarial interaction. They highlight the need for long-horizon evaluations and conversation-level safeguards that account for risk accumulating across turns.

AI.tldr: 该研究测试语言模型在多轮持续对抗性对话中的安全性，发现首轮安全率虽高，但随着对话轮数增加会显著下降。
AI.motivation: 现有对话安全评估常只用单一有害提示测试模型，而现实系统通过长时、自适应对话与用户交互，因此需要检验模型在持续对抗用户下是否仍能保持安全。
AI.method: 评估三个开放权重、指令微调模型，针对两个有害提示，在不同对话长度和随机种子下进行测试；每轮由一个语言模型扮演持续对抗用户，另一个安全分类器将模型回复标注为安全或不安全。
AI.result: 所有模型-提示组合的首轮安全回复率为85%至100%；到第11轮降至38%至61%，到第101轮降至15%至44%。这种下降跨模型出现，并远超通常多轮安全评估的短交互范围。
AI.conclusion: 强单轮安全性不一定能在持续对抗交互中保持，说明需要长时程评估和对话级安全防护，以应对跨轮次累积的风险。

title: Decode-Latency Feedback Prefill: A Model-Free Controller and Its Generalization Limits
comment: 5 pages, 1 figure. Includes negative generalization results for Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-32B, and two-GPU tensor parallelism
summary:
Concurrent autoregressive inference creates a fundamental interference problem: prefilling a newly arrived long prompt can delay tokens for requests that are already decoding. Fixed prefill chunks reduce this interference, but the best chunk size depends on the model, hardware, load, and latency objective. We introduce Decode-Latency Feedback Prefill (DLFP), a model-free controller that changes only prefill work that overlaps active decodes. After a guarded scheduling cycle, DLFP uses the observed interval as proportional feedback to resize the next prefill chunk; isolated prefills remain unrestricted.
  We implement DLFP in vLLM and evaluate it with open-loop Poisson arrivals, exact token accounting, raw request traces, and NVIDIA telemetry. On Qwen3-0.6B in BF16 on one A100 80 GB GPU, three paired 100-request trials reduce P99 inter-token latency by 24.8%, 30.1%, and 28.2% (mean 27.7%, paired 95% confidence interval 21.0% to 34.3%) with exact output agreement, no failures, and unchanged SLO compliance. The benefit is not free: mean P99 time to first token increases 34.8% while remaining inside the declared SLO.
  Crucially, the mechanism does not generalize to Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-32B, or a two-GPU tensor-parallel configuration. We trace the failure to an asynchronous scheduler-call interval that is only a proxy for completed GPU iteration time. This negative result defines the boundary of the contribution and motivates a completion-timed controller for concurrent CPU and on-device inference. We do not claim mobile-device performance; the present work is a reproducible proof-of-concept and generalization study.

AI.tldr: 提出Decode-Latency Feedback Prefill (DLFP)，一种无模型控制器，动态调整与活跃解码重叠的预填充块大小以减少对解码请求的干扰。在vLLM中实现，A100上Qwen3-0.6B降低P99 inter-token延迟约27.7%，但TTFT增加34.8%，且无法泛化到更大模型或多GPU配置。
AI.motivation: 并发自回归推理中，新到达的长提示预填充会延迟正在解码请求的token；固定预填充块大小受模型、硬件、负载和延迟目标影响，难以通用。
AI.method: DLFP仅改变与活跃解码重叠的预填充工作：在受保护的调度周期后，用观察到的间隔作为比例反馈调整下一个预填充块大小；孤立预填充不受限制。在vLLM中实现，使用开环泊松到达、精确token计费、原始请求trace和NVIDIA遥测评估。
AI.result: Qwen3-0.6B BF16单A100 80GB上，三次配对100请求试验将P99 inter-token延迟降低24.8%、30.1%、28.2%（均值27.7%，95% CI 21.0–34.3%），输出完全一致，无失败，SLO合规不变。代价是平均P99 TTFT增加34.8%，但仍在SLO内。然而方法无法泛化到Qwen3-8B、Qwen3-32B或双GPU张量并行配置；失败源于异步调度器调用间隔仅是完成GPU迭代时间的代理。
AI.conclusion: 该负结果界定了贡献边界，并推动为并发CPU和端侧推理设计基于完成时间的控制器。作者不声称移动设备性能，当前工作是可复现的概念验证和泛化研究。

title: Embodiment-aware control by inference over the operator: a simulation study
comment: 13 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/sa-falcone/uee-embodiment-sim (doi:10.5281/zenodo.23044669)
summary: Teleoperation systems are tuned for channel fidelity, while whether the operator experiences the device as part of the body, the Sense of Embodiment (SoE), is measured only afterwards, by questionnaire. Predictive-processing accounts suggest controlling devices to reduce the mismatch between the operator's predictions and the returned feedback, but those predictions are unobservable, and an objective that only penalizes mismatch is minimized by removing feedback. We formulate an embodiment-aware controller, the Universal Embodiment Engine (UEE), that infers the operator's embodiment and visuo-proprioceptive cue weighting from implicit gaze and pupil signals and task outcome, and chooses bounded device settings under explicit preferences, cast as a discrete Active Inference agent. In simulations with 300 heterogeneous synthetic operators, the UEE found the suitable setting within half a minute for most operators, before identifying their exact type, and came close to an oracle in the second half of the session (embodiment 1.68 against 0.73 for the best fixed setting, on a 0-2 scale). Adapting without reading the operator did no better than fixed control, and model-free bandits did worse, whereas an expected-utility controller with the same inference did exactly as well: the benefit comes from Bayesian inference over the operator with explicit preferences, not from the information-seeking term of Active Inference. A naive prediction-error minimizer withheld feedback, as its objective implies, and lost task success (0.74 vs 0.90). The benefit shrank but persisted for operators outside the controller's model family, grew with the variety of the population, and vanished when the controller trusted an uninformative signal or when cue weighting changed mid-session without being modeled. These failures show what studies with people must establish first: calibrated signals and a model of change.

AI.tldr: 论文提出通用具身引擎（UEE），一种基于主动推理的控制器，通过隐式眼动和瞳孔信号及任务结果推断操作者的具身感与视觉-本体感觉线索权重，自适应选择遥操作设备设置以提升具身感。
AI.motivation: 遥操作系统通常仅针对信道保真度调优，而操作者是否将设备体验为身体一部分（具身感SoE）仅事后用问卷测量。预测处理理论认为应减少预测与反馈失配，但预测不可观测，且仅惩罚失配的目标会通过移除反馈来最小化。
AI.method: 将UEE建模为离散主动推理代理，从眼动、瞳孔等隐式信号和任务结果中推断操作者的具身感及线索权重，在显式偏好下选择有界设备设置。在300个异质合成操作者上进行仿真，并与固定控制、无模型bandit、期望效用控制器及朴素预测误差最小化器对比。
AI.result: UEE在多数操作者中半分钟内找到合适设置，后半段具身感接近oracle（1.68 vs 最佳固定设置0.73，0-2量表）。无推断的自适应不优于固定控制，无模型bandit更差；相同推断的期望效用控制器表现相同，说明收益来自对操作者的贝叶斯推断与显式偏好，而非主动推理的信息寻求项。朴素预测误差最小化器会扣留反馈，任务成功率下降（0.74 vs 0.90）。对模型族外操作者收益缩小但持续，随群体多样性增加而增大；当信任无信息信号或未建模线索权重中途变化时收益消失。
AI.conclusion: 该控制器能通过隐式生理信号推断并适应操作者具身感，但实际人类研究需先确保信号校准和变化建模，否则收益可能消失。

title: Observability Analysis and Online Calibration of Visual-Inertial-Wheel Odometry for 4WIS4WID Mobile Robots
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: In this paper, we present a visual-inertial-wheel odometry (VIWO) framework with online calibration for four-wheel independently steered and driven (4WIS4WID) mobile robots. We derive a 2D odometry model directly from the four driving velocities and steering angles, using both the longitudinal rolling constraints and the lateral no-slip constraints of all wheels. A preintegration model and analytical Jacobians are developed for efficient filtering and calibration. An observability analysis of the linearized VIWO system shows that a drive-only model makes all steering offsets unobservable, whereas the proposed redundant model restores their observability. The analysis also identifies four standard VINS unobservable directions and three additional directions associated with the arbitrary placement of the odometry reference frame. Furthermore, we characterize several degenerate motions, including zero yaw rate, constant steering, and a non-rolling wheel, and derive the corresponding excitation conditions for the thirteen wheel intrinsics that remain after fixing the odometry frame reference. The performance of the proposed system has been demonstrated in both simulation and real-world experiments on a 4WIS4WID mobile robot.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向四轮独立转向驱动（4WIS4WID）移动机器人的视觉-惯性-轮式里程计（VIWO）框架，支持在线标定，并通过仿真和真实实验验证其性能。
AI.motivation: 针对4WIS4WID机器人中轮式里程计参数标定与状态估计的难题，尤其是转向偏置等参数的可观测性问题，需要一种能在线校准并提升里程计精度的融合框架。
AI.method: 从四个驱动速度和转向角直接推导2D里程计模型，利用所有车轮的纵向滚动约束和横向无滑移约束；建立预积分模型与解析雅可比以支持高效滤波和标定；对线性化VIWO系统进行可观测性分析，并分析退化运动及激励条件。
AI.result: 仅驱动模型会使所有转向偏置不可观测，而提出的冗余模型可恢复其可观测性；分析还识别出四个标准VINS不可观测方向及三个与里程计参考系任意放置相关的额外方向；刻画了零偏航角速度、恒定转向、车轮不滚动等退化运动，并给出固定参考系后13个车轮内参的激励条件。
AI.conclusion: 所提VIWO框架在4WIS4WID移动机器人上的仿真和真实实验均展示了良好性能。

title: Sharing the Gains of Aggregation: Cooperative Imbalance Cost Allocation
summary: A facilitator is an intermediary that offers renewable producers and consumers fixed-price contracts and, acting as their balance responsible party, manages the residual imbalances in the market. Pooling imperfectly correlated residuals nets consumers' imbalances and reduces the portfolio's total imbalance cost, but raises an allocation question: how should these savings be divided among heterogeneous consumers? We formulate this as a cooperative game, the imbalance netting game, and compare six allocation mechanisms under a two-price imbalance settlement in terms of computational requirements, budget balance, group rationality, and additivity. We establish three analytical results: a necessary and sufficient condition for budget balance of the marginal cost contribution mechanism, group rationality of the marginal cost contribution and Vickrey-Clarke-Groves mechanisms, and a necessary and sufficient condition for when the Gately point is well-defined. On Danish 2024 data for 19 consumers, aggregation reduces imbalance cost by 10%, but how these savings are shared depends strongly on the allocation rule. A flat-rate allocation proportional to consumption, used as a benchmark for socialized imbalance pricing, charges some consumers more than twice their standalone cost, whereas all the game-theoretic mechanisms studied produce stable allocations in practice.

AI.tldr: 本文将促进者聚合可再生能源生产者与消费者的不平衡量建模为合作博弈“不平衡净额结算博弈”，比较六种分配机制，并用丹麦2024年19个消费者数据验证聚合可降低不平衡成本，但节省分配高度依赖规则。
AI.motivation: 促进者通过固定价格合同和作为平衡责任方管理市场剩余不平衡；聚合不完全相关的残余不平衡可降低总不平衡成本，但如何在异质消费者之间分配节省成为关键公平与激励问题。
AI.method: 构建合作博弈模型，比较六种分配机制在双边不平衡结算下的计算需求、预算平衡、群体理性和可加性；给出边际成本贡献机制预算平衡、边际成本贡献与VCG机制群体理性、Gately点良定义的条件；使用丹麦2024年19个消费者数据进行实证。
AI.result: 聚合使不平衡成本降低10%；节省分配强烈依赖分配规则。按消费量比例的统一费率分配（社会化不平衡定价基准）会使部分消费者被收取超过其独立成本两倍的费用，而所研究的博弈论机制在实践中产生稳定分配。
AI.conclusion: 聚合可带来显著不平衡成本节省，但分配机制选择至关重要；博弈论分配机制在实证中表现稳定，优于可能造成过度收费的统一费率基准。

title: LoopVL: Recurrent Visual Intelligence
summary: We introduce LoopVL to study whether Loop Transformers can be effectively extended to vision- language models. LoopVL combines Module-Loop and Model-Loop computation to iteratively update a unified vision-language state through shared modules. We train LoopVL from scratch through language pre-training, multimodal training, and post-training. LoopVL outperforms a range of similarly sized and larger non-recurrent models on multimodal understanding and visual reasoning benchmarks. We also observe Visual Aha Moments in LoopVL, characterized by pronounced shifts in visual attention across loops. LoopVL provides practical evidence for recurrent vision-language modeling and offers an intuitive perspective on how shared parameters can support deeper multimodal computation over continuously evolving visual-language states.

AI.tldr: LoopVL 将循环 Transformer 扩展到视觉语言模型，通过模块循环和模型循环迭代更新统一的视觉语言状态，从零训练后在多模态理解与视觉推理任务上优于同类及更大非循环模型，并展现出视觉 Aha Moments。
AI.motivation: 研究循环 Transformer 是否能有效扩展到视觉语言模型，以及共享参数如何支持更深入的多模态计算。
AI.method: 结合 Module-Loop 与 Model-Loop 计算，通过共享模块迭代更新统一的视觉语言状态；从零开始进行语言预训练、多模态训练和后训练。
AI.result: 在多模态理解和视觉推理基准上超越一系列同规模及更大规模的非循环模型；观察到 Visual Aha Moments，即视觉注意力在不同循环间发生显著变化。
AI.conclusion: 为循环视觉语言建模提供了实践证据，并直观展示了共享参数如何支持基于持续演化的视觉语言状态进行更深层的多模态计算。

title: Circuit-Based Dispersion Analysis of Periodic Cross-Shaped Unit Cells with Dirac Characteristics
summary: In this paper, the dispersion behavior of periodic cross-shaped unit cells is investigated with emphasis on Dirac-type dispersion using an equivalent circuit modeling approach. Two unit-cell geometries, including a simple cross structure and a modified configuration with a central patch, are analyzed using full-wave eigenmode simulations and scattering-parameter-based dispersion extraction. An equivalent circuit model is developed to capture the dominant coupling mechanisms and accurately reproduce the dispersion characteristics near the $Γ$-point. The results demonstrate that the proposed circuit model exhibits good agreement with full-wave simulations and provides a physically intuitive framework for analyzing stopband behavior and mode degeneracy. Furthermore, the limitations of S-parameter-based dispersion extraction in the presence of low-Q radiative modes are highlighted.

AI.tldr: 本文通过等效电路建模研究了周期性十字形单元结构的色散特性，重点关注狄拉克型色散。
AI.motivation: 为了深入理解周期性十字形单元结构中的色散行为，尤其是狄拉克型色散，并建立物理直观的分析框架。
AI.method: 针对简单十字结构和带中心贴片的改进结构两种单元，采用全波本征模仿真和基于散射参数的色散提取，并建立等效电路模型来捕捉主要耦合机制。
AI.result: 等效电路模型与全波仿真吻合良好，能准确复现Γ点附近的色散特性，并直观分析阻带行为和模式简并；同时揭示了基于S参数的色散提取在低Q辐射模式下的局限性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的等效电路模型是分析周期性十字形单元色散的有效且直观的工具，并指出了S参数提取方法的适用限制。

title: SimTrace: Grounded Multimodal User Trajectories Generation for Online User Modeling
summary: Virtual clients offer a cost-effective approach to support applications such as A/B testing, recommender system development, and interface evaluation. However, building them requires access to large-scale, semantically faithful, fine-grained online user trajectories. These data are difficult to obtain because proprietary logs are subject to privacy restrictions and small businesses often lack sufficient traffic. Consequently, existing public datasets either abstract away fine-grained user interaction details or preserve rich context but remain platform-specific and small-scale. To address this gap, we propose SimTrace, a framework that generates faithful, fine-grained synthetic multimodal clickstreams through a computer-use client agent that is grounded in real user trajectories and the given web environment. SimTrace anonymizes real interactions and constructs a simulated twin of the given web environment, then uses both to generate synthetic interaction trajectories. Each action is paired with its corresponding web observations and user context, yielding a shareable alternative to confidential logs for developing computer-use agent-style virtual clients. We apply SimTrace to an e-commerce setting and evaluate both its fidelity and downstream utility. SimTrace outperforms competing baselines on 7 out of 8 fidelity metrics. Models trained on synthetic data achieve performance comparable to those trained on real data on downstream tasks such as purchase prediction and recommendation. For next action prediction task, augmenting real data with synthetic data further improves accuracy by 11.0% relative to training on real data alone. We release SimTrace as an open-source package to facilitate research on online user behavior modeling.

AI.tldr: 提出 SimTrace 框架，通过基于真实用户轨迹和给定网页环境的 computer-use 客户端智能体，生成忠实、细粒度、多模态的合成点击流，用于开发虚拟客户端。
AI.motivation: 虚拟客户端需要大规模、语义忠实、细粒度的在线用户轨迹，但专有日志受隐私限制，小企业又缺乏足够流量；现有公开数据集要么缺少细粒度交互细节，要么虽保留丰富上下文但平台特定且规模小。
AI.method: SimTrace 先匿名化真实交互，并为给定网页环境构建模拟孪生，再结合两者生成合成交互轨迹；每个动作都配有对应网页观察和用户上下文。作者在电商场景中评估其保真度和下游效用。
AI.result: SimTrace 在 8 项保真度指标中的 7 项优于竞争基线；用合成数据训练的模型在购买预测、推荐等下游任务上性能与真实数据相当；在下一动作预测任务中，真实数据加合成数据比仅用真实数据相对提升 11.0% 准确率。
AI.conclusion: SimTrace 能生成可共享的细粒度合成点击流，作为机密日志的替代品，支持 computer-use 智能体式虚拟客户端和在线用户行为建模研究，并已开源发布。

title: TrafficSignBench: Rule-Centric Closed-Loop Evaluation of Traffic-Sign Compliance in Autonomous Driving
summary: Autonomous driving planners are typically evaluated using aggregate metrics such as driving score, destination rate, and collision rate, which do not explicitly measure compliance with traffic rules. As a result, planners can achieve high benchmark scores while still exhibiting unsafe or illegal behaviors, limiting their applicability to real-world deployment. To address this gap, we introduce TrafficSignBench, a large-scale, traffic sign-centric benchmark for systematic and interpretable evaluation of traffic-rule compliance in autonomous driving. Our framework combines real-map-based simulation for realistic road layouts with rule-targeted procedural scenario generation for scalable and balanced coverage of underrepresented rules. We implement traffic rules corresponding to 34 traffic signs, each equipped with an automatic rule checker for detecting violations during closed-loop execution. This design yields 29,000 diverse road scenes and 29 distinct testing scenario types, enabling controlled evaluation of rule-specific planner behavior. We construct 5,800 testing scenes and demonstrate that current autonomous driving planners can exhibit poor traffic-rule compliance despite strong performance on standard evaluation metrics. To address this limitation, we transform existing planners into rule-compliant trajectory experts via explicit traffic-sign constraints, enabling scalable generation of high-quality oracle trajectories for fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 TrafficSignBench，一个以交通标志为核心的大规模基准，用于系统且可解释地评估自动驾驶规划器对交通规则的遵守情况。该基准结合真实地图仿真和面向规则的场景生成，覆盖34种交通标志、29,000个道路场景和29类测试场景，并发现现有规划器虽在常规指标上表现良好，却常违反交通规则；作者进一步利用显式交通标志约束将规划器转化为规则合规的轨迹专家，以生成高质量微调数据。
AI.motivation: 现有自动驾驶规划器通常使用驾驶分数、到达率和碰撞率等聚合指标评估，不能显式衡量交通规则遵守情况，导致规划器可能获得高分却存在不安全或违规行为，限制实际部署。
AI.method: 提出 TrafficSignBench：结合基于真实地图的仿真与面向规则的程序化场景生成，实现可扩展且均衡的规则覆盖；为34种交通标志实现对应规则，并为每种规则配备自动违规检查器，在闭环执行中检测违规；构建29,000个多样道路场景和29种测试场景类型，并构建5,800个测试场景；还通过显式交通标志约束将现有规划器转化为规则合规的轨迹专家，以生成高质量 oracle 轨迹用于微调。
AI.result: 构建了大规模、可解释的交通规则合规评估基准，包含34种交通标志规则、29,000个道路场景、29类测试场景和5,800个测试场景。实验表明，当前自动驾驶规划器在标准评估指标上表现较强，但在交通规则遵守方面可能表现较差。
AI.conclusion: 聚合指标不足以衡量自动驾驶规划器的交通规则合规性；TrafficSignBench 提供了系统化、可解释的评估手段。将现有规划器转化为规则合规的轨迹专家，可规模化生成高质量 oracle 轨迹，为提升规则合规性提供微调数据。

title: Doc2LoRA Provides Decodable Representations of Scientific Ideas
summary: Representing scientific papers as points in a space lets us search for similar papers and inquire about how fields relate to one another and drive innovation. Beyond search, the vector space of papers invites generation: mixing papers through simple vector operations creates new points, mirroring combinatorial novelty, the recombination of existing ideas into new ones. However, a mixed point often represents an idea no paper has yet realized, with no papers nearby to identify the idea. We propose representing each paper by a LoRA adapter generated by the Doc-to-LoRA hypernetwork. Every point in the space, including mixtures, thus represents a large language model (LLM) open to questions and instructions in natural language. On papers from the American Physical Society (APS), we instruct the LLM at the average of each subfield to name the field in a few words and obtain labels closer to the official names than the labels of five baselines, as judged by word overlap and a panel of five LLM judges. We also ask the LLMs at points between two APS papers to write an abstract and obtain descriptions shifting from one paper to the other in step with the mixing weight. While Doc-to-LoRA is trained for generation, a small invertible transform makes the embeddings competitive for search, on par with SPECTER2 and EmbeddingGemma and close to SBERT. Because the transform is invertible, every point in the transformed space still maps back to an LLM. The embeddings thus serve both search and generation, enabling researchers to question the idea at any point in the space as a starting point for generating new ideas.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出用 Doc-to-LoRA 超网络为每篇科学论文生成一个 LoRA 适配器，使论文空间中的每个点（包括混合点）都对应一个可用自然语言提问和指令的 LLM；该方法既能支持论文搜索，也能通过混合生成新想法。
AI.motivation: 将科学论文表示为向量空间中的点有助于搜索相似论文并理解领域关系，但通过简单向量运算混合论文得到的新点往往代表尚未实现的构想，附近没有论文可用于识别该想法。
AI.method: 使用 Doc-to-LoRA 超网络为每篇论文生成 LoRA 适配器，将论文表示为 LLM 而非普通向量；在 APS 论文上，让子领域平均点处的 LLM 用几个词命名领域，并让两篇论文之间混合点处的 LLM 写摘要；同时引入小型可逆变换，使嵌入可用于搜索且可逆回映射到 LLM。
AI.result: 子领域标签比五个基线更接近官方名称，依据词重叠和五个 LLM 评审判断；混合点生成的摘要会随混合权重从一篇论文逐步转向另一篇；搜索性能与 SPECTER2、EmbeddingGemma 相当，接近 SBERT。
AI.conclusion: 论文空间中的点可同时服务于搜索和生成；由于可逆变换保留回映射能力，研究者可以就空间中任意点所代表的“想法”进行提问，并将其作为生成新想法的起点。

title: VidHarness: Evolving Agent Harnesses for Cost-Efficient Long Video Understanding
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) can answer questions about hour-long videos, but processing every frame is prohibitively expensive, even though the evidence for a question usually spans only a few seconds. Video agents, i.e., harness programs wrapped around a frozen VLM, address this by observing the video selectively, yet existing harnesses are hand-crafted by experts through slow build-and-test cycles.
