We propose VidHarness, a framework that automates harness design for cost-efficient long video understanding, in which a harness proposer iteratively evolves harnesses based on execution feedback from an evolution environment. To escape the local optima of greedy refinement, we organize the evolution as Monte Carlo tree search (MCTS), and to reduce the evaluation cost, we integrate uncertainty-aware multi-fidelity validation, which screens new harnesses on a few questions and promotes only the promising ones. Since the best harness varies with the frame budget, we further introduce a mixture-of-harness that routes each question to a harness specialized for its budget. VidHarness sets new state-of-the-art results on LongVideoBench, Video-MME, and Video-Holmes, outperforms the strongest hand-crafted video agent by up to $11.2$ points, and generalizes to the knowledge-intensive benchmarks Video-MMMU and MMVU with fewer than half of the frames of uniform sampling.

AI.tldr: VidHarness 是一个自动化视频代理（harness）设计的框架，用于成本高效的长视频理解，通过 MCTS 进化 harness，结合多保真度验证和混合专家路由，在多个基准上取得 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLM 处理长视频时逐帧处理成本过高，而问题证据通常只持续几秒；现有视频代理依赖专家手工设计，构建-测试周期慢，效率低。
AI.method: 提出 VidHarness，自动化 harness 设计：harness 提议器根据执行反馈迭代进化 harness；采用蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）避免贪心局部最优；集成不确定性感知的多保真度验证，用少量问题筛选候选 harness；引入混合-of-harness，根据帧预算将问题路由到专用 harness。
AI.result: 在 LongVideoBench、Video-MME、Video-Holmes 上取得新 SOTA，比最强手工视频代理提升最多 11.2 分；在知识密集型基准 Video-MMMU 和 MMVU 上泛化，使用不到均匀采样一半的帧数。
AI.conclusion: VidHarness 能自动设计高效视频代理，显著提升长视频理解性能并降低帧数成本，具有良好泛化能力。

title: ArgGYM: A Procedural, Engine-Verified Benchmark for Structured Defeasible Reasoning
summary: Recent progress in large language model reasoning has been driven by benchmarks and reinforcement learning environments with automatically verifiable rewards, particularly in mathematics, code, and formal logic. These settings make model accuracy easier to evaluate and optimize, but it remains unclear how far success under fixed problem specifications and stable evaluation criteria transfers to reasoning outside such domains. Real-world reasoning often proceeds under incomplete and revisable information: conclusions may be supported provisionally, defeated by counter-evidence, reinstated by further arguments, or revised when stronger reasons become available. Reasoning of this kind is generally referred to as defeasible reasoning. We introduce ArgGYM, a procedural benchmark and RLVR-compatible training environment for structured defeasible reasoning. ArgGYM decomposes this reasoning into twelve tasks and grounds task-specific scoring in a symbolic argumentation engine that computes the formal states used to evaluate model outputs. It includes a frozen benchmark of 1,440 verified instances across fifteen curriculum configurations, two argument preference orderings (weakest-link and last-link), and two set orderings (elitist and democratic), while the same generators and verifiers can produce fresh instances for evaluation that reduces dependence on static test sets and for verifiable-reward training. On the frozen benchmark, frontier and open-weight models show sharply different reasoning profiles: they can recover substantial parts of structured answers without solving the complete task, and performance declines in later curriculum configurations with longer dependencies and more interacting structures. We release the benchmark, generators, and verifiers for reproducible evaluation and RLVR training.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ArgGYM，一个面向结构化可废止推理（defeasible reasoning）的过程式基准与 RLVR 兼容训练环境，用于评估和训练模型在信息不完整、结论可修正情境下的推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型推理进展多依赖数学、代码和形式逻辑等具有自动可验证奖励的基准与环境，但这类固定问题设定和稳定评价标准下的成功，是否能迁移到真实世界中信息不完整、结论可被反驳或修正的可废止推理，仍不明确。
AI.method: ArgGYM 将可废止推理分解为十二项任务，并基于符号论证引擎计算形式状态，对模型输出进行任务特定评分。它包含一个冻结基准，涵盖十五种课程配置、两种论证偏好排序（weakest-link 与 last-link）和两种集合排序（elitist 与 democratic），共 1440 个已验证实例；同一套生成器与验证器还可生成新实例，以减少对静态测试集的依赖，并支持可验证奖励训练。
AI.result: 在冻结基准上，前沿模型与开放权重模型表现出明显不同的推理画像：它们能够恢复结构化答案的相当一部分，但未完整解决全部任务；随着课程配置推进，依赖链更长、交互结构更多时，性能下降。
AI.conclusion: 论文发布基准、生成器和验证器，以支持可复现评估与 RLVR 训练，并推动可废止推理研究。

title: L1-MPPI: L1 Adaptive Model Predictive Path Integral for Agile UAV Control
summary: This work proposes the L1 Adaptive Model Predictive Path Integral (L1-MPPI). It cascades L1 adaptive control with the Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) to improve tracking of high-speed UAV trajectories. Thanks to the L1augmentation, the tracking remains accurate even under model uncertainties and external disturbances, such as an additional payload or a mismatch in the modeled aerodynamic drag. In contrast to existing MPPI approaches for UAV control that do not explicitly model aerodynamic effects, varying payloads, and typically neglect the dynamics of low-level motor controllers, our L1-MPPI approach enhances the dynamic model used in the MPPI by incorporating the low-level flight controller and motor dynamics, as well as an iterative mixing scheme that reflects the approach of the low-level controller. The proposed method demonstrates improved tracking performance in both simulation and the real world, even when the UAV is subjected to an unknown payload. In flight with 35% mass increase, our approach lowers the RMSE by 58.61% with respect to plain MPPI. Compared to the same MPPI using an online mass estimator in place of the L1 augmentation, the RMSE is lower by 38.59%. During the real-world experiments the UAV reaches speeds up to 13.50 m/s and accelerations up to 2.5 g.

AI.tldr: 本文提出L1自适应模型预测路径积分（L1-MPPI），将L1自适应控制与MPPI级联，用于提升高速无人机轨迹跟踪性能，并在模型不确定性和外部扰动下保持鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有面向无人机控制的MPPI方法通常未显式建模气动效应、变化负载，并忽略底层电机控制器动态，导致在高速飞行、未知负载或模型失配时跟踪精度下降。
AI.method: 采用L1自适应控制与MPPI级联的L1-MPPI框架；在MPPI的动态模型中纳入底层飞行控制器与电机动态，并引入反映底层控制器行为的迭代混合方案；利用L1自适应增强补偿模型不确定性和外部扰动。
AI.result: 在仿真和真实实验中均提升跟踪性能；在无人机负载增加35%时，相比普通MPPI将RMSE降低58.61%，相比使用在线质量估计器的MPPI降低38.59%；实飞速度最高达13.50 m/s，加速度最高达2.5 g。
AI.conclusion: L1-MPPI通过融合L1自适应与增强动态模型，能够有效应对未知负载、气动阻力失配等不确定性，实现高速无人机轨迹的高精度鲁棒跟踪。

title: Evaluating Whether LLMs Can Reliably Connect the DOTs?
summary: Access to real-world information is often noisy and fragmented. Constructing a coherent narrative from such fragments requires models to reconstruct missing spans within a broader storyline, commonly referred to as text infilling, while preserving consistency with both the local context and the global storyline. Despite using text infilling as a pre-training objective in many Large Language Models (LLMs), their actual performance on real-world narrative infilling remains underexplored. In this paper, we address this gap by introducing a multi-domain benchmark of ~9.2K instances for narrative infilling, constructed by masking one to three sentences across four narrative types: encyclopedic text, commonsense stories, news articles, and visual narratives. Using this benchmark, we evaluate 20 instruction-tuned open-source LLMs ranging from 1.5B to 70B parameters across varying levels of instruction specificity and reasoning guidance. Outputs are assessed using standard automatic metrics and a qualitative framework covering five narrative dimensions. Results show that model scale does not reliably predict infilling quality: Gemma-2-2B achieves the highest qualitative score (4.02/5), outperforming models over ten times larger, including DeepSeek-Qwen-32B (3.77/5, 6.6%) and LLaMA-3.3-70B (3.71/5, 8.3%). We further find that explicit reasoning offers limited benefits as chain-of-thought reasoning yields only a marginal improvement (+0.6%). Additionally, short narratives and domain characteristics emerge as stronger predictors of task difficulty than infill position alone for narrative infilling in current LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个约9.2K实例的多领域叙事填充基准，覆盖百科、常识故事、新闻和视觉叙事四类叙事，并评估20个1.5B至70B指令微调开源LLM。结果显示模型规模并不能可靠预测填充质量，小模型Gemma-2-2B在定性评分上最佳。
AI.motivation: 现实世界信息往往嘈杂且碎片化，模型需要从碎片中重建缺失片段并保持局部与全局叙事一致，即文本填充。尽管文本填充常被用作LLM预训练目标，但其在真实叙事填充任务上的表现仍缺乏充分探索。
AI.method: 作者构建了一个多领域叙事填充基准，通过遮盖1至3个句子生成约9.2K个实例，涵盖百科文本、常识故事、新闻文章和视觉叙事。基于该基准，评估20个指令微调开源LLM，参数量从1.5B到70B，并变化指令具体程度和推理引导。输出使用标准自动指标和覆盖五个叙事维度的定性框架进行评估。
AI.result: 模型规模不能可靠预测填充质量：Gemma-2-2B取得最高定性分数4.02/5，优于参数量大十倍以上的模型，包括DeepSeek-Qwen-32B（3.77/5，低6.6%）和LLaMA-3.3-70B（3.71/5，低8.3%）。显式推理收益有限，思维链仅带来约0.6%的边际提升。此外，短叙事和领域特征比填充位置更能预测当前LLM在叙事填充中的任务难度。
AI.conclusion: 叙事填充任务中，模型规模并非可靠的质量指标，小模型也可能表现优异；显式推理和思维链带来的提升有限；任务难度更多受叙事长度和领域特征影响，而非单纯由填充位置决定。

title: STELLA: A 16nm Spatio-Temporal Elastic Low-Latency CGRA for Multi-Stage Pipelined Applications
summary: Emerging non-matrix ML kernels, such as LayerNorm, GeLu, FFT or circular convolutions, demand low-latency, energy-efficient spatial accelerators beyond MatMul-centric arrays. STELLA presents a spatio-temporal elastic 16 nm coarse-grained reconfigurable array (CGRA) with a rapid configuration path, per-PE hardware loop control, and a low-latency, deeply pipelined elastic fabric with spatio-temporal data reuse. STELLA reaches up to 110 GOPS/mm2 at 850 MHz, and improves effective kernel throughput by 4.84-7.14x over baseline CGRAs.

AI.tldr: STELLA 是一种面向非矩阵类机器学习内核的 16nm 粗粒度可重构阵列（CGRA），通过时空弹性架构、快速配置路径和硬件循环控制，实现低延迟、高能效加速。
AI.motivation: LayerNorm、GeLU、FFT、循环卷积等非矩阵类 ML 内核不断涌现，传统以 MatMul 为中心的阵列难以满足低延迟和能效需求，因此需要新型空间加速器。
AI.method: 提出 STELLA 时空弹性 16nm CGRA，包含快速配置路径、每个 PE 的硬件循环控制，以及支持时空数据复用的低延迟深度流水弹性织物。
AI.result: 在 850 MHz 下达到最高 110 GOPS/mm2，相比基线 CGRA，有效内核吞吐率提升 4.84-7.14 倍。
AI.conclusion: STELLA 能有效加速非矩阵类 ML 内核，并在吞吐率和能效上显著优于基线 CGRA 方案。

title: Diffusion-2BC: Hybrid Diffusion and Regression Training for Offline Behavior Cloning in Autonomous Driving
summary: Behavior cloning provides an offline route to autonomous-driving policy learning, but mean-squared-error regression is poorly matched to demonstrations in which one observation admits several valid actions. Diffusion policies can represent conditional multimodal action distributions, yet their closed-loop performance may be unstable when visual features and control are learned from limited data. This paper presents Diffusion-2BC, which combines a diffusion denoising objective with an auxiliary deterministic behavior-cloning loss over a shared visual encoder. The auxiliary branch is used only during training; inference remains diffusion-based. The proposed method is evaluated in the controlled Claw environment and in bird's-eye-view CARLA navigation, including route-conditioned driving, route-free navigation through multiple intersections, and cross-map evaluation from Town01 to Town02. In the Claw task, Diffusion-2BC reduced the mean mask-distance error by approximately 10% relative to a diffusion-based behavior-cloning baseline and by 85% relative to standard deterministic behavior cloning. In route-free CARLA, Diffusion-2BC traveled substantially farther before termination under the evaluation protocol than both baselines in Town01 and Town02. Additional qualitative rollouts revealed distinct route choices, showing the multimodal behavior of the proposed diffusion-based agent. The results indicate that an auxiliary regression signal can improve the closed-loop reliability of diffusion behavior cloning while preserving multimodal prediction in the controlled benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Diffusion-2BC，将扩散去噪目标与辅助确定性行为克隆损失结合在共享视觉编码器上，以提升自动驾驶扩散策略的闭环可靠性，同时保留多模态动作预测能力。
AI.motivation: 行为克隆常用均方误差回归，但难以处理同一观测对应多个有效动作的多模态演示；扩散策略虽能建模条件多模态动作分布，但在有限数据下联合学习视觉特征与控制时闭环表现可能不稳定。
AI.method: 在共享视觉编码器上同时使用扩散去噪目标和辅助确定性行为克隆损失；辅助回归分支仅用于训练，推理仍基于扩散生成。在 Claw 受控环境和 CARLA 鸟瞰导航中评估，包括路线条件驾驶、无路线多路口导航及 Town01 到 Town02 的跨地图评估。
AI.result: 在 Claw 任务中，Diffusion-2BC 相比扩散行为克隆基线将平均掩码距离误差降低约 10%，相比标准确定性行为克隆降低约 85%。在无路线 CARLA 中，Diffusion-2BC 在 Town01 和 Town02 的评估协议下均比两个基线行驶更远才终止。定性 rollout 还显示出不同路线选择，表明扩散智能体具有多模态行为。
AI.conclusion: 辅助回归信号可以提高扩散行为克隆的闭环可靠性，同时在受控基准中保留多模态预测能力。

title: Policy-Conditioned AI-Use Detection: An Evidentiary Framework for Academic Publishing
summary: Major venues now publish detailed rules about how authors, reviewers, and area chairs may use AI, and those rules differ by role, by task, and by what must be disclosed. AI detection, the instrument usually proposed to enforce them, estimates something else: whether an AI model wrote the text. We argue that this target is misaligned with the decisions conferences and journals face, and propose policy-conditioned AI-use detection, an evidentiary framework for assessing whether a human--AI workflow complied with a stated rule. Policy makes the governing rule an explicit input. Inference reports hypotheses, evidence, calibration regime, and uncertainty in place of verdicts such as "AI detected". Evaluation builds benchmarks from reproducible pipelines that generate compliant and non-compliant workflows, and reports true positive rate at a false positive rate the venue fixes in advance. We work the framework through peer review, where at plausible violation rates a detector at a strong operating point still flags more compliant authors than violating ones. The framework therefore also names what a venue must instrument: structured disclosure, approved-tool routing that respects reviewer confidentiality, and a path by which a finding can be contested. Under this framing a detector is not an authorship classifier but an auditable procedure with an error rate the venue fixes in advance and can defend.

AI.tldr: 论文指出现有AI检测器判断“文本是否由AI生成”，这与会议/期刊实际需要执行的AI使用政策不匹配；提出“政策条件化的AI使用检测”框架，以判断人机工作流是否遵守既定规则。
AI.motivation: 主要 venues 已发布针对作者、审稿人和领域主席的AI使用规则，但现有AI检测器估计的是文本作者身份，无法直接回答政策合规问题，导致检测目标与实际决策错位。
AI.method: 提出政策条件化AI使用检测：将政策规则作为显式输入，输出假设、证据、校准机制和不确定性，而非“检测到AI”的裁决；用可复现流程构建合规/不合规工作流基准，并在场馆预先设定的假阳性率下报告真阳性率。
AI.result: 在同行评审场景中，即使检测器处于强操作点，在合理违规率下仍可能标记更多合规作者而非违规作者；框架进一步指出场馆需建设结构化披露、尊重审稿人保密性的批准工具路由，以及可申诉路径。
AI.conclusion: 检测器不应被视为作者身份分类器，而应成为可审计程序：其错误率由场馆预先设定并可为其辩护。

title: MOBA-VL: Event-Localized Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning for Real-Time MOBA Commentary
summary: Real-time commentary for Multiplayer Online Battle Arena (MOBA) esports requires a vision-language model (VLM) to narrate a live match second by second, both fluently and accurately. Existing streaming VLMs sound natural but often miss key events such as kills and objectives. To address this limitation, we use game telemetry, which records exactly when each event occurs, as a supervision signal. We introduce MOBA-VL, a 9B-parameter model trained on this signal with event-localized multi-turn reinforcement learning, which rewards the turns that describe each event. We also collect MOBACast, 860 professional matches (about 460 hours) across three MOBA games with word-level timestamped commentary, and MOBACast-Bench, a benchmark from held-out tournaments. On MOBACast-Bench, MOBA-VL achieves the highest Overall score on full matches (63.25 vs. 55.12 for StreamingVLM) and clips (63.45 vs. 56.22 for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash). Event-localized credit also raises event recall from 34.5 to 42.1 over supervised fine-tuning. Code and data will be released, and demos are available on an anonymous project page at https://moba-vl.github.io.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对MOBA电竞实时解说，提出MOBA-VL模型，利用游戏遥测记录的事件时间作为监督信号，并通过事件定位多轮强化学习提升关键事件解说的准确性与召回率；同时构建了MOBACast数据集和MOBACast-Bench基准。
AI.motivation: 现有流式视觉语言模型（VLM）的解说虽然流畅，但常遗漏击杀、目标等关键事件，原因是缺乏事件级监督信号。
AI.method: 使用游戏遥测中精确的事件发生时间作为监督信号；训练9B参数的MOBA-VL模型，采用事件定位多轮强化学习，奖励描述对应事件的解说轮次；收集MOBACast数据集（860场职业比赛，约460小时，覆盖三款MOBA游戏，含词级时间戳解说）和MOBACast-Bench基准。
AI.result: 在MOBACast-Bench上，MOBA-VL在完整比赛上取得最高Overall分数63.25（StreamingVLM为55.12），在片段上为63.45（DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash为56.22）；事件定位信用机制将事件召回率从监督微调的34.5提升至42.1。
AI.conclusion: 利用游戏遥测和事件定位强化学习可有效提升MOBA实时解说的事件覆盖与整体质量；代码和数据将公开，并在匿名项目页面提供演示。

title: Audible World Models: Spatially Aware Sound Generation for 3D Worlds
comment: Accepted at the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
summary: Text- and image-conditioned world generators can create visually rich 3D environments, yet these worlds often remain silent or rely on soundtracks synthesized solely from text or rendered video. Although such audio can convey what should be heard, it lacks an explicit representation of where sound sources are located and how their perceived sound should vary with listener movement. We introduce Audible World Models, a training-free framework that incorporates sound into the generated world state. Starting from a text prompt, our system constructs a panoramic 3D proxy, separates it into semantic layers, identifies sound-producing foreground objects and ambient background regions, and synthesizes dry audio for each sound label. It then anchors these sources to reconstructed geometry and renders listener-dependent spatial audio using geometric acoustic propagation. By explicitly linking semantics, geometry, and sound propagation, the framework maintains persistent source locations while adapting the rendered audio to changes in listener viewpoint and motion. Experiments across 80 generated scenes demonstrate substantial gains in spatial consistency over text-, video-, and panorama-conditioned baselines, while preserving competitive semantic alignment. VLM-based assessments and human evaluations further indicate that our soundtracks are preferred for their audio-visual consistency, spatial plausibility, and motion-dependent behavior.

AI.tldr: 提出 Audible World Models，一个无需训练的框架，将声音融入文本/图像条件生成的世界状态中，使生成的三维场景具备与几何和语义一致的空间音频。
AI.motivation: 现有文本或图像条件的世界生成器虽能生成视觉丰富的三维环境，但往往无声，或仅依赖文本/渲染视频合成音轨；这类音频缺乏明确声源位置，也不能随听者运动产生合理的空间变化。
AI.method: 从文本提示出发构建全景三维代理，分割语义层，识别发声前景物体与环境背景区域，为每个声音标签合成干音频；随后将声源锚定到重建几何，并利用几何声学传播渲染依赖听者位置与运动的空间音频。
AI.result: 在80个生成场景中，相比文本、视频和全景条件基线，空间一致性显著提升，同时保持有竞争力的语义对齐；基于VLM的评估和人类评估表明，其音轨在音视频一致性、空间合理性和运动依赖行为上更受偏好。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式关联语义、几何与声音传播，该框架能保持声源位置持久性，并让渲染音频自适应听者视角和运动，从而提升生成世界中的空间音频体验。

title: Transient Triggering Grid-Forming Synchronization Control Under Voltage and Frequency Dips
summary: Grid-forming (GFM) inverters are gaining attention as a promising alternative for conventional synchronous generators in the modern power systems. Unlike conventional synchronous generators, GFM inverters have limited overcurrent capability that makes them vulnerable during large disturbances. During disturbances i.e., voltage and frequency dips, GFM inverters are pushed into current-limited operation to protect the semiconductor switches. This causes the internal angle of the GFM inverters to accelerate and lose synchronism with the rest of the grid. To address this limitation, this article proposes a transient triggering grid-forming (TTGFM) synchronization control to enhance the synchronization stability performance under voltage and frequency dips. This method uses two feedback signals; terminal voltage and the difference between unsaturated and saturated power to adjust the internal angle which is generated by power synchronization loop (PSL) of the GFM inverters. These two signals manipulates the internal reference angle generation that act as a virtual braking mechanism. This mechanism limits the angle acceleration during voltage and frequency dips without requiring an extra supervisory signal or parameters to tune. The proposed method is benchmarked against two state-of-the-art synchronization enhancement schemes and validated through high-fidelity electromagnetic transient (EMT) simulations with a grid dynamic equivalent (GDE) model in MATLAB/Simulink\textsuperscript{\textregistered}. An analytical framework is developed to derive the synchronization instability mechanism and the critical limits of the stability margins. Generalization of the GDE model further shows that the TTGFM control is not restricted to a single configuration but is applicable to any standard benchmark system.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种暂态触发型构网（TTGFM）同步控制，用于提升构网逆变器在电压和频率跌落下的同步稳定性。
AI.motivation: 构网逆变器过流能力有限，在大扰动下会进入限流运行，导致内部角度加速并失去与电网的同步。
AI.method: TTGFM利用端电压以及未饱和功率与饱和功率之差两个反馈信号，调节功率同步环生成的内部角度，形成虚拟制动机制，无需额外监督信号或整定参数。
AI.result: 该方法与两种先进同步增强方案对比，并通过MATLAB/Simulink中基于电网动态等值（GDE）模型的高保真电磁暂态仿真验证；同时建立了解析框架以推导同步失稳机理和稳定裕度临界极限。
AI.conclusion: TTGFM控制可有效限制电压和频率跌落期间的 angle 加速度，且GDE模型推广表明其不局限于单一配置，适用于任何标准基准系统。

title: AIM: Agentic Idea Management for Automated Research
summary: Frontier LLMs are increasingly used to automate scientific research through iterative search. We distinguish idea-driven search from solution-driven search and identify three core challenges: organizing evolving research ideas, selecting promising directions, and maintaining alignment between ideas and their implementations. To address these challenges, we introduce the Agentic Idea Manager (AIM), a fully autonomous framework for managing and exploring research directions in idea-driven automated research. Inspired by Bayesian optimization, AIM uses an Agentic Surrogate and an Agentic Acquisition mechanism to organize discovered ideas and guide their selection. A Solution Auditor maintains idea-solution integrity, while a Resource Planner adaptively allocates the remaining experimental budget across parallel search branches. Experiments on 10 AutoLab benchmark tasks show that AIM surpasses the strongest baseline by 1.6 percentage points on System Optimization tasks and 4.9 percentage points on long-horizon Model Development & CUDA tasks. Notably, AIM reaches the best baseline performance up to 3.1x faster in wall-clock time. We further provide a theoretical analysis of when searching over ideas becomes beneficial. Our analysis shows that explicit idea-level allocation makes semantic coverage directly controllable, and that broader coverage becomes increasingly valuable when competitive research directions are sparse among many plausible alternatives. Project Page: https://imhgchoi.github.io/agentic-idea-manager/

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Agentic Idea Manager (AIM)，一个全自主框架，用于管理并探索想法驱动的自动化科研中的研究方向，受贝叶斯优化启发，通过 Agentic Surrogate、Agentic Acquisition、Solution Auditor 和 Resource Planner 来组织想法、选择方向、保持想法-实现一致性并分配实验预算。
AI.motivation: 前沿 LLM 越来越多地通过迭代搜索自动化科研，但想法驱动搜索面临三大挑战：组织不断演化的研究想法、选择有前景的方向、维持想法与实现之间的一致性。
AI.method: 提出 AIM 框架：受贝叶斯优化启发，使用 Agentic Surrogate 组织已发现想法，使用 Agentic Acquisition 指导选择；用 Solution Auditor 维护想法-方案完整性；用 Resource Planner 在并行搜索分支间自适应分配剩余实验预算。
AI.result: 在 10 个 AutoLab 基准任务上，AIM 在 System Optimization 任务上超过最强基线 1.6 个百分点，在长程 Model Development & CUDA 任务上超过 4.9 个百分点；达到最佳基线性能的墙钟时间最多快 3.1 倍。理论分析表明，显式的想法级分配使语义覆盖可直接控制，且当竞争性研究方向在众多合理替代中较稀疏时，更广覆盖的价值更大。
AI.conclusion: AIM 能有效支持想法驱动的自动化科研，通过想法级组织、选择、审计和资源分配提升搜索性能与效率，并给出了何时搜索想法更有益的理论解释。

title: CADeT: Causal-Aware Deformation Transmission for Indirect Robotic Manipulation of Soft Tissue
summary: Indirect manipulation of deep-seated deformable anatomy inaccessible to the robot is challenging in robot-assisted minimally invasive surgery (RAMIS) because intervening tissues spatially filter deformation transmission. Passive observations can be ambiguous because the Decoupled and Blocked modes may produce similar motion responses. We propose CADeT, a causal-aware deformation transmission framework that integrates structural causal model (SCM) with active sensing to infer a latent transmission mode and estimate a state-dependent adhesion Jacobian online. During normal manipulation, control actions update the mode belief; when ambiguity persists, an additional probing action is selected to improve mode distinguishability. The mode belief and learned Jacobian are incorporated into a belief-aware model predictive controller for indirect target-shape control. Validation in simulation and on the da Vinci research kit (dVRK), using phantom and ex vivo porcine tissues, shows higher mode-identification accuracy and faster shape-error convergence than the evaluated model-free and model-based baselines. These results show that active sensing improves mode identification and indirect deformation control under the evaluated conditions.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出CADeT框架，将结构因果模型与主动感知结合，用于机器人辅助微创手术中间接操控深层可变形组织，通过推断潜在变形传递模式并在线估计状态相关黏附雅可比，实现间接目标形状控制。
AI.motivation: 在机器人辅助微创手术中，机器人无法直接接触深层可变形解剖结构，而中间组织会空间滤波变形传递；仅靠被动观察难以区分解耦与阻塞模式，因为二者可能产生相似运动响应。
AI.method: 提出CADeT因果感知变形传递框架：集成结构因果模型与主动感知，推断潜在传递模式并在线估计状态相关黏附雅可比；正常操控时控制动作更新模式信念，歧义持续时选择额外探测动作提高模式可区分性；将模式信念与学习到的雅可比融入信念感知模型预测控制器，用于间接目标形状控制。
AI.result: 在仿真和da Vinci研究套件（dVRK）上，使用体模与离体猪组织验证，相比无模型和基于模型的基线，取得更高的模式识别准确率和更快的形状误差收敛速度。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，在评估条件下，主动感知能够提升模式识别与间接变形控制性能。

title: The Backdrop Exposes What the World Around an Agent Costs It
summary: Agent benchmarks test agents in worlds that stay still. Deployed agents work in worlds that other people also change. Someone texts the agent to send the money elsewhere or an order confirmation asks it to reply with a door code. We present BACKDROP, which asks how much of an agent's capability in a clean world survives in such a world. BACKDROP takes a task along with the agents execution environment, and plants four everyday hazards in its world, one at a time and all together. The instruction and the correct end state stay the same. Each hazard asks one question. Authority: does a message from another person override the user? Injection: does text planted in a record redirect the agent? Boundary: does a request pull it into an app it was not given? Fault: after a write fails without saying whether it landed, does the agent check before it retries? Across 3,678 variants and 16 models, , the average pass rate falls from 69.5% to 31.3% once all four hazards are present; the strongest models fall furthest (Claude Fable 5.1 from 96.6% to 56.0%). Agents have learned to resist injected text but often follow other unauthorized requests of other people. With all four hazards present, and counting only runs where the planted text reached the agent, agents followed another person's message in 46.4% of runs and injected text in 20.3%. The gap is consistent throughout all 16 models. BACKDROP formalizes these gaps and shows how an agent's score in a task's world is a ceiling on real-world performance.

AI.tldr: BACKDROP 是一个智能体鲁棒性基准，用来测试在他人可改变环境的动态世界中，智能体原本在干净世界中的能力还剩多少。它在任务执行环境中逐一及同时植入权威、注入、边界、故障四类日常风险，保持指令和正确终态不变。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体基准多在静态、干净世界中评测，但实际部署的智能体会面对他人发消息、记录中植入文本、越权请求、写入失败等干扰，因此干净世界中的高分可能高估真实表现。
AI.method: BACKDROP 接收任务及其执行环境，在不改变指令和正确终态的前提下，分别和同时植入四类风险：Authority 他人消息是否覆盖用户；Injection 记录中的文本是否重定向智能体；Boundary 请求是否把智能体拉入未授权应用；Fault 写入失败且结果未知时是否先检查再重试。实验覆盖 3,678 个变体和 16 个模型。
AI.result: 四类风险同时存在时，平均通过率从 69.5% 降至 31.3%；最强模型下降最多，Claude Fable 5.1 从 96.6% 降至 56.0%。智能体已较能抵抗注入文本，但仍常服从他人未授权请求。统计植入文本到达智能体的运行中，46.4% 的运行服从了他人消息，20.3% 服从了注入文本，且该差距在 16 个模型中一致存在。
AI.conclusion: BACKDROP 形式化了这些能力缺口，并表明智能体在某个任务干净世界中的得分，是其在真实世界中表现的上限。

title: A Competing-Hazards Systematization of Loss of Control in Autonomous Agents
summary: Leading AI developers have reported agents acting beyond their approved limits, which a United Nations panel described as an early warning of loss of human control. Yet incident reports and agent-safety evaluations describe these events differently, making it difficult to compare failures, trace risk across attempts, or separate agent behavior from the environment's role in allowing an out-of-scope action to succeed. To address this gap, we introduce a common framework in which each attempt ends in approved completion, safe stopping, scope escape, or continuation. We formalize the framework as a discrete-time competing-hazards model and derive escape probability within a retry budget, a model-conditional safe-budget limit, and conditions for estimation from execution logs. We audit 22 incident reports and 102 agent-safety evaluations published from January 2025 to September 2026 using primary sources. Six incidents involved tasks that could not be completed within scope, thirteen involved agents that continued rather than stopped, and five did not report stopping behavior. Developers' figures imply a task-level incidence ratio near 47 for out-of-scope coordination in never-solved versus solved tasks. Among evaluations, 87 recorded an out-of-scope effect or specification violation, 26 treated safe stopping as a first-class outcome, only 20 recorded both, and 79 merged budget exhaustion with failure. In 20 of 22 incidents, the environment allowed an out-of-scope effect, indicating that realized loss of control often reflected persistent agent behavior interacting with permissive boundary conditions; meanwhile, no evaluation reported all fields needed to estimate the full competing-hazards process from published evidence.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一个通用框架，将AI代理每次尝试的结果分为批准完成、安全停止、越界逃逸或继续，并形式化为离散时间竞争风险模型。审计22份事故报告和102份代理安全评估后发现，越界行为常与环境允许有关，且现有评估缺乏完整数据来估计该模型。
AI.motivation: 领先AI开发者报告代理越界行为，联合国小组称其为人类失去控制的早期预警。但事故报告与代理安全评估描述方式不同，难以比较失败、追踪风险或区分代理行为与环境在越界成功中的作用，因此需要统一框架。
AI.method: 引入通用框架，将每次尝试结果分为批准完成、安全停止、越界逃逸或继续；形式化为离散时间竞争风险模型；推导重试预算内的逃逸概率、模型条件安全预算限制及从执行日志估计的条件；使用原始资料审计2025年1月至2026年9月发布的22份事故报告和102份代理安全评估。
AI.result: 6起事故涉及无法在范围内完成的任务，13起涉及代理继续而非停止，5起未报告停止行为；开发者数据表明未解决任务中越界协调的发生率比已解决任务高约47倍。评估中87份记录越界效应或规范违反，26份将安全停止视为首要结果，仅20份两者都记录，79份将预算耗尽与失败合并。22起事故中20起环境允许越界效应，表明失控常是代理持续行为与宽松边界条件相互作用的结果；无评估报告所有字段以从已发表证据估计完整竞争风险过程。
AI.conclusion: 失控往往是代理行为与宽松环境共同作用的结果；现有评估缺乏完整数据来估计竞争风险过程，需采用该通用框架来标准化报告和风险评估。

title: KlinikeBench: Evaluating Language Models Beyond Diagnostic Accuracy
summary: Most clinical benchmarks evaluate language models (LMs) on diagnosis using complete case descriptions. In clinical practice, however, patients present information in different ways, and clinicians must obtain relevant history and determine which examinations are needed before reaching a diagnosis. Diagnostic accuracy alone therefore cannot establish whether an agent gathered essential information or conducted an appropriate clinical assessment. Furthermore, existing benchmarks lack professional clinicians' verification. To address this gap, we introduce KlinikeBench, a benchmark of 333 clinician-authored tasks, each providing an isolated sandbox environment with a virtual patient, clinical tools, and task-specific success criteria. More than 35 clinicians contributed to case authoring and benchmark evaluation. In an empirical study, clinicians gave simulated dialogues higher mean quality ratings than reference conversations, which is adapted from real conversation. In each task, an LM has a fixed budget of turns to communicate with the patient, ask about relevant history, request examinations, follow action constraints, and record a final diagnosis. We score these steps separately as well as together. Across 31 models and seven model families, the best-performing models (e.g., GPT-6-astra and Claude Opus 5) succeed on less than 30% of tasks, even though their diagnosis accuracy reaches 90.7%. Some models benefit from talking with the patient; others diagnose well from a complete chart but perform much worse in conversation. Overall, KlinikeBench provides a testbed for evaluating the full clinical encounter and reveals a substantial gap between diagnostic accuracy and performance in interactive clinical assessment.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 KlinikeBench，一个由临床医生撰写的 333 项交互式临床评估基准，用于评估语言模型在完整诊疗过程中的表现，而不仅是最终诊断准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有临床基准多基于完整病例描述评估诊断，未反映真实临床中信息获取、检查选择和互动评估的过程；同时缺乏专业临床医生的验证。
AI.method: 构建包含虚拟患者、临床工具和任务成功标准的沙盒环境；由 35 名以上临床医生参与任务撰写与评估；让模型在固定对话轮次内询问病史、申请检查、遵守约束并给出诊断；对步骤和总体表现分别评分，并在 31 个模型、7 个模型家族上进行实证研究。
AI.result: 表现最好的模型（如 GPT-6-astra、Claude Opus 5）任务成功率不足 30%，尽管其诊断准确率可达 90.7%；部分模型从与患者对话中受益，另一些模型在完整病历上诊断良好但在对话中表现明显较差。
AI.conclusion: KlinikeBench 为评估完整临床诊疗过程提供了测试平台，并揭示了诊断准确率与交互式临床评估能力之间的显著差距。

title: PAMI: Part Anchored Motion for Text to Human-Object Interaction Generation
summary: Text-conditioned full-body human-object interaction (HOI) generation requires synthesizing human motion and object trajectories that match the input text while remaining precisely coordinated over time. Most methods represent the human and object as separate trajectories and predict the global human-object couplings. Learning this complex, dynamically changing relationship implicitly, however, often yields object drift, missed contact, and penetration. We introduce PAMI, a Part-Anchored Motion framework for Interaction generation. Inspired by the classic Hough Transform, our key idea is to localize object motion by letting body-part anchors vote for it: we express object motion relative to multiple body-part anchors and use PamiVAE to learn an interaction latent space, decoding frame-wise weights that aggregate these part-specific votes. Building on this representation, PAMI generates interactions in a coarse-to-fine hierarchy. PamiGen first generates a coarse human-object interaction from text in this structured latent space, and PamiRefiner then recursively resolves fine-grained contact geometry using a hybrid surface-sensing representation, combining long-range probes that capture overall body-part influence with short-range sensors that resolve detailed contacts near the object surface. Experiments on InterAct show that PAMI generates more faithful interactions and more accurate human-relative object motion than previous methods, achieving 14.5% higher contact recall than the previous state of the art. Extensive ablations validate the contributions of both the part-anchored voting representation and hybrid surface-sensing refinement.

AI.tldr: 提出 PAMI，一种面向文本条件全身人-物交互生成的部件锚定运动框架，通过身体部件锚点投票表示物体运动，并在粗到细层次中生成和精修交互。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通常将人与物体表示为独立轨迹并隐式学习全局人-物耦合关系，容易导致物体漂移、接触缺失和穿透等问题。
AI.method: 受 Hough 变换启发，将物体运动表示为相对多个身体部件锚点的运动，并用 PamiVAE 学习交互隐空间，解码逐帧权重以聚合部件特定投票；随后采用粗到细框架：PamiGen 基于文本在结构化隐空间生成粗粒度交互，PamiRefiner 使用混合表面感知表示递归精修接触几何，结合长距离探针与短距离传感器。
AI.result: 在 InterAct 数据集上，PAMI 生成更忠实的人-物交互和更准确的人体相对物体运动，相比此前最优方法接触召回率提升 14.5%；消融实验验证了部件锚定投票表示和混合表面感知精修的有效性。
AI.conclusion: PAMI 通过部件锚定投票表示与混合表面感知精修，有效提升了文本条件人-物交互生成的协调性、接触准确性和运动真实性。

title: Flatness-based Neural Network Control of DC-DC Converters
comment: Accepted to 2026 65th IEEE Conference on Decision and Control (CDC)
summary: In this work, we present a simple method to engineer a small neural network to control power converters. Learning-based methods have emerged as a promising approach for power converter control over wide operating point variations. However, many of these approaches do not exploit the analytical structure of converter dynamics and, therefore, search over unnecessarily broad policy classes. We address this gap with a systematic framework that combines model-based trajectory generation with policy learning. First, we use differential flatness of averaged converter models to generate feasible state and constrained duty cycle trajectories where duty acts as a control effort signal. Then for policy learning, we use these model-generated trajectories to construct labeled state-to-duty data and train a multilayer perceptron to approximate the control law with a static map. We apply this framework across buck, boost, and buck-boost converters through topology-dependent flat output selection and a common learning pipeline. Simulations show close agreement between learned and model-generated duty trajectories and stable regulation under large synchronous input and load disturbances.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种将模型驱动轨迹生成与策略学习相结合的系统框架，用于设计小型神经网络控制器来控制功率变换器。
AI.motivation: 基于学习的方法在宽工作点变化下控制功率变换器很有前景，但许多方法没有利用变换器动力学的解析结构，导致在过宽的策略空间中搜索。
AI.method: 首先利用平均变换器模型的微分平坦性，生成可行的状态轨迹和受约束的占空比轨迹，其中占空比作为控制信号；然后用这些模型生成轨迹构造状态到占空比的标注数据，训练多层感知机以静态映射逼近控制律。该框架通过拓扑相关的平坦输出选择与通用学习流程应用于Buck、Boost和Buck-Boost变换器。
AI.result: 仿真表明，学习得到的占空比轨迹与模型生成轨迹高度吻合，并在大幅同步输入和负载扰动下实现稳定调节。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过结合基于模型的轨迹生成和策略学习，能够为功率变换器设计结构更合理、更小型化的神经网络控制器。

title: Parameter-Robust Sensorless Control of IPMSM Drives With Adaptive Flux Observer
summary: To address parameter sensitivity commonly in interior permanent magnet synchronous motor (IPMSM) sensorless control, this paper proposes a parameter-robust control framework by extending the adaptive flux observer from surface-mounted PMSM to salient-pole machines. First, parameter mismatches are interpreted as an equivalent flux vector with $d$-axis and $q$-axis components. Permanent magnet flux, $d$-axis inductance, and resistance mismatches are mapped to the $d$-axis flux component, whereas $q$-axis inductance mismatch is mapped to the $q$-axis component. Then, a scalar adaptive flux update is designed to compensate the $d$-axis flux variation by tracking the equivalent flux magnitude. Since the $q$-axis component rotates the observed flux direction and cannot be eliminated by scalar adaptation, a high-frequency $q$-axis voltage injection method is introduced to identify the $q$-axis inductance. Meanwhile, stability analysis proves bounded equivalent flux magnitude tracking and identifies the residual tangential flux responsible for position error. Finally, experimental results show that the proposed method does not require precise resistance, $d$-axis inductance, or flux, while the $q$-axis inductance is provided by online identification.

AI.tldr: 本文针对IPMSM无位置传感器控制中的参数敏感性问题，提出一种参数鲁棒控制框架，将自适应磁链观测器从表贴式PMSM扩展到凸极电机。
AI.motivation: IPMSM无位置传感器控制通常对电阻、电感、永磁磁链等参数敏感，参数失配会导致观测精度和位置估计性能下降。
AI.method: 将参数失配等效为d轴和q轴磁链分量：永磁磁链、d轴电感和电阻失配映射到d轴磁链，q轴电感失配映射到q轴磁链；设计标量自适应磁链更新以跟踪等效磁链幅值并补偿d轴磁链变化；针对q轴分量导致观测磁链方向旋转的问题，引入高频q轴电压注入在线辨识q轴电感；并进行稳定性分析。
AI.result: 稳定性分析证明等效磁链幅值跟踪有界，并指出残余切向磁链是位置误差来源；实验结果表明该方法无需精确电阻、d轴电感或磁链，q轴电感由在线辨识提供。
AI.conclusion: 所提参数鲁棒控制框架可有效降低IPMSM无位置传感器控制对关键参数的依赖，并通过高频注入实现q轴电感在线辨识，提升参数失配下的控制鲁棒性。

title: Reach Into The CHOIR: Free-List Elicitation Uncovers Distinct Model Voices in LLM Ensembles
comment: 23 pages, 6 figures. Published in the Proceedings of the Third Conference on Language Modeling (COLM 2026)
summary: Open-ended LLM homogeneity can create false plurality when several systems appear to offer independent perspectives while returning the same familiar default. Single-pass answers obscure the distinction between agreement produced by a tightly constrained answer space, prompt-vocabulary echo, and broader answer spaces with stable alternatives beneath the surface. We introduce CHOIR (Collective Hierarchically-Ordered Inquiry Responses), a framework that adapts free-list elicitation from cognitive anthropology to LLM ensembles. CHOIR repeatedly elicits ranked lists, clusters items into prompt-level concepts, and measures concept salience across models, prompt variants, and persona conditions. We evaluate CHOIR on Infinity-Chat 100, an external prompt bank from recent work on open-ended model homogeneity, and on a 27-question targeted diagnostic bank designed to isolate mechanism-level contrasts. On Infinity-Chat 100, CHOIR reproduces high surface agreement (93/100 prompts above chance) while separating narrow prompts from broad prompts with recoverable depth. Across targeted probes and the external prompt bank, base-model identity remains the strongest recoverable signature, and persona prompts shift surfaced concepts within base-model signatures. A source-blind ranking module prioritises rare-but-stable candidates for later inspection. CHOIR turns open-ended homogeneity into a diagnostic measurement problem by asking where models converge, why they converge, and what remains reachable under structured depth probing.

AI.tldr: 论文提出CHOIR框架，通过重复自由列表 elicitation 与概念聚类，诊断LLM开放式回答的同质化，区分表面一致与深层多样性。
AI.motivation: 开放式LLM同质化会造成虚假多元，单次回答难以区分受限答案空间、提示词回声与存在稳定替代的宽答案空间，需要诊断测量。
AI.method: 借鉴认知人类学自由列表法，构建CHOIR：重复 elicit 排序列表，聚类为提示级概念，测量跨模型、提示变体、人格条件下的概念显著性；在Infinity-Chat 100和27题诊断题库上评估；含source-blind排序模块。
AI.result: 在Infinity-Chat 100上，93/100提示表面一致性高于随机，但能区分窄提示与有可恢复深度的宽提示；基座模型身份是最强可恢复签名；人格提示在基座签名内改变表面概念；排序模块优先稀有但稳定候选。
AI.conclusion: CHOIR将开放式同质化转为诊断测量问题，可回答模型在哪里趋同、为何趋同、结构化深度探测下仍可达什么。

title: What to Attend, What to Keep: Skill-Conditioned Visuotactile Representation with Progress-Guided Event Memory
summary: Robotic manipulation integrates vision, touch, and language, whose importance shifts across stages: vision guides reaching, while touch, through its evolution over time, decides grasping, alignment, and contact. Yet existing multi-modal manipulation policies typically use fixed temporal contexts and fusion strategies, despite shifts in what each modality contributes across different skills. We study how vision and touch should be combined at the level of primitive skills, asking what each skill needs from each sensor, and propose a skill-conditioned representation in which the queried skill conditions fusion over modality-specific short-term observation tokens while attending to a sparse event memory that retains terminal observations from the last $K$ executed skills. Evaluated by skill progress estimation on three contact-rich tasks, it reduces slip-detection delay by 87% against fine-tuned SOTA progress models, twist-completion delay by 67.5% against a vision-only ablation, and progress error on a blind search task by 92% through sparse event memory. Gains concentrate exactly where completion is defined by contact or task history. More broadly, our results suggest that observation formation not only policy architecture is a central challenge in multi-modal representation. Project Website: http://what-to-attend-what-to-keep.github.io/

AI.tldr: 该论文研究机器人操作中视觉与触觉的融合，提出一种技能条件化表征：由当前技能查询并融合短时多模态观测 token，同时关注仅保留最近 K 个技能终端观测的稀疏事件记忆，并在三类接触密集任务上验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有多种模态操作策略通常使用固定的时间上下文和融合策略，但视觉与触觉在不同技能和阶段中的作用会动态变化；因此需要从基础技能层面研究每个技能真正需要从各传感器获取什么信息。
AI.method: 提出技能条件化表征：以查询到的技能为条件，对模态特定的短时观测 token 进行融合，并让模型关注稀疏事件记忆；该记忆仅保留最近 K 个已执行技能的终端观测。通过三个接触密集任务上的技能进度估计进行评估。
AI.result: 相比微调后的 SOTA 进度模型，滑动检测延迟降低 87%；相比仅视觉消融，扭转完成延迟降低 67.5%；在盲搜任务中，通过稀疏事件记忆使进度误差降低 92%。性能提升集中在任务完成由接触或任务历史定义的场景。
AI.conclusion: 观测形成而非仅策略架构，是多模态表征中的核心挑战；技能条件化融合与稀疏事件记忆能更有效利用视觉和触觉信息。

title: Curating Synthetic Data for Task-Specific Visual Perception
summary: Synthetic data are most valuable where general-purpose datasets cannot provide the domain-specific priors a task requires, and where manual annotation is expensive, imprecise, or infeasible. In this article we argue that the central question for specialized vision systems is not how to generate more data, but which data to generate. We therefore discuss curated synthetic data, whose scene content, appearance variations, sensing characteristics, and annotations are deliberately designed around a given task. We examine three complementary curation paradigms. Procedural rendering offers explicit control over scene parameters and the annotations follow by construction. Physically-based simulation encodes the mechanism behind an observed effect and yields exactly aligned supervision pairs. Generative AI learns sensor-specific appearance from small real seed sets and attains plausible realism, though it remains prone to hallucination and to inaccurate annotation. These paradigms are illustrated with examples from industrial surface defect detection, restoration of degraded digitized autochrome plates, and 6DoF pose estimation from RGB and event data. Using these examples, we analyze different data regimes and training strategies that combine synthetic and real data across these paradigms. We conclude that curated synthetic data are best understood as a complement to real observations, and that hybrid pipelines combining controllable supervision with learned appearance are the most promising direction for reliable sim-to-real transfer.

AI.tldr: 本文主张专用视觉系统的关键不是生成更多数据，而是生成哪些数据，并讨论围绕任务定制的策展式合成数据。文章比较程序化渲染、基于物理的仿真和生成式AI三种范式，结合工业缺陷检测、复古照片修复和6DoF位姿估计案例，分析合成与真实数据结合的混合训练策略。
AI.motivation: 通用数据集难以提供特定任务所需的领域先验，而人工标注昂贵、不精确或不可行，因此需要研究面向任务的合成数据生成与使用。
AI.method: 讨论策展式合成数据，即场景内容、外观变化、传感特性和标注围绕任务设计。分析三种范式：程序化渲染、基于物理的仿真、生成式AI。并结合工业表面缺陷检测、退化彩色底片修复、RGB与事件数据6DoF位姿估计等例子，分析不同数据机制及合成与真实数据结合的训练策略。
AI.result: 程序化渲染可控性强且标注天然准确；基于物理的仿真能编码观测效应机制并产生精确对齐监督；生成式AI可从少量真实种子学习传感器特定外观并获得逼真效果，但易产生幻觉和标注不准确。混合流水线结合可控监督与学习外观最具前景。
AI.conclusion: 策展式合成数据应被理解为真实观测的补充，而非替代。结合可控监督与学习外观的混合流水线，是实现可靠sim-to-real迁移最有希望的方向。

title: Personalized State-Transition-Aware Memory for Clinical Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents that reason over clinical records must track changes in a patient's state while preserving the history needed to understand them. Simply accumulating memories leaves it unclear which information still applies, whereas overwriting earlier memories can erase evidence needed to reconstruct treatment history and clinical trajectories. We introduce STAM, a state-transition-aware memory framework that records state changes as new clinical entries arrive. STAM combines semantic retrieval with typed clinical relations to identify affected memories, maintaining current information in Active and superseded or resolved information in History. At read time, a query-dependent gate selectively serves historical memory. Across four longitudinal clinical benchmarks, we evaluate STAM with downstream question answering, direct state-maintenance diagnostics, and comparisons at approximately matched context lengths.

AI.tldr: 提出STAM，一种面向临床记录的状态转移感知记忆框架，用于追踪患者状态变化并保留必要历史信息。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在推理临床记录时，既要追踪患者状态变化，又要保留理解这些变化所需的历史。单纯累积记忆难以判断哪些信息仍适用，而覆盖旧记忆可能丢失重建治疗史和临床轨迹所需的证据。
AI.method: STAM将新临床条目中的状态变化记录下来，结合语义检索与类型化临床关系识别受影响的记忆；当前信息保存在Active中，被取代或已解决的信息保存在History中；读取时通过查询相关门控选择性提供历史记忆。
AI.result: 在四个纵向临床基准上评估STAM，包括下游问答、直接状态维护诊断，以及约匹配上下文长度下的比较；摘要未给出具体量化结果。
AI.conclusion: STAM通过状态转移感知和Active/History分离，旨在兼顾当前有效信息与必要历史证据，为临床记录推理提供更合理的记忆管理方式。

title: PrivMeSA: Privacy-Aware Self-Evolving Multi-Agent System for Medicine via Local-Remote LLM Collaboration
summary: Clinical large language model (LLM) agents deployed locally can consult more capable remote models, but doing so risks exposing patient information. Privacy-conscious delegation places disclosure decisions with a local agent, yet removing explicit identifiers is insufficient: quasi-identifiers can accumulate across multi-turn consultations and repeated patient visits to enable re-identification. We introduce PrivMeSA, a privacy-aware self-evolving multi-agent system that learns to control disclosure and retains remote expertise for local reuse. A local agent manages each encounter and consults remote specialists that may request additional information. Reinforcement learning balances task accuracy against direct disclosure and registry-based re-identification risk, with privacy evaluated over the complete outbound transcript of each encounter. A local lesson memory distills completed consultations into generalized clinical guidance and retrieves relevant lessons before transmission, allowing subsequent cases to reuse expertise without another remote exchange. Memory grows without additional outcome labels or parameter updates. On an emergency-department benchmark built from MIMIC-IV-ED records, PrivMeSA improves mean task accuracy over delegation by up to 15.8 percentage points. In the same setting, PrivMeSA reduces the disclosure of personal details from 98.0% to 0.2% of cases and the share of cases in which the patient can be narrowed to ten or fewer registry patients from 74% to 0%.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 PrivMeSA，一种隐私感知、自进化的多智能体系统，用于本地临床大模型代理在咨询远程专家时控制信息披露，并通过本地经验记忆复用远程知识，减少患者信息暴露与再识别风险。
AI.motivation: 本地临床 LLM 代理咨询远程更强模型可能暴露患者隐私；仅删除显式身份标识不够，因为准标识符可在多轮咨询和多次就诊中累积，导致再识别。
AI.method: PrivMeSA 让本地代理管理每次就诊，远程专家可请求额外信息；使用强化学习在任务准确率与直接披露及基于登记库的再识别风险之间权衡，并在每次就诊的完整外发对话记录上评估隐私；通过本地经验记忆将已完成咨询提炼为通用临床指导，传输前检索相关经验，使后续病例无需再次远程交换即可复用知识；记忆无需额外结果标签或参数更新即可增长。
AI.result: 在基于 MIMIC-IV-ED 构建的急诊科基准上，PrivMeSA 相比委托咨询将平均任务准确率提高最多 15.8 个百分点；同一设置下，个人细节披露比例从 98.0% 降至 0.2%，患者可被缩小到 10 名或更少登记库患者的案例比例从 74% 降至 0%。
AI.conclusion: PrivMeSA 能在保留远程专家能力并提升任务准确率的同时，显著降低直接披露与再识别风险，说明隐私感知的自进化多智能体机制可用于隐私保护型临床 LLM 委托。

title: DEdit: Iterative Draft Editing for Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive LLMs by having a lightweight drafter propose tokens that the target model verifies in parallel. Diffusion-based drafters further reduce drafting latency by proposing multiple tokens at once. However, these tokens are predicted independently, so a single early error causes prefix verification to discard the rest of the draft, even when it contains useful downstream predictions. We introduce DEdit, a diffusion-based drafter that can not only draft by conventional parallel unmasking but also iteratively edit its draft through token-to-token predictions. Through editing, later predictions can serve as bidirectional context for repairing earlier errors and extending the accepted prefix. To teach the model to repair errors while preserving correct predictions, we propose ProposalMix, a training scheme that mixes draft predictions with ground-truth tokens based on first-pass confidence during training. Across seven benchmarks on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B, DEdit achieves the highest macro-average token acceptance and speedup among the evaluated drafters, reaching macro-average speedups of $5.72\times$ and $5.97\times$ over autoregressive generation under greedy decoding, respectively. Further analysis shows that acceptance improves with more editing passes and wider drafting windows, and that ProposalMix halves harmful edits that shorten the accepted prefix. Moreover, restricting the editor to causal attention lowers acceptance, especially on highly predictable outputs, indicating that future context is a key source of these gains.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 DEdit，一种基于扩散的推测解码草稿器，除了并行去掩码外还能通过 token-to-token 编辑迭代修正草稿，从而修复早期错误并延长可接受前缀。配合 ProposalMix 训练策略，DEdit 在多个基准上取得更高的 token 接受率和加速比。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散式草稿器虽然能一次并行预测多个 token 来降低草稿延迟，但这些 token 是独立预测的。一旦早期 token 出错，前缀验证会丢弃后续即使正确的预测，导致接受前缀短、加速效果受限。
AI.method: 提出 DEdit：扩散草稿器既支持传统并行去掩码草稿生成，也支持通过 token-to-token 预测对草稿进行迭代编辑，使后续预测能为修复早期错误提供双向上下文。并提出 ProposalMix 训练方案：训练时根据首轮预测置信度，将草稿预测与真实 token 混合，使模型学会在保留正确预测的同时修复错误。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3-8B 的七个基准上，DEdit 在所评估草稿器中取得最高宏平均 token 接受率和加速比；贪心解码下相对自回归生成分别达到 5.72 倍和 5.97 倍宏平均加速。分析表明，编辑轮数越多、草稿窗口越宽，接受率越高；ProposalMix 将缩短接受前缀的有害编辑减半；将编辑器限制为因果注意力会降低接受率，尤其在高可预测输出上，说明未来上下文是收益的重要来源。
AI.conclusion: DEdit 通过可迭代编辑的扩散草稿与 ProposalMix 训练，有效修复草稿中的早期错误并提升推测解码的接受长度与端到端加速。未来上下文和编辑机制是性能提升的关键，表明双向编辑式草稿优于仅独立并行草稿。

title: Behavioral Persistence and Incomplete Functional Transfer of Co-evolved Communication in Evolutionary Robotics
comment: 13 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Source code and data available at Zenodo
summary: This work evaluates the direct transfer of a co-evolved communication protocol from a 2D simulation to a 3D physical environment, without retraining the network weights. Two e-puck-type robots, controlled by a GRU network with residual connection, were evaluated in a food-seeking task with social signaling. The sensory and motor translation layer required three corrections for stable physical operation, including the calibration of a hunger term based on a measurable asymmetry in the trained residual weights. Even with these corrections, the transfer was partial and asymmetric: one agent reached the food source in one of thirty tested seeds, while the other did not reach it in any. Task success was measured by both agents reaching the food area. An additional experiment incorporating explicit directional information in the social channel produced observable changes in the trajectory of the receiving agent and improvements in several specific cases. However, these improvements were not enough to allow the second agent to reach the food source, suggesting that the limitation may not be explained solely by signal translation, but also by the ability to navigate under the new physical constraints. The results suggest that successful transfer of emergent communication may depend not only on preserving the signaling process itself, but also on preserving the ecological and navigational conditions under which the protocol evolved.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估将2D仿真中共同演化出的通信协议直接迁移到3D物理环境，且不重新训练网络权重。两个e-puck型机器人执行带社交信号的食物寻找任务，但迁移仅部分成功且不对称。
AI.motivation: 探究涌现通信协议能否从仿真直接迁移到真实物理环境，以及成功迁移是否只取决于信号翻译，还是也依赖演化时的生态与导航条件。
AI.method: 使用两个e-puck型机器人，由带残差连接的GRU网络控制，在食物寻找任务中进行社交通信。构建传感与运动转换层，并进行三项校正，包括依据训练后残差权重中的可测不对称性校准饥饿项。测试30个种子，并额外在社交通道加入显式方向信息。
AI.result: 即使经过校正，迁移仍是部分且不对称的：一个智能体在30个种子中仅1次到达食物源，另一个从未到达；任务成功要求两个智能体均到达。加入显式方向信息可改变接收者轨迹并改善若干具体案例，但仍不足以让第二个智能体到达食物源。
AI.conclusion: 成功迁移涌现通信可能不仅依赖保留信号过程，还依赖保留协议演化时的生态和导航条件；迁移失败也可能源于新物理约束下的导航能力限制。

title: Onboard Vision and MPC Navigation for Underwater Robots: An Open BlueROV2 Platform for Multi-Robot Experiments & Docking
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: Autonomous underwater robots require robust perception, estimation and control to operate in confined environments. This paper presents an open-source BlueROV2 platform combining onboard vision with nonlinear Model Predictive Control (NMPC) for autonomous navigation and docking. The platform integrates an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX and an Intel RealSense D435i stereo camera in a modular pressure housing. Underwater-calibrated stereo depth and realtime object detection provide relative position measurements of nearby BlueROV2 vehicles in the camera and body frames. A quaternion-based estimator fuses external pose and inertial measurements, while an NMPC controller based on a nonlinear six-degree-of-freedom model tracks planned navigation and docking trajectories. To support reproducible development, we also provide open-source physics-based PX4 SITL and Gazebo environments, multi-robot simulation tools and a lowcost physical docking station. Experiments evaluate underwater perception, onboard computational performance, state estimation, trajectory tracking and autonomous docking.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个开源的BlueROV2平台，结合机载视觉与非线性模型预测控制（NMPC），用于自主导航与对接。
AI.motivation: 自主水下机器人需要在受限环境中具备鲁棒的感知、估计和控制能力。
AI.method: 该平台集成了NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX和Intel RealSense D435i立体相机于模块化耐压舱中。采用水下标定的立体深度和实时目标检测获取附近BlueROV2的相对位置。基于四元数的估计器融合外部位姿与惯性测量，基于非线性六自由度模型的NMPC控制器跟踪规划轨迹。此外，提供了开源的基于物理的PX4 SITL和Gazebo仿真环境、多机器人仿真工具及低成本物理对接站。
AI.result: 实验评估了水下感知、机载计算性能、状态估计、轨迹跟踪和自主对接。
AI.conclusion: 该开源平台为BlueROV2的自主导航与对接提供了集成感知、估计与控制的解决方案，并支持可重复开发。

title: Concept and Rationale for Stratospheric Balloon-Based Laser Debris Removal
summary: Laser-based deorbiting has long been proposed as a promising technique for mitigating the growing population of orbital debris, particularly decimetre-scale objects -- large enough to cause catastrophic collisions yet too small to be economically captured by current active debris removal (ADR) missions. However, the practical implementation of laser-based approaches remains constrained by several factors. Ground-based systems suffer from atmospheric absorption, scattering, and turbulence, which degrade beam quality and limit effective energy delivery. Space-based platforms benefit from superior propagation efficiency, enabling more compact and lower-power systems, but require complex, high-cost orbital infrastructure with demanding deployment, maintenance, and scalability challenges. This paper proposes a stratospheric balloon-based concept for laser debris removal, exploring the intermediate regime between ground-based and space-based approaches. Operating above 99% of the atmospheric mass, such a platform may enable ultraviolet (3HG/4HG) laser operation -- largely precluded from ground level by ozone absorption -- with improved propagation and ablation coupling efficiency, while presenting a different set of engineering constraints than orbital systems. Rather than a fully developed system, this work focuses on the conceptual design and underlying rationale. We describe the main architectural elements, discuss the expected operational envelope, and position the concept against existing ground- and space-based solutions, identifying potential advantages as well as key challenges and limitations requiring further investigation. Developed within STRATOLASER, an EIC Pathfinder Challenge project targeting TRL 4 through stratospheric balloon experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于平流层气球的激光碎片清除概念，作为地面与空间激光系统之间的中间方案，旨在利用高空平台优势进行紫外激光操作。
AI.motivation: 激光清除十厘米级轨道碎片具有潜力，但地面系统受大气吸收、散射和湍流影响，空间系统则成本高、部署维护复杂，因此需要探索平流层气球这一中间平台。
AI.method: 通过概念设计和原理分析，描述平流层气球平台的主要架构元素、预期操作包络，并与现有地面和空间方案进行对比，识别优势与挑战。
AI.result: 该平台可运行在99%大气质量之上，可能实现紫外（3HG/4HG）激光操作，改善传播和烧蚀耦合效率，但面临不同于轨道系统的工程约束。
AI.conclusion: 该概念具有潜在优势，但也存在关键挑战和限制，需要进一步研究；本文属于STRATOLASER项目，目标达到TRL4并通过平流层气球实验验证。

title: NAQD Env: A benchmark for selective withdrawal in language agents
comment: 16 pages. Code and evaluation artifacts: https://github.com/abouzamm/naqd
summary: Language agents must revise planned actions when evidence changes, permission is revoked, or a stop instruction arrives. A useful response is selective: suspend affected actions, preserve unaffected work, and resume only after sufficient repair. We introduce NAQD-Env, a synthetic environment that evaluates these decisions against a deterministic reference policy over explicit evidence, authorization, and constraint dependencies. Eleven dependency families support evaluation on development structures, held-out families, and held-out combinations of structures. Metrics distinguish attempted violations from violations permitted by a simulated execution gate and jointly report policy agreement, task value, withdrawal, resumption, and event reporting. We evaluate three open-weight instruction-tuned models from two families under three prompt conditions on 350 frozen scenarios, yielding 3,150 model-prompt episodes before gate replay. Across the reported conditions, withdrawal recall is at most 0.06, no valid resumption is observed at eligible opportunities, and only one episode matches the complete reference policy. Under the NAQD prompt, Qwen2.5-7B has fewer unsafe-attempt episodes than Qwen2.5-3B and Llama-3.1-8B, but also completes less useful work and preserves unaffected actions less accurately. Exploratory supervised fine-tuning probes increase Qwen2.5-3B decision accuracy from 0.45-0.54 to 0.83-0.92; separate diagnostics reveal inappropriate withdrawal after curriculum omissions and a loss of event reporting. These results motivate evaluating selective withdrawal as a distinct component of agent reliability. The setting measures policy application with trusted structured inputs and does not establish real-world containment or source-verification ability.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 NAQD-Env 合成环境，用于评估语言智能体在证据变化、授权撤销或停止指令到来时，能否做出选择性撤回：暂停受影响动作、保留不受影响工作，并在充分修复后恢复。实验显示现有模型普遍无法可靠完成该任务。
AI.motivation: 语言智能体需要在环境变化时修订计划，但有效响应应是选择性的，而非全盘停止或继续执行。作者希望将选择性撤回作为智能体可靠性的独立组成部分进行评测。
AI.method: 构建 NAQD-Env 合成环境，基于显式的证据、授权和约束依赖，与确定性参考策略对比。包含 11 个依赖家族，支持开发结构、留出家族和留出组合测试。指标区分尝试违规与执行门允许的违规，并联合报告策略一致性、任务价值、撤回、恢复和事件报告。评估 3 个开源指令微调模型、2 个模型家族、3 种提示条件、350 个冻结场景，共 3150 个模型-提示回合，并进行执行门重放和探索性监督微调探针。
AI.result: 在所有报告条件下，撤回召回率最高仅 0.06，合格机会中未观察到有效恢复，仅 1 个回合完全匹配参考策略。NAQD 提示下，Qwen2.5-7B 的不安全尝试回合少于 Qwen2.5-3B 和 Llama-3.1-8B，但其完成有用工作更少，且保留不受影响动作的准确性更低。探索性监督微调将 Qwen2.5-3B 决策准确率从 0.45-0.54 提升至 0.83-0.92，但诊断出课程遗漏后不当撤回和事件报告丢失。
AI.conclusion: 结果说明应将选择性撤回作为智能体可靠性的独立评估组件。该设置使用可信结构化输入衡量策略应用能力，并不证明真实世界遏制能力或来源验证能力。

title: Caption-Mediated Perceived-Safety Estimation for Pedestrian Routing
summary: This paper presents an explainable approach to pedestrian routing, in which perceived safety is estimated from street-level imagery through an explicit natural-language intermediate representation. A vision--language model caption is generated and stored before any scoring is undertaken, and the perceived-risk class is derived entirely from structured features of that stored text, so that every segment score remains inspectable by the user. Nine captioning conditions across five model families are benchmarked against a direct Contrastive Language--Image Pre-training (CLIP) image-embedding baseline under an identical downstream pipeline, and the caption-mediated representation is found to reach parity with the image embedding rather than to trail it. The approach was deployed over 654,115 images covering 36 electoral wards in two locations in Northern England (Manchester and Huddersfield). Independent field validation against 3,669 locally collected ratings of 494 images across 70 participant sessions established agreement that is statistically significant but modest, at $r=0.262$, against a measured noise ceiling of 0.737 imposed by disagreement between raters. A single-use confirmatory test then found that a pipeline 44\% stronger on the supervised benchmark did not produce measurable improvement in the field ($r=0.250$, $p=0.84$), so the benchmark gains did not predict the deployment gains in this case. Routing behaviour varies systematically with journey length. There is negligible change below 1\,km, reaching a median increase of 12.78\% in low-risk route length for a median detour of 2.73\% on journeys of 3 to 6 km.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种可解释的行人路由方法，通过视觉-语言模型生成街道图像的自然语言描述作为中间表示，并从中提取感知风险类别，实现路段评分的可检查性。在英格兰北部部署并验证，发现基于描述的方法与直接图像嵌入基线性能相当，但基准提升未转化为实地改善。
AI.motivation: 为了使行人路由中的感知安全评分具有可解释性和可审查性，避免直接使用图像嵌入的黑箱决策。
AI.method: 生成并存储视觉-语言模型对街道图像的描述，从中提取结构化特征来推导感知风险类别；在五个模型家族的九种描述条件下与CLIP图像嵌入基线进行对比；在654,115张图像上部署，覆盖36个选区；通过70次参与者session对494张图像的3,669个评分进行实地验证；并进行一次确认性测试。
AI.result: 基于描述的中介表示达到与图像嵌入相当的性能；实地验证一致性为r=0.262（噪声上限0.737）；在监督基准上强44%的流程在实地无显著改善（r=0.250, p=0.84）；路由行为随行程长度变化：低于1km变化可忽略，3-6km行程中低风险路线长度中位数增加12.78%，绕行中位数2.73%。
AI.conclusion: 基准性能提升未能预测部署效果；可解释的基于描述的方法在行人路由中可行，且路由改变与行程长度相关。

title: Beyond Layers: Position-Resolved Gradient Conflict and Position-Aware Modulation for Unified Multimodal Models
comment: 20 pages, 10 figures, 6 tables. Code will be made publicly available upon acceptance
summary: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) train image understanding and autoregressive image generation on shared parameters, and the two objectives are known to interfere. Existing diagnoses and remedies operate at the resolution of layers or experts, measuring conflict per layer and resolving it by separating parameters. We argue that this resolution hides an orthogonal axis. Generation in a UMM is next-token prediction over a raster sequence of visual tokens whose roles vary systematically with position, so how strongly a generation gradient interferes with understanding should depend on where in the sequence it originates. We introduce a position-resolved interference map that attributes understanding-generation gradient conflict to visual-token positions within every layer, computed from a single backward pass at $1.2\times$ the cost of a standard backward pass. On Show-o and Janus-Pro, position explains a large share of conflict variance after controlling for depth (partial $η^2=0.31$ vs. $0.35$ for layer on Show-o; $0.15$ vs. $0.30$ on Janus-Pro): the first quarter of the sequence has a mean gradient cosine of $-0.18$ against understanding, the last quarter $-0.02$. The dependence survives per-position gradient-norm normalization, retaining $80%$ of its effect size, and conflict strength tracks semantic content (Spearman $ρ=0.64$). Building on the map, we propose position-aware modulation (PAM), which removes the anti-aligned component of generation gradients only at high-conflict positions without changing the architecture. Under a matched trainable-parameter budget, PAM improves over layer-wise separation by $+21$ MME and $+2.4$ GenEval points on Show-o while matching it on POPE and overall FID; a random-position control recovers about $31%$ of the gain. Position-based and layer-based separation are complementary degrees of freedom and can be combined.

AI.tldr: 本文研究统一多模态模型中图像理解与自回归图像生成之间的梯度冲突，提出按视觉 token 位置刻画冲突的干扰图，并据此提出位置感知调制（PAM），在不改架构的情况下缓解冲突并提升性能。
AI.motivation: 统一多模态模型在共享参数上同时训练图像理解和自回归图像生成，两个目标会相互干扰。现有诊断和缓解方法多停留在层或专家粒度，按层测量冲突并分离参数；作者认为这忽略了视觉 token 在序列中的位置这一正交维度，因为生成是栅格 token 序列上的下一 token 预测，不同位置 token 的角色系统性地不同。
AI.method: 提出 position-resolved interference map，将理解-生成梯度冲突归因到每一层内视觉 token 的位置，只需一次反向传播，成本为标准反向传播的 1.2 倍。在 Show-o 和 Janus-Pro 上分析位置对冲突方差的解释力。基于该图提出 PAM（position-aware modulation），仅在高冲突位置移除生成梯度中与理解反对齐的分量，不改变模型架构，并与按层分离方法比较。
AI.result: 在控制深度后，位置仍解释大量冲突方差：Show-o 上 partial η²=0.31，层为 0.35；Janus-Pro 上为 0.15，层为 0.30。序列前四分之一相对理解的梯度余弦均值为 -0.18，后四分之一为 -0.02；按位置做梯度范数归一化后仍保留 80% 效应量，冲突强度与语义内容相关（Spearman ρ=0.64）。在匹配可训练参数预算下，PAM 在 Show-o 上比按层分离提升 +21 MME 和 +2.4 GenEval，同时在 POPE 和整体 FID 上持平；随机位置控制仅恢复约 31% 的增益。
AI.conclusion: 位置是理解-生成冲突的重要且此前被忽视的维度，基于位置和基于层的分离是互补的自由度，可以结合使用；PAM 表明按位置调制生成梯度能有效缓解冲突并提升统一多模态模型性能。

title: VAmoS Part Deux: Harder, More Realistic Voice-Agent Simulation
comment: 13 pages, 3 figures, 7 tables. Agent implementations: https://github.com/veris-ai/rory-agent
summary: Voice agents in production must handle several requests, background speech, and customers who lose patience. We introduce VAmoS Energy, a benchmark that combines these challenges in 100 calls about utility billing and payment assistance. Each caller makes two to four requests. The agent has sixteen tools backed by a stateful Stripe billing twin and the Apache Fineract loan engine, with account access blocked until caller verification succeeds. The tasks use public household electricity data and a policy based on Pennsylvania's residential billing rules. An LLM-as-a-verifier checks the agent's actions and spoken figures against explicit requirements. On a calibration run, it agrees with a code verifier on 99.1% of checks. Across fourteen voice stacks and three repeats per task, completion ranges from 17.3% to 44.7%. Grok Voice leads, and Gemini 3.8 Live and GPT-Live follow at about the same cost per call. Background television reduces pooled completion from 38.7% to 8.6%. The simulated caller often accepts an incorrect result because it hears the agent's words but cannot inspect its actions. These findings show why voice agents need evaluation across the whole call, including what they say, what they change, and how they handle competing speech.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 VAmoS Energy 基准，用 100 通公用事业账单与支付协助电话，评估语音代理在多次请求、背景语音和用户不耐烦等真实场景下的表现。
AI.motivation: 生产环境中的语音代理必须处理多个请求、背景人声或电视声，以及失去耐心的用户，但现有评估往往没有覆盖整通电话中的这些复合挑战。
AI.method: 构建 100 通电话基准，每通包含 2 到 4 个请求；代理使用 16 个工具，后端连接有状态 Stripe 计费孪生和 Apache Fineract 贷款引擎，且账户访问需先通过来电者验证；任务使用公开家庭用电数据和基于宾夕法尼亚州住宅计费规则的政策；采用 LLM-as-a-verifier 检查代理动作和口述数字，其与代码验证器在 99.1% 的检查上一致；测试 14 个语音栈，每个任务重复 3 次。
AI.result: 十四种语音栈的完成率在 17.3% 到 44.7% 之间；Grok Voice 领先，Gemini 3.8 Live 和 GPT-Live 紧随其后，且每通电话成本大致相同；背景电视使合并完成率从 38.7% 降至 8.6%；模拟来电者常接受错误结果，因为它能听到代理的话，但无法检查代理的实际操作。
AI.conclusion: 语音代理评估需要覆盖整通电话，包括代理说了什么、实际改变了什么，以及如何处理竞争性语音。

title: Exact Noise Limits for Bounded Scalar Stabilization Experiments
comment: 6 pages, 1 figure. Submitted to the American Control Conference (ACC)
summary: How much unknown process noise can a bounded experiment tolerate while still establishing that the plant can be stabilized? We answer this question for scalar discrete-time systems with bounded inputs, exact state measurements, and a disturbance-energy budget proportional to the experiment length. We distinguish individual stabilizability of every consistent model, stabilization by one common gain, and a common quadratic certificate. We determine their exact noise ceilings for every drift. The last two requirements coincide; individual stabilizability generally tolerates more noise. Bounded periodic inputs approach the ceilings, while adversarial disturbances prevent their attainment. We also determine the long-horizon limits. For unstable plants, a short experiment can establish individual stabilizability at noise levels where every sufficiently long experiment fails. The same obstruction yields upper bounds for multidimensional systems with real eigenvalues. Input design may use plant knowledge, but certification uses only the recorded data and noise bound. The results therefore provide fundamental robustness benchmarks for unknown-plant designs.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在未知过程噪声下，有界实验能以多大噪声容忍度证明标量离散时间系统可镇定，并给出不同镇定认证要求的精确噪声极限。
AI.motivation: 为未知对象的数据驱动镇定设计提供根本鲁棒性基准，明确噪声、实验长度与认证条件之间的极限关系。
AI.method: 针对有界输入、精确状态测量、噪声能量预算与实验长度成正比的标量离散时间系统，区分每个一致模型的个体可镇定、单一公共增益镇定与公共二次证书，并推导精确噪声上限及长时极限。
AI.result: 得到对任意漂移的精确噪声天花板；公共增益镇定与公共二次证书条件重合，个体可镇定通常容忍更多噪声；有界周期输入可逼近极限，但对抗扰动阻止达到；不稳定对象的短实验可在长实验失败的噪声水平上证明个体可镇定；对具实特征值的多维系统给出上界。
AI.conclusion: 输入设计可利用对象知识，但认证仅依赖记录数据和噪声界；结果为未知对象镇定提供基本鲁棒性基准，并揭示实验长度、噪声与认证要求间的根本权衡。

title: Multidimensional Observer Model and Perceptual Dimensions of Human Image Quality Assessment
summary: Judging image quality is not only ecologically relevant to everyday human tasks, but also underpins many machine vision tasks such as image generation. This paper proposes a framework to understand the inherent perceptual space underlying image quality judgment in humans. We propose a multi-dimensional observer model that represents images as distributions in a latent perceptual space and that models human judgment as comparing noisy samples. Being constrained by neural representations in the primate ventral stream and fit to large-scale behavioral data, the model enables analysis of perceptual structure while matching the predictive power of existing metrics. Using this model, we find that the perceptual spaces needed to account for image quality judgment in humans are extremely low-dimensional compared to the image space even when considering its sparsity. The exact structure of the space (e.g., dimensionalities, information encoded) varies between low-level and high-level quality judgments, suggesting that, despite a shared retinal encoding in the beginning, humans selectively construct task-dependent perceptual spaces in visual decision making.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个多维观察者模型，用于理解人类图像质量判断背后的内在感知空间。模型将图像表示为潜在感知空间中的分布，并将人类判断建模为对带噪样本的比较。
AI.motivation: 图像质量判断既与日常人类任务密切相关，也是图像生成等机器视觉任务的基础，因此需要理解人类图像质量判断的内在感知结构。
AI.method: 提出多维观察者模型，将图像编码为潜在感知空间中的分布，并用带噪样本比较来模拟人类判断；模型受灵长类腹侧流通路神经表征约束，并拟合大规模行为数据。
AI.result: 该模型在预测能力上可与现有指标匹配，同时支持感知结构分析；发现人类图像质量判断所需的感知空间维度极低，远低于图像空间维度，即使考虑稀疏性也是如此。低层与高层质量判断的感知空间结构（如维度、所编码信息）不同。
AI.conclusion: 尽管早期共享视网膜编码，人类在视觉决策中会选择性地构建任务依赖的感知空间，表明图像质量判断具有任务特异的感知结构。

title: Shifting Mechanisms: How Positional Encoding Choice Shapes In-Context Retrieval
summary: Language models increasingly use architectures that vary attention span and positional encoding across layers, such as applying RoPE with sliding-window attention and NoPE with global attention (SWA NoPE). However, how these choices shape in-context retrieval remains unclear. To study this question, we take a mechanistic view, tracing how positional encoding (PE) choice shapes the internal mechanisms models use for in-context retrieval. Across 22 open-weight models spanning eight families, we find that standard RoPE models rely primarily on positional retrieval, while PE hybrids shift toward semantic retrieval. We further show on a controlled pre-training ablation that confining positional encoding to local layers produces this semantic shift, degrading representations of positional information. Finally, we show that the reported long-context gains of PE hybrids mask a retrieval trade-off: SWA NoPE improves over RoPE on multiple-target retrieval and QA, but degrades when distinguishing competing keys. We show that these behavioral differences better track the mechanism shift from positional toward semantic mechanisms than a uniform improvement in long-context retrieval.

AI.tldr: 语言模型日益采用跨层变化的位置编码和注意力跨度（如RoPE+滑动窗口与NoPE+全局注意力），本文从机制角度研究这些选择如何影响上下文检索。发现标准RoPE模型主要依赖位置检索，而混合位置编码模型转向语义检索，并揭示了长上下文增益背后的检索权衡。
AI.motivation: 语言模型越来越多地使用跨层变化的位置编码和注意力跨度，但这些选择如何塑造上下文检索机制尚不清楚。研究旨在理解位置编码选择对模型内部检索机制的影响。
AI.method: 采用机制可解释性方法，追踪位置编码选择如何塑造模型用于上下文检索的内部机制。分析了22个开源模型（涵盖8个家族），并进行了受控预训练消融实验，将位置编码限制在局部层。
AI.result: 标准RoPE模型主要依赖位置检索，而混合位置编码模型转向语义检索。消融实验表明，将位置编码限制在局部层会导致语义转变，降低位置信息表示。SWA NoPE在多个目标检索和QA上优于RoPE，但在区分竞争键时性能下降。行为差异更好地反映了从位置机制到语义机制的转变，而非长上下文检索的均匀提升。
AI.conclusion: 位置编码选择显著影响上下文检索机制，混合位置编码模型的长上下文增益掩盖了检索权衡，行为差异与机制转变一致。

title: Systematically Exploring the Capabilities of GPT-6 Astra as Embodied Policies
summary: GPT-6 Astra exhibits a remarkable ability to generate numerical robot actions, extending its role beyond high-level planning. To assess Astra's capabilities as general-purpose embodied policies, we conduct comprehensive evaluations across six domains, examining direct control, cooperation with learned policies, and feedback-driven adaptation. In gripper manipulation, Astra can correct task targets and prepare contact conditions for subsequent policy execution; hybrid control with π0.5 achieves 48% success on the evaluated RoboDojo subset. In dexterous manipulation, hybrid control achieves 50% success in ten experience-guided DexJoCo trials, while direct in-hand control struggles to coordinate finger contacts. In mobile manipulation, hybrid control reaches 38.7% success on the evaluated RoboCasa365. In navigation, Astra leads our local comparisons, reaching 92% success on RxR instruction following and 82% on HM3D object search, although search incurs substantial detours. In locomotion, dense motion-reference generation remains unreliable: none of five sequential attempts on a single obstacle course reaches the goal, despite improvements in stability and forward progress. In humanoid loco-manipulation, Astra exceeds baseline methods on 13 of 30 HumanoidBench tasks with pretrained whole-body controllers. These findings reveal a gap between useful task decisions and reliable physical control. Inference latency further constrains practical control: across 50 RoboDojo instances per condition, policy-assisted and direct control consume 624.8 million and 1.132 billion tokens. A 30-second locomotion run requires 250 model calls averaging 39.86 seconds each, with physics paused during inference.

AI.tldr: 对GPT-6 Astra作为通用具身策略在六个领域进行全面评估，涵盖直接控制、与学习策略协作及反馈适应。
AI.motivation: 评估Astra作为通用具身策略的能力，超越高层规划，检验其生成数值机器人动作的潜力。
AI.method: 在六个领域（夹爪操作、灵巧操作、移动操作、导航、运动、人形全身操作）进行综合评估，包括直接控制、与学习策略混合控制、反馈驱动适应。
AI.result: 夹爪混合控制48%成功；灵巧混合50%；移动混合38.7%；导航92%（RxR）和82%（HM3D）；运动不可靠，5次尝试均未达目标；人形在13/30 HumanoidBench任务超越基线。推理延迟显著：策略辅助与直接控制消耗6.248亿和11.32亿token；30秒运动运行需250次模型调用，平均39.86秒/次，推理时物理暂停。
AI.conclusion: 发现任务决策有用性与可靠物理控制之间存在差距；推理延迟制约实际控制。

title: Demographic Pluralism: Inference-Time Modeling of Pluralistic Human Preference Distributions
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in culturally sensitive settings, where alignment requires representing diverse preferences within populations. Yet existing methods model populations at coarse demographic or community levels and overlook within-group variation. We introduce Demographic Pluralism, an inference-time framework that estimates population-level opinion distributions without opinion-distribution training data or task-specific fine-tuning by generating multiple perspectives within demographically grounded groups. Across four backbones on GlobalOpinionQA and VITAL, it reduces Jensen-Shannon distance by 8.4%-26.4% over Modular Pluralism. Among weighted, equal-weighted, and inverse-weighted aggregation, equal weighting performs best overall; group-level error also increases with group weight, helping explain weighted aggregation's weaker performance.

AI.tldr: 提出 Demographic Pluralism，一种无需意见分布训练数据或任务微调的推理时框架，通过在人口统计分组内生成多视角来估计群体意见分布。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在文化敏感场景中多以粗粒度人口或社区层面建模，忽略了群体内部差异，难以表示人口中的多样偏好。
AI.method: 在推理阶段，将人口按人口统计特征分组，并在每组内生成多个视角，从而估计群体层面的意见分布；无需意见分布训练数据和任务特定微调。
AI.result: 在 GlobalOpinionQA 和 VITAL 上，使用四种骨干模型，相比 Modular Pluralism 将 Jensen-Shannon 距离降低 8.4%–26.4%。在加权、等权和逆加权聚合中，等权总体表现最佳；组级误差随组权重增加，解释了加权聚合较弱的原因。
AI.conclusion: Demographic Pluralism 能更细粒度地建模群体内部意见差异，并提升人口意见分布估计；等权聚合更稳健，而加权聚合可能因组级误差放大而受限。

title: GazeFlow: From Human Gaze Behavior to Generative Egocentric Gaze Prediction
summary: Egocentric gaze prediction enables many downstream applications but remains challenging, as human gaze is inherently stochastic. This stochasticity is constrained by structured temporal dynamics alternating between fixations and saccades, top-down influences from tasks, and bottom-up visual saliency. Based on this observation, we introduce GazeFlow, a framework that directly models gaze as a joint distribution of temporal gaze positions conditioned upon both top-down and bottom-up information. In particular, GazeFlow uses conditional flow matching (CFM): a learned velocity field iteratively transports a Gaussian noise sample into a plausible gaze trajectory drawn from this joint distribution. The velocity field is conditioned on bottom-up visual features extracted by a video encoder and on top-down task information obtained by globally querying these features. On standard datasets, GazeFlow achieves state-of-the-art performance on per-frame metrics, and the generated trajectories align better with human gaze temporal dynamics.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 GazeFlow，将自我中心视线预测建模为在自上而下任务信息和自下而上视觉信息条件下的视线位置联合分布，并使用条件流匹配生成视线轨迹。
AI.motivation: 自我中心视线预测具有重要应用，但人类视线本身具有随机性，同时受注视与扫视交替、任务自上而下影响和视觉显著性自下而上影响等结构化因素约束，因此需要更好的建模方法。
AI.method: GazeFlow 采用条件流匹配（CFM），学习一个速度场，将高斯噪声样本迭代传输为合理的视线轨迹。该速度场以视频编码器提取的自下而上视觉特征和通过全局查询这些特征得到的自上而下任务信息为条件。
AI.result: 在标准数据集上，GazeFlow 在逐帧指标上达到最先进性能，并且生成的轨迹与人类视线的时间动态更一致。
AI.conclusion: 将视线建模为受任务和视觉信息共同约束的联合分布，并通过条件流匹配生成轨迹，能够有效提升自我中心视线预测性能及其时间动态一致性。

title: Data-Efficient Adaptation of a Driving VLA to Class 8 Trucks
summary: Class 8 trucks differ from passenger cars in geometry, dynamics, and maneuvering requirements. As a result, vision-language-action (VLA) models trained for passenger vehicles do not readily transfer to Class 8 trucks, particularly in unstructured scenarios such as accident scenes and construction zones. Rather than training a truck-driving VLA from scratch, we propose an adapt-then-steer strategy that adapts an off-the-shelf VLA to generate trajectories for Class-8 trucks in these challenging scenarios. In the adapt stage, we use NVIDIA's Alpamayo 1.5 as the base model, fine-tuning only its action-generation stack on a few hundred real-world construction and accident-related highway scenarios. In the steer stage, we introduce Flow Velocity Steering (FVS) to further refine the model's predictions while holding the adapted VLA fixed. FVS is a compact, flow-time-conditioned residual module that adds learned corrections to the action-space flow velocity used to update the action sequence at each generation step. In open-loop evaluation on a scenario-disjoint held-out set, targeted fine-tuning more than halves single-candidate average displacement error (ADE) and final displacement error (FDE) over the entire 6.4 s horizon compared to the base model. Using the same targeted demonstrations, FVS further reduces the fine-tuned model's full-horizon ADE and FDE by 13.9% and 16.5%, respectively. At matched data budgets, targeted supervision yields 19-26% lower full-horizon ADE than general truck-driving supervision, while the targeted model remains competitive with a model fine-tuned on approximately 65 times as many general truck-driving scenarios. These results support adapt-then-steer for data-efficient vehicle-domain transfer to Class 8 trucks. Our project website is available at https://truckvla.github.io.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种“先适配再引导”（adapt-then-steer）策略，将现成的乘用车VLA模型迁移到Class 8卡车的轨迹生成任务，尤其面向事故现场和施工区等非结构化场景。
AI.motivation: Class 8卡车在几何、动力学和操纵要求上与乘用车差异显著，直接使用为乘用车训练的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型难以迁移，且从零训练卡车驾驶VLA成本高。
AI.method: 方法分两阶段：适配阶段以NVIDIA Alpamayo 1.5为基础，仅微调其动作生成模块，使用数百个真实施工和事故相关高速场景；引导阶段提出Flow Velocity Steering（FVS），在保持适配后VLA固定的情况下，通过一个紧凑的、流时间条件的残差模块，对动作空间流速度加入学习到的修正，以逐步优化动作序列。
AI.result: 在场景不相交的留出集开环评估中，定向微调使6.4秒全时域的单候选平均位移误差（ADE）和最终位移误差（FDE）相比基础模型降低超过一半；FVS进一步将微调模型的全时域ADE和FDE分别降低13.9%和16.5%。在相同数据预算下，定向监督比通用卡车驾驶监督的全时域ADE低19-26%，且与使用约65倍通用卡车驾驶场景微调的模型相比仍具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，adapt-then-steer策略能够以数据高效的方式实现车辆域向Class 8卡车的迁移，适用于事故和施工等挑战性场景。

title: On the Input Sensitivity of METANET Models and the Robustness of Dynamic Calibration
comment: Accepted at the 65th IEEE Conference on Decision and Control. C. Hickert and S. Raghavan contributed equally to this work. 8 pages, 5 figures
summary: While traffic modeling and control rely upon effective calibration of macroscopic traffic simulation models like METANET, recent empirical work shows these models can exhibit severe sensitivity to input noise. This paper explains this phenomenon through a string-stability analysis, demonstrating that a calibrated METANET model can amplify small additive perturbations to boundary conditions along the corridor, causing the simulated state to diverge from the nominal baseline. The input sensitivity in off-nominal cases may compromise the model's capabilities for counterfactual analysis, which is required for use cases of interest like the design of large-scale variable speed limits. To address these issues, this work demonstrates how a dynamic, time-varying approach to calibrate model parameters can achieve robustness and improved accuracy of the resulting macrosimulation.
