To test these models, introduce SiFC, a fine-grained concept-centric dataset across three countries, with human-reviewed class-level concept maps. On SiFC, APERTURE outperforms the best training-free baselines by more than 10 percentage points in macro F1-score, and notably also outperforms supervised concept bottleneck models. Targeted component-removal tests examine whether concept scores respond to changes in visual evidence, while temporal experiments show that descriptor updates improve recognition of technological changes without retraining.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 APERTURE，一种无需训练的遥感概念瓶颈模型，通过多尺度图像概念定位与预训练多模态大模型生成可靠概念分数，并发布细粒度概念数据集 SiFC，在宏观 F1 上显著优于无训练基线甚至监督概念瓶颈模型。
AI.motivation: 地球观测模型性能提升但缺乏可解释性；现有概念瓶颈模型在遥感领域要么训练成本过高，要么缺少标注时性能不佳。作者认为专家领域需要图像空间和概念空间的细粒度细节。
AI.method: 在图像空间提出多尺度概念瓶颈，用贪心四叉树路由定位小概念；在概念空间用预训练多模态大模型替代对比式视觉语言模型，并给出获取可靠概念分数的方法；将全局图像概念分数与原生概念尺度分数融合。同时发布 SiFC 数据集，覆盖三个国家，具有人工审核的类别级概念图。
AI.result: 在 SiFC 上，APERTURE 的宏观 F1 比最佳无训练基线高出超过 10 个百分点，并优于监督概念瓶颈模型。组件移除测试检验概念分数是否响应视觉证据变化；时序实验显示描述符更新无需重新训练即可提升技术变化识别。
AI.conclusion: APERTURE 表明无需训练的细粒度概念瓶颈模型可在遥感专家领域实现最先进性能，同时保持可解释性和专家交互能力；SiFC 为概念中心评估提供了基准。

title: AgBench: Agentic AI Benchmarks for Personal AI Devices
summary: Agentic AI systems increasingly rely on cloud-hosted large language models for planning, tool use, and iterative execution, raising concerns about API cost and data exposure. Advances in personal AI devices enable agents to execute locally, but limited resources on device may affect task success and performance. Existing benchmarks are inadequate for systematically characterizing these trade-offs across devices, workloads, and deployment architectures. We present AgBench, a benchmark suite and open artifacts for reproducible evaluation of agentic AI on personal devices. Using AgBench, we evaluate local, hybrid, and cloud execution across agentic workloads, examining task success, latency, cloud API cost, and data exposure. Our results, drawn from over 162.07 million data points, show that personal AI devices can complete many agent tasks locally, but local-only execution generally has lower task success and longer completion times than cloud-only execution, especially as concurrency increases. Local-only execution eliminates cloud model API costs and sensitive-information exposure to cloud agents. Hybrid execution can improve task success, but its cloud cost and data exposure depend on how agents divide work and share information. No single architecture performs best across task success, goodput, cloud cost, and data exposure; deployment choices should reflect the intended workload and device capabilities. AgBench is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/AgBench-2777.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AgBench，一个用于可复现评估个人设备上 agentic AI 的基准套件与开放工件，并在本地、混合、云端执行之间比较任务成功率、延迟、云 API 成本与数据暴露。基于超过 1.6207 亿数据点，研究发现个人设备可本地完成许多 agent 任务，但纯本地通常成功率更低、完成时间更长，尤其在并发增加时；纯本地可消除云 API 成本与敏感信息暴露；混合执行可提升成功率，但成本和暴露取决于任务划分与信息共享方式；没有单一架构在成功率、goodput、云成本与数据暴露上全面最优。
AI.motivation: Agentic AI 系统日益依赖云端大语言模型进行规划、工具使用和迭代执行，引发 API 成本与数据暴露担忧。个人 AI 设备虽可支持本地执行，但设备资源有限，可能影响任务成功与性能。现有基准不足以系统刻画不同设备、工作负载和部署架构之间的权衡。
AI.method: 构建 AgBench 基准套件与开放工件，用于可复现评估个人设备上的 agentic AI。使用 AgBench 在 agentic 工作负载上评估本地、混合和云端执行，测量任务成功率、延迟、云 API 成本与数据暴露，并基于超过 1.6207 亿数据点进行分析。
AI.result: 个人 AI 设备能够在本地完成许多 agent 任务，但纯本地执行通常比纯云端执行成功率更低、完成时间更长，尤其在并发增加时。纯本地执行消除云模型 API 成本以及向云 agent 暴露敏感信息。混合执行可提高任务成功率，但其云成本与数据暴露取决于 agent 如何划分工作和共享信息。没有单一架构在任务成功率、goodput、云成本和数据暴露方面表现最佳。
AI.conclusion: 部署选择应反映预期工作负载与设备能力。AgBench 作为可复现评估工具与开放工件，可用于系统理解 agentic AI 在个人设备上的部署权衡。AgBench 已在 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/AgBench-2777 提供。

title: EvoSteer: Online Self-Evolving Graph Orchestration via Reference-Anchored Credit Assignment
summary: In recent years, LLM-based multi-agent systems have been widely applied to orchestrate tool-using agents into executable communication graphs. However, existing self-evolving orchestration still faces key challenges, including post-hoc evolution that revises the team only after the trajectory ends, credit diffusion that gives every action the same terminal advantage under confounded baselines, and skill admission that is uncalibrated and never retired. To address these challenges, we propose EvoSteer, a new paradigm of Online Self-Evolving Graph Orchestration -- the orchestrator builds a running team and repairs its plausible but failing steps from execution features and a learned value estimate. To support this paradigm, we introduce Anchored Trajectory Balance (AnchorTB), a regression-style flow-matching loss that assigns each orchestration action a coefficient by balancing subtrajectories against a frozen reference. Built on the learned flow, we further propose Validated Skill Admission, in which a candidate skill is tried before promotion and promoted only if paired evidence passes a sequential test under a shared nominal testing budget. Moreover, AnchorTB combines measured task-level reference reward statistics with prefix-dependent corrections. Experimental results on twelve datasets show that EvoSteer significantly outperforms baselines across question answering, mathematical reasoning, code generation, and interactive decision making. Our code is available at https://github.com/beita6969/evosteer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EvoSteer，一种在线自演化图编排范式，让编排器在执行过程中实时构建团队并修复失败步骤；配合 Anchored Trajectory Balance 与 Validated Skill Admission，在十二个数据集上显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的多智能体工具编排存在三大问题：事后演化只能在轨迹结束后调整团队；信用扩散使所有动作获得相同终端优势，且基线存在混杂；技能准入缺乏校准且没有淘汰机制。
AI.method: 提出 EvoSteer 在线自演化图编排范式，编排器基于执行特征和学习到的价值估计修复看似合理但失败的步骤；引入 Anchored Trajectory Balance，一种回归式流匹配损失，通过将子轨迹与冻结参考平衡来为编排动作分配系数；并基于学习到的流提出 Validated Skill Admission，候选技能先试用，仅在配对证据通过共享名义测试预算下的序贯检验后才晋升；AnchorTB 还结合任务级参考奖励统计与前缀相关修正。
AI.result: 在十二个数据集上的实验表明，EvoSteer 在问答、数学推理、代码生成和交互式决策任务上均显著优于基线。
AI.conclusion: EvoSteer 通过在线自演化编排、锚定轨迹平衡和验证式技能准入，有效缓解事后演化、信用扩散与技能准入未校准等问题，提升了多智能体工具编排性能。

title: Communication-Free Distributed Multi-Robot Task Allocation under Partial Observations Using Labeled Multi-Bernoulli Filtering
comment: This paper has been submitted to IEEE ICRA 2027 for possible publication
summary: This paper proposes a communication-free multi-robot task allocation framework based solely on local observations. In this study, tasks are defined as reaching target locations. Each robot estimates the positions of neighboring robots using a Labeled Multi-Bernoulli (LMB) filter and independently assigns tasks through a greedy auction-based strategy. By continuously updating state estimates and reallocating tasks during execution, the proposed method enables decentralized coordination without explicit communication. Monte Carlo simulations demonstrate that the proposed method enables effective cooperative task allocation without inter-robot communication while remaining robust to measurement clutter and observation uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种仅基于局部观测、无需机器人间通信的多机器人任务分配框架，任务定义为到达目标位置。
AI.motivation: 传统多机器人任务分配通常依赖通信，本文旨在实现无显式通信条件下的去中心化协作任务分配。
AI.method: 每个机器人使用标签多伯努利（LMB）滤波器估计邻居位置，并通过贪婪拍卖策略独立分配任务；执行过程中持续更新状态估计并重新分配任务。
AI.result: 蒙特卡洛仿真表明，该方法无需机器人间通信即可实现有效的协作任务分配，并对测量杂波和观测不确定性具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 基于局部观测的LMB估计与贪婪拍卖相结合，可在无通信条件下实现去中心化多机器人任务分配，且对噪声和不确定性保持稳健。

title: DODGER: Safety-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Robot Navigation Among Dynamic Obstacles
comment: The first three authors contributed equally to this work. Project Page: https://psh0823.github.io/dodger-homepage
summary: Robots operating in human-centered environments must safely navigate among multiple dynamic obstacles to avoid collisions with people and surrounding infrastructure. Control barrier functions (CBFs) provide an effective mechanism for safety filtering, and recent CBF-based reinforcement learning (RL) methods embed such safety information into learned policies. However, executing only safety-filtered actions during training can restrict policy exploration, a limitation that becomes particularly consequential in dynamic scenes where safety depends on relative robot-obstacle motion. We propose DODGER, a safety-guided RL framework that directly executes policy-generated actions to drive training rollouts while using CBF-filtered references and constraint violations to shape the policy toward collision-avoidance behavior. We evaluate DODGER through a Dubins-car safety analysis and demonstrate goal-directed navigation among multiple dynamic obstacles in full-order humanoid simulation and real-world humanoid experiments using LiDAR-based perception, without a runtime safety filter.

AI.tldr: 提出DODGER，一种安全引导的强化学习框架，在训练中直接执行策略动作，同时利用CBF滤波参考和约束违反来塑造避障行为，实现多动态障碍物下的安全导航。
AI.motivation: 现有基于CBF的强化学习方法在训练中仅执行安全滤波后的动作，限制了策略探索，在动态场景中安全依赖相对运动时尤为不利。
AI.method: DODGER框架：训练时直接执行策略生成的动作进行rollout，但使用CBF滤波后的参考动作和约束违反信号来引导策略学习避障；通过Dubins车安全分析进行验证，并在全阶人形仿真和真实人形机器人上使用LiDAR感知进行实验。
AI.result: 在Dubins车分析中验证了安全性；在全阶人形仿真和真实人形实验中，无需运行时安全滤波器即可实现多动态障碍物下的目标导向导航。
AI.conclusion: DODGER能在不依赖运行时安全滤波的情况下，实现动态环境中安全且目标导向的导航，表明训练时直接执行策略动作并结合CBF引导是可行且有效的。

title: FlapKAD: A Simulation Dataset of Coupled Wing Kinematics and Aerodynamic Dynamics for Flapping-Wing Aerial Vehicles
summary: Experimental investigation and modeling of flapping-wing aerial vehicles are limited by the scarcity of large-scale records that temporally align wing kinematics, aerodynamic responses, and flight states. Existing datasets are often limited in scale and affected by measurement noise and temporal misalignment between rapidly varying wing motion and the associated dynamic response, particularly during high-frequency flapping. We introduce FlapKAD, an episode-structured simulation dataset comprising 2,000 rigid-wing flight episodes and 720,152 valid time steps, with bilateral wing kinematics, aerodynamic responses, and flight states recorded synchronously within a common clock. FlapKAD supports a unified bidirectional sequence-prediction benchmark constructed from the same temporally aligned episodes. The forward task predicts future vertical force coefficients and body vertical velocity from histories of realized flap and twist angles, whereas the inverse task reconstructs future flap- and twist-angle trajectories from the corresponding response histories. A benchmark of eight representative time-series architectures across multiple prediction horizons reveals direction- and horizon-dependent model behavior, systematically higher reconstruction errors for twist angle than for flap angle, and no consistent advantage from increased architectural complexity. FlapKAD provides a reproducible dataset and benchmark for studying coupled wing-kinematic, aerodynamic, and flight-state dynamics in flapping-wing aerial vehicles.

AI.tldr: 论文提出FlapKAD——一个面向扑翼飞行器的大规模、时间对齐的仿真数据集与双向序列预测基准，用于研究机翼运动学、气动响应与飞行状态之间的耦合动态。
AI.motivation: 扑翼飞行器实验研究与建模受限于缺乏大规模记录，现有数据集规模有限，且存在测量噪声以及高频扑动中机翼运动与动态响应之间的时间错位问题。
AI.method: 构建FlapKAD，包含2000个刚性翼飞行片段和720152个有效时间步，在同一时钟下同步记录双侧机翼运动学、气动响应与飞行状态；基于这些时间对齐片段建立统一双向序列预测基准，并评测8种代表性时间序列架构在多个预测时域下的表现。
AI.result: 基准显示模型行为具有方向和预测时域依赖性；扭转角的重构误差系统性高于扑动角；增加架构复杂度并未带来一致优势。
AI.conclusion: FlapKAD为研究扑翼飞行器中机翼运动学、气动与飞行状态耦合动态提供了可复现的数据集和基准。

title: Recovering Off-Policy Supervision for Speculative Decoding
summary: Block drafters for speculative decoding are commonly trained on corpora written by external models, where a single off-policy token invalidates supervision for all subsequent slots in a block. Existing approaches discard these divergent slots, resulting in severe supervision loss. To resolve this problem while preserving the training corpus, we propose a rollout-based training framework that recovers full supervision through two complementary components. The first component, Anchor-Label Relabelling (ALR), replaces corpus labels with distributions from greedy target rollouts, restoring valid supervision across all predicted slots. The second component, In-Rollout Anchors (IRA), places draft blocks directly inside these rollouts to expose the drafter to target-generated context, reusing precomputed rollout features at no additional target cost. Across fixed vision-language and text corpora, our framework increases greedy accepted length by up to 36.5% over DFlash and consistently outperforms erasing baselines. Notably, a single epoch of our method surpasses the best erase schedules. After three epochs, it matches the acceptance length of training on target-regenerated responses. These results show that our framework provides an effective and compute-efficient approach for training speculative drafters on fixed corpora without modifying the original text. Code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/ALR-IRA.

AI.tldr: 论文提出基于rollout的训练框架，通过ALR和IRA恢复投机解码draft模型在外部语料上的完整监督，显著提升接受长度且计算高效。
AI.motivation: 现有draft模型常在外模型生成的语料上训练，单个off-policy token会使块内后续slot的监督失效，丢弃这些slot会造成严重监督损失，同时又不希望修改原始训练语料。
AI.method: 提出rollout训练框架，包含两个组件：Anchor-Label Relabelling (ALR) 用贪心目标rollout分布替换语料标签，恢复所有预测slot的有效监督；In-Rollout Anchors (IRA) 将draft block放入rollout中，使draft接触目标生成上下文，并复用预计算rollout特征，不增加额外目标成本。
AI.result: 在固定视觉语言和文本语料上，贪心接受长度相比DFlash最高提升36.5%，并持续优于擦除基线；一个epoch即超过最佳擦除调度，三个epoch后匹配在目标重新生成响应上训练的效果。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能在不修改原始文本的固定语料上，有效且计算高效地训练投机解码draft模型。代码已开源。

title: After a Decade: Bringing Shadow Removal into the Real World with Agentic Training Data
summary: Shadow removal looks nearly solved on established benchmarks, yet remains brittle in the real world. Models have advanced; the paired training data they rely on have barely changed in nearly a decade. The reason is simple: obtaining a shadow-free target requires removing the occluder while keeping the scene, camera, and illumination otherwise unchanged, making diverse paired data difficult to capture. Meanwhile, large shadow detection datasets already contain diverse real-world images and masks, but no shadow-free targets. To turn this abundant but incomplete data into paired supervision, we propose an offline agentic workflow combining physics-motivated generation, failure detection, feedback-driven retry, candidate selection, and deterministic correction. Using this workflow, we construct AgenticShadow, a dataset of 17,138 image-mask-target triplets spanning general scenes, faces, and remote sensing. Our construction workflow reduces Color Distribution Difference by 50.5% over previous shadow removal work, while training existing shadow removal models on AgenticShadow reduces cross-domain LAB RMSE by 19.7-37.5%.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种离线智能体工作流，将大量仅有阴影图像和掩码的检测数据转化为成对阴影去除监督数据，并构建了 AgenticShadow 数据集，显著提升了现有模型的跨域阴影去除性能。
AI.motivation: 阴影去除在既有基准上看似接近解决，但在真实场景中仍很脆弱。核心瓶颈是成对训练数据近十年变化不大：获取无阴影目标需要在保持场景、相机和光照不变的同时移除遮挡物，导致多样化成对数据难以采集；而大规模阴影检测数据集虽包含多样真实图像和掩码，却缺少无阴影目标。
AI.method: 提出离线智能体工作流，结合物理启发式生成、失败检测、反馈驱动重试、候选选择与确定性校正，将不完整的检测数据转化为成对监督，并构建 AgenticShadow 数据集，包含 17,138 个图像-掩码-目标三元组，覆盖通用场景、人脸和遥感。
AI.result: 该构建流程相比先前阴影去除工作将颜色分布差异降低 50.5%；使用 AgenticShadow 训练现有阴影去除模型，可将跨域 LAB RMSE 降低 19.7% 至 37.5%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，通过智能体化数据构建流程，可利用丰富但不完整的阴影检测数据生成高质量成对监督，从而有效提升阴影去除模型在真实跨域场景中的泛化能力。

title: Overlap, Unique and Conflict: Can LLMs Extract What They Can Recognize?
summary: Understanding multi-perspective alternative narratives requires identifying how their information agrees, conflicts, or differs across sources. Existing work on cross-text relations largely focuses on categorizing relations between predefined text pairs, such as entailment or contradiction, rather than directly extracting such information from full narratives. To address this gap, we introduce Overlap-Unique-Conflict (OUC) extraction, a cross-narrative task that extracts all overlapping, conflicting, and unique clauses from two narratives. To support this study, we construct a benchmark of approximately 22K narrative pairs and 140K OUC instances spanning factual, argumentative, and political discourse. Evaluating 14 open-source LLMs (0.6B-35B), we find that unique information is far easier to extract than overlap and conflict: the strongest model, Gemma-4-31B, reaches only 61.13% F1-score on overlap and 48.58% on conflict, against more than 75% on unique. Further diagnostic analysis reveals that this difficulty does not stem from relation recognition alone, but rather from a failure to pair and extract the corresponding clauses from full narratives, especially in smaller models. Nevertheless, learning these extractions with task-specific supervision narrows the gap considerably: a fine-tuned Qwen-3-8B gains 15-28% absolute over its baseline and surpasses models roughly four times its size (e.g., Qwen-3.6-35B) on several tasks. Even so, overlap and conflict remain well below satisfactory, leaving cross-narrative clause extraction an open challenge.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出跨叙事线索提取任务 OUC，即从两个叙事中抽取所有重叠、冲突和独有子句，并构建约 2.2 万叙事对、14 万 OUC 实例的基准，评测 14 个开源 LLM。
AI.motivation: 现有跨文本关系研究多关注对预定义文本对进行分类（如蕴含或矛盾），难以直接从完整多视角叙事中识别信息的一致、冲突与差异，因此需要新的任务与基准。
AI.method: 提出 Overlap-Unique-Conflict (OUC) 抽取任务，构建覆盖事实、论证和政治话语的约 22K 叙事对、140K 实例基准；评测 14 个开源 LLM（0.6B-35B），并进行诊断分析及任务特定监督微调实验。
AI.result: 独有信息比重叠和冲突更易抽取：最强模型 Gemma-4-31B 在重叠上仅 61.13% F1，冲突 48.58% F1，而独有超过 75%。困难不仅在于关系识别，更在于从完整叙事中配对并抽取对应子句，小模型尤甚。经任务特定监督微调，Qwen-3-8B 较基线提升 15-28 个绝对点，并在若干任务上超过约四倍规模的 Qwen-3.6-35B。
AI.conclusion: 跨叙事子句抽取仍是开放挑战，尤其重叠与冲突的提取效果远未令人满意，但任务特定监督可显著缩小差距。

title: Bounded Channel-Adaptive Spectral Learning for Forward-Consistent Inverse Flapping-Wing Aerodynamics
summary: Flapping-wing vehicles regulate aerodynamic forces and moments through coordinated variations in stroke, deviation, and pitch motion. Because the resulting loads depend on both the instantaneous wing configuration and its preceding motion history, recovering suitable wing kinematics from a desired aerodynamic trajectory is a challenging inverse problem. Existing sequence models capture temporal dependencies, while spectral methods can exploit the periodic structure of flapping motion. However, unrestricted frequency-domain augmentation may interfere with temporal representations and produce inconsistent corrections across kinematic variables and prediction horizons. We propose the Bounded Channel-Adaptive Spectral Residual Gated Recurrent Unit (BCS-GRU), which retains recurrent temporal prediction as its primary representation and restricts spectral information to a controlled output-specific correction. We further introduce a causally aligned forward-consistency objective that evaluates predicted kinematics through a separately trained and frozen aerodynamic surrogate. Experiments under a unified episode-level protocol show that BCS-GRU improves inverse prediction over recurrent and adaptive-spectral baselines, with greater benefits at longer prediction horizons. Forward-consistent fine-tuning further improves surrogate-based aerodynamic consistency while maintaining mean kinematic accuracy. These results demonstrate that controlled spectral correction and forward-consistent learning provide an effective framework for history-aware inverse modelling of flapping-wing aerodynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 BCS-GRU 模型，用于从期望气动轨迹反推扑翼运动学参数。该方法以门控循环网络为主，仅将频谱信息作为受控的通道自适应残差修正，并引入基于冻结气动代理模型的前向一致性目标。实验表明其在逆预测上优于循环和自适应频谱基线，且长预测时域收益更明显。
AI.motivation: 扑翼气动力和力矩取决于瞬时翼面构型及其历史运动，因此从期望气动轨迹反推合适运动学是一个困难逆问题。现有序列模型能捕捉时序依赖，频谱方法可利用周期性，但不受约束的频域增强可能干扰时序表示，并导致不同运动学变量和预测时域上的修正不一致。
AI.method: 提出 Bounded Channel-Adaptive Spectral Residual Gated Recurrent Unit（BCS-GRU）：以循环时序预测为主要表示，将频谱信息限制为输出特定的受控修正。同时引入因果对齐的前向一致性目标，通过单独训练并冻结的气动代理模型评估预测运动学。
AI.result: 在统一 episode 级协议下，BCS-GRU 在逆预测任务上优于循环基线和自适应频谱基线，且在更长预测时域上优势更明显。前向一致性微调进一步提升了基于代理模型的气动一致性，同时保持平均运动学精度。
AI.conclusion: 受控频谱修正与前向一致性学习为扑翼气动的历史感知逆建模提供了有效框架。

title: General Performance Guarantee for Human Torque Estimation-Based Task-Agnostic Assistive Exoskeleton Control
summary: Accurate human torque estimation is crucial for enabling task-agnostic control in robotic exoskeleton systems. However, estimation errors may cause mismatches between the robot assistance and the human intention, degrading controllability and task performance. In this paper, we address this issue by formally defining matched assistance as scenarios in which the robot positively contributes to human movement. Based on this definition, we develop a theoretical framework to design the robot's desired interaction torque that guarantees a lower bound on the matched assistance probability. Importantly, the proposed guarantee holds over the entire torque distribution, including unseen data beyond the training tasks. This provides our method with strong reliability and generalization, both of which are critical for effective exoskeleton control. The proposed strategy is implemented on the ABLE upper-limb exoskeleton and evaluated in a multi-task setup. Experimental results validate the theoretical guarantees and demonstrate that the proposed strategy achieves effective general performance across several tasks, guaranteeing movement smoothness while reducing human physical effort.

AI.tldr: 本文针对外骨骼机器人中人机扭矩估计误差导致辅助与意图不匹配的问题，提出一种可保证匹配辅助概率下界的交互扭矩设计框架，并在ABLE上肢外骨骼上验证了其多任务泛化性与有效性。
AI.motivation: 准确估计人体扭矩对实现机器人外骨骼的任务无关控制至关重要，但估计误差会造成机器人辅助与人体意图不匹配，降低可控性与任务表现。
AI.method: 形式化定义匹配辅助，即机器人对人体运动有正向贡献；基于该定义建立理论框架，设计机器人期望交互扭矩，使其在整个扭矩分布（含训练任务之外未见数据）上保证匹配辅助概率下界；并在ABLE上肢外骨骼上进行多任务实验评估。
AI.result: 实验结果验证了理论保证，表明所提策略在多个任务中具有有效泛化性能，在保证运动平滑性的同时降低了人体体力消耗。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法为外骨骼控制提供了可靠且可泛化的匹配辅助保证，能够改善人机协作中的可控性与任务表现。

title: Exo2EgoHOI: Hand-Object-Interaction Aware Exocentric-to-Egocentric Video Generation
summary: Egocentric videos of human manipulation provide valuable visual experience for embodied intelligence, yet collecting such data at scale is costly. Exocentric-to-egocentric video generation offers a scalable alternative by transforming abundant third-person manipulation videos into first-person observations. However, existing methods often struggle to faithfully preserve demonstrated hand-object interactions (HOI) across large viewpoint changes due to insufficient fine-grained interaction guidance and weak object-centric anchoring. We present Exo2EgoHOI, an HOI-aware video generative framework for interaction-preserving exocentric-to-egocentric translation. To preserve fine-grained HOI, we introduce a unified 4D HOI prior that combines scene geometry, articulated hand renderings, and dense hand-object relation fields, together with a dual-branch residual adapter for injecting structural and relational cues into the video generation backbone. To preserve object consistency, we introduce Decomposed Gated Cross-Attention, which separately encodes object and background references and adaptively integrates global semantic and local appearance features as object-centric anchors. Experiments on ARCTIC-HOI and Ego-Exo4D demonstrate substantial improvements in object consistency and HOI preservation while maintaining competitive visual fidelity. In particular, on ARCTIC-HOI, Exo2EgoHOI improves object mIoU by 32.3% and reduces MPJPE and PA-MPJPE by 34.7% and 50.0%, respectively, relative to the respective best baseline results. Project page: https://rcl-robotics.github.io/Exo2EgoHOI/.

AI.tldr: 提出 Exo2EgoHOI，一种面向手-物交互保持的外中心到自我中心视频生成框架，通过引入 4D 手-物交互先验和分解门控交叉注意力，显著提升物体一致性与交互保持效果。
AI.motivation: 自我中心人类操作视频对具身智能很有价值，但大规模采集成本高。将大量第三人称操作视频转化为第一人称视频是一种可扩展替代方案，但现有方法在大视角变化下难以忠实保持手-物交互，原因是缺乏细粒度交互引导和强物体中心锚定。
AI.method: 提出 HOI 感知的视频生成框架 Exo2EgoHOI。为保持细粒度 HOI，引入统一 4D HOI 先验，融合场景几何、关节手部渲染和稠密手-物关系场，并使用双分支残差适配器向视频生成骨干注入结构与关系线索。为保持物体一致性，提出 Decomposed Gated Cross-Attention，分别编码物体和背景参考，并自适应整合全局语义与局部外观特征作为物体中心锚点。
AI.result: 在 ARCTIC-HOI 和 Ego-Exo4D 上实验表明，方法在物体一致性和 HOI 保持方面显著提升，同时保持有竞争力的视觉保真度。在 ARCTIC-HOI 上，相比各自最佳基线，物体 mIoU 提升 32.3%，MPJPE 和 PA-MPJPE 分别降低 34.7% 和 50.0%。
AI.conclusion: Exo2EgoHOI 能有效实现交互保持的外中心到自我中心视频生成，在大视角变化下提升手-物交互与物体一致性，为可扩展地获取自我中心操作视频提供了新途径。

title: Concept-Grounded Attention: A Controlled Evaluation of Graph-Injected Attention, Temporal Versioning, and Epistemic Status
summary: Knowledge-intensive language-model systems typically represent external knowledge as text chunks or static graphs, with limited support for concept evolution, point-in-time reasoning, and distinctions between validated and inferred knowledge. We introduce the Concept Lifecycle Model (CLM), which represents concepts as persistent, graph-grounded, temporally versioned entities with explicit provenance and epistemic status, and Concept-Grounded Attention (CGA), which injects concept-graph structure into transformer computation through graph-biased self-attention (Form A) and gated cross-attention over concept nodes (Form B). We evaluate the framework in controlled settings using disabled-mechanism baselines. On 200 MuSiQue and HotpotQA questions with retrieval fixed, concept-graph retrieval recovers explicit multi-hop paths but does not improve evidence recall. Form A appears to steer attention, with 2.76 times more attention on gold than distractor concepts, but the same ratio occurs when Form A is disabled; the learned bias is negligible and no answers change. An identity-preserving Form B improves F1 from 0.188 to 0.221, but control concepts yield 0.213, indicating that most of the gain reflects added capacity. On LongMemEval, explicit temporal representation improves answer accuracy by 13 to 25 points across all tested generators, up to 122B parameters, while simplified CLM version resolution performs similarly to dated serialization because concept identity is not established reliably. On a synthetic source-independence task, protocol-derived epistemic status reduces unsupported assertions from 28% to 0.1% in a fine-tuned small model and from 19-68% to 0-5% in 72-122B models. Overall, the results support making temporal validity and epistemic status explicit, while showing that graph-attention diagnostics are not informative without disabled-mechanism controls.

AI.tldr: 论文提出概念生命周期模型（CLM）与概念接地注意力（CGA），将概念建模为持久、图接地、带时间版本、来源与认知状态的知识实体，并在多跳问答、长时记忆与来源独立性任务上评估。
AI.motivation: 现有知识密集型语言模型通常将外部知识表示为文本块或静态图，难以支持概念演化、时间点推理，以及区分已验证知识与推断知识。
AI.method: 提出CLM，用图结构表示持久概念并加入时间版本、显式来源和认知状态；提出CGA，通过图偏置自注意力（Form A）和基于概念节点的门控交叉注意力（Form B）将概念图结构注入Transformer。使用禁用机制基线进行受控评估，并在MuSiQue、HotpotQA、LongMemEval和合成来源独立性任务上测试。
AI.result: 概念图检索能恢复显式多跳路径，但不提升证据召回。Form A看似引导注意力，黄金概念注意力为干扰概念2.76倍，但禁用Form A时比例相同，学习偏置可忽略且答案不变。Form B将F1从0.188提升至0.221，但控制概念为0.213，表明增益主要来自额外容量。LongMemEval上，显式时间表示使不同生成器答案准确率提升13至25点，最高至122B参数模型；简化CLM版本解析与日期序列化效果相似，因概念身份未可靠建立。合成来源独立性任务中，协议推导的认知状态将小模型无支持断言从28%降至0.1%，72-122B模型从19-68%降至0-5%。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持显式建模时间有效性和认知状态；同时表明若无禁用机制控制，图注意力诊断不具信息量。

title: Where Scientific Search Agents Fail: Decision-Checkpoint Auditing of Exposure and Inspection Attempts
summary: Final-answer accuracy does not reveal whether a scientific-search agent failed to encounter a target paper, attempt to inspect it, or return an accepted answer after inspection. We introduce decision checkpoints that record observations and tool actions without benchmark labels during inference, then join target identities and evaluator labels to assign outcome categories from recorded events. Across five conditions on 540 answerable AutoResearchBench Deep questions in a fixed, target-enriched environment, keyword search achieves 24.6\% accuracy, compared with 17.8\% for raw search. The keyword condition has fewer incorrect answers with neither target exposure nor inspection, but more incorrect answers after the target is exposed and left uninspected. Compared with keyword search, read-first has 27.4\% more recorded evidence-search calls. Target inspection attempts occur on 199 questions under read-first and 191 under keyword search; both conditions achieve 24.6\% accuracy. The checkpoint protocol makes these question-level differences explicit, distinguishing target exposure and inspection from aggregate accuracy and total tool use.

AI.tldr: 论文关注科学搜索智能体的评估，提出决策检查点来记录推理过程中的观察和工具动作，从而判断智能体是否遇到目标论文、是否尝试检查以及最终答案是否在检查后产生。
AI.motivation: 最终答案准确率无法揭示科学搜索智能体失败的原因：是未遇到目标论文、尝试检查但未成功，还是检查后返回了可接受答案。因此需要更细粒度的行为诊断。
AI.method: 在推理时使用决策检查点记录观察和工具动作，不依赖基准标签；随后结合目标身份和评估者标签，将记录事件归类为不同结果类别。在固定且目标增强的环境中，对 540 个可回答的 AutoResearchBench Deep 问题进行五种条件实验。
AI.result: 关键词搜索准确率为 24.6%，原始搜索为 17.8%。关键词条件下，既未暴露目标也未检查的错误答案更少，但目标已暴露却未被检查后的错误答案更多。相比关键词搜索，read-first 的记录证据搜索调用多 27.4%。目标检查尝试在 read-first 下出现于 199 个问题，在关键词搜索下出现于 191 个问题，但两者准确率均为 24.6%。
AI.conclusion: 检查点协议能够显式揭示问题层面的差异，将目标暴露和目标检查与总体准确率、总工具使用量区分开来，为分析搜索智能体行为提供更细粒度依据。

title: HIGS: Hierarchical Implicit Grids for Joint Geometric and Semantic Scene Understanding
summary: Neural implicit representations have had a significant impact on scene reconstruction by enabling robots to build continuous, differentiable, and high-fidelity 3D maps. Most existing works focus on geometric reconstruction and lack semantic information for high-level spatial understanding and task planning. Also, as the scale and complexity of the environment increase, neural representations face the challenge of maintaining computational efficiency in back-end optimization. To resolve these two challenges, we introduce a hierarchical neural field that leverages multiresolution submaps to achieve an efficient and scalable implicit representation, and a unified query and decoding mechanism to support both geometric and semantic features. More specifically, the learnable map features can be converted to the output with the query and decoding process for both training and inference. For large-scale representation, we decompose a scene into overlapping submaps and do hierarchical optimization within each local submap, thus enabling scalable computation. To further improve efficiency, we design feature encoders that predict initial hierarchical grid features to substantially reduce the time needed to optimize the submap features from scratch. To correct estimation drift among submaps, we align and fuse them entirely within the implicit feature space, leading to substantial acceleration by avoiding the need to decode the final output. Building upon this efficient hierarchical representation, we embed both geometric features and vision-language latent features into the map, and demonstrate it on both Signed Distance Field (SDF) construction and open-vocabulary object grounding. Our approach significantly improves computation and memory efficiency, maintains high estimation accuracy, and endows the robot with spatial awareness on large-scale real-world benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出一种分层神经隐式表示方法，通过多分辨率子图实现高效、可扩展的几何与语义建图，并在大规模真实场景中验证了SDF构建和开放词汇物体定位。
AI.motivation: 现有神经隐式表示多关注几何重建，缺乏语义信息，难以支持高层空间理解与任务规划；同时环境规模和复杂度增加后，后端优化计算效率面临挑战。
AI.method: 构建分层神经场，将场景分解为重叠子图并进行分层局部优化；设计统一查询与解码机制同时支持几何和语义特征；利用特征编码器预测初始分层网格特征以加速优化；在隐式特征空间中对子图进行对齐与融合，避免解码最终输出。
AI.result: 显著提升计算和内存效率，保持高估计精度，并能在大规模真实世界基准上实现SDF构建和开放词汇物体定位，赋予机器人空间感知能力。
AI.conclusion: 该分层隐式表示能够高效、可扩展地融合几何与视觉语言语义特征，为机器人提供面向大规模环境的空间理解与任务规划能力。

title: AIfred: Augmented Learning through Functional Robotic Embodiment at the Desk
comment: 7 pages, 9 figures. Submitted to ICRA 2027. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: Desk-based learning and creative activities benefit from handwritten engagement. However, current generative AI tools deliver guidance through a separate screen, creating a gap between where users think and where assistance appears. To address this, in this work we design AIfred, a desk-based robotic arm with a projector mounted at the end-effector that places AI-generated guidance alongside handwritten work. AIfred combines workspace perception, context-aware content generation, and robot-mediated projection to support math assignments, image generation, and drawing tasks. In a user study (n = 36), we compared AIfred against ChatGPT (GPT-5.6 Luna) running on a laptop. Both tools performed comparably while assistance was available during the math assignment (6.7 vs. 7.3/10, p = .41), but AIfred improved short-term learning transfer by 60% once assistance was withdrawn (7.0 vs. 4.4/10, p = .003). In addition, independent art and design professors ranked drawings produced with AIfred better in 33 of 36 cases. Our findings indicate that spatially co-located AI assistance benefits tasks whose guidance shares a spatial frame with the work.

AI.tldr: 本文设计了 AIfred：一种桌面机械臂，末端装有投影仪，可将 AI 生成指导直接投射到手写作业旁。用户研究（n=36）比较了 AIfred 与笔记本电脑上的 ChatGPT，发现两者在数学任务中辅助可用时表现相当，但撤除辅助后 AIfred 的短期学习迁移提升 60%；艺术设计教授也在 36 例中的 33 例更偏好 AIfred 辅助完成的绘画。
AI.motivation: 桌面学习和创意活动依赖手写参与，但现有生成式 AI 工具通常通过独立屏幕提供指导，导致用户思考与 AI 辅助出现空间分离。研究希望让 AI 指导出现在手写工作旁边，弥合这一差距。
AI.method: 设计 AIfred：桌面机械臂与末端投影仪结合，集成工作区感知、上下文内容生成和机器人投影，支持数学作业、图像生成和绘画任务。开展 n=36 用户研究，将其与笔记本电脑上的 ChatGPT（GPT-5.6 Luna）对比。
AI.result: 数学任务中，辅助可用时两者表现相当（6.7 vs. 7.3/10，p=.41）；但撤除辅助后，AIfred 的短期学习迁移提升 60%（7.0 vs. 4.4/10，p=.003）。此外，独立艺术与设计教授在 36 例中的 33 例认为 AIfred 辅助生成的绘画更好。
AI.conclusion: 空间共置的 AI 辅助对指导与工作共享同一空间框架的任务更有益，表明将 AI 指导直接放置在桌面手写工作旁可改善学习迁移和创意产出评价。

title: HALO: Heterogeneous Allocation Via Localized Observations for the Vehicle Routing Problem
comment: 2026 IEEE. Personal use of this material is permitted. Permission from IEEE must be obtained for all other uses, in any current or future media, including reprinting/republishing this material for advertising or promotional purposes, creating new collective works, for resale or redistribution to servers or lists, or reuse of any copyrighted component of this work in other works
summary:
Scalable robotic fleets have become increasingly popular for various applications such as package delivery, warehouse management, and military operations. Prior fleet control algorithms solve centralized routing problems with up to $1{,}000$ tasks in controlled environments, yet they fail to consider realistic constraints such as limited observation and communication ranges typical of decentralized fleets. Thus, deploying existing fleet control algorithms into real-world settings is currently infeasible.
  To tackle this, we propose Heterogeneous Allocation via Localized Observations (HALO) to solve the Vehicle Routing Problem (VRP). HALO is a hybrid method that splits the VRP into allocation and routing portions to provide onboard, real-time solutions to robots in dynamic environments. During the allocation phase, HALO utilizes a heterogeneous graph neural network framework with unique message passing layers to explicitly separate the learning of spatial distributions and task-to-robot compatibility.
  Evaluation results on a partially observable, online variant of the VRP show HALO significantly outperforms the heuristic baseline while maintaining similar solution quality to an all-knowing offline variant of HALO. While HALO is explicitly designed for partially observable environments, it imposes no strict upper bound on the observation space allowing us to test HALO on the traditional static, single-depot VRP. Here, HALO outperforms state-of-the-art architectures strictly optimized for the static variant of the VRP by up to $14.06\%$. Throughout all testing, this framework maintains the quickest execution times which emphasizes its potential for large-scale, real-time deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 HALO，一种面向动态、部分可观测环境的混合式车辆路径问题求解方法，将 VRP 拆分为分配与路径规划两部分，支持机器人实时在线决策。
AI.motivation: 现有车队控制算法多在集中式、受控环境中处理最多约 1000 个任务，未考虑去中心化车队中常见的有限观测与通信范围等现实约束，难以部署到真实场景。
AI.method: HALO 将 VRP 分为分配和路径规划阶段。分配阶段采用异构图表神经网络框架，通过独特的消息传递层，显式分离空间分布学习和任务-机器人兼容性学习，从而为机器人提供在线实时解。
AI.result: 在部分可观测的在线 VRP 变体中，HALO 显著优于启发式基线，并接近全知离线变体的解质量。在传统静态单仓库 VRP 上，HALO 比针对静态 VRP 优化的最先进架构高出最多 14.06%，且在所有测试中保持最快执行时间。
AI.conclusion: HALO 能在部分可观测、动态环境下实现高质量、实时的 VRP 求解，并具备大规模实时部署潜力；同时不限制观测空间上界，也可适用于传统静态 VRP。

title: GATE-ST: Gene-Aware Text-image Encoder for Spatial Transcriptomics
summary: Spatial transcriptomics enables spatially resolved gene expression analysis from slide-level images while preserving morphological features, providing valuable information for studying disease mechanisms and developing treatments. However, spatial gene expression profiling typically requires expensive and time-consuming tests. While existing image-based prediction optimizations mostly revolve around including positional embeddings and further image-based changes, text-based optimizations remain relatively unexplored. We present GATE-ST, which incorporates text-based inputs into image-based spatial gene expression predictions. With this approach, generated text descriptions of genes are utilized to better spatial transcriptomics prediction results. Gene summaries are put through a text encoder, generating embeddings that integrate with image embeddings through cross-attention layers to align with morphological features. We demonstrate the effectiveness of such text inputs by benchmarking performance against random gene embeddings and multiple other image-text fusion architectures, and show that GATE-ST outperforms these alternatives. Our results demonstrate the effectiveness of GATE-ST in pathology imaging, which may greatly reduce the time and cost of accurate spatial transcriptomic predictions, proving the potential of text-guided spatial gene expression prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GATE-ST，将基因文本描述引入基于图像的空间转录组基因表达预测，通过文本编码与图像嵌入的交叉注意力融合来对齐形态特征，并在基准比较中优于随机基因嵌入和其他图文融合架构。
AI.motivation: 空间转录组能在保留形态特征的同时实现空间分辨的基因表达分析，但空间基因表达检测通常昂贵且耗时；现有基于图像的预测优化多集中在位置嵌入和图像改进，基于文本的优化仍较少探索。
AI.method: 生成基因文本摘要，经文本编码器得到文本嵌入；将文本嵌入与图像嵌入通过交叉注意力层融合，以对齐形态特征；并与随机基因嵌入及多种其他图像-文本融合架构进行性能基准比较。
AI.result: GATE-ST 优于随机基因嵌入和多种其他图像-文本融合架构，证明了文本输入在空间转录组预测中的有效性，并在病理影像任务中表现良好。
AI.conclusion: 文本引导的空间基因表达预测具有潜力，可大幅减少准确空间转录组预测所需的时间和成本。

title: Eulerian Motion Reconstruction for Water Scenery
summary: Reconstructing and animating water scenery from nature produces compelling and immersive visual experiences. Previous work examined this task from the perspective of 2D video textures, with the goal of creating a looping video. In our work, we tackle the problem from a 3D perspective, creating a looping 4D dynamic reconstruction which can be interactively rendered from novel viewpoints from a single non-looping 2D source video. We represent motion as a 3D static \textit{Eulerian} motion field that advects canonical Gaussian splats that are cyclically reborn at fixed time periods, supervised using rendering losses. To model non-periodic and stochastic dynamics present in real-world scenes, we add a non-periodic, time-varying residual term to capture deviations from the static Eulerian motion field. We show quantitatively and qualitatively that our framework enables photorealistic animation of water scenes better than prior art.

AI.tldr: 从单段非循环2D视频重建可循环、可从新视角交互渲染的4D动态水面场景。
AI.motivation: 以往工作主要基于2D视频纹理生成循环视频，缺乏3D视角下的动态重建与交互渲染能力。
AI.method: 使用3D静态Eulerian运动场平流规范高斯splats，使splats按固定周期循环重生，并以渲染损失监督；同时加入非周期、时变残差项建模真实场景中的非周期和随机动态。
AI.result: 定量与定性结果表明，该框架能比先前方法更逼真地实现水面场景动画。
AI.conclusion: 该工作实现了从单段非循环2D视频出发的循环4D动态重建，并支持新视角交互渲染，效果优于现有方法。

title: StateTree: Enhancing Long-Term Dialogue Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Large language models deployed as personalized assistants must reason over long, evolving interaction histories. However, in long-term dialogue reasoning, relevant evidence is scattered across sessions, preferences may be revised over time, and standard long-context training fails to address these challenges under data scarcity and prohibitive computational costs. We propose StateTree, a data-driven RL method that constructs a challenging auxiliary task from scarce dialogues with verifiable ground truth. StateTree augments multi-session dialogues with a tree-structured path-tracing task: key-value records are embedded across sessions to form a binary tree. Solving the task requires the model to traverse from root to leaf by retrieving records across sessions and comparing timestamps to resolve branches, then recover the hidden target question among distractor leaves. We apply curriculum RL training progressively increasing tree depth and introduce a compositional variant whose edges carry step-level reasoning fragments, training the model to compose partial cues into coherent queries. Trained on 10K-token contexts, StateTree generalizes to 128K tokens without full-length RL costs and exhibits capabilities including cross-session retrieval, temporal reasoning, knowledge update, and compositional multi-hop reasoning. StateTree outperforms both SFT and RL-based baselines while preserving short-context general reasoning. StateTree-7B achieves gains up to +23.60% on LongMemEval (128k), and StateTree-14B reaches 59.00% accuracy on LongMemEval, surpassing QwenLong-L1-32B (45.20%).

AI.tldr: 论文提出StateTree，一种数据驱动的强化学习方法，通过在多会话对话上构建树结构路径追踪辅助任务，提升大语言模型在长时对话推理中的能力。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型作为个性化助手需在长时、演化的交互历史中推理，但相关证据分散于不同会话、偏好随时间修改，而标准长上下文训练在数据稀缺和高计算成本下难以应对这些挑战。
AI.method: StateTree从稀缺对话中构建带可验证真值的挑战性辅助任务：将键值记录跨会话嵌入形成二叉树，模型需从根到叶遍历、跨会话检索记录并比较时间戳解决分支，再从干扰叶子中恢复隐藏目标问题；采用课程强化学习逐步增加树深度，并引入组合变体（边携带步骤级推理片段）训练模型组合部分线索为连贯查询。
AI.result: 在10K token上下文训练即可泛化到128K tokens，无需全长RL成本；展现跨会话检索、时间推理、知识更新和组合多跳推理能力；优于SFT和RL基线且保持短上下文通用推理。StateTree-7B在LongMemEval(128k)上提升达+23.60%，StateTree-14B达59.00%准确率，超过QwenLong-L1-32B（45.20%）。
AI.conclusion: StateTree能有效提升长时对话推理能力，可泛化到更长上下文并保持通用推理，性能优于现有基线。

title: Magnetic based In-situ Self 3D Pose Estimation for a Modular Soft Tendon-Driven Continuum Robot via IMU-Fusion
summary: Continuum robots are well suited for gentle manipulation because of their inherent compliance and ability to adapt to complex environments. However, their continuously deformable structure makes accurate configuration estimation challenging, particularly when external vision systems are unavailable or obstructed. In this work, we present an embedded pose sensing framework that combines inertial measurement units (IMUs) and active magnetic fields to estimate the robot configuration without relying on external cameras. The angular measurements from the IMU and magnetic-field references are fused to improve local orientation estimation and reduce accumulated orientation error during operation. This pose sensing scheme achieves an update rate of 16.7~Hz, allowing real-time feedback. The proposed system is experimentally validated through closed-loop control, where the estimated robot configuration is used to maintain the end-effector at a desired position while interacting with an object. These results demonstrate the potential of distributed magnetic--inertial sensing for real-time pose estimation and closed-loop control of continuum robots.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种结合IMU和主动磁场的嵌入式位姿感知框架，用于连续体机器人的实时构型估计，更新率达16.7 Hz，并通过闭环控制实验验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 连续体机器人因其固有柔顺性和适应复杂环境的能力而适合进行轻柔操作，但其连续变形结构使得精确构型估计具有挑战性，尤其是在外部视觉系统不可用或受遮挡时。
AI.method: 提出一种不依赖外部相机的嵌入式位姿感知框架，融合IMU的角度测量和主动磁场参考，以改善局部方向估计并减少运行中累积的方向误差，实现16.7 Hz的实时更新率。通过闭环控制实验验证，利用估计的机器人构型在与物体交互时保持末端执行器在期望位置。
AI.result: 该位姿感知方案实现了16.7 Hz的更新率，能够提供实时反馈。闭环控制实验表明，估计的构型可用于维持末端执行器在期望位置并与物体交互，展示了分布式磁-惯性传感在连续体机器人实时位姿估计和闭环控制中的潜力。
AI.conclusion: 分布式磁-惯性传感在连续体机器人的实时位姿估计和闭环控制中具有应用潜力。

title: Uncovering Uncontrolled Repetition through Residual Stream Dynamics
summary: Uncontrolled repetition can prolong autoregressive generation in large language models (LLMs) and enable resource consumption attacks. Prior analyses of repetitive generation have identified strongly activated features in intermediate and late layers. However, how uncontrolled repetition activity emerges and develops before becoming prominent in these layers remains insufficiently understood. In this paper, we investigate this question primarily in large vision-language models (LVLMs), which support a richer set of uncontrolled repetitions through both visual and textual inputs. We propose Tokenwise Residual Comparison (TRC), a method that identifies and localizes anomalies associated with repetition from residual dynamics during generation. TRC compares attention and multilayer perceptron writes to the residual stream across generated tokens to identify patterns associated with repetition. It then selectively suppresses coordinates in the residual stream at the identified layer. Experiments show that TRC effectively mitigates uncontrolled repetition, reducing loop rates by 57\% on average. Our analysis further shows that repetition semantics emerge in shallow layers and propagate through the residual stream, disrupting normal representations. TRC also generalizes to large language models (LLMs) and large reasoning models (LRMs), where it consistently captures analogous repetition dynamics and achieves effective mitigation. Our work broadens the study of repetitive generation from its prominent internal representations to earlier opportunities for intervention, providing insights for mitigating resource consumption attacks.

AI.tldr: 本文研究大语言模型（及视觉语言模型）中不受控重复现象的早期形成机制，提出Tokenwise Residual Comparison (TRC)方法，通过比较残差流中的注意力与MLP写入来定位重复异常，并选择性抑制相关坐标，从而有效缓解重复生成。
AI.motivation: 不受控重复会延长自回归生成并导致资源消耗攻击。已有分析主要关注中后期层中强烈激活的特征，但对重复活动在早期层如何出现和发展尚不清楚。此外，大型视觉语言模型支持更丰富的重复模式，需要更早的干预机会。
AI.method: 提出Tokenwise Residual Comparison (TRC)。该方法在生成过程中比较不同生成token对残差流的注意力和多层感知机（MLP）写入，以识别与重复相关的模式，定位异常发生的层，然后在该层选择性地抑制残差流中的特定坐标。
AI.result: 实验表明，TRC能有效缓解不受控重复，平均降低循环率57%。分析发现重复语义在浅层出现并通过残差流传播，破坏正常表示。TRC还能泛化到LLM和大型推理模型（LRM），一致地捕捉类似的重复动态并实现有效缓解。
AI.conclusion: 本文拓宽了重复生成的研究，从关注显著内部表示转向更早的干预机会，为缓解资源消耗攻击提供了见解。

title: TACTIC: Temporal and Context-Aware LLM Tactical Planning for Roadside LiDAR Attacks
summary: Physical LiDAR attacks are often evaluated using fixed primitives and manually selected parameters, despite their strong dependence on surrounding traffic. We present TACTIC, a scene-aware framework that uses a multimodal large language model (MLLM) to coordinate state-adaptive roadside LiDAR attacks. Under a gray-box threat model, TACTIC relies only on an attacker-operated roadside perception stack, without accessing the victim LiDAR's native point clouds or internal processing. Local perception provides metric vehicle states, while the MLLM combines these measurements with roadside imagery to infer relational traffic context and construct a semantic scene graph. Based on this representation, TACTIC selects and configures two complementary primitives: \emph{push-away}, which shifts the perceived range of a lead vehicle, and \emph{phantom-obstacle braking}, which triggers emergency braking through obstacle injection. Measured traffic states and empirically calibrated constraints ground the generated tactics in physically feasible operating regions. To accommodate MLLM latency, TACTIC overlaps reasoning and execution asynchronously while high-rate local perception detects scene changes and triggers replanning. Across 280 randomized CARLA trials, the full policy achieves a 100% collision rate, compared with 35% for a fixed rule, 60% for random selection, and 75% for a restricted LLM using mode selection with default parameters. Joint physical-and-image input achieves 100% success, versus 65% with physical measurements alone and 75% with imagery alone, while asynchronous $Δ$ refresh reduces scene-mutation response from 7.4 s to 2.0 s. These results show that scene-dependent tactical planning can expose context-sensitive LiDAR failure modes that fixed attack policies may miss.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TACTIC——一个利用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）实现场景感知、状态自适应路侧 LiDAR 攻击的框架，在灰盒威胁模型下仅依赖攻击方自身感知栈，通过语义场景图选择并配置攻击原语，在 CARLA 仿真中实现 100% 碰撞率。
AI.motivation: 现有物理 LiDAR 攻击多采用固定原语和人工选定参数进行评估，忽略了攻击效果对周围交通场景的强依赖性，导致难以暴露真实交通环境中的上下文敏感失效模式。
AI.method: 在灰盒威胁模型下，TACTIC 仅使用攻击方部署的路侧感知栈（不访问受害者 LiDAR 原始点云或内部处理）。本地感知提供车辆度量状态，MLLM 结合测量结果与路侧图像推断交通关系上下文并构建语义场景图；据此选择并配置两种互补原语：push-away（偏移前车感知距离）与 phantom-obstacle braking（注入障碍触发紧急制动）。生成的策略通过实测交通状态和经验校准约束限定在物理可行域内。为应对 MLLM 延迟，采用异步方式重叠推理与执行，并由高频本地感知检测场景变化触发重规划。
AI.result: 在 280 次随机化 CARLA 试验中，完整策略达到 100% 碰撞率，而固定规则为 35%、随机选择为 60%、使用默认参数模式选择的受限 LLM 为 75%。联合物理测量与图像输入成功率为 100%，仅物理测量为 65%，仅图像为 75%；异步增量刷新将场景突变响应时间从 7.4 秒降至 2.0 秒。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，依赖场景的战术规划能够暴露固定攻击策略可能遗漏的上下文敏感 LiDAR 失效模式，说明多模态场景理解在物理攻击评估中具有重要价值。

title: Staying on Task: Testing the Foundations of Long-Horizon Agent Reliability
summary: Long-horizon agentic workflows require models to sustain repeated state-dependent actions all while the context grows, sub-task complexity changes, and new data arrives. Each situation represents an independent axis along which an agent may fail. An agent reconciling a long ledger, for example, must repeatedly read its state, update the correct record, and preserve alignment across thousands of outputs. A model may accept the entire ledger yet lose its place or stop applying the operation consistently as generation proceeds. We introduce Long-Transduction, a controlled diagnostic that tests a model's ability to stay on task during long generation while continuously reading, mutating, and outputting input-context dependent operations such as arithmetic, sorting, variable lookups, and table transformations. Long-Transduction evaluation independently varies local task complexity, input data formatting, and context length isolate failures along each axis. We evaluate seven open-weight models, finding a 62.8\% decrease when scaling context length from 4-128K, a 36.5\% decrease when varying input format, and a 39.9\% decrease by increasing local task complexity. Together, these failures represent critical liabilities in long-horizon agentic workflows.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Long-Transduction 诊断基准，用于测试模型在长程生成中持续执行依赖输入上下文的操作（如算术、排序、变量查找、表格变换）的能力。
AI.motivation: 长时程智能体工作流要求模型在上下文增长、子任务复杂度变化和新数据到达时，持续进行状态依赖的重复操作。每种情况都是独立的失败轴，而现有评估未能隔离这些失败。
AI.method: 提出 Long-Transduction 受控诊断，独立改变局部任务复杂度、输入数据格式和上下文长度，以隔离各轴上的失败；评估了七个开放权重模型。
AI.result: 上下文长度从 4K 扩展到 128K 时性能下降 62.8%；输入格式变化导致下降 36.5%；局部任务复杂度增加导致下降 39.9%。
AI.conclusion: 这些失败是长时程智能体工作流中的关键隐患。

title: STEPS: Scene Text Editing with Preserved Style Using Diffusion and Contrastive Style Encoding
comment: 9 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. A version of this paper appeared in PAKDD 2026 (LNCS vol. 16618)
summary: We introduce Scene Text Editing with Preserved Style (STEPS), a novel diffusion model architecture for quality text replacement in images. Scene Text Editing (STE), also known as Visual Text Editing, consists of changing the textual content in an image while conserving the original style, e.g. font, colors, orientation, background, etc. STEPS advances the state of the art in STE through directed focus on improved style preservation. We introduce a style encoder for visual text that captures style independently of textual content, and a model architecture that combines the style encoder with multiple semantic conditions (target text characters encoding and rendered glyphs). STEPS achieves superior results to previous STE methods in style preservation, output readability, and subjective quality.

AI.tldr: 提出STEPS，一种扩散模型架构，用于在保留原始风格的情况下替换图像中的场景文字，并提升风格保持效果。
AI.motivation: 场景文字编辑需要改变图像中的文字内容，同时保留字体、颜色、方向、背景等原始风格，但现有方法在风格保持方面仍有不足。
AI.method: 引入独立于文本内容、专门捕获视觉文本风格的风格编码器，并将其与目标文本字符编码、渲染字形等多种语义条件结合，构建扩散模型架构。
AI.result: STEPS在风格保持、输出可读性和主观质量方面均优于先前的场景文字编辑方法。
AI.conclusion: STEPS通过聚焦风格保持的扩散模型设计，推进了场景文字编辑领域的最新水平。

title: BatSLAM 2.0: Sequence-Verified Sonar Place Recognition in a Robust Pose Graph
summary: Echolocating bats can navigate dark and cluttered spaces using echolocation. Over a decade ago, BatSLAM showed that a robot with a biomimetic binaural sonar can build a topological map of the environment, by recognizing places from the received acoustic signals. Sonar place recognition, however, is ambiguous by nature: corridors produce nearly identical echo trains, and wrong loop closure can collapse the topological map. In this paper, we introduce BatSLAM 2.0, a novel sonar-only SLAM system built from three elements: an updated acoustic front-end, a sequence verifier that tracks and verifies loop closure candidates and a pose graph implemented on a high performance factor graph framework. The system was thoroughly evaluated both in simulated as well as real world recordings. In both cases, the BatSLAM2.0 algorithm shows the capability of robust topological map creation, countering map collapse, and robust scaling of map size.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 BatSLAM 2.0，一种仅依赖声呐的 SLAM 系统，通过改进声学前端、回环候选序列验证器和高性能因子图位姿图，实现稳健的拓扑地图构建。
AI.motivation: 蝙蝠能利用回声定位在黑暗杂乱环境中导航。此前的 BatSLAM 证明仿生双耳声呐机器人可通过声学信号识别地点并构建拓扑地图，但声呐地点识别本身具有歧义性：走廊会产生几乎相同的回声序列，错误的回环闭合可能导致拓扑地图崩溃。
AI.method: BatSLAM 2.0 由三部分组成：更新的声学前端、跟踪并验证回环闭合候选的序列验证器，以及在高效因子图框架上实现的位姿图。系统在仿真和真实世界记录中进行了评估。
AI.result: 在仿真和真实场景中，BatSLAM 2.0 均展现出稳健的拓扑地图创建能力，能够抵抗地图崩溃，并实现地图尺寸的稳健扩展。
AI.conclusion: BatSLAM 2.0 是一种仅使用声呐的稳健 SLAM 方案，可有效应对声呐地点识别歧义和错误回环闭合问题，支持可靠且可扩展的拓扑建图。

title: PhaseSync-Exo: Human Clock Anchored Reference Adaptation for Dynamic Gait Tracking
summary: Human-aware exoskeleton walking requires reconstructing gait, tracking diverse motions under dynamic constraints, and preserving human timing. We present PhaseSync-Exo, which combines two-IMU CNN-Transformer reconstruction, factorized amplitude-cadence retargeting with curriculum-trained recurrent control, and a human-clock-anchored adapter (HCA). HCA combines human-clock attraction with robot-relative feedback to adjust reference rate while preserving forward progression and continuity. The reconstruction module achieves a mean absolute error (MAE) of 3.24 degrees on a held-out recording, and the frozen tracking policy completes 356 of 357 amplitude-frequency trials. Two complementary dynamic comparisons isolate HCA's timing benefit without retraining. Against robot-relative correction, HCA reduces human-clock phase MAE from 95.55 degrees to 10.99 degrees, limiting reference drift. When human and delivered phases initially differ, it reduces phase MAE from 72.02 degrees to 13.90 degrees versus fixed-clock continuation. Compared with immediate phase reset, HCA reduces transient reference-tracking hip RMSE by 22.7% without reference jumps. All 420 timing rollouts complete without falls. These simulation results support continuous phase acquisition and sustained alignment to an independent human clock.

AI.tldr: 提出PhaseSync-Exo，通过双IMU CNN-Transformer步态重建、幅度-步频分解重定向与课程训练循环控制，以及人钟锚定适配器HCA，实现仿真中连续相位获取并持续对齐独立人体时钟。
AI.motivation: 人感知外骨骼行走需要重建步态、在动态约束下跟踪多样运动，并保持人体自身时序；现有机器人相对校正易漂移，固定时钟会延续初始相位差，立即相位重置又会造成参考跳变和瞬态跟踪误差。
AI.method: 方法包括：双IMU输入的CNN-Transformer步态重建；分解幅度与步频的重定向；课程训练的循环控制策略；以及人钟锚定适配器HCA，将人体时钟吸引与机器人相对反馈结合，用于调整参考速率并保持前向推进与连续性。
AI.result: 重建模块在留出录制上MAE为3.24度，冻结跟踪策略完成357次幅度-频率试验中的356次。相比机器人相对校正，HCA将人体时钟相位MAE从95.55度降至10.99度；初始相位不一致时，相比固定时钟延续，相位MAE从72.02度降至13.90度；相比立即相位重置，HCA将瞬态参考跟踪髋关节RMSE降低22.7%且无参考跳变。420次时序 rollout 均未跌倒。
AI.conclusion: 这些仿真结果支持连续相位获取，并表明系统能够持续对齐独立的人体时钟，为保持人体时序的外骨骼行走控制提供了可行方案。

title: You're Hired: Strategic Model Selection for LLM Collaboration
summary: While multi-agent and model collaboration algorithms gain traction to combine the strengths of diverse Large Language Models (LLMs), existing systems remain bottlenecked on pre-defined and hand-crafted model pools. In this work, we investigate the problem of model selection in multi-LLM systems. We propose and systematically evaluate a taxonomy of 9 selection algorithms ranging from diversity of model descriptions, capability-aware behavioral diversity, and LLM-based recruiters. We conduct extensive experiments across two candidate pools of 10 and 32 models, deployed in four model collaboration algorithms, and evaluated across tasks spanning math, coding, QA, and reasoning. Results demonstrate that successful selection algorithms greatly outperform random or heuristics-based teams such as merely selecting the models with top individual performance, by up to 36.1% across settings. Specifically, capability- and training-based selection strategies alleviate selection variance and achieve the best performance, which we recommend to employ before deploying real-world multi-LLM systems. Further analysis reveals that larger candidate pools pose greater challenges to shallow selection heuristics, while algorithms grounded in interacting with candidate models and understanding model capability robustly filter out misaligned, unsafe models, as well as generalizing to novel, out-of-distribution tasks. Together, we establish that principled and informed team selection is critical and present strong model selection algorithms for assembling effective multi-LLM systems.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多LLM系统中的模型选择问题，提出并评估了9种选择算法，在10和32个模型池、4种协作算法及数学、编程、问答、推理任务上验证，发现合理选择可显著优于随机或启发式团队，最高提升36.1%。
AI.motivation: 现有多LLM协作系统依赖预定义、手工构建的模型池，模型选择成为瓶颈，缺乏系统性的选择方法研究。
AI.method: 提出9种选择算法分类，涵盖模型描述多样性、能力感知行为多样性、基于LLM的招募器；在10和32个候选模型池中，结合4种模型协作算法，跨数学、编程、问答和推理任务进行广泛实验。
AI.result: 成功选择算法比随机或仅选个体最强模型等启发式团队最高提升36.1%；能力与训练相关选择策略减少选择方差并取得最佳性能；更大候选池对浅层启发式更具挑战；与候选模型交互并理解能力的算法能过滤错配、不安全模型并泛化到新分布外任务。
AI.conclusion: 有原则且基于信息的团队选择对构建有效多LLM系统至关重要，推荐在真实部署前采用能力与训练相关的选择策略。

title: Budget Boundary Effects in Test-Time Mathematical Reasoning
comment: Accepted as a poster at the 6th Workshop on Mathematical Reasoning and AI (MATH-AI), NeurIPS 2026. 11 pages, 3 figures, 8 tables. Includes additional post-acceptance accounting and selection diagnostics
summary: A cumulative token cap can fall inside a mathematical derivation, forcing a test-time controller to choose between stopping at the cap (strict) and allowing the current attempt to finish (advisory). We measure this boundary choice with paired offline replays of 19,200 public traces: 120 AIME, BrUMO and HMMT problems and two archive configurations of one model. Candidate order and a 16-attempt cap are fixed, and answer selection is blind to reference answers and correctness labels. Three findings emerge. First, at the 4k cap, most advisory accuracy gains replace abstention with a correct answer; strict stopping pays for an unfinished prefix that the completed-only selector cannot use. Second, comparisons along realized cost differ from same-cap comparisons: advisory 4k in low has higher accuracy than strict 8k at comparable mean completion cost, while in high its observed accuracy is 0.42 points below strict 32k using 59% of its mean tokens. These aggregate comparisons do not establish equal-compute superiority or accuracy equivalence. Third, increased candidate coverage does not guarantee higher answer accuracy: a log-probability selector loses accuracy while coverage rises, including after a source-grade consistency repair. Same-cap majority-accuracy differences shrink below 1.3 percentage points at 32k. Budget curves should jointly state the cap, realized cost, eligible candidates, stopping rule and selector information.

AI.tldr: 本文研究累计token上限落在数学推导中途时，测试时控制器应严格停止还是允许当前尝试完成。通过19,200条公开轨迹的配对离线重放，比较strict与advisory两种停止规则，并考察成本、候选覆盖与选择器对答案准确率的影响。
AI.motivation: 累计token上限可能截断未完成的数学推导，导致控制器面临严格停止与建议性完成当前尝试的边界选择。现有预算曲线常未明确区分该选择及其对准确率、实际成本和候选选择的影响。
AI.method: 对120道AIME、BrUMO和HMMT题目、一个模型的两种归档配置进行配对离线重放，共19,200条公开轨迹。固定候选顺序和16次尝试上限，答案选择不依赖参考答案和正确性标签，比较strict与advisory在4k、8k、32k等上限下的表现。
AI.result: 第一，在4k上限，advisory多数准确率增益来自将弃答替换为正确答案；strict停止会为已完成选择器无法利用的未完成前缀付出成本。第二，按实际成本比较与同上限比较不同：低配置中advisory 4k在相近平均完成成本下准确率高于strict 8k；高配置中其观测准确率比strict 32k低0.42个百分点，但仅用后者59%的平均token。第三，候选覆盖增加不保证答案准确率提高：对数概率选择器在覆盖率上升时准确率下降，即使经源级一致性修复后仍如此；32k下同上限多数准确率差异缩小至1.3个百分点以内。
AI.conclusion: 预算曲线应同时说明token上限、实际成本、合格候选、停止规则和选择器信息。advisory与strict的聚合比较不能确立等计算量优越性或准确率等价性；更高候选覆盖也未必带来更高答案准确率。

title: Can Terminal Agents Trust Their Own Verification? Diagnosing and Improving Self-Verification
summary: Terminal agents rely on self-verification to assess and correct their solutions as they solve tasks through interaction with command-line environments. Yet how trustworthy such self-verification is remains poorly understood. To investigate this question systematically, we introduce a diagnostic framework that identifies the first complete solution in each trajectory, determines whether it is objectively correct, and uses this ground truth to quantify the agent's subsequent verification and recovery behavior. Applying it to ten terminal agents on TerminalBench2.1, we find that verification is nearly universal after a complete candidate is formed, yet only 61.43\% of incorrect candidates are detected and only 49.36\% of detected errors are successfully repaired. These results show that the main weakness in self-verification lies not in initiating verification, but in detecting and repairing errors. Motivated by these findings, we propose Student-Conditioned Verification Distillation (SCVD), which lets the student first produce a candidate solution and distills a stronger teacher's subsequent verification and recovery from the same interaction context. Across three Qwen3.5 backbones, SCVD improves \textsc{Pass@1} on TerminalBench2.1 by 9.74--16.85 percentage points over the corresponding base models and by 4.49--8.61 points over the standard full-trajectory distillation, while avoiding the pronounced out-of-distribution degradation of full-trajectory distillation on SWE-bench Verified.

AI.tldr: 论文研究终端智能体自我验证的可信度，提出诊断框架量化其验证与修复行为，发现瓶颈在错误检测与修复；进而提出SCVD方法，通过蒸馏更强教师的验证与恢复能力提升终端任务表现。
AI.motivation: 终端智能体依赖自我验证来评估和修正解决方案，但这种自我验证是否可信尚不明确。需要系统诊断验证失败发生在何处，并据此改进智能体的自验证与纠错能力。
AI.method: 提出诊断框架：识别每条轨迹中首个完整解决方案，判断其客观正确性作为真值，并量化智能体后续的验证与恢复行为。在TerminalBench2.1上评估十个终端智能体。进一步提出Student-Conditioned Verification Distillation（SCVD）：让学生先产生候选解，再在同一交互上下文中蒸馏更强教师的后续验证与恢复过程。
AI.result: 诊断发现验证几乎普遍发生，但仅61.43%的错误候选被检测到，且仅49.36%被检测到的错误能成功修复。SCVD在三个Qwen3.5骨干模型上将TerminalBench2.1的Pass@1较基座模型提升9.74–16.85个百分点，较标准全轨迹蒸馏提升4.49–8.61个百分点，同时避免全轨迹蒸馏在SWE-bench Verified上的明显分布外退化。
AI.conclusion: 自我验证的主要弱点不在于是否启动验证，而在于检测和修复错误。SCVD能有效提升终端智能体的自验证与恢复能力，在终端任务上取得显著性能提升，并缓解分布外性能下降。

title: Coral Grow-out Robotic Assessment System (CGRAS): Scaling Coral Recruit Monitoring Through Robotics and Computer Vision
summary: Climate change is the largest threat to coral reefs, with increasing global impacts accelerating the need for scalable reef restoration technologies. Large-scale reef restoration depends on the mass production of corals, such as through coral aquaculture. Coral seeding with recruits grown in aquaculture facilities is a feasible restoration approach, but effective production requires consistent, high-frequency monitoring of tens of thousands of macroscopic (0.5-2mm diameter) recruits, making conventional manual assessment prohibitively labor-intensive. To address this monitoring bottleneck, we introduce the Coral Grow-out Robotic Assessment System (CGRAS) which combines robotic imaging and computer vision to automate data acquisition, perform multi-species detection and counting of corals, and evaluate coral health. CGRAS automatically extracts coral growth, survival and spatial distribution metrics, with the aim of providing timely feedback to operators for optimizing production, grow-out and deployment workflow processes. We demonstrate CGRAS in a large aquaculture facility on standardized coral settlement tiles, reducing the time and labor costs by a factor of 9.6 as compared to manual monitoring, whilst achieving 96.4% agreement for Acropora kenti corals relative to expert counts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CGRAS系统，结合机器人成像与计算机视觉，自动化监测珊瑚养殖中的珊瑚幼体，实现多物种检测、计数和健康评估。在大型养殖设施中，相比人工监测节省9.6倍时间和劳动力，对Acropora kenti与专家计数一致率达96.4%。
AI.motivation: 气候变化严重威胁珊瑚礁，大规模珊瑚礁恢复依赖珊瑚水产养殖，但需要对数万个毫米级珊瑚幼体进行高频监测，传统人工评估成本过高，成为规模化生产的瓶颈。
AI.method: 开发Coral Grow-out Robotic Assessment System（CGRAS），集成机器人成像和计算机视觉，自动采集数据，进行多物种珊瑚检测、计数和健康评估，并自动提取生长、存活和空间分布指标；在大型水产养殖设施的标准珊瑚沉降板上进行验证。
AI.result: CGRAS将监测时间和劳动力成本较人工监测降低9.6倍，对Acropora kenti珊瑚的计数与专家计数一致率达到96.4%。
AI.conclusion: CGRAS能够自动化珊瑚养殖监测，为操作人员提供及时反馈，以优化生产、培育和部署流程，从而支持可扩展的珊瑚礁恢复。

title: Template-Search Domain Adaptation via Multi-Stage Feature Alignment for Cross-Modal Object Tracking
summary: Visual object tracking typically assumes that the initial template and subsequent search frames share the same sensing modality. In practice, sensor availability or operation may change over time, creating a substantial representation gap between template and search frames. Unlike conventional multi-modal tracking where paired modalities are simultaneously available, cross-modal tracking requires localization when template and search frames originate from different active modalities. Accordingly, we introduce TSDA-Track, a Template-Search Domain Adaptation framework to reduce modality discrepancy during training. We investigate two feature alignment strategies. Pre-AFA TSDA-Track applies adversarial alignment before transformer's template-search interaction to suppress modality-specific bias. Enc-CFA TSDA-Track applies contrastive alignment to encoder representations after interaction to strengthen target-level cross-modal correspondence. Both variants retain a shared inference pipeline without modality-specific branches. Experiments on LasHeR, and zero-shot evaluations on RGBT234 and GTOT under multiple cross-modal protocols demonstrate improvements over representative state-of-the-art trackers. For instance, under the modality-switch protocol on RGBT234, Pre-AFA TSDA-Track achieves an SR/PR of 43.2/56.0, compared with 36.8/50.0 for ToMP-101 baseline. In addition, a study on Anti-UAV-024 further verifies the applicability of TSDA-Track to aerial tracking. Our study highlights the effectiveness of feature alignment domain adaptation for cross-modal tracking.

AI.tldr: 提出TSDA-Track，一种模板-搜索域自适应框架，用于解决模板帧与搜索帧来自不同模态时的跨模态视觉目标跟踪问题，并通过两种特征对齐策略缩小模态差异。
AI.motivation: 传统跟踪通常假设初始模板与后续搜索帧共享同一传感模态，但实际中传感器可用性或工作状态可能变化，导致模板与搜索帧之间存在较大表征鸿沟；现有方法多假设配对模态同时可用，难以应对跨模态跟踪。
AI.method: TSDA-Track在训练阶段进行模板-搜索域自适应。Pre-AFA TSDA-Track在Transformer模板-搜索交互前使用对抗对齐，抑制模态特定偏差；Enc-CFA TSDA-Track在交互后对编码器表示使用对比对齐，增强目标级跨模态对应。两种变体均保持共享推理流程，无需模态特定分支。
AI.result: 在LasHeR及RGBT234、GTOT上的零样本跨模态评估中优于代表性SOTA跟踪器。例如RGBT234模态切换协议下，Pre-AFA TSDA-Track达到SR/PR 43.2/56.0，而ToMP-101基线为36.8/50.0；Anti-UAV-024研究也验证了其在空中跟踪中的适用性。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，基于特征对齐的域自适应方法对跨模态跟踪是有效的，能够缩小模板与搜索帧之间的模态差异并提升跟踪性能。

title: BARRAC: Adaptation of an English Aspect-based Sentiment Analysis Approach for Classification Tasks in Arabic Dialects
summary: With the rapid growth of Arabic NLP, several models, datasets and benchmarks have been reported. This paper asks whether approaches developed for majority languages like English can be adapted to Arabic tasks. We adapt an English aspect-based sentiment analysis framework to Arabic classification tasks and present the adaptation as BARRAC: Brainstorming Alignment and Replaced Representation learning for ArabiC tasks. BARRAC replaces consumer-review attribute pools with Arabic linguistic devices and markers for dialectal sentiment, sarcasm, and dialect identification, and replaces noisy self-training with two-stage training. Evaluated on five Arabic dialect datasets, BARRAC achieves a mean macro-F1 of 63.93\%, outperforming the best few-label SOTA by 3\%, and outperforming GPT-4o on four out of five tasks. Error analysis provides insights into remaining challenges. These results demonstrate that adapting task-specific approaches is a promising direction for Arabic NLP alongside adapting models, datasets and benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 该论文将面向英语的基于方面的情感分析框架适配到阿拉伯语分类任务，提出 BARRAC，并在五个阿拉伯语方言数据集上验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 阿拉伯语 NLP 快速发展，已有模型、数据集和基准，但尚不清楚为英语等主流语言开发的任务方法能否适配阿拉伯语任务。
AI.method: 提出 BARRAC（Brainstorming Alignment and Replaced Representation learning for ArabiC tasks），将消费者评论属性池替换为阿拉伯语语言手段和方言情感、讽刺、方言识别标记，并用两阶段训练替代噪声自训练。
AI.result: 在五个阿拉伯语方言数据集上，BARRAC 取得 63.93% 的平均 macro-F1，比最佳少标签 SOTA 高 3%，并在五项任务中的四项上超过 GPT-4o；误差分析揭示了剩余挑战。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，除适配模型、数据集和基准外，适配任务特定方法也是阿拉伯语 NLP 的一个有前景方向。

title: Passive Stiffness Shaping in Cable-Suspended Aerial Manipulation via Movable Compliant Anchors
summary: Cable-suspended aerial manipulation offers a lightweight architecture for cooperative transportation and physical interaction, yet the passive mechanical response perceived at the load remains insufficiently understood and systematically exploited. This work interprets aerial vehicles as movable compliant anchors and develops a gravity-aware quasi-static theory for predicting and shaping the passive Cartesian stiffness of a suspended load. The formulation applies to an arbitrary number of aerial vehicles connected to a point load by taut, straight, inextensible cables. At a selected gravity-loaded equilibrium, aerial-anchor compliance and transverse cable geometric compliance combine in series within each leg, while the leg stiffnesses act in parallel on the load. For isotropic aerial-anchor behavior, each leg is exactly equivalent to a virtual unilateral elastic cable, revealing an axial--transverse stiffness decomposition governed by the equilibrium tension. These results define a nonlinear map from commanded-anchor configuration to passive load stiffness, whose differential enables local constraint-preserving shaping through anchor repositioning. A dynamic rigid-body validation framework with nonlinear vehicle control, elastic-damped tendons, and environmental contact is defined to assess when and to what extent the derived stiffness remains predictive beyond the assumptions of the analytical model.

AI.tldr: 该文将空中飞行器视为可移动柔顺锚点，建立了重力感知的准静态理论，用于预测和塑造缆索悬吊负载的被动笛卡尔刚度，并提出了动力学验证框架。
AI.motivation: 缆索悬吊空中操作具有轻量、可协同运输与物理交互的潜力，但负载处感受到的被动机械响应尚未被充分理解与系统利用。
AI.method: 针对任意数量飞行器通过张紧、直线、不可伸长缆索连接点负载的系统，在选定的重力平衡态下，将飞行器锚点柔顺性与缆索横向几何柔顺性按每条腿串联、各腿刚度对负载并联；在锚点各向同性假设下，将每条腿等价为虚拟单侧弹性缆索，并进行轴向-横向刚度分解；进一步建立从指令锚点构型到被动负载刚度的非线性映射，并利用其微分实现通过锚点重定位的局部保约束刚度塑造；同时定义包含非线性飞行器控制、弹性阻尼腱和环境接触的动力学刚体验证框架。
AI.result: 理论表明：重力平衡张力决定轴向-横向刚度分解；每条腿可精确等效为虚拟单侧弹性缆索；锚点构型到负载被动刚度存在非线性映射，其微分可用于局部保约束的刚度调节。
AI.conclusion: 该理论为缆索悬吊负载的被动刚度预测与主动塑造提供了系统框架，并通过动力学验证框架评估其在偏离解析假设时仍具预测性的条件与程度。

title: UniEvo-VL: An On-policy Self-Distillation Training Recipe for Multimodal Model Self-improvement
summary: Modern multimodal models bring generation and understanding into a single unified system, which enables them to provide and learn from their own feedback. Motivated by this unified capacity, we introduce UniEvo-VL, a self-evolving framework for multimodal models to learn from this constructive self-correction feedback during test-time compute. Instead of relying on a separate, often larger, teacher, we leverage their self-critiques as privileged information and ask a single multimodal model to act as both teacher and student with different contexts. The student only sees the vanilla question, while the teacher conditions on the privileged critique. Then training minimizes the per-state divergence between their denoising diffusion distributions over the student's own sampling trajectories. Experiments demonstrate that UniEvo-VL improves the image generation capabilities of multimodal models, while maintaining their sensitivity to additional reflection information. Specifically, we build on top of the open-source Qwen-image-2512 and observe a significant performance gain from 0.747 to 0.808 on GenEval and from 32.97 to 35.53 on GenEval2 Soft-TIFA. Moreover, attempts with more powerful external critics (e.g., GPT5.6-Luna) show that multimodal models with strong judge capabilities can anticipate a higher self-evolving ceiling. Last but not least, mixed text-rendering outcomes show that our self-improvements may not be uniform across different tasks. Our study aims to shed light on the current hot recursive self-improvement research line to enhance the user experience when using multimodal models without external supervision or guidance.

AI.tldr: 提出 UniEvo-VL：一种多模态模型自进化框架，利用模型自身在测试时计算中产生的自我纠错反馈，让同一模型分别扮演教师与学生，从而提升图像生成能力。
AI.motivation: 现代多模态模型已统一生成与理解能力，能够提供并学习自身反馈；因此希望不依赖独立且通常更大的外部教师模型，而是利用自我批判作为特权信息，实现无外部监督的递归自我改进。
AI.method: 在测试时计算中，学生只接收到原始问题，教师则额外条件于模型自身的批判反馈；训练时最小化二者在学生自身采样轨迹上每状态的去噪扩散分布散度。基于开源 Qwen-image-2512 实现，并测试外部更强批判者（如 GPT5.6-Luna）的影响。
AI.result: UniEvo-VL 提升了多模态模型的图像生成能力，同时保持对额外反思信息的敏感性。在 Qwen-image-2512 上，GenEval 从 0.747 提升到 0.808，GenEval2 Soft-TIFA 从 32.97 提升到 35.53。更强外部批判者表明，具备强评判能力的多模态模型可能达到更高自进化上限。混合文本渲染结果显示自改进在不同任务上可能并不均匀。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为递归自我改进方向提供了探索，表明多模态模型可在无外部监督或指导的情况下通过自身反馈提升用户体验；但自改进效果可能因任务而异，并非普遍均匀。

title: Code to Control: Synthesizing Parameterized Reactive Controllers
summary: Recent LLM-based approaches to control either invoke a language model to select actions or synthesize world models that require planning at every decision, introducing latency that can limit real-time use. We introduce Code to Control, an approach that synthesizes Python controllers which execute directly as policies. Code to Control separates program structure from parameters. An LLM synthesizes the controller structure, while derivative-free search fits its parameters for continuous control using feedback from the environment. Once learned, the resulting controllers require neither LLM inference nor planning at decision time, enabling real-time gameplay and, under our timing protocol, faster action selection than a PPO policy. Across a suite of Atari games, Flappy Bird, and MuJoCo tasks, Code to Control outperforms planning-based program synthesis methods, remains competitive with deep reinforcement learning while using fewer environment interactions, transfers across substantial changes in environment dynamics, and scales to complex locomotion tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出 Code to Control 方法，用 LLM 合成 Python 控制器结构，再用无导数搜索优化参数，使控制器可直接作为策略执行，无需决策时 LLM 推理或规划，实现实时控制。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的控制方法要么让语言模型选择动作，要么合成需要每步规划的世界模型，导致延迟较高，难以满足实时应用需求。
AI.method: Code to Control 将程序结构与参数分离：LLM 负责合成控制器结构，无导数搜索利用环境反馈拟合连续控制参数；学习完成后，控制器直接执行，决策时不需要 LLM 推理或规划。
AI.result: 在 Atari、Flappy Bird 和 MuJoCo 任务中，该方法优于基于规划的程序合成方法，与深度强化学习相当但环境交互更少，能适应环境动态的显著变化，并可扩展到复杂运动任务；在给定计时协议下，动作选择比 PPO 策略更快。
AI.conclusion: 通过合成可执行代码控制器并学习其参数，可以在不依赖运行时 LLM 推理或规划的情况下实现实时、高效、可迁移且可扩展的控制。

title: Forging LLM Authorship Fingerprints with Targeted Rewriting
summary: Model-attribution classifiers can often identify which language model produced a text, making model-specific writing patterns a signal of provenance. Accurate attribution on unmodified text, however, does not show whether the prediction still identifies the original source after deliberate rewriting. We formulate this problem as targeted fingerprint transfer: rewriting one model's output so that attribution classifiers assign it to a chosen target model. We study summarization, where different models receive the same document and express the same underlying content, providing a controlled setting for conditional generation. We introduce ForgePrint, a search-then-distil framework that first searches for rewrites that move attribution toward a target fingerprint, then distils the selected rewrites into a one-pass 4B Student model. On CNN/DM, the Student reaches 70.2% target success rate, outperforming both its Teacher (54.1%) and the strongest of six published rewriting baselines (39.3%), against held-out classifiers that are never queried by the attack. It also reaches 68.3% target success when transferring summaries from an open model toward chosen commercial models. These results show that fingerprint detectability should not be conflated with source authenticity, and that text-only attribution can provide misleading evidence of model identity under targeted rewriting, even when it is accurate on unmodified text.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“目标指纹迁移”问题：通过改写某模型的输出，使模型归因分类器将其误判为指定目标模型。作者提出ForgePrint（先搜索后蒸馏）框架，在摘要任务上实现了高成功率的目标指纹迁移。
AI.motivation: 模型归因分类器能在未修改文本上准确识别来源模型，但无法说明文本被刻意改写后是否仍能正确归因。这关系到仅凭文本归因判断模型身份的证据是否可靠。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为目标指纹迁移，并在摘要任务（不同模型基于同一文档生成内容）这一受控条件下研究。提出ForgePrint：首先搜索能推动归因指向目标指纹的改写，然后将选中的改写蒸馏为一次性4B学生模型，并在攻击未查询过的留出分类器上评估。
AI.result: 在CNN/DM上，学生模型目标成功率达70.2%，优于教师模型（54.1%）和六个已发表改写基线中最强者（39.3%）。在将开放模型摘要迁移至选定商业模型时，目标成功率也达68.3%。
AI.conclusion: 指纹可检测性不应与来源真实性混为一谈；在针对性改写下，即使文本归因在未修改文本上准确，也可能对模型身份提供误导性证据。

title: Locomotion-Grounded Humanoid Soccer: Task-Gated Reinforcement Learning of a Multi-Directional Kicking Library
summary: Recent humanoid soccer systems make motion tracking the substrate and derive locomotion from it, typically by steering a motion-reference anchor toward the ball. This yields strong shooting results, but locomotion is trained only on the narrow, deterministic command distribution ball approach induces, never evaluated as a capability in its own right. We invert the stack: a general, command-conditioned locomotion policy is trained first as the substrate, and N motion-guided kicking skills are added on top as task-gated layers, so the reachable gait space is set by the locomotion curriculum rather than any reference clip. Because every skill starts from and returns to this same commandable state, locomotion also becomes a composition hub (O(N) transitions rather than O(N^2)), and post-strike stabilisation is handed back to the trained controller rather than scripted per clip. We instantiate this on a 29-DoF Unitree G1 with seven retargeted kicking skills spanning 259.5 degrees of nominal aim direction, including lateral, rearward and weak-foot strikes a single forward-facing reference cannot express, and report shooting accuracy alongside command-tracking, terrain and push-recovery results with the full skill library attached, an axis prior humanoid soccer systems do not report. The library is validated on hardware across forward, lateral, rearward and commanded approaches.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种颠倒式人形机器人足球控制框架：先训练通用的、由指令条件化的运动策略作为基底，再在其上叠加多个运动引导的踢球技能层，并在29自由度Unitree G1上验证了七种踢球技能及硬件部署。
AI.motivation: 现有人形足球系统以运动跟踪为基底，通过将运动参考锚点转向球来衍生移动，导致 locomotion 仅在狭窄且确定性的接近球指令分布上训练，未被作为独立能力评估。作者希望让可达到的步态空间由 locomotion 课程决定，而非参考片段。
AI.method: 先训练一个通用的、命令条件化的 locomotion 策略作为基底；再添加 N 个运动引导的踢球技能作为任务门控层。每个技能从同一可命令状态出发并返回该状态，使 locomotion 成为组合中心，将技能间转换从 O(N^2) 降为 O(N)，并将击球后稳定交回训练好的控制器而非逐片段脚本化。在29自由度Unitree G1上实例化，包含7个重定向踢球技能，覆盖259.5度标称瞄准方向。
AI.result: 系统支持横向、后向和弱脚踢球等单一前向参考无法表达的动作；报告了射击精度，以及在挂载完整技能库时的指令跟踪、地形和推力恢复结果，这是以往人形足球系统未报告的维度。技能库在硬件上通过前向、横向、后向及指令化接近方式验证。
AI.conclusion: 以通用命令条件化 locomotion 为基底、叠加任务门控踢球技能的架构，可扩展可命令步态空间、简化技能组合，并提升击球后稳定性；在Unitree G1上验证了多方向踢球与鲁棒运动能力。

title: Vision-Language-Action Autonomous Driving Agent with Language-based Memory
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) foundation models have recently emerged as one of the prevailing solutions for autonomous driving, as they can utilize knowledge acquired during vision-language pretraining for accurate and interpretable driving. However, VLAs can take only a limited number of frames as visual input due to the high token cost of an image, which is problematic for memory-dependent tasks such as determining the arrival order at all-way stops and long-horizon driving scene understanding. Existing solutions use latent vector memories accessed through cross-attention, which are neither interpretable nor portable. In this paper, we propose AD-Memo, a general-purpose VLA driving agent with language-based memory. The agent outputs memory as an extension of its Chain-of-Thought (CoT) to record surrounding objects critical to driving; this memory becomes part of the agent's future input. We curate memory-based datasets and train VLAs with a two-stage recipe: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and \textit{Da Capo}, a novel semi-closed-loop Reinforcement Learning (RL) algorithm which uses trajectory-level advantage for memory and step-level advantage for driving, leading to better credit assignment. Across scenarios such as all-way stops and general driving, AD-Memo improves driving quality, enables better question answering on driving scenes, and produces plug-and-play memory for other models.

AI.tldr: 提出AD-Memo，一种基于语言记忆的通用VLA驾驶智能体，通过将记忆作为思维链扩展输出，并采用SFT和Da Capo强化学习两阶段训练，提升驾驶质量和场景问答能力。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型因图像token成本高只能处理有限帧，难以应对需要记忆的任务（如全向停车、长时驾驶场景理解）；现有潜在向量记忆方法不可解释且不便携。
AI.method: 提出AD-Memo，使用语言记忆作为CoT扩展记录关键周围物体，并作为未来输入；构建记忆数据集；两阶段训练：有监督微调（SFT）和Da Capo半闭环强化学习算法，分别对记忆使用轨迹级优势、对驾驶使用步级优势进行信用分配。
AI.result: 在全向停车和一般驾驶等场景中，AD-Memo提升了驾驶质量，改善了驾驶场景问答性能，并能为其他模型提供即插即用的记忆。
AI.conclusion: AD-Memo通过语言记忆和两阶段训练有效解决了VLA在记忆依赖任务上的局限，实现了可解释、可移植的记忆，并提升了驾驶表现。

title: Unveiling the Value of Motion for Cinematic Camera Trajectories
summary: Cinematic camera motion is a fundamental storytelling tool, defined not only by where the camera is positioned in the scene, but also by how it moves in terms of direction and speed. Recent work on camera trajectory generation and alignment to text relies on pose-centric representations. While in principle a network could derive direction of movement and speed, we find that in practice this might not happen. In fact, in this paper we discover that decomposing the camera trajectory representation from the traditional per-frame poses to direction and speed has surprising benefits across multiple tasks, including trajectory-to-text alignment as well as text-to-trajectory generation. To accurately evaluate the former, we introduce a simple and reliable protocol that overcomes the limitations of prior evaluation baselines.
