For the latter, building on this representational insight, we propose a novel generative model for camera trajectories, CineGEN, that achieves superior performance across a variety of metrics. We also propose a novel dataset, CineScript, containing movie clips that are enriched with scene descriptions as well as higher-level metadata. This novel data allows us to test models' ability to capture high-level cinematographic information. We show that, despite its simplicity, representing camera trajectories through direction and speed not only helps numerically to achieve better alignment and generation, but also inherently encodes complex directorial intent.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现，将相机轨迹表示从传统的逐帧姿态分解为方向和速度，可在轨迹-文本对齐与文本-轨迹生成任务中带来显著收益；为此提出评估协议、生成模型 CineGEN 和新数据集 CineScript。
AI.motivation: 电影相机运动是核心叙事工具，不仅取决于相机位置，还取决于运动方向与速度。现有相机轨迹生成与文本对齐工作依赖以姿态为中心的表示，但实际中网络未必能有效推导出方向与速度，因此需要更合适的表示与评估方法。
AI.method: 提出将相机轨迹表示从逐帧姿态分解为方向与速度；设计简单可靠的轨迹-文本对齐评估协议；基于该表示提出生成模型 CineGEN；并构建 CineScript 数据集，包含电影片段、场景描述及更高层元数据。
AI.result: 方向和速度表示在多个指标上提升了轨迹-文本对齐和文本-轨迹生成性能；CineGEN 在多种指标上表现优越；新评估协议克服了先前基线的局限；CineScript 可测试模型捕获高层电影信息的能力。
AI.conclusion: 尽管表示简单，方向和速度不仅能在数值上改善对齐与生成，还天然编码了复杂的导演意图，说明该表示对电影相机轨迹任务具有重要价值。

title: Plan-Conditioned Imitation for Robust Object Retrieval under Self-Occlusion in Dense Clutter
summary: Retrieving objects from dense clutter requires rearrangement during which the manipulator can occlude objects while moving them. Repeated arm withdrawals to restore visibility interrupt execution. We introduce TRACE, a plan-conditioned imitation framework for retrieval under self-occlusion. A single unoccluded observation initializes a digital twin, where a privileged teacher generates a fixed nominal rollout. A recurrent student combines local rollout context, partial object observations, and proprioception to select actions that can correct deviations from the prediction. Behavior cloning initializes the student; DAgger refines it with teacher labels on student-visited states. The rollout remains fixed throughout execution, so the deployed student needs neither online teacher queries nor additional simulator rollouts during pushing. On 511 simulation test scenes, TRACE achieves 90.7% success versus 43.4% for nominal replay and 96.7% for the privileged closed-loop teacher. At a matched 26,373-label budget, student-state supervision achieves 87.8% versus 66.7% for expert-only cloning, demonstrating gains beyond additional labels. On a UR5e, TRACE achieves 90.0% success versus 95.0% for the closed-loop teacher, while reducing total execution time from 192.7 s to 67.3 s. It avoids the teacher's 16.8 sensing-related arm retractions per trial during pushing, retaining a final withdrawal for graspability evaluation. Code and data will be released at: https://trace-retrieval.github.io.

AI.tldr: TRACE 是一个面向自遮挡下密集杂乱物体抓取的计划条件模仿学习框架：用一次无遮挡观测初始化数字孪生，由特权教师生成固定标称轨迹，再训练循环学生模型在无需在线教师查询或额外仿真推演的情况下纠偏执行。
AI.motivation: 在密集杂乱环境中取物需要推挤重排，但机械臂移动时会遮挡物体；为避免遮挡而反复撤回机械臂会打断执行、降低效率。
AI.method: TRACE 先用单个无遮挡观测构建数字孪生，由特权教师生成固定标称 rollout。学生模型为循环网络，输入局部 rollout 上下文、部分物体观测和本体感觉，输出可纠正偏差的动作。训练先用行为克隆初始化，再用 DAgger 在学生访问状态上由教师标注精炼。执行时 rollout 固定，学生无需在线教师查询或额外仿真 rollout。
AI.result: 在 511 个仿真测试场景中，TRACE 成功率为 90.7%，高于标称重放的 43.4%，低于特权闭环教师的 96.7%。在 26,373 标签预算下，学生状态监督达到 87.8%，优于仅专家克隆的 66.7%，说明增益来自监督状态而非仅增加标签。在 UR5e 上，TRACE 成功率为 90.0%，教师为 95.0%，但总执行时间从 192.7 秒降至 67.3 秒，并避免教师每轮约 16.8 次与感知相关的机械臂撤回，仅保留最后一次撤回用于可抓取性评估。
AI.conclusion: TRACE 能在自遮挡和密集杂乱取物中实现高效、稳健的模仿执行，显著减少因恢复可见性导致的机械臂撤回，并在无需在线教师或额外仿真推演的情况下接近特权教师性能。代码和数据将发布。

title: Efficient Multi-Modal Planning with Reward-Guided Preference Optimization for Autonomous Driving
summary: Safe and efficient trajectory planning is essential in autonomous driving. However, existing end-to-end approaches often fall short in both computational efficiency and safety guarantees. Methods based on imitation learning suffer from causal confusion, while rule-based scoring approaches often incur heavy computational overhead and suffer from objective misalignment. Additionally, preference-based methods rely on strict pairwise annotations, limiting data utilization. To overcome these limitations, we propose EMPlan, an efficient multi-modal trajectory planning method powered by reward-guided fine-tuning. We design a hybrid architecture that combines sparse anchors with an offset refinement module for efficient multi-modal trajectory prediction. Sparse anchors provide coarse trajectory candidates with low latency, which are subsequently refined by the offset module for higher prediction accuracy. To enhance safety without incurring additional inference costs, we adopt a two-stage training paradigm consisting of pretraining and reward-guided fine-tuning. During fine-tuning, we leverage rule-based reward signals and unpaired preference supervision to refine the pretrained policy toward safer trajectory selection. We evaluate EMPlan on the non-reactive NAVSIM benchmark, where it strikes a favorable balance between planning accuracy and efficiency, demonstrating superior performance under real-time constraints.

AI.tldr: 提出EMPlan，一种基于奖励引导微调的高效多模态轨迹规划方法，用于自动驾驶，在效率与安全之间取得平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有端到端方法计算效率和安全保证不足：模仿学习存在因果混淆，规则评分方法计算开销大且目标错位，偏好方法依赖严格成对标注，限制数据利用。
AI.method: 设计稀疏锚点与偏移细化模块结合的混合架构，先以低延迟稀疏锚点生成粗轨迹候选，再通过偏移模块细化；采用预训练加奖励引导微调的两阶段训练，利用规则奖励信号和非配对偏好监督优化轨迹选择。
AI.result: 在非反应式NAVSIM基准上评估，EMPlan在规划精度和效率之间取得良好平衡，并在实时约束下表现出优越性能。
AI.conclusion: EMPlan能在不增加额外推理成本的情况下增强安全性，适用于实时自动驾驶轨迹规划，有效兼顾准确性与效率。

title: Learning to Route in Visual Space via Multi-Step Embedding Retrieval
summary: LLM agents rely on retrieval tools to access external knowledge, yet visual agentic search remains severely bottlenecked by standard single-step retrievers. In current pipelines, the agent must issue text queries for every intermediate step, struggling when visual clues are difficult to describe or when the retriever fails to surface necessary intermediate evidence within its top results. We hypothesize that offloading multi-step navigation across the entire embedding space directly to the retrieval tool resolves this performance bottleneck. To study this systematically, we introduce VHOP, a flexible data generation framework and benchmark with five core difficulty levels testing both visual matching and search planning. Using this framework, we develop VHOP-Router, an end-to-end training pipeline---combining supervised fine-tuning, online imitation learning, and reinforcement learning---that transforms a standard embedding model into an autoregressive multi-step retriever. Operating directly in the visual latent space, VHOP-Router retrieves linked image chains in a single tool call without requiring the agent to formulate intermediate text queries. Experiments show VHOP-Router boosts retrieval performance from under 5\% to 76.3\%. In agentic search, it improves task success rates by 52.7\% and reduces the average token length by 61\% from 1886 to 728, whereas upgrading the agent yields only a 3.7\% gain. Compared to a strong baseline where the agent retrieves the top 50 results per step, VHOP-Router maintains superior performance while reducing in-context images by $23\times$ and cutting the cumulative API payload by $35\times$. The models also generalize robustly to unseen difficulty levels and realistic test sets. Ultimately, VHOP and VHOP-Router provide an efficient and effective solution for visual agentic search that leaves native LLM capabilities entirely intact.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 VHOP 基准与 VHOP-Router，将多步视觉检索能力从 LLM agent 卸载到检索工具，通过端到端训练把嵌入模型变为自回归多步检索器，显著提升视觉代理搜索的效果与效率。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉代理搜索受限于单步检索器：agent 每步都需发出文本查询，难以描述视觉线索或在上位结果中获取必要中间证据，形成性能瓶颈。作者假设应把整个嵌入空间上的多步导航直接交给检索工具完成。
AI.method: 引入 VHOP 数据生成框架与基准，包含五个核心难度级别，测试视觉匹配和搜索规划；提出 VHOP-Router，结合监督微调、在线模仿学习和强化学习，将标准嵌入模型训练为自回归多步检索器，直接在视觉潜空间中以一次工具调用检索链接图像链，无需中间文本查询。
AI.result: VHOP-Router 将检索性能从低于 5% 提升至 76.3%；在代理搜索中任务成功率提升 52.7%，平均 token 长度减少 61%，从 1886 降至 728；相比仅升级 agent 只带来 3.7% 增益；相比每步检索 top 50 的强基线，保持更优性能同时将上下文图像减少 23 倍、累计 API 负载减少 35 倍，并能泛化到未见难度和真实测试集。
AI.conclusion: VHOP 和 VHOP-Router 为视觉代理搜索提供了高效且有效的解决方案，同时完全保留原生 LLM 能力。

title: EPIC: Epipolar-Consistent 360° Immersive Stereo Video Generation
summary:
Immersive displays can enable rich and diverse virtual experiences. Manually authoring every possible experience to realize this potential, however, is prohibitively expensive, difficult to scale, and impractical. Generative AI models could remove this bottleneck, but today's models are built for conventional displays and cannot generate the high-resolution, stereoscopic $360^\circ$ content required for immersive viewing. Further, temporal and stereo inconsistencies that may be tolerable on conventional displays can become highly disruptive when viewed through an immersive headset.
  Here, we address this gap with a zero-shot generative pipeline that extends existing video diffusion models into 4K stereoscopic $360^\circ$ videos. Inspired from binocular vision and depth perception, we develop an epipolar-aware $360^\circ$ image matching metric that captures the temporal and stereo geometric inconsistencies across views. We then use this metric as a preference signal for direct preference optimization with limited training data. Our work enables $360^\circ$ stereo video generation and provides a scalable path for bringing generative content to immersive displays, allowing diverse mixed reality experiences on demand.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种零样本生成流程，将现有视频扩散模型扩展到4K立体360°视频，通过极线感知匹配指标和直接偏好优化，实现沉浸式立体360°视频生成。
AI.motivation: 手动创作沉浸式虚拟体验成本高、难扩展且不现实；现有生成模型面向传统显示，无法生成沉浸式观看所需的高分辨率立体360°内容；且传统显示可容忍的时空和立体不一致在头显中会变得非常明显。
AI.method: 受双目视觉和深度感知启发，提出极线感知的360°图像匹配度量，用于捕捉跨视角的时空与立体几何不一致；将该度量作为偏好信号，在有限训练数据下进行直接偏好优化；构建零样本生成流程以扩展视频扩散模型。
AI.result: 实现了360°立体视频生成，能够生成4K立体360°内容，并缓解沉浸式观看中的时空与立体不一致问题。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为将生成式内容引入沉浸式显示提供了可扩展路径，支持按需生成多样化的混合现实体验。

title: Benchmarking and Enhancing Skill-Level Memory for Partially Observable Robotic Manipulation
summary: Recent advances in robot learning have enabled manipulation policies to perform increasingly diverse tasks and generalize across environments. However, reliable execution often depends on hidden task states that cannot be determined from current observations alone, making interaction history essential. We introduce $HIDE$, a benchmark for evaluating manipulation memory under partial observability. HIDE comprises 15 tasks covering repetition counting, historical-state recall, and execution-progress tracking, with randomized initial configurations and decision points where similar observations require different actions depending on prior events. We further propose $SEEK$, a framework combining three complementary memory mechanisms to retain historical evidence and track execution state. Evaluations reveal substantial limitations in existing policies on HIDE, while memory augmentation improves task success in both simulation and real-world experiments. Individual mechanisms benefit some tasks but can degrade others; their combination achieves the highest average success rate on HIDE among the evaluated configurations. These findings highlight the importance of maintaining internal representations of hidden task states and matching memory design to task-specific information requirements.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 HIDE 基准，用于评估部分可观测条件下的机器人操作记忆能力，并提出 SEEK 框架，通过组合三种记忆机制来保留历史证据并跟踪执行状态。
AI.motivation: 机器人操作策略虽日益多样且泛化，但可靠执行常依赖无法仅从当前观测推断的隐藏任务状态，因此需要依赖交互历史。
AI.method: 构建 HIDE 基准，包含 15 个任务，覆盖重复计数、历史状态回忆和执行进度跟踪，并设置随机初始配置及相似观测下需不同动作的决策点；提出 SEEK 框架，结合三种互补记忆机制。
AI.result: 现有策略在 HIDE 上表现明显不足；记忆增强在仿真和真实实验中均提升任务成功率；单一记忆机制对部分任务有益但可能损害其他任务，而组合机制在评估配置中取得最高平均成功率。
AI.conclusion: 维护隐藏任务状态的内部表征很重要，且记忆设计需与任务特定信息需求相匹配。

title: Self-Evolving Algorithm-Design Agents: Escaping In-Context Evolutionary Stagnation via Population-Curated Policy Optimization
summary: Large language models are increasingly participating in complex real-world tasks in the form of algorithm-design agents, designing and refining algorithms. Many successful algorithm-design agents adopt pure in-context evolutionary frameworks, but they may quickly plateau in domains that require specialized knowledge. Parametric adaptation offers a way to internalize specialized knowledge, but conventional training requires abundant domain-specific corpora while high-quality algorithms are scarce in complex algorithm-design scenarios. In this paper, we propose sample-efficient parametric self-evolution where agents can explore and learn from self-generated algorithms. First, we characterize in-context evolutionary stagnation and analytically propose the Improvement Chain proposition, showing how learning successive self-generated algorithms can locally increase the likelihood of neighboring algorithms. Motivated by this local-transfer perspective, we further propose Population-Curated Policy Optimization (PCPO) to utilize a global population and a hybrid policy update scheme for retaining and reusing high-quality, diverse self-generated algorithms, shifting the policy towards stronger algorithms. In the task of learning rate schedule design for global placement in electronic design automation, trained only on 4 chip cases, PCPO outperforms the state-of-the-art in-context evolutionary methods (e.g., OpenEvolve and ShinkaEvolve) on average across 16 chip cases. With an 8B-size base model, PCPO achieves competitive performance compared to frontier closed-source models such as GPT-5.5. PCPO also reduces inference-time token cost by internalizing grounded domain knowledge and prompt distillation. Moreover, PCPO achieves significant speedups on four GPU kernel designs, with an average of 8.27$\times$ speedup against the PyTorch Eager baseline.

AI.tldr: 论文提出样本高效参数自进化与PCPO，使算法设计智能体能从自生成算法中学习，在EDA学习率调度和GPU内核设计任务上超越上下文进化方法。
AI.motivation: 纯上下文进化式算法设计智能体在需要专门知识的领域容易停滞；传统参数适应虽可内化知识，但依赖大量领域语料，而复杂算法设计场景中高质量算法稀缺。
AI.method: 先刻画上下文进化停滞，提出Improvement Chain命题；进而提出Population-Curated Policy Optimization（PCPO），利用全局种群和混合策略更新方案，保留并复用高质量、多样化的自生成算法，使策略向更强算法偏移，并内化领域知识、进行提示蒸馏。
AI.result: 在电子设计自动化全局布局的学习率调度任务中，仅用4个芯片案例训练，PCPO在16个芯片案例上平均优于OpenEvolve、ShinkaEvolve等SOTA上下文进化方法；8B基础模型达到接近GPT-5.5等前沿闭源模型的性能，并降低推理token成本；在四个GPU内核设计上平均取得8.27倍于PyTorch Eager基线的加速。
AI.conclusion: 样本高效参数自进化能让智能体从自生成算法中有效学习，在少样本条件下获得强算法设计能力，并同时提升性能、泛化能力和推理效率。

title: Scaling Parameter and Context in Attention: Native Sparse Attention from Mixture-of-Head
summary: Scaling attention parameters can improve language model quality, but retaining full token histories makes additional heads costly at long contexts. Furthermore, since attention retrieves and combines contextual information, parameter scaling should also support longer contexts. We therefore ask whether attention parameter scaling can directly enable efficient and effective context scaling. We introduce NAMOH, an architecture-native sparse attention mechanism that activates $K$ of $H$ heads per token. Each head retains only its assigned tokens and performs causal attention within this subsequence. Head selection thus jointly determines active parameters and available context without scanning the full history. Under balanced assignments, increasing $H$ at fixed $K$ shortens head histories and reduces per-token key-value (KV) access without increasing total KV storage. We further support head-relative rotary position embeddings to shorten positional spans within routed subsequences, aiming to mitigate position-induced attention noise. Experiments show that NAMOH can outperform fully activated models with the same total parameters, while enabling more efficient long-context inference than smaller dense models with matched active parameter counts. It remains compatible with GQA and existing sparse attention mechanisms. We hope this work offers a new path for scaling attention, with parameter scaling directly enabling context scaling.

AI.tldr: NAMOH是一种原生稀疏注意力机制，每个token仅激活H个头中的K个，每个头只关注其分配的子序列，从而在参数缩放的同时实现高效的长上下文缩放，提升推理效率。
AI.motivation: 缩放注意力参数可提升语言模型质量，但保留完整token历史使额外头在长上下文下代价高昂；注意力检索并组合上下文信息，因此参数缩放也应支持更长上下文。研究是否注意力参数缩放能直接实现高效且有效的上下文缩放。
AI.method: 提出NAMOH，架构原生稀疏注意力，每个token激活K/H个头。每个头仅保留分配token并在子序列内做因果注意力。头选择决定活跃参数和可用上下文，无需扫描完整历史。均衡分配下，固定K增加H可缩短头历史并减少每token的KV访问，且不增加总KV存储。支持头相对旋转位置嵌入，缩短路由子序列内的位置跨度，缓解位置引起的注意力噪声。兼容GQA和现有稀疏注意力。
AI.result: 实验表明NAMOH在相同总参数下优于全激活模型，且相比匹配活跃参数量的更小密集模型，能实现更高效的长上下文推理。与GQA和现有稀疏注意力兼容。
AI.conclusion: 为注意力缩放提供了新路径，使参数缩放直接支持上下文缩放。

title: PathAnchor: Path-Structured Evidence for Scientific Agents
summary: Scientific agents can retrieve relevant passages yet still lose functional order, mix evidence across sources, or state conclusions that exceed the retrieved record. We introduce PathAnchor, a bounded scientific reasoning system built on path-structured evidence workspaces. Instead of treating passages or extracted concepts as independent units, the system retrieves source-linked Material-Sensor-Signal-System trajectories that preserve role, direction, and the evidence supporting each transition. A controller uses three read-only tools to search paper-specific trajectories, trace paths across candidate sources, and open exact evidence before producing a claim-cited answer and an explicit evidence boundary. On 120 single- and cross-paper flexible-sensor questions, PathAnchor scores 82.6% and leads six evaluated systems. Under a matched controller, corpus, and six-call budget, replacing unordered concept graphs with path-structured records raises source recall from 61.3% to 82.9%, increases answers whose claims all cite opened evidence from 69.2% to 90.0%, and reduces tool calls. These results show that evidence organization affects retrieval and citation completeness under fixed agent resources.

AI.tldr: 提出 PathAnchor，一种基于路径结构化证据工作区的有界科学推理系统，用于提升科学问答中的检索、引用完整性和证据边界控制。
AI.motivation: 科学智能体虽能检索相关段落，但仍会丢失功能顺序、混合不同来源证据，或得出超出检索记录的结论。
AI.method: PathAnchor 不将段落或概念视为独立单元，而是检索保留角色、方向和转换证据的来源关联 Material-Sensor-Signal-System 轨迹。控制器通过三个只读工具搜索论文特定轨迹、跨候选来源追踪路径并打开精确证据，最终生成带引用的答案和明确证据边界。
AI.result: 在 120 个单论文和跨论文柔性传感器问题上，PathAnchor 得分 82.6%，领先六个评估系统。在匹配控制器、语料和六次调用预算下，用路径结构化记录替代无序概念图，将来源召回率从 61.3% 提升至 82.9%，使所有主张均引用已打开证据的答案比例从 69.2% 提升至 90.0%，并减少工具调用。
AI.conclusion: 在固定智能体资源下，证据组织方式会影响检索效果和引用完整性。

title: PRICE the Action Chunks: Physical Relational Credit Assignment for Embodied Reinforcement Learning
summary: Outcome-based reinforcement learning (RL) post-trains vision--language--action policies using terminal success signals, but assigns the same trajectory-level advantage to every action chunk. A failed episode can thus penalize useful early actions as if they caused the failure. Existing approaches seek finer-grained feedback through learned evaluators, adding task-specific supervision or additional model training. We explore, for the first time to our knowledge, whether physical relations across trajectories can provide action-chunk credit in embodied RL from terminal outcomes alone, without an auxiliary evaluator. The key insight is that rollouts reaching corresponding physical situations can serve as references for one another: their terminal outcomes provide evidence for assessing local progress. We introduce Physical Relations for Inferring Credit from Episodes(PRICE), with two components: (i) a physical relational graph that pools current and historical outcomes at corresponding chunk boundaries to estimate success potentials; and (ii) confidence-gated credit assignment that uses changes in these potentials to refine trajectory-level supervision. Our analysis connects oracle potential changes to the terminal-success objective and provides a finite-sample directional bound for outcome-independent evidence pools. Independent continuation tests show that PRICE's retained credits align with local progress, while experiments on LIBERO, RoboTwin 2.0, and real robots demonstrate improved task success over outcome-based baselines and faster learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PRICE，一种仅利用终端成功信号，通过跨轨迹的物理关系为动作块推断信用分配的具身强化学习方法，无需额外评估器。
AI.motivation: 现有基于结果强化学习将轨迹级优势统一分配给每个动作块，失败轨迹中早期有效动作会被误罚；已有细粒度反馈方法往往需要任务特定监督或额外模型训练。
AI.method: PRICE包含两部分：(i) 物理关系图，在对应动作块边界汇总当前与历史结果以估计成功潜力；(ii) 置信门控信用分配，利用潜力变化细化轨迹级监督。理论上连接了oracle潜力变化与终端成功目标，并为结果无关证据池提供有限样本方向界。
AI.result: 独立延续测试表明PRICE保留的信用与局部进展一致；在LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0和真实机器人实验中，任务成功率优于基于结果的基线，且学习更快。
AI.conclusion: 跨轨迹物理关系可为仅依赖终端结果的具身强化学习提供动作块信用，而无需辅助评估器，从而提升细粒度信用分配与学习效率。

title: Where MLLMs Fail and Why: Causal Task Decomposition for Capability Failure Diagnosis
summary: End-to-end accuracy on compositional tasks records how often MLLMs fail, but cannot distinguish whether a failure reflects an intrinsic deficit in the targeted capability or a cascading error from an upstream prerequisite. We propose a causal decomposition framework that isolates these two failure modes through controlled interventions on the prerequisite dependencies of each task. Our capability metrics (NC, IC, RC) score each task under unassisted, correct, or incorrect prerequisites to diagnose where failures arise; contribution metrics (N-Score, S-Score), adapted from probabilities of causation, quantify each prerequisite's necessity and sufficiency to determine why. We instantiate the framework in CADET, a diagnostic benchmark of 10 composite tasks decomposed into 46 unit tasks with over 33,000 human-annotated questions spanning perception, spatial, temporal, and cognitive categories. Diagnosing frontier MLLMs with our framework uncovers systematic patterns that end-to-end accuracy obscures. Capability-wise, supplying correct prerequisites eliminates 54\% of errors on cognitive tasks, lifting them from weakest to above spatial and temporal. Prerequisite-wise, causal contributions are concentrated in a few critical prerequisites, and supplying the single most important one alone captures 84\% of the gain from supplying all prerequisites.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种因果分解框架，用于区分多模态大模型在组合任务中的失败是目标能力本身缺陷，还是上游前置能力错误导致的级联失败，并构建了 CADET 诊断基准。
AI.motivation: 端到端准确率只能记录多模态大模型在组合任务上是否失败，无法判断失败源于目标能力的内在不足，还是上游前置依赖错误引发的级联错误，因此需要更细粒度的诊断方法。
AI.method: 提出因果分解框架，通过对任务前置依赖进行受控干预来隔离两类失败模式。使用能力指标 NC、IC、RC 分别评估无辅助、正确前置、错误前置下的任务表现；使用贡献指标 N-Score 和 S-Score 量化各前置条件的必要性与充分性。实例化为 CADET 基准，包含 10 个组合任务、46 个单元任务、超过 33,000 个人工标注问题，覆盖感知、空间、时间和认知类别。
AI.result: 对前沿多模态大模型的诊断揭示了端到端准确率掩盖的系统性模式。能力方面，提供正确前置条件可消除认知任务中 54% 的错误，使其从最弱类别提升到高于空间和时间类别。前置条件方面，因果贡献集中在少数关键前置条件上，仅提供最重要的单个前置条件即可获得提供全部前置条件所带来的 84% 的增益。
AI.conclusion: 该因果分解框架能够诊断组合任务失败的来源，区分内在能力缺陷与级联错误，并揭示传统端到端准确率无法呈现的模型能力与前置依赖贡献模式。

title: No Corners Cut: State-Grounded Transitions for Mid-Stream Prompt Switches in Video Generation
summary: Streaming video generators allow users to dynamically modulate video synthesis via mid-stream prompt switching. Existing streaming methods can respond to the updated instruction while still cutting corners, prematurely realizing goals or taking heuristic shortcuts that bypass necessary intermediate state changes needed for a plausible transition. In this study, we present SEGUE, a novel framework that makes this process explicit and trains the generator to execute these transitions faithfully. At each switch, a training-free planner parses the latest frame and prompts, writes a few segue prompts with roles and durations, and then hands control back to the user's prompt. Furthermore, to address the inherent difficulty of training causal models on short-lived temporal schedules without corrupting preparatory supervision, we introduce SPANDMD, which evaluates each active prompt using the full rollout as temporal context while retaining its DMD residual only within the prompt's assigned span. On OpenTrans-360, a benchmark of 1,800 switches that scores how the old state exits and the new one begins, SEGUE ranks first on all eight transition metrics and raises the overall score over the strongest baseline from 0.866 to 0.887. It also ranks first on four of six instruction-response metrics of StreamAV-Bench, while the planner transfers to frozen autoregressive generators without retraining.

AI.tldr: 提出流式视频生成框架 SEGUE，通过训练无关规划器在中途提示切换时显式生成过渡提示，并用 SPANDMD 训练生成器忠实执行状态转换，在多个基准上取得领先效果。
AI.motivation: 现有流式视频生成方法虽能响应中途更新的提示，但容易走捷径，过早实现目标或跳过合理过渡所需的中间状态变化，导致切换不自然。
AI.method: 在每个提示切换点，使用训练无关规划器解析最新帧和提示，生成带角色与持续时间的若干 segue 提示，再交还用户提示控制；同时提出 SPANDMD，在完整 rollout 作为时间上下文下评估每个活跃提示，但仅在提示指定区间内保留 DMD 残差，以训练因果模型处理短时时间安排且不破坏预备监督。
AI.result: 在包含 1,800 次切换的 OpenTrans-360 基准上，SEGUE 在全部八项过渡指标上排名第一，总体分数从最强基线的 0.866 提升至 0.887；在 StreamAV-Bench 的六项指令响应指标中四项排名第一，且规划器无需重训练即可迁移到冻结的自回归生成器。
AI.conclusion: SEGUE 能显式建模并忠实执行流式视频生成中的中途提示切换，其规划器与 SPANDMD 训练策略有效且具有可迁移性。

title: GraphForge: Training Working Agents with Graph-Anchored Workspace Synthesis
summary: Working agents need to read diverse files, coordinate tools, and produce deliverables. Training such agents requires tasks built on many real files with verifiable results, but few pipelines exist to synthesize this kind of data. Existing pipelines either generate files with models, which lack realism and diversity, or build tasks on real files without task-specific verifiers, leaving result quality unchecked. We introduce GraphForge, an evidence-graph based framework that grounds both the task and its verification in real files. Starting from occupation-grounded seeds for controlled diversity, GraphForge assembles a workspace of real files for each seed and builds an evidence graph over their relations. Since the task statement and rubrics are both derived from this graph, task requirements are backed by the workspace files and each criterion is anchored to the files needed to verify it. An initial rollout further tests executability, and a revision agent repairs the task and rubrics against the original files before trajectories are collected. Fine-tuning Qwen3.6-27B on 2,169 GraphForge trajectories brings GDPVal to 1445.7 (+65.7) under OpenHands, and Workspace-Bench-Lite and SpreadsheetBench II to 63.7 (+7.7) and 24.0 (+13.7) under Claude Code. Rejection fine-tuning on the SFT model's own rollouts, with candidates selected by the evidence-anchored rubrics, yields further improvements on all three benchmarks, suggesting that the rubrics provide a useful selection signal. The data and models are available.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 GraphForge，一个基于证据图的框架，以真实文件为基础同时构建任务与验证标准，用于合成可验证的智能体训练数据，并显著提升多个基准表现。
AI.motivation: 训练能读写多种文件、协调工具并产出交付物的智能体，需要大量基于真实文件且结果可验证的任务数据；但现有流程要么用模型生成文件（缺乏真实性与多样性），要么基于真实文件却缺少针对任务的验证器，导致结果质量无法保证。
AI.method: GraphForge 从职业相关的种子出发保证多样性，为每个种子组装真实文件工作区，并在文件关系上构建证据图；任务描述与评分标准均由图导出，使任务要求有工作区文件支撑、每条标准都锚定到可验证所需文件。随后通过初始 rollout 检验可执行性，并由修订智能体对照原始文件修复任务与评分标准，再收集轨迹。此外，用证据锚定评分标准从 SFT 模型自身 rollout 中筛选候选进行拒绝微调。
AI.result: 在 2,169 条 GraphForge 轨迹上微调 Qwen3.6-27B：OpenHands 下 GDPVal 达 1445.7（+65.7）；Claude Code 下 Workspace-Bench-Lite 与 SpreadsheetBench II 分别达 63.7（+7.7）和 24.0（+13.7）。基于证据锚定评分标准筛选的拒绝微调在三个基准上进一步提升。
AI.conclusion: 证据图能够将任务与验证同时锚定在真实文件上，从而生成高质量可验证的训练数据；评分标准还可作为有效的候选选择信号，数据与模型已公开。

title: SCALE: Synthetic Calibration via Agreement Labeling in Embedding Space
summary: Foundation models for computational pathology are usually evaluated using AUC and accuracy, while calibration is often left untested. This matters because a model can be accurate on average but still assign overly confident probabilities to cases that are difficult even for pathologists. We study calibration across eight pathology foundation models. Using pathologist agreement as a measure of diagnostic difficulty, we find that calibration error is consistently higher on low-agreement cases than on high-agreement cases. This pattern is not apparent from aggregate expected calibration error (ECE) alone. We then propose synthetic agreement calibration, a method for improving calibration without collecting multi-annotator labels. Given a trained linear probe, we select high-confidence embeddings as class anchors and interpolate between anchors from opposite classes. The interpolation weights encode a continuous notion of diagnostic ambiguity, which we use as a synthetic agreement signal to retrain the probe with agreement-aware label smoothing. On MHIST, which includes annotations from seven pathologists, synthetic agreement calibration recovers most of the calibration improvement obtained by label smoothing based on real pathologist agreement, while substantially reducing low-agreement ECE relative to the uncalibrated baseline. Discrimination metrics are preserved. On PatchCamelyon and BreakHis, public histopathology datasets without multi-annotator labels, the method improves calibration across the evaluated foundation models, whereas annotator-dependent approaches cannot be used without additional expert annotation.

AI.tldr: 该研究关注病理基础模型的校准问题，发现低病理医生一致性病例的校准误差更高，并提出无需多标注者标签的合成一致性校准方法。
AI.motivation: 病理基础模型常以AUC和准确率评估，校准较少被检验；模型可能平均准确但对此困难病例过度自信，因此需要研究并改善校准。
AI.method: 评估八个病理基础模型的校准，以病理医生一致性衡量诊断难度；提出合成一致性校准：基于训练好的线性探针选择高置信嵌入作为类锚点，在异类锚点间插值，用插值权重编码诊断模糊性，作为合成一致性信号，结合一致性感知标签平滑重新训练探针。
AI.result: 低一致性病例的校准误差持续高于高一致性病例，且总体ECE无法体现该模式。在MHIST上，该方法恢复大部分基于真实病理医生一致性的标签平滑所带来的校准提升，并显著降低低一致性ECE，同时保持判别指标；在PatchCamelyon和BreakHis上也改善多个基础模型的校准。
AI.conclusion: 合成一致性校准可在不收集多标注者标签的情况下改善病理基础模型校准，尤其针对诊断困难病例，优于依赖额外专家标注的方法。

title: TRACE: Target-Aware Retrieval, Attributed Evidence, and Contract-Constrained Extraction for LitTraceQA
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at the 1st Workshop on Grounding Language Models: Learning Faithfully and Efficiently (GroundLM 2026), co-located with EMNLP 2026
summary: Finding a relevant paper is not the same as producing a verifiable answer from it. LitTraceQA requires canonical paper identifiers, exact evidence at the page or object level, and typed answers that match the evaluator. We call the separation between source access and scorer-visible correctness the grounding contract gap. TRACE - Target-Aware Retrieval, Attributed Evidence, and Contract-Constrained Extraction - addresses this gap with target-grouped retrieval, independent typed evidence localization, multimodal table extraction, schema-driven table construction, and fail-closed validation. It indexes 27,487 papers through passage, object, alias, citation, and dense representations while retaining the question target behind each signal. For tables, TRACE predicts the observation unit before extracting values and assembles rows with evaluator-compatible key normalization. Our audited selected clean-track artifact scores 0.760613 on the official 71-question test set, including 0.9728 paper F1, 0.6847 evidence F1, 0.9800 multiple-choice accuracy, 0.5423 table-row F1, and 0.3508 macro cell accuracy. On 11 public-development table records, a clean baseline and coordinate-aware visual fill obtain row F1 of 0.291 and 0.411, respectively; this diagnostic comparison includes fallback outputs and is not an official-test claim. Remaining errors chiefly concern locator, observation-unit, row-key, and source-value identity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TRACE 系统，用于弥合 LitTraceQA 中源访问与评分可见正确性之间的“grounding contract gap”，通过目标感知检索、证据定位和契约约束抽取，在官方 71 题测试集上总体得分为 0.760613。
AI.motivation: 找到相关论文不等于能从中产生可验证答案；LitTraceQA 要求规范论文标识、页面或对象级精确证据、以及与评测器匹配的类型化答案，源访问与评分可见正确性之间存在差距。
AI.method: TRACE 包含目标分组检索、独立类型化证据定位、多模态表格抽取、模式驱动表格构建和 fail-closed 验证；它通过 passage、object、alias、citation 和 dense 表示索引 27,487 篇论文，并保留每个信号背后的问题目标；表格方面先预测观察单元再抽取值，并以评测器兼容的键归一化组装行。
AI.result: 官方 71 题测试集得分为 0.760613，其中 paper F1 为 0.9728，evidence F1 为 0.6847，多选准确率为 0.9800，表格行 F1 为 0.5423，宏单元格准确率为 0.3508。在 11 条公开开发表格记录上，clean baseline 与坐标感知视觉填充的行 F1 分别为 0.291 和 0.411；该诊断比较包含 fallback 输出，并非官方测试结论。
AI.conclusion: 剩余错误主要涉及定位器、观察单元、行键和源值身份；TRACE 能缩小 grounding contract gap，但表格处理与证据定位仍是主要挑战。

title: Action Conditioned Bisimulation For GUI Agent Memory
summary: An agent that remembers what it did on a web page must decide when two pages count as the same. Memories built on observation similarity merge pages that look alike but behave differently, and GUIs are full of such pages: two tabs of one widget or two rows of one menu answer the same click differently. We define the merge rule as an action-conditioned bisimulation over the empirical predictive state graph a frozen agent fills as it acts. Two states merge only when their shared actions lead to agreeing outcomes and successor blocks under an affordance label. Observation similarity never enters the rule, and nothing is trained. It replaces the merge rule of an existing outcome-value memory, so a closed-loop comparison isolates it. On MiniWoB++ it raises success rate over a memoryless agent, while a control taking identical exploratory detours, the prior successor-representation merge, and the same criterion without action conditioning change nothing.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于动作条件双模拟的记忆合并规则，用于判断网页状态何时相同，不依赖观察相似度且无需训练，在 MiniWoB++ 上提升成功率。
AI.motivation: 基于观察相似度的记忆会把外观相似但行为不同的网页状态合并，而 GUI 中同一控件不同标签或菜单项等常表现出不同点击结果，因此需要更可靠的状态合并规则。
AI.method: 将合并规则定义为在冻结智能体行动时填充的经验预测状态图上的动作条件双模拟。仅当共享动作导致一致结果，并且在可供性标签下后继块一致时，才合并两个状态。观察相似度不进入规则，且不进行训练。该方法替换现有结果价值记忆的合并规则，通过闭环比较隔离其效果。
AI.result: 在 MiniWoB++ 上，相比无记忆智能体提高了成功率。采取相同探索绕路的对照、先前的后继表示合并方法、以及去掉动作条件的同一准则均未带来变化。
AI.conclusion: 动作条件双模拟能够有效合并网页状态并提升基于记忆的智能体表现；仅靠观察相似度或缺少动作条件的合并准则不足以解决该问题。

title: Persona and Persuasive Framing in AI Voice Agents: A $2\times2$ Field Experiment with Children
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at the 60th Hawaii International Conference on System Sciences (HICSS-60), 2027
summary: Conversational agents increasingly interact with children, yet evidence on how their design shapes children's susceptibility to persuasion comes almost entirely from the lab. We report a $2\times2$ randomized field experiment embedded in a public German Santa Claus telephone hotline. Children's calls were randomly routed to one of four LLM voice agents varying persona (Santa, high authority, vs. Helper, low authority) and framing (persuasive nudges toward prosocial wishes vs. neutral). Of 1,072 logged calls, 89 conversations (median age 6) met inclusion criteria. Persuasive framing raised the probability of a prosocial wish from 11.6% to 45.7%, robust to controls. Persona authority showed a near-zero effect: Santa did not outperform the Helper. Persona instead shaped engagement; children hung up on the Helper far more often within the first minute (65% vs. 39%). Where context already lends an agent legitimacy, how it speaks shapes children's compliance more than who it claims to be.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过在德国圣诞老人电话热线中嵌入2×2随机田野实验，检验LLM语音代理的人格设定与说服性框架如何影响儿童的说服易感性。
AI.motivation: 儿童越来越多地与对话代理互动，但关于代理设计如何影响儿童说服易感性的证据几乎都来自实验室，缺乏真实场景中的田野实验证据。
AI.method: 在公共德国圣诞老人电话热线中开展2×2随机田野实验，将儿童来电随机分配给四种LLM语音代理，操纵人格（圣诞老人=高权威 vs. 助手=低权威）和框架（说服性 nudges 引导亲社会愿望 vs. 中性）。共记录1,072通来电，其中89通对话符合纳入标准，中位年龄6岁。
AI.result: 说服性框架将儿童表达亲社会愿望的概率从11.6%提高到45.7%，且在控制变量下稳健。人格权威效应接近零：圣诞老人并不比助手更有效。人格主要影响参与度：儿童在助手条件下更常在前1分钟内挂断（65% vs. 39%）。
AI.conclusion: 当情境本身已赋予代理合法性时，代理如何说话比它声称自己是谁更能影响儿童顺从性。

title: SpatialCORE: Confidence-Aware Grounded Spatial Reasoning in Large Vision--Language Models
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have made remarkable progress across visual perception tasks, yet spatial reasoning remains a persistent weakness, especially for questions that require reasoning over visual space. Recent spatial-reasoning methods incorporate generated grounding, where models predict bounding boxes, masks, or other localization outputs for task-relevant objects as part of their reasoning trace. However, these approaches typically optimize final-answer correctness alone, allowing correct answers to be rewarded even when the model does not reason from confidently localized task-relevant objects. We introduce SpatialCORE (Spatially COnfident REasoning), a post-training framework that turns the model's own confidence in generated grounding into a learning signal for spatial reasoning. Its central idea is to reinforce grounding that is both accurate and confident, encouraging the model to reason from confidently localized task-relevant objects. SpatialCORE realizes this through a self-regulating spatial reward that weights each predicted bounding box's matching quality by its coordinate-token confidence. An answer gate further ties grounding optimization to final-answer correctness. SpatialCORE achieves state-of-the-art results among open-source and specialized spatial reasoning models across diverse benchmarks, and transfers effectively in zero-shot settings to unseen data distributions. The source code is available at https://github.com/rafiibnsultan/SpatialCORE.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 SpatialCORE，一种利用模型自身在生成式定位中的置信度作为空间推理学习信号的后训练框架，通过奖励既准确又高置信的定位来提升 LVLM 的空间推理能力。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型在视觉感知任务上进展显著，但空间推理仍是明显短板。现有引入生成式定位的方法通常只优化最终答案正确性，可能导致模型即使没有基于高置信定位的任务相关对象进行推理，也能因答案正确而获得奖励。
AI.method: SpatialCORE 将模型对生成定位的置信度转化为学习信号，设计自调节空间奖励：用坐标 token 置信度对预测边界框的匹配质量进行加权，从而强化既准确又高置信的定位。另设答案门控，将定位优化与最终答案正确性绑定。
AI.result: 在多个基准上，SpatialCORE 在开源模型和专门空间推理模型中取得最先进结果，并能零样本有效迁移到未见数据分布。
AI.conclusion: 通过让模型从高置信定位的任务相关对象出发进行推理，SpatialCORE 能有效提升空间推理性能，并展现出良好的泛化与迁移能力。

title: Local-Minimum Escaper: Programmatic Subgoal Generation for Robust Navigation in Unknown Environments
summary: Mapless navigation in unknown and partially observable environments remains challenging for mobile robots, particularly when local minima prevent the robot from making progress toward its goal. Existing local navigation methods often lack an explicit mechanism for escaping such situations, while deep reinforcement learning (DRL) approaches typically learn recovery behaviors implicitly through reward design and policy optimization. In this work, we propose \textbf{LME} (Local-Minimum Escaper), a programmatic hierarchical framework that explicitly generates and reasons subgoals to guide robots out of local-minimum regions. LME operates solely on local observations and selects candidate subgoals using interpretable heuristic criteria that account for both surrounding obstacle geometry and candidate-location safety. A local planner then generates low-level motion commands toward the selected subgoal. This design enables LME to handle environments both with and without local minima within a unified framework, while remaining independent of the underlying local planner and requiring no additional training. Extensive experiments in simulated and real-world environments demonstrate that LME provides robust navigation performance and generalizes to challenging unseen scenarios. Furthermore, the generated subgoals can be used to guide different local planners, substantially improving their ability to escape local minima. Successful deployments on both differential-drive and quadruped robots further demonstrate the practical applicability and generality of the proposed framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LME（Local-Minimum Escaper），一个程序化分层框架，通过显式生成并推理子目标，引导机器人在无地图、部分可观测环境中逃出局部极小值区域，并在仿真和真实环境中验证了其鲁棒性与泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 未知与部分可观测环境下的无地图导航仍具挑战性，尤其是局部极小值会使机器人无法继续朝目标前进。现有局部导航方法缺乏显式的逃逸机制，而深度强化学习方法只能通过奖励设计和策略优化隐式地学习恢复行为，因此需要一种无需训练、可解释且通用的显式逃逸方案。
AI.method: LME采用分层框架：仅依赖局部观测，使用可解释的启发式准则（同时考虑周围障碍物几何结构与候选位置安全性）来选择候选子目标；随后由局部规划器根据所选子目标生成底层运动指令。该框架与底层局部规划器解耦，无需额外训练，并可统一处理含或不含局部极小值的环境。
AI.result: 在仿真与真实环境中的大量实验表明，LME具有稳健的导航性能，并能泛化到未见过的挑战性场景；其生成的子目标可用于引导不同的局部规划器，显著提升它们逃出局部极小值的能力；并成功部署于差速驱动机器人与四足机器人上。
AI.conclusion: LME通过显式子目标生成与推理有效解决了无地图导航中的局部极小值问题，具备通用性、可解释性、规划器无关性与免训练特性，验证了其实际适用性与推广价值。

title: EmbodiRSI: Recursive Self-Improvement for Data-Efficient Robot Adaptation
summary: Adapting robot manipulation policies to new tasks and environments remains highly data-intensive, while the data needed for further improvement depends on the policy's current capabilities and failure modes. We introduce EmbodiRSI, an agentic system for recursive self-improvement (RSI) in a real-to-sim-to-real setting, where task-specific simulations are constructed from target deployment scenarios and used as low-cost environments for iterative policy improvement before transfer back to the physical world. EmbodiRSI uses policy execution feedback to guide subsequent experience acquisition and policy updates. Two complementary mechanisms close this loop: Collaborative Error Correction generates agent-assisted corrective trajectories from policy-reached states, while Adaptive Data Collection directs expert demonstration generation toward the current policy's weaknesses. The task-specific simulation serves as a reusable workspace for policy warm-up, repeatable evaluation, failure diagnosis, and targeted data generation across successive RSI rounds. Across three tabletop environments and 14 subtasks, EmbodiRSI increases scene-balanced autonomous simulation success from 50.4% to 83.5% over two RSI updates. With 400 adaptive simulated trajectories and only ten real-world refinement trajectories per subtask, EmbodiRSI achieves 83.1% scene-balanced autonomous real-world success, compared with 75.0% for adaptation using 200 real-world demonstrations per subtask. These results demonstrate that feedback-driven recursive improvement in deployment-specific simulations can enable data-efficient adaptation of embodied policies to physical environments.

AI.tldr: 提出 EmbodiRSI，一个在 real-to-sim-to-real 设置下进行递归自我改进的智能体系统。它根据部署场景构建任务专用仿真，并利用策略执行反馈指导经验获取和策略更新，从而实现数据高效的机器人操作策略适应。
AI.motivation: 机器人操作策略适应新任务和新环境高度依赖数据，而进一步提升所需的数据取决于策略当前能力与失败模式，因此需要一种能根据策略表现定向获取数据和改进策略的方法。
AI.method: EmbodiRSI 在任务专用仿真中进行策略预热、可重复评估、失败诊断和目标数据生成，并通过两个机制闭环：协同纠错从策略到达状态生成智能体辅助的纠正轨迹；自适应数据收集针对当前策略弱点生成专家示范。随后将改进策略迁移回真实世界。
AI.result: 在 3 个桌面环境和 14 个子任务中，EmbodiRSI 经过两次 RSI 更新将场景平衡的仿真自主成功率从 50.4% 提升到 83.5%；仅用每个子任务 400 条自适应仿真轨迹和 10 条真实世界精调轨迹，达到 83.1% 的场景平衡真实世界自主成功率，优于每个子任务使用 200 条真实示范的 75.0%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，在部署专用仿真中进行反馈驱动的递归改进，能够实现具身策略向物理环境的数据高效适应。

title: Hard-Region Supervision: #1 on the Waymo Open Dataset 2D Video Panoptic Segmentation Leaderboard
summary: We describe our winning entry to the Waymo Open Dataset 2D Video Panoptic Segmentation Challenge. The task asks for a semantic class at every pixel of every frame and, for countable objects, an identity that holds across 100 frames and across five overlapping cameras. We build on DVIS++, a cascade of a segmenter, a tracker, and a refiner, as our baseline. We propose hard region supervision (HRS) to improve the baseline. In particular, we use the baseline to define the hard region as where it makes mistakes, and design a loss and an auxiliary prediction head for this region. The auxiliary head is used only in training and removed at test time, so at inference the model trained with HRS has the same architecture as the baseline. In addition, we propose three test-time steps that further improve the results: a two-model ensemble, a merge of the segmenter's output into the final panoptic map, and cross-camera identity linking. On the challenge test set, our entry reaches 0.3547 wSTQ, 0.2071 wAQ, and 0.6075 mIoU, ranking first on all three metrics. It is 3.6 wSTQ points ahead of the second entry and 2.4 points ahead of our DVIS++ baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了 Waymo Open Dataset 2D 视频全景分割挑战赛的冠军方案。该方法基于 DVIS++，提出硬区域监督 HRS，并结合三种测试时策略，在挑战赛测试集上三项指标均排名第一。
AI.motivation: 该任务要求对每帧每个像素进行语义分类，并对可数物体在 100 帧和五个重叠相机间保持身份一致。作者希望改进 DVIS++ 基线，以提升视频全景分割在困难区域和多相机身份关联上的表现。
AI.method: 以 DVIS++（分割器、跟踪器、细化器的级联）为基线。提出硬区域监督 HRS：利用基线预测错误定义硬区域，并设计相应损失和辅助预测头；辅助头仅用于训练，测试时移除，因此推理结构与基线相同。测试时还采用三种策略：双模型集成、将分割器输出合并到最终全景图、跨相机身份链接。
AI.result: 在挑战赛测试集上，该方法达到 0.3547 wSTQ、0.2071 wAQ 和 0.6075 mIoU，三项指标均排名第一；wSTQ 比第二名高 3.6 分，比 DVIS++ 基线高 2.4 分。
AI.conclusion: HRS 能在不增加推理时结构开销的情况下提升基线性能，结合测试时集成、分割结果合并和跨相机身份链接，可进一步显著提升视频全景分割效果，最终取得挑战赛冠军。

title: Positive Ratings, Hidden Concerns: Employee Voice Disclosure in AI-Mediated Organizational Listening
comment: 10 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at the 60th Hawaii International Conference on System Sciences (HICSS-60), 2027
summary: Organizations started listening to employees through conversational AI agents alongside structured surveys. Little is known about what these channels change in what employees say when disclosure carries hierarchical risk. We report a field study inside a global management consulting firm whose process pairs a pre-survey with an adaptive AI voice interview on the same themes within one session. Across 44 first-session interviews (132 matched theme observations), 20-41% of sessions showed a favorable rating co-occurring with a substantive concern voiced later, depending on the favorability threshold. The Gioia analysis drew on 158 protective quotes from 65 eligible sessions. Disclosure rarely arrived unguarded: employees softened concerns, deflected accountability, and bounded how far they went, and this protective work tracked the perceived legitimacy of the listening structure. We develop a grounded model of bounded disclosure and derive four propositions for voice, channel and listening research. Silence, we argue, can persist inside expression.

AI.tldr: 在一家全球管理咨询公司中，员工先填问卷再接受自适应AI语音访谈，同一场次覆盖相同主题。研究发现，正面评分常与随后提出的实质性担忧并存，员工披露时普遍进行保护性修饰，这种保护行为与对倾听结构合法性的感知相关。作者据此提出“有限披露”模型，认为沉默可以存在于表达之中。
AI.motivation: 组织开始用对话式AI代理与结构化问卷并行倾听员工，但当披露存在层级风险时，这些渠道会如何改变员工所言，尚不清楚。
AI.method: 在一家全球管理咨询公司开展实地研究，流程为同场次“预问卷+自适应AI语音访谈”，主题匹配。分析44场首次访谈、132个匹配主题观察；采用Gioia方法分析来自65场合格访谈的158条保护性引述。
AI.result: 视好感阈值而定，20%–41%的场次出现“正面评分与稍后提出的实质性担忧共存”。披露很少毫无防备：员工弱化担忧、转移责任、限制披露深度；这些保护性做法与对倾听结构合法性的感知相关。
AI.conclusion: 提出“有限披露”的扎根模型，并为员工发声、渠道与倾听研究提出四个命题。核心论点是：沉默可以持续存在于表达之中。

title: Making LLMs Say What They Think: Measuring and Improving CoT-Interpretability Alignment
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) traces often serve as a proxy for how Large Language Models (LLMs) arrive at their answers. However, growing evidence shows that models' CoT often fails to reflect their internal computations and can be changed without affecting their final answers. In this work, we measure and improve the alignment between the reasoning described in an LLM's CoT and what it computes internally. We propose CoT-Interpretability Alignment (CIA), a metric that measures the agreement between a model's CoT traces and its internal reasoning strategies as detected by interpretability tools. We evaluate CIA on three tasks (two-hop question answering, hint intervention, and integer multiplication) across three LLMs, finding that LLMs exhibit limited alignment across all tasks (44.8-75.9%). We then experiment with improving CIA via post-training, setting both the task accuracy and parametric faithfulness signals as a reward. Experiments show that we can substantially improve CoT parametric faithfulness while maintaining or improving the task accuracy. We provide rich analysis, such as their generalization patterns. Our work provides both a framework for auditing CoT parametric faithfulness and a pathway toward making models' explicit reasoning more trustworthy. Code and data are available at https://github.com/yihuaihong/CIA-minimal-repro.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CIA指标，用于衡量LLM的思维链（CoT）与内部计算策略之间的一致性，并通过后训练提升这种一致性，同时保持或提升任务准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有研究表明，LLM的CoT往往不能真实反映其内部计算过程，甚至可以在不改变最终答案的情况下被修改，因此需要测量并提升CoT与内部推理的对齐程度。
AI.method: 提出CoT-Interpretability Alignment（CIA）指标，利用可解释性工具检测模型内部推理策略，并计算其与CoT描述的一致程度；在二跳问答、提示干预和整数乘法三个任务及三个LLM上评估CIA；随后通过后训练优化CIA，将任务准确率和参数化忠实性信号共同作为奖励。
AI.result: LLM在全部任务上的CIA对齐程度有限，仅为44.8%至75.9%；通过后训练可以显著提升CoT的参数化忠实性，同时保持或提升任务准确率，并展现出一定的泛化模式。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一个审计CoT参数化忠实性的框架，也为使模型显式推理更加可信提供了可行路径，代码和数据已公开。

title: Soft Spatial Reasoning
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) commonly perform spatial reasoning through chain-of-thought (CoT), encoding intermediate reasoning as autoregressive sequences of discrete language tokens. Such hard thinking requires committing to a single token at each step, even when the correct spatial interpretation remains uncertain. This early commitment constitutes premature discretization: an incorrect token selection can propagate errors through subsequent reasoning. We propose Soft Spatial Reasoning, a post-training framework that introduces soft thinking for spatial tasks in LVLMs. At each intermediate reasoning step, the LVLM forms a continuous soft state by mixing token embeddings rather than selecting a single token, allowing multiple candidate continuations to influence the next step. The appropriate degree of softness, however, can vary across reasoning steps: retaining multiple candidates may preserve a useful spatial interpretation, but if those candidates imply conflicting spatial relations, mixing them may interfere with subsequent reasoning. At the core of Soft Spatial Reasoning is AdaptSoft, a controller that uses the current hidden state and predictive uncertainty to adapt the degree of softness at each reasoning step. To train AdaptSoft, we introduce a gradient-alignment learning objective that provides a step-specific learning signal for softness control without intermediate reasoning supervision. Across diverse spatial benchmarks, Soft Spatial Reasoning outperforms hard and fixed-soft CoT baselines using the same backbone, as well as a range of existing LVLMs. The source code is available at https://github.com/rafiibnsultan/Soft_Spatial_Reasoning

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Soft Spatial Reasoning，一种面向大型视觉语言模型空间推理的后训练框架，用连续软状态替代链式思维中的离散 token 选择，并通过 AdaptSoft 自适应控制每步软度，从而减少过早离散化导致的错误传播。
AI.motivation: 现有 LVLM 通常用链式思维进行空间推理，每一步必须选定单个离散 token，这会造成过早离散化；一旦选错，错误会沿后续推理传播。
AI.method: 提出 Soft Spatial Reasoning：在中间推理步骤混合 token 嵌入形成连续软状态，而非硬选单个 token；核心组件 AdaptSoft 根据当前隐藏状态和预测不确定性自适应调整软度；并引入梯度对齐学习目标，在没有中间推理监督的情况下训练 AdaptSoft。
AI.result: 在多个空间推理基准上，Soft Spatial Reasoning 使用相同骨干网络时优于硬 CoT 和固定软度 CoT 基线，也优于多种现有 LVLM。
AI.conclusion: 自适应软空间推理能够缓解过早离散化问题，提升 LVLM 的空间推理性能，并优于硬推理与固定软推理方案。

title: DrivingBench: Can Vision-Language Models Drive a Toyota Corolla?
summary: Frontier models excel at many digital benchmarks, yet their ability to drive a real car, an everyday human skill, remains largely untested. We present DrivingBench, to our knowledge the first benchmark where general-purpose vision-language models must drive a real car. Through three tools, the models see camera frames from a Toyota Corolla and directly command its steering and velocity around a parking lot cone course at low speeds. The car may continue moving while the model thinks and new commands replace the currently running one, so inference latency is part of the task, testing the models' abilities to observe, act, monitor, recover, and complete a long-horizon objective under such constraints. We benchmark GPT-6 Astra, Claude Fable 5.1, GPT-5.6 Sol, and Grok 4.6 in vendor-native harnesses (Codex, Claude Code, Cursor) with up to three attempts each in one conversation; Astra is the only model to finish the course, on its second attempt, with no other attempt passing 50% of the course. Two of the four models improved materially across attempts with retained context. We also detail the design principles behind our action interface, and show how the tool output format and the framing of the task combined to determine whether models would drive at all or refuse. We release our harness, prompts, course map, and traces with video and telemetry for reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 提出 DrivingBench，首个让通用视觉语言模型驾驶真实汽车的基准：模型通过摄像头画面直接控制丰田卡罗拉在停车场锥桶赛道上的转向与速度。
AI.motivation: 前沿模型在数字基准上表现出色，但驱动真实汽车这一日常人类技能仍未被测试，尤其缺少对延迟约束下长时程观察、行动、监控与恢复能力的评估。
AI.method: 使用三个工具让模型接收真实车辆摄像头帧，并直接发出转向和速度命令；车辆在模型推理时仍可能移动，新命令会替换正在执行的命令，因此推理延迟成为任务一部分。在 Codex、Claude Code、Cursor 等原生环境中测试 GPT-6 Astra、Claude Fable 5.1、GPT-5.6 Sol 和 Grok 4.6，每个模型在单次对话中最多尝试三次。
AI.result: 仅 Astra 完成赛道，且是在第二次尝试完成；其他尝试均未通过 50% 赛道。四个模型中有两个借助保留上下文在多次尝试中显著进步。工具输出格式与任务表述方式共同决定模型是否愿意驾驶或拒绝。
AI.conclusion: DrivingBench 展示了真实驾驶任务对通用视觉语言模型的挑战，并强调动作接口设计、延迟处理和任务框架的重要性；作者发布测试框架、提示词、赛道地图以及带视频和遥测的轨迹以支持复现。

title: GraphCert: Bootstrap Agentic Graph Reasoning with Certified Evidence Rubrics
summary: Graph agents extend large language models (LLMs) with the ability to actively explore and reason over knowledge graphs through multi-step interactions with graph tools. However, training capable graph agents typically requires large collections of question-answer pairs and reasoning trajectories, whose manual construction is costly and difficult to scale. Moreover, employing proprietary LLMs to generate such supervision further risks exposing sensitive graph data to external services. Therefore, we propose GraphCert to bootstrap agentic graph reasoning with certified evidence rubrics during post-training. Specifically, the Bootstrapped Graph Quizzer guided by generation controls produces graph-grounded QA pairs and marks supporting evidence, which undergo execution certification and semantic curation. The accepted evidence is then canonicalized into certified evidence rubrics that later reward Graph Solver evidence alignment alongside answer correctness during GRPO training. Experiments on five graph reasoning domains in GRBENCH demonstrate that GraphCert consistently outperforms substantially larger LLM agents and post-training method. Furthermore, our analysis demonstrates that the learned policy transfers robustly across heterogeneous graph domains, suggesting that GraphCert acquires reusable graph-reasoning capabilities rather than domain-specific patterns. These results establish executable self-certification as an effective approach to self-training compact graph reasoning agents. Our code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出 GraphCert，通过可执行自认证与证据评分标准，在无昂贵人工标注和避免敏感图数据外泄的情况下，自举训练紧凑型图推理智能体。
AI.motivation: 训练图智能体通常需要大量问答对和推理轨迹，人工构建成本高且难以扩展；使用专有 LLM 生成监督数据还可能将敏感图数据暴露给外部服务。
AI.method: GraphCert 在后训练中引入认证证据评分标准。Bootstrapped Graph Quizzer 在生成控制下产出基于图的问答对并标注支持证据；这些证据经过执行认证和语义筛选后，被规范化为认证证据评分标准；在 GRPO 训练中，该标准同时奖励 Graph Solver 的证据对齐和答案正确性。
AI.result: 在 GRBENCH 的五个图推理领域上，GraphCert 持续优于规模更大的 LLM 智能体和后训练方法；学习到的策略能稳健迁移到异构图领域，表明其获得的是可复用的图推理能力而非领域特定模式。
AI.conclusion: 可执行自认证是自训练紧凑型图推理智能体的有效方法，代码将公开。

title: Settle: Learning When to Stop Reasoning
summary: Reasoning models often continue generating after their answers have settled. Settle learns when to stop from answer stability in completed traces. It trains the existing end-of-reasoning token while keeping other predictions close to the base model, and requires only ordinary decoding at inference. On MATH-500 with Qwen3-4B, Settle reduces token count by 40% with a 0.5-percentage-point decrease in accuracy. It gains 6.16 percentage points over supervised fine-tuning on the same traces shortened at their first stable answer, at nearly identical token counts. Its stopping score predicts whether a correct answer will remain correct. Settle extends the accuracy-token-count Pareto frontier of the evaluated stopping methods.

AI.tldr: Settle 利用完整推理轨迹中答案的稳定性来学习何时停止推理，只训练已有的推理结束标记，并在推理时使用普通解码，从而在几乎不损失准确率的情况下显著减少 token 消耗。
AI.motivation: 推理模型在答案已经确定后仍常常继续生成，造成不必要的计算浪费，因此需要让模型学会在合适时机停止推理。
AI.method: Settle 从完整轨迹中的答案稳定性学习停止时机；训练已有的 end-of-reasoning token，同时让其他预测尽量接近基座模型；推理阶段仅需普通解码。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-4B 和 MATH-500 上，Settle 将 token 数减少 40%，准确率仅下降 0.5 个百分点；相比在首个稳定答案处截断的相同轨迹上做监督微调，其在几乎相同 token 数下准确率提升 6.16 个百分点；停止分数还能预测正确答案是否保持正确。
AI.conclusion: Settle 在评估的停止方法中扩展了准确率-token 数的帕累托前沿，说明其能有效减少推理冗余并保持较高准确率。

title: Fairness Beyond a Single Run: Training-Seed Variability in Speech LLM Adaptation
summary: Demographic fairness gaps in automatic speech recognition are almost always reported from a single training run. We fine-tune the Q-former projector and LoRA adapters of a speech LLM at five audio compression factors and six random seeds, holding the encoder, base decoder, data and decoding fixed, and evaluate every run on Common Voice and Fair-Speech. At 460 h of clean LibriSpeech, the seed moves fairness metrics more than compression does on most demographic axes. A balanced 3x3 decomposition attributes 85.3% of the variation in Fair-Speech ethnicity normalized gap to the seed against 8.3% to compression (p = 0.009), though compression explains more on age and gender. Held-out LibriSpeech word error rate spreads by 0.04 points across those seeds while Common Voice spreads by 8.57, so these are not failed runs, and the effect survives controlling for accuracy and dropout. Scaling and diversifying the adaptation set to 960 h damps the effect but does not remove it. On Fair-Speech ethnicity, two single-run systems must differ by more than 0.30 in normalized gap to exceed seed variability.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究语音大模型ASR中的公平性差异是否受随机种子影响。作者在5种音频压缩因子和6个随机种子下微调Q-former与LoRA，并在Common Voice和Fair-Speech上评估，发现多数人口统计轴上的公平性指标变异性主要来自随机种子而非压缩因子。
AI.motivation: 当前自动语音识别中的群体公平性差距通常只基于单次训练运行报告，这可能把随机种子带来的波动误判为模型或压缩方法导致的公平性差异，因此需要系统检验种子与压缩因子对公平性指标的影响。
AI.method: 固定编码器、基础解码器、数据和解码策略，仅微调语音LLM的Q-former投影器和LoRA适配器；设置5种音频压缩因子和6个随机种子，在Common Voice与Fair-Speech上评估每次运行；使用平衡3x3分解分析公平性指标变异来源，并控制准确率和dropout。
AI.result: 在460小时干净LibriSpeech上，多数人口统计轴上随机种子对公平性指标的影响大于压缩因子。Fair-Speech族裔归一化差距的变异中，85.3%归因于种子，仅8.3%归因于压缩（p=0.009）；但年龄和性别上压缩解释更多。留出LibriSpeech的WER在不同种子间仅波动0.04个点，而Common Voice波动8.57个点，说明并非失败运行。该效应在控制准确率和dropout后仍存在；将适配数据扩展到960小时可削弱但未消除。Fair-Speech族裔上，两个单次运行系统需在归一化差距上相差超过0.30才能超过种子波动。
AI.conclusion: ASR公平性评估不能依赖单次训练运行；随机种子可显著影响公平性结论，尤其在某些人口统计轴上。报告公平性差距时应考虑多种子不确定性，单次运行间的族裔公平性差异需达到较大阈值才可视为有意义。

title: When Clipping Reverses Correction: Failure Dynamics of Pointwise Forward-KL On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) trains a student on its own generated responses using feedback from the same model conditioned on privileged information. On mathematical reasoning, the original OPSD study finds that stylistic tokens can dominate the training signal over math-related tokens, and that pointwise clipping of the forward KL objective stabilizes training. Pointwise clipping caps each vocabulary-wise forward KL term at a fixed threshold before summing over the vocabulary. Follow-up studies have adopted this clipping, but its effect on training has not been directly examined. In matched training runs differing only in whether clipping is applied, we observe that clipped runs produce substantially more repetitions that persist to the end of the response than their unclipped counterparts. We trace this failure to the clipped objective. We prove that the clipped objective can fail to correct the student toward the teacher and can instead push clipped and unclipped token probabilities away from its teacher. Our training runs agree with this analysis: inside repetitions, the clipped student places less probability than its teacher on leaving the repetition, and more on continuing it, whereas the unclipped runs stay close to their teachers.

AI.tldr: 论文研究on-policy自蒸馏中逐点裁剪前向KL目标的影响，发现裁剪会导致学生模型产生更多持续到回答末尾的重复，并从理论和实验上将其归因于裁剪目标本身。
AI.motivation: 原OPSD在数学推理中发现风格token会主导训练信号，并用逐点裁剪前向KL目标来稳定训练；后续研究沿用了该裁剪，但其对训练的实际影响尚未被直接检验。
AI.method: 进行仅是否应用逐点裁剪不同的匹配训练实验，并对裁剪目标进行理论分析，证明其可能无法将学生纠正向教师，反而可能将裁剪与未裁剪token概率推离教师。
AI.result: 裁剪后的训练运行产生明显更多、且持续到回答末尾的重复；训练动态与理论分析一致：在重复内部，裁剪学生比教师更少赋予离开重复的概率、更多赋予继续重复的概率，而未裁剪运行则接近教师。
AI.conclusion: 逐点裁剪并非无害，它可能无法正确纠正学生并加剧重复问题，因此需要重新审视OPSD中该裁剪目标的使用。

title: SimEX: Simulation-Integrated Robotics AutoResearch
summary: Coding agents powered by large language models (LLMs) have shown remarkable abilities to autonomously reason about and achieve goals in the digital world. However, bringing this success to the physical world remains challenging. On the one hand, direct generation methods (e.g., Code as Policies) often suffer from the LLMs' insufficient understanding of robots and physical environments. On the other hand, iterative trial-and-error tuning in the physical world (e.g., physical autoresearch) induces significant experimental cost and safety concerns. We introduce SimEX: Simulation-Integrated Robotics AutoResearch, an autoresearch framework that tightly integrates simulated experimentation, enabling coding agents to efficiently acquire physical capabilities for controlling real robots. SimEX operates in two stages. First, the agent conducts open-ended probe-and-optimize iterations in simulation, developing a robot toolbox with robust and generalizable capabilities. Second, the agent adapts the toolbox and the simulator together through only a few physical trials: each trial corrects the simulator, and the corrected simulator is used to diagnose failures and screen candidate repairs. We evaluate SimEX extensively in sim-to-sim settings and on physical robots. On challenging real-world manipulation tasks including towel folding, barcode scanning, and plate manipulation, SimEX enables coding agents to efficiently acquire robot skills without any demonstration and with only 10 minutes of real-robot interaction. These results suggest that simulation can be a critical component in achieving physical intelligence, not only as a source of training data that must closely replicate the real world, but also as a roughly correct laboratory where a coding agent develops the knowledge and procedures needed to act on the robot. More details and robot videos at https://robo-simex.github.io/

AI.tldr: 提出 SimEX，一个将模拟实验与编码智能体紧密结合的机器人自动研究框架，使智能体无需示范、仅用约 10 分钟真实机器人交互即可学习折叠毛巾、扫描条码和操作盘子等物理操作技能。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体在数字世界表现优异，但迁移到物理世界仍困难：直接生成方法常因 LLM 对机器人和物理环境理解不足而失败；在真实世界反复试错又带来高昂实验成本和安全风险。
AI.method: SimEX 分两阶段：第一阶段，智能体在仿真中进行开放式“探测-优化”迭代，构建具有鲁棒性和泛化能力的机器人工具箱；第二阶段，智能体通过少量真实试验同时适配工具箱与模拟器，每次真实试验用于校正模拟器，再用校正后的模拟器诊断失败并筛选候选修复方案。
AI.result: 在 sim-to-sim 设置和真实机器人上广泛评估。在折叠毛巾、条码扫描、盘子操作等挑战性真实操作任务中，SimEX 使编码智能体无需任何示范、仅用 10 分钟真实机器人交互即可高效获得机器人技能。
AI.conclusion: 仿真可成为实现物理智能的关键组件：它不仅可作为必须高度复现真实世界的训练数据来源，也可作为一个大致正确的实验室，让编码智能体发展出操作机器人所需的知识和流程。

title: When Reasoning Goes Astray: Attention Dynamics of Uncontrolled Reasoning
summary: Large reasoning models (LRMs) improve performance on complex tasks through extended reasoning, yet the same process can degenerate into redundant verification and persistent generation loops. Such uncontrolled reasoning increases inference cost and creates risks of resource exhaustion and service degradation. However, existing mitigations largely truncate long outputs or react to surface repetition, and thus fail to distinguish normal thinking from uncontrolled reasoning or explain how benign reasoning degenerates into harmful behavior. In this paper, we operationalize LRM generation as four states and further introduce Reasoning-state Analysis via Dynamic Attention Responses (RADAR), which identifies the current reasoning state in real time and characterizes how effective reflection can develop into uncontrolled generation. Guided by RADAR's analysis, we further realign abnormal attention distributions toward patterns observed in normal requests and examine how this correction affects excessive reflection and persistent looping. Temporal analyses show that uncontrolled reasoning is characterized by attention distributions that deviate from normal generation, with abnormal trends becoming detectable before repetition begins. Correcting these deviations through Attention Realignment consistently reduces looping while largely preserving benign performance. Together, RADAR provide a mechanistic account of how reasoning becomes uncontrolled, offering actionable guidance for identifying critical failure stages and designing targeted runtime interventions.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究大型推理模型（LRMs）中不受控推理问题，提出将生成过程划分为四种状态，并引入基于动态注意力响应的推理状态分析（RADAR），以实时识别推理状态并解释正常反思如何退化为失控生成。
AI.motivation: LRMs通过扩展推理提升复杂任务表现，但推理过程可能退化为冗余验证和持续生成循环，导致推理成本增加、资源耗尽和服务降级风险。现有缓解方法多依赖截断长输出或对表面重复做出反应，难以区分正常思考与不受控推理，也无法解释良性推理如何退化为有害行为。
AI.method: 将LRM生成操作化为四种状态；提出RADAR（Reasoning-state Analysis via Dynamic Attention Responses），通过动态注意力响应实时识别当前推理状态，并刻画有效反思如何发展为不受控生成；基于RADAR分析，将异常注意力分布重新对齐到正常请求中观察到的模式，并考察该校正对过度反思和持续循环的影响。
AI.result: 时间分析表明，不受控推理的注意力分布偏离正常生成，且在重复开始前即可检测到异常趋势；通过注意力重对齐（Attention Realignment）校正这些偏差，可持续减少循环，同时大体保持良性性能。
AI.conclusion: RADAR从机制层面解释了推理如何变得不受控，为识别关键失败阶段和设计有针对性的运行时干预提供了可操作指导。

title: Matisse: Evidence-Space Reasoning for Active 3D Reconstruction
comment: 20 pages, 7 figures, 7 tables. Project page: https://xihangyu630.github.io/matisse/
summary: How can a 3D reconstruction system acquire and retain useful information to understand the geometry of a scene from partial views under a limited computation budget? Existing active view acquisition methods typically estimate uncertainty over observed or instantiated geometry, limiting their ability to reason about unseen structure, while long-horizon reconstruction methods often retain redundant observations. We introduce Matisse, a training-free framework that unifies active reconstruction and keyframe selection by leveraging evidence provided by a pretrained generative 3D model. Matisse estimates Evidential Uncertainty from cross-attention evidence associated with 3D latent tokens and derives an Evidential Information Gain to guide both view acquisition and keyframe selection based on the expected reduction in posterior entropy. Matisse supports multi-object scenes through occlusion-aware, object-balanced aggregation and propagates uncertainty through intermediate latents to avoid full reconstruction during planning. Matisse reduces Chamfer distance by 12.7%, 3.8%, and 9.2% on GSO30, YCB-V, and Replica, respectively, relative to the best baseline on each dataset, and achieves a $1.50\times$ end-to-end speedup over the best active reconstruction baseline on GSO30 with the same reconstruction backend. In the GSO30 keyframe selection experiment for long-horizon reconstruction, Matisse achieves comparable Chamfer distance using 14% of the input views compared with Stream3D.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Matisse，一个无需训练的框架，利用预训练生成式 3D 模型提供的证据，将主动重建与关键帧选择统一起来，从而在有限计算预算下从部分视角理解场景几何。
AI.motivation: 现有主动视角获取方法通常只对已观测或已实例化几何估计不确定性，难以推理未观测结构；而长时程重建方法常保留冗余观测。因此，如何在有限计算预算下获取并保留有用信息仍是一个关键问题。
AI.method: Matisse 从与 3D 潜在 token 相关的交叉注意力证据中估计 Evidential Uncertainty，并推导 Evidential Information Gain，以基于后验熵的预期减少来指导视角获取和关键帧选择。它通过遮挡感知、对象平衡的聚合支持多对象场景，并在规划过程中传播中间潜在变量的不确定性，从而避免完整重建。
AI.result: 在 GSO30、YCB-V 和 Replica 数据集上，Matisse 相对各数据集最佳基线分别将 Chamfer 距离降低 12.7%、3.8% 和 9.2%；在 GSO30 上，使用相同重建后端时，相比最佳主动重建基线实现 1.50 倍端到端加速。在 GSO30 长时程重建的关键帧选择实验中，Matisse 仅使用 14% 的输入视角即可达到与 Stream3D 相当的 Chamfer 距离。
AI.conclusion: Matisse 通过证据不确定性驱动的信息增益，有效统一了主动重建和关键帧选择，在提升重建精度的同时减少冗余观测和计算开销，适用于有限预算下的部分视角 3D 场景理解。

title: Consensus-Aware Multi-Source Fusion for Reference-Guided Camouflaged Object Detection
comment: 20 pages, including 2 pages of appendix; 9 figures and 4 tables
summary: Reference-guided camouflaged object detection aims to segment a target whose visual appearance closely resembles its surroundings by exploiting auxiliary reference samples. The task remains difficult because reference samples contain inconsistent target cues, while generic visual representations are not inherently aligned with the target specified by the references. To handle these problems, we present a consensus-aware multi-source fusion framework. Reference-Conditioned Dual-Backbone Fusion (RCDF) couples trainable PVTv2 query features with frozen DINOv3 representations and uses reference-conditioned correlation to select foundation-model evidence before multi-scale fusion. The framework also aggregates multiple references through cross-reference consensus aggregation and injects reference information at semantic depths matched to the query features. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method. The results further show that reference consensus, target-conditioned foundation features, and hierarchical decoding provide complementary improvements under the evaluation protocol. The source code will be made publicly available upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种共识感知的多源融合框架，用于参考引导的伪装目标检测，通过参考条件双骨干融合、跨参考共识聚合和层级解码提升分割性能。
AI.motivation: 参考引导伪装目标检测因目标与背景高度相似而困难，且参考样本中的目标线索不一致，通用视觉特征也未能与参考指定的目标对齐。
AI.method: 提出RCDF模块，将可训练的PVTv2查询特征与冻结的DINOv3表示耦合，利用参考条件相关性选择基础模型证据并进行多尺度融合；同时通过跨参考共识聚合整合多个参考，并在与查询特征匹配的语义深度注入参考信息。
AI.result: 大量实验验证了方法的有效性，结果表明参考共识、目标条件基础特征和层级解码在评估协议下提供了互补的改进。
AI.conclusion: 所提框架能有效解决参考线索不一致和特征对齐问题，提升伪装目标检测性能，源代码将在接收后公开。

title: Video2SwimFish: An Automated Pipeline for Reconstructing Controllable Fish Models and Biological Locomotion from Real Fish Videos
summary: We present Video2SwimFish, an automated pipeline and benchmark for building controllable fish assets from real-fish videos for underwater embodied AI. Given synchronized multi-view videos of an individual fish, the pipeline reconstructs a metrically scaled deformable mesh from a VLM-selected canonical frame, generates internal articulation adapted to that individual's morphology through a VLM actor-critic loop, and extracts a Biological Locomotion Manifold (BLM) from the fish's observed midline curvature. The BLM provides a low-dimensional action space bounded by real-fish motion, enabling an individual swimming policy to be learned for each reconstructed fish. We release two paired datasets: synchronized top- and front-view recordings of 120 individual fish across 6 species, and the controllable assets and individual swimming policies derived from them. Because every asset is tied to the animal it came from, the dataset supports a benchmark that evaluates locomotion learning not only on task success but on fidelity to that individual in trajectory shape, body curvature, and tail-beat frequency, across trajectory following, reward-free swimming behavior transfer from video, and a downstream case study in which a simulated BlueROV underwater robot captures one of the assets. We find that task success and locomotion fidelity do not necessarily improve together: the method achieving the highest task completion is not the method achieving the highest locomotion fidelity, and we identify faithful reproduction of individual animal locomotion as an open challenge for the community. Project website: https://hangongchen.github.io/video2swimfish-web/.

AI.tldr: 提出 Video2SwimFish，一个从真实鱼多视角视频自动构建可控鱼资产与个体游泳策略的流程与基准，并发布覆盖6种鱼、120个体的配对数据集。
AI.motivation: 水下具身智能缺乏源自真实个体的可控鱼类资产和评估基准，尤其需要衡量学习到的运动是否忠实于特定个体的真实游动。
AI.method: 利用同步多视角视频，基于 VLM 选择规范帧重建度量尺度可变形网格；通过 VLM actor-critic 循环生成适配个体形态的内部关节；从观测中线曲率提取 Biological Locomotion Manifold 作为低维动作空间，并为每条鱼学习个体游泳策略。发布顶视/前视同步视频及派生资产与策略，并设计包含轨迹跟随、无奖励游泳行为迁移和 BlueROV 案例的基准。
AI.result: 基准从任务成功和运动保真度两方面评估，包括轨迹形状、身体曲率和尾拍频率。结果显示任务成功与运动保真度不一定同步提升，最高任务完成的方法并非最高保真度的方法。
AI.conclusion: 忠实复现个体动物运动仍是开放挑战；该工作提供流程、数据集和基准，以推动水下具身 AI 中可控仿生鱼资产与个体化游泳策略研究。

title: Sparse-WAM: Accelerating World Action Models via Action-Guided Sparse Imagination
comment: Xinling Xie and Haodong Wang contributed equally to this work
summary: World-action models (WAMs) leverage pretrained video models to improve generalization in robot control by jointly predicting future visual states and actions. This capability comes at a substantial inference cost, as dense future-frame tokens are repeatedly processed during denoising. Prior methods address this by token pruning that prioritizes visual fidelity to reduce denoising costs in video diffusion models. However, these methods do not use action relevance to determine which future-frame tokens to retain during joint denoising in WAMs. In this paper, we propose Sparse-WAM, a training-free framework for action-guided sparse imagination that selectively processes future-frame tokens to accelerate WAM inference. We observe substantial overlap in the spatial distribution of attention from action tokens to future-frame tokens (action-to-future attention) between consecutive denoising steps, despite continued updates to the future representations. Motivated by this, we develop Action-Guided Token Selection to retain frame-specific action-relevant regions together with cross-frame context. However, a naive implementation can incur attention-scoring and token-packing overhead that offsets the computational savings from pruning. We therefore introduce Pilot, an efficient engine that reduces sparse inference overhead through lightweight scoring and cross-step reuse of token selections. On LIBERO with FastWAM-Joint and RoboLab-120 with Cosmos 3 Edge, Sparse-WAM achieves inference speedups of approximately $2.0\times$ and $1.8\times$, respectively, over dense eager inference on an NVIDIA RTX 4090, while largely preserving task performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Sparse-WAM，一种免训练的动作引导稀疏想象框架，通过选择性处理未来帧 token 来加速世界-动作模型（WAM）的推理，在保持任务性能的同时实现约 1.8-2.0 倍加速。
AI.motivation: 世界-动作模型（WAM）虽能提升机器人控制的泛化能力，但推理成本高昂——去噪过程中需反复处理大量未来帧 token。现有 token 剪枝方法仅关注视觉保真度，未利用动作相关性来决定在联合去噪中应保留哪些未来帧 token。
AI.method: 提出 Sparse-WAM 免训练框架：基于观察到的现象——相邻去噪步中动作 token 对未来帧 token 的注意力空间分布高度重叠，设计了 Action-Guided Token Selection，保留帧级动作相关区域及跨帧上下文；并引入高效引擎 Pilot，通过轻量级打分和跨步复用 token 选择来降低稀疏推理开销。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO（FastWAM-Joint）和 RoboLab-120（Cosmos 3 Edge）上，Sparse-WAM 在 NVIDIA RTX 4090 上分别比稠密 eager 推理加速约 2.0 倍和 1.8 倍，同时基本保持了任务性能。
AI.conclusion: 利用动作相关性引导未来帧 token 的稀疏选择，并结合跨步复用与轻量打分，可在免训练条件下显著加速 WAM 推理，而不过多牺牲任务表现。

title: Agentic Relative Camera Pose Estimation via Learned Ranking and Verification
comment: 22 pages, including 10 pages for the main body
summary: A wide range of approaches have been developed for camera pose estimation, including correspondence-based methods, end-to-end pose regression, and recent 3D geometric foundation models. Our key observation is that no single estimator is optimal for diverse challenges, such as wide baselines, lack of texture, appearance changes, and occlusions. Further analysis reveals substantial performance variation across both benchmarks and individual image pairs, with different estimators exhibiting complementary strengths. We introduce PoseAgent, an agentic framework for relative camera pose estimation that dynamically orchestrates pose estimators through learnable ranking and verification. Given an image pair, a profiling agent first extracts appearance, semantic, and geometric features relevant to pose estimation, e.g., scene type. A learned ranking agent then predicts the relative competence of multiple pose estimators given the image-pair profile. The top-ranked estimator is executed, and its predicted pose is assessed by a learned verification agent that estimates the corresponding pose error. When verification fails, PoseAgent adaptively invokes lower-ranked estimators until a candidate is accepted or the execution budget is reached. For pose verification, our verification network predicts pose errors more accurately than prior models. For pose estimation, PoseAgent improves AUC@5 degree up to 4.2% over the strongest standalone estimator on each of ARKitScenes, MegaDepth, ScanNet++, and RealEstate10K. On ARKitScenes, PoseAgent also outperforms VLM-based agents, which include a VLM ranker with the same verifier and fallback policy. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of our learned ranking and verification.

AI.tldr: 提出PoseAgent，一种通过可学习排序与验证动态调度多个位姿估计器的智能体框架，用于相对相机位姿估计。
AI.motivation: 单一估计器难以应对宽基线、弱纹理、外观变化和遮挡等多样挑战，不同估计器在不同基准和图像对上性能差异大且优势互补。
AI.method: PoseAgent包含：1）剖析智能体提取图像对的外观、语义和几何特征（如场景类型）；2）学习排序智能体预测各估计器的相对能力；3）执行排名最高的估计器；4）学习验证智能体评估位姿误差，失败时按序调用次优估计器直至接受或达到预算。验证网络能更准确预测位姿误差。
AI.result: 在ARKitScenes、MegaDepth、ScanNet++和RealEstate10K上，PoseAgent相比最强单估计器将AUC@5°提升最多4.2%；在ARKitScenes上还优于基于VLM的智能体（含相同验证器和回退策略的VLM排序器）。
AI.conclusion: 学习排序与验证机制有效，动态调度多个估计器能显著提升相对相机位姿估计的鲁棒性和精度。

title: Here the World in Stereo: Learning Dynamic Spatial Correspondence for Immersive Joint Video-Audio Generation
summary: Recent joint video-audio generation models have achieved strong semantic correspondence and temporal synchronization. However, applications such as AR/VR and interactive gaming further require stereo audio to provide an immersive sense, which remains largely overlooked. Effective stereo audio requires the perceived sound location to evolve consistently with the motion of its corresponding visual source. We refer to this property as Dynamic Spatial Correspondence and propose StereoBind, a framework that binds visual source motion to stereo sound generation. StereoBind uses motion tracks to coordinate visual motion and stereo audio through three complementary mechanisms. Visual Motion Binding establishes source-aware audiovisual correspondence, the Spatial Track Encoder captures absolute source positions, and Residual Track RoPE models relative motion. For supervision and evaluation, we construct StereoWorld-29K, a large-scale stereo audio-video dataset with paired motion tracks, and StereoWorldBench for measuring audiovisual spatial consistency. Experiments show that StereoBind substantially improves spatial alignment in stereo audio generation over existing models while preserving overall audiovisual quality.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出StereoBind框架，利用运动轨迹将视觉源运动与立体声音频生成绑定，并构建数据集StereoWorld-29K和基准StereoWorldBench，显著提升了立体声生成中的空间对齐效果。
AI.motivation: 现有联合视频-音频生成模型虽实现了语义对应和时间同步，但AR/VR、交互游戏等应用需要立体声以提供沉浸感，这一需求被忽视。有效立体声要求感知声源位置随对应视觉源运动一致变化，即动态空间对应。
AI.method: StereoBind通过运动轨迹协调视觉运动与立体声音频，采用三种互补机制：视觉运动绑定建立源感知的视听对应，空间轨迹编码器捕捉绝对源位置，残差轨迹RoPE建模相对运动。同时构建了带配对运动轨迹的大规模立体声音视频数据集StereoWorld-29K，以及用于测量视听空间一致性的基准StereoWorldBench。
AI.result: 实验表明，StereoBind在立体声音频生成的空间对齐方面显著优于现有模型，同时保持了整体视听质量。
AI.conclusion: StereoBind有效实现了动态空间对应，提升了立体声生成的沉浸感和空间一致性。

title: Whose Voice Survives the Summary? A Voice-Retention Audit of LLM Employee Listening
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at the 60th Hawaii International Conference on System Sciences (HICSS 2027)
summary: Organizations increasingly route employee feedback to leaders through large language model (LLM) summaries, an unaudited layer that silences already-spoken voice. We introduce a Voice Retention / Representation Ratio metric for representational bias in summarization and apply it to a bilingual (English/German) corpus of 2,586 free-text responses from a global professional service company. First, employees supply criticism more reliably than praise (withholding praise is 82 times more common). Second, across 45 leader-summaries the pipeline filters by popularity, not sentiment: criticism survives, yet a concern voiced once is dropped 86% of the time, with short and German-only content lost on the same axis (theme retention 0.14 vs 0.74; German directional). Controlling for frequency, sentiment has no independent effect; the harm is prevalence-driven, which sentiment-only audits miss. A targeted prompt recovers only named themes. We contribute the metric, field evidence, and a disaggregated voice-retention card.

AI.tldr: 论文研究LLM摘要作为员工反馈到领导之间的未审计中介层，提出“声音保留/代表比率”指标，并用某全球专业服务公司的2586条英/德自由文本及45份领导摘要进行检验。结果显示，摘要主要按问题普遍性过滤，而非情感，导致低频、短文本和纯德文内容被系统性丢弃。
AI.motivation: 组织日益使用LLM摘要向领导转达员工反馈，但这一未审计层可能让已经说出的声音被消音。现有审计多关注情感，可能漏掉由问题普遍性驱动的代表性偏差。
AI.method: 提出Voice Retention / Representation Ratio指标来衡量摘要中的代表性偏差；使用双语（英语/德语）语料，包含某全球专业服务公司的2586条自由文本反馈；分析45份领导摘要，考察主题保留、频率、情感、语言和长度；并测试针对性提示词能否恢复被丢失内容。
AI.result: 员工更可靠地表达批评而非表扬，隐藏表扬比批评常见82倍；在45份领导摘要中，批评能够保留，但仅被提出一次的问题有86%被丢弃；短文本和纯德文内容同样被丢失，主题保留率为0.14对0.74，德语存在方向性偏差；控制频率后，情感没有独立影响；针对性提示词只能恢复已命名的主题。
AI.conclusion: LLM摘要中的声音丢失主要由问题普遍性驱动，而非情感，因此仅审计情感会遗漏关键伤害。论文贡献包括新指标、实地证据和分项声音保留卡片。

title: Cue the Flow: Steering Flow-Matching Policies for Open-World Delivery Manipulation
summary: Open-world goods delivery requires mobile manipulators to follow free-form user instructions and manipulate potentially novel objects. Existing dual-system approaches use high-level grounding models to convert language into grounded visual prompts, but their low-level controllers can remain brittle under noisy perception, dynamic scenes, and contact-rich interactions. We instead use a pretrained flow-matching vision-language-action model as the low-level control interface, leveraging its reactivity and robustness to environmental changes while treating the grounding output as a spatial cue for policy steering. Our key insight is that the pretrained VLA already provides a strong manipulation prior, while the spatial cue supplies the missing target information needed to guide actions under novel language--object mappings. Concretely, we introduce a lightweight cue-conditioned adapter. The adapter is first trained with contrastive objectives to produce salient and spatially discriminative cue representations, and is then supervised to predict a diagonal affine transformation over the generated action chunk, aligning policy steering with the cued target. Across tabletop and mobile-base settings, our method improves instruction following and manipulation success on both in-domain and out-of-domain objects, achieving up to near $2\times$ improvement in average task success rate with negligible inference overhead.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出将预训练 flow-matching VLA 模型作为低级控制接口，并把 grounding 输出作为空间线索来引导策略，从而提升开放世界货物递送中的指令跟随与操作成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有双系统方法虽用高层 grounding 模型将语言转为视觉提示，但低级控制器在噪声感知、动态场景和接触丰富交互中仍较脆弱，因此需要利用预训练 VLA 的操作先验并补充新颖语言-物体映射所需的目标信息。
