AI.method: 使用预训练 flow-matching 视觉-语言-动作模型作为低级控制接口，将 grounding 输出视为策略引导的空间线索；引入轻量 cue-conditioned adapter，先通过对比目标学习显著且空间可辨的线索表示，再监督预测对生成动作块的对角仿射变换，以对齐策略引导与线索目标。
AI.result: 在桌面和移动底座设置中，方法提升了域内和域外物体的指令跟随与操作成功率，平均任务成功率最高接近 2 倍提升，且推理开销可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 将预训练 VLA 的强操作先验与 grounding 空间线索结合，可增强开放世界操作鲁棒性与泛化能力，同时保持高效推理。

title: The Invisible Language Tax: Token Premiums of French and Regional Languages in 2026 LLM Tokenizers, and a French-Optimized Prototype
comment: 11 pages, 5 figures, 7 tables. Code, tokenizer, per-sentence counts and controls: https://github.com/Baracoda-ai-labs/baracoda-fr (commit fc8a736)
summary: LLM services are billed per token and context windows are measured in tokens, yet the number of tokens needed for the same content varies across languages. We measure this token premium on seven tokenizers of widely used 2026 models (OpenAI o200k, Llama 3, Qwen3, DeepSeek V3/V4, Gemma 3, Mistral Tekken, and the Claude generation-5 tokenizer via Anthropic's counting API) on NTREX-128 (124 non-English reference translations) and on the Universal Declaration of Human Rights for regional languages. French requires 31% to 58% more tokens than English, whereas Simplified Chinese ranges from 5% fewer to 40% more and is cheaper than French on six of the seven tokenizers. Regional and overseas languages of France pay roughly 1.6 to 3.3 times the English count. We discuss how history re-sending, tiered pricing and fixed context windows amplify the absolute gap in agentic use. In a controlled experiment (BPE, Europarl, 50k vocabulary), adding French to tokenizer training data quickly reduces the premium, with diminishing returns and a growing cost for English. Finally, we present Baracoda FR v1.2, a byte-level BPE prototype with Tekken's vocabulary size. On a final test of six corpora never consulted during design, with a protocol declared fixed beforehand, it uses 11.5% fewer tokens than Tekken on French and 3.7% fewer on English; results hold after removing test sentences overlapping the training data and with an equal ordinary-token budget. It is worse on other languages and, at comparable vocabulary size, does not outperform CroissantLLM. These are segmentation results only; effects on model quality and task cost remain to be shown.

AI.tldr: 该文测量不同语言在主流模型分词器下的token溢价，并发布法语优化分词器Baracoda FR v1.2原型。
AI.motivation: LLM按token计费且上下文窗口以token计量，但相同内容在不同语言中所需token数不同，可能导致非英语用户成本更高、可用上下文更少，尤其在代理式使用中因历史重发、分层定价和固定窗口而被放大。
AI.method: 在NTREX-128的124种非英语参考译文和《世界人权宣言》区域语言上，评测2026年常用模型的七个分词器：OpenAI o200k、Llama 3、Qwen3、DeepSeek V3/V4、Gemma 3、Mistral Tekken及通过Anthropic计数API的Claude第5代分词器；另做BPE、Europarl、50k词表的受控实验，加入法语训练数据；提出字节级BPE原型Baracoda FR v1.2，并在六个未参与设计语料上按预先固定协议测试，同时去除与训练数据重叠的测试句并做等普通token预算比较。
AI.result: 法语比英语多需31%至58%的token；简体中文为少5%到多40%，且在七个分词器中六个比法语便宜；法国区域及海外语言约为英语的1.6至3.3倍。受控实验中加入法语可快速降低法语溢价，但收益递减且英语成本上升。Baracoda FR v1.2在法语上比Tekken少用11.5% token，英语少3.7%，去除重叠和等预算后结果仍成立；但在其他语言更差，且同词表规模下未超过CroissantLLM。
AI.conclusion: 语言间token计数差异会造成成本和上下文不平等，分词器训练数据会影响溢价，但该文结果仅为分词/切分层面，对模型质量与任务成本的实际影响仍待验证。

title: More Choices, Fewer Decisions: Ordinal-Scale Bias in JEV-like Direct-Decision Models
summary: Direct-decision models turn text into low-latency structured labels and scores, making them attractive for classification and automatic evaluation. Yet reliability requires more than accuracy: a model must also use the ordinal decision scale supplied by the user faithfully. We analyze JEV~1.13 and three open KEV models. Our investigation begins with ANLI, where JEV assigns 38.8\% of all predictions and 51.3\% of errors to Neutral despite 74.95\% accuracy, nearly balanced gold labels, and balanced candidate positions. Across 36 ordinal datasets, final decisions use only 67--76\% of the effective gold support, versus 87--102\% on four nominal tasks. Randomizing candidate order weakens but does not remove this compression. Holding items and source scores fixed while balancing gold support and positions, we refine scales from $K=2$ to $14$; utilization falls for every model and reaches 26--75\% at $K=14$, although candidate probabilities remain broad for most models. Targeted BA-LoRA post-training raises gold-relative utilization from roughly 47\% to 86\% on eight supervised scales at both KEV sizes, showing that the compression is learned and modifiable rather than an immutable architectural limit. We call this ordinal scale-utilization bias: decision-stage candidate-space compression distinct from accuracy, gold imbalance, fixed position, and candidate count alone. The code and data are available at https://github.com/Glax147/jev_ordinal_scale_bia

AI.tldr: 论文研究直接决策模型在有序分类/自动评估中的“序数尺度利用偏差”：模型虽准确率尚可，却不能忠实使用用户给定的有序决策尺度，导致候选空间压缩。
AI.motivation: 可靠的有序决策不仅要求准确，还要求模型忠实利用用户提供的序数决策尺度；现有模型可能只依赖少数标签或分数，存在被忽视的可靠性问题。
AI.method: 分析 JEV 1.13 与三个开源 KEV 模型；从 ANLI 入手，比较 36 个有序数据集与四个名义任务；通过随机化候选顺序、固定样本与源分数并平衡金标支持与位置，将尺度从 K=2 细化到 K=14；并尝试 BA-LoRA 后训练进行干预。
AI.result: JEV 在 ANLI 上准确率 74.95%，却有 38.8% 预测和 51.3% 错误集中于 Neutral；36 个有序数据集的最终决策仅利用 67–76% 有效金标支持，而四个名义任务为 87–102%；K=14 时所有模型利用率降至 26–75%，但多数模型候选概率仍较宽；BA-LoRA 在两种 KEV 规模、八个监督尺度上把金标相对利用率从约 47% 提升到 86%。
AI.conclusion: 该现象被命名为序数尺度利用偏差，即决策阶段候选空间压缩，区别于准确率、金标不平衡、固定位置和候选数量本身；它是可学习且可通过后训练修改的，而非不可变的架构限制。代码与数据见 https://github.com/Glax147/jev_ordinal_scale_bia。

title: Diversity Combining for Multi-Path LLM Reasoning
summary: Multi-path reasoning methods such as self-consistency (SC) sample $K$ reasoning paths and choose the most frequent answer. However, their gains quickly plateau as $K$ increases, and existing methods do not predict when this saturation will occur. We formalize multi-path LLM reasoning as a diversity combining problem from wireless communications: each path is a noisy channel observation, and the pairwise correlation of path correctness caps the design-effect effective sample size of the vote at a finite ceiling. Generalized least squares (GLS) analysis shows that, under exchangeability, the optimal symmetric linear combiner of latent embeddings is uniform, supporting majority vote as the natural default in standard SC while leaving room for weighting or pruning under heterogeneous prompt-template branches. Across 5 models and 12 benchmarks, prompt-template diversity reduces path correlation in $55$ of $57$ valid cells, with the strongest effect on open-ended QA. We derive an Adaptive-K rule that uses a four-path pilot to select $K^*$, retaining $96$--$103\%$ of MV@$K{=}32$ accuracy across Math, QA, and NLU.

AI.tldr: 该论文将多路径大模型推理中的自一致性投票形式化为无线通信中的分集合并问题，指出路径正确性之间的相关性会限制有效样本量并导致性能饱和，并提出利用提示模板多样性和自适应K策略来缓解该问题。
AI.motivation: 自一致性等多路径推理方法随着采样路径数K增加，性能提升会迅速饱和，但现有方法无法预测饱和何时发生，也无法有效判断是否应继续增加K。
AI.method: 论文将多路径LLM推理建模为分集合并问题，把每条推理路径视为含噪信道观测；使用广义最小二乘（GLS）分析线性组合器，并研究提示模板多样性对路径相关性的影响；进一步提出基于四条路径试点选择K*的Adaptive-K规则。
AI.result: 在5个模型和12个基准上，提示模板多样性在55/57个有效单元中降低了路径相关性，尤其在开放式问答中效果最强；Adaptive-K在Math、QA和NLU任务上保留了MV@K=32准确率的96%–103%。
AI.conclusion: 路径正确性的成对相关性会将投票的有效样本量限制在有限上限，因此标准自一致性中均匀多数投票是自然默认选择；在异构提示模板分支下仍有加权或剪枝空间，并且自适应选择K可在几乎不损失准确率的情况下提升推理效率。

title: Evidence First, Arithmetic Second: A System Report and Failure Analysis for DocSem
comment: 5 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Accepted as a shared-task system paper at DocInsights 2026, co-located with EMNLP 2026
summary: EVICALC, our system for the DocSem shared task, achieved 8.61% joint accuracy on 1,730 tasks in the official final test evaluation. It reads a PDF, selects a passage, asks a language model to write an arithmetic expression, and evaluates that expression in local code. Saved intermediate results support inspection of failures. A separate public-validation run achieved 92.17% answer accuracy and 1.00 evidence F1. The configurations and metrics differ, so these scores are not a controlled comparison. Our manual, post-hoc analysis is descriptive: in one inspected case, optical character recognition (OCR) and block grouping merged the relevant passage into another block, and the system answered from unrelated text. An exploratory study of reading page images on 100 documents returned evidence identifiers for only 22 documents. These descriptive findings motivate further evaluation; they do not establish the causes of the overall score.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍DocSem共享任务系统EVICALC：它读取PDF、选择段落、让语言模型生成算术表达式并在本地求值。官方最终测试联合准确率为8.61%，公开验证运行答案准确率为92.17%、证据F1为1.00，但两者配置和指标不同，不构成受控比较。
AI.motivation: 参与DocSem共享任务，构建能够从PDF中定位证据并进行算术计算的系统，同时通过保存中间结果和事后分析理解系统失败情况。
AI.method: 系统读取PDF，选择相关段落，调用语言模型生成算术表达式，并在本地代码中求值；保存中间结果以支持失败检查。作者还进行了人工事后描述性分析，并在100份文档上探索读取页面图像以返回证据标识。
AI.result: 官方最终测试在1730个任务上联合准确率为8.61%。公开验证运行达到92.17%答案准确率和1.00证据F1，但因配置与指标不同，不能直接比较。分析发现一例中OCR和块分组将相关段落合并到其他块，导致系统依据无关文本作答；100份文档的探索性研究中仅22份返回证据标识。
AI.conclusion: 这些描述性发现提示需要进一步评估，但并不能确定总体得分的原因；最终测试得分较低，且与公开验证结果之间缺乏受控比较。

title: A Missing Piece for Trustworthy AI Reviewers: From Benchmarking Rhetorical Robustness to SciCore Review
comment: 35 pages, 2 figures, 20 tables. Accepted (Oral) at AI-Native Academia @ NeurIPS 2026
summary: AI reviewers can assign different judgments to manuscripts that report the same science in different wording, potentially rewarding rhetorical optimization over scientific improvement. We formulate Rhetorical Robustness as the joint requirement of stability across content-preserving rewrites and discrimination across papers. We introduce RobustReview, a controlled full-manuscript benchmark with 1,260 manuscript versions, and evaluate 30 reviewer configurations. The benchmark reveals false robustness, where low rewrite sensitivity coincides with score collapse across papers, and shows that human alignment and rhetorical robustness rank reviewers differently. Moreover, the evaluated content-focused prompting protocol does not consistently improve robustness across backbones. Motivated by these findings, we introduce SciCore, a dual-branch reviewer that averages a full-manuscript judgment with a judgment based on an extracted, structured science core. This design combines manuscript-level assessment with a content-normalized view intended to reduce rhetorical sensitivity. In our primary GPT-5.5 comparison, SciCore achieves a leading joint stability-discrimination profile among the benchmarked reviewers while maintaining competitive human alignment. These results identify rhetorical robustness as a distinct evaluation target and demonstrate the potential of science-core review to improve it.

AI.tldr: 论文提出修辞稳健性这一AI审稿评价目标，并构建RobustReview基准，发现现有审稿配置存在假稳健性等问题；进而提出双分支审稿器SciCore，以结构化科学核心判断来降低对修辞改写的敏感性。
AI.motivation: AI审稿人可能因稿件措辞不同而对同一科学内容给出不同判断，从而奖励修辞优化而非科学改进。因此需要将跨内容保持型改写的稳定性与跨论文的区分性联合起来考察。
AI.method: 作者提出RobustReview，一个受控的全稿基准，包含1260个稿件版本，并评估30种审稿人配置。随后提出SciCore，一种双分支审稿器，将全稿判断与基于抽取出的结构化科学核心的判断进行平均，以结合稿件级评估与内容归一化视角。
AI.result: 基准揭示出假稳健性，即低改写敏感性与跨论文评分塌缩同时出现；人类对齐与修辞稳健性对审稿人的排序不同；内容聚焦提示协议在不同主干模型上未能一致提升稳健性。在主要GPT-5.5比较中，SciCore在基准审稿人中取得领先的稳定性-区分性联合表现，同时保持有竞争力的人类对齐。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果将修辞稳健性确立为一个独立的评价目标，并表明科学核心审稿在提升该目标方面具有潜力。

title: NEXUS: Perceptive Whole-Body Control for Terrain-Adaptive Teleoperation
summary: Whole-body teleoperation requires a humanoid robot to reproduce a human operator's behavior even when their terrains differ. This demands that the robot perceive local terrain and adapt its posture and contacts accordingly, rather than copy the operator's motion frame by frame. However, paired motion data linking the same behaviors across flat ground and different terrains remain scarce, limiting supervision for learning terrain-adaptive control. To enable whole-body teleoperation across mismatched terrains, we introduce NEXUS, a perceptive whole-body control framework that combines human motion commands with onboard sensory feedback. We first develop a scalable terrain-aware adaptation algorithm that efficiently generates high-quality motion pairs across motions and terrains without per-motion or per-terrain tuning. Using a paired motion corpus totaling nearly 1,000 hours, we train a perceptive whole-body controller through teacher-student learning to reproduce commanded behaviors across terrains. Experiments demonstrate efficient, scalable generation of high-quality motion data and show that NEXUS combines broad behavioral coverage with terrain adaptability and tracking fidelity, outperforming existing whole-body controllers on the evaluated benchmarks. Zero-shot real-world deployment enables real-time whole-body teleoperation on diverse unseen terrains, further validating the generalization of our method. Project website: https://nexus-humanoid.github.io/

AI.tldr: NEXUS 是一个感知式全身控制框架，用于让仿人机器人在地形不匹配时仍能通过全身遥操作复现人类操作者行为。它结合人类运动指令与机载传感反馈，并利用大规模配对运动数据训练控制器，实现跨地形适应与真实世界零样本部署。
AI.motivation: 现有全身遥操作通常要求机器人逐帧复制操作者动作，但人与机器人所处地形可能不同，因此机器人需要感知局部地形并调整姿态与接触。然而，同一行为在平地与不同地形间的配对运动数据稀缺，限制了地形自适应控制的学习监督。
AI.method: 提出 NEXUS 感知式全身控制框架，将人类运动指令与机载感知反馈结合。开发可扩展的地形自适应算法，无需针对每种运动或地形调参即可高效生成高质量配对运动数据；构建近 1000 小时配对运动语料，并通过教师-学生学习训练感知式全身控制器。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法能高效、可扩展地生成高质量运动数据；NEXUS 在行为覆盖广度、地形适应性和跟踪保真度上优于现有全身控制器。真实世界零样本部署实现了在多种未见地形上的实时全身遥操作，验证了泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: NEXUS 通过结合人类运动指令与机载感知反馈，并利用大规模配对运动数据训练，实现了跨不匹配地形的全身遥操作。其在仿真基准和真实世界部署中均展现出良好适应性与泛化性。

title: Event-Driven Refresh and Recurrence Memory to Reduce Stale Grounding in Referring Video Object Segmentation
summary: Referring Video Object Segmentation (RVOS) aims to produce a pixel-accurate mask sequence for an object specified by natural language. Sa2VA combines a multimodal large language model with SAM2 for grounded segmentation; however, its inference typically grounds the query from a small fixed set of initial keyframes and then relies on propagation. In long or dynamic videos, this can cause stale grounding and persistent false positives when the object composition changes (e.g., distractors enter or the target disappears/re-appears). We propose Event-Driven Refresh + Recurrence Memory (EDRRM), an enhancement that selectively re-invokes Sa2VA only at stable change points. EDRRM triggers refresh boundaries using an EMA-smoothed event score computed from tracking-derived cues (births/deaths and coarse composition/layout changes) with temporal constraints. A recurrence memory further retrieves anchor frames via CLIP similarity to re-condition the model on re-appearance events. Experiments on Ref-DAVIS17, MeViS, and ReVOS show that EDRRM achieves a competitive accuracy-efficiency trade-off relative to fixed-window and FrameDiff-SSIM baselines, maintaining comparable or superior J&F scores at substantially lower average refresh-call budgets and reducing false-positive failures. End-to-end runtime analysis further confirms that the overhead introduced by tracking, CLIP-based recurrence matching, and the identifiability gate remains modest relative to the dominant Sa2VA inference cost, thereby validating the efficiency of the proposed pipeline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EDRRM，用于增强Sa2VA在参考视频目标分割中的长视频/动态视频表现，通过事件驱动刷新与复发记忆减少陈旧定位和持续误报，在多个数据集上实现精度与效率的较好权衡。
AI.motivation: Sa2VA通常从少量固定初始关键帧进行定位，再依赖传播；在长视频或动态视频中，当目标组成变化（干扰物进入、目标消失/重现）时，会导致定位过时和持续误报。
AI.method: EDRRM包含事件驱动刷新和复发记忆：利用跟踪线索（目标出现/消失及粗粒度组成/布局变化）计算EMA平滑事件分数，并结合时间约束在稳定变化点选择性重新调用Sa2VA；同时通过CLIP相似度检索锚帧，在目标重现事件中重新条件化模型。
AI.result: 在Ref-DAVIS17、MeViS和ReVOS上，EDRRM相比固定窗口和FrameDiff-SSIM基线取得有竞争力的精度-效率权衡，在显著降低平均刷新调用预算的同时保持相当或更优的J&F分数，并减少误报失败。
AI.conclusion: 端到端运行时分析表明，跟踪、CLIP复发匹配和可识别性门控带来的开销相对于主要Sa2VA推理成本仍然较小，验证了该流程的效率。

title: RSIGame: Autonomous Agentic Game Development with Recursive Self-improvement
summary: Recent advances in large language models have made automatic game generation increasingly feasible, yet reliably improving generated games beyond a playable version remains challenging. Naive iterative refinement can easily overfit a small set of test cases, producing fragile games with unresolved bugs, missing behaviors, and poor generalization to broader player interactions. We introduce RSIGame, an autonomous agentic game development framework with recursive self-improvement. RSIGame organizes development into complementary local and global loops. Concretely, a local explore-diagnose-improve loop broadly explores the executable game, diagnoses and prioritizes discovered issues, and performs evidence-grounded revision, where an evolving checklist continually accumulates new testing and improvement guidance. A global loop tracks overall quality, preserves the best checkpoint, and detects saturation or regression over long-horizon development. Beyond test-time improvement, RSIGame further internalizes successful development experience into the generator through training. Across 140 GameCraft-Bench tasks, two game engines, and five generators, RSIGame consistently improves game quality under matched development budgets. Notably, experience internalization enables Qwen3.8-27B to reach 61.38 on Godot and 58.53 on Phaser, exceeding GPT-5.5 one-shot scores while reducing Qwen's generation tokens by 11 times.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RSIGame——一个具备递归自我改进能力的自主智能体游戏开发框架，通过局部与全局双循环迭代提升生成游戏质量，并将成功经验内化到生成器中。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型虽使自动游戏生成变得可行，但朴素迭代式改进容易过拟合少量测试用例，产生漏洞未修复、行为缺失且泛化性差的脆弱游戏，难以在可玩版本基础上可靠提升质量。
AI.method: RSIGame将开发过程组织为互补的局部与全局循环：局部“探索—诊断—改进”循环广泛探索可执行游戏、诊断并排序发现的问题、进行有证据支撑的修改，并通过不断演化的检查清单积累新的测试与改进指引；全局循环追踪整体质量、保留最佳检查点、检测长程开发中的饱和或退化。此外，框架还将成功的开发经验通过训练内化进生成器。
AI.result: 在140个GameCraft-Bench任务、两个游戏引擎和五种生成器上，RSIGame在相同开发预算下持续提升游戏质量；经验内化使Qwen3.8-27B在Godot上达到61.38、Phaser上达到58.53，超过GPT-5.5的一次性生成得分，同时将Qwen的生成token减少11倍。
AI.conclusion: RSIGame能够有效缓解迭代改进中的过拟合与脆弱性问题，在多种任务、引擎和生成器上稳定提升游戏质量，并可通过经验内化显著增强生成器能力与效率。

title: When Context Changes: Understanding Update Failures in LLMs
summary: As preferences, goals, and facts change, LLM agents must use the current state while earlier versions remain in context. Yet they can answer with an old value of the same variable, a failure that we call stale binding. To study when models use outdated information and why, we introduce Controlled In-Context Memory (CICM), a benchmark for tracking and using updated information in conversations and agent logs. We observe that even frontier reasoning models can fail to recover the current state. We find that in open-source models probes can still recover the updated value when the model answers with an old one, pointing to a failure to select information that remains available. Component tests in Qwen and Pythia identify a mechanism for this selection failure: attention drift, where attention favors old values over the current one when producing an answer. We study a one-layer transformer to mathematically understand how this phenomenon happens: when attention scores are similar, several old values can together receive more attention than the current value. Guided by this explanation, we redirect attention toward the current value without further training. When the current value is requested directly, adjusting this intervention for each input corrects most old-value errors across various model families while preserving nearly all initially correct answers. Reliable context management therefore requires more than remembering updated information: models must use it to guide their answers.

AI.tldr: 论文研究LLM智能体在上下文中同时存在旧值和新值时，仍可能使用过期信息的问题，称为“陈旧绑定”。作者提出CICM基准，发现该失败源于注意力漂移，并给出无需训练即可纠正多数旧值错误的注意力干预方法。
AI.motivation: 随着偏好、目标和事实变化，LLM智能体需要使用当前状态，但早期版本仍留在上下文中，模型可能回答同一变量的旧值，导致不可靠的上下文管理。
AI.method: 提出Controlled In-Context Memory（CICM）基准，用于对话和智能体日志中跟踪与使用更新信息；结合探针分析、Qwen和Pythia组件测试、单层Transformer数学分析，以及无需训练的注意力重定向干预。
AI.result: 即使是前沿推理模型也可能无法恢复当前状态；开源模型中，即使模型回答旧值，探针仍可恢复更新值。机制为注意力漂移：注意力分数相近时，多个旧值可共同获得比当前值更多注意力。针对输入调整干预后，可在多个模型家族中纠正大多数旧值错误，并几乎保留所有原本正确的回答。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的上下文管理不仅要求记住更新信息，还要求模型用更新信息指导回答；通过干预注意力选择当前值可有效缓解陈旧绑定问题。

title: Function beyond Form: Functional Correspondence for Cross-Embodiment Dexterous Grasp Generation
summary: Cross-embodiment dexterous grasp generation remains challenging because robotic hands differ substantially in geometry, topology, and kinematics. Existing approaches often lack explicit correspondences between structurally different hand regions that play similar functional roles in a grasp, a concept we refer to as functional correspondence. Consequently, their models tend to learn hand-specific interaction patterns rather than transferable grasp knowledge, limiting generalization to unseen hands. To address this limitation, we introduce FunCo-Grasp, which establishes functional correspondences across heterogeneous hand embodiments. Specifically, Functional Part Alignment aligns each hand to a canonical functional schema by mapping physical links to shared functional parts according to their grasping roles, while Canonical Frame Alignment expresses these parts in canonical local frames. These two alignments provide a consistent representation for inter-part and hand-object interactions, allowing the model to learn transferable grasp knowledge across hands. Conditioned on the aligned hand representation and object geometry, a diffusion model generates the target spatial arrangement of the functional parts, which are then converted into an executable joint configuration. Adapting FunCo-Grasp to an unseen hand requires only its geometric and kinematic models and a one-time lightweight functional annotation, without target-hand grasp data, fine-tuning, or learned retargeting. In simulation on held-out objects from the filtered CMapDataset, we achieves average success rates of 92.40% on three seen hands and 74.02% on four unseen hands. In real-world experiments, the same model achieves an overall success rate of 76.00% on two unseen hands without additional training or fine-tuning. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of FunCo-Grasp in transferring grasp knowledge to unseen hands.

AI.tldr: 提出 FunCo-Grasp，通过建立异构机械手之间的功能对应，实现跨本体灵巧抓取生成，并能无需目标手抓取数据、微调或学习式重定向即可泛化到未见手。
AI.motivation: 跨不同机械手的灵巧抓取生成仍很困难，因为机械手在几何、拓扑和运动学上差异显著。现有方法往往缺乏结构不同但功能相似的手部区域之间的显式对应，导致模型学到的是特定手的交互模式，而非可迁移的抓取知识，泛化到未见手时受限。
AI.method: FunCo-Grasp 引入两种对齐：功能部件对齐将每只手的物理连杆按抓取角色映射到共享功能部件，形成规范功能模式；规范坐标系对齐在规范局部坐标系中表达这些部件。基于对齐后的手部表示和物体几何，使用扩散模型生成功能部件的目标空间布局，再转换为可执行关节配置。适配未见手只需其几何与运动学模型以及一次性轻量功能标注。
AI.result: 在 filtered CMapDataset 的留出物体仿真中，三只已见手平均成功率为 92.40%，四只未见手为 74.02%；真实世界实验中，同一模型在两只未见手上无需额外训练或微调达到总体成功率 76.00%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，FunCo-Grasp 能有效建立异构手之间的功能对应，学习可迁移的抓取知识，并成功泛化到未见机械手。

title: Talk2Agent: Benchmarking Voice Interfaces for Text Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) computer-use agents are typically evaluated with clean written instructions, despite speech being an increasingly popular interface for interacting with such systems. Speech input introduces an additional failure point: transcription errors can alter task-critical entities, constraints, or targets before the agent begins reasoning, while conventional ASR metrics do not directly measure whether the information required for successful execution has been preserved. We introduce Talk2Agent, a benchmark for evaluating how effectively voice interfaces convey human-spoken instructions to LLM-based computer-use agents. Talk2Agent builds human-spoken versions of tasks from WildClawBench and OSWorld and evaluates a range of voice interfaces, including dedicated ASR models, audio-capable LLMs, contextual biasing, and LLM-based ontology repair. Because repeatedly executing long-horizon computer-use tasks is costly and stochastic, we further propose an execution-free, task-conditioned evaluation framework that projects the original task grader onto prompt-addressable intentions and measures how much task-relevant information is retained after the voice interface. On WildClawBench, Talk2Agent's execution-free native projection provides a practical, execution-grounded measure of voice-interface quality, correlating with downstream task completion and improving Pearson correlation by 0.246 over WER/CER on 32 hours of real human speech.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Talk2Agent 基准，用于评估语音接口如何将人类口述指令传递给基于大语言模型的计算机使用智能体，并关注转录错误对任务关键信息的影响。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 计算机使用智能体通常基于干净的文本指令评估，但语音正成为重要交互方式；语音输入会引入转录错误，可能改变任务关键实体、约束或目标，而传统 ASR 指标无法直接衡量成功执行所需信息是否被保留。
AI.method: Talk2Agent 基于 WildClawBench 和 OSWorld 构建人类口述任务版本，评估专用 ASR 模型、音频 LLM、上下文偏置和基于 LLM 的本体修复等语音接口；并因长时程任务执行成本高且随机性强，提出免执行、任务条件化的评估框架，将原始任务评分器投影到提示可寻址意图上，衡量语音接口后任务相关信息的保留程度。
AI.result: 在 WildClawBench 上，Talk2Agent 的免执行原生投影提供了实用的、基于执行依据的语音接口质量度量，与下游任务完成情况相关；在 32 小时真实人类语音上，其 Pearson 相关性比 WER/CER 提高 0.246。
AI.conclusion: 语音接口质量应通过任务相关信息是否被保留来评估，而 Talk2Agent 提供了一种无需反复执行长时程任务、且比传统 ASR 指标更能预测下游任务完成情况的方法。

title: Distill the Visual Evidence, Not Just the Answer: Cross-World On-Policy Distillation for Vision-Language Models
summary: A central goal of vision-language model (VLM) distillation is to transfer both the teacher's language capabilities and its visual understanding. However, existing methods primarily supervise the student's output, leaving visual understanding implicit. Our analysis reveals that a student can match the teacher's answer without relying on the same visual evidence, raising the question: how can we ensure the student responds to the visual information that actually determines the answer? To this end, we propose \textbf{Cross-World On-Policy Distillation (CW-OPD)}, which explicitly supervises the student's response to changes in visual evidence. For each example, CW-OPD constructs two visual worlds that share the question and scene context but differ in answer-critical evidence, yielding different answers. We perform on-policy distillation in both worlds and distill the teacher's cross-world belief transition, encouraging the student to match not only \emph{what} the teacher predicts but also \emph{why} its prediction changes with the evidence. A gradient analysis shows that this term is invariant to errors shared by both worlds and supplies a corrective signal invisible to endpoint matching alone. In this way, CW-OPD makes reliance on the relevant visual evidence an explicit distillation target rather than an implicit consequence of output matching. To diagnose whether a model truly grounds its answers in visual evidence, we introduce CWBench, which measures cross-world consistency via Cross-World Pair Accuracy (CWPA). Experiments on Qwen3.5-4B show that CW-OPD outperforms the strongest baseline by \textbf{1.2} points on average, and the 4B student exceeds DeepSeek-V4.1 (552B) by \textbf{22.4} CWPA points on CWBench. Code is released in https://github.com/baokou-fw2/CWAD.

AI.tldr: 论文提出跨世界On-Policy蒸馏（CW-OPD），通过构造答案关键视觉证据不同的两个视觉世界，显式监督学生随视觉证据变化而变化的回答，从而将视觉理解与证据依赖变为蒸馏目标；同时提出CWBench与CWPA诊断模型是否真正基于视觉证据作答。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM蒸馏主要监督学生输出，视觉理解是隐式的。分析发现学生可能未依赖与教师相同的视觉证据也能匹配答案，因此需要确保学生回应真正决定答案的视觉信息。
AI.method: 为每个样本构造两个共享问题与场景、但答案关键证据不同的视觉世界，并产生不同答案；在两个世界中执行on-policy蒸馏，蒸馏教师的跨世界信念转变，使学生不仅匹配教师预测什么，也匹配预测为何随证据变化。梯度分析表明该项对两世界共同错误不变，并提供端点匹配无法提供的纠正信号。还提出CWBench，用跨世界配对准确率（CWPA）衡量跨世界一致性。
AI.result: 在Qwen3.5-4B上，CW-OPD平均超过最强基线1.2分；4B学生在CWBench上的CWPA超过DeepSeek-V4.1（552B）22.4点。
AI.conclusion: CW-OPD将依赖相关视觉证据作为显式蒸馏目标，而非输出匹配的隐式结果，从而促进学生真正基于视觉证据作答，并提供诊断视觉 grounding 的基准。

title: CRAFT: Causal Responsibility and Failure Tracing in Medical Vision Language Models
summary: As vision language models are increasingly deployed in clinical diagnosis, understanding how they internally resolve competing visual and textual signals becomes a safety imperative. Existing mechanistic analyses remain confined to unimodal text and offer no explanation for why a single misleading sentence can override a correct image based diagnosis, or why a model commits to a confident answer despite insufficient visual evidence. We find that these two safety risks, arbitration failure where textual context overrides visual grounding and brake failure where the model commits without adequate evidence, are mediated by spatially disjoint attention head populations: arbitration heads form a mid-to-deep wideband reflecting cross-layer evidence competition, while brake heads concentrate in a narrow middle-to-late layer band that regulates evidence sufficiency and abstention behavior. To ground these observations in causal circuitry, we introduce CRAFT, which localizes each failure mode to a minimal causal head set via dual criteria and verifies necessity and sufficiency through temporal probes and Tuned Lens trajectory analysis. Excising arbitration heads sharply reduces conflict following with negligible degradation on clean inputs, while excising brake heads restores appropriate abstention under degraded visual evidence. The two interventions target spatially disjoint head sets and produce distinct corrective effects, underscoring the mechanistic separability of the failure modes. Experiments across multiple medical VQA benchmarks and VLM architectures validate both the localization and interventions, demonstrating that the identified heads causally drive each failure mode and that targeted modulation generalises without retraining. The code is available at GitHub repository.

AI.tldr: 本文从机制可解释性角度研究医疗视觉语言模型的两类安全失效：文本误导覆盖图像判断的“仲裁失效”，以及视觉证据不足时仍强行作答的“刹车失效”，并提出CRAFT定位与干预相应注意力头。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型在临床诊断中日益部署，但现有机制分析多局限于纯文本模型，无法解释单句误导文本为何能覆盖正确图像诊断，以及模型为何在视觉证据不足时仍给出高置信答案。
AI.method: 作者定位两类失效对应的空间分离注意力头群体：仲裁头分布于中深层宽带，刹车头集中于中后层窄带。提出CRAFT，通过双重标准将每种失效定位到最小因果头集合，并用时间探针和Tuned Lens轨迹分析验证其必要性与充分性；通过消融相关头进行干预。
AI.result: 消融仲裁头可显著减少模型跟随冲突文本，且对干净输入性能影响很小；消融刹车头可在视觉证据退化时恢复适当拒答。两种干预针对空间分离的头集合，产生不同纠正效果。多个医疗VQA基准和VLM架构实验验证了定位与干预的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 两类安全失效在机制上可分离，由特定注意力头因果驱动；针对这些头的定向调制无需重训练即可泛化，为医疗VLM安全诊断提供机制性干预路径。

title: OpenJev-RLCD: A Working RLCD Implementation
summary: Decision models such as Jev answer questions with probabilities, which are only useful if they are calibrated. Open-source reproductions rely on supervised fine-tuning plus temperature scaling, while reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) makes reasoning models overconfident. We present a working implementation of reinforcement learning for calibrated decisions (RLCD) for reasoning models: the model samples a rationale, and we score the answer distribution it commits to afterwards with a strictly proper scoring rule. A variance identity shows that scoring the mixture of several samples rewards disagreeing rationales, and that RLVR is exactly this mixture objective without its diversity term. Optimized naively, the per-rationale objective either switches reasoning off or is drowned out by policy-gradient noise, which leads to a two-stage recipe: calibrate, then reinforce. With Qwen3-1.7B on two reasoning tasks (3 seeds, paired tests), RLCD matches or beats SFT, RFT/STaR and GRPO (each temperature-scaled) in accuracy and beats all of them in selective prediction; on GSM8K answer verification a single query decides \gvTwoCovFive\% of the items at $\le$5\% error, versus \gvGrpoCovFive\% for GRPO. When uncertainty comes from annotator disagreement, RLCD provably cannot beat cross-entropy. Code and results: https://github.com/ZimmyGao/openjev-rlcd.

AI.tldr: 论文提出用于推理模型校准决策的强化学习方法 RLCD：模型先采样推理过程，再对其最终答案分布用严格proper评分规则打分，并通过“先校准、后强化”的两阶段流程提升准确率与选择性预测。
AI.motivation: 决策模型给出的概率只有在校准后才有用；现有开源复现多依赖SFT加温度缩放，而基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）会让推理模型过度自信。
AI.method: RLCD让模型采样rationale，并对答案分布用严格proper scoring rule评分。方差恒等式表明，对多个样本的混合分布评分会奖励彼此分歧的rationale，而RLVR正是去掉多样性项的混合目标。由于直接优化会使推理关闭或被策略梯度噪声淹没，作者采用两阶段方法：先校准，再强化。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-1.7B和两个推理任务上（3个随机种子、配对检验），RLCD在准确率上匹配或超过经温度缩放的SFT、RFT/STaR和GRPO，并在选择性预测上优于全部基线；在GSM8K答案验证中，单次查询在≤5%错误率下的覆盖比例高于GRPO。
AI.conclusion: RLCD能有效提升推理模型的校准决策能力，但当归结不确定性来自标注者分歧时，它可证明无法超过交叉熵。代码与结果已开源。

title: Reasoning Externalization for Faithful Large Language Model Narratives of Stock Return Predictions
summary: In finance, interpreting machine learning predictions is essential, yet the numerical outputs of explainable AI can be difficult for non-experts to understand. While large language models (LLMs) can translate these outputs into natural language, they may produce errors when inferring numerical changes and feature relations. We propose an LLM narrative framework for cross-sectional stock return prediction that combines temporal Shapley additive explanations (SHAP) evidence with historical regime analogs. Temporal evidence tracks changes in the normalized global SHAP importance of an XGBoost model over six months. Historical analogs are past periods with similar changes in SHAP importance, their model performance and subsequent market returns are provided as comparative context. Using this framework, we conduct a controlled study of progressive reasoning externalization, sequentially providing raw SHAP sequences, deterministic temporal descriptors, and feature relations. Each generated claim is verified against provenance-linked evidence. Across Qwen3, externalizing numerical and relational reasoning improved evidence faithfulness as well as temporal and relational accuracy. Evidence faithfulness increased from 0.696 to 0.996 for Qwen3-32B-Instruct. While historical analogs did not improve structured automatic faithfulness, they received higher human-rated usefulness scores. These results suggest that externalizing verifiable reasoning enhances narrative faithfulness and that historical context adds interpretive value.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个面向横截面股票收益预测的LLM叙事框架，将时间SHAP证据与历史相似市场状态结合，并通过逐步外化推理提升解释的忠实度与可验证性。
AI.motivation: 金融中机器学习预测的可解释性很重要，但可解释AI的数值输出对非专家难以理解；LLM虽可将其转成自然语言，却在推断数值变化和特征关系时容易出错。
AI.method: 使用XGBoost模型，追踪其归一化全局SHAP重要性在六个月内的变化作为时间证据；检索SHAP重要性变化相似的历史时期作为类比，并提供模型表现与后续市场收益作为比较背景。开展受控研究，逐步外化推理：依次提供原始SHAP序列、确定性时间描述和特征关系，并对每条生成声明用溯源证据进行验证。
AI.result: 在Qwen3上，外化数值与关系推理提升了证据忠实度、时间准确性和关系准确性；Qwen3-32B-Instruct的证据忠实度从0.696提升至0.996。历史类比未提升结构化自动忠实度，但在人工评分中获得更高的有用性分数。
AI.conclusion: 外化可验证推理能增强LLM叙事的忠实度，而历史背景则增加了解释价值。

title: Make Code as Policy Great Again: Frontier Agents Write, Call, and Evolve Robot Tools
summary: Frontier models can control robots, but reasoning through every reach, grasp, and retreat makes manipulation slow and token-intensive. We revisit code as policy with a different division of labor: models build executable tools, code handles multi-phase motions, and models decide what to do next. We introduce URAI (Universal Robot-Agent Interface), which couples a programming agent that constructs robot tools with an execution agent that uses them in a feedback loop. The programming agent writes reusable and task-specific tools from task intent and refines them through execution feedback and human guidance. The execution agent selects and parameterizes these tools from current observations; each call runs a complete motion locally before returning control to the agent. Unlike delegating subsequent decisions to a generated program, this design retains model-level decision-making between tool executions. Validated tool revisions persist across episodes without updating foundation-model weights, and a shared GUI and API make the same tools available to humans and agents. Across five RoboDojo tasks and four frozen execution agents, URAI raises aggregate success from 18.0% to 53.0% relative to direct fingertip control, with the largest gain on Swap Blocks; with the same tools, a program written in advance reaches only 24% against 56% for two agents deciding after each call. Three of the four agents also finish episodes 1.3-1.5 times faster with 1.5-1.7 times fewer execution-agent output tokens; DeepSeek-V4-Flash's cost barely changes. We further evaluate URAI on seven real-world AgileX dual-arm tasks, spanning object manipulation, cloth folding, and human-interactive tic-tac-toe. URAI connects the coding and decision-making capabilities of frontier agents, organizing robot control around reusable tools that agents can both invoke and revise.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 URAI（通用机器人-智能体接口），让编程智能体构建可复用的机器人工具，执行智能体在反馈循环中调用并参数化这些工具，从而把多阶段运动交给代码、把下一步决策保留给模型。
AI.motivation: 前沿模型虽能控制机器人，但对每次伸手、抓取和撤回都进行推理会使操作缓慢且消耗大量 token，因此需要重新划分模型与代码的职责。
AI.method: URAI 将编程智能体与执行智能体耦合：编程智能体根据任务意图编写可复用和任务专用工具，并通过执行反馈与人工指导进行改进；执行智能体根据当前观测选择并参数化工具，每次调用在本地完成完整运动后再交回控制权。工具修订经验证后可跨回合持久化，且无需更新基础模型权重；共享 GUI 和 API 使人类与智能体都能使用同一套工具。
AI.result: 在五个 RoboDojo 任务和四个冻结执行智能体上，URAI 相比直接指尖控制将总体成功率从 18.0% 提升到 53.0%，其中 Swap Blocks 提升最大。使用相同工具时，预先写好的程序仅达到 24%，而两个智能体在每次调用后决策达到 56%。四个智能体中有三个完成任务快 1.3-1.5 倍，执行智能体输出 token 少 1.5-1.7 倍；DeepSeek-V4-Flash 的成本几乎不变。URAI 还在七个真实世界 AgileX 双臂任务上评估，涵盖物体操作、折布和人机交互井字棋。
AI.conclusion: URAI 连接了前沿智能体的编码与决策能力，将机器人控制组织为可复用、可调用且可修订的工具，表明代码作为策略与模型级决策相结合能显著提升机器人操作的成功率与效率。

title: Structure vs. Chain-of-Thought: Evaluating LLM Criteria Extraction for Depression Severity
comment: Extended version of a paper accepted at MHSM 2026 (IEEE ICDM 2026 workshop). 14 pages, 1 figure. Code: https://github.com/xinkaichen97/depseverity-artifact
summary: A large language model (LLM) can rate depression severity directly from a social media post or mark which clinical criteria the post shows and let code turn the count into a label. The latter is easier to audit because a clinician can check each marked criterion. We compare these approaches on two Reddit corpora using three LLMs (from 9B to frontier scale) and two questionnaires (PHQ-9, BDI-II), and measure agreement with quadratic weighted kappa. For the two frontier models, criteria extraction scores above chain-of-thought on one corpus only when its decision thresholds are fitted on labeled data. Neither model's gain is significant, with or without recalibrating chain-of-thought on the same labels. With thresholds fixed a priori from PHQ-9's criteria, extraction shows no gain on either corpus, even where models mark over two criteria per post. The 9B model behaves differently on a corpus from depression communities. It labels most posts severe, whether prompted directly or with chain-of-thought, while the a priori rule beats both without labels. After chain-of-thought is recalibrated on the same labels, no significant gap remains, consistent with a calibration effect. Yet higher ordinal agreement does not ensure better detection of severe cases. PHQ-9 criteria extraction misses most severe posts, and moving from direct prompting to chain-of-thought and then to extraction increases misses in nearly all comparisons. On the primary corpus, a relabeled stress dataset, a model using that dataset's own features, including word counts from the text, is not significantly different from frontier criteria extraction under the a priori rule.

AI.tldr: 本文比较LLM直接评估社交媒体帖子抑郁严重程度与提取临床标准再计数生成标签两种方法，在多个Reddit语料、三种LLM和两种问卷上发现：标准提取未必优于直接提示或思维链，且可能漏检更多严重病例。
AI.motivation: 标准提取方法更易审计，因为临床医生可检查每个被标记的标准，因此研究希望验证其是否在抑郁严重程度评估中优于直接评分方法。
AI.method: 使用两个Reddit语料、三个LLM（从9B到前沿规模）和两种问卷（PHQ-9、BDI-II），以二次加权kappa衡量一致性，比较直接提示、思维链和临床标准提取三种策略，并分析阈值拟合、先验阈值、标签重校准及严重病例检测。
AI.result: 前沿模型的标准提取仅在阈值用标注数据拟合时，在一个语料上高于思维链，且增益不显著；使用PHQ-9先验阈值时提取无增益。9B模型在抑郁社区语料中倾向将多数帖子标为严重，先验规则反而更好，但重校准后差距消失。较高序数一致性并不保证更好检测严重病例；PHQ-9标准提取漏掉大多数严重帖，从直接提示到思维链再到提取，漏检在几乎所有比较中增加。在主语料上，使用数据集自身特征（含词数）的模型与先验规则下的前沿标准提取无显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 标准提取的可审计性并不自动带来更优性能或更好的严重病例检测；阈值校准会显著影响结果；直接提示或思维链可能减少严重病例漏检，因此将LLM用于抑郁严重程度评估时应谨慎选择方法并重视校准与严重病例召回。

title: LexReward: A Taxonomy-Driven Reward Framework for Legal Language Models
summary: Legal language models require reward signals that capture not only answer correctness but also the multidimensional quality of legal responses. Existing reward methods, however, often rely on coarse-grained holistic judgments, providing limited domain specificity and interpretability. We introduce LexReward, a taxonomy-driven framework for legal reward modeling. LexReward characterizes legal response quality along three complementary dimensions: Style, covering lexical and syntactic quality; Element, assessing legal subjects, facts, statutes, and decisions; and Chain, evaluating the order, completeness, correctness, and non-redundancy of legal reasoning. For each dimension, we develop rubrics that specify evaluation criteria and quality levels. The resulting rewards are used to construct pairwise preference data for Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) and reward-model training. Experiments show that the rubric-based rewards reliably distinguish legal responses of different quality and that DPO training on the preference data improves performance across all three dimensions. The learned reward models, LexRM, also support effective downstream optimization: each dimension-specific reward model improves policy performance in its corresponding dimension through reinforcement learning, without requiring reference answers at reward time. Dimension-wise analyses further support the effectiveness of the proposed taxonomy and reward construction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LexReward，一个基于分类体系的法律奖励建模框架，从风格、要素和推理链三个维度评估法律回答质量，并用于构建偏好数据、训练奖励模型和优化法律语言模型。
AI.motivation: 现有法律语言模型的奖励信号多依赖粗粒度整体判断，领域特异性与可解释性不足，难以全面反映法律回答的多维质量。
AI.method: 提出三维法律回答质量分类：Style 关注词汇与句法质量；Element 评估法律主体、事实、法条和裁判；Chain 评估法律推理的顺序、完整性、正确性和非冗余性。为每个维度设计评分标准，并据此构建成对偏好数据，用于 DPO 和奖励模型训练，得到 LexRM。
AI.result: 实验表明，基于评分标准的奖励能可靠区分不同质量的法律回答；使用偏好数据进行 DPO 训练可在三个维度上均提升表现；各维度专用奖励模型通过强化学习能提升对应维度的策略表现，且奖励时无需参考答案。
AI.conclusion: 维度化、分类体系驱动的奖励构建能有效提升法律语言模型的多维质量与下游优化效果，并增强领域特异性和可解释性。

title: Looking Back to Move Forward: Temporal Verification for Generative Robot Policies
summary: Generative policies have emerged as a promising paradigm for robot learning, combining expressive generative action modeling with scalable imitation learning from large demonstration corpora. However, heterogeneous demonstrations can induce suboptimal action chunks whose errors compound over time, eventually driving the robot into out-of-distribution states from which recovery is difficult. Action verification offers a test-time scaling strategy for mitigating this failure mode by sampling multiple candidate actions and using a verifier to select one for execution. Existing approaches, however, remain temporally myopic and costly to train, evaluating candidates from the current observation alone without accounting for trajectory continuity and often relying on large verifiers and additional expert demonstrations. In this paper, we introduce Temporal Verification (TeV), an efficient temporally aware action verification framework for flow-matching VLAs. TeV first learns a temporal token that summarizes recent observation--action history, enabling candidate chunks to be evaluated as continuations of the execution trajectory rather than as isolated predictions. Conditioned on this token, TeV constructs positive--negative pairs without additional expert demonstrations or preference annotations and trains an energy-based verifier contrastively to assign lower energy to higher-quality, trajectory-consistent action chunks. Beyond post-hoc ranking, TeV further uses the learned energy landscape to guide intermediate flow samples toward lower-energy regions, improving candidates before final selection. Extensive experiments in simulation and real-world settings demonstrate that TeV provides reliably ranks action candidates, improves task success rates, and produces smoother execution trajectories.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TeV（时序验证），一种面向流匹配VLA模型的高效时序感知动作验证框架。它通过学习时序token总结近期观察-动作历史，以对比方式训练基于能量的验证器，无需额外专家演示即可对候选动作块排序，并利用能量景观引导流采样优化中间动作。
AI.motivation: 生成式策略在机器人学习中前景广阔，但异构演示数据会导致次优动作块，误差随时间累积使机器人进入难以恢复的分布外状态。现有动作验证方法存在时序短视（仅基于当前观测评估候选，忽略轨迹连续性）且训练成本高（依赖大型验证器和额外专家演示）的问题。
AI.method: TeV首先学习一个时序token来总结近期观察-动作历史，使候选动作块作为执行轨迹的延续而非孤立预测被评估。基于该token，TeV无需额外专家演示或偏好标注即可构建正负样本对，并以对比方式训练基于能量的验证器，使更高质量、轨迹一致的动作块获得更低能量。除事后排序外，TeV还利用学到的能量景观引导中间流样本向低能量区域移动，在最终选择前改进候选动作。
AI.result: 在仿真和真实环境中的大量实验表明，TeV能够可靠地对动作候选进行排序，提高任务成功率，并产生更平滑的执行轨迹。
AI.conclusion: TeV是一种高效且时序感知的动作验证框架，通过时序token和能量对比学习解决了现有验证方法短视和昂贵的问题，同时利用能量景观优化生成候选，显著提升了流匹配VLA策略的鲁棒性和执行质量。

title: CORE: Conflict-Oriented Reasoning Elimination for Verifiable Language-Model Search
summary: Test-time reasoning systems often respond to failure by restarting or revising the latest step, even when an earlier decision caused the error. We introduce CORE, a search controller that requests a certified conflict core from a verifier, backjumps to the latest decision in that core, and caches the conflict to avoid repeating it. Under sound verification, finite branching and depth, and exhaustive proposals, the uncapped search is complete and never prunes a valid solution. On 2,000 planted graph-coloring instances with matched proposals and an exact verifier, CORE reduces median verifier calls by 39.8% at 30 variables and 35.0% at 36 variables relative to chronological repair; caching further improves on backjumping alone. Across five reasoning tasks, CORE achieves 75.9% mean success with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and 84.2% with Qwen3-8B, compared with 72.5% and 81.8% for Tree of Thoughts. It also uses fewer verifier calls and generated tokens on both backbones. These results show the value of using certified failure explanations to direct language-model search.

AI.tldr: CORE 是一种搜索控制器，它从验证器获取经过认证的冲突核心，回溯到冲突核心中的最新决策，并缓存冲突以避免重复。该方法在保证完备性的同时，提高了测试时推理的效率和成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有的测试时推理系统在遇到失败时，往往选择重新开始或修改最近一步，即使错误是由更早的决策引起的。这导致了搜索效率低下和重复错误。
AI.method: CORE 向验证器请求经过认证的冲突核心，回溯到核心中的最新决策，并缓存冲突以避免重复。在可靠验证、有限分支和深度以及穷举提议的条件下，无上限搜索是完备的，且不会剪枝有效解。在 2000 个植入图着色实例（匹配提议和精确验证器）以及五个推理任务上，使用 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 和 Qwen3-8B 进行评估。
AI.result: 在 30 个变量和 36 个变量的图着色实例上，CORE 相比时序修复将中位验证器调用次数分别减少了 39.8% 和 35.0%；缓存进一步优于仅回溯。在五个推理任务上，CORE 在 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 上达到 75.9% 的平均成功率，在 Qwen3-8B 上达到 84.2%，而 Tree of Thoughts 分别为 72.5% 和 81.8%。在两个骨干模型上，CORE 还使用了更少的验证器调用和生成的 token。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果表明，利用经过认证的失败解释来指导语言模型搜索是有价值的。

title: OccluDex: Hierarchical 3D Visuo-Tactile Representation Learning for Egocentric Dexterous Manipulation under Self-Occlusion
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: Reliable dexterous manipulation requires continuous estimation of object geometry and hand-object contact throughout interaction. With egocentric sensing, however, the manipulating hand frequently occludes task-relevant object surfaces and contact regions, reducing the visual evidence available for state estimation and thereby making robust closed-loop control and generalization to unseen object geometries particularly challenging. To address this, we present OccluDex, a hierarchical 3D visuo-tactile representation learning framework that integrates global geometric structure with local contact information for robust manipulation under dynamic self-occlusion during hand-object interaction. OccluDex adopts multi-scale masked autoencoding to progressively encode partial 3D geometry and fuses tactile contact tokens with high-level geometric features through cross-modal attention. The encoder is pretrained from synchronized human visuo-tactile demonstrations and transferred as a frozen perceptual backbone for downstream reinforcement learning. We evaluate OccluDex on a faucet rotation task, requiring one full clockwise handle revolution, and a tabletop object reorientation task, requiring a 180-degree tabletop object reorientation without toppling. In simulation experiments, OccluDex demonstrated 12.6% higher accuracy for unseen objects and 8.3% higher accuracy for previously seen objects than the strongest state-of-the-art baseline models. Physical experiments were further performed with a Shadow Hand to demonstrate successful zero-shot sim-to-real generalization on unseen physical objects. This results could enable humanoid egocentric object manipulation for seen and unseen objects even when the manipulating robotic hand occludes vision.

AI.tldr: OccluDex是一种分层3D视触觉表征学习框架，用于解决手部自遮挡下的灵巧操作，通过多尺度掩码自编码和跨模态注意力融合视觉几何与触觉信息，在仿真和真实实验中验证了性能提升和零样本sim-to-real泛化。
AI.motivation: 在自我中心感知中，操作手经常遮挡任务相关的物体表面和接触区域，减少视觉证据，导致状态估计、闭环控制和泛化到新物体几何形状变得困难。
AI.method: 提出OccluDex，分层3D视触觉表征学习框架。采用多尺度掩码自编码逐步编码部分3D几何，并通过跨模态注意力将触觉接触令牌与高层几何特征融合。编码器从同步的人类视触觉演示中预训练，并作为冻结感知骨干转移用于下游强化学习。
AI.result: 在龙头旋转（手柄顺时针一整圈）和桌面物体重定向（180度不翻倒）任务上评估。仿真中，对未见物体准确率比最强SOTA基线高12.6%，对已见物体高8.3%。用Shadow Hand进行物理实验，展示了对未见物理物体的零样本sim-to-real泛化。
AI.conclusion: OccluDex能够在手部遮挡视觉的情况下，实现已见和未见物体的类人自我中心物体操作。

title: Future Video Generation Better Aligns with the Human Visual Cortex than Observed Video
summary: Studying the alignment between the internal representations of vision models and the responses of the visual cortex to the same observed visual stimuli has enabled us to better understand human visual processing. However, studies so far have largely overlooked the fact that the human brain not only processes observed visual stimuli, but also predicts upcoming stimuli based on what has been observed. Accordingly, we hypothesize that internal representations for generating future video frames are better aligned with the predictive nature of human visual processing than representations of the observed video itself. To this end, we compare the alignment between human video-watching fMRI responses in the visual cortex and the internal representations from two types of video diffusion models, an autoregressive (AR) model and its non-AR base model. We first conduct a within-model analysis of the AR video diffusion model and show that the representations for future video generation align better with the visual cortex than the representations of the observed video. We then compare the internal representations of the AR model with those of its non-AR base model and again show that the representations for future video generation align better with the visual cortex than the representations for observed video reconstruction by the base model. Specifically, the alignment of observed video reconstruction is concentrated in lower-order visual cortex, whereas that of future video generation is concentrated in higher-order visual cortex. Finally, we show in a human behavioral experiment that humans prefer videos generated by amplifying the contributions of individual layers that align better with the visual cortex.

AI.tldr: 该研究比较了人类观看视频时的视觉皮层fMRI响应与视频扩散模型内部表示的对齐，发现用于生成未来视频帧的表示比观察视频本身的表示更符合人类视觉皮层的预测性处理，尤其集中在高级视觉皮层。
AI.motivation: 以往研究多关注大脑对已观察视觉刺激的处理，却忽略了人脑还会基于已观察内容预测未来刺激。作者因此假设：用于生成未来视频帧的内部表示，比观察视频本身的表示，更符合人类视觉处理的预测特性。
AI.method: 研究使用人类观看视频时的fMRI响应，比较视觉皮层与两类视频扩散模型内部表示的对齐：自回归（AR）模型及其非AR基模型。进行了AR模型内部比较、AR与非AR模型间比较，并开展人类行为实验，测试人类是否偏好放大与视觉皮层对齐更好的层贡献后生成的视频。
AI.result: AR模型中，用于未来视频生成的表示比观察视频的表示与视觉皮层对齐更好；与非AR基模型相比，未来视频生成表示也比观察视频重建表示对齐更好。观察视频重建的对齐主要集中在低级视觉皮层，而未来视频生成的对齐主要集中在高级视觉皮层。行为实验表明，人类偏好放大与视觉皮层对齐更好的层贡献所生成的视频。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持人类视觉处理具有预测性，生成未来视频帧的模型内部表示能更好捕捉这种预测性视觉处理；视觉皮层对齐也可为视频生成模型的设计与评估提供指导。

title: DCM-SAM: Defect-Conditioned Mixture of LoRA Experts for NPU-Deployed AM Defect Segmentation
comment: 12 pages, 1 figure, 8 tables. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on On-Device Intelligence: Foundation Models under Real-World Constraints (ODI)
summary: Metal additive manufacturing parts are inspected by X-ray computed tomography, where labelled data is scarce, the pores and inclusions that matter span a few pixels, and inspection must happen at the machine. We present DCM-SAM, a defect-conditioned adaptive mixture of LoRA experts: one frozen Segment Anything backbone carries a separate Conv-LoRA expert bank and mask decoder per defect class, each trained in its own pass, without prompts, on synthetic slices alone, updating only 4.4% of the parameters. On benchmarks that XCT-SAM reports, DCM-SAM improves on every baseline for both classes from a ViT-B backbone against their ViT-H, and reaches 64.2% pore IoU on real NIST scans having seen no real images during training. Deployment then exposes what adaptation work rarely measures: on a Qualcomm Hexagon NPU, ViT-H and ViT-L compile yet cannot allocate at 1024x1024 image resolution, since activations rather than weights exceed the device ceiling, and quantizing weights does not help. ViT-B alone runs, but the adapted encoder then fails to allocate where the stock one succeeds, until a numerically identical rewrite of the attention lets the complete DCM-SAM run in FP16 at 1024x1024, with no operator falling back to the CPU, masks within 0.01% of pixels of the FP32 reference. Code: https://github.com/MushfiqShovon/DCM-SAM.

AI.tldr: 提出DCM-SAM，用于金属增材制造XCT缺陷检测：冻结SAM骨干，每类缺陷配独立Conv-LoRA专家和掩码头，仅训4.4%参数，仅用合成切片训练；在真实NIST扫描上孔洞IoU达64.2%，并通过数值等价重写注意力解决Hexagon NPU上1024x1024的FP16部署问题。
AI.motivation: XCT检测中标注数据稀缺、关键孔洞和夹杂仅占几像素，且需在机器端部署。现有大模型在NPU上因激活值而非权重的内存上限无法分配，且权重量化无效，适配与部署脱节。
AI.method: DCM-SAM采用缺陷条件自适应LoRA专家混合：冻结SAM骨干，每个缺陷类有独立Conv-LoRA专家库和掩码解码器，分遍训练、无提示、仅用合成切片，只更新4.4%参数。部署时对注意力进行数值等价重写，使完整模型以FP16在1024x1024运行。
AI.result: 在XCT-SAM基准上，基于ViT-B的DCM-SAM在两个类别上均超过其ViT-H基线；未见真实图像训练下，真实NIST扫描孔洞IoU达64.2%。Hexagon NPU上ViT-H/L在1024x1024无法分配，ViT-B可运行但适配编码器失败；重写后可完整运行FP16，无CPU回退，掩码与FP32参考差异小于0.01%像素。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在少标注、小目标和边缘部署场景中有效，表明模型适配需与硬件部署协同设计；数值等价重写可突破NPU激活内存瓶颈，实现高分辨率FP16推理。

title: CLIPPER Beyond Shortlisting: Auditable Decision Support for Changing Municipal Micromobility Policies
comment: Author preprint. Accepted for publication in the proceedings of the 2nd ACM SIGSPATIAL International Workshop on Spatial Intelligence for Smart and Connected Communities (SpatialConnect 2026)
summary: In municipal planning workshops, planners and other stakeholders compare shared-micromobility parking policies by varying no-parking zones, retained sites, spacing, or area allocations. Each edit changes feasible sites and how much demand they cover, so the alternative must be reoptimized on the same spatial data. Full-set greedy, the transparent reference for this task, takes tens of seconds per alternative at city scale. We present Constraint-exact Low-latency Iterative Planning with Pooled Evaluation and Replay (CLIPPER), an optimizer with audit functions developed for requirements elicited with the City of Braunschweig. In each greedy round, it forms a deterministic candidate pool of bounded size, computes how much still-uncovered demand each candidate would add, and rejects candidates that violate an active constraint. An optional offline audit scans every remaining feasible candidate and records what the restricted pool omitted. We evaluate these functions on complete eleven-state edit chains ($E_0,\ldots,E_{10}$) in Braunschweig, Munich, and Berlin. With $K=1024$ candidates per group, the fixed-width mode CLIPPER-F has mean coverage gaps to full-set greedy under the same policy of 0.245, 0.003, and 0.001 percentage points in Braunschweig, Munich, and Berlin, respectively, while mean rollout time falls by factors of 13.6--28.9; no audited run terminates while a candidate outside the pool could still increase coverage. Plans computed from two checksummed versions of Braunschweig's official no-parking-zone data differ in 30 of about 540 selected sites although coverage moves by only about 0.1 percentage points. These changes still require municipal assessment and implementation. The findings inform a proposed municipal process that versions policy inputs, reports site changes beside coverage, and scans the full candidate set before a final decision.

AI.tldr: 论文提出CLIPPER，一种面向城市共享微出行停车政策规划的快速贪心优化器，通过受限候选池和审计机制，在几乎不损失覆盖率的条件下大幅缩短方案重优化时间，并揭示政策输入版本差异对选点的影响。
AI.motivation: 市政规划工作坊中，规划者需反复调整禁停区、保留站点、间距或面积分配等政策，每次编辑都会改变可行站点与需求覆盖，需在同一空间数据上快速重优化。城市尺度下全集合贪心虽透明但每次耗时数十秒，难以支持交互式比较。
AI.method: CLIPPER采用约束精确、低延迟的迭代规划：每轮贪心构建有界大小的确定性候选池，计算各候选新增的未覆盖需求，并拒绝违反活动约束的候选；可选离线审计扫描所有剩余可行候选，记录受限池遗漏内容。作者与布伦瑞克市合作获取需求，在布伦瑞克、慕尼黑和伯林林完整11状态编辑链上评估，并与全集合贪心比较。
AI.result: 在每组K=1024候选时，固定宽度模式CLIPPER-F相对全集合贪心在同政策下的平均覆盖率差距分别为布伦瑞克0.245、慕尼黑0.003、柏林0.001个百分点，平均运行时间缩短13.6至28.9倍；所有审计运行均未在池外仍有可提升覆盖候选时终止。布伦瑞克官方禁停区数据两个校验版本算出的方案在约540个选中站点中有30个不同，但覆盖率仅变化约0.1个百分点。
AI.conclusion: CLIPPER能以可审计方式实现接近全集合贪心的覆盖效果并显著提速，支持交互式市政规划。研究建议市政流程应版本化政策输入、在覆盖率旁报告站点变化，并在最终决策前扫描完整候选集；这些站点变化仍需市政评估与实施。

title: Beyond Text: LLM-Based Dimensional Emotion Evaluation in Multimodal Dialogue
summary: Emotion recognition in conversation has been widely studied, but applying Large Language Models (LLMs) to continuous dimensional emotion evaluation in multimodal dialogue remains largely unexplored. We propose an LLM-based framework that performs discrete emotion recognition and Valence-Arousal-Dominance (VAD) dimensional evaluation on IEMOCAP, incorporating acoustic cues as natural language descriptions following the SpeechCueLLM approach. We evaluate six models spanning the LLaMA, GPT, and Qwen families under zero-shot prompting, few-shot prompting, and LoRA fine-tuning. LoRA fine-tuned LLaMA models substantially outperform prompt-engineered GPT models on both tasks despite GPT's larger scale, a gap we attribute to domain adaptation rather than model capacity. Our best model achieves a Valence CCC of 0.7822, a new state-of-the-art on IEMOCAP. Ablation studies confirm that textual audio descriptions meaningfully improve smaller models (+3.5 to 3.6 weighted F1) while contributing little for the largest model, suggesting audio cues are most valuable when linguistic capacity is limited. The performance asymmetry across VAD dimensions closely mirrors the annotator agreement hierarchy in IEMOCAP's own annotations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于大语言模型的多模态对话情感评估框架，在IEMOCAP上同时进行离散情绪识别与VAD连续维度评估，并比较零样本、少样本和LoRA微调。
AI.motivation: 对话情感识别已有较多研究，但将LLM用于多模态对话中的连续维度情感评估仍缺乏探索；同时需考察声学线索以自然语言描述注入LLM的效果及不同模型与适应策略的差异。
AI.method: 采用SpeechCueLLM思路，将声学线索转为自然语言描述；在IEMOCAP上评估LLaMA、GPT、Qwen六个模型，设置零样本、少样本提示与LoRA微调，并通过消融实验分析文本音频描述的作用。
AI.result: LoRA微调的LLaMA在两项任务上显著优于提示工程的GPT，尽管GPT规模更大；最佳模型Valence CCC达0.7822，创IEMOCAP新SOTA。文本音频描述使较小模型加权F1提升约3.5至3.6，但对最大模型帮助很小；VAD各维度性能差异与IEMOCAP标注者一致性层级一致。
AI.conclusion: 领域适配而非模型容量是性能关键；音频文本描述在语言能力有限时更有价值；LLM经微调可有效用于多模态对话VAD评估，且模型表现受标注一致性影响。

title: Consistent Plan-Act for Long-Horizon Agentic Tasks
summary: Long-horizon agentic tasks demand strong reasoning and efficient execution across successive interactions with dynamic environments. A common approach decouples high-level planning from low-level execution through separate planner and actor roles. To investigate coordination failures in these tasks, we prompt both agents for structured state assertions and compare their reports programmatically to detect explicit contradictions. Our analyses reveal systematic disagreement about the same task-relevant state facts, a phenomenon we term planner-actor state mismatch. We further find that providing agents with task-relevant state information reduces mismatch and improves coordination and task performance. Based on the systematic analysis of the state mismatch, we propose Consistent Plan-Act (ConPAct), which feeds detected contradictions back to both agents to form consistent state interpretations and fine-tunes them on curated consistent interactions for better coordination. ConPAct improves performance across various environments and model configurations, e.g., increasing MiniGrid success rate from 38.6% to 54.4% with GPT-5.6-sol/terra as planner and actor respectively, demonstrating that state consistency can guide both inference-time correction and coordination training.

AI.tldr: 本文研究长时程智能体任务中规划者（planner）与执行者（actor）分离架构下的协调失败问题，提出并验证了「规划者-执行者状态不一致」（planner-actor state mismatch）现象，并据此提出 ConPAct 方法，通过反馈矛盾信息与一致性交互微调来提升协调与任务表现。
AI.motivation: 长时程智能体任务需要在动态环境中进行多轮交互，常见做法是将高层规划与低层执行解耦为独立的 planner 和 actor。然而这种解耦可能带来协调失败，作者希望系统地定位并量化其根源。
AI.method: 让两类智能体输出结构化的状态断言，并以程序化方式比对二者报告，从而检测显式矛盾；基于检测到的矛盾，提出 Consistent Plan-Act（ConPAct），将矛盾反馈给双方以形成一致的状态理解，并在筛选出的一致性交互数据上对智能体进行微调，以同时实现推理期的纠正与协调训练。
AI.result: 分析发现智能体在同一任务相关状态事实上存在系统性分歧，即 planner-actor state mismatch；提供任务相关状态信息可减少不一致并提升协调与任务性能。ConPAct 在多种环境和模型配置下均取得提升，例如以 GPT-5.6-sol/terra 分别作为 planner 与 actor 时，MiniGrid 成功率从 38.6% 提升至 54.4%。
AI.conclusion: 状态一致性是长时程智能体协调的关键因素，可作为推理期纠错与协调训练的共同指导信号，ConPAct 验证了该思路的有效性与通用性。

title: DecoMoE: Decoupling Visual Propagation and Expert Computation for Efficient Multimodal MoE Inference
summary: Multimodal mixture-of-experts (MoE) models combine sparse expert activation with visual-language capabilities, yet their inference remains costly because long visual-token sequences repeatedly incur attention, routing, dispatch, and expert-MLP computation. Existing methods typically compress either the token or expert dimension, leaving redundancy along the other. Our analysis reveals two complementary regularities: the depth required for visual propagation varies across inputs, while text-token routing exhibits concentrated and recurrent expert-importance patterns. Based on these observations, we propose DecoMoE, a two-dimensional structured compression framework that decouples visual propagation from expert computation. The Sample-Adaptive Visual Boundary (SAVB) predicts an input-dependent visual-exit layer at which the visual-token block is removed. The Routing-Calibrated Expert Prefix (RCEP) reorders experts offline using text-token routed mass and, from this predicted exit layer onward, retains at each MoE layer the shortest contiguous prefix covering a target routed-mass fraction. We evaluate DecoMoE on Qwen3-VL-MoE and InternVL3.5-30B-A3B across six benchmarks. On Qwen3-VL-MoE, DecoMoE retains 97.91% of dense-baseline performance while reducing computation from 27.06 to 16.73 TFLOPs and latency from 0.44 to 0.26 seconds, yielding a 1.69x speedup. Code will be available at https://github.com/ShawnTan86/DecoMoE.

AI.tldr: 提出 DecoMoE，一种针对多模态 MoE 模型的两维结构化压缩框架，通过样本自适应视觉退出与路由校准专家前缀，在几乎不损失性能的情况下显著加速推理。
AI.motivation: 多模态 MoE 推理成本高：长视觉 token 序列反复触发注意力、路由、分发和专家 MLP 计算。现有方法通常只压缩 token 或专家单一维度，另一维度仍存在冗余。
AI.method: 基于两个规律：视觉传播所需深度因输入而异；文本 token 路由呈现集中且可复现的专家重要性模式。DecoMoE 解耦视觉传播与专家计算：SAVB 预测输入相关的视觉退出层并移除视觉 token 块；RCEP 离线按文本路由质量重排专家，并从退出层起每层保留覆盖目标路由质量比例的最短连续专家前缀。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-VL-MoE 和 InternVL3.5-30B-A3B 上六个基准评测。Qwen3-VL-MoE 上保留密集基线 97.91% 性能，计算从 27.06 降至 16.73 TFLOPs，延迟从 0.44 降至 0.26 秒，获得 1.69 倍加速。
AI.conclusion: DecoMoE 通过样本自适应视觉边界与路由校准专家前缀实现两维压缩，在保持接近密集基线性能的同时大幅降低计算与延迟，代码将开源。

title: STRATA: Self-Learning Through Role-Aligned Tiered Agents for Real-Time Strategy Games
summary: Real-time strategy (RTS) games require agents to coordinate economic development, production and construction, base defense, unit organization, and attack timing over long matches. Existing studies have applied large language models to command decision-making in RTS games, enabling agents to read textual game states and generate high-level plans. However, long inference latency can cause them to miss critical tactical events. The complexity and tactical diversity of full RTS matches also leave existing systems heavily dependent on manually written experience-based prompts, with limited ability to learn continuously from past games. We present STRATA, a role-aligned hierarchical system with cross-game self-learning for Red Alert. STRATA assigns in-game strategic, logistical, and tactical decisions to a Strategic Agent (SA), Logistics Agent (LA), and Tactical Agent (TA), respectively. The SA generates high-level directives based on the global game state and relevant experience cards, while the LA and TA handle logistics and tactical execution. After each match, a Review Agent (RA) derives candidate experience from game traces, validates and revises it using evidence from subsequent matches, and compresses strategic experience supported across multiple games into concise experience cards for SA retrieval. We evaluate STRATA through the formation of experience cards, full-match comparisons before and after learning, and experience learning against AI opponents with different play styles. Under a fixed scenario, using the learned experience cards increases the observed win rate from 30% to 100%. Sequential learning against AI opponents with different play styles also produces distinct long-term strategic experience.

AI.tldr: 本文提出STRATA，一个用于《红色警戒》的角色对齐分层系统，具备跨游戏自学习能力。通过战略、后勤、战术智能体分工及复盘智能体提炼经验卡片，显著提高了胜率。
AI.motivation: 现有基于大语言模型的RTS智能体推理延迟高，易错过关键战术事件；且严重依赖人工编写的经验提示，难以从过往对局中持续学习。
AI.method: STRATA将游戏内决策分配给战略智能体（SA）、后勤智能体（LA）和战术智能体（TA）。SA根据全局状态和经验卡片生成高层指令，LA和TA负责后勤与战术执行。每局结束后，复盘智能体（RA）从游戏记录中提取候选经验，利用后续对局证据验证和修正，并将跨多局支持的策略经验压缩成简洁的经验卡片供SA检索。评估包括经验卡片的形成、学习前后的全场对比，以及针对不同风格AI对手的经验学习。
AI.result: 在固定场景下，使用学习到的经验卡片将观察到的胜率从30%提升至100%。针对不同风格AI对手的持续学习也产生了不同的长期战略经验。
AI.conclusion: STRATA通过角色对齐分层架构和跨游戏自学习，有效提升了RTS游戏中的表现，实现了持续学习和适应。

title: SteerQuant: Steering Quantization Error with Action-Guided Scaling in World-Action Models
comment: Yunhan Wang and Haodong Wang contributed equally to this work
summary: World-action models (WAMs) jointly generate future world states and actions through iterative denoising, using shared weights to process heterogeneous semantic streams of video, proprioceptive, and action tokens. Quantization reduces inference cost, but comparable numerical errors in different streams can have markedly different effects on final actions, making numerical accuracy alone insufficient for reliable control. We introduce SteerQuant, a 4-bit quantization framework for WAMs that steers errors toward computations with less influence on final actions. It maps how each stream's quantization errors affect final actions and uses this map to guide shared channel scaling. Activation scaling is further calibrated for each stream and denoising step to accommodate changes in activation ranges and action impact. This adapts quantization to different stream requirements without duplicating weights or increasing bit-widths for selected streams. To reduce the extra kernel launches and memory traffic introduced by scaling, we develop Rudder, a 4-bit inference engine for WAMs that fuses scaling and output compensation into low-bit kernels. Under W4A8 and W4A4, SteerQuant maintains mean LIBERO success within 0.8 percentage points of full precision, while delivering up to $2.23\times$ denoising speedup over BF16 across three WAMs with reduced peak GPU memory usage. On a real dual-arm robot, W4A8 deployment achieves a $1.35\times$ end-to-end inference speedup while maintaining average task success relative to BF16.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SteerQuant，一种面向世界-动作模型（WAMs）的 4 比特量化框架，通过将量化误差引导至对最终动作影响较小的计算，并结合逐流与逐步激活缩放，实现在不复制权重、不增加比特宽度的前提下高效推理。
AI.motivation: WAMs 通过迭代去噪联合生成未来世界状态和动作，共享权重处理视频、本体感觉和动作等异构语义流。量化虽可降低推理成本，但不同流中相近的数值误差对最终动作的影响差异显著，仅靠数值精度不足以保障可靠控制。
AI.method: SteerQuant 映射各流量化误差对最终动作的影响，并以此指导共享通道缩放；进一步针对每个流和去噪步骤校准激活缩放，以适应激活范围与动作影响的变化。为减少缩放带来的额外内核启动和内存开销，设计了 Rudder 4 比特推理引擎，将缩放与输出补偿融合进低位内核。
AI.result: 在 W4A8 和 W4A4 下，SteerQuant 在 LIBERO 上的平均成功率与全精度差距在 0.8 个百分点以内，同时在三个 WAMs 上相比 BF16 实现最高 2.23 倍去噪加速，并降低峰值 GPU 显存。在真实双臂机器人上，W4A8 部署取得 1.35 倍端到端推理加速，平均任务成功率与 BF16 相当。
AI.conclusion: SteerQuant 能够有效实现 WAMs 的 4 比特量化，在保持控制性能的同时显著提升推理效率，适用于真实机器人部署。

title: Composing Task-specific Agent Harnesses at Test Time with Reusable Primitives
summary: Agent harnesses govern how large language models (LLMs) gather context, invoke tools, verify results, preserve state, and terminate, largely affecting agent performance. However, the value of each harness mechanism can differ across heterogeneous tasks: a mechanism that improves one task may impose overhead or context distraction on another, leading to the suboptimality of a global harness. We characterize this suboptimality as a mismatch induced by fixed mechanism choices, motivating task-specific harness construction. Nonetheless, generating harness code for each task introduces generation and debugging costs, with execution risks that can compound as more mechanisms are generated. To address those challenges, we introduce Harness Primitives, reusable harness mechanisms with clear application scope and composition contract mined from failed task trajectories. Based on Harness Primitives, we propose STITCH, a framework that Selects suitable primitives given Task Information and compiles them into Task-speCific Harnesses at test time. This separation enables task-specific harnesses without generating or repairing mechanism code at test time. Extensive experiments demonstrate that STITCH not only improves harness adaptability and robustness, but also scales with the primitive library size, boosting task success rates by up to 12 points over fixed harness baselines, surpassing human-designed harnesses like Codex CLI while maintaining a minimal test-time harness composition overhead of only 2.7%, 638 times more efficient than generating task-specific harnesses from scratch. Ultimately, our work demonstrates that building task-adaptive harnesses can be beneficial for completing diverse tasks and that building reusable primitives can be a promising path towards this goal.

AI.tldr: 论文研究代理harness对LLM agent性能的影响，指出固定harness机制在不同任务上存在不匹配，提出可复用的Harness Primitives与STITCH框架，在测试时选择并组合任务特定harness。
AI.motivation: 现有agent harness通常采用全局固定机制，但不同任务对上下文收集、工具调用、验证、状态保存和终止等机制需求不同，固定选择会导致次优；而按任务生成harness代码又带来生成、调试和执行风险成本。
AI.method: 从失败任务轨迹中挖掘具有明确适用范围和组合契约的可复用Harness Primitives；提出STITCH，根据任务信息选择合适原语，并在测试时编译成任务特定harness，避免测试时生成或修复机制代码。
AI.result: 实验表明STITCH提升harness适应性与鲁棒性，并随原语库规模扩展；任务成功率较固定harness基线最高提升12个百分点，超过Codex CLI等人工设计harness，测试时组合开销仅2.7%，比从零生成任务专用harness高效638倍。
AI.conclusion: 构建任务自适应harness有助于完成多样任务，构建可复用原语是实现该目标的有前景路径。

title: False Frontiers: Diagnosing and Mitigating Co-Cheating in Self-Evolving Search Agents
comment: 21 pages. Equal contribution: Meijia Chen, Hao Li, Zheng Lu
summary: Self-evolving search agents build their own training curricula by jointly optimizing a proposer that generates questions and a solver that answers them. This closed loop introduces a failure mode we call co-cheating: the proposer and solver increasingly agree on shared errors, so internal reward improves without a matching gain in external correctness. A post-hoc audit against source evidence shows co-cheating growing more severe over successive rounds of self-evolution, with pseudo-label correctness stagnating or declining even as the in-loop training signal improves. The most direct mitigation is to verify proposals before training: we introduce multi-sample verification (MSV), which queries the same model three times with the source and three times without it to decide task admission and replace unreliable pseudo-labels. MSV partially reduces false agreement but leaves substantial residual co-cheating and costs six extra labeler generations per candidate. These limitations motivate CrossFit, our main method: it partitions the proposer's source documents into groups A and B; questions generated from A are scored by an auxiliary solver trained only on B, and vice versa. The cross-fitted agreement determines proposer reward, so a same-source pseudo-label cannot be reproduced through the feedback solver, while the original solver's update rule is unchanged. Rerunning the loop with Qwen3.5-4B and Qwen3.5-9B, MSV reduces false-agreement mass from 6.1% to 5.7% and from 8.8% to 7.2%, whereas CrossFit reduces it to 3.0% and 3.7%. Replaying identical proposals with source-excluded feedback further reduces false agreement to 0.4% and 0.1%, isolating feedback ancestry from curriculum changes. Across seven downstream search benchmarks, CrossFit improves average performance over standard coupled self-evolution by 8.8 and 8.4 points and over Search-R1 by 8.7 and 7.8 points at 4B and 9B.

AI.tldr: 论文研究自演化搜索智能体中 proposer 与 solver 闭环训练导致的 co-cheating 问题，即双方逐渐共享错误、内部奖励提升但外部正确性不增；提出 CrossFit，通过交叉拟合文档分区与辅助 solver 打分阻断同源伪标签反馈，减少虚假一致并提升下游搜索性能。
AI.motivation: 自演化搜索智能体通过 proposer 生成问题、solver 回答并联合优化，形成闭环训练课程；但这会引发 co-cheating：proposer 和 solver 越来越认同共同错误，内部奖励上升却不带来外部正确性提升，且随自演化轮次加剧。因此需要缓解这种失败模式。
AI.method: 先审计 co-cheating，再提出多样本验证 MSV：用同一模型带源查询3次、不带源查询3次，决定任务准入并替换不可靠伪标签。进一步提出 CrossFit：将 proposer 的源文档分为 A/B 两组，A 生成的问题由只在 B 上训练的辅助 solver 评分，反之亦然；交叉拟合一致性决定 proposer 奖励，原 solver 更新规则不变。使用 Qwen3.5-4B 和 Qwen3.5-9B 重跑闭环，并用 source-excluded feedback replay 隔离反馈来源。
AI.result: MSV 将 false-agreement mass 从 6.1%降至5.7%、从8.8%降至7.2%；CrossFit 降至3.0%和3.7%；source-excluded feedback replay 进一步降至0.4%和0.1%。在七个下游搜索基准上，CrossFit 相比标准 coupled self-evolution 平均提升8.8和8.4分，相比 Search-R1 提升8.7和7.8分（4B和9B）。
AI.conclusion: co-cheating 是自演化搜索智能体的重要失败模式；MSV 只能部分缓解且成本较高；CrossFit 能有效阻断同源伪标签反馈，显著降低虚假一致，并在多个下游搜索任务上带来稳定性能提升。

title: DiFF: Doppler-informed Flow Matching for Human Motion Flow
comment: IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS), 2026. Code: https://github.com/keroseus/DiFF
summary: Perceiving human motion via privacy-preserving 4D millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar is critical for next-generation human-robot interaction (HRI), where point cloud scene flow serves as a foundational motion representation. Yet the extreme sparsity and noise of 4D radar point clouds make non-rigid motion flow estimation severely ill-posed--a challenge that existing rigid-centric methods and prior works fail to adequately address, largely because they neglect the rich Doppler velocity cues inherent in 4D radar. We propose DiFF, a generative framework that marries Doppler-informed motion priors with a Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (KAN)-based conditional flow matching model. At its core, a KAN-attention mechanism enables expressive feature extraction, while a prior-guided generative process harnesses Doppler cues to regularize the ill-posed solution space. Extensive experiments show that DiFF achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance across diverse real-world datasets, reducing 3D endpoint error to the millimeter scale on the mmBody benchmark.

AI.tldr: 论文提出DiFF，一种结合多普勒运动先验与基于KAN的条件流匹配的生成式框架，用于从隐私保护的4D毫米波雷达点云中估计非刚性人体运动场景流。
AI.motivation: 4D毫米波雷达对下一代人机交互至关重要，但其点云极度稀疏且噪声大，导致非刚性运动流估计严重病态；现有以刚性为中心的方法和先前工作未能充分利用4D雷达固有的多普勒速度线索。
AI.method: DiFF采用生成式框架，将多普勒信息运动先验与Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KAN）驱动的条件流匹配模型结合；核心包括KAN注意力机制以进行表达性特征提取，以及先验引导的生成过程，利用多普勒线索正则化病态解空间。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，DiFF在多个真实世界数据集上达到SOTA性能，在mmBody基准上将3D端点误差降低至毫米级。
AI.conclusion: DiFF能有效解决4D雷达点云中非刚性人体运动流估计难题，验证了融合多普勒先验与KAN条件流匹配的生成式方法的优越性。

title: Decoupling Spherical Reasoning from Dense Prediction for 360 Depth Estimation
summary: The equirectangular projection (ERP) is widely used for panoramic depth estimation, but its spatially varying distortion makes geometry-consistent feature modeling challenging. We revisit panoramic depth estimation by decoupling contextual modeling in native spherical space from dense ERP prediction. To this end, we propose a Fibonacci Spherical Graph (FSG) as an intermediate reasoning space to lift ERP features onto quasi-uniform Fibonacci nodes on the sphere and capture local and long-range dependencies through complementary spherical neighborhoods. The resulting spherical discretization distributes graph nodes approximately uniformly over the spherical surface, reducing the over-representation of highly stretched regions during relational modeling. Operating on a compact set of Fibonacci nodes also avoids the computational burden of constructing and processing a graph at full ERP resolution. To bridge spherical reasoning and dense prediction, we propose a Spherical Context Conditioning (SCC) module that adaptively modulates dense ERP features with the enhanced spherical representation, allowing spherical context to guide pixel-aligned depth prediction. Extensive experiments on three benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed method consistently achieves superior depth accuracy over existing approaches.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出在球面空间进行上下文建模、再回归ERP稠密深度预测的全景深度估计方法，核心是Fibonacci球面图（FSG）和球面上下文调节（SCC）模块。
AI.motivation: ERP投影存在空间变化的畸变，导致全景深度估计中几何一致的特征建模困难。
AI.method: 将ERP特征提升到球面上近似均匀分布的Fibonacci节点，构建Fibonacci球面图（FSG），通过互补球面邻域捕获局部与长程依赖；再以球面上下文调节（SCC）模块自适应调制稠密ERP特征，实现球面上下文引导的像素对齐深度预测。
AI.result: 在三个基准数据集上的实验表明，所提方法在深度精度上持续优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 将球面上下文建模与稠密ERP预测解耦，并利用FSG与SCC桥接两者，可有效提升全景深度估计性能，同时避免全分辨率图计算负担。

title: Bongard: Training Machine Intuition
comment: Technical report, 28 pages, 7 figures. Model weights: https://huggingface.co/AgentBull/bongard-mini
summary: Human intelligence relies heavily on learned intuition: recognising patterns and judging situations without explicitly unfolding every intermediate step. We introduce Bongard, an open-weight System One model that treats machine intuition as an independent capability to design and train. A T5Gemma 2 4B-4B encoder-decoder separates reading the evidence from making judgments. The encoder reads the state bidirectionally together with the question instructions, and separate decoder branches share this encoding, so many judgments about the same situation require only one reading of the state. A trained head returns probabilities over the supplied candidates without generating text. Training proceeds in three stages, from supervised judgments to semantic relationships to action outcomes, and each stage updates all 7.09 billion trainable parameters on one Blackwell GPU. Joint-embedding post-training raises accuracy on held-out rephrasings from 75.7% to 85.9%. A sandbox stage then learns outcome distributions from action rollouts and exact oracles, raising accuracy on a frozen sandbox panel from 50.6% to 64.8%. On DecisionBench, the final model reaches 78.05% accuracy over 23,900 decisions and ranks fourth of 61 systems in the public comparison. On one RTX PRO 6000, its median latency is 36 ms for short requests, and 32 questions about one state take 221 ms. Bongard demonstrates that machine intuition can be systematically trained via representation learning and outcome feedback, providing an open, efficient alternative for high-throughput decision workloads.

AI.tldr: 提出Bongard，一个开放权重的System One模型，将机器直觉作为可独立设计训练的能力；基于T5Gemma 2 4B-4B编码器-解码器，通过三阶段训练与后训练提升决策准确率，并在DecisionBench等任务上取得高效表现。
AI.motivation: 人类智能高度依赖习得直觉，即无需显式展开每个中间步骤即可识别模式并判断情境；作者希望把机器直觉设计为独立能力进行训练，并为高吞吐决策任务提供开放、高效的替代方案。
AI.method: 采用T5Gemma 2 4B-4B编码器-解码器，将读取证据与作出判断分离。编码器双向读取状态和问题指令，多个解码器分支共享同一编码，训练头直接输出候选概率而不生成文本。训练分三阶段：监督判断、语义关系、动作结果，每阶段更新全部7.09亿可训练参数；随后进行联合嵌入后训练，并设置沙盒阶段从动作rollout和精确oracle学习结果分布。
AI.result: 联合嵌入后训练将留出改写集准确率从75.7%提升至85.9%；沙盒阶段将冻结沙盒面板准确率从50.6%提升至64.8%。在DecisionBench上，最终模型对23,900个决策达到78.05%准确率，在61个系统的公开比较中排名第四。在单张RTX PRO 6000上，短请求中位延迟为36毫秒，关于同一状态的32个问题耗时221毫秒。
AI.conclusion: Bongard表明机器直觉可以通过表示学习和结果反馈进行系统训练，为高吞吐决策工作负载提供了一种开放、高效的方案。

title: Diagnosing On-Policy Self-Distillation for Reasoning Language Models
summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) has attracted growing interest as a promising approach to improve the reasoning ability of language models. Without external rewards nor a separate stronger teacher, the self-teacher with privileged information could provide dense signals on student's trajectories. However, its behavior in language reasoning remains unclear, with reported outcomes ranging from modest gains to behavioral collapse. In this work, we diagnose OPSD for mathematical reasoning across models spanning 0.6B--8B parameters. We conduct controlled experiments and token-level analyses to fully delve into OPSD. We point out that teacher's signal is shaped by reasoning-mode alignment and the complete teacher prefix, rather than by privileged semantics alone. OPSD improves reasoning only in narrow compatibility regimes. Otherwise, it produces ineffective length growth, stable degradation, or behavioral collapse. Token-level analysis shows that teacher's signal is not stable and does not predict downstream performance. Based on these results, we argue that OPSD is a sensitive algorithm rather than a generally reliable reasoning-improvement post-training method.

AI.tldr: 本文诊断了用于数学推理的在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD），发现其仅在狭窄的兼容条件下有效，并非普遍可靠的推理提升方法。
AI.motivation: OPSD 作为提升语言模型推理能力的方法受到关注，无需外部奖励或独立强教师，但已有结果从适度提升到行为崩溃不一，其机制和适用性尚不清晰。
AI.method: 在 0.6B--8B 参数模型上针对数学推理进行受控实验和 token 级分析，探究教师信号来源及 OPSD 的行为表现。
AI.result: 教师信号由推理模式对齐和完整教师前缀塑造，而非仅由特权语义决定；OPSD 只在狭窄兼容范围内提升推理，否则导致无效长度增长、稳定退化或行为崩溃；token 级分析显示教师信号不稳定且不能预测下游性能。
AI.conclusion: OPSD 是一种敏感算法，而非普遍可靠的推理提升后训练方法。

title: FrameMorrow: Future-guided Frame Selection with Prospective Tokens for Long-Horizon Video Generation
summary: Long-horizon video generation requires models to effectively leverage an increasingly long generation history. As the generated history grows, retaining all previous content becomes increasingly expensive and redundant, making effective historical selection essential. Existing approaches often determine historical relevance based on the current content. However, information relevant to the present is not necessarily useful for future generation, while seemingly less relevant history may become important later. Our key insight is that historical information should be selected according to its relevance to future information needs. Capturing these needs does not require generating the full future; instead, a compact representation of what becomes important next is sufficient to guide historical selection.
