Building on this insight, we propose FrameMorrow, a prospective frame selector that predicts a small set of prospective tokens representing future information needs and uses them to identify relevant information from history. FrameMorrow selects explicit historical frames rather than model-specific internal states, enabling plug-and-play integration across diverse generators, including closed-source models, with little additional inference cost. We evaluate FrameMorrow across five benchmarks and 11 generative models spanning long-video generation, interactive generation, and action-conditioned world models. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent improvements in long-range consistency, visual quality, and action alignment across diverse generation settings.

AI.tldr: 提出FrameMorrow，一种前瞻性帧选择器，通过预测未来信息需求的紧凑表示来选择历史帧，以提升长时视频生成的一致性和质量。
AI.motivation: 长时视频生成中，历史信息不断增长，保留全部内容昂贵且冗余，因此需要有效选择历史信息。现有方法基于当前内容判断历史相关性，但当前相关未必对未来有用，而看似不相关的历史可能后来重要。关键洞察是应根据对未来信息需求的相关性来选择历史信息。
AI.method: 提出FrameMorrow，预测一小组前瞻性token表示未来信息需求，并利用它们从历史中识别相关信息。它选择显式的历史帧而非模型内部状态，可即插即用地集成到各种生成器，包括闭源模型，且额外推理成本低。
AI.result: 在五个基准和11个生成模型上评估，涵盖长视频生成、交互式生成和动作条件世界模型。实验表明，在长程一致性、视觉质量和动作对齐方面均有持续改进。
AI.conclusion: FrameMorrow通过前瞻性历史选择有效提升了多种视频生成任务的表现，具有通用性和高效性。

title: AdaOcc: Adaptive 3D Occupancy Prediction for Embodied Tasks
summary: Embodied tasks demand accurate, flexible, and semantically rich 3D scene representations. 3D semantic occupancy is well suited to this requirement, as it can model holistic 3D spaces by encoding geometric occupancy along with semantic categories. However, existing occupancy prediction methods struggle to meet practical deployment requirements, such as adapting to varying computing budgets, sensor setups, and observation views. In this paper, we propose a point-based Adaptive 3D Occupancy Prediction method, called AdaOcc, tailored for embodied scenarios. To accommodate heterogeneous sensor inputs, AdaOcc uses an adaptive geometry-guided dual-branch encoder that can support RGB images in various numbers of views with (estimated) depth maps or LiDAR scans. AdaOcc represents occupied regions via sparse semantic points trained with a progressive query learning strategy, allowing the prediction computational budget to be flexibly adjusted through query point numbers and decoder layers. To facilitate high-fidelity geometric modeling for lightweight point-based occupancy learning, we further propose a novel containment loss that regularizes predicted points to reside within valid occupied regions. Extensive experiments show that our method achieves a new state-of-the-art on Occ-ScanNet with considerable performance improvements over previous methods. Moreover, our framework demonstrates strong practical applicability as an adaptive 3D perception module in real-world embodied systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AdaOcc，一种面向具身场景的基于点的自适应 3D 语义占据预测方法，可适配不同传感器配置、计算预算和观察视角，并在 Occ-ScanNet 上取得新 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 具身任务需要准确、灵活且语义丰富的 3D 场景表示。现有 3D 语义占据预测方法难以满足实际部署需求，例如适应不同计算预算、传感器设置和观察视角。
AI.method: AdaOcc 采用自适应几何引导双分支编码器，支持多种视角的 RGB 图像配合估计深度或 LiDAR 扫描；使用稀疏语义点表示占据区域，并通过渐进式查询学习策略训练，使计算预算可通过查询点数量和解码器层数灵活调整；还提出 containment loss 约束预测点位于有效占据区域内。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，AdaOcc 在 Occ-ScanNet 上取得了新的 state-of-the-art，相较此前方法有显著性能提升；同时作为自适应 3D 感知模块，在真实具身系统中展现出较强的实用适用性。
AI.conclusion: AdaOcc 能够灵活适应异构传感器输入和不同计算预算，兼顾高性能与实用性，适合作为具身系统中的自适应 3D 占据预测模块。

title: Prototype-guided Bilateral Alignment Multimodal Federated Learning
summary: Multimodal federated learning (MFL) has emerged as a pivotal paradigm for leveraging distributed data to enhance model performance. However, existing methods predominantly rely on idealized assumptions of model homogeneity and balanced modality distributions, rendering them ill-suited for practical scenarios characterized by heterogeneous client architectures and severe modality imbalance. To address these challenges, we propose a \textbf{M}ultimodal \textbf{Fed}erated learning Prototype-guided Bilateral Alignment (MFedPBA) framework. MFedPBA facilitates robust knowledge synergy through a dual alignment mechanism: (i) at the feature level, it aligns heterogeneous feature spaces via a projection encoder optimized by contrastive learning and the Gromov-Wasserstein distance; (ii) at the decision level, it employs an entropy-weighted aggregation of naturally aligned logit prototypes. This novel design achieves robust MFL by jointly tackling heterogeneous feature spaces and collectively aggregating decisions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines under conditions of model heterogeneity and modality imbalance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多模态联邦学习框架 MFedPBA，通过特征级和决策级双重对齐，应对客户端模型异构与模态不平衡问题，并在实验中显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态联邦学习方法多基于模型同构和模态分布均衡的理想假设，难以适用于实际中客户端架构异构和模态严重不平衡的场景。
AI.method: 提出 MFedPBA 框架，采用双边对齐机制：特征级通过对比学习和 Gromov-Wasserstein 距离优化投影编码器，对齐异构特征空间；决策级采用熵加权聚合自然对齐的 logit 原型。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，在模型异构和模态不平衡条件下，该方法显著优于当前最先进的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: MFedPBA 通过联合处理异构特征空间并聚合决策，实现了鲁棒的多模态联邦学习。

title: Risk-Aware Adaptive Evaluation: Finding High-Impact Failures Under Limited Budgets
comment: Accepted to 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Workshop: Evaluation of Interactive Agents
summary: Evaluating interactive agents is expensive. Agent behavior is stochastic, so reliability must be measured over repeated trials, but failures are rare and differ widely in how much they matter. Standard benchmarks spend this budget uniformly: a read-only lookup is sampled as often as an irreversible payment action. We instead formulate evaluation as a sequential allocation problem. Given a fixed trial budget and a set of scenarios whose failure behavior is unknown, which scenarios should be run, and run again? We propose a risk-aware contextual Thompson Sampling policy that combines a pre-execution scenario context vector and a fixed impact score with the failure outcomes observed during evaluation, and we test it by offline replay over 70 $τ$-bench airline scenarios and 824 recorded trials. Our main result is at the smallest budget: with only 50 trials ($6\%$ of the corpus), the policy recovers $86\%$ of the impact-weighted failures an oracle could find, compared to $25\%$ for uniform allocation. It discovers $3.5\times$ more impact-weighted failures (215.4 vs. 62.2) with the same number of trials, delivers $5\times$ the discovery per dollar, and cuts the budget wasted on scenarios that never fail from $34\%$ to $2.8\%$. The rest of our analysis demonstrates and qualifies this result: a budget sweep shows the advantage shrinks as the budget approaches the corpus size, and paired significance tests show that scenario context helps mainly at small budgets while posterior-based exploration helps at moderate ones. Risk-aware adaptive allocation therefore helps most exactly where evaluation budget is scarcest.

AI.tldr: 论文将交互式智能体评估形式化为序贯分配问题，提出风险感知上下文Thompson Sampling策略，在τ-bench航空场景上小预算显著提升高风险失败发现效率。
AI.motivation: 评估交互式智能体成本高昂；智能体行为随机，可靠性需重复试验测量，但失败罕见且影响差异大。标准基准均匀分配预算，导致只读查询与不可逆支付等高风险动作被同等采样，浪费预算。
AI.method: 将评估视为序贯分配问题：在固定试验预算和未知失败行为的场景集中，决定运行与重跑哪些场景。提出风险感知上下文Thompson Sampling策略，结合预执行场景上下文向量、固定影响分数以及评估中观察到的失败结果，并通过70个τ-bench航空场景和824次记录试验进行离线回放测试。
AI.result: 在最小预算50次试验（语料的6%）下，策略恢复86%的oracle可达影响加权失败，均匀分配仅25%；相同试验数下发现3.5倍影响加权失败（215.4 vs. 62.2），每美元发现量5倍，浪费在永不失败场景上的预算从34%降至2.8%。预算扫描显示优势随预算接近语料规模而缩小；配对显著性检验表明场景上下文主要在小预算有帮助，后验探索在中等预算有帮助。
AI.conclusion: 风险感知自适应分配在评估预算最稀缺时帮助最大。

title: LBDU-VIO: Learned Bias Dynamics and Uncertainty for Visual-Inertial Odometry with Unreliable Vision
summary: Visual-inertial odometry (VIO) for aerial robots relies on high rate inertial measurement unit (IMU) propagation between visual updates. However, conventional multi state constraint Kalman filters (MSCKFs) use random walk bias assumptions and fixed noise parameters, which can limit robustness when visual information is unreliable. To address this problem, we propose LBDU-VIO, a learning-augmented MSCKF with learned continuous time bias dynamics and an IMU uncertainty model. A neural ordinary differential equation (ODE) models continuous time bias dynamics to propagate the filter's bias states, replacing their random walk model. The IMU uncertainty model predicts motion adaptive measurement noise covariances for covariance propagation. Both models are trained with pose supervision without direct labels. Experiments on real world EuRoC and TUM-VI benchmarks show lower errors than representative visual-inertial baselines, including a 25.1% reduction in mean relative position error compared with S-MSCKF on EuRoC sequences with 10s visual outage.

AI.tldr: 提出LBDU-VIO，一种学习增强的MSCKF视觉惯性里程计，利用神经ODE建模连续时间偏置动力学并学习IMU不确定性模型，在视觉信息不可靠时提升鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 传统多状态约束卡尔曼滤波（MSCKF）采用随机游走偏置假设和固定噪声参数，当视觉信息不可靠时鲁棒性受限。
AI.method: LBDU-VIO用神经常微分方程（ODE）建模连续时间偏置动力学以传播滤波器偏置状态，替代随机游走模型；同时学习IMU不确定性模型，预测运动自适应测量噪声协方差用于协方差传播。两个模型均通过位姿监督训练，无需直接标签。
AI.result: 在真实世界EuRoC和TUM-VI基准测试中，误差低于代表性视觉惯性基线。在EuRoC序列10秒视觉中断下，相比S-MSCKF平均相对位置误差降低25.1%。
AI.conclusion: 学习增强的MSCKF通过连续时间偏置动力学和自适应噪声建模，有效提升了视觉惯性里程计在视觉退化场景下的精度和鲁棒性。

title: MEMO: Multi-Level Entity-Aware Memory for Streaming Video Understanding
summary: Streaming video understanding requires models to process unbounded visual streams while preserving rich visual semantics across vast temporal horizons, posing a fundamental challenge for memory modeling. Existing approaches primarily focus on increasing memory capacity, either by compressing historical information into fixed-size representations or by extending storage beyond GPU memory. However, these methods largely rely on global or coarse-grained representations, inevitably losing fine-grained visual information. In this work, we argue that streaming video memory should explicitly encode structured and semantically meaningful representations, particularly at the entity level. To this end, we propose MEMO, a novel framework that models streaming video through multi-level, entity-aware structured memory. MEMO performs multi-level perception to jointly capture global semantics, entity dynamics, and spatial structures, partitioning streaming video into semantically coherent chunks. Each chunk is organized into a structured memory, where lightweight global and entity-level representations serve as retrieval indices, while the corresponding high-resolution visual content is retained separately for on-demand access. At inference time, MEMO performs query-specific retrieval over the structured memory and selectively recalls relevant visual evidence for downstream reasoning. Notably, MEMO is training-free and plug-and-play with existing multimodal large language models. Extensive experiments on StreamingBench and OVO-Bench demonstrate that MEMO consistently improves multiple base models and achieves state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 MEMO 框架，用多层级、实体感知的结构化记忆来建模流式视频，在无需训练的情况下提升多模态大模型对长视频流的理解能力。
AI.motivation: 流式视频理解需要处理无界视频流并保留长时程视觉语义，但现有方法多依赖固定大小压缩或扩展存储，且使用全局或粗粒度表示，容易丢失细粒度视觉信息。
AI.method: MEMO 进行多层级感知，联合捕捉全局语义、实体动态和空间结构，将视频流切分为语义连贯片段；每个片段组织为结构化记忆，用轻量全局和实体级表示作为检索索引，并单独保留高分辨率视觉内容供按需访问。推理时进行查询特定检索，选择性召回相关视觉证据，且无需训练、可即插即用接入现有多模态大模型。
AI.result: 在 StreamingBench 和 OVO-Bench 上，MEMO 持续提升多个基础模型表现，并达到当前最优性能。
AI.conclusion: 流式视频记忆应显式编码结构化、语义上有意义的表示，尤其是实体级表示；MEMO 验证了这种结构化记忆在流式视频理解中的有效性和通用性。

title: ViLegalExpert: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Vietnamese Legal Retrieval and Question Answering from Real-World Consultations
summary: Trustworthy Legal AI requires systems that can answer legal questions while grounding their responses in authoritative sources. However, existing Vietnamese legal benchmarks provide limited coverage of real-world legal consultations. We introduce \textbf{ViLegalExpert}, a large-scale benchmark constructed from authentic citizen--lawyer consultations, containing over \textbf{172K} questions across \textbf{34 legal domains}, together with professional answers and expert-verified legal evidence. ViLegalExpert supports legal information retrieval, extractive QA, and abstractive QA. Experiments with representative retrieval methods and language models reveal substantial challenges in evidence retrieval and grounded answer generation. While pretrained models perform strongly on QA, hybrid retrieval achieves the best retrieval performance. These results demonstrate the difficulty of mapping naturally expressed legal questions to authoritative provisions and establish ViLegalExpert as a challenging benchmark for reliable Vietnamese Legal AI.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ViLegalExpert，一个基于真实公民-律师咨询构建的大规模越南语法律基准，包含超过17.2万个问题、34个法律领域、专业答案和专家核验的法律证据，并支持法律信息检索、抽取式问答和生成式问答。
AI.motivation: 可信法律AI需要将回答建立在权威来源之上，但现有越南语法律基准对真实法律咨询场景覆盖有限，因此需要构建更贴近实际咨询、可评估证据检索与有据回答生成的大规模基准。
AI.method: 从真实的公民-律师咨询中构建 ViLegalExpert 基准，提供专业答案和专家核验的法律证据；设计支持法律信息检索、抽取式问答和抽象式问答的任务；并使用代表性检索方法和语言模型进行实验评估。
AI.result: 实验表明，证据检索和有据答案生成仍面临显著挑战；预训练模型在问答任务上表现较强，而混合检索在检索任务中取得最佳性能。
AI.conclusion: 将自然表达的法律问题映射到权威法律条文仍然困难，ViLegalExpert 可作为可靠越南语法律AI的具有挑战性的基准。

title: DAGent: Evaluate-then-Grow Planning for Deep Research Agents
summary: Deep research tasks require agents to navigate large knowledge spaces, synthesize evidence across many sources, and adapt their plans as findings emerge. Directed acyclic graph (DAG)-based multi-agent systems suit this setting because they support parallel execution and isolate each sub-task within a focused dependency context. Yet existing DAG-based agents instantiate a task-level plan before execution and repair the graph only after failures or missing evidence are observed. This Plan-then-Patch strategy is brittle for deep research: the system commits most strongly when its evidence is weakest, and later revisions waste computation on branches that should not have been planned. We propose DAGent, a DAG-based multi-agent framework with Evaluate-then-Grow incremental planning: an Orchestrator grows the task graph one batch at a time, conditioning each expansion on confidence and uncertainty signals from completed nodes. A hierarchical context layer propagates compact QueryDocs by default while preserving full execution traces for on-demand recall. The recorded DAG topology admits structural RL signals that outcome-only recipes cannot define; DAGRPO, a GRPO adaptation, injects topology-conditioned credit on Executor rollouts and a structural compliance regularization on Orchestrator plans. Across BrowseComp-Plus, GAIA, and xbench-DeepSearch, DAGent surpasses the strongest open-source baseline by 5.3 / 5.8 / 2.0 points at the Qwen3-235B-A22B scale, and the lead replicates across four open-source backbones and extends to GPT-5 at 327K context. At the Qwen3-8B scale, DAGRPO improves over a same-budget outcome-only GRPO baseline by 3.0 average Pass@1 points. A same-architecture comparison shows that evidence-conditioned planning reaches higher accuracy at lower per-task token, tool-call, and step footprints than its Plan-then-Patch counterpart. Code: https://github.com/hanwenliu6825/DAGent

AI.tldr: 论文提出 DAGent，一种基于 DAG 的多智能体深度研究框架，采用 Evaluate-then-Grow 增量规划，并引入 DAGRPO 强化学习，以提升复杂研究任务中的规划鲁棒性与执行效率。
AI.motivation: 现有 DAG 多智能体系统多采用 Plan-then-Patch 策略：先制定完整任务级计划，失败或证据缺失后再修补图。这在深度研究中较脆弱，因为系统在证据最弱时过早强承诺，后续修正还会浪费计算。
AI.method: DAGent 让 Orchestrator 基于已完成节点的置信度和不确定性信号，逐批扩展任务图；使用分层上下文层默认传播紧凑 QueryDocs，同时保留完整执行轨迹供按需召回；并利用 DAG 拓扑定义结构强化学习信号，提出 DAGRPO 适配 GRPO，在 Executor 轨迹上注入拓扑条件信用，并对 Orchestrator 计划施加结构合规正则。
AI.result: 在 BrowseComp-Plus、GAIA 和 xbench-DeepSearch 上，DAGent 在 Qwen3-235B-A22B 规模下比最强开源基线分别高 5.3、5.8、2.0 分；优势在四个开源骨干上复现，并扩展到 327K 上下文的 GPT-5。Qwen3-8B 规模下，DAGRPO 比同预算 outcome-only GRPO 基线平均 Pass@1 高 3.0 分。同架构比较显示，证据条件规划以更低的每任务 token、工具调用和步数达到更高准确率。
AI.conclusion: 证据条件化的增量 DAG 规划优于 Plan-then-Patch：DAGent 能更早利用不确定性调整计划，减少无效分支，并在准确率与计算效率上同时取得优势。

title: FLOW: Feature-Level Optimal Warping for Generalized Remote Physiological Measurement
summary: Remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) enables non-contact physiological measurement but remains vulnerable to domain shifts from illumination, motion, and sensors. We propose \textbf{FLOW (Feature-Level Optimal Warping)}, an \emph{optimal transport--driven} framework for domain-generalized rPPG. FLOW integrates a \textbf{Temporal Refinement Module (TRM)} to stabilize temporal dynamics and a \textbf{Prototype-based Cross-Temporal Optimal Transport (PCOT)} module to achieve domain-invariant alignment via learnable prototypes.Beyond feature alignment, FLOW employs soft cross-temporal correspondence modeling that aligns temporal features in a flexible manner, allowing the model to respect and preserve the intrinsic rhythmic patterns of physiological signals. Moreover, the lightweight design of our modules allows seamless integration into existing end-to-end rPPG architectures without additional preprocessing. Two regularization terms further enforce source consistency and identity preservation. Theoretically, we derive a generalization bound under conditional optimal transport. Extensive experiments across four rPPG benchmarks show that FLOW achieves state-of-the-art cross-domain performance with lightweight design and strong physiological fidelity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FLOW（Feature-Level Optimal Warping），一种基于最优传输的域泛化 rPPG 框架，通过时序细化与原型跨时序最优传输实现跨域对齐，并在多个基准上取得先进性能。
AI.motivation: 远程光电容积描记（rPPG）虽支持非接触生理测量，但易受光照、运动和传感器差异导致的域偏移影响，跨域泛化能力不足。
AI.method: FLOW 融合时序细化模块（TRM）稳定时序动态，并设计基于原型的跨时序最优传输模块（PCOT）实现域不变对齐；采用软跨时序对应建模以保留生理信号固有节律，并引入两个正则项约束源一致性与身份保持。理论上推导了条件最优传输下的泛化界。
AI.result: 在四个 rPPG 基准上的大量实验表明，FLOW 以轻量设计实现了最先进的跨域性能，并保持较强的生理保真度。
AI.conclusion: FLOW 为域泛化 rPPG 提供了一种有效的最优传输驱动方案，可无缝集成到现有端到端架构中，无需额外预处理，兼顾跨域性能与生理信号保真度。

title: Occlusion-Aware, Quasi-Static, Stability-Oriented Trajectory Planning on Uneven Terrain
summary: Autonomous navigation in unstructured off-road environments requires reasoning about both vehicle--terrain interaction and environmental unknowns. We propose a model-based framework for generating quasi-static, stability-oriented reference trajectories for rigid, non-articulated four-wheeled vehicles on highly uneven terrain. Our work makes three primary contributions. First, we model blind spots caused by terrain occlusion as coverage-induced epistemic uncertainty in a fixed-feature Fourier terrain representation, quantified through a regularized inverse-Hessian estimate. Second, we propagate this uncertainty through the Nonlinear Least-Squares (NLS) pose/contact model using implicit differentiation and incorporate the resulting pose, contact-point, and per-wheel surface-normal uncertainty terms into trajectory optimization based on the Cross-Entropy Method (CEM). Third, we introduce a Flow Matching model that warm-starts terrain fitting, and we evaluate its fitting-accuracy--latency trade-off while retaining model-based refinement. Across six synthetic terrains with 30 matched start--goal pairs per terrain, the complete framework produced an observed failure rate of 18.9%, compared with 46.1% and 41.7% for two representative baselines and 34.4% for an ablation that removed the propagated-uncertainty scoring. Hardware evaluations span six distinct outdoor environments, with two representative executions presented in the paper and four additional executions included in the supplementary video. The evaluation also reports the accuracy--latency trade-off for the Flow Matching warm start.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向非结构化越野环境的基于模型的准静态稳定性参考轨迹生成框架，针对刚性四轮车在崎岖地形上的自主导航。
AI.motivation: 越野自主导航需同时处理车辆-地形交互与环境未知性；地形遮挡造成的盲区会引入认知不确定性，影响轨迹稳定性与安全性。
AI.method: 将地形遮挡盲区建模为固定特征傅里叶地形表示中的覆盖诱导认知不确定性，并用正则化逆Hessian估计量化；通过隐式微分将不确定性传播到NLS位姿/接触模型，并将位姿、接触点和各轮表面法向不确定性纳入基于交叉熵方法(CEM)的轨迹优化；引入Flow Matching模型热启动地形拟合，同时保留基于模型的细化。
AI.result: 在6种合成地形、每种30对起止点中，完整框架失败率为18.9%，优于两个基线(46.1%、41.7%)及去除传播不确定性评分的消融(34.4%)；在6个户外环境进行硬件评估，论文展示2次代表性执行，补充视频另有4次；报告了Flow Matching热启动的精度-延迟权衡。
AI.conclusion: 所提框架通过量化并传播地形遮挡不确定性，有效降低了崎岖地形导航失败率；Flow Matching热启动在精度与延迟间提供可评估的权衡，结合模型细化可提升地形拟合效率。

title: From Image Interpretation to Clinical Reasoning: Upstream Physician-Context-Aware Multimodal Learning with Causal Reinforcement Learning
summary: Major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE) remain the leading cause of mortality worldwide. Opportunistic screening using routinely acquired clinical data offers a scalable approach for identifying high-risk individuals before acute events occur. Although chest X-rays (CXRs) capture latent cardiovascular biomarkers and clinical histories provide complementary patient context, existing medical vision-language models are primarily optimized for radiology interpretation rather than prognostic reasoning. We propose a causal reinforcement learning framework for multimodal clinical reasoning that integrates CXRs and physician-authored clinical histories for opportunistic MACE prediction. The framework introduces (1) a role-decoupled dual-LLM architecture that separates reasoning from risk prediction, (2) a dual-action causal reinforcement learning policy for evidence selection and reasoning optimization, and (3) causal token pruning to learn compact multimodal representations. Evaluated on an internal cohort, an emergency department cohort, and the external MIMIC dataset, the proposed framework consistently outperformed unimodal baselines and state-of-the-art medical vision-language models, achieving AUROCs of 0.720, 0.760, and 0.845, respectively. It also substantially improved reasoning quality, achieving higher GREEN scores and higher expert preference while maintaining robust predictive performance across diverse patient populations.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种因果强化学习框架，融合胸部X光片与临床病史进行机会性MACE预测，并在多个队列中优于单模态及先进医学视觉语言模型。
AI.motivation: MACE是全球主要死因，利用常规临床数据可在急性事件前识别高风险个体；但现有医学视觉语言模型主要面向影像解读，而非预后推理，且CX与病史的多模态互补信息未被充分利用。
AI.method: 提出多模态临床推理的因果强化学习框架，包括：角色解耦的双LLM架构，将推理与风险预测分离；双动作因果强化学习策略，用于证据选择与推理优化；因果token剪枝，学习紧凑多模态表征。
AI.result: 在内部队列、急诊队列和外部MIMIC数据集上分别取得AUROC 0.720、0.760、0.845，持续优于单模态基线和最先进医学视觉语言模型；同时GREEN分数和专家偏好显著提升，并保持跨人群稳健预测性能。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能够有效整合CX与临床病史进行机会性MACE预测，在预测性能与推理质量上均表现优越，展示了因果强化学习在临床多模态预后推理中的潜力。

title: Argument Structure Prediction in Online Conversations: A Comparative Study of Modeling Paradigms and Task Architectures
comment: CMNA'26: 26th International Workshop on Computational Models of Natural Argument
summary:
Argument structure prediction (ASP) constructs complete argument structures from discourse by identifying argumentative units and their relations. While recent work has explored diverse approaches---including unified neural models, multi-step pipelines, and prompt-based large language models (LLMs)---their relative trade-offs remain under-explored, particularly in dialogical settings.
  We present a systematic evaluation of ASP under strict schema constraints, comparing supervised fine-tuning and prompt-based LLMs across single- and multi-step task architectures, generating complete argument structures from dialogical input end-to-end. We benchmark them on three diverse dialogical corpora adapted from Inference Anchoring Theory into bipolar argument structures. Under a shared evaluation framework, we assess predictive performance, cross-domain generalization, schema compliance, and computational efficiency. Our results show that ASP remains a challenging task, with identifying argumentative relations emerging as the primary bottleneck, largely due to the implicit and context-dependent nature of dialogical argumentation. To facilitate future research, we release our data processing pipeline and end-to-end modeling framework for computational ASP on dialogical corpora.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了对话场景下的论点结构预测（ASP），比较监督微调与基于提示的大语言模型在不同任务架构下的表现，并发布数据处理流程与端到端建模框架。
AI.motivation: 现有ASP研究虽探索了统一神经模型、多步流水线和提示式LLM等方法，但其相对优劣仍未被充分研究，尤其是在对话场景和严格模式约束下。
AI.method: 在严格模式约束下，从对话输入端到端生成完整论点结构；比较监督微调与提示式LLM，以及单步和多步任务架构；使用三个由Inference Anchoring Theory改编为双极论点结构的对话语料库；在统一评估框架下考察预测性能、跨域泛化、模式合规性和计算效率。
AI.result: ASP仍是一项具有挑战性的任务，其中论点关系识别是主要瓶颈，主要源于对话论辩的隐含性和上下文依赖性。
AI.conclusion: 为促进后续研究，作者发布了面向对话语料库计算ASP的数据处理流程和端到端建模框架。

title: How Much Can Reliability Drift Under a Fixed Confidence Distribution?
summary: A classifier's conditional accuracy can change while its confidence distribution stays exactly the same. We study the worst-case movement of the reliability relation under covariate shifts that preserve the distribution of the confidence score, constraining the reweighting within each confidence level by a $χ^2$ budget; the resulting worst case, as a function of the budget, is a fragility profile. On an interval of budgets that can be computed from the source distribution, the profile equals exactly the square root of the budget times the within-level variance of the correctness propensity -- the grouping-loss term of calibration-refinement decompositions. Beyond this interval the profile is governed by the tails of the propensity law, and the entire upward profile determines the centred within-level law; consequently, calibration residual and grouping variance do not determine fragility in general, though they do when labels and predictions are deterministic. Since the propensity is not observed, we restrict reweightings to a learned finite readout within confidence bins, bound the part the restriction misses by the grouping variance remaining inside readout cells, estimate the restricted profile with role-separated labels, and provide a separate split-sample lower confidence bound. On ImageNet this bound is positive in both splits for four of six primary classifiers and nine of twelve additional ones as released, and for three of eighteen after temperature scaling. Held-out drift under optimised reweightings fitted without evaluation labels tracks the estimated profile; an exploratory label-permutation diagnostic yields near-zero agreement for this statistic while largely reproducing the correlation observed for unsigned random reweightings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究分类器在协变量偏移且置信度分布保持不变时，可靠性关系可能发生的最坏变化，并提出“脆弱性轮廓”来刻画这种风险；论文给出估计方法与置信下界，并在 ImageNet 上验证。
AI.motivation: 分类器的条件准确率可以在置信度分布完全相同的情况下发生变化，因此仅看校准误差或置信度分布可能无法揭示模型在分布偏移下的真实脆弱性；作者希望量化这种隐藏的最坏情形可靠性偏移。
AI.method: 在每个置信水平内用 χ² 预算约束重加权，定义最坏情形下的脆弱性轮廓；推导该轮廓与组内正确倾向方差及尾部行为的关系。由于正确倾向不可观测，作者将其限制为置信分箱内学习的有限读出，用读出单元内剩余分组方差界定遗漏部分，并使用角色分离标签估计受限轮廓，同时给出分样本置信下界。
AI.result: 在可由源分布计算的预算区间内，脆弱性轮廓等于预算平方根乘以正确倾向的组内方差，即校准-细化分解中的分组损失项；超出该区间后由倾向分布尾部决定，且整个上升轮廓决定中心化组内分布。ImageNet 上，该下界在两种划分中对 6 个主分类器中的 4 个、12 个附加分类器中的 9 个为正，温度缩放后 18 个中仅 3 个为正。优化重加权下的留出漂移能跟踪估计轮廓；标签置换诊断对该统计量近乎零一致，但大体重现了无符号随机重加权观察到的相关性。
AI.conclusion: 校准残差和分组方差一般不足以决定脆弱性，但在标签和预测确定时二者可决定脆弱性；论文提出的估计与下界能够揭示置信度分布不变条件下隐藏的可靠性脆弱性，并说明温度缩放等后处理可能显著改变该风险。

title: On the Relaxation of Conditional Independence Assumption for Image Segmentation
summary: In semantic segmentation, a recent line of RankSEG methods directly optimizes Dice/IoU scores at inference time, improving alignment with evaluation metrics without modifying model training. Despite its theoretical and empirical success, RankSEG relies on the restrictive Conditional Independence Assumption (CIA), which ignores crucial label correlations and therefore degrades performance in ambiguous or low-contrast scenarios. However, accounting for full label dependence is computationally prohibitive, requiring $\mathcal{O}(d^3)$ time. To address this, we replace the CIA with a Spatially Localized Dependence (SLD) structure that captures local label correlations while keeping the dependence model tractable. We further overcome the remaining computational bottleneck via a Reciprocal Moment Approximation coupled with a novel fixed-point optimization strategy that eliminates exhaustive search. The proposed algorithm achieves a highly practical $\mathcal{O}(d \log d)$ complexity and consistently outperforms conventional argmax and CIA-based RankSEG across diverse segmentation benchmarks. Improvements are significant in low-contrast or small-object scenarios, where label dependence offers valuable signals complementary to image information for accurate segmentation. The code of experiments is available at https://github.com/ZixunWang/RankSEG-DEP.

AI.tldr: 本文针对语义分割中的RankSEG方法，提出用空间局部依赖（SLD）替代条件独立假设（CIA），并结合互易矩近似与不动点优化，将复杂度降至O(d log d)，在多个分割基准上超越argmax和基于CIA的RankSEG。
AI.motivation: 现有RankSEG在推理时直接优化Dice/IoU，但依赖条件独立假设（CIA），忽略了标签相关性，导致在模糊或低对比度场景下性能下降；而完整建模标签依赖需要O(d^3)时间，计算不可行。
AI.method: 用空间局部依赖（SLD）结构替代CIA以捕捉局部标签相关性，保持依赖模型可处理；通过互易矩近似和一种新颖的不动点优化策略消除穷举搜索，实现O(d log d)的实用复杂度。
AI.result: 所提算法在多种分割基准上持续优于传统argmax和基于CIA的RankSEG，尤其在低对比度或小目标场景中提升显著，说明标签依赖能提供图像信息之外的补充信号。
AI.conclusion: 通过SLD建模局部标签依赖并采用高效近似与优化，可在不修改模型训练的情况下提升推理阶段与评估指标的对齐，且计算复杂度实用。代码已开源。

title: Drape-Compatible Tool-Tip Localization for Hand-Held Laparoscopic Instruments via UWB Carrier-Phase Ranging and Trocar-Constrained Geometry
summary: A surgical robot policy needs to know where each instrument's working end sits relative to the camera and to the other instrument, yet a laparoscopic operation leaves only the endoscope video, and a draped instrument hides every optical path on itself. We estimate the tool tips from distances and an IMU alone. The distances are measured by ultra-wideband carrier phase between antenna nodes on the handle side of the instruments: one per hand-held instrument, one on the endoscope, all outside the sterile barrier. Take the endoscope antenna as the reference. The two instrument antennas carry six coordinates while the three pairs give three distances, so the problem is short by three, and averaging cannot close that gap because what is missing is information, not precision. Carrier phase adds one more unknown per pair, an integer that leaves distance fixed only modulo lambda/2 = 23.1 mm. The trocar settles both difficulties: each shaft passes through a port whose position is known and whose direction the on-board IMU measures, so its antenna keeps a single degree of freedom, the insertion depth. Two unknowns now face three distances -- two fix the depths and the third is left over, and that spare equation exposes a wrong integer or a wrong mounting offset instead of absorbing it. The same solve returns both tool tips in the endoscope frame, without the second carrier frequency that integer resolution usually needs, so the link never leaves a single PLL lock. In an 11-hole phantom among metal instruments the three distances hold sigma = 0.10-0.33 mm at 35-46 Hz, a sterile drape pressed onto the antennas leaves the link unchanged where an optical path would be blocked, and the logger was carried into a live rabbit appendectomy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出仅用超宽带载波相位测距和IMU来估计腹腔镜手术器械尖端相对内窥镜相机的位置。通过套管针已知位置和IMU测得方向提供约束，解决欠定与载波相位整数模糊问题，无需第二载频即可同时解出两个器械尖端。
AI.motivation: 手术机器人策略需要知道器械工作端相对相机及另一器械的位置。但腹腔镜手术仅有内窥镜视频，且铺巾会遮挡器械上的光学路径，因此需要不依赖光学且能穿透无菌屏障的定位方法。
AI.method: 在手持器械和内窥镜的手柄侧、无菌屏障外安装超宽带天线节点，以内窥镜天线为参考，用载波相位测量三对天线间距离，并结合器械上的IMU。利用套管针位置已知及IMU测得方向，将每个器械天线约束为仅剩插入深度一个自由度，从而用三个距离解两个深度并留出冗余方程检测错误整数或安装偏移。
AI.result: 在含金属器械的11孔体模中，三个距离在35–46 Hz下标准差为0.10–0.33 mm；无菌铺巾压在天线上时链路不受影响，而光学路径会被遮挡；记录系统还被带入活体兔阑尾切除术中测试。
AI.conclusion: 该方法可在内窥镜坐标系中同时返回两个器械尖端，无需第二载波频率进行整数解算，使链路保持单个PLL锁定，并能应对无菌铺巾遮挡，展示了临床前可行性。

title: Blackout vs. Freeze: Analyzing Physical Failure Modes of VLAs under Camera Faults
summary: Unreliable visual inputs can harm task performance and cause potential physical safety risks for vision-language-action (VLA) models. We analyze how $π0.5$ and GR00T models act under input faults such as image blackouts and freezing. We find that blackout and freezing produce distinct physical failure modes even when task-success rates are similarly low: freezing causes more extreme joint behavior, whereas blackout after gripper closure can cause more object drops, most markedly without proprioception. Selective intervention studies reveal that proprioception (current robot state) partly compensates for the removed robot depictions and reduces non-target contact. However, it cannot sufficiently restore task success when wrist-view object information is removed, even when aided by the remaining scene view. We then evaluate two mitigation approaches: camera-blackout training and training-free replacement of faulty visual embeddings. Both improve task success in selected conditions, but can increase unintended contact or disturbance to surrounding objects. Real-robot trials further show that successful execution under camera faults can still involve unintended physical interactions. These findings motivate designing VLA policies that use the robot and object information still available under camera faults to limit hazardous motion.

AI.tldr: 本文分析视觉-语言-动作模型在图像黑屏和冻结等输入故障下的行为，发现不同故障会导致不同物理失效模式，并评估了两种缓解方法。
AI.motivation: 不可靠视觉输入会损害VLA模型任务表现并带来物理安全风险，因此需要理解模型在相机故障下如何行动及如何缓解。
AI.method: 以π0.5和GR00T为对象，分析图像黑屏与冻结下的任务成功率和物理失效模式；开展选择性干预实验考察本体感觉和不同视角信息的作用；评估相机黑屏训练和无训练故障视觉嵌入替换两种缓解方法；并进行真实机器人试验。
AI.result: 黑屏和冻结即使任务成功率都低，也会产生不同失效：冻结导致更极端的关节行为，夹爪闭合后黑屏更易掉物，缺少本体感觉时尤甚。本体感觉能部分补偿机器人本体信息缺失并减少非目标接触，但无法在缺失腕部视角物体信息时恢复成功率。两种缓解方法在部分条件下提升成功率，却可能增加意外接触或对周围物体的扰动。真实机器人中，相机故障下成功执行仍可能伴随意外物理交互。
AI.conclusion: 应设计能利用相机故障下仍可获得的机器人及物体信息来限制危险运动的VLA策略。

title: Learning What to Forget: Distributional Unlearning for LLM Representation Spaces
summary: Machine learning systems increasingly face the need to remove the influence of entire data domains, such as toxic language, harmful behavior, or topical content, rather than isolated records. Recent work formalizes this problem as \emph{distributional unlearning}: selecting a subset of a forget domain whose removal moves the training distribution away from an unwanted population while preserving proximity to the desired one. However, existing analyses often impose parametric assumptions to obtain tractable selection rules. These assumptions may be poorly suited to high-dimensional language-model representations. We introduce \textsc{Mamushi}, a framework for non-parametric distributional unlearning that ranks forget examples using a probabilistic classifier whose Bayes-optimal logit equals the forget-to-retain log-density ratio (up to an additive class-prior constant). We show that thresholding the population log-density ratio yields the optimal fixed-budget selection rule for our removal--preservation objective and establish a non-asymptotic transfer guarantee relating score-estimation and threshold-calibration errors to degradation from the population-optimal selection rule. Our empirical evaluation spans real-world datasets on toxic-language removal and topical-domain removal regimes using different representations, with \textsc{Mamushi} achieving a more favorable removal--preservation trade-off than other baselines. Our work shows that \textsc{Mamushi} can serve as an efficient selection approach for downstream machine unlearning procedures, reducing the number of forget examples required to reach a fixed forgetting target.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Mamushi，一种非参数分布性遗忘框架，用概率分类器的 Bayes 最优 logit 等于遗忘域到保留域的对数密度比来排序遗忘样本；在固定预算下，阈值化该比值是最优选择规则，并提供非渐近迁移保证。实验表明其在毒性语言和主题域移除中取得更好的移除-保留权衡，并能减少达到固定遗忘目标所需的遗忘样本数。
AI.motivation: 机器学习系统常需移除整个数据域的影响，如毒性语言、有害行为或主题内容，而非仅删除孤立记录。现有分布性遗忘分析多依赖参数假设，这些假设可能不适合高维语言模型表示。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为分布性遗忘：选择遗忘域子集，使训练分布远离不想要总体并保持接近期望总体。提出非参数框架 Mamushi，利用概率分类器的 Bayes 最优 logit 估计遗忘到保留的对数密度比（至多相差类别先验常数），据此排序并阈值选择固定预算样本。理论上证明阈值化总体对数密度比是固定预算下最优选择规则，并建立非渐近迁移保证，将分数估计和阈值校准误差与相对总体最优选择的退化联系起来。
AI.result: 在真实世界的毒性语言移除和主题域移除任务、不同表示下评估，Mamushi 相比其他基线实现更有利的移除-保留权衡。它可作为下游机器遗忘流程的高效选择方法，减少达到固定遗忘目标所需的遗忘样本数量。
AI.conclusion: Mamushi 表明，非参数、基于密度比排序的选择方法能有效解决分布性遗忘问题，避免不适合高维语言模型表示参数假设，并提升遗忘效率与移除-保留权衡。

title: Targeted Retrieval, Compact Representations: How CoT Reasoning Improves Long-Context Counting
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have been rapidly improving in long-context tasks, powered by Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning. However, the internal mechanisms underlying this improvement remain unclear. We investigate these mechanisms through a needle-in-a-haystack (NIAH) counting task, where an LLM is asked to count the number of records dispersed in a long text. Across twelve model comparison groups, Thinking (or reasoning) improves counting accuracy over Non-thinking, with pronounced gains at larger counts. This motivates our mechanistic analysis, which identifies two contrasting mechanisms: (i) broad retrieval, where Non-thinking models broadly attend to multiple needles; (ii) targeted retrieval, where Thinking models use enumeration in CoT traces to successively retrieve needles. Targeted retrieval concentrates attention on individual needles and is accompanied by more compact internal representations. Moreover, causal intervention analysis suggests that Thinking models use the CoT trace to maintain and update an internal counter as needles are successively retrieved, even without explicit numbering. In small controlled experiments, both retrieval mechanisms and counter states emerge under standard autoregressive training. Together, our results connect long-context retrieval with representation geometry of counting, supporting a state-tracking account of CoT reasoning.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过“大海捞针”计数任务，揭示大语言模型长上下文推理中Chain-of-Thought提升性能的内部机制：Thinking模型采用定向检索与内部计数器，而非Thinking模型主要依赖广泛检索。
AI.motivation: 尽管CoT推理显著提升LLM长上下文任务表现，但其背后的内部机制仍不清楚。
AI.method: 采用needle-in-a-haystack计数任务，在12组模型比较中对比Thinking与非Thinking；结合机制分析、注意力与表示分析、因果干预，以及小型受控实验。
AI.result: Thinking比非Thinking计数更准，计数越大提升越明显；非Thinking广泛关注多个needle，Thinking通过CoT枚举依次定向检索needle，注意力更集中、表示更紧凑；因果干预表明CoT轨迹用于维护和更新内部计数器，即使无显式编号；检索机制与计数器状态可在标准自回归训练中出现。
AI.conclusion: 研究将长上下文检索与计数的表示几何联系起来，支持CoT推理是一种状态跟踪机制的解释。

title: RAIM: Robust Aggregation of Inexpensive Models for Hallucination Detection
comment: 49 pages, 23 tables, 10 figures. Code and data: https://github.com/eOnofri04/raim-analysis and https://github.com/eOnofri04/raim-verdicts
summary: Automatic evaluation of faithfulness increasingly relies on a large language model acting as a judge, yet the most reliable judges are proprietary frontier models, costly and ill-suited to high-throughput monitoring. We investigate whether a panel of cheap open-weight judges (4--9B) can be aggregated to stand in for a frontier one, what the substitution sacrifices, and when it is worth making. We propose RAIM, an aggregation scheme robust to the members' correlated errors, coupling a cross-fitted stacked logistic regression with an admissibility test that, read from the members' own outputs, identifies when aggregating them improves on their best member and stays within reach of the frontier judge. We instantiate RAIM with ten judges from disjoint families across eight faithfulness benchmarks. Against Claude Sonnet, the panel retains a median 93% of its Cohen's $κ$ and gives up only 2.9 points of balanced accuracy on average; read as paired differences, it clearly improves on one benchmark and clearly worsens on three (only two by a non-negligible margin), leaving four unresolved. At a sixty-fourth of the frontier's inference price, the operative expense is a one-time in-domain calibration on 50--100 labelled records. The panel is also competitive with purpose-trained detectors on their home benchmarks (within 1.3 accuracy points of GPT-4o and 1.9 of the LLM-AggreFact leader), and beats the strongest one we reran by 6 points on our grounded sets. Whether aggregation pays depends on the members themselves: where several capable members err on different items, the panel improves on its best judge and approaches the frontier; where one dominates, the stacker recovers the leader, and only there does the frontier remain materially ahead. Both conditions are read off the calibration set at no further cost, so a cheap panel can stand in for a frontier one wherever this audit admits it.

AI.tldr: 本文研究能否用一组廉价的开放权重小模型评委（4–9B）聚合替代昂贵的前沿模型评委，以进行忠实性自动评估，并提出RAIM聚合方法及其准入测试。
AI.motivation: 忠实性评估日益依赖大语言模型作为评委，但最可靠的评委多为昂贵、难以支撑高通量监测的专有前沿模型，因此需要探索低成本替代方案及其代价和适用条件。
AI.method: 提出RAIM：一种对成员相关错误稳健的聚合方案，结合交叉拟合的堆叠逻辑回归与准入测试；该测试仅依据成员自身输出，判断聚合是否优于最佳成员并接近前沿评委。实验使用10个来自不同模型家族的评委，覆盖8个忠实性基准。
AI.result: 相对Claude Sonnet，评委小组保留中位数93%的Cohen κ，平均仅损失2.9个平衡准确率点；成对差异显示1个基准明显提升、3个明显下降（仅2个降幅不可忽略）、4个未定。推理成本为前沿模型的1/64，主要开销是50–100条标注记录的一次性域内校准。该小组在原生基准上也接近专用检测器：距GPT-4o 1.3个准确率点、距LLM-AggreFact榜首1.9个点，并在 grounded 集上比复跑的最强检测器高6个点。
AI.conclusion: 聚合是否值得取决于成员：若多个有能力的成员在不同样本上出错，则小组优于最佳单个评委并接近前沿；若一个成员占主导，堆叠器会退化为该领先者，此时前沿模型仍明显更强。这两种条件均可无额外成本地从校准集读出，因此只要通过该审计，廉价评委小组即可替代前沿模型。

title: Beyond Spatial-Domain Supervision: A Relation Constrained Space for Multi-Modal Image Fusion
summary: Multi-modal image fusion (MMIF) aims to form a single image by integrating shared information, preserving complementary cues, and coordinating cross-modal conflicts across modalities. However, due to the absence of ground-truth fused images, existing MMIF supervision commonly uses spatial-domain sources or gradient variants as surrogate ground truth, making the supervision mechanism inherently misaligned with the goal of MMIF and causing pixel-level compromise or modality bias. To address this, we propose a relation-constrained supervision paradigm that moves fusion supervision from the spatial domain to a learned relation space. Rather than relying solely on direct source approximation, we further leverage frozen pretrained representation models as information providers and design a learnable feature adapter to align heterogeneous DINO and CLIP features into a unified supervision space. The adapter infers three relation parameters, namely sharedness, dominance, and coordination radius, which define three losses corresponding to the MMIF's goal. To make this space reliable, we devise a self-supervised contrastive ranking objective tailored to the adapter and couple it with the fusion network through alternating optimization. Extensive experiments show that the proposed supervision space yields significant gains regardless of which mainstream backbone the fusion network adopts, offering a supervision paradigm better aligned with the goal of MMIF. Code: github.com/GMY628/RCS-Fusion.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种关系约束监督范式，将多模态图像融合（MMIF）的监督从空间域转移到学习到的关系空间，以更好对齐融合目标。
AI.motivation: 现有MMIF因缺乏真实融合图像，常用空间域源图像或梯度变体作为替代监督，导致监督机制与MMIF目标不一致，易产生像素级折中或模态偏置。
AI.method: 利用冻结的预训练DINO和CLIP作为信息提供者，设计可学习特征适配器，将异构特征对齐到统一监督空间；适配器推断共享性、主导性和协调半径三个关系参数，并定义对应三种损失；同时提出面向适配器的自监督对比排序目标，并与融合网络交替优化。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，无论融合网络采用哪种主流骨干，所提监督空间均带来显著性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 该监督范式比传统替代监督更符合MMIF目标，为多模态图像融合提供了更有效的监督机制。

title: Linear Recurrent Memory Suffices to Distil a World-Model Policy for Robot Air Hockey
summary: Does memory-dependent control need nonlinear recurrent dynamics? We study simulated air-hockey defence under temporary loss of puck tracking. A DreamerV3 teacher outperforms a memoryless policy under tracking loss, while resetting the teacher's recurrent state sharply reduces performance, which demonstrates that the task requires memory. We distil this teacher into compact recurrent policies with a 64 dimensional state, with a combination of a diagonal linear recurrence and an optional rank-$k$ nonlinear innovation while retaining nonlinear observation encoders and action heads. Across five matched seeds, the purely linear recurrent model ($k=0$) matches both the GRU baseline and the teacher throughout the tested range of tracking loss. Increasing nonlinear innovation rank providing no measured benefits. This result is obtained on a fresh test split, which will be only opened after all models and analyses are frozen. The linear model requires fewer recurrent parameters and less computation than GRU, but performs comparably. These results suggest that, for this memory dependent control task, nonlinear representation learning around a simple linear memory mechanism can be sufficient, and that nonlinear recurrent dynamics are not necessarily required. These conclusions are limited to the simulated task, teacher, state dimension, and blackout horizon considered here, and to policies whose observation encoder and action head remain nonlinear.

AI.tldr: 该研究在模拟空气曲棍球防守且暂时丢失冰球跟踪的任务中，检验记忆依赖控制是否需要非线性循环动态。通过将DreamerV3教师蒸馏为64维紧凑循环策略，发现纯线性循环模型（k=0）在五个匹配种子下可匹配GRU基线和教师，增加非线性创新项未带来可测收益。
AI.motivation: 记忆依赖控制通常使用GRU等非线性循环网络，但是否真正需要非线性循环动态尚不清楚。作者希望在一个明确需要记忆的模拟控制任务中，分离线性记忆机制与非线性表征学习的作用。
AI.method: 使用DreamerV3教师训练模拟空气曲棍球防守任务，并测试在暂时丢失冰球跟踪时的表现；通过重置教师循环状态验证任务对记忆的依赖。将教师蒸馏为64维状态的紧凑循环策略，采用对角线性循环并可选加入rank-k非线性创新项，同时保留非线性观测编码器和动作头；在五个匹配种子上比较纯线性模型、GRU基线和教师。
AI.result: DreamerV3教师在跟踪丢失下优于无记忆策略，重置其循环状态会显著降低性能，说明任务需要记忆。纯线性循环模型（k=0）在整个测试跟踪丢失范围内匹配GRU基线和教师；提高非线性创新秩未测得收益。线性模型所需循环参数和计算量少于GRU，但性能相当。
AI.conclusion: 对于该记忆依赖控制任务，围绕简单线性记忆机制进行非线性表征学习可能已经足够，非线性循环动态并非必要。结论受限于所考虑的模拟任务、教师、状态维度和黑障时长，且仅适用于观测编码器和动作头保持非线性的策略。

title: 4MT-VLM: How Coarse Is a VLMs Cognitive Map?
summary: An agent that moves must recognise a place from a viewpoint it has never seen. We introduce 4MT-VLM, a dataset of procedurally generated landscapes, each rendered across five stimulus modes that remove appearance cues while holding layout fixed: shape and colour, shape only, colour only, bare terrain peaks with no objects, and a valley viewpoint that puts the peaks on the horizon. The last condition is commonly used in clinics to probe hippocampal function in human patients. We test this benchmark across sixteen different open and closed-source models and report 4AFC performance, a measure which is also used to grade human participants. We observe that models identify a place from the studied viewpoint but lose it once the camera moves, dropping below the 25% chance level at 135° where a human observer scores 85%. Frontier models (Gemini 3.8 Flash, GPT-5.6) answer only 39% and 31% of rotated trials correctly, recovering to 85% and 55% only when distractors are moved more than 30 meters apart. Our benchmark demonstrates that while current VLMs possess rudimentary cognitive maps, their spatial resolution remains fundamentally too coarse to maintain a stable, 3D understanding of the world once the viewpoint changes.

AI.tldr: 论文提出4MT-VLM基准数据集，用程序生成的景观在五种刺激模式下测试视觉语言模型（VLM）从新视角识别地点的能力，发现模型在视角旋转后性能急剧下降，远低于人类水平。
AI.motivation: 移动的智能体必须能够从从未见过的视角识别地点，但当前VLM是否具备这种稳定的三维空间理解能力尚不清楚，因此需要一个可控的、去除外观线索的基准来检验。
AI.method: 构建4MT-VLM数据集，程序化生成景观并在五种刺激模式中渲染（形状+颜色、仅形状、仅颜色、无物体的裸地形山峰、山峰位于地平线的山谷视角），在十六个开源与闭源模型上测试，采用与人类被试相同的4AFC指标评估。
AI.result: 模型能从已学习视角识别地点，但相机移动后便失效：在135°旋转时低于25%随机水平，而人类得分85%；前沿模型Gemini 3.8 Flash和GPT-5.6在旋转试次中仅答对39%和31%，只有当干扰物间距超过30米时才分别回升到85%和55%。
AI.conclusion: 当前VLM仅具备初步的认知地图，其空间分辨率过于粗糙，一旦视角改变便无法维持稳定、一致的三维世界理解。

title: Alleviating Hallucination in Reasoning Tasks with Training-Free Uncertainty-Guided Steering
summary: Recent work on hallucination detection in large language models has shown that, for a fixed pre-trained model and reasoning task, it is possible to estimate the model's confidence in the correctness of its outputs. Such uncertainty estimates have primarily been used to improve truthfulness by detecting or filtering confabulations. In this work, we ask whether these signals can instead be used more proactively to directly improve the accuracy of model-generated answers. We propose USteer, a simple, training-free steering mechanism that adjusts a model's layer-wise activations during inference using the gradient of a confidence measure with respect to the activations. This procedure nudges generation toward outputs with lower uncertainty at inference time, without modifying model parameters or requiring additional supervision. We show that this approach consistently reduces hallucination across a range of tasks, demonstrating that confidence signals can be leveraged not only for detection, but also for effective inference-time control of model behavior.

AI.tldr: 提出USteer：一种无需训练、利用置信度梯度在推理时调整模型层激活的干预方法，以减少大语言模型幻觉并提升生成答案准确性。
AI.motivation: 已有研究主要用不确定性估计来检测或过滤幻觉，属于被动事后处理；作者希望探索能否主动利用这些置信信号，在推理时直接提升模型生成答案的正确性。
AI.method: 提出USteer，一种简单、无需训练的推理时激活引导机制。它计算置信度度量相对于层激活的梯度，并据此调整模型各层激活，使生成结果趋向更低不确定性；不修改模型参数，也不需要额外监督。
AI.result: 在多种任务上，该方法能够一致地减少幻觉，说明置信信号可用于推理时控制模型行为。
AI.conclusion: 置信信号不仅可用于幻觉检测，还可被主动用于推理时干预；USteer表明无需修改参数即可利用不确定性估计提升模型真实性与答案准确性。

title: Concurrent Semantic Search and Mission Execution for LTL Missions in Unknown Environments
summary:
Planning complex missions in unknown environments requires robots to reason simultaneously about what they should do and what they still need to discover. Existing approaches for solving LTLf missions typically assume a known environment, or separate the exploration of the environment from the execution of the mission, while semantic exploration methods look for one target at a time and ignore the mission being executed.
  To fill this gap, our main contribution is an adaptive high-level planning method that interleaves a task-driven semantic search with the execution of the mission, advancing both in a non-myopic manner.
  Our method leverages two representations built online, a metric-semantic scene graph, built with a Vision Language Model (VLM), that provides the evidence needed to locate the objects the mission refers to, and the deterministic finite automaton (DFA) encoding the mission, that indicates which of them matter at each mission state. At every planning stage, our planner selects the waypoints that are most valuable for both the semantic search and the advancement of the mission, valuing them over the remaining mission stages in order to avoid blocking states. The selected waypoints are then ordered in a single high-level plan, which is recomputed as new information arrives.
  In photorealistic indoor environments over five mission types, our method completes more missions than the compared approaches while having to cover less of the environment, and it does so with shorter paths and complying with the restrictions imposed by the mission.

AI.tldr: 提出一种自适应高层规划方法，将任务驱动的语义搜索与LTLf任务执行交织进行，在未知环境中非短视地推进两者。
AI.motivation: 现有LTLf任务规划假设环境已知或将探索与执行分离，语义探索方法一次只找一个目标且忽略任务执行，难以在未知环境中高效完成复杂任务。
AI.method: 在线构建两种表示：基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的度量语义场景图，用于定位任务所指对象；编码任务的确定性有限自动机（DFA），指示各任务状态下哪些对象重要。规划阶段选择对语义搜索和任务推进最有价值的航点，并考虑剩余任务阶段以避免阻塞状态，将航点排序为单一高层计划，随新信息到达重新计算。
AI.result: 在逼真室内环境的五种任务类型中，该方法比对比方法完成更多任务，覆盖更少环境，路径更短，且符合任务限制。
AI.conclusion: 表明交织任务驱动语义搜索与任务执行的自适应非短视规划能有效提升未知环境下LTLf复杂任务的完成效率与合规性。

title: LocoWM: High-Precision Locomotion through World-Model-Guided Residual Adaptation
summary: High-precision locomotion combines motion-command tracking with precise regulation of task-relevant physical states, enabling robots to interact reliably with their surroundings during motion. Joint end-to-end optimization can leave precision objectives insufficiently optimized, while reactive residual control adjusts actions only after deviations become observable. We present \textbf{LocoWM}, a world-model-guided preactive residual adaptation framework for high-precision locomotion. A base policy provides command-following locomotion, while an action-conditioned world model predicts a sequence of future physical states from proprioceptive history and the proposed base action. A residual adapter conditions on this predicted sequence to generate additive action corrections that compensate for anticipated deviations. Two-stage training first learns locomotion and action-conditioned dynamics, then freezes both modules while training the adapter, separating locomotion acquisition from precision adaptation. Experiments spanning terrain leveling, acceleration compensation, and push recovery demonstrate improved control precision and disturbance robustness over end-to-end and reactive residual baselines. Demos and code are available at: https://zhaozijie2022.github.io/LocoWM

AI.tldr: 提出LocoWM，一种基于世界模型引导的预主动残差自适应框架，用于实现高精度运动控制。
AI.motivation: 现有端到端优化难以充分优化精度目标，而反应式残差控制仅在偏差可观测后才调整动作，无法提前补偿。
AI.method: 基础策略负责指令跟随运动；动作条件世界模型根据本体感受历史和基础动作预测未来物理状态序列；残差适配器基于预测序列生成加性动作修正。采用两阶段训练：先学习运动和动作条件动力学，再冻结两者训练适配器。
AI.result: 在地形平整、加速度补偿和推力恢复实验中，相比端到端和反应式残差基线，控制精度和抗扰动鲁棒性均有提升。
AI.conclusion: LocoWM通过世界模型引导的预主动残差适应，将运动获取与精度适应分离，有效提高了高精度运动控制的性能。

title: Exploiting Vulnerabilities: Universal Adversarial Attacks on Vision-Language-Action Models in Robotics
comment: Accepted to the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA 2026), Vienna, Austria. 8 pages. (c) 2026 IEEE. Personal use of this material is permitted. Permission from IEEE must be obtained for all other uses, in any current or future media, including reprinting/republishing this material for advertising or promotional purposes
summary: Recently, Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have revolutionized robotic manipulation by seamlessly integrating visual perception, language understanding, and action generation in an end-to-end learning framework. However, since these models are designed to interact directly with the physical world and humans, their security is critical, and even small vulnerabilities can lead to catastrophic failures. In this work, we propose the Universal Adversarial Object, a sphere with optimized surface texture that significantly degrades task success rates when placed within the robot's field of view. Specifically, our approach introduces a multi-level attack framework that jointly disrupts trajectory planning, task execution, and action control. We validate our method in both simulated and real-world robotic settings. Experimental results demonstrate that the adversarial object reduces the average task success rates by 31.2%-39.9% for two representative VLA models (Pi0 and RDT), with success rates dropping to near zero in complex scenarios. Index Terms--Vision-Language-Action models, adversarial attack, robotic security, universal adversarial object

AI.tldr: 本文提出通用对抗物体（Universal Adversarial Object），一种表面纹理经过优化的球体。将其置于机器人视野中可显著降低视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的任务成功率，并在仿真和真实环境中验证了攻击有效性。
AI.motivation: VLA模型将视觉感知、语言理解和动作生成集成到端到端框架中，可直接与物理世界和人类交互，因此安全性至关重要。即使微小漏洞也可能导致灾难性失败，促使研究者探索其对抗脆弱性。
AI.method: 提出多层级攻击框架，联合干扰轨迹规划、任务执行和动作控制。核心是设计一个表面纹理优化的通用对抗球体，放置在机器人视野内即可实施攻击。在仿真和真实机器人环境中对Pi0和RDT两种代表性VLA模型进行验证。
AI.result: 实验表明，该对抗物体使两个VLA模型平均任务成功率下降31.2%-39.9%，在复杂场景中成功率降至接近零。
AI.conclusion: VLA模型对通用对抗物体存在显著安全漏洞，仅通过视野中的对抗纹理即可严重破坏机器人操作任务，凸显了机器人安全防御的紧迫性。

title: Routing Probes Can Improve Without New Information: An Exact-Null Audit of Uncertainty Beyond Model Outputs
summary: Routing signals of modern vision transformers -- expert gates, attention-residual weights and halting scores -- often improve probes that predict whether the model is correct, and the improvement is commonly read as evidence that routing carries information about errors beyond the model's outputs. We test this inference directly: keeping real output-routing pairs, we redraw correctness labels from a frozen output-only generator fitted on disjoint data, so that routing is uninformative by construction. Under this exact label null, a width-matched MLP comparison still reports a routing gain in 51.3% of confidence-only evaluations (308/600), while a linear comparison reports none. Holding each training trajectory fixed on a six-model panel and selecting the checkpoint by validation log loss instead of validation accuracy removes the detections (50/120 to 0/120, and 83/120 to 0/120 in an independently implemented probe), identifying accuracy-based checkpoint selection as the cause; across all output views the raw detection rate falls from 27.5% (528/1,920) to zero observed detections. The repaired comparison is not sensitive, detecting an implanted signal of about 0.005 nats in 0/20 replicates in each of two matched settings, whereas a conditional permutation test built on an estimated routing law detects it in 11/20 and 10/20 and rejects rarely under the null. On real correctness labels, the conditional analysis yields model-relative evidence in five DeiT attention-residual families; in four it persists under two specified variants of the conditional law, and no family passes an additional noise criterion. Fitting a better probe and testing for incremental information are different problems, and each needs its own validation.

AI.tldr: 论文直接检验“视觉Transformer的路由信号能提供超越模型输出的错误信息”这一常见推断。结果发现，常用探针比较会因准确率选检查点等偏差产生虚假路由增益；改用验证log loss选检查点后检测消失。作者随后采用基于估计路由律的条件置换检验，在真实标签上对五个DeiT注意力残差族给出模型相对证据，但证据仍受条件律与噪声标准限制。
AI.motivation: 现代视觉Transformer中的路由信号（专家门控、注意力残差权重、停止分数）常能提升预测模型是否正确的外挂探针，这被解读为路由包含输出之外的错误信息。作者认为这一推断需要直接检验，排除探针拟合、检查点选择或标签构造带来的伪影。
AI.method: 构造精确标签零假设：保留真实输出-路由对，但从仅在输出上、且在不相交数据上拟合的冻结生成器重抽正确性标签，使路由原则上无信息。比较线性探针与宽度匹配MLP探针；固定训练轨迹，并比较按验证准确率与验证log loss选择检查点；进行植入信号敏感度测试；提出基于估计路由律的条件置换检验，并在DeiT注意力残差族真实正确性标签上分析。
AI.result: 在标签零假设下，宽度匹配MLP仍在51.3%（308/600）的仅置信度评估中报告路由增益，线性比较则无。固定六模型面板训练轨迹并改用验证log loss选检查点后，检测从50/120降至0/120，独立实现探针从83/120降至0/120；总体原始检测率从27.5%（528/1920）降至0。修复后的比较不敏感：约0.005 nats植入信号在两组匹配设置中均为0/20检测；条件置换检验则分别检测到11/20和10/20，且零假设下很少拒绝。真实标签上，条件分析在五个DeiT注意力残差族中给出模型相对证据，四个在两种条件律变体下仍成立，但没有族通过额外噪声标准。
AI.conclusion: 拟合更好的探针与检验增量信息是两个不同问题，需要各自的验证。常见的路由增益可能主要由准确率型检查点选择等偏差造成，而非路由真正携带额外错误信息；条件置换检验更合适，但在真实数据上的证据仍有限且不稳健。

title: PARK: Accurate Block Retrieval for Sparse Attention in Video Diffusion Transformers
summary: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have become a dominant architecture for video generation, but their efficiency is limited by the quadratic complexity of full attention. Sparse attention reduces this cost by retrieving important blocks and computing attention only within them, but inaccurate retrieval can either degrade generation quality or yield unnecessary computation. We identify two retrieval mismatches in methods that retrieve blocks using the averaged representations of query and key blocks: (i) query-side aggregation mismatch, where averaging queries before Softmax fails to preserve their individual attention preferences, and (ii) key-side clustering metric mismatch, where standard Euclidean clustering in the original key space can group keys with dissimilar QK scores under the current query, so their average representation may not accurately represent how the current query scores individual keys. These mismatches can lead to inaccurate block retrieval. To address these mismatches, we propose PARK, a training-free sparse attention method for accurate block retrieval. PARK retains every original query, independently normalizes its attention over key blocks, and then averages these distributions within each query block. It also uses information from the current queries to transform keys before clustering, so that keys receiving similar QK scores are grouped together. A fused GPU kernel further reduces the overhead of block retrieval. Experiments on HunyuanVideo and Wan demonstrate that PARK improves block retrieval accuracy and preserves generation quality while accelerating inference, achieving the best quality-efficiency trade-off among the compared sparse attention methods.

AI.tldr: 本文针对视频扩散 Transformer 中稀疏注意力块检索不准确的问题，提出无需训练的 PARK 方法，通过改进查询聚合与键聚类来提升块检索准确性，并在保持生成质量的同时加速推理。
AI.motivation: DiT 在视频生成中效率受全注意力二次复杂度限制。稀疏注意力通过检索重要块降低计算量，但现有方法基于查询块和键块的平均表示进行检索，存在两类不匹配：查询侧平均会丢失单个查询的注意力偏好；键侧在原始键空间用欧氏距离聚类，可能把当前查询下 QK 分数差异大的键分到一组，导致块检索不准确，进而损害生成质量或造成无效计算。
AI.method: 提出 PARK，一种无需训练的稀疏注意力方法。它保留每个原始查询，独立在键块上归一化注意力分布，再在查询块内平均这些分布；同时利用当前查询信息对键进行变换后再聚类，使当前查询下 QK 分数相近的键被分到同一组；并设计融合 GPU 核以降低块检索开销。
AI.result: 在 HunyuanVideo 和 Wan 上的实验表明，PARK 提升了块检索准确性，在加速推理的同时保持生成质量，在所比较的稀疏注意力方法中取得了最佳的质量-效率权衡。
AI.conclusion: PARK 通过修正查询侧聚合和键侧聚类中的检索不匹配，实现了更准确的稀疏注意力块检索，是一种有效且无需训练的 DiT 视频生成加速方案。

title: Mitigating Object Hallucination in Large Vision-Language Models via False Discovery Controlled Visual Data Splitting
summary: Multiple object hallucination, where large vision-language models (LVLMs) generate objects not supported by the visual input, is a persistent challenge caused by visual uncertainty during decoding. Existing methods reduce hallucinations using contrastive signals, but they rely on heuristics and lack principled control of false positives at the image level. To address this, we propose False Discovery Rate-COntRol of HALlucination (CORAL), a training-free framework that models visual uncertainty using an uncertainty-aware visual data splitting strategy and leverages mirror statistics to quantify visual contrast during decoding. By computing mirror statistics from paired, symmetrically perturbed visual inputs, CORAL estimates spurious object predictions and sets a data-driven threshold to control the expected fraction of false discoveries per image, suppressing hallucinations while retaining high power for truly grounded objects. The framework is flexible, supports multiple LVLMs, and mitigates hallucinations without retraining or supervision. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks with several evaluation metrics demonstrate that CORAL consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, providing more reliable and robust hallucination control. Code is available at: https://changliu1993-cl.github.io/CORAL/

AI.tldr: 论文提出 CORAL，一种无需训练的框架，通过不确定性感知的视觉数据划分与镜像统计来控制多目标幻觉，在图像级别控制错误发现率，从而抑制 LVLM 的幻觉并保留真实物体的预测能力。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型在解码时因视觉不确定性会产生多目标幻觉，即生成图像中不存在的物体。现有基于对比信号的方法依赖启发式规则，缺乏对图像级假阳性的原则性控制。
AI.method: CORAL 使用不确定性感知的视觉数据划分策略建模视觉不确定性，并利用镜像统计量化解码过程中的视觉对比。具体地，通过对成对且对称扰动的视觉输入计算镜像统计，估计虚假物体预测，并设置数据驱动阈值，以控制每张图像中预期错误发现比例。该框架无需重训练或监督，可支持多种 LVLM。
AI.result: 在多个基准和多种评估指标上的大量实验表明，CORAL 持续优于当前最先进方法，能够提供更可靠、更稳健的幻觉控制。
AI.conclusion: CORAL 是一种灵活、无需训练且无需监督的幻觉抑制框架，通过控制图像级错误发现率，在抑制幻觉的同时保持对真实 grounded 物体的高检出能力。

title: When Order Matters: First-Speaker Bias and Mitigation through Personality in Sequential Multi-Agent Debate
summary: Multi-agent debate (MAD) is often used to improve large language model (LLM) reasoning, but sequential debate is rarely a neutral aggregator of agents' opinions. We show that sequential MAD suffers from a pronounced first-speaker bias: agents disproportionately shape the final answer when they speak first. As a result, placing a stronger model after weaker ones can substantially offset its reasoning advantage. We then focus on the disadvantaged strong-agent-last setting and ask whether personality prompting can mitigate this imbalance. Drawing on the Big Five model, we study agreeableness and extraversion as behavioral interventions applied to either the strong or weak side. We find that their effects are trait-specific. Influence consistently shifts in the direction of lower agreeableness, and assigning low agreeableness to the stronger agent helps restore its lost influence and improves final accuracy. Extraversion, by contrast, produces less systematic changes in influence and accuracy, with its clearest effect appearing in agents' verbosity. These findings show that effective MAD design depends not only on model capability, but also on how speaking order and induced interaction behavior shape the debate process.

AI.tldr: 顺序多智能体辩论存在首发言人偏差，导致强者后发言时优势被削弱；通过大五人格中的宜人性与外向性提示可调节此不平衡，低宜人性可恢复强者影响力并提升准确率。
AI.motivation: 探究顺序多智能体辩论中首发言人偏差对强者后发言的不利影响，以及能否通过人格提示来缓解这种不平衡。
AI.method: 基于大五人格模型，对强/弱智能体分别施加宜人性和外向性提示，分析其对影响力和最终准确率的影响。
AI.result: 影响力一致向低宜人性方向转移；给强者分配低宜人性可恢复其失去的影响力并提高最终准确率。外向性影响不系统，主要体现在发言冗长度上。
AI.conclusion: 有效的多智能体辩论设计不仅取决于模型能力，还取决于发言顺序和诱导的交互行为如何塑造辩论过程。

title: RealWorldShop: Benchmarking and Improving Conversational Shopping Agents in Real-World E-commerce
summary: Large language models are reshaping ecommerce from static recommenders into interactive shopping assistants, yet real-world shopping requires session-level decision support: users reveal and revise constraints, coordinate multiple goals, and expect product-grounded recommendations over a full conversation. Existing benchmarks are mostly outcome-oriented or execution-oriented, leaving this evolving decision process under-evaluated. We introduce REALWORLDSHOP, a benchmark built on 3.28M grounded products, structured shopping episodes, a profile-grounded and actioncontrolled user simulator, and role-play evaluation. Our analysis shows that current systems produce locally plausible responses but struggle with state tracking, constraint updating, and grounded convergence, especially under ambiguous intent, bundle, and multi-intent scenarios. We further propose REALSHOP_AGENT, an executable session-control framework with explicit state management, shopping-flow control, catalog-grounded retrieval, and runtime guards. Experiments show that REALSHOP_AGENT consistently outperforms strong baselines on REALWORLDSHOP.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 REALWORLDSHOP 基准，用于评估电商会话级决策支持，并给出 REALSHOP_AGENT 框架以提升状态跟踪、约束更新和商品落地推荐能力。
AI.motivation: 现有电商基准多关注最终结果或执行过程，未充分评估真实购物中用户逐步揭示与修改约束、协调多目标、进行多轮商品落地决策的会话级过程。
AI.method: 构建基于 328 万真实商品的 REALWORLDSHOP 基准，包含结构化购物片段、基于用户画像且动作可控的用户模拟器以及角色扮演评估；同时提出 REALSHOP_AGENT，一个具备显式状态管理、购物流程控制、目录检索与运行时防护的可执行会话控制框架。
AI.result: 分析表明当前系统虽能生成局部合理回复，但在状态跟踪、约束更新和落地收敛方面表现不佳，尤其在模糊意图、捆绑和多意图场景下；REALSHOP_AGENT 在 REALWORLDSHOP 上持续优于强基线。
AI.conclusion: 真实电商助手需要面向会话级决策支持，REALWORLDSHOP 揭示了现有系统不足，而 REALSHOP_AGENT 通过显式状态与流程控制有效提升了复杂购物会话中的表现。

title: Concept Subspaces Compute Beyond the Logit Lens: A Weights-Only Test for Locating Representations Upstream of Readout
comment: 54 pages. Substantially revised preprint: new title, expanded model coverage, readout-geometry controls, supplementary intervention and transfer experiments, revised interpretation, updated figures and author list
summary: A concept subspace's effect on model behavior does not establish how it relates to the output readout. We introduce a two-sided geometric diagnostic that measures an extracted subspace's overlap with the dominant right-singular directions of the unembedding matrix, evaluated against output-oriented positive controls. Given an extracted basis, the raw diagnostic requires only model weights. Our testbed is the Format-Agnostic Reasoning Subspace (FARS), a ten-dimensional basis extracted from eighteen reasoning concepts expressed in six surface forms. Across nine rank-matched estimators and twenty-six models, four activation-derived concept estimators carry only 0.38--0.80% mean energy in the top-ten readout span. Final-layer PCA carries 3.56%, exceeding FARS in 25 of 26 models. A same-layer next-token control, evaluated using a fitted linear translator for depth matching, carries approximately thirteen times more energy than FARS, with separation in all 25 tested models. Re-extracting FARS on ten disjoint concepts yields 62--100% cross-format retrieval across twenty-four generative models, demonstrating transfer of the extraction procedure rather than a fixed basis. A complementary four-model, three-seed intervention study finds model-dependent source-directed effects that remain well below full-vector replacement. Together, the geometry and intervention controls distinguish concept structure from dominant readout directions while limiting claims of causal sufficiency.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种双侧几何诊断，衡量提取出的概念子空间与 unembedding（解嵌入）矩阵主导右奇异方向的重叠，并用输出导向阳性对照检验。以 FARS 为例，概念子空间与主导读出方向重叠很低，明显低于 next-token 等对照；同时 FARS 提取流程可跨格式迁移，但干预实验只显示有限且模型相关的因果效应。
AI.motivation: 仅证明概念子空间会影响模型行为，并不能说明它与输出读出机制的关系；需要区分概念结构与主导读出方向，并限制对因果充分性的过度声称。
AI.method: 提出双侧几何诊断：测量提取子空间与 unembedding 矩阵前若干右奇异方向的重叠，并与输出导向阳性对照比较；原始诊断只需模型权重。测试床为 FARS，一个由 18 个推理概念、6 种表层形式提取的 10 维基。评估涵盖 9 个秩匹配估计器和 26 个模型，并设置同层 next-token 对照，用拟合线性翻译器做深度匹配。另在 10 个不相交概念上重新提取 FARS，测试 24 个生成模型的跨格式检索；并进行 4 模型、3 种子的干预研究。
AI.result: 四类激活导出的概念估计器在前十读出跨度中平均能量仅 0.38--0.80%；最终层 PCA 为 3.56%，在 26 个模型中有 25 个超过 FARS。同层 next-token 对照能量约为 FARS 的 13 倍，在全部 25 个测试模型中均出现分离。在 10 个不相交概念上重新提取 FARS，24 个生成模型跨格式检索达 62--100%，表明迁移的是提取流程而非固定基。干预研究显示模型相关的源导向效应，但低于全向量替换。
AI.conclusion: 几何诊断与干预对照能够区分概念结构与主导读出方向，同时说明概念子空间对输出的因果充分性有限；FARS 的可迁移性来自提取程序而非某一固定基。

title: DSDyn-VLA: A Dual-Stream Dynamic Manipulation Framework with Motion Perception, Future Awareness, and Realtime Correction
summary: While Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models excel in static tasks, they struggle in dynamic environments where objects are in motion (e.g., conveyor belt manipulation). We identify three fundamental limitations hindering current VLAs in these scenarios: the \textbf{perception gap}, where static visual inputs lack temporal motion cues; the \textbf{latency gap}, where inference delays render actions obsolete; and the \textbf{control gap}, caused by the open-loop action chunk execution without real-time adjustment. In this work, we propose \textbf{DSDyn-VLA}, a Slow-Fast \textbf{D}ual-\textbf{S}tream \textbf{Dyn}amic manipulation framework that integrates motion-aware foresighted planning with real-time residual correction. The slow \textbf{Flow-Planner} serves as a macro-planner. By enhancing the VLA with optical flow for temporal perception and a future state awareness mechanism to preemptively offset inference latency, it produces globally consistent, motion-aware action chunks. Complementing this, the fast \textbf{Res-Refiner} employs a lightweight RL policy to inject high-frequency, closed-loop corrections into the planned action chunks based on real-time observations. In addition, we introduce \textbf{DynBench}, a MuJoCo-based benchmark for dynamic object manipulation that comprises nine tasks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DSDyn-VLA reduces the failure rate by over 76\% compared to current SOTA method in high-latency setting on the Kinetix dynamic benchmark, while achieving about 6$\times$ the success rate of PI0.5 in real-world dynamic settings and about 5$\times$ on DynBench. We will open-source all the code and weights.

AI.tldr: 针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在动态环境中表现不佳的问题，提出慢-快双流动态操作框架DSDyn-VLA，结合运动感知的前瞻规划与实时残差校正，并发布动态操作基准DynBench，在多个动态场景下显著优于现有SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型在静态任务中表现优异，但在物体运动（如传送带操作）等动态环境中失效。作者将其归因于三个根本性缺陷：感知差距（静态视觉输入缺乏时序运动线索）、延迟差距（推理延迟导致动作过时）、控制差距（开环动作块执行缺乏实时调整）。
AI.method: 提出DSDyn-VLA，一个慢-快双流动态操作框架。慢流Flow-Planner作为宏观规划器，通过引入光流增强VLA的时序感知，并利用未来状态感知机制预先补偿推理延迟，生成全局一致、运动感知的动作块；快流Res-Refiner采用轻量级强化学习策略，基于实时观测向规划的动作块注入高频闭环残差校正。同时构建了基于MuJoCo的动态物体操作基准DynBench，包含九项任务。
AI.result: 在高延迟设置下的Kinetix动态基准上，DSDyn-VLA相比当前SOTA方法将失败率降低超过76%；在真实世界动态场景中成功率约为PI0.5的6倍，在DynBench上约为5倍。
AI.conclusion: DSDyn-VLA通过慢-快双流架构有效弥合了感知、延迟与控制三方面的差距，在动态操作任务中显著优于现有方法，且作者将开源全部代码与权重。

title: Offline Guidance, Online Reasoning: Reusing LLM Feedback for Small Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) offer strong reasoning capabilities but are often costly to access through commercial APIs, while small language models (SLMs) are easier to deploy locally yet remain weaker in reasoning. This capability-deployment gap has motivated LLM-SLM collaboration, which aims to improve SLM reasoning using LLM capabilities while preserving the deployment advantages of SLMs. Existing approaches mainly follow two paradigms. Knowledge distillation uses LLM-generated answers and reasoning trajectories to train SLMs offline, but requires parameter updates and additional training. Alternatively, online collaboration routes difficult problems to an LLM or leverages LLM-generated guidance and corrections when an SLM encounters difficulties. Although effective, online collaboration requires repeated LLM access. Moreover, the guidance produced for a particular problem is discarded after inference and cannot benefit subsequent problems involving similar reasoning states. In the paper, we focus on a more constrained setting in which the LLM is accessed only offline, the SLM parameters remain fixed, and online inference is performed solely by the SLM. To this end, we propose Reusable Latent Correction (RLC), which converts one-off natural-language guidance from a black-box LLM into persistent corrective experiences in the hidden space of an SLM. RLC stores these experiences in an external bank and retrieves them according to the SLM's current reasoning state, enabling the SLM to reuse LLM-derived corrections during inference without any online LLM calls. Experiments across multiple reasoning benchmarks and SLM scales show that RLC consistently improves SLM reasoning without parameter updates or online LLM calls. Code is available at https://github.com/ZBH031/reusable-latent-correction.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出可复用潜在校正（RLC），将黑盒LLM的离线自然语言指导转化为SLM隐藏空间中的持久校正经验，存储于外部库并按推理状态检索，使SLM在在线推理时无需调用LLM或更新参数即可提升推理能力。
AI.motivation: LLM推理能力强但API成本高，SLM易部署但推理弱。现有LLM-SLM协作中，知识蒸馏需参数更新和训练，在线协作需反复访问LLM且指导无法复用。本文关注LLM仅离线访问、SLM参数固定、在线推理仅由SLM完成的受限场景。
AI.method: 提出RLC，将LLM的一次性自然语言指导转化为SLM隐藏空间中的持久校正经验，存入外部经验库；根据SLM当前推理状态检索相关经验，使SLM在推理中复用LLM校正，无需在线LLM调用。
AI.result: 在多个推理基准和不同规模SLM上实验表明，RLC无需参数更新或在线LLM调用，能持续提升SLM推理性能。
AI.conclusion: RLC为离线LLM辅助SLM推理提供有效方案，在固定参数和仅SLM在线推理约束下实现LLM知识复用，提升SLM推理能力。

title: Benchmarking EMlog Calibration for Autonomous Surface Vehicles
summary: Accurate velocity measurement is a fundamental requirement for autonomous surface and underwater vehicles. Commonly, velocity is provided by a Doppler velocity log (DVL) sensor, yet it becomes unavailable due to operational altitude constraints. In such situations, electromagnetic logs (EMLogs) provide a critically robust alternative for continuous velocity estimation. However, raw EMLog measurements are inherently corrupted by systematic errors, which need to be calibrated prior mission begins. Currently, a benchmarking comparative evaluation of how different calibration models perform under rapidly changing dynamic sea conditions is missing in the literature. To bridge this gap, this paper presents a comparative model-based calibration methodology that evaluates four distinct calibration models using two different estimation pipelines. The proposed framework is rigorously validated on a unique 221 minutes of continuous real-world telemetry collected from the MARVEL surface vehicle during dynamic sea trials. The dataset contains two different EMLogs and DVL recordings. Experimental results demonstrate that the bias and scale error model implemented with the Kalman filter improves the speed estimation by 71%. We also demonstrate that dynamical manoeuvres further improve the accuracy compared to standard straight-line paths, ultimately delivering a validated, real-time online calibration EMLog approach for autonomous surface vehicles.

AI.tldr: 本文针对自主水面与水下航行器在DVL受限时使用EMLog测速的问题，提出并比较了四种EMLog校准模型与两种估计流程，并通过221分钟真实动态海试数据验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: DVL在作业高度受限时不可用，EMLog可作为连续测速的鲁棒替代方案，但原始EMLog存在系统误差，且文献中缺少在快速变化动态海况下不同校准模型的基准比较评估。
AI.method: 提出基于模型的比较校准方法，评估四种不同校准模型，并结合两种估计流程；使用MARVEL水面艇在动态海试中采集的221分钟连续真实遥测数据，包含两种EMLog和DVL记录进行验证。
AI.result: 实验表明，采用卡尔曼滤波实现的偏置与尺度误差模型将速度估计精度提升71%；同时，动态机动相比标准直线路径可进一步提高校准精度。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了一种经过验证的、面向自主水面车辆的实时在线EMLog校准方法，弥补了动态海况下EMLog校准模型比较评估的空白。

title: MeshOctave generates meshes via cascading resolution transitions
summary: Generating compact, artist-style meshes with explicit topology typically relies on autoregressive models which incur prohibitive sequential per-token costs, or continuous flow models that depend on heuristic connectivity decoders. Next-scale generation paradigms offer a compelling alternative by enabling parallel intra-scale token prediction and coarse-to-fine refinement from global structure to local topology; yet, existing methods derive hierarchical scales via progressive mesh simplification and invert them sequentially. This eliminates intra-scale parallelism and scales generation steps linearly with face count. In this paper, we propose MeshOctave, which instead defines scale through dyadic spatial grid resolutions, framing coarsening as a deterministic collapse that merges vertices sharing a voxel cell and inherits connectivity. Its inverse operation, split-and-rewire, determines which octant sub-vertices are instantiated for each coarse face and resolves local connectivity using discrete structural tokens. These per-face operations require no serialization, each scale transition is modeled as an unordered set that adds one bit of coordinate precision, naturally supporting dynamic-length meshes and adaptive resolution refinement. We construct a scale-conditioned masked-uniform discrete diffusion model to learn split-and-rewire operation from resolution collapse hierarchies. MeshOctave outperforms strong baselines in geometric fidelity and topological validity by a non-trivial margin, while supporting adaptive resolution refinement and extending naturally to mesh subdivision tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出 MeshOctave，一种基于二进空间网格分辨率定义尺度的 next-scale 网格生成方法，通过确定性 collapse 与可并行 split-and-rewire 实现由粗到细的艺术家风格网格生成。
AI.motivation: 现有艺术家风格网格生成中，自回归模型逐 token 成本过高，连续流模型依赖启发式连接解码器；而现有 next-scale 方法通过渐进网格简化构建层级并顺序逆推，失去 intra-scale 并行性，生成步数随面数线性增长。
AI.method: 用二进空间网格分辨率定义尺度，将粗化视为确定性 collapse：合并同一体素单元内顶点并继承连接性；逆操作为 split-and-rewire，用离散结构 token 决定每个粗面实例化哪些八分量子顶点并解决局部连接。每面操作无需序列化，尺度转换建模为无序集合，每级增加 1 bit 坐标精度，支持动态长度网格和自适应分辨率细化；并构建尺度条件 masked-uniform 离散扩散模型学习该层级操作。
AI.result: MeshOctave 在几何保真度和拓扑有效性上显著优于强基线，同时支持自适应分辨率细化，并能自然扩展到网格细分任务。
AI.conclusion: MeshOctave 通过并行、由粗到细的 next-scale 生成框架，克服了现有方法顺序逆推和线性生成步骤的瓶颈，为艺术家风格网格生成提供了高效且有效的方案。

title: Working Around the Compute Ceiling: Byte-Exact Memory in Galahad Makes LLM Reading a One-Time Cost LLM Reading a One-Time Cost
summary: A transformer language model performs a bounded amount of computation per token, and recent work by Vishal Sikka, former CEO of Infosys, argues that this bound limits which tasks a model can carry out or verify (arXiv:2507.07505). We ask how much of the budget beneath that ceiling is spent on work the model has already done. Serving is stateless across requests: a model that answers a second question about a document recomputes the document's attention state from the first token. On seven real-world datasets, 98.7% of prompt tokens were text the model had already read. We present Galahad, a memory layer for vLLM, SGLang and llama.cpp that makes this reading a one-time cost. Taliesin saves the model's key-value (KV) state for a block of text and loads it on the next request that contains the same bytes, instead of recomputing it. Blaise keeps the documents themselves and passes the model only the section a question needs. On a recall test with 100 facts hidden in a 97,000-token corpus (Gemma 4 31B), Taliesin alone let the model attend to the whole corpus and answered 98 of 100 on llama.cpp at 3.0 s and 572 J per question, against 10 of 100, 9.3 s and 2,754 J for the same model without Galahad, which could hold only the last 12,000 tokens. With Blaise added, the model read about 668 tokens per question and answered 100 of 100 on all three runtimes at 0.59-0.64 s and 200-213 J; a tuned RAGFlow pipeline answered 77. Storing the corpus is a one-time cost of about 100 s and 28 kJ, whose energy is recovered after 13 questions. Restored state is bit-identical: all 262,144 output logits matched after restart, rehydration and hot-load. Galahad worked with all 30 models we tested under vLLM, and it fails closed: any load that does not pass its checks is recomputed. Together these results move LLM serving from stateless to stateful inference.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Galahad 记忆层，用于 vLLM、SGLang 和 llama.cpp，将已读文本的 KV 状态或文档内容缓存复用，把 LLM 服务从无状态推理推向有状态推理，从而避免每个请求重复计算相同上下文。
AI.motivation: Transformer 语言模型每个 token 的计算量有上限，且当前服务是无状态的：模型回答关于同一文档的第二个问题时，会从第一个 token 重新计算文档的注意力状态。在七个真实数据集上，98.7% 的提示 token 是模型已经读过的文本，造成大量重复计算和能耗浪费。
AI.method: 提出 Galahad 记忆层，包含两个组件：Taliesin 保存一段文本的键值（KV）状态，并在后续包含相同字节的请求中加载，而不是重新计算；Blaise 保留文档本身，只把问题所需段落传给模型。系统集成到 vLLM、SGLang 和 llama.cpp，并采用失败关闭机制：任何未通过检查的加载都会回退为重新计算。
AI.result: 在 97,000 token 语料、100 条事实的召回测试中（Gemma 4 31B），仅 Taliesin 就让模型关注整个语料，在 llama.cpp 上答对 98/100，每题 3.0 秒、572 焦耳；无 Galahad 时仅答对 10/100，9.3 秒、2,754 焦耳，且只能保留最后 12,000 token。加入 Blaise 后，模型每问约读 668 token，在三个运行时均答对 100/100，耗时 0.59–0.64 秒、能耗 200–213 焦耳；调优后的 RAGFlow 流水线答对 77/100。存储语料一次性成本约 100 秒、28 千焦，其能耗在 13 个问题后收回。恢复状态比特级一致：重启、再水化和热加载后全部 262,144 个输出 logits 匹配。Galahad 在 vLLM 下测试的 30 个模型上均可用。
AI.conclusion: Galahad 通过缓存和复用 KV 状态及文档选择，显著减少重复计算、提升长上下文问答准确率并降低时延与能耗，同时保证状态恢复的一致性；这些结果推动 LLM 服务从无状态推理转向有状态推理。

title: Making Grid Beam Search Less Greedy
comment: Published as a conference paper at COLM 2026
summary: A common formalism for constraining the output of autoregressive text generation models involves lexical constraints, words or phrases which are required to occur in the generated text. DFA-constrained beam search and grid beam search are two widely used paradigms for decoding from autoregressive models while enforcing lexical constraints. As the former approach requires a number of forward passes exponential in the number of constraint tokens, it is often dispreferred to the latter, which requires only linearly many forward calls. However, while grid beam search achieves an exponential speedup, it does so in a manner which does not treat all of the constraints equally. In this paper, we demonstrate that grid beam search is biased to incorporate easier-to-satisfy constraints first, leaving harder constraints to the end of the sequence. This contrasts with DFA-constrained beam search, which exhibits no such bias.
