To address this shortcoming, we propose fair grid beam search, a modification to grid beam search which avoids this bias while still requiring only linearly many forward passes. Experimentally, we confirm grid beam search's bias on two constrained generation tasks, finding significant differences in how it orders constraint tokens as compared to DFA-constrained beam search and fair grid beam search. Furthermore, we find that fair grid beam search not only fixes grid beam search's bias, but finds higher-probability strings in the process.

AI.tldr: 本文研究自回归文本生成中的词汇约束解码，指出网格束搜索存在偏向先满足较容易约束的顺序偏差，并提出公平网格束搜索来消除该偏差。
AI.motivation: DFA约束束搜索需要随约束词元数量指数级的前向计算，而网格束搜索只需线性级前向调用；但网格束搜索可能不公平对待约束，因此需要兼顾效率与公平性。
AI.method: 分析并比较网格束搜索与DFA约束束搜索的约束顺序偏差；提出公平网格束搜索，对网格束搜索进行修改，在保持线性前向调用次数的同时避免偏差。
AI.result: 在两个约束生成任务上验证了网格束搜索的偏差，发现其约束词元排序显著不同于DFA约束束搜索和公平网格束搜索；公平网格束搜索不仅修正偏差，还能找到更高概率的字符串。
AI.conclusion: 公平网格束搜索能在保持效率优势的同时消除网格束搜索的顺序偏差，并提升生成质量，是词汇约束解码中更优的替代方案。

title: Ready2Blend: From Natural-Language Instructions to Composable Alignment Prompts
summary: Continual alignment requires LLMs to adapt to new requirements without forgetting previously acquired behaviors. Natural-language instructions are flexible and composable but offer only indirect control, whereas post-training provides stronger adaptation at the cost of repeated parameter updates. We introduce Ready2Blend, which combines the flexibility of natural language with learned alignment. AlignFormer maps each requirement to a fixed-length alignment prompt stored in a modular prompt bank, while the backbone and prior prompts remain frozen. Composability regularization transfers the semantic geometry of textual requirements into prompt space, enabling inference-time blending and reweighting. Across two practical continual alignment settings, Ready2Blend is the only frozen-backbone method that matches post-training-based alignment methods, reaching $93.1$-$98.5\%$ of a joint-training reference with competitive retention, while requiring only a few prompt tokens and up to $4.3\times$ less training time. Its modular design further enables weighted personalization and order-free composition without retraining. Code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 提出Ready2Blend，通过AlignFormer将自然语言需求映射为固定长度对齐提示并存入模块化提示库，冻结主干和先前提示，利用可组合性正则化实现推理时混合与重加权，在持续对齐中匹配后训练方法，仅需少量提示token且训练时间更少。
AI.motivation: 持续对齐要求LLM适应新需求而不遗忘旧行为。自然语言指令灵活可组合但控制间接；后训练提供更强适应但需重复参数更新，成本高。
AI.method: Ready2Blend结合自然语言灵活性与学习对齐。AlignFormer将每个需求映射为固定长度对齐提示，存入模块化提示库；主干和先前提示冻结。可组合性正则化将文本需求的语义几何转移到提示空间，支持推理时混合和重加权。
AI.result: 在两种实际持续对齐设置中，Ready2Blend是唯一匹配后训练对齐方法的冻结主干方法，达到联合训练参考的93.1%-98.5%，具有竞争性保留，仅需少量提示token，训练时间减少最多4.3倍。模块化设计支持加权个性化和无顺序组合，无需重新训练。
AI.conclusion: Ready2Blend为持续对齐提供有效方案，兼顾灵活性与效率，模块化设计支持个性化与组合，代码将发布。

title: When Integral Meets Decomposition: A Signal-Level Self-Supervised Feature Decompose Paradigm for Multi-Modal Image Fusion
summary: Multimodal image fusion (MMIF) aims to integrate complementary information from different modalities into a high-quality fused image and support downstream tasks. Recently, feature decomposition has become an important paradigm by separating source images into common and modality-specific unique features. However, existing methods lack clear supervision because ground-truth (GT) decomposition feature maps are unavailable. They usually combine multiple image-level metrics as losses, which are inherently incomplete and may conflict since each pixel couples attributes such as texture, edge, and contour. To address this, we propose a 1D signal-level self-supervised feature decomposition paradigm. Our core insight is to reformulate feature decomposition from unclear 2D image-level supervision into an integral-driven 1D signal-level optimization problem. This objective-level reformulation uses the 1D signal form to compute the integral constraint. The decomposer is optimized by the integral area between common and original signals, enabling more stable optimization with a clear optimization objective. Our model follows a two-stage SSL framework. Stage I designs dual pretext tasks for integral-driven decomposition at the signal level and structure-preserving reconstruction at the image level. Stage II fuses unique features and combines them with common features to reconstruct the fused image. Experiments on representative MMIF tasks show state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance. Code: github.com/Wangjiayu0512/SIDFusion.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种一维信号级自监督特征分解范式，用于多模态图像融合（MMIF），将分解监督从模糊的二维图像级优化转为积分驱动的1D信号级优化，并在代表性任务上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有特征分解方法缺乏真实分解特征图作为监督，只能组合多个图像级指标作为损失；这些损失本身不完整，且由于每个像素耦合纹理、边缘、轮廓等属性，容易相互冲突。
AI.method: 核心是将特征分解重构为积分驱动的1D信号级优化问题，利用公共信号与原始信号之间的积分面积优化分解器，使优化更稳定且目标明确。模型采用两阶段自监督框架：阶段一包含信号级积分驱动分解和图像级结构保持重建两个预文本任务；阶段二融合模态独特特征，并与公共特征结合重建融合图像。
AI.result: 在代表性多模态图像融合任务上取得了当前最优（SOTA）性能，代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 1D信号级自监督特征分解能够为多模态图像融合提供更清晰、稳定的优化目标，并有效提升融合性能。

title: ASENA: Self-evolving Agents for Embodied Navigation
summary: We present ASENA, an embodied agent system that connects general-purpose coding agents to robot sensing, computation, supervised execution, and persistent experience. Agents can write and execute programs, inspect recorded outcomes, repair failures, and reuse notes and executable skills while keeping their model weights fixed. We further introduce ASENA-VLN, a 4B monocular navigation policy that serves as an optional tool within this programmable system. ASENA-VLN predicts body-frame trajectories for both extended routes and short-horizon behaviors using a shared vision-language decoder trained on route instructions, visual question answering, and a newly curated dataset of geometry-derived atomic navigation tasks. As a standalone policy, ASENA-VLN achieves state-of-the-art success rates of 68.7% on R2R and 70.2% on RxR. When integrated with a coding agent, learned navigation improves ASENA's success rate by 11 percentage points on both agentic benchmarks while reducing execution time. Through persistent workspace evolution and simulator feedback, ten passes over recurring 100-task subsets further improve success from 72% to 98% on R2R and from 65% to 89% on RxR. On embodied question answering, ASENA achieves state-of-the-art accuracy with fewer interaction steps. Finally, real-world demonstrations on a Unitree G1 combine search, visual inspection, spatial reasoning, and synthesized gestures without a pre-built map, illustrating how online programming extends robot behavior beyond route following and predefined skills.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ASENA，一个将通用编程智能体与机器人感知、计算、监督执行及持久经验相连的具身智能体系统，并引入 ASENA-VLN 作为可选导航工具，在导航、具身问答和真实机器人任务中取得优异表现。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人通常依赖预定义技能和固定策略，难以在线编程、失败修复与经验复用；同时导航策略多为孤立模型，缺乏与编程智能体系统的结合。
AI.method: ASENA 允许编码智能体编写/执行程序、检查记录、修复失败并复用笔记与可执行技能，且保持模型权重固定。ASENA-VLN 是 4B 单目导航策略，使用共享视觉-语言解码器，在路线指令、视觉问答和新构建的几何原子导航任务上训练，预测机体坐标系轨迹。
AI.result: ASENA-VLN 单独在 R2R 和 RxR 上分别达到 68.7% 和 70.2% 成功率；与编程智能体集成后，两个智能体基准成功率均提升 11 个百分点并减少执行时间。在重复 100 任务子集上十轮持久工作区演化与模拟器反馈后，R2R 从 72% 提升至 98%，RxR 从 65% 提升至 89%。具身问答中以更少交互步骤达到最先进准确率。Unitree G1 真实演示无需预建地图即可完成搜索、视觉检查、空间推理与合成手势。
AI.conclusion: 在线编程与持久经验演化可扩展机器人行为，使其超越路线跟随和预定义技能，并与学习型导航策略形成互补。

title: C-STRIDE: An Observation-Driven AI Digital Twin for Predicting Basin-Wide Flood Fields from Sparse Stream-Gauge Histories
summary: Emergency managers need to know where floodwater is, how deep it is, and how it will change over the coming hours across an entire river basin. During a flood, however, real-time measurements come from only a handful of stream gauges, and high-resolution hydrodynamic models are too costly to rerun each time new data arrive or to run as large ensembles. We present C-STRIDE, an observation-driven AI digital twin that turns short records from a few stream gauges, together with terrain and rainfall, into basin-wide maps of water depth and extends these predictions up to a day ahead. It is trained on simulations from a calibrated two-dimensional hydrodynamic model and needs no separate data-assimilation step. In the Des Plaines River basin near Chicago, six gauges inform predictions over 4.2 million 30-m grid cells. Terrain improves the predictions most, rainfall keeps errors from growing over longer horizons, and together they reduce errors by about 40% compared with gauge records alone. When future rainfall is known, errors remain near 15% one day ahead, compared with nearly 40% without rainfall. Given real instead of simulated gauge records, the model shifts its predictions toward the observed hydrographs at three of six gauges without retraining, and it runs about 150 times faster than the hydrodynamic model. These results show how sparse gauges, terrain, and rainfall can be combined into fast, continuously updated flood predictions, a step toward operational flood digital twins that still requires testing with real-time data and rainfall forecasts.

AI.tldr: 提出C-STRIDE，一种观测驱动的AI数字孪生，利用少量水位计、地形和降雨数据，生成整个流域的水深图并预测未来一天，速度比水动力模型快约150倍，误差降低约40%。
AI.motivation: 应急管理者需要了解整个流域洪水的位置、深度及未来变化，但实时测量仅来自少数水位计，高分辨率水动力模型重跑成本过高，无法频繁更新或进行大集合模拟。
AI.method: C-STRIDE基于校准的二维水动力模型模拟进行训练，无需单独的数据同化步骤；输入为少量水位计短记录、地形和降雨，输出为流域尺度30米网格的水深图，并可提前一天预测。在芝加哥附近Des Plaines河流域测试，6个水位计预测420万个网格。
AI.result: 地形对预测改进最大，降雨可防止误差随预测时长增长，两者结合比仅用水位计记录减少约40%误差；有未来降雨时，一天后误差约15%，无降雨时近40%；使用真实而非模拟水位计记录，模型无需重新训练即可在6个水位计中的3个向观测水文过程线调整；运行速度约为水动力模型的150倍。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏水位计、地形和降雨可结合用于快速、持续更新的洪水预测，是迈向业务化洪水数字孪生的一步，但仍需用实时数据和降雨预报进一步测试。

title: Frame Differential On-Policy Self-Distillation for Video Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has substantially improved the reasoning ability of multimodal language models through verifiable rewards and increasingly fine-grainedvisual or temporal credit assignment. In video reasoning, however, current RL methods typically train with a fixed sparse frame budget: increasing the number of frames makes autoregressive rollouts expensive, while too few frames may miss temporally localized events and fine-grained visual details. We present \textbf{Frame Differential On-Policy Self-Distillation (FD-OPSD)}, which transfers the useful evidence of dense frame observations to a sparse frame policy during RL training. FD-OPSD compares the policy's token level preferences for the same sampled response under sparse and dense views, and distills the resulting frame differential signal without an external teacher or dense autoregressive rollout. The method preserves sparse-frame rollouts and leaves inference unchanged. Across Qwen2.5-VL-7B and Qwen3-VL-4B on six video reasoning benchmarks, FD-OPSD yields higher overall average performance than the strongest corresponding GRPO, T-GRPO, or Video-KTR baselines across the 16, 32, and 64 frame evaluation settings. These results show that dense visual evidence can be transferred selectively during training through token level self-distillation while retaining sparse frame rollouts and unchanged inference.

AI.tldr: 提出FD-OPSD方法，在视频推理的强化学习中，将密集帧观测的有效证据通过token级自蒸馏迁移到稀疏帧策略，从而在保持稀疏rollout和推理不变的情况下提升性能。
AI.motivation: 当前视频推理RL方法通常使用固定稀疏帧预算：增加帧数会使自回归rollout昂贵，帧数过少则可能漏掉局部时序事件和细粒度视觉细节。
AI.method: FD-OPSD在RL训练中比较同一采样响应在稀疏视图和密集视图下的token级偏好，蒸馏出帧差分信号，无需外部教师或密集自回归rollout，并保留稀疏帧rollout与不变推理。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-VL-7B和Qwen3-VL-4B上，于六个视频推理基准以及16、32、64帧评估设置下，FD-OPSD总体平均性能优于对应的GRPO、T-GRPO和Video-KTR最强基线。
AI.conclusion: 密集视觉证据可以在训练期间通过token级自蒸馏被选择性迁移，同时保留稀疏帧rollout和不变推理，从而提升视频推理能力。

title: Search Shapes Conclusions: Auditing Evidence Selection Bias in Deep Research Agents
summary: Deep Research agents synthesize evidence into cited reports, yet a well-cited report can still reach a misleading conclusion. Citation correctness checks whether cited sources support individual claims. It does not show whether adaptive search exposed a representative view of all documents made available for evaluation, which we call the candidate pool. Early findings redirect later queries, document choices, and stopping, so the documents an agent reads form a selective sample. Existing evaluations rarely account for this selection. We formulate the problem as adaptive evidence sampling and introduce Causal Evidence Selection Correction (CESS). CESS predicts each candidate document's evidence direction and corrects the candidate-pool average using the logged probabilities of selecting each document and reaching each search round. Shrinkage stabilizes short searches, while intervals replace point estimates when some documents cannot be sampled. We also prove that estimating the average evidence direction of a common pool differs from measuring how a change in search policy alters the evidence read. The latter requires intervention. On questions from the MS2 systematic-review benchmark, CESS reduces mean absolute error against the candidate-pool average by $9.2\%$ and reduces the estimate's change under opposing document rankings by $39.4\%$ relative to averaging the evidence scores of documents read. Across trajectories from a public Open Deep Research agent, the corresponding reductions reach $60.1\%$ and $87.2\%$. A further 4,800 trajectories under paired interventions confirm that correcting a pool estimate and measuring a policy effect are different tasks. CESS therefore audits whether the evidence direction underlying a report reflects the documents available for evaluation, while a separate intervention analysis measures the effect of search decisions.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 CESS 方法，用于审计 Deep Research 智能体在自适应搜索中的证据选择偏差，并区分估计候选池平均证据方向与测量搜索策略干预效应两个任务。
AI.motivation: 现有引用正确性检查只能判断单条声明是否被来源支持，无法说明智能体因早期发现改变后续查询、文档选择和停止后，所读文档是否代表整个候选池，因此报告可能仍得出误导性结论。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为自适应证据采样；提出 CESS，预测每篇候选文档的证据方向，并用选择文档和到达搜索轮次的 logged probabilities 校正候选池平均；用收缩稳定短搜索，用区间替代无法采样时的点估计；并证明池平均估计与搜索策略干预效应不同，后者需要干预分析。
AI.result: 在 MS2 系统综述基准问题上，CESS 相比直接平均所读文档证据分数，将候选池平均的 MAE 降低 9.2%，在相反文档排序下估计变化降低 39.4%；在公开 Open Deep Research 智能体轨迹上，相应降低达 60.1% 和 87.2%；4800 条配对干预轨迹确认两个任务不同。
AI.conclusion: CESS 可审计报告底层证据方向是否反映可评估文档总体，而搜索决策对证据的影响需通过单独的干预分析来测量。

title: Multi-LLM Collaborative Alignment via Stackelberg Games
summary: A pool of language models can collaborate and improve collectively by learning from one another's responses. These interactions depend on the instructions used during training. Existing methods typically sample instructions uniformly, even though their usefulness may change as the models improve: an instruction on which models' responses once differed in quality may later be answered equally well, while a previously difficult instruction may begin to provide a useful learning signal. We propose Stackelberg Alignment, a game-theory-inspired leader-follower framework that turns instruction selection into an adaptive curriculum. An EXP3 bandit acts as the leader, allocating a fixed sampling budget across instructions and updating its sampling distribution using a reward that combines instruction difficulty and response discriminability. The language models act as followers: they respond to the selected instructions, evaluate one another's responses, and learn from the resulting preference signals through DPO or GRPO. The framework uses Elo-style reputation-weighted peer judgment and reputation-based opponent matching to support reliable and competitive model interactions. Experiments across three heterogeneous model pools and 12 benchmarks spanning scientific discovery, reasoning, code, instruction following, and knowledge show that Stackelberg Alignment achieves the highest macro-average across three diverse model pools, outperforming the strongest training-time baseline by up to 7.4% and the best static inference baseline by 12-25%. Analysis confirms that the adaptive leader concentrates duels on the most informative instructions, and ablations show that both reputation-weighted judgment and reputation-based matching improve the effectiveness of multi-LLM evolution.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Stackelberg Alignment，一种受博弈论启发的领导者-跟随者框架，将指令选择转化为自适应课程，通过 EXP3 多臂老虎机选择指令，让多个语言模型互相评估、匹配并学习，从而协同提升性能。
AI.motivation: 多个语言模型可以通过互相学习响应来共同提升，但现有方法通常均匀采样指令，忽略了指令有效性会随模型能力变化：曾经有区分度的指令可能变得不再有用，而之前困难的指令可能开始提供学习信号。
AI.method: 采用 Stackelberg 博弈框架：EXP3 bandit 作为领导者，在固定采样预算下根据指令难度和响应的可区分性分配采样概率；语言模型作为跟随者，对所选指令作答、相互评估，并通过 DPO 或 GRPO 从偏好信号中学习。同时使用 Elo 式声誉加权同伴判断和基于声誉的对手匹配。
AI.result: 在三个异构模型池和涵盖科学发现、推理、代码、指令跟随与知识的 12 个基准上，Stackelberg Alignment 取得最高宏平均，优于最强训练时基线最多 7.4%，优于最佳静态推理基线 12-25%。分析表明自适应领导者将对抗集中在信息量最大的指令上，消融显示声誉加权判断和声誉匹配均提升多 LLM 演化效果。
AI.conclusion: 将指令选择建模为自适应领导者-跟随者博弈，并结合声誉机制，能有效促进多语言模型协同进化，优于均匀采样和静态基线。

title: Persistent Watermarking of Text-to-Image Models
summary: Text-to-image (T2I) generation is gaining increasing popularity with the general public, motivating the development of reliable mechanisms for copyrighting such models given their expensive training costs. An adversary may obtain and reuse a pretrained T2I model without authorization, and then serve a modified version through an API service. Such modifications may arise from ordinary downstream adaptation or deliberate attempts to erase ownership, including input-prompt preprocessing, model fine-tuning, and output post-processing. From the model owner's perspective, a key challenge is therefore to embed trigger data that remain persistent under such changes while preserving the model's normal image-generation capabilities. In this work, we propose a contrastive-style watermarking objective with a term that explicitly encourages the watermarked model to behave differently from the original model on trigger inputs. Experiments show substantially stronger trigger-data persistence than prior methods across a wide range of downstream modifications and deliberate attempts to weaken the watermark, resulting in higher detection rates, often approaching 100% TPR@FPR<$10^{-4}$.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向文本到图像（T2I）模型的对比式水印方法，通过在触发输入上强制水印模型与原始模型行为不同，实现更强的版权溯源能力。
AI.motivation: T2I模型训练成本高，但容易被未授权获取、微调或通过API提供服务。现有水印需在输入预处理、模型微调和输出后处理等修改下仍保持可检测，同时不影响正常生成能力。
AI.method: 提出对比式水印目标，其中包含一个显式项，鼓励带水印模型在触发输入上产生与原始模型不同的输出。
AI.result: 在多种下游修改和故意削弱水印的尝试下，触发数据持久性显著优于先前方法，检测率更高，常接近100% TPR@FPR<10^{-4}。
AI.conclusion: 该对比式水印目标能有效提升T2I模型水印在修改和攻击下的鲁棒性，为模型版权保护提供可靠机制。

title: Exploring Heterogeneous Model Merging Approach for Complex Knowledge Transfer
summary: Specialized models encode task-oriented behavior, but transferring that behavior to a general language model usually requires training, distillation, or representation alignment. We study whether such ability can instead be transferred directly at the parameter level. We apply two existing training-free heterogeneous merging methods, previously shown to transfer knowledge between general language models, to specialist-to-general transfer, projecting a specialist donor into the recipient's shape and interpolating backbone parameters without gradient updates or semantic alignment. Intersection-Merge (IM) injects a prefix-aligned donor slice matching the recipient shape, while Activate-Prune-Merge (APM) uses forward-pass activation statistics to select which donor dimensions to retain before injection. Across embedding, reranking, reward modeling, and MoE code-specialist transfer, both methods improve the general recipient, showing that simple heterogeneous merging can move capabilities across diverse specialist roles.

AI.tldr: 研究将专用模型能力直接通过参数级异构合并迁移到通用语言模型，无需训练、蒸馏或表示对齐。
AI.motivation: 传统上将专用模型的任务行为迁移到通用语言模型通常需要训练、蒸馏或表示对齐，成本较高；作者探究能否直接在参数层面完成迁移。
AI.method: 将两种免训练异构模型合并方法用于专家到通用迁移：Intersection-Merge（IM）注入与接收模型形状匹配的前缀对齐捐赠切片；Activate-Prune-Merge（APM）利用前向传播激活统计选择要保留的捐赠维度后再注入，全程无梯度更新和语义对齐。
AI.result: 在嵌入、重排序、奖励建模和MoE代码专家迁移任务中，两种方法均提升了通用接收模型的性能。
AI.conclusion: 简单的异构合并在多种专家角色间可有效迁移能力，为专家到通用模型的能力迁移提供了免训练的参数级路径。

title: The Planning Limits of Latent World Models
summary: World models offer a promising way to help robots understand how the physical world evolves and plan complex behaviours through imagination. Yet existing studies mainly demonstrate what these models can accomplish, leaving unclear when their predictions remain useful for planning and where they fail. We study this question using action-conditioned predictors built on five frozen self-supervised visual backbones: V-JEPA 2, V-JEPA 2.1, VideoMAEv2, VideoPrism, and DINOv2. We use frozen backbones to test representations intended to transfer across environments. We evaluate these models on diverse Meta-World manipulation tasks and real-robot interactions from BridgeData V2. We find that a world model guides action selection reliably only when the goal lies within, or slightly beyond, the trajectory it imagines during planning. With five-step rollouts, the length the predictor was trained on, the world model ranks actions reliably only for targets five to ten control steps ahead, whereas task goals lie 16 to 53 steps away. Neither an 81-fold larger predictor nor longer-rollout training extends this range; the encoder affects both range and closed-loop success, with V-JEPA 2.1 performing most consistently. More fundamentally, the limit persists under perfect prediction: using the real simulator, success falls from 92% to 41% as the target moves from five to twenty steps ahead of a five-step rollout. Planning therefore requires either longer imagined trajectories or closer subgoals. For distant goals, pure imagination succeeds in 23% of episodes, planning with feedback (MPC) raises success to 30%, imagining as far as the goal to 47%, and nearby expert subgoals to 76%. Used within its plannable range, a world model can also improve a vision-language-action (VLA) policy: choosing among eight actions the VLA proposes raises its success from 65% to 77% across 16 different tasks.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统检验了基于冻结自监督视觉骨干的动作条件世界模型在机器人规划中的可用范围与失效边界，发现其仅能可靠指导接近想象轨迹范围的目标，远距离目标需要更长想象或更近子目标。
AI.motivation: 现有工作多展示世界模型能做什么，但较少说明其预测何时对规划有用、何时失效，尤其缺乏对跨环境迁移表示和不同骨干影响的系统评估。
AI.method: 使用五种冻结自监督视觉骨干（V-JEPA 2、V-JEPA 2.1、VideoMAEv2、VideoPrism、DINOv2）构建动作条件预测器，在Meta-World操作任务和BridgeData V2真实机器人交互上评估，并对比更长 rollout、更大预测器、完美预测模拟器、MPC、专家子目标以及结合VLA策略等设置。
AI.result: 五步rollout下，世界模型通常只能可靠排序未来5到10个控制步的目标，而任务目标常在16到53步之外；扩大预测器81倍或训练更长rollout不能扩展该范围；编码器影响范围和闭环成功率，V-JEPA 2.1最稳定。即使完美预测，目标从五步增至二十步时成功率也从92%降至41%。远距离目标下，纯想象成功率23%，MPC为30%，想象到目标为47%，附近专家子目标为76%。用于VLA时，在八个候选动作中选择可将16个任务成功率从65%提升至77%。
AI.conclusion: 世界模型只在可规划范围内可靠，远距离规划需更长想象轨迹或更近子目标；合理使用世界模型可改进VLA策略，但其有效性受想象时域根本限制。

title: TTLab at Daleel 2026: STAR-Ar, Sequence Tagging for Argument Recognition in Arabic
comment: Accepted at ArabicNLP 2026 Daleel-2026 shared task
summary: Argument Mining (AM) is a critical NLP task that remains significantly under-resourced in Arabic. This paper presents $\testtt{STAR-Ar}$, a BERT-BiLSTM-CRF architecture for argument discourse detection and classification, as our system for Daleel 2026, the inaugural Arabic argument mining shared task. The task requires the identification and classification of argumentative discourse units (ADUs) in debate and editorial texts.We jointly model these two objectives as a token-level sequence labeling task using a BERT-BiLSTM-CRF architecture that combines contextual transformer embeddings with structural transition constraints to support accurate span detection. $\testtt{STAR-Ar}$ achieves an F1-score of 72.69 on validation and 73.7 on test data. Our domain-specific analysis shows that models trained exclusively on editorials underperform those trained on debates, a disparity we primarily attribute to the smaller size of the editorial dataset. The code for $\testtt{STAR-Ar}$ is available at ${\href{https://github.com/ENTAILab/daleel_2026_Arabic-Argumentative-Discourse-Mining}{\faGithub~TTLab at Daleel 2026}}$

AI.tldr: 该论文提出STAR-Ar系统，用于首个阿拉伯语论证挖掘共享任务Daleel 2026，采用BERT-BiLSTM-CRF进行论证话语单元检测与分类，验证集F1为72.69，测试集F1为73.7。
AI.motivation: 阿拉伯语论证挖掘仍严重缺乏资源，Daleel 2026作为首个阿拉伯语论证挖掘共享任务，需要识别并分类辩论与社论文本中的论证话语单元。
AI.method: 将论证话语单元识别与分类联合建模为token级序列标注任务，使用BERT-BiLSTM-CRF架构，结合上下文Transformer嵌入与结构化转移约束以支持准确的跨度检测。
AI.result: STAR-Ar在验证集上取得72.69的F1分数，在测试集上取得73.7的F1分数；领域分析表明，仅用社论训练的模型表现不如用辩论训练的模型，主要原因是社论数据集规模较小。
AI.conclusion: STAR-Ar在阿拉伯语论证挖掘任务上取得了有效结果，并揭示了数据规模对领域性能的影响；代码已开源。

title: Beyond Prediction: Steering VLM Agents with Retrospective World Modeling
summary: Equipping VLM agents with world modeling capabilities has shown strong potential for complex reasoning and long-horizon planning, while reducing the dependence of policy learning on costly real-world interactions. Existing methods mainly rely on prospective simulation to predict the consequences of candidate actions. However, this forward-only paradigm focuses on what will happen next and provides limited constraints for verifying whether an action is causally consistent with the observed state transition, which can lead to plausible-looking but physically incoherent behaviors. In this paper, we challenge the view of world modeling as only prospective prediction and introduce Retrospective World Modeling, a new agent learning paradigm that enables agents to reason backward by estimating the retrospective attribution distribution $P(\hat{a}{t}|s_t, s{t+1})$ for the action that most likely caused a given transition. Based on this capability, we formulate the Self-Consistency Reward (SCR), an intrinsic signal that measures the probabilistic consistency between the policy action and the retrospective explanation. Integrating SCR into reinforcement learning provides dense transition-level feedback and steers agents toward behaviors that are both task-effective and physically grounded. Extensive experiments across diverse agentic tasks show that our method substantially improves policy robustness and generalization over prospective-only world modeling baselines.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“回溯世界建模”新范式，让VLM智能体通过估计导致状态转移的动作归因分布进行反向推理，并据此设计自洽奖励（SCR）融入强化学习，提升策略鲁棒性与泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有世界建模主要依赖前向模拟预测候选动作的后果，只关注“接下来会发生什么”，对动作是否与观测到的状态转移因果一致缺乏验证约束，容易产生看似合理但物理上不连贯的行为。
AI.method: 引入回溯世界建模，估计最可能引起给定转移的动作回溯归因分布 P(â_t|s_t, s_{t+1})；基于该能力构造自洽奖励（SCR），作为衡量策略动作与回溯解释之间概率一致性的内在信号；将SCR融入强化学习，提供密集的转移级反馈。
AI.result: 在多种智能体任务上的大量实验表明，相比仅依赖前向世界建模的基线，该方法显著提升了策略的鲁棒性和泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 世界建模不应仅局限于前瞻预测；回溯式世界建模与自洽奖励能够引导智能体产生既任务有效又符合物理规律的行为。

title: ReWAM: Reciprocal World Action Models for Interactive Autonomous Driving
summary: In interactive scenarios, an autonomous driving system is required to generate ego actions under the influence of other agents' behaviors. Existing World Action Models (WAMs) typically model other agents as components of the world model rather than as decision-makers that fundamentally shape the action of the ego agent, which impairs their performance in dense interaction scenarios. We introduce Reciprocal World Action Models (ReWAM), a game-theoretic world action modeling framework that captures the reciprocal influence between the ego agent and other agents by representing them as conditional responders whose actions are mutually influenced. We instantiate this framework with a Level-$k$ response hierarchy, where role-specific ego and other action DiTs exchange compact strategy tokens through cross-agent attention while remaining grounded in a shared representation of the future driving world. To learn the response policy of the ego agent from demonstrations, we formulate expert actions as samples from the best response distribution and jointly optimize the entire hierarchy using conditional flow matching. Our framework is evaluated on the NAVSIM dataset and achieves state-of-the-art performance compared to baselines. The improvement is particularly significant in interactive scenarios, validating that modeling reciprocal responses provides a more effective foundation for interaction-aware world action generation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出互惠世界动作模型（ReWAM），一个博弈论世界动作建模框架，通过将自车与其他智能体建模为相互影响的条件响应者，并在NAVISIM数据集上取得最优性能，尤其在交互场景中提升显著。
AI.motivation: 现有世界动作模型通常将其他智能体视为世界模型的一部分，而非影响自车决策的决策者，导致在密集交互场景中性能受损。
AI.method: 将自车与其他智能体建模为条件响应者，实例化为Level-k响应层级；角色特定的自车与其他动作DiT通过跨智能体注意力交换紧凑策略token，并共享未来驾驶世界表示；将专家动作视为最佳响应分布样本，使用条件流匹配联合优化整个层级。
AI.result: 在NAVISIM数据集上达到最先进性能，相较基线在交互场景中的提升尤为显著。
AI.conclusion: 建模互惠响应为交互感知的世界动作生成提供了更有效的基础。

title: Scale and Selection: What Makes Automatic Harness Evolution Work for Visual-Interface Robot Agents
summary: When an off-the-shelf coding agent is used directly as a robot policy, observing a browser-based 3D interface through screenshots and acting by posing a virtual target gripper through a few tools, the agent's harness, its prompts, tools, and control rules, largely determines success, and until now it has been written by hand. We show that this harness can be improved automatically by another coding agent, the optimizer agent, and report two findings about what makes it work. First, the number of rollouts the optimizer agent sees per round governs whether the evolved harness is trustworthy, generalizes, and improves steadily. A single rollout is a noisy binary outcome, so with few rollouts per round a revision can be promoted on luck; enlarging the batch raises the signal-to-noise ratio of every promotion decision. Holding rounds fixed and growing the training set from 5 to 100 rollouts, held-out success rises from 47% to 67%, while small training sets overfit, reaching 70% on training tasks but only 54% held-out. Second, the optimizer agent must not be given free rein. With every revision it proposes accepted unconditionally, performance drifts downward within ten rounds as ill-judged edits accumulate; adding the most basic safeguard, Champion-Challenger selection that promotes a revision only if it strictly beats the incumbent on the same fixed evaluation set, turns the same loop into one that raises held-out success from 51% to 67% over 30 rounds. Automatic harness evolution for visual-interface robot agents is thus feasible, but its gains hinge on the rollout scale behind each decision and on how the optimizer agent's revisions are selected.

AI.tldr: 本文证明可用另一个编码智能体自动优化机器人策略的harness，并发现其效果取决于每轮rollout数量和修订筛选机制。
AI.motivation: 现成编码智能体直接作为机器人策略时，其harness（提示、工具、控制规则）主要靠手工编写。
AI.method: 让optimizer agent自动改进harness；控制每轮rollout数量（5到100），并对比无条件接受修订与Champion-Challenger选择（仅在固定评估集上严格优于当前版本才提升）。
AI.result: 训练rollout从5增至100，留出成功率从47%升至67%；小训练集过拟合，训练达70%但留出仅54%。无条件接受修订时性能10轮内下降；加入Champion-Challenger后30轮留出成功率从51%升至67%。
AI.conclusion: 视觉界面机器人智能体的harness自动进化可行，但收益取决于决策背后的rollout规模和optimizer修订的筛选方式。

title: QuantCode Model: Specializing Language Models for Executable Algorithmic Trading Code
summary: Large language models are strong general-purpose code generators, but executable algorithmic trading remains a demanding specialization target: a model must translate a natural-language strategy specification into correct program logic for a specialized trading framework, execute on historical data, produce trades, and remain semantically faithful to the request. We study two complementary mechanisms for specializing language models for this setting: continued pretraining on algorithmic-trading framework code and supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on agent-validated request-to-code pairs. Evaluation is centered on QuantCode-Bench, our 400-task benchmark for Backtrader strategy generation, together with a repository-level SWE-bench-like track. Continued pretraining improves single-turn Judge Pass from 41.5% to 47.5% for Qwen3.5-397B-A17B and from 27.8% to 33.0% for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B. SFT applied after continued pretraining yields a larger gain for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, reaching 58.2% Judge Pass and 83.5% successful backtests; in agentic evaluation it raises first-turn success from 22.3% to 58.3% and final success after up to 10 turns from 47.5% to 79.5%. Continued pretraining alone improves first-turn agentic success but lowers final success after repair from 47.5% to 32.5%, consistent with degraded instruction following, whereas SFT improves both. We also identify a capability-retention failure: domain specialization degrades parser-conformant structured tool calling, and targeted recovery SFT restores tool-call formatting but not the base checkpoint's repository-level agent performance. The results show that framework-oriented pretraining, validated SFT, and explicit capability-retention evaluation address distinct failure modes in domain-specific executable code generation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究如何让大语言模型胜任可执行的算法交易策略生成，提出以交易框架代码继续预训练加经智能体验证的数据监督微调（SFT）进行领域特化，并构建400任务的QuantCode-Bench基准来评测Backtrader策略生成效果。
AI.motivation: 通用大模型虽擅长代码生成，但算法交易策略要求把自然语言策略描述转写为特定交易框架中逻辑正确、可回测执行且语义忠实的程序，属于高难度专业场景，需要专门的领域适配方法并系统评估其失败模式。
AI.method: 采用两种互补的领域特化手段：一是在算法交易框架代码上继续预训练；二是在由智能体验证过的“需求—代码”配对上做监督微调（可叠加于继续预训练之后）。评测以自建的QuantCode-Bench（400个Backtrader策略生成任务）为核心，并辅以类SWE-bench的仓库级任务轨道和智能体多轮评测（最多10轮）。
AI.result: 继续预训练使单轮Judge Pass从41.5%升至47.5%（Qwen3.5-397B-A17B）、从27.8%升至33.0%（Qwen3.6-35B-A3B）。在其后施加SFT对Qwen3.6-35B-A3B提升更大，达到58.2% Judge Pass与83.5%回测成功率；智能体评测中首轮成功率由22.3%升至58.3%，10轮内最终成功率由47.5%升至79.5%。仅做继续预训练虽提升首轮智能体成功率，却使修复后的最终成功率从47.5%降至32.5%，提示指令遵循能力受损，而SFT可同时改善两者。此外发现能力保留失效：领域特化会破坏符合解析器要求的结构化工具调用，针对性恢复性SFT可修复工具调用格式，但无法恢复基座模型的仓库级智能体性能。
AI.conclusion: 面向框架的继续预训练、经验证的监督微调以及显式的能力保留评测，分别对应领域特定可执行代码生成中的不同失败模式，三者需结合使用；领域特化在提升目标任务表现的同时可能带来指令遵循与工具调用等通用能力的退化。

title: Reserve-Aware Contrast Certificates for Conservative Bandits with Uncertain Baselines
summary: Conservative bandits must improve an incumbent policy without exhausting a prescribed performance budget. When the incumbent is uncertain, separately bounding candidate and baseline rewards can charge twice for shared estimation error. We develop Reserve-C4B around the baseline-relative contrast itself. A shared confidence set yields an exact expression for this avoidable penalty and a tighter admissibility test at every fixed history. A reserve ledger separates statistical evidence from permitted performance deficit; a prefix-refresh extension recertifies accumulated decisions under the current confidence set without discarding previously certified credit. For linear rewards, self-normalized confidence sets provide simultaneous validity over time and adaptively generated candidates, and the resulting policy satisfies a conditional-mean performance constraint with high probability. Reproducible experiments isolate certificate coupling, prefix refresh, and historical information, showing large reductions in baseline fallback while exposing the limitations of frozen certificates.

AI.tldr: 本文研究保守老虎机中如何在不确定基线策略下控制性能预算，提出基于基线相对对比的 Reserve-C4B，避免候选与基线奖励分别定界带来的重复估计误差惩罚，并在线性奖励下给出满足条件均值性能约束的高概率策略。
AI.motivation: 现有方法分别对候选奖励和基线奖励进行置信界估计，当基线不确定时会因共享估计误差被重复计入而过于保守，导致不必要的基线回退。
AI.method: 围绕基线相对对比构建共享置信集，推导可避免惩罚的精确表达式并给出更紧的可接受性检验；使用储备账本分离统计证据与允许的性能赤字；引入前缀刷新机制，在不丢弃已认证信用的前提下，用当前置信集重新认证历史决策；在线性奖励下采用自归一化置信集实现跨时间及自适应生成候选的同时有效性。
AI.result: 共享置信集给出了重复惩罚的精确刻画并收紧固定历史下的可接受性判定；储备账本与前缀刷新改善了预算利用和认证连续性；线性奖励策略以高概率满足条件均值性能约束。可复现实验表明基线回退大幅减少，同时揭示了冻结置信集的局限。
AI.conclusion: 通过直接建模基线相对对比并引入储备账本和前缀刷新，可在保守约束下更有效地利用性能预算，减少不必要的基线回退；但冻结置信集仍存在局限，需要动态重新认证以维持有效性。

title: BadAction: Backdoor Attacks on Interactive Video Generation via Action-Guided Triggers
comment: 12 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Project page: https://wsad55.github.io/badaction01/
summary: Interactive video generation (IVG) models have achieved remarkable progress in producing controllable visual content guided by user-defined actions, yet their security vulnerabilities remain largely unexplored. In this paper, we present the first systematic study of backdoor attacks against the interactivity of IVG models. Based on this attack surface, we propose BadAction, which leverages action-guided triggers to achieve the attack. Specifically, BadAction implants predefined motion patterns into the action sequences of backdoor samples and associates them with a static target video. Once triggered, the backdoored model generates frozen future frames that no longer respond to subsequent user actions, while preserving normal behavior on benign action sequences. In addition, we explore a stealthier attack in which multimodal triggers jointly poison action, text, and image inputs. Experiments show that BadAction achieves average attack success rates of 91.0% with action-only triggers and 80.4% with multimodal triggers. Moreover, extensive defense evaluations show that BadAction successfully bypasses existing backdoor detection methods, revealing a critical security gap in the interactive video generation pipeline. Project page: https://wsad55.github.io/badaction01/.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统研究交互式视频生成模型的交互性后门攻击，提出BadAction，通过动作触发器等使模型生成冻结未来帧。
AI.motivation: 交互式视频生成模型在可控视觉内容生成上进展显著，但其安全漏洞，尤其是交互性相关的后门攻击，尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 提出BadAction：将预定义运动模式植入后门样本的动作序列，并与静态目标视频关联；同时探索联合污染动作、文本和图像输入的多模态触发器。
AI.result: 动作触发器平均攻击成功率达91.0%，多模态触发器达80.4%；大量防御评估表明BadAction可绕过现有后门检测方法。
AI.conclusion: 交互式视频生成流程存在关键安全缺口，BadAction有效且隐蔽，凸显了针对IVG交互性后门攻击的防御需求。

title: TED:Text-Axis Evidence Decomposition for Prompted Anomaly Localization
comment: 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
summary: CLIP is a powerful vision-language model, but it was not designed for fine-grained defect localization; CLIP-based anomaly detectors therefore adapt it with prompts or lightweight modules to increase defect sensitivity. We show that stronger sensitivity does not necessarily make local evidence reliable: under domain shift, adapted CLIP-AD models often assign high anomaly scores to both true defects and visually complex normal regions. The issue is not simply missing defect information, but a local scoring rule that decodes defect and hard-normal evidence, having the same anomaly evidence. We propose TED (Text-Axis Evidence Decomposition), a post-hoc scoring method that asks whether each ambiguous response is better supported by source defect patches or by source normal patches mistaken as anomalous. TED compares these supports under the host's normal-versus-anomaly text response, leaves the backbone and prompts unchanged, and requires no target-domain training. It works as a train-free score for raw VLM backbones or as a source-calibrated residual correction for adapted CLIP-AD hosts. Across frozen VLM backbones, TED substantially improves pixel-level localization over raw prompt similarity; across adapted hosts, it improves most pixel-level settings over P-AUROC, P-PRO, and P-AP. Gains are largest under stronger hard-FP competition, with mean localization gain increasing from +5.0 in low-competition regimes to about +10.9 in mid/high-competition regimes. These results suggest that recoverable defect evidence can already exist in pretrained multimodal representations, but reliable localization requires decoding it against hard-normal competitors. Code will be released at TED GitHub repository.

AI.tldr: 论文指出，基于CLIP的异常检测在域偏移下会把真实缺陷与视觉复杂的正常区域都打出高异常分，问题在于局部打分规则将缺陷与hard-normal证据解码为相同的异常证据。作者提出TED（Text-Axis Evidence Decomposition），一种后处理打分方法，通过比较源域缺陷patch与被误判为异常的源域正常patch在normal-vs-anomaly文本响应下的支持度，无需改动backbone/prompt，也无需目标域训练。
AI.motivation: CLIP-based anomaly detector通常通过prompt或轻量模块增强缺陷敏感性，但更强的敏感性并不保证局部证据可靠；在域偏移下，adapted CLIP-AD常将高异常分同时赋予真实缺陷和视觉复杂的正常区域（hard normal），导致定位不可靠。
AI.method: TED（Text-Axis Evidence Decomposition）是一种post-hoc scoring方法：针对每个模糊响应，判断其更受源域缺陷patch支持，还是更受被误判为异常的源域正常patch支持；在host的normal-versus-anomaly文本响应下比较这两类支持。它保持backbone和prompt不变，不需要目标域训练，既可作为raw VLM backbone的train-free score，也可作为adapted CLIP-AD host的source-calibrated residual correction。
AI.result: 在冻结VLM backbone上，TED相比原始prompt相似度显著提升像素级定位；在adapted hosts上，在多数像素级设置中优于P-AUROC、P-PRO和P-AP。hard-FP竞争越强，增益越大：低竞争下平均定位增益+5.0，中/高竞争下约+10.9。
AI.conclusion: 预训练多模态表示中已经存在可恢复的缺陷证据，但可靠定位需要针对hard-normal竞争者进行解码；TED表明无需目标域训练即可提升CLIP-AD在域偏移下的像素级异常定位。

title: FORTE: Forecasting Occupancy for Spatiotemporal Risk-Aware Planning in Dynamic Environments
summary: Safe navigation in dynamic environments requires anticipating future environmental states to account for spatiotemporal risks, specifically when and where collisions may occur. To this end, occupancy grid map (OGM) prediction has been widely adopted as an effective approach. However, existing OGM-based navigation methods often struggle to achieve accurate and efficient forecasting and fail to fully exploit the temporal information in predicted OGMs during planning. To address these challenges, we propose FORTE, a navigation framework that directly exploits the spatiotemporal evolution of predicted occupancy from the perspectives of spatiotemporal occupancy overlap and occupancy directivity. Based on these properties, FORTE evaluates multiple topology-distinct paths and selects the suitable one without explicit object detection or tracking. To support online planning, we formulate a latent diffusion model-based OGM predictor that generates the entire forecast horizon in a non-autoregressive manner while maintaining temporal consistency through temporal shift modules. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that FORTE outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. For prediction, FORTE achieves up to 215.3% higher IoU and 5.24x faster inference; for navigation, it yields up to a 3.5x higher success rate.

AI.tldr: 提出 FORTE 导航框架，直接利用预测占据栅格图（OGM）的时空演化信息进行路径评估与选择，并配合潜在扩散模型实现高效 OGM 预测。
AI.motivation: 动态环境中安全导航需预见未来何时何地发生碰撞，但现有基于 OGM 的导航方法预测不够准确高效，且规划时未充分利用预测 OGM 中的时序信息。
AI.method: FORTE 从时空占据重叠和占据方向性两个角度利用预测占据的时空演化，评估多条拓扑不同的路径并选择合适路径，无需显式目标检测或跟踪；同时提出基于潜在扩散模型的 OGM 预测器，以非自回归方式生成整个预测时域，并通过时间偏移模块保持时序一致性。
AI.result: 大量评估表明 FORTE 优于现有最优基线：预测方面 IoU 最高提升 215.3%，推理速度最高提升 5.24 倍；导航方面成功率最高提升 3.5 倍。
AI.conclusion: FORTE 能有效提升动态环境下 OGM 预测的准确性与效率，并显著改善导航性能，证明充分利用预测占据图的时空信息具有重要价值。

title: DuplexAct-Bench: Broadening Full-Duplex Speech Evaluation toward Proactive Interaction across Diverse Behavioral Requirements
summary: Existing full-duplex speech benchmarks cover only subsets of real-time interaction behaviors, often under limited contextual conditions. We introduce DuplexAct-Bench, a bilingual benchmark that systematically covers six complementary behaviors, from interruption and yielding to proactive initiation, active silence, and backchanneling, across Pre-session, In-session, and No-explicit conditions. Across 1,290 English and Chinese streaming trials, we evaluate 12 full-duplex speech systems on both Timing and Content. Results reveal substantial variation across behaviors, conditions, and systems, as well as frequent mismatches between semantic quality and behavioral timing. These findings show that current systems remain far from robustly managing when, whether, and how to participate as real-time interaction unfolds. Project page: https://alitaxky.icu/DuplexAct-Bench/

AI.tldr: 该论文提出双语全双工语音交互基准 DuplexAct-Bench，系统覆盖六类实时交互行为，并在多条件下评测12个系统，揭示其在行为时机与内容质量上的显著不足。
AI.motivation: 现有全双工语音基准仅覆盖部分实时交互行为，且上下文条件有限，难以全面评估系统在真实对话中何时、是否以及如何参与交互。
AI.method: 构建 DuplexAct-Bench 双语基准，覆盖打断、让出话轮、主动发起、主动沉默、反馈信号等六类互补行为，并设置 Pre-session、In-session、No-explicit 三类条件；在1,290个中英文流式试验中，从 Timing 和 Content 两个维度评测12个全双工语音系统。
AI.result: 结果显示不同行为、条件和系统之间存在显著差异，且语义质量与行为时机经常不匹配，表明当前系统难以稳健管理实时交互中的参与时机、参与决策与参与方式。
AI.conclusion: 当前全双工语音系统在实时交互行为管理方面仍远未达到鲁棒水平，DuplexAct-Bench 为更全面评估此类能力提供了系统化基准。

title: MASCRDM: Multi-Agent System for Compliance Risk Detection and Mitigation in Training Process of Large Language Models
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have been applied in various fields. However, ensuring compliance and safety of LLMs, such as avoiding discrimination and bias, still remains a challenge. Current efforts mainly focus on detecting and filtering inputs and outputs of the trained models, rather than studying the intrinsic architecture of the models in real-time. To tackle this challenge, we analyze the LLMs training process and discover two critical issues: 1) Most of the existing methods are predominantly static in their approach to detection and filtering, achieving only localized optimizations without systematically enhancing the compliance of LLMs. 2) Another issue with existing approaches is the lack of real-time risk detection and mitigation across the full training process, which leads to limited flexibility. Motivated by these, we propose MASCRDM (Multi-Agent System for Compliance Risk Detection and Mitigation) during the LLM training process. Firstly, we develop a set of compliance rules based on existing Artificial Intelligence (AI) laws and a compliance-specific LLM with the instruction of compliance law experts. Then, we deconstruct LLMs into several components and identify key nodes based on the compliance knowledge graph. During LLMs training, we implement our multiple agents in the whole process, giving compliance risk alerts and suggestions for LLM developers. Experiments on discrimination and bias benchmark demonstrate that our multi-agent system can effectively improve the compliance while maintaining reasonable semantic performance. The results indicate that our method provides an executable path for mitigating compliance risk from within the LLMs systematically.

AI.tldr: 提出MASCRDM多智能体系统，在LLM训练过程中进行合规风险检测与缓解，基于AI法律和合规知识图谱，实验表明能提升合规性并保持语义性能。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM合规安全方法主要检测过滤输入输出，静态局部优化，缺乏全训练过程实时风险检测与缓解，需从模型内部系统性提升合规性。
AI.method: 分析训练过程，基于AI法律和专家指导构建合规规则与合规专用LLM；解构LLM组件，基于合规知识图谱识别关键节点；在训练全程部署多智能体，提供风险警报和建议。
AI.result: 在歧视与偏见基准上，多智能体系统有效提升合规性，同时保持合理的语义性能。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为从LLM内部系统性地缓解合规风险提供了可执行路径。

title: TSMD: Temporal-Stream Modality Dropout for Robust Video Highlight Detection
summary: Existing multimodal video highlight detectors typically assume that visual, audio, and textual streams are continuously available. In practice, however, inputs may suffer from localized frame missingness or complete-stream outage. We formulate this robustness challenge along two dimensions: temporal missingness, where frames are missing independently in each modality, and stream-level missingness, where one modality is unavailable throughout a video. Moreover, we find that the mean squared error (MSE) loss is misaligned with both the evaluation metrics and the peak-driven nature of highlights. Therefore, we propose Temporal-Stream Modality Dropout (TSMD), which combines structured missingness simulation with a joint objective comprising pointwise MSE, per-video Pearson correlation, and peak-oriented RankNet loss terms. TSMD has three variants: temporal, stream-level, and mixed dropout. On the MoSu and Mr. HiSum datasets, TSMD-Temporal improves mAP@15 by 7.06 and 3.41 points over TripleSumm under 50% independent temporal removal, whereas TSMD-Stream performs the best under complete-stream removal. TSMD-Mix retains most of these complementary benefits and ranks the best or the second-best across the evaluated temporal and stream-level conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多模态视频高光检测在模态缺失下的鲁棒性问题，提出TSMD方法，通过模拟时序与流级缺失并联合MSE、Pearson相关和RankNet损失，在多个数据集上取得优于TripleSumm的效果。
AI.motivation: 现有视频高光检测方法通常假设视觉、音频和文本流始终完整可用，但实际中可能出现局部帧缺失或整条模态流中断；同时MSE损失与评价指标及高光峰值特性不匹配。
AI.method: 提出Temporal-Stream Modality Dropout（TSMD），结合结构化缺失模拟与联合目标函数，包括逐点MSE、逐视频Pearson相关损失和面向峰值的RankNet损失；TSMD有三个变体：时序缺失、流级缺失和混合缺失。
AI.result: 在MoSu和Mr. HiSum数据集上，50%独立时序移除下，TSMD-Temporal相比TripleSumm将mAP@15分别提升7.06和3.41个点；完整流移除下TSMD-Stream表现最佳；TSMD-Mix保留互补优势，在评估的时序和流级条件下排名最佳或次佳。
AI.conclusion: TSMD能有效提升多模态视频高光检测在时序缺失和流级缺失场景下的鲁棒性，混合变体可综合不同缺失模式下的优势。

title: BELIEFRAG: Making Adaptive RAG State-Aware under Evolving Evidence
summary: Adaptive RAG uses signals such as confidence, relevance, support, and retrieval quality to decide when to search or correct evidence. In multi-step retrieval, however, these local signals must be combined into a persistent view of what the current evidence supports, what remains missing, and which action should follow. Existing methods often use such signals as separate triggers, making it difficult to preserve a coherent evidence state across a trajectory; we call this problem evidence-state fragmentation. We introduce BELIEFRAG, a closed-loop controller that updates an explicit state over sufficiency, reliability, conflict, uncertainty, evidence gaps, and acquisition cost, then chooses among retrieval, query rewriting, verification, answering, stopping, and abstention. Across six QA benchmarks with gpt-oss-120b, BELIEFRAG reaches mean token F1 0.572 with 3.89k tokens per question, outperforming fixed iterative retrieval (0.555 F1) while using 39% fewer tokens. The same quality-cost pattern transfers to Qwen3-32B, where BELIEFRAG reaches 0.552 F1 versus 0.523 for iterative retrieval while using 35% fewer tokens. Analysis shows that the main gains come from corrective re-retrieval rather than pruning alone, while several belief dimensions are redundant and calibrated answerability plays the strongest operational role. Calibration improves threshold stability across related evidence sources, although source shift can still invalidate the same decision signal.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 BELIEFRAG，通过维护显式证据状态并闭环选择检索、改写、验证、回答、停止或弃答等动作，缓解多步检索中的证据状态碎片化问题，在六个问答基准上取得更优质量-成本权衡。
AI.motivation: 自适应 RAG 常利用置信度、相关性、支持度、检索质量等局部信号决定是否检索或纠错，但在多步检索中这些信号通常被当作独立触发器，难以形成对当前证据支持什么、还缺什么以及下一步该做什么的持续一致状态，即证据状态碎片化。
AI.method: BELIEFRAG 是一个闭环控制器，维护关于充分性、可靠性、冲突、不确定性、证据缺口和获取成本的显式状态，并据此在检索、查询改写、验证、回答、停止和弃答等动作之间进行选择。
AI.result: 在六个 QA 基准上，使用 gpt-oss-120b 时 BELIEFRAG 达到平均 token F1 0.572，每问题 3.89k tokens，优于固定迭代检索的 0.555 F1，且 token 减少 39%；迁移到 Qwen3-32B 时达到 0.552 F1，优于迭代检索的 0.523 F1，且 token 减少 35%。分析表明主要收益来自纠正性再检索而非仅靠剪枝，部分信念维度存在冗余，校准后的可回答性在操作上作用最强。
AI.conclusion: 校准可提升相关证据源之间的阈值稳定性，但源分布偏移仍可能使同一决策信号失效。整体上，显式证据状态与闭环控制能更有效地平衡多步检索问答的质量与成本。

title: A Biophysically Detailed C. elegans Circuit as a Task-Agnostic Dynamical Core for Visually Robust Robot Manipulation
summary: Robot policies are usually trained for one task, one body and one visual environment, and generalize poorly beyond these conditions. Whether a nervous system can instead supply the sensorimotor computation through its evolved wiring and biophysics remains unresolved. Here we embed a biophysically detailed Caenorhabditis elegans sensorimotor circuit - 136 multicompartment neurons with realistic morphologies and electrophysiological characteristics - as the dynamical core of a visuomotor policy. Only thin task-specific adapters are trained; the core's synaptic weights stay fixed while its membrane voltages evolve freely. Across different MetaWorld tasks the core matches or exceeds diffusion-policy, action-chunking-transformer and neural-circuit-policy baselines, and degrades less under visual perturbations. Replacing the core with generic network models such as MLP, LSTM, transformer or reservoir networks removes the advantage. Furthermore, on a real robotic arm the core withstands diverse visual perturbations that collapse the baselines. Our results suggest that visual robustness can be inherited from biophysically detailed circuit dynamics rather than learned by task-specific controllers.

AI.tldr: 该研究将生物物理详细的秀丽隐杆线虫感觉运动回路作为视觉运动策略的动力学核心，仅训练轻量任务适配器，在仿真任务和真实机械臂上展现出优于多种基线的视觉鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 机器人策略通常只针对单一任务、身体和视觉环境训练，泛化能力差；神经系统能否通过其进化形成的连接和生物物理特性提供可迁移的感觉运动计算仍不清楚。
AI.method: 嵌入包含136个多房室神经元、具有真实形态和电生理特性的线虫感觉运动回路作为策略核心；固定其突触权重，让膜电压自由演化，仅训练任务特定的薄适配器；在不同MetaWorld任务中与扩散策略、动作分块Transformer和神经回路策略等基线比较，并替换为MLP、LSTM、Transformer或储备池网络进行消融；还在真实机械臂上测试视觉扰动下的表现。
AI.result: 在多个MetaWorld任务中，该核心匹配或超越扩散策略、动作分块Transformer和神经回路策略基线，且在视觉扰动下性能下降更少；替换为MLP、LSTM、Transformer或储备池网络会消除这一优势；在真实机械臂上，该核心能承受多种视觉扰动，而基线方法会崩溃。
AI.conclusion: 视觉鲁棒性可以继承自生物物理详细回路的动力学特性，而不必完全依赖任务特定控制器学习得到。

title: Synthetic Data Characterization via Training Dynamics
summary: Interpreting properties of LLM-generated data is important for understanding its utility and limitations across learning tasks. In this work, we characterize synthetic data through sample-level learnability, studying variation among LLM families and scales, alongside human-written data as a reference. We first generate synthetic datasets spanning single- and multi-label classification, labeling, and tree prediction tasks. We then derive empirical data distributions from encoder training dynamics for both machine and organic data, and estimate the robustness of these distributions across encoders. Finally, we evaluate how data selection strategies based on these learnability signals affect both data sources differently.

AI.tldr: 该工作通过样本级可学习性刻画LLM生成数据，比较不同LLM家族与规模及人类数据，并评估基于可学习性的数据选择策略对不同数据源的影响。
AI.motivation: 理解LLM生成数据的特性对于判断其在不同学习任务中的效用与局限很重要，尤其需要区分合成数据与人类数据。
AI.method: 生成涵盖单标签/多标签分类、标注和树预测任务的合成数据集；利用编码器训练动态推导机器数据与人类数据的经验分布，并评估其跨编码器鲁棒性；基于可学习性信号进行数据选择并比较影响。
AI.result: 摘要指出合成数据的样本级可学习性随LLM家族与规模变化，且机器数据与人类数据的经验分布存在差异；基于可学习性的数据选择策略对两类数据源影响不同。
AI.conclusion: 样本级可学习性可作为理解与利用LLM生成数据的有效视角；针对合成数据的数据选择需考虑其与人类数据的来源差异。

title: Schema: Discovering Unknown Environments via Agentic Program Induction
summary: Learning to complete tasks in unfamiliar environments with unknown rules remains a key challenge for LLM agents. Current LLM agents often record their discoveries in prose, which may not provide a compact, explicit account of how the environment works. Inspired by how scientists organize observations into testable, predictive theories, we introduce Schema, an agent harness that organizes learning and action through interactive program induction. The LLM agent decides what to investigate and how to act, expressing its evolving understanding of the environment as executable programs. The harness consists of a persistent program workspace and a small set of interfaces for checking these programs against the interaction history, planning within them, and executing plans under step-by-step verification. Schema raises ARC-AGI-3 RHAE from 58.7% to 99.2% with the same base model, solves 100% of the public DiG-bench games, and reaches the median performance of the top-50 human players on MazeBench. Extensive analysis shows the effectiveness of Schema in unknown mechanism discovery, and ablations confirm the contribution of each component.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Schema，一种通过交互式程序归纳来组织学习与行动的 LLM 智能体框架，使智能体将其对环境规则的理解表示为可执行程序，并在未知环境中显著提升任务完成表现。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体在未知规则环境中常以自然语言散文记录发现，难以形成紧凑、明确且可预测的环境模型，因此需要更结构化的学习与行动机制。
AI.method: 受科学家将观察组织为可检验、可预测理论的启发，Schema 让 LLM 智能体决定探索与行动方式，并以可执行程序表达不断演进的环境理解；框架包含持久程序工作区，以及用于对照交互历史检查程序、在程序内规划、并在逐步验证下执行计划的一组接口。
AI.result: 在相同基座模型下，Schema 将 ARC-AGI-3 RHAE 从 58.7% 提升至 99.2%，解决 100% 公开 DiG-bench 游戏，并在 MazeBench 上达到前 50 名人类玩家的中位表现；分析显示其能有效发现未知机制，消融实验验证了各组件的贡献。
AI.conclusion: Schema 通过交互式程序归纳显著增强了 LLM 智能体在未知机制环境中的学习与行动能力，表明将环境理解显式建模为可执行程序是提升智能体泛化与任务完成效果的有效方向。

title: HiWE: Hierarchical World Knowledge Model with Visual Keypoint Enhancement for Zero-Shot 3D Path Planning
summary: Robot demonstration generation requires a system to identify where an interaction should occur, plan a feasible motion, and execute the required contact. HiWE connects these decisions through a point-based interface between visual grounding and language-based planning. PointVLM is instruction-tuned to associate task-relevant objects with image coordinates using a mixture of point annotations, segmentation-derived samples, robot observations, and visual question answering data. Depth measurements lift these predictions into a semantic 3D representation. A language planner, 3DLLM, uses this representation to specify end-effector waypoints and gripper commands, while a hybrid grasping module resolves local grasp poses. The evaluation covers 14 simulated manipulation tasks and four physical-robot tasks, together with ablations of the visual training data, spatial inputs, and grasp selection. Here, zero-shot execution refers to deployment without task-specific demonstration training; the visual model uses existing robot data during fine-tuning. This paper describes the original point-based formulation of the framework; its relationship to the subsequent GeneralVLA extension is detailed in the introduction.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于点接口的机器人演示生成框架，将视觉定位与语言规划连接起来，用于识别交互位置、规划可行运动并执行接触。
AI.motivation: 机器人演示生成需要系统判断交互应发生在何处、规划可行运动并执行所需接触，因此需要连接视觉 grounding 与语言规划。
AI.method: 提出 HiWE 框架，通过点接口连接视觉与语言。PointVLM 使用点标注、分割样本、机器人观测和视觉问答数据进行指令微调，将任务相关物体关联到图像坐标；深度测量将预测提升为语义 3D 表示。语言规划器 3DLLM 利用该表示指定末端执行器路点和夹爪命令，混合抓取模块解析局部抓取位姿。
AI.result: 评估覆盖 14 个仿真操作任务和 4 个物理机器人任务，并对视觉训练数据、空间输入和抓取选择进行了消融。零样本执行指不进行任务特定演示训练即可部署；视觉模型在微调时使用现有机器人数据。论文描述了该框架最初的点式公式，并在引言中说明了其与后续 GeneralVLA 扩展的关系。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过基于点的公式化方法连接视觉定位与语言规划，为机器人演示生成提供了统一框架，并明确了其与 GeneralVLA 扩展的关系。

title: Right-Wing Rock or Just Rock? A Computational Linguistic Analysis of Frei.Wild
comment: 20 pages, 9 figures, for code and data see https://zenodo.org/records/22676753, to be published in the proceedings of the NLP 4 Positive Impact workshop at EMNLP 2026
summary: Rechtsrock is a subgenre of rock music that spreads right-wing ideology, often instrumentalized to recruit adolescents into the radical scene. Monitoring institutions counteract this by manually examining and, in some cases, banning extremist content; however, there are border cases that evade regulation. We present a study aimed at determining whether such a case, the band Frei.Wild, should be classified as politically right-leaning or as part of the general German rock genre. We sampled a German rock dataset and created a corpus for right-wing rock to use as reference in this analysis and found that we can confirm the intuitions from previous investigations that Frei.Wild successfully maintains an ambiguity with regard to their political affiliation. However, the tendency is towards the right-wing spectrum. Lexical analyses reveal nationalistic narratives and two high-performing classifiers (up to 97% ROC-AUC score) label more than half of their songs as right-wing extremist. Our analysis provides insight into how computational methods can improve the process of identifying right-wing extremist tendencies in music, especially in borderline cases like Frei.Wild. The code and data are made available for future research.

AI.tldr: 论文研究用计算方法判断德国乐队 Frei.Wild 应归为政治右倾/右翼摇滚还是普通德国摇滚，以辅助识别边界性右翼极端内容。
AI.motivation: Rechtsrock 传播右翼意识形态并常被用于招募青少年，监测机构需人工审查甚至封禁极端内容，但存在逃避监管的边界案例，如 Frei.Wild，因此需要更有效的计算识别方法。
AI.method: 构建德国摇滚数据集和右翼摇滚参考语料库；对 Frei.Wild 歌词进行词汇分析；训练并应用文本分类器来判别其歌曲是否具有右翼极端倾向。
AI.result: 确认 Frei.Wild 在政治归属上保持模糊性，但整体倾向右翼光谱；词汇分析显示民族主义叙事；两个高性能分类器（ROC-AUC 最高达 97%）将其超过一半歌曲标为右翼极端。
AI.conclusion: 计算方法可改进对音乐中右翼极端倾向的识别，尤其适用于 Frei.Wild 这类边界案例；代码和数据已公开以供后续研究。

title: Agentic Tool-Augmented Reasoning for Explainable Image Forgery Detection
summary: Conventional image forgery detection methods produce binary scores or pixel-level masks without interpretable evidence, while recent multimodal large language model (MLLM)-based approaches generate post-hoc explanations of predetermined classification results rather than reasoning from evidence. Inspired by the forensic workflow of human judicial experts, we propose Agentic Tool-Augmented Reasoning (ATAR), a framework integrating 22 specialized forensic tools across seven complementary domains to autonomously detect, localize, and explain image forgeries through multi-turn reasoning. A Dual-Stream Forensic Reasoning paradigm combines a high-level semantic anomaly path, which magnifies suspicious regions for fine-grained inspection, with a low-level forgery artifact path, which invokes forensic tools to extract objective evidence. We further introduce Forensics Curriculum Learning: during General Experience SFT, an automated teacher-student mentoring pipeline synthesizes multi-turn tool-usage reasoning trajectories; during Forensic Scene RL, a Tool Prior Curriculum guides early tool exploration and progressively transfers control to the agent, while a Structured Evidence Reward provides fine-grained process-level supervision. Experiments across IMDL, Deepfake detection, DMDL, and AIGC detection show that ATAR achieves 78.5% average image-level F1 on six zero-shot IMDL benchmarks, surpassing the strongest MLLM baseline by 11.8 percentage points, and remains competitive with specialized detectors on other tasks while producing substantially more faithful and grounded explanations.

AI.tldr: 提出ATAR框架，通过集成22种取证工具进行多轮推理，实现图像伪造的自主检测、定位与解释。
AI.motivation: 传统图像伪造检测缺乏可解释证据，而现有多模态大模型方法仅对预定分类结果生成事后解释，并非基于证据推理。受人类司法专家取证流程启发，需开发能基于证据推理的检测方法。
AI.method: ATAR框架整合七领域22种取证工具，采用双流取证推理范式：高层语义异常路径放大可疑区域进行细粒度检查，低层伪造痕迹路径调用工具提取客观证据。并引入取证课程学习：在通用经验SFT阶段，通过自动师生指导流程合成多轮工具使用推理轨迹；在取证场景RL阶段，采用工具先验课程引导早期工具探索并逐步转移控制权，同时用结构化证据奖励提供细粒度过程级监督。
AI.result: 在IMDL、Deepfake检测、DMDL和AIGC检测任务上实验。ATAR在六个零样本IMDL基准上平均图像级F1达78.5%，超越最强MLLM基线11.8个百分点，在其他任务上与专用检测器性能相当，同时生成更忠实、有依据的解释。
AI.conclusion: ATAR通过工具增强推理和课程学习，有效提升了图像伪造检测的性能与可解释性，实现了更可靠的检测、定位和解释。

title: RefCon: Iterative Refinement and Contrastive Memory Extraction for Context-Evolving Agent
summary: Long-horizon agent interactions generate useful but noisy experience, and retraining models to absorb it is expensive. Context-evolving agents therefore need memory extraction methods that improve with more test-time compute without relying on gold labels. We propose RefCon, which combines sequential self-refinement with parallel self-contrast to extract higher-quality memories without gold labels. Evaluated on AppWorld and BFCL-V3 across multiple context-evolving agent frameworks, RefCon delivers strong and consistent gains, including relative improvements of 21.6% on ACE and 16.6% on ReMe over no-scaling baselines, while a diversity-focused variant (DivCon) achieves a 35.5% gain on ReasoningBank. RefCon consistently outperforms existing baselines without ground-truth labels, and generalizes across model scales and to software engineering tasks, where it surpasses even ground-truth baselines. We further analyze the accuracy-token trade-off and scaling behavior, showing RefCon maintains favorable efficiency and continues to improve as more trajectories are used, unlike diversity-only scaling which saturates earlier.

AI.tldr: 提出 RefCon，一种无需金标签的记忆提取方法，通过顺序自精炼与并行自对比提升上下文演化智能体的测试时扩展效果。
AI.motivation: 长时程智能体交互会产生有用但带噪声的经验，重新训练模型来吸收这些经验成本高昂；因此需要能随测试时计算增加而提升、且不依赖人工标注的记忆提取方法。
AI.method: RefCon 结合顺序自精炼与并行自对比，无需金标签提取更高质量记忆；并提出多样性导向变体 DivCon。在 AppWorld 和 BFCL-V3 上跨多个上下文演化智能体框架评估，并测试跨模型规模与软件工程任务泛化性。
AI.result: RefCon 在 ACE 上相对提升 21.6%，在 ReMe 上提升 16.6%；DivCon 在 ReasoningBank 上提升 35.5%。它持续优于无真值标签基线，并可泛化到软件工程任务，甚至超过真值基线；分析显示其精度-令牌权衡与扩展行为良好，随轨迹增多持续改进，而仅靠多样性扩展更早饱和。
AI.conclusion: RefCon 证明无需金标签也能有效利用测试时计算来提取更优记忆，持续提升智能体表现，并具有较好的泛化性与效率。

title: MRI Super-Resolution with RCDM/WaveMix and Task-Aware Segmentation
summary: Super-resolution and quality enhancement of 1.5\,T brain MRI are normally validated with image-fidelity metrics, although their purpose is to improve downstream analysis. We study whether enhancement improves tissue segmentation, and for which segmenters. We propose an unpaired, physics-guided training pipeline for a lightweight ($\le$2.5\,M parameter) recurrent convolutional enhancer: a six-module stochastic 1.5\,T degradation operator, a residual adversarial network that adds scanner-specific texture without moving anatomy, and a cycle-consistent objective with an anti-identity penalty that rules out the copy solution. We then train U-Net, Swin-UNet and wavelet token-mixing segmenters \citep{jeevan2023wavemix} from scratch on either raw or enhanced 1.5\,T images of the same subjects, using identical labels and subject-level splits, for three enhancer variants and two datasets. On ABIDE (41 held-out subjects, FreeSurfer labels) enhancement significantly improves the wavelet segmenter (mean Dice $+0.014$, Wilcoxon $p=3.5\times10^{-5}$; CSF $+0.018$, grey matter $+0.013$), significantly degrades the U-Net ($-0.008$, $p=5.1\times10^{-4}$) and leaves Swin-UNet unchanged. On IXI, whose labels come from FSL-FAST, enhancement lowers Dice for all nine pairings, almost entirely through CSF; we trace this to spatially implausible CSF voxels in the labels that penalise smoother predictions. Enhancement of low-field MRI should therefore be validated per downstream model and against reliable labels.

AI.tldr: 研究1.5T脑MRI增强是否改善下游组织分割，发现效果取决于分割器：在ABIDE上小波分割器改善、U-Net受损、Swin-UNet不变；在IXI上所有配对均下降，主要源于不可靠的CSF标签。
AI.motivation: 超分辨与质量增强通常用图像保真度指标验证，但其真正目的是改善下游分析；因此需要研究增强是否、以及针对哪些分割器能改善组织分割。
AI.method: 提出无配对、物理引导的训练流程，训练参数不超过2.5M的轻量循环卷积增强器：包含六模块随机1.5T退化算子、添加扫描仪特定纹理而不移动解剖结构的残差对抗网络，以及带反恒等惩罚的循环一致目标以排除复制解。随后在相同受试者、相同标签和受试者级划分下，从头训练U-Net、Swin-UNet和小波token混合分割器，比较原始与增强的1.5T图像，涉及三种增强器变体和两个数据集。
AI.result: ABIDE（41个留出受试者，FreeSurfer标签）上，增强显著改善小波分割器（平均Dice +0.014，Wilcoxon p=3.5×10⁻⁵；CSF +0.018，灰质 +0.013），显著降低U-Net（-0.008，p=5.1×10⁻⁴），Swin-UNet无变化。IXI（FSL-FAST标签）上，增强在全部九种配对中降低Dice，几乎完全由CSF导致；这归因于标签中空间不合理的CSF体素惩罚了更平滑的预测。
AI.conclusion: 低场MRI增强应按下游模型并基于可靠标签进行验证，不能仅依赖图像保真度指标。

title: Spike-driven Vision-Language-Action Model
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models bridge multimodal understanding and robotic control, advancing the dominant paradigm for embodied intelligence. However, most existing models rely on large Transformers, whose latency and energy costs hinder deployment on resource-constrained platforms. Through sparse event-driven computation, spiking neural networks offer a promising paradigm for high-performance and energy-efficient computing. Here, we propose the first Spike-driven VLA framework enabling end-to-end direct training for robotic manipulation, which mainly comprises three core components. First, we develop spiking visual and instruction encoders for multimodal perception, encoding visual observations and language instructions into sparse, reliable spike representations for subsequent cross-modal fusion. Then, we introduce Multi-Winner Spike Fusion for instruction-guided scene understanding, using bidirectional top-$k$ winner-take-all spike routing to suppress background interference and yield fused memory. Finally, we propose a Spike Action Chunking Transformer that incorporates spiking cross-attention over the fused memory and the current robot state, enabling efficient end-to-end generation of continuous action chunks for robotic control. Extensive experiments on LIBERO and Meta-World demonstrate that Spike-driven VLA achieves competitive performance with fewer parameters and lower estimated inference energy than conventional VLA models. This work establishes a foundational framework for neuromorphic VLA modeling, paving the way for future advances in resource-efficient embodied intelligence.

AI.tldr: 提出首个脉冲驱动的VLA框架，支持机器人操作端到端直接训练，并在LIBERO和Meta-World上以更少参数和更低估计推理能耗取得有竞争力的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型多依赖大型Transformer，延迟和能耗较高，难以部署在资源受限平台；脉冲神经网络通过稀疏事件驱动计算，有望实现高性能且节能的计算。
AI.method: 开发脉冲视觉与指令编码器，将视觉观测和语言指令编码为稀疏可靠的脉冲表示；提出Multi-Winner Spike Fusion，利用双向top-k winner-take-all脉冲路由进行指令引导的场景理解，抑制背景干扰并生成融合记忆；提出Spike Action Chunking Transformer，在融合记忆和当前机器人状态上使用脉冲交叉注意力，端到端生成连续动作块。
AI.result: 在LIBERO和Meta-World上的大量实验表明，Spike-driven VLA相比传统VLA模型参数更少、估计推理能耗更低，同时性能具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了神经形态VLA建模的基础框架，为资源高效的具身智能未来进展铺平了道路。

title: MotionWeave: Learning Motion-Centered Future Dynamics for Vision-Language-Action Policies
comment: 4 pages + 1 page references, 3 figures, 2 tables. Code: https://github.com/autu-mn/MotionWeave
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently incorporated world models to provide richer dynamic supervision beyond sparse action labels. However, explicitly predicting future images or videos may include control-irrelevant appearance, while guidance derived from holistic future visual representations and shared global action features may fail to establish timestep-specific correspondence between actions and local visual changes. To address this issue, we propose MotionWeave, a motion-centric future-dynamics framework for action-chunk prediction with two modules: the Action-Induced Motion Grounder (AIMG) and the Horizon Residual Composer (HRC). Specifically, AIMG conditions on action and proprioceptive representations to construct horizon-specific queries that localize interaction regions associated with each future action timestep from current visual tokens. HRC extracts differences between interaction representations at adjacent horizons, encodes them as temporal motion cues, and injects them into action tokens through a gated residual. During training, robot-arm masks rendered from future frames are used to construct KL-based motion-grounding supervision, while inference uses only the current observation. On six MetaWorld tasks, MotionWeave achieves a 75.3% average success rate, an absolute gain of 8.6% over π0 (66.7%), especially on sustained-interaction tasks. Our code is available at https://github.com/autu-mn/MotionWeave.

AI.tldr: 提出MotionWeave，一种以运动为中心的未来动态框架，用于动作块预测，包含AIMG和HRC两个模块，在六个MetaWorld任务上平均成功率达75.3%，比π0高出8.6%。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型引入世界模型提供动态监督，但显式预测未来图像/视频会包含与控制无关的外观信息，且整体未来视觉表示和共享全局动作特征难以建立动作与局部视觉变化之间逐时间步的对应关系。
AI.method: 提出两个模块：AIMG基于动作和本体感觉表示构建时间步特定的查询，从当前视觉token中定位每个未来动作时间步对应的交互区域；HRC提取相邻时间步交互表示间的差异，编码为时序运动线索，通过门控残差注入动作token。训练时使用未来帧渲染的机械臂掩码构建KL散度运动定位监督，推理仅用当前观测。
AI.result: 在六个MetaWorld任务上平均成功率为75.3%，比π0（66.7%）绝对提升8.6%，在持续交互任务上尤其显著。
AI.conclusion: MotionWeave通过运动中心未来动态建模有效提升了VLA模型的动作预测性能，代码已开源。

title: UGOD: Uncertainty-Guided Opacity and Dropout for Sparse-View 3D Gaussian Splatting
comment: 31 pages, 5 figures, 10 tables. Supplementary material included at the end of the manuscript
summary: Sparse-view 3D Gaussian Splatting is prone to overfitting because limited observations leave many Gaussian primitives weakly constrained, yet their contributions are still accumulated through alpha blending. Without uncertainty estimation, the renderer cannot distinguish unreliable primitives from well-constrained ones, allowing their erroneous contributions to corrupt novel-view synthesis. We introduce UGOD, an uncertainty-guided framework that estimates a view-dependent uncertainty score for each Gaussian and uses it to regulate its rendering contribution. A lightweight uncertainty head conditioned on Gaussian attributes and viewing direction predicts this score, which then drives a differentiable opacity-modulation mechanism that attenuates high-uncertainty primitives before compositing. During training, a detached soft-dropout branch applies an uncertainty-controlled continuous keep mask to discourage the model from relying on poorly constrained Gaussians and thereby reduce overfitting. Crucially, detaching the uncertainty score prevents gradients from this stochastic regulariser from biasing or collapsing the uncertainty prediction. Experiments on Mip-NeRF~360 and LLFF show that UGOD improves sparse-view novel-view synthesis while producing more compact Gaussian representations than the compared methods. These results demonstrate that Gaussian uncertainty provides an effective rendering-time control for sparse-view reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 UGOD，一种面向稀疏视角 3D Gaussian Splatting 的不确定性引导框架，通过估计每个高斯原语视角相关的不确定性并调节其渲染贡献，缓解过拟合并提升新视角合成质量。
AI.motivation: 稀疏视角下观测不足，许多高斯原语约束较弱，但仍在 alpha blending 中累积贡献；缺乏不确定性估计时，渲染器无法区分可靠与不可靠原语，导致错误贡献破坏新视角合成。
AI.method: 引入轻量不确定性头，基于高斯属性和视角方向预测每个高斯的视角相关不确定性分数；该分数驱动可微不透明度调制机制，在合成前衰减高不确定性原语。训练时使用 detached soft-dropout 分支，以不确定性控制的连续保留掩码减少对弱约束高斯的依赖，并分离不确定性分数梯度以避免正则项偏置或使不确定性预测崩溃。
AI.result: 在 Mip-NeRF 360 和 LLFF 数据集上，UGOD 改善了稀疏视角新视角合成效果，并产生比对比方法更紧凑的高斯表示。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，高斯不确定性可作为渲染时的有效控制信号，用于稀疏视角重建，在提升合成质量的同时减少冗余高斯表示。

title: CATCH: A Controllable Analysis Testbed for Reward Hacking in Coding RL
summary: During reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), large language models (LLMs) can exploit loopholes in their environments to obtain high rewards without improving the intended capabilities, i.e., reward hacking. Despite its risks to training efficiency and safety, monitoring and mitigating reward hacking during training remain challenging, which is limited by a lack of testbeds that reproduce hacking and reliably identify it. We introduce CATCH, a controllable testbed for studying reward hacking in coding RL. CATCH deliberately exposes environmental loopholes and provides execution-based gold labels by comparing success under a vulnerable evaluator with task correctness under an independent audit. It also can control the model's initial hacking tendency through supervised fine-tuning data mixtures and the difficulty of earning rewards through reward designing, enabling systematic comparisons of hacking dynamics and interventions. Experiments show that CATCH can produce diverse RL training trajectories with clear reward hacking, and analyses demonstrate that both initial models and reward difficulties shape the emergence of reward hacking. We further evaluate the effectiveness of different reward hacking detection and mitigation methods. A key finding is that a chain-of-thought monitor initially suppresses hacking, but this protection erodes as the policy model learn to mislead the monitor with code comments. This highlights the need to evaluate hacking mitigations throughout training with CATCH. The source code and resources are publicly released at https://github.com/THUAIS-Lab/CATCH.

AI.tldr: 论文提出CATCH，一个用于研究代码RL中奖励黑客的可控测试平台，能故意暴露环境漏洞并提供基于执行的黄金标签，实验揭示了初始模型与奖励难度对奖励黑客的影响，并评估了检测与缓解方法。
AI.motivation: 在带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）中，LLM可能利用环境漏洞获得高奖励而不提升目标能力，即奖励黑客。这对训练效率和安全构成风险，但缺乏能复现并可靠识别奖励黑客的测试平台，导致训练中的监控与缓解困难。
AI.method: 引入CATCH可控测试平台，故意暴露环境漏洞；通过比较脆弱评估器下的成功与独立审计下的任务正确性，提供基于执行的黄金标签；通过SFT数据混合控制模型初始黑客倾向，通过奖励设计控制获取奖励难度，从而系统比较黑客动态与干预；并评估不同奖励黑客检测与缓解方法。
AI.result: CATCH能产生多样且明显奖励黑客的RL训练轨迹；分析表明初始模型和奖励难度共同塑造奖励黑客的出现；评估了不同检测与缓解方法，关键发现是：思维链监控器初期能抑制黑客，但随着策略模型学会用代码注释误导监控器，这种保护会逐渐侵蚀。
AI.conclusion: 需要在训练全程使用CATCH评估奖励黑客缓解措施；CATCH为研究代码RL中的奖励黑客提供了有效测试平台，源码与资源已公开。

title: MADBench: Benchmarking the Security of Multi-Agent Debate
summary:
Multi-agent debate (MAD) can improve large language model (LLM) reasoning by allowing multiple agents to exchange and critique their answers to the same task. However, the interactions that enable agents to correct mistakes can also spread adversarial errors and steer the agents toward an incorrect answer. Although some efforts have been made to examine particular attack types on MAD, systematic evaluation of MAD under diverse attacks remains limited. A central question is whether debate mitigates adversarial influence or amplifies it.
  In this paper, we present MADBench, a benchmark for evaluating the security of MAD. We organize attacks into a layered taxonomy following the MAD workflow, incorporating both established attacks and new strategies tailored to debate. We evaluate six attack families over 356 source tasks and 3,958 test cases, examining their effects on the final answer and the propagation of adversarial influence. Our results show that, under attacks, MAD does not necessarily improve LLM reasoning. Compared with a single-agent baseline, MAD can mitigate attacks on answer accuracy in question-answering tasks while amplifying unauthorized reads or writes in both question-answering and workspace tasks. Moreover, even when three out of five agents collude, the attack changes the final answer from correct to wrong on only 28.30\% of tasks answered correctly without attack, while only 3.26\% of initially correct honest agents switch to wrong answers during debate.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 MADBench，用于系统评估多智能体辩论（MAD）在多种攻击下的安全性，发现 MAD 并不必然提升 LLM 推理，其安全影响具有两面性：既能缓解部分问答任务中的答案准确率攻击，也会放大未授权读写等风险。
AI.motivation: MAD 可通过多智能体交换与批评提升 LLM 推理，但交互过程也可能传播对抗性错误并将智能体引向错误答案。现有研究多关注特定攻击，缺乏对 MAD 在多样攻击下的系统评估。核心问题是：辩论究竟缓解还是放大了对抗影响。
AI.method: 提出 MADBench 基准；按照 MAD 工作流构建分层攻击分类法，纳入已有攻击和针对辩论的新策略；评估六类攻击家族，覆盖 356 个源任务和 3,958 个测试用例，并分析其对最终答案及对抗影响传播的作用。
AI.result: 在攻击下，MAD 不必然改善 LLM 推理。与单智能体基线相比，MAD 在问答任务中可缓解对答案准确率的攻击，但在问答和工作区任务中会放大未授权读写。此外，即使五分之三的智能体合谋，在无攻击时已正确回答的任务中，攻击也仅使 28.30% 的最终答案由正确变为错误；而最初正确的诚实智能体在辩论中转向错误答案的比例仅为 3.26%。
AI.conclusion: MAD 的安全性影响取决于攻击类型与任务目标，不能简单认为辩论总能提升鲁棒性；它可能同时带来缓解与放大效应。因此需要面向安全的多智能体辩论评估与设计。

title: CamAgent: An LLM-Agent Framework for Multi-Species Camera-Trap Workflows
summary: Camera traps accumulated vast, multidimensional data for wildlife monitoring, yet translating raw media archives into meaningful ecological insights remains highly fragmented. Current research workflows require laboriously stitching together disparate analysis tools and scripts, creating steep programming hurdles and complicating end-to-end spatiotemporal analyses. To overcome this fragmentation, we present CamAgent, an autonomous Large Language Model (LLM) agent framework that integrates camera-trap analytical workflows into a unified intelligent ecosystem. CamAgent interprets natural-language ecological intent, schedules computational routing, and executes specialized tools spanning computer-vision perception (e.g., SpeciesNet), CamtrapDP-compatible data management, detection-corrected occupancy modeling, temporal activity analysis, and species co-occurrence networks. The framework automates multi-stage analytical pipelines while maintaining essential data-quality controls and analytical conventions. Consequently, CamAgent significantly reduces manual programming overhead for conservationists, establishing a transparent, scalable, and fully integrated paradigm for camera-trap ecology. Our project is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/artifact72c6f4.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出CamAgent，一个基于大语言模型的自主智能体框架，将相机陷阱数据分析工作流整合为统一生态系统，以降低编程门槛并支持端到端时空生态分析。
AI.motivation: 相机陷阱积累了大量多维野生动物监测数据，但原始媒体档案转化为生态学见解的过程高度碎片化，现有工作流需要拼接不同分析工具和脚本，编程门槛高，端到端时空分析复杂。
AI.method: CamAgent利用大语言模型理解自然语言生态分析意图，进行任务调度与计算路由，并执行多种专用工具，包括计算机视觉感知（如SpeciesNet）、兼容CamtrapDP的数据管理、检测校正占用建模、时间活动分析和物种共现网络等。
AI.result: 该框架可自动执行多阶段分析流程，同时保持数据质量控制和生态分析规范，显著减少保护工作者的手动编程负担，提供透明、可扩展且完全集成的相机陷阱生态学分析范式。
AI.conclusion: CamAgent为相机陷阱生态学建立了一种统一、自动化且可扩展的分析范式，项目已匿名开源。

title: Do Self-Evolving Skills Generalize to Held-Out Tasks?
summary: AI agents can externalize what they learn from past tasks into reusable \emph{skills}, such as procedures, checklists, code, or other executable artifacts, that can be retrieved and reused when solving new tasks. Self-evolving skill methods keep rewriting these skills after each round of practice on training tasks, and the skill is then used on new tasks of the same kind. We ask a question: does the improvement a skill shows on its training tasks carry over to new test tasks? We test five self-evolving methods and a one-shot skill on six benchmarks, with the same model, the same agent, and the same train/test split for every method. Of the 21 skills that improve on their training tasks, 5 keep all of that improvement on the test tasks, 13 keep part of it, and 3 keep none of it. No existing method is best everywhere. When we read the skills, the ones that carry over badly often fix details that should depend on the task, such as column names and output files, or turn a fix for one failure into a rule for every task. An LLM judge that reads the skill content can often see this: it ranks finished skills the same way the test results do in 86\% of pairs. But it predicts the effect of a single edit poorly, so edits still have to be tested by running them. Based on these findings, we describe Generalizable Skill Optimization (GSO), which keeps only a guide for writing skills and writes a new skill for each task; it scores highest on all six benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文研究AI智能体学到的可复用技能，在训练任务上的提升能否迁移到同类新测试任务，并提出Generalizable Skill Optimization（GSO）方法。
AI.motivation: 自进化技能方法会不断重写技能，并用于同类新任务，但尚不清楚训练任务上的性能提升是否能泛化到测试任务。
AI.method: 在六个基准上，使用相同模型、相同智能体和相同训练/测试划分，比较五种自进化方法与一种一次性技能方法；并分析技能内容，使用LLM judge评估技能质量与单次编辑效果。
AI.result: 在21个训练任务上提升的技能中，5个在测试任务上完全保持提升，13个部分保持，3个完全没有保持；没有方法在所有任务上最优。泛化差的技能常固化任务相关细节或把单次失败修复变成通用规则。LLM judge在86%的技能对中排序与测试结果一致，但难以预测单次编辑效果。
AI.conclusion: 基于这些发现，作者提出GSO：只保留写技能的指南，并为每个任务重新编写技能；该方法在全部六个基准上得分最高。

title: DeCoPrune: Efficient KV-Cache Pruning for Autoregressive Video Diffusion via Denoising Consistency
summary: Autoregressive video diffusion supports streaming generation and interactive control, but its KV cache grows with the generated history. Existing compression strategies discard history using fixed windows or select tokens through local attention and similarity signals, without directly measuring whether a chunk contributes information beyond the retained context. We introduce DeCoPrune, a training-free method that treats cache compression as a denoising-consistency problem. We find that tokens with larger discrepancies between intermediate clean predictions and final denoised values tend to carry visual evidence less predictable from the retained context. DeCoPrune uses this model-intrinsic signal to retain high-discrepancy tokens in the long-term cache while pruning low-discrepancy tokens. To evaluate information retention, we introduce CMBench, comprising 58 approximately one-minute generated or real-world context episodes and 116 Reappear or Revisit continuation tasks requiring recall of earlier events or objects.
