Experiments with LingBot World v2 show that DeCoPrune achieves a DINO score of 0.6701 on a 0-1 scale, with an 85.43% reduction in cumulative historical KV token counts and a 4.14-fold continuation-generation speedup over FullKV. Its head-specialized variant reaches 0.6783 at an 86.19% pruning ratio, approaching FullKV's 0.6803 score and exceeding the evaluated compression baselines at similar budgets. These results indicate that denoising consistency can support long-range information retention while reducing autoregressive inference cost. Our project homepage is https://decoprune.github.io. The code is available at https://github.com/DeCoPrune/CMBench, and the benchmark at https://huggingface.co/datasets/Aoraku/CMBench.

AI.tldr: 提出 DeCoPrune：一种免训练的自回归视频扩散 KV 缓存压缩方法，将缓存压缩视为去噪一致性问题，并发布 CMBench 基准。
AI.motivation: 自回归视频扩散的 KV 缓存随生成历史增长，现有压缩策略多用固定窗口、局部注意力或相似度信号，未直接衡量被丢弃内容是否包含超出保留上下文的信息。
AI.method: DeCoPrune 利用模型内在的去噪一致性信号：中间干净预测与最终去噪值差异大的 token 更可能包含不可由保留上下文预测的视觉证据，因此保留高差异 token、剪除低差异 token。同时提出 CMBench，包含 58 个约一分钟的生成或真实上下文片段和 116 个 Reappear/Revisit 续写任务。
AI.result: 在 LingBot World v2 上，DeCoPrune 达到 0.6701 DINO 分数，累计历史 KV token 减少 85.43%，续写生成相对 FullKV 加速 4.14 倍；其 head-specialized 变体达到 0.6783，剪枝率 86.19%，接近 FullKV 的 0.6803，并在相近预算下超过所评估的压缩基线。
AI.conclusion: 去噪一致性可用于支持长程信息保留，同时降低自回归视频扩散的推理成本。

title: Rep2Skill: Representation-Guided Skill Self-Evolution for LLM Agents
summary: Textual skills enable large language model (LLM) based agents to accumulate reusable procedural knowledge without updating model parameters. Yet existing skill evolution remains largely confined to the text space: an optimizer must diagnose success and failure patterns, and revise skills solely from long execution trajectories and sparse task outcomes. This text-only paradigm leaves the agent's internal representations, which contain rich records of its evolving execution state, outside the skill optimization loop. We ask whether an agent can improve its external textual skills by reflecting on its own internal representations. We introduce Rep2Skill, a representation-guided framework for self-evolution on agent skills. Specifically, upon the collected agent rollouts, Rep2Skill models their internal model representation trajectories to localize turns that deviate from successful execution dynamics, and it further interprets these signals alongside the execution contexts as actionable textual feedback for targeted skill revision. Experiments on two agent environments with two open-source LLMs show that Rep2Skill consistently outperforms text-only approaches in the self-evolution setting, where the same LLM serves as both executor and optimizer without a stronger external model. This establishes a promising direction moving agent self-improvement beyond text-only reflection.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Rep2Skill，利用智能体内部表示轨迹指导文本技能的自我进化，并在多个环境与开源 LLM 上优于纯文本反思方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的智能体技能进化主要局限于文本空间，优化器只能从长执行轨迹和稀疏任务结果中诊断成功与失败并修改技能，忽略了包含丰富执行状态信息的内部表示。
AI.method: Rep2Skill 收集智能体 rollout，对其内部模型表示轨迹进行建模，定位偏离成功执行动态的轮次，并结合执行上下文将这些信号解释为可操作的文本反馈，用于针对性技能修订。
AI.result: 在两个智能体环境和两个开源 LLM 上，Rep2Skill 在自我进化设置中持续优于纯文本方法；该设置中同一 LLM 同时作为执行者与优化器，且不使用更强外部模型。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，将智能体自我改进从纯文本反思扩展到内部表示引导是一个有前景的方向。

title: Beyond the Current Scene: Event-Referential Grasping with Active View Selection
summary: A robot that observes people interacting with objects should be able to carry out later requests that refer back to those interactions. Such requests may specify a grasp target by the role it played in a past event rather than by its name or appearance. Moreover, the target may no longer be visible when the robot is asked to act. We present BeyondSCe, a zero-shot robotic grasping system for this event-referential setting. Given the event history and the current scene, the system identifies the requested object or part and localizes it for grasping. If the target is occluded, it combines an event prior recovered from the history with current scene geometry to select camera viewpoints likely to reveal the target. The system uses pretrained models without additional task-specific training. In real-robot experiments with a single wrist-mounted RGB-D camera, it achieves grasp success rates of 76% and 77% for initially visible and occluded targets, respectively, compared with 40% and 55% for the strongest baseline in each condition. On four additional scenes with heavy occlusion, it increases grasp success rates from 75% to 95% while reducing the mean number of views from 3.35 to 2.20, compared with an active-perception baseline given the target's ground-truth 3D bounding box.

AI.tldr: 提出零样本机器人抓取系统BeyondSCe，能根据过去事件中物体所扮演的角色进行指代抓取，并处理目标被遮挡的情况。
AI.motivation: 机器人需要理解并响应人们过去与物体交互后提出的请求，这类请求基于事件角色而非名称或外观，且目标在请求时可能已不可见。
AI.method: 利用事件历史和当前场景，识别并定位目标物体或部件；若目标被遮挡，结合事件先验与当前场景几何选择可能揭示目标的相机视角；使用预训练模型，无需任务特定训练。
AI.result: 真实机器人单腕部RGB-D相机实验中，初始可见和遮挡目标抓取成功率分别为76%和77%，基线为40%和55%；在四个严重遮挡场景中，成功率从75%提升至95%，平均视角数从3.35降至2.20。
AI.conclusion: BeyondSCe能有效处理事件指代与遮挡下的零样本抓取，性能优于基线。

title: Compact Language, Complex Model Shifts: How and Where Ambiguity and Underspecification Affect LLMs
comment: To appear in Proceedings of BlackBoxNLP 2026
summary: We analyze how lexical ambiguity and underspecification affect language model training. We create artificial homonyms and artificial hypernyms as pseudowords and analyze the generative performance of language models as they are trained with increasing amounts of these ambiguous or underspecified pseudoword types. We further analyze whether the models disambiguate ambiguous or underspecified statements and provide a first mechanistic account of how ambiguity and disambiguation are represented internally. Our main results show that both ambiguity and underspecification increase model performance in ways that scale with their influence on the language's type-token ratio. However, the accuracy of generating sequences containing ambiguous words or their synonyms decreases compared to other texts. We also show that internal representations of pseudowords reflect disambiguation of pseudo-homonyms, but underspecification of pseudo-hypernyms is maintained during the generative process.

AI.tldr: 本文研究词汇歧义与 underspecification 对语言模型训练的影响，通过构造人工同形异义词和人工上位词作为伪词，分析模型生成表现、消歧能力及内部表示机制。
AI.motivation: 探究词汇歧义和语义 underspecification 如何影响语言模型训练，以及模型是否能在生成过程中消歧，并理解其内部表示机制。
AI.method: 构造人工 homonyms 和 artificial hypernyms 作为 pseudowords，用不同数量的歧义或 underspecified 伪词类型训练语言模型，评估生成性能，并分析模型是否对歧义/underspecified 语句进行消歧，同时提供初步机制性解释。
AI.result: 歧义和 underspecification 都会提升模型性能，且提升程度与它们对语言 type-token ratio 的影响成比例；但生成包含歧义词或其同义词的序列时准确率下降。内部表示显示，伪同形异义词会被消歧，而伪上位词的 underspecification 在生成过程中得以保持。
AI.conclusion: 词汇歧义与 underspecification 对语言模型训练具有复杂影响：一方面可通过改变 type-token ratio 提升整体性能，另一方面会降低含歧义内容的生成准确性；模型对 homonymy 和 hypernymy 的处理方式不同，前者倾向于消歧，后者则保持 underspecified 表示。

title: Thinking Outside the Box: Can Language Models Rely on External Guidance Selectively?
summary: Agent harnesses often improve language models with human-designed workflows, but as models grow more capable, unreliable guidance can increasingly constrain their execution. We call the ability to benefit from useful guidance while overriding unreliable guidance thinking outside the box. We introduce Box$^2$-Bench, which holds the model and task fixed while varying workflow reliability to isolate how models regulate their reliance on guidance. On Box$^2$-Bench, frontier models often benefit from reliable guidance but remain vulnerable when it is misleading or becomes unreliable. To test whether this capability can be learned, we train two open-weight models using bad workflows, reserving good workflows for evaluation. We explore two complementary training strategies: counterfactual supervised fine-tuning improves robustness, while outcome-based reinforcement learning can shift the balance toward greater use of helpful workflows. We further find that this behavior extends beyond workflows to other forms of external information, improving peer correction and robustness to corrupted memory. Together, our results identify selective reliance on fallible external information as a dimension of agent reliability not captured by task performance alone.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Box²-Bench基准，研究模型如何在利用有用指导的同时忽略不可靠指导，即“跳出框框思考”。发现前沿模型易受误导，通过训练可提升选择性依赖外部信息的能力。
AI.motivation: Agent harnesses常用人类设计的工作流提升语言模型，但随着模型能力增强，不可靠的指导可能限制其执行。因此需要研究模型如何调节对指导的依赖，以提升代理可靠性。
AI.method: 提出Box²-Bench，固定模型和任务，变化工作流可靠性；训练两个开源模型，用坏工作流训练、好工作流评估；采用反事实监督微调和基于结果的强化学习；并测试行为是否扩展到其他外部信息形式，如同伴纠正和损坏记忆。
AI.result: 前沿模型在可靠指导下受益，但在误导或不可靠时脆弱；反事实SFT提升鲁棒性，结果RL可增加对有用工作流的使用；行为可扩展到其他外部信息，提升同伴纠正和记忆鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 选择性依赖易错外部信息是代理可靠性的一个维度，任务性能本身无法捕捉。

title: Beyond Local Linearity: Scale-Resolved Geometry of Learned Image Encoders
comment: Extended abstract, NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Symmetry and Geometry in Neural Representations (NeurReps). 14 pages, 5 figures
summary: Understanding how learned representations respond to finite input changes is important for characterizing their sensitivity, invariances, and robustness. Yet existing geometric analyses are predominantly local and describe only infinitesimal perturbations. We introduce a scale-resolved statistic that compares an encoder's measured feature displacement with its local linear prediction as the perturbation magnitude increases. Across diverse image encoders, we discover a characteristic plateau-rise-peak-decay profile, which we call the bump. The bump is absent at initialization, emerges early during standard training, and does not form under randomized labels or random-noise inputs. Its shape also varies with the training distribution and robustness objective. These results establish departures from local geometry as a signature of how encoder representations are shaped by learning.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种尺度分辨的统计量，用于比较编码器特征位移与局部线性预测，发现学习到的图像编码器呈现‘平台-上升-峰值-衰减’的 bump 特征。
AI.motivation: 现有对学习表示几何的分析多局限于局部无穷小扰动，无法刻画有限输入变化下的敏感性、不变性和鲁棒性。
AI.method: 引入尺度分辨统计量，随扰动幅度增加比较编码器实际特征位移与局部线性预测；并在多种图像编码器、初始化、训练阶段和不同训练分布/鲁棒性目标下分析该统计量。
AI.result: 在多种图像编码器中发现特征性的 bump 曲线；该现象在初始化时不存在，标准训练早期出现，随机标签或随机噪声输入下不形成；其形状随训练分布和鲁棒性目标变化。
AI.conclusion: 偏离局部几何的尺度分辨行为可作为学习如何塑造编码器表示的一个标志性特征。

title: RoboAssist: Interactive Human-Humanoid Planning for Long-Horizon Surgical Assistance
summary: Long-horizon surgical assistance requires humanoid robots to coordinate with evolving human activities while maintaining safety across planning and execution. We present RoboAssist, an agent-based framework for interactive human-humanoid planning that integrates workflow reasoning, task coordination, and cross-layer safety. At its core is an asymmetric dual-track representation that separates partially observed human process states from executable robot task sequences. By updating human-process estimates, scene context, and task dependencies online, RoboAssist revalidates the remaining task sequence and replans only the affected suffix when workflow requests change. A cross-layer safety architecture combines preventive navigation regulation, reactive regulation during close-range handover, and independent whole-body runtime supervision. This design couples online task coordination with safety constraints throughout execution. We demonstrate the framework on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot in long-horizon, multi-stage simulated surgical assistance scenarios encompassing multimodal interaction, instrument handling, medical material transport, navigation, and safe human-robot handover. Experiments show multi-stage task completion and adaptation to workflow-request changes. A targeted full-replanning ablation shows that residual replanning reduces plan-update latency and post-update token usage. Separate safety experiments demonstrate complementary protection across navigation, handover, and runtime supervision. Additional results and demonstrations are available online at https://roboassist.github.io.

AI.tldr: 提出RoboAssist，一个基于代理的人-人形机器人交互规划框架，用于长时程手术辅助，集成工作流推理、任务协调和跨层安全。核心是非对称双轨表示，分离人类过程状态与机器人任务序列。在Unitree G1上验证了多阶段任务完成、适应工作流变化，以及残余重规划降低延迟和token消耗，安全机制互补。
AI.motivation: 长时程手术辅助要求人形机器人与不断变化的人类活动协调，并在规划与执行中保持安全。
AI.method: 采用基于代理的框架，集成工作流推理、任务协调和跨层安全。非对称双轨表示分离部分可观测的人类过程状态和可执行机器人任务序列；在线更新人类过程估计、场景上下文和任务依赖，重新验证剩余任务序列，当工作流请求变化时仅重规划受影响的后缀。跨层安全架构结合预防性导航调节、近距离交接的反应性调节和独立全身运行时监督。
AI.result: 在Unitree G1人形机器人上于长时程多阶段模拟手术辅助场景中验证，涵盖多模态交互、器械处理、医疗物资运输、导航和安全人机交接。实验显示多阶段任务完成和对工作流请求变化的适应。消融表明残余重规划比完全重规划降低计划更新延迟和后更新token使用。安全实验显示导航、交接和运行时监督的互补保护。
AI.conclusion: RoboAssist能有效支持交互式人-人形机器人规划，实现高效重规划和分层安全，适用于长时程手术辅助场景。

title: UniWAM Technical Report: Unified Mobile Manipulation via Mixed-Stream World-Action Modeling and Manipulation Anchor Pose Supervision
summary: Mobile manipulation requires precise navigation to a manipulation-ready pose followed by reliable object interaction. These two stages differ in action spaces and visual requirements, which complicates unified policy learning. In addition, collecting diverse real-world navigation data with explicit manipulation-ready pose supervision remains costly and difficult to scale. We introduce UniWAM, a unified mixed-stream world-action model with separate action encoders and output heads for navigation and manipulation, sharing a common backbone. This design supports joint representation learning on independently sampled navigation and manipulation data. UniWAM supports independent inference for either stream and batch-parallel inference for both. We further introduce Manipulation Anchor Pose (MAP) supervision for where to stop and how to orient for manipulation. An automated pipeline constructs MAP-Data from large-scale 3D scenes, yielding over 1.5 million episodes and 7,500 hours. MAP-Data provides per-frame target-object bounding boxes and image-plane MAP coordinates as auxiliary navigation supervision. Together with projected end-effector trajectories for manipulation, these prediction targets provide stream-specific image-plane supervision for action learning from egocentric observations. With large-scale MAP-Data, UniWAM outperforms the strongest external baselines on our MAP-Bench by 30.1\% in position error and 44.0\% in heading error. Across 24 real-robot tasks, UniWAM achieves leading results in MAP navigation and mobile manipulation, with competitive manipulation performance. We have released code, data, and benchmark.

AI.tldr: 提出UniWAM统一混合流世界-动作模型，用于移动操作中的导航与操作联合学习，并引入MAP监督和大规模MAP-Data数据集，在基准与真实机器人任务上取得领先效果。
AI.motivation: 移动操作需先精确导航至可操作位姿，再进行可靠物体交互；两阶段动作空间和视觉需求不同，统一策略学习困难。同时，带明确可操作位姿监督的真实世界导航数据采集成本高、难以扩展。
AI.method: UniWAM采用共享主干、导航与操作独立动作编码器和输出头，支持独立采样数据联合表示学习，并支持单流独立推理和双流批并行推理。提出Manipulation Anchor Pose (MAP)监督，即在哪里停、如何朝向。通过自动化流水线从大规模3D场景构建MAP-Data，含超150万episodes、7500小时，提供逐帧目标物体框和图像平面MAP坐标作为导航辅助监督，并结合投影末端执行器轨迹用于操作。
AI.result: 在大规模MAP-Data上，UniWAM在MAP-Bench上比最强外部基线位置误差降低30.1%、朝向误差降低44.0%。在24个真实机器人任务中，UniWAM在MAP导航和移动操作上取得领先结果，操作性能具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: UniWAM通过统一混合流架构、MAP监督和大规模自动构建数据，有效提升移动操作中导航与操作联合学习性能，并已发布代码、数据和基准。

title: Reinforcing Multimodal Reasoning via Token-Level Perception-Grounded Advantage Estimation
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has improved the reasoning capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), yet existing frameworks rely on coarse, sequence-level reward signals that lack the fine-grained supervision over the visually-grounded steps within a multimodal reasoning chain. We investigate this gap through the lens of two token-level metrics: visual dependency (i.e. how much a token's prediction relies on the input image features) and predictive entropy. Our empirical analysis reveals two key findings: (1) correct reasoning chains exhibit a markedly sharper entropy reduction as visual grounding intensifies, compared to incorrect ones; (2) pivotal tokens, those whose misprediction triggers reasoning collapse, are statistical outliers in the joint distribution of visual dependency and predictive entropy derived from correct chains. Motivated by these findings, we propose token-level perception-grounded advantage estimation (TPAE), which estimates token-level advantages by measuring each token's statistical consistency with the vision-entropy patterns of correct rollouts. TPAE leverages this granular score to modulate the sequence-level advantage, producing a fine-grained supervision signal that can be integrated into various RLVR frameworks. Extensive experiments on seven benchmarks show that TPAE consistently outperforms leading strong baselines, yielding more stable and efficient optimization for multimodal reasoning. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/Zhihan72/TPAE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 token 级感知接地优势估计（TPAE），通过视觉依赖性与预测熵两个 token 级指标，为多模态推理的 RLVR 提供细粒度监督，并在七个基准上取得优于强基线且更稳定高效的优化效果。
AI.motivation: 现有 RLVR 框架多依赖粗粒度的序列级奖励，无法对多模态推理链中与视觉接地相关的关键步骤进行细粒度监督。
AI.method: 通过 token 级视觉依赖性和预测熵进行实证分析，发现正确推理链随视觉接地增强而熵下降更明显，且关键 token 在正确链的视觉依赖性-预测熵联合分布中是统计离群点。基于此提出 TPAE：衡量每个 token 与正确 rollout 的视觉-熵模式的一致性，得到 token 级优势并用于调制序列级优势，可集成到多种 RLVR 框架。
AI.result: 在七个基准上的大量实验表明，TPAE 持续优于领先强基线，并为多模态推理带来更稳定、更高效的优化。
AI.conclusion: TPAE 能提供细粒度监督信号，有效提升多模态推理中的 RLVR 性能，代码已公开。

title: Marginal Response Surface Elicitation for Zero-Label Tabular Learning
summary: Tabular learning uses structured data to predict target outcomes. Traditionally, this process has relied on labeled data. However, large language models (LLMs) can be used to elicit domain priors based on the task description and feature semantics, thereby enabling predictions without labeled data. We propose Marginal Response Surface Elicitation (MARS), a method that transforms feature-level LLM priors into a reusable, zero-shot tabular classifier. To construct this classifier, MARS selects representative values for each feature from unlabeled data and prompts the LLM to provide corresponding class support scores and feature weights. It then aggregates multiple responses using the median to construct feature response functions, and makes predictions through their weighted sum without further LLM queries. Across eight tabular benchmark tasks, MARS achieves the highest average AUC and AP, outperforming direct prompting by 1.97 and 6.21 percentage points respectively, while substantially reducing end-to-end costs. Evaluations with LLMs of different sizes further demonstrate its predictive advantage over direct prompting.

AI.tldr: 提出MARS方法，将大语言模型的特征级先验转化为可复用的零样本表格分类器，在多个表格基准任务上取得优于直接提示的预测性能并降低成本。
AI.motivation: 传统表格学习依赖标注数据，而无标注场景下预测困难；大语言模型可基于任务描述和特征语义提供领域先验，因此有望实现无需标注数据的零样本表格预测。
AI.method: MARS从无标注数据中为每个特征选择代表值，提示LLM输出类别支持分数和特征权重；随后用中位数聚合多次响应，构建特征响应函数，并通过加权求和进行预测，无需进一步查询LLM。
AI.result: 在八个表格基准任务上，MARS取得了最高的平均AUC和AP，分别比直接提示高出1.97和6.21个百分点，同时大幅降低端到端成本；不同规模LLM的评估也显示其预测优势。
AI.conclusion: MARS能有效将LLM先验转化为可复用的零样本表格分类器，在无标注数据下优于直接提示，并具备成本优势和跨模型规模稳健性。

title: Is This Evidence Decision-Critical? Learning to Verify Rule-Governed Decisions
summary: Rule-based reasoning, as in eligibility checks and contract reviews, requires language models to assess evidence against individual conditions and combine their judgments under explicit rules. Errors in evidence assessment can leave a decision unchanged, but misinterpreting or overlooking decision-critical evidence can reverse it. Identifying such evidence allows more capable models to focus on checking the corresponding condition judgments, supporting accurate and safe decisions. Recognizing the evidence's criticality requires understanding how evidence affects a condition judgment and how that judgment affects the decision. To achieve the goal, we propose a INTERvention-based imPACT learning framework (InterPact), which enables counterfactual verification of evidence criticality in rule-governed decisions. Specifically, its evidence intervention constructor generates training pairs for a propagation verifier by editing case facts with a frozen language model while holding rules and non-target conditions fixed. Human-reviewed labels record the resulting condition and decision changes, while complete state-to-decision mappings supervise consequences beyond the observed edit. During training, the verifier weights learned conditional decision predictions by evidence-based condition probabilities through a fixed composition operation, propagating decision-change supervision into the base model. At inference, the trained base model directly judges criticality from the original case and target evidence, without human or stronger-model supervision. On single-case evidence criticality verification over adapted rule-governed decision cases, InterPact achieves 68.28% accuracy, outperforming all six baselines. These results support learned decision sensitivity as a basis for prioritizing evidence checks.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 InterPact 框架，用于在规则驱动的决策中通过反事实干预验证证据的关键性，帮助语言模型识别会影响最终决定的关键证据，从而支持准确且安全的判断。
AI.motivation: 在资格审核、合同审查等规则推理场景中，语言模型需要依据证据判断各个条件并按规则组合决策。普通证据判断错误可能不改变结论，但若误解或忽略决定关键性证据，则可能导致决策逆转，因此需要识别关键证据，让更强模型重点核查相应条件判断。
AI.method: 提出基于干预的影响学习框架 InterPact。其证据干预构造器用冻结语言模型编辑案件事实，同时固定规则和非目标条件，生成传播验证器的训练对；人工审核标签记录条件与决策变化，完整状态到决策映射监督超出观测编辑的后果。训练时，验证器通过固定组合操作，用基于证据的条件概率加权条件决策预测，将决策变化监督传播到基础模型。推理时，训练后的基础模型直接从原始案件和目标证据判断关键性，无需人工或更强模型监督。
AI.result: 在适配的规则驱动决策案例上，InterPact 在单案例证据关键性验证任务中达到 68.28% 准确率，优于全部六个基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，学习到的决策敏感性可以作为优先进行证据核查的依据，有助于提升规则驱动决策中证据关键性识别的效果。

title: GRC-Pose: Generation-Reconstruction Correspondence for Prior-Free 6D Object Pose Tracking
summary: Prior-free 6D object pose tracking seeks to recover the trajectory of an unseen object from a single RGB video without object-specific CAD models, posed reference images, or pose annotations. Geometric foundation models provide complementary object-centric and scene-centric cues, yet SAM3D CAD is indexed by an arbitrary object-local surface parameterization, whereas reconstructed evidence is expressed in a sequence-specific world frame with partial surface coverage. To exploit this complementarity, we formulate tracking as generation-reconstruction correspondence and introduce GRC-Pose, a correspondence-based framework that combines learned correspondence prediction with robust pose estimation. Concretely, GeoCorr-Matcher estimates weighted object-scene correspondences and per-match uncertainty for each pose candidate. FGH-Solver integrates these matches through multiple robust geometric estimators and sequence-level posterior inference, while a posterior-gated memory retains only inlier-supported observations through occlusion and viewpoint change. Extensive evaluation shows that with SAM3D CAD, GRC-Pose achieves state-of-the-art Average Recall and motion retention on HOT3D, improving the latter by 58% over prior art. On classical benchmarks including YCBInEOAT and LINEMOD, it remains highly competitive.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GRC-Pose，一种无需先验的6D物体位姿跟踪框架，通过生成-重建对应关系，结合学习到的对应预测与鲁棒位姿估计，在无CAD模型、参考图像或位姿标注条件下从单目RGB视频跟踪未见物体。
AI.motivation: 现有无需先验的6D位姿跟踪难以利用几何基础模型提供的互补线索：SAM3D CAD使用任意物体局部表面参数化，而重建证据位于序列相关的世界坐标系且表面覆盖不完整。需要一种方法弥合二者差异，实现无先验的鲁棒跟踪。
AI.method: 将跟踪建模为生成-重建对应问题，提出GRC-Pose。GeoCorr-Matcher估计加权物体-场景对应及每个位姿候选的匹配不确定性；FGH-Solver通过多种鲁棒几何估计器和序列级后验推断整合匹配；后验门控记忆仅保留内点支持的观测，以应对遮挡和视角变化。
AI.result: 结合SAM3D CAD，GRC-Pose在HOT3D上取得最优平均召回率和运动保持率，后者较先前方法提升58%；在YCBInEOAT和LINEMOD等经典基准上仍具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: GRC-Pose通过生成-重建对应有效利用几何基础模型的互补信息，实现了无需物体先验的鲁棒6D位姿跟踪，并在多个基准上达到领先或竞争性性能。

title: IronMind: Scaling Humanoid Dexterous Manipulation via Camera-Space Ego-Centric Pretraining
summary: Egocentric human video offers a scalable data source for dexterous manipulation, yet using it to train humanoid robots presents two challenges: (1) an embodiment gap, as human hands differ structurally from robot end-effectors and low-cost egocentric recordings lack the torso kinematics required by conventional retargeting; and (2) heterogeneous data quality, including noisy hand-pose tracking and weakly aligned text annotations. We introduce IronMind, a vision-language-action (VLA) model that uses egocentric human video and heterogeneous robot data to pretrain policies for humanoid dexterous manipulation. To bridge the embodiment gap, IronMind bypasses explicit body-retargeting by using a camera-space action representation, the native reference space of egocentric video, and semantically aligning robot and human action dimensions. Across total pretraining budgets from 250 to 10,000 hours, validation loss decreases approximately log-linearly with data scale. Larger pretraining budgets also improve out-of-distribution real-robot manipulation after post-training: across six challenging tasks with unseen objects, affordances, and reasoning prompts, the 10,000-hour model achieves a 55.0% success rate, compared with at most 11.7% for every pretraining budget up to 5,000 hours and 5.0% without pretraining. At the same pretraining budget, the camera-space action representation also outperforms the torso-frame baseline. Together, these findings support pretraining with a camera-space action representation on large-scale human egocentric data as a scalable foundation for humanoid robot manipulation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 IronMind，一种视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，利用第一人称人类视频和异构机器人数据预训练人形机器人灵巧操作策略。该方法采用相机空间动作表示绕过身体重定向，预训练规模从250到10000小时，验证损失随数据量近似对数线性下降；10000小时模型在六项挑战性真实机器人任务上达到55.0%成功率。
AI.motivation: 第一人称人类视频是灵巧操作的可扩展数据源，但用于人形机器人训练存在两个挑战：一是人类手与机器人末端执行器结构不同，且低成本第一人称录制缺少传统重定向所需的躯干运动学，造成具身差距；二是数据质量异构，包括手部姿态跟踪噪声和文本标注弱对齐。
AI.method: 提出 IronMind，一个 VLA 模型，使用第一人称人类视频和异构机器人数据预训练人形机器人灵巧操作策略。为弥合具身差距，IronMind 不进行显式身体重定向，而是采用相机空间动作表示，即第一人称视频的原生参考空间，并在语义上对齐机器人与人类的动作维度。
AI.result: 在250到10000小时的总预训练预算范围内，验证损失随数据规模近似对数线性下降。更大预训练预算提升后训练后的分布外真实机器人操作表现：在六项具有未见物体、可供性和推理提示的挑战性任务中，10000小时模型成功率为55.0%，而所有不超过5000小时的预训练预算最高仅为11.7%，无预训练为5.0%。相同预训练预算下，相机空间动作表示也优于躯干坐标系基线。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现支持使用相机空间动作表示，在大规模人类第一人称数据上进行预训练，作为人形机器人操作的可扩展基础。

title: Learning Process Rewards via Reasoning State Propagation
summary: Process reward models (PRMs) have demonstrated notable effectiveness in test-time scaling and reinforcement learning by providing fine-grained signals for evaluating intermediate reasoning states, but their training relies heavily on costly process annotations. A natural way to alleviate this dependence is to complement limited process supervision with scalable outcome supervision. However, existing PRMs often model reasoning prefixes independently, providing no explicit mechanism for effectively using final outcome to guide the learning of intermediate reasoning states. We introduce Reasoning State Propagation (RSP), which represents each reasoning prefix with a binary validity state and models transitions between successive states across the reasoning trajectory. Specifically, RSP predicts a break probability that a valid state becomes invalid and a repair probability that an invalid state returns to valid. By propagating these transitions, RSP connects intermediate states to the final state, allowing process annotations to supervise intermediate states while outcome labels supervise the final state and can provide learning signals to preceding steps. Across reasoning search, response selection, and reinforcement learning, RSP consistently outperforms representative PRM baselines, with average improvements over Qwen2.5-Math-PRM of 5.6% in beam search and 2.1% in reinforcement learning.

AI.tldr: 论文提出推理状态传播（RSP），将推理前缀建模为有效/无效二值状态，并学习状态间的破坏与修复转移，从而用结果监督辅助过程监督训练过程奖励模型。
AI.motivation: 过程奖励模型（PRM）能提供细粒度中间推理信号，但依赖昂贵的过程标注；现有PRM通常独立建模推理前缀，缺乏利用最终结果指导中间状态学习的显式机制。
AI.method: RSP为每个推理前缀引入二值有效性状态，建模相邻状态转移：预测有效变无效的破坏概率和无效恢复有效的修复概率；通过转移传播将中间状态与最终状态连接，使过程标注监督中间状态，结果标签监督最终状态并反向提供学习信号。
AI.result: 在推理搜索、响应选择和强化学习中，RSP一致优于代表性PRM基线；相比Qwen2.5-Math-PRM，在束搜索中平均提升5.6%，在强化学习中平均提升2.1%。
AI.conclusion: RSP通过显式建模推理状态转移，有效结合有限过程监督与可扩展结果监督，提升PRM在测试时扩展和强化学习中的性能。

title: Is Better Teacher Supervision Enough? Unlocking Student-side Learning in Multimodal On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) improves reasoning by providing token-level supervision from a teacher on a student's own trajectories. Existing methods primarily focus on enhancing this teacher-side guidance (e.g., by enriching teacher inputs and refining teacher feedback), yet we find that limited student perception is another critical bottleneck in multimodal OPD. By providing oracle visual facts, the performance of OPD-trained students can still be substantially improved for both weak and strong teachers. To address this bottleneck, we propose S-OPD, a simple multimodal on-policy distillation framework that explicitly strengthens student perceptual learning through two objectives. Specifically, Teacher-calibrated Policy Contrast separates student policies under original and masked images with teacher-based token-level gating, strengthening the student's reliance on visual evidence during reasoning. Policy Agreement aligns student policies under original and noise-perturbed images, further improving perceptual robustness to visual noise. Notably, our method can be seamlessly plugged into existing OPD frameworks, requiring no additional data annotations, model parameters or inference operations. Extensive experiments on eight benchmarks across student scales and distillation paradigms demonstrate consistent performance improvements, with gains of up to 4.25 points on LogicVista. When combined with existing teacher-side supervision methods, our method can yield further gains. Code is available at https://github.com/Sirilaw/S-OPD.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现多模态在线策略蒸馏（OPD）中学生感知能力不足是另一个关键瓶颈，提出了S-OPD框架，通过两个目标强化学生感知学习，在八个基准上取得一致提升。
AI.motivation: 现有OPD方法主要关注教师端监督的增强（如丰富教师输入、优化教师反馈），但作者发现学生端感知能力有限同样是多模态OPD的关键瓶颈。即使提供 oracle 视觉事实，弱教师和强教师训练的学生性能仍能显著提升。
AI.method: 提出S-OPD，一个简单的多模态在线策略蒸馏框架，包含两个目标：1）教师校准的策略对比（Teacher-calibrated Policy Contrast）：在原始图像和掩码图像下，利用教师token级门控分离学生策略，增强学生对视觉证据的依赖；2）策略一致性（Policy Agreement）：对齐原始图像和噪声扰动图像下的学生策略，提升对视觉噪声的感知鲁棒性。该方法可无缝插入现有OPD框架，无需额外数据标注、模型参数或推理操作。
AI.result: 在八个基准上，跨学生规模和蒸馏范式进行大量实验，性能一致提升，在LogicVista上最高提升4.25分。与现有教师端监督方法结合可进一步提升。
AI.conclusion: 学生感知学习是多模态在线策略蒸馏中被忽视的瓶颈，S-OPD通过强化学生感知有效提升推理性能，且易于集成，无需额外开销。

title: Beyond the Remembered World: Predictive 4D Belief for Persistent Navigation in Evolving Worlds
summary: Persistent spatial memory enables embodied agents to navigate familiar environments across repeated visits. However, targets may move while unobserved, including during navigation, making remembered locations unreliable by the time an agent arrives. Despite advances in memory retrieval and state prediction, accounting for continued hidden world evolution and revising beliefs under limited visibility remain challenging. We study Evolving-World Navigation, where agents infer target locations from intermittent observations, predict their states at inspection time, and revise beliefs using visual evidence. We propose EvolvingNav, which constructs a time-indexed belief from timestamped 3D object histories through a structured persistence-relocation model. The belief distinguishes persistence at the last observed location from relocation to alternative locations and retains probability mass outside the known candidate set. An event-driven filter propagates the current belief as time elapses, forecasts target occupancy at candidate inspection times, and incorporates new RGB-D evidence. Negative observations downweight location hypotheses according to calibrated, visibility-conditioned detection probabilities, while evidence tracking prevents repeated use of the same observations. A frozen, zero-shot vision-language controller uses the updated belief to choose actions and replan. We further introduce EvoWorld-Bench, a benchmark grounded in human activity traces, comprising 54 scenes and 803,680 tasks with controlled changes before and during navigation. In simulation and real-robot experiments, EvolvingNav improves navigation success and search efficiency over the evaluated baselines. Paired experiments show the clearest gains under learnable temporal patterns, while ablations demonstrate the value of preserving uncertainty and incorporating visibility-aware evidence.

AI.tldr: 论文研究动态世界中的具身导航，提出 EvolvingNav，通过时间索引的概率信念与事件驱动滤波，在目标可能移动且间歇可见时预测并修正目标位置。
AI.motivation: 记忆位置在到达时可能已失效：目标会在未被观察时移动，包括导航过程中。现有记忆检索和状态预测方法难以处理隐藏世界持续演化及有限可见度下的信念修正。
AI.method: 构建基于带时间戳3D物体历史的持久-迁移结构化模型，形成时间索引信念；区分目标停留在最后观测位置与迁移到其他位置，并保留候选集外概率。事件驱动滤波器随时间传播信念，预测候选检查时刻的目标占据，融合RGB-D证据；负观测依可见度条件检测概率降低假设权重，证据跟踪避免重复使用。冻结零样本视觉语言控制器根据更新信念选动作并重规划。同时提出基于人类活动轨迹的 EvoWorld-Bench，含54场景、803,680任务。
AI.result: 在仿真和真实机器人实验中，EvolvingNav 相比基线提升导航成功率与搜索效率；配对实验显示在可学习时间模式上增益最明显；消融表明保留不确定性和可见度感知证据有价值。
AI.conclusion: 面对目标可能移动的动态世界，维护时间索引且保留不确定性的信念、结合可见度感知证据进行滤波，可有效支撑具身导航与重规划。EvoWorld-Bench 为该问题提供评测基准。

title: Discrete Forcing: Infusing Discrete Guidance into Continuous Denoising for Few-Step Action Experts
summary: Efficient action generation in vision-language-action (VLA) models requires capturing both coarse action structure and fine-grained details. Discrete action tokens provide compact structural representations but sacrifice precision, while continuous action tokens offer high precision but often require multiple denoising steps. We introduce Discrete Forcing, a flow-matching framework that combines these representations through an explicit coarse-to-fine generation process. It first predicts discrete action tokens to establish a coarse action structure, then uses them to guide continuous action refinement. The discrete and continuous components share a common diffusion transformer backbone with specialized branches, maintaining a parameter count comparable to a conventional single-branch model while requiring only one forward pass per branch. Extensive evaluations across multiple benchmarks demonstrate improved performance and faster inference over a parameter-matched continuous action expert, with consistent performance gains as model capacity increases. Real-world experiments further demonstrate improvements on high-precision and dynamic manipulation tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出 Discrete Forcing，一种通过显式粗到细生成过程结合离散与连续动作表示的 flow-matching 框架，用于高效且高精度的 VLA 动作生成。
AI.motivation: VLA 模型中，离散动作 token 结构紧凑但精度不足，连续动作 token 精度高但通常需要多步去噪，因此需要兼顾粗动作结构与细粒度细节的高效生成方法。
AI.method: 先预测离散动作 token 以建立粗动作结构，再用其引导连续动作精修；离散与连续组件共享 diffusion transformer 主干并设置专用分支，参数量与常规单分支模型相当，每个分支仅需一次前向。
AI.result: 在多个基准上优于参数量匹配的连续动作专家，推理更快，并随模型容量增加获得持续性能提升；真实世界高精度与动态操作任务也表现改进。
AI.conclusion: Discrete Forcing 通过粗到细生成统一离散与连续动作表示，在保持参数效率的同时提升动作生成性能与推理速度。

title: Zero-Compute Cross-Lingual Transferability Estimation Using Typological Feature Proxies
comment: 4 pages, NeurIPS workshop, Linguistic Principles for Foundation Models, lp4fm
summary: Cross-lingual transfer describes how knowledge in a source language benefits a target language. Measuring it quantitatively requires broad multilingual pre-training, as prior work has done with cross-lingual transfer matrices. We ask whether transfer is predictable from freely available typological features, and whether the prominence of high-resource source languages reflects typology or data quality and quantity. We show that typological databases contain cheap and dense signals about cross-lingual transfer. Our typology-only random forest on a 24-language prior-work transfer matrix scores leave-one-language-out $ρ{=}0.705$ and $R^2{=}0.49$, beating a non-typological control at $ρ{=}0.62$, which verifies the ability of typology-only predictions to reconstruct costly measured cross-lingual transfer. The signal survives leave-one-script-out and leave-one-family-out protocols, so script and family confounding do not explain the effect. By decomposing the transfer into a typology term and a resource-and-script bias term, we find the best-source ranking sensitive to this bias. In contrast, typology is not affected by this bias, which makes it a zero-compute screening tool that replaces hundreds of training runs with a model fit. Our code is available \href{https://github.com/dharmsen/typo-x-ling-transfer}{here}.

AI.tldr: 本文研究跨语言迁移是否可由类型学特征预测，并发现仅用类型学特征的随机森林模型能较好重建跨语言迁移矩阵，且不受脚本和语系混淆影响，可作为零计算筛选工具。
AI.motivation: 跨语言迁移通常需要大量多语言预训练和训练运行来测量，成本高昂；作者希望探究迁移能否通过免费可得的类型学特征预测，并判断高资源源语言的优势究竟反映类型学还是数据质量与数量偏差。
AI.method: 使用类型学数据库特征，在24种语言的已有跨语言迁移矩阵上训练仅依赖类型学的随机森林；采用留一语言、留一文字系统和留一语系验证；并与非类型学控制模型比较；进一步将迁移分解为类型学项和资源及文字偏差项。
AI.result: 类型学-only随机森林留一语言-out达到ρ=0.705、R^2=0.49，优于非类型学控制模型的ρ=0.62；信号在留一文字和留一语系下依然存在，说明脚本和语系混淆不能解释该效应；最佳源语言排序对资源与文字偏差敏感，而类型学不受此偏差影响。
AI.conclusion: 类型学特征包含廉价且密集的跨语言迁移信号，可替代数百次训练运行，作为零计算筛选工具用于预测跨语言迁移；最佳源语言选择需警惕资源与脚本偏差，而类型学预测相对稳健。

title: How to Reduce Localization Ambiguity? Geometry-Semantic Constrained BEV Representation Learning for Satellite-Ground Localization
summary: Satellite-ground localization estimates the planar position and yaw orientation of a ground camera within a geo-referenced satellite image. Most recent methods map ground and satellite features into a shared bird's-eye-view (BEV) space and establish spatial correspondences. However, insufficient depth constraints can assign one ground feature to different distances along a viewing direction, creating geometric ambiguity in BEV feature placement. Similar appearances at different locations can also create descriptor matching ambiguity, while existing descriptor learning lacks explicit semantic supervision to distinguish them. We propose GeoSem-BEV, a geometry-semantic constrained BEV representation learning method. Radial depth supervision constrains distance assignment, and vertical height supervision constrains height aggregation. Shared explicit semantic supervision promotes consistent semantic predictions across views and helps distinguish locations with similar semantics. These constraints improve feature placement and descriptor discriminability, enhancing state-of-the-art BEV localization models. On VIGOR with unknown orientation, GeoSem-BEV reduces mean orientation error by 37.2% and 38.1% in the cross-area and same-area settings, respectively. The corresponding errors are reduced by 10.8% and 15.6% on DReSS-D. On KITTI-CVL, it reduces same-area mean orientation error by 26.8% under 10 degree orientation noise.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出GeoSem-BEV，一种几何-语义约束的BEV表示学习方法，用于卫星-地面定位，通过深度、高度和语义监督提升地面相机在卫星图像中的平面位置与偏航角估计性能。
AI.motivation: 现有BEV定位方法将地面与卫星特征映射到共享BEV空间并建立对应关系，但深度约束不足会导致同一地面特征被分配到视线方向上不同距离，造成BEV特征放置的几何歧义；不同位置相似外观也会带来描述子匹配歧义，而现有描述子学习缺乏显式语义监督来区分这些相似位置。
AI.method: 提出GeoSem-BEV，引入径向深度监督约束距离分配，引入垂直高度监督约束高度聚合，并使用共享显式语义监督促进跨视角语义预测一致，从而帮助区分语义相似的位置，改善特征放置和描述子判别能力。
AI.result: 在VIGOR未知朝向设置下，跨区域和同区域的平均朝向误差分别降低37.2%和38.1%；在DReSS-D上对应误差分别降低10.8%和15.6%；在KITTI-CVL上，10度朝向噪声下同区域平均朝向误差降低26.8%。
AI.conclusion: 几何与语义约束能够提升BEV定位模型的特征放置质量和描述子判别性，进而显著增强当前最先进BEV定位模型的性能。

title: Sparse Planner: A Hybrid Planner for Efficient Sampling via a Conditional Variational Autoencoder
summary:
Trajectory planning is a core component of autonomous driving systems, where real-time performance and solution quality directly affect safety and reliability. Sample-Based Motion Planning (SBMP) is widely adopted for its ability to approximate near-optimal solutions through parameter space sampling. However, achieving high-quality trajectories typically requires dense sampling, leading to substantial computational overhead and significant runtime variability in complex traffic scenarios.
  To address this limitation, we propose a Sparse Planner (SP) that improves sampling efficiency by learning the conditional relationship between scene context and effective trajectory parameters using a Conditional Variational Autoencoder (CVAE). By modeling the structure of high-quality sampling distributions, SP directly generates cost-effective samples in the parameter space, significantly reducing the required sampling density while preserving solution quality.
  Experimental results show that SP achieves lower trajectory cost than the state-of-the-art FISS+ planner while using only one-eighth of the sampling density. In addition, SP demonstrates improved distance-keeping capability in obstacle-rich scenarios and maintains reduced and more stable runtime characteristics, indicating enhanced computational efficiency and predictable runtime behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种稀疏规划器（SP），利用条件变分自编码器（CVAE）学习场景上下文与有效轨迹参数之间的条件关系，从而在自动驾驶轨迹规划中以更稀疏的采样获得高质量轨迹。
AI.motivation: 基于采样的运动规划（SBMP）虽能逼近近优解，但高质量轨迹通常依赖密集采样，导致计算开销大、复杂交通场景下运行时间波动显著。
AI.method: 提出稀疏规划器（SP），使用条件变分自编码器（CVAE）建模高质量采样分布的结构，学习场景上下文与有效轨迹参数的条件关系，从而直接在参数空间中生成高性价比样本，降低所需采样密度。
AI.result: 实验表明，SP仅使用最先进FISS+规划器八分之一的采样密度，即可获得更低的轨迹代价；在障碍物密集场景中展现出更好的距离保持能力，并具有更低且更稳定的运行时间。
AI.conclusion: SP通过CVAE学习采样分布，有效提升采样效率，在保证轨迹质量的同时显著降低采样密度和计算开销，增强运行时间可预测性。

title: LIBERO-Agent: Evaluating General-Purpose Agents for Direct Embodied Manipulation
summary: General-purpose agents can plan, use tools, and revise their behavior from feedback, but it remains unclear whether these capabilities transfer from digital environments to embodied manipulation. To investigate this question, we introduce LIBERO-Agent, an agent-native benchmark for evaluating these agents in robot manipulation tasks. Rather than asking agents to submit task-level Python control programs or operate through high-level robot skills, LIBERO-Agent provides an interactive robotic environment where agents can select which observations to inspect, process them with their own tools, and issue native action commands. LIBERO-Agent integrates 200 tasks into a common interaction framework and provides a 30-task primary suite that separates perception, short-horizon execution, and long-horizon composition. Results reveal a pronounced reliability gap: while agents perform well on perception and easy short-horizon tasks, their performance degrades substantially on hard short-horizon and long-horizon tasks. Richer observations improve short-horizon manipulation, while demonstration benefits depend on the agent and format. Among these agents, GPT-6 Astra achieves the strongest overall performance. Further analysis shows its major advantage lies in mechanism interaction, especially when sustained physical contact is needed, while its remaining failures stem from cross-stage interference and geometric errors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LIBERO-Agent，一个面向通用智能体的机器人操作基准，将200个任务统一到交互式环境中，并提供30个任务的主套件。研究发现通用智能体从数字环境迁移到具身操作时存在明显可靠性差距，GPT-6 Astra总体表现最佳。
AI.motivation: 通用智能体已能规划、使用工具并根据反馈修正行为，但这些能力是否能从数字环境迁移到具身机器人操作尚不清楚，因此需要专门的智能体原生评测基准。
AI.method: 构建LIBERO-Agent交互式机器人环境，允许智能体自主选择观测、使用自身工具处理信息并发出原生动作命令；集成200个任务，提供30任务主套件，分离感知、短时程执行和长时程组合；评估多类通用智能体，并分析更丰富观测与演示对不同智能体的影响。
AI.result: 智能体在感知和简单短时程任务上表现良好，但在困难短时程和长时程任务上性能显著下降；更丰富观测能改善短时程操作，演示收益取决于智能体和格式；GPT-6 Astra总体最强，优势集中在机制交互，尤其是需要持续物理接触时，其剩余失败主要来自跨阶段干扰和几何错误。
AI.conclusion: 通用智能体在具身操作中仍存在显著可靠性缺口，数字环境中的规划与工具使用能力不能直接等价迁移；未来需重点提升长时程组合、跨阶段干扰抑制和精确几何与接触控制能力。

title: Effective Does Not Mean Useful: Conditional Functional Substitutability for Redundancy and Scaling in Transformers
summary: Modern neural networks scale predictably, yet the mechanisms behind these regularities remain unclear. Neural redundancy is typically characterized by component importance or representational similarity, both indirect proxies. We view redundancy as an input-conditioned, dynamic relation: intermediate computational states are functionally redundant when they induce similar downstream responses. We introduce Conditional Functional Substitutability (CFS) to directly characterize such functional substitution. CFS exposes functional relations and reduction potential missed by conventional importance- and similarity-based measures. Across modalities and Transformer families, CFS reveals systematic functional reorganization with scale. Controlled scaling further shows that performance gains need not track growth in substitutability, while fixed-capacity models with more independent functional structure perform better, providing a functional account of diminishing returns. Predicted CFS further enables dynamic computation with a better performance--computation trade-off than importance-based component selection, suggesting new directions for redundancy-aware computation and more efficient model scaling.

AI.tldr: 论文提出条件功能可替代性（CFS），从输入条件与动态关系角度直接刻画神经网络的冗余，并揭示其随规模变化的功能重组规律。
AI.motivation: 现代神经网络规模增长具有可预测性，但其内在机制尚不清晰；现有冗余度量多依赖重要性或表征相似性等间接代理，难以直接反映功能替代关系。
AI.method: 引入条件功能可替代性（CFS）：若中间计算状态能诱导相似的下游响应，则视为功能冗余。在不同模态和Transformer家族上评估CFS，并进行受控规模实验，同时用预测的CFS指导动态计算。
AI.result: CFS揭示了随规模出现的系统性功能重组；性能提升未必伴随可替代性增长，而固定容量下功能结构更独立的模型表现更好，为递减回报提供功能解释。基于CFS的动态计算在性能—计算权衡上优于基于重要性的组件选择。
AI.conclusion: CFS提供了直接的功能视角来理解冗余与规模规律，并为冗余感知计算和更高效的模型扩展指明新方向。

title: Fyan: A Human--AI Harness with Semantic Auditing for Document-Level Formalization
summary: We present FYAN, a human--AI harness for document-level mathematical formalization. Rather than treating theorems in isolation, FYAN coordinates an end-to-end workflow spanning specification, proof planning, logical review, Lean proof construction, knowledge curation, and validation, with support for independent supervision and human guidance. A central component is evidence-grounded semantic auditing, which assesses whether formal statements faithfully preserve their informal specifications. A language model constructs structured evidence over local correspondences, omissions, scope, and logical relations, while a deterministic validator checks this evidence and produces reproducible judgments. When a substantive but admissible deviation is accepted, FYAN requires an explicit proof-transfer obligation connecting the formal statement back to a source-facing interpretation. With the same model (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash) in every stage, FYAN proves 86 of 143 FormalTCS theorems under a strict Lean check, against 69 for a general agent harness, and raises the natural-language proof score from 0.501 to 0.851. On ConsistencyCheck, its semantic audit catches more inconsistent statements than a direct LLM judge, both on labels verified against the source (recall 0.777 vs. 0.636) and on the original labels (0.873 vs. 0.820), and localizes each mismatch it reports to a specific hypothesis, conclusion, or scope. FYAN also built ODENumLib, a 9,355-line Lean library for the numerical analysis of ordinary differential equation.

AI.tldr: FYAN 是一个面向文档级数学形式化的人机协作框架，将规范、证明规划、逻辑审查、Lean 证明构建、知识整理与验证统一为端到端流程，并引入基于证据的语义审计，以判断形式化陈述是否忠实于非形式化规范。
AI.motivation: 现有工作往往孤立地处理定理，难以保证文档级数学形式化的忠实性、可追溯性和可验证性；因此需要一种支持独立监督、人类指导与语义审计的端到端人机协作框架。
AI.method: FYAN 协调规范、证明规划、逻辑审查、Lean 证明构建、知识整理和验证。核心是基于证据的语义审计：语言模型构建关于局部对应、遗漏、范围和逻辑关系的结构化证据，确定性验证器检查证据并给出可复现判断。若接受实质性但可允许的偏差，则要求显式证明迁移义务，将形式化陈述连接回面向来源的解释。所有阶段使用同一模型 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash。
AI.result: 在相同模型下，FYAN 在严格 Lean 检查中证明 143 个 FormalTCS 定理中的 86 个，通用智能体框架为 69 个；自然语言证明分数从 0.501 提升到 0.851。在 ConsistencyCheck 上，其语义审计比直接 LLM 判断器发现更多不一致陈述：对源验证标签召回率 0.777 对 0.636，对原始标签 0.873 对 0.820，并能将每个不匹配定位到具体假设、结论或范围。FYAN 还构建了 ODENumLib，一个 9,355 行的 Lean 库，用于常微分方程数值分析。
AI.conclusion: FYAN 通过人机协作、证据驱动的语义审计和显式证明迁移义务，提升了文档级数学形式化的证明成功率、自然语言证明质量和一致性检查能力，并展示了构建大规模领域 Lean 库的可行性。

title: SEPAL: Separated Expert Pairs with Answer-Level Fusion for Reliable LLM Collaboration
summary: Multi-agent collaboration lets large language models (LLMs) improve question answering through deliberation and feedback. Yet shared discussion couples correction with exposure to the same mistakes, which can erode the diversity needed for voting. Self-consistency offers sampling diversity without feedback, while single-pair Actor-Critic collaboration refines only one candidate. We introduce SEPAL, which assigns three private Actor-Critic teams to direct reasoning, evidence grounding, and verification. Role-specific training gives the teams different reasoning objectives beyond sampling variation. Each Critic guides revisions within its own team, preventing feedback from carrying errors across candidates. Once revision ends, majority voting combines only the final answers, keeping the reasoning histories separate until the decision. Across five open-weight backbones and five question-answering benchmarks, SEPAL improves mean accuracy by 1.81 percentage points over a matched single Actor-Critic pair, with improvements across all five backbones. Code is available at https://github.com/zhansan114514/SEPAL.

AI.tldr: SEPAL 提出三组私有的 Actor-Critic 团队，分别负责直接推理、证据依据和验证；各团队内部由 Critic 指导修正，最后仅对最终答案进行多数投票。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体协作的共享讨论会把纠错与暴露相同错误耦合在一起，损害投票所需的多样性；自一致性虽提供采样多样性但无反馈，单对 Actor-Critic 又只能精炼一个候选答案。
AI.method: 将三组私有 Actor-Critic 团队分别用于直接推理、证据依据和验证，并通过角色特定训练赋予不同推理目标；每个 Critic 只在本团队内指导修订，避免错误反馈跨候选传播；修订结束后仅对最终答案做多数投票，保持推理历史相互独立。
AI.result: 在五个开源权重骨干模型和五个问答基准上，SEPAL 相比匹配的单对 Actor-Critic 平均准确率提升 1.81 个百分点，且在全部五个骨干模型上均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过私有角色分工、团队内反馈与延迟答案投票，SEPAL 能在保持推理历史独立的同时提升多智能体 LLM 问答准确率，代码已开源。

title: The Evolution of Attention in Large Language Models: Mechanisms, Trade-offs, and Emerging Trends
summary:
Self-attention gives LLMs fine-grained, query-dependent access to context, but dense token interactions incur quadratic prefill cost and a key--value cache growing with context length. Research thus spans explicit-memory compression, sparse access, recurrent state construction, structured state dynamics, and heterogeneous mechanism composition. This survey analyzes these developments as model-internal contextual memory. We introduce a five-dimensional lens---Memory Representation, Memory Update, Access, Readout, and Integration---describing what is represented, how it changes, what is query-eligible, how it is read, and how readouts form outputs. This lens compares overlapping research lines without imposing one computational model.
  We reconstruct mechanism-level developments and architectural adoption using 59 release-level records from 14 major model lineages and 11 high-performing open-weight endpoints. First, explicit-memory and recurrent-state methods retain distinct interfaces but increasingly control overlapping memory functions. Second, heterogeneous architectures increasingly coordinate across network depth: layer-wise composition distributes complementary memory processing across representational stages, while cross-layer reuse carries selected memory and routing artifacts forward. Depth thus becomes a dimension along which contextual memory is constructed and managed. Third, these developments motivate a stateful multidimensional memory-routing hypothesis: persistent memory is organized across temporal scope, network depth, substrate type, and representation granularity, while coordinated Sparse Write and Sparse Read determine what is maintained and what contributes to each query. Overall, efficient sequence architecture design increasingly concerns the organization, lifecycle, and selective use of contextual memory rather than an isolated Attention operator.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇关于LLM高效序列架构的综述，将自注意力及各类高效机制统一视为模型内部的上下文记忆，并提出五维分析视角与状态化多维记忆路由假设。
AI.motivation: 自注意力虽能提供细粒度、依赖查询的上下文访问，但稠密token交互带来二次预填充成本，且KV缓存随上下文长度增长，因此需要研究显式记忆压缩、稀疏访问、循环状态、结构化状态动态和异构机制组合等方向。
AI.method: 作者以模型内部上下文记忆为框架，提出五维视角：记忆表示、记忆更新、访问、读出和整合；并基于14个主要模型谱系、59条发布级记录和11个高性能开放权重端点，重构机制级发展与架构采用情况。
AI.result: 显式记忆与循环状态方法虽接口不同，但日益控制重叠的记忆功能；异构架构越来越在网络深度上协调，层间组合分配互补记忆处理，跨层复用传递记忆与路由产物；由此提出状态化多维记忆路由假设，即持久记忆按时间范围、网络深度、基底类型和表示粒度组织，并由协调的稀疏写入与稀疏读取决定维持内容和查询贡献。
AI.conclusion: 高效序列架构设计正日益关注上下文记忆的组织、生命周期和选择性使用，而不再仅聚焦于孤立的Attention算子。

title: ANI: Adaptive Numerical Injection for Unifying Semantic and Arithmetic Representations in Numerical Reasoning
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026. 16 pages, 7 figures. Code available at https://github.com/Jinsung-Jeon/ANI_EMNLP
summary: Precise numerical reasoning with Large Language Models (LLMs) is essential for expanding their applicability to complex real-world tasks. However, text-based tokenization often fragments numbers, significantly hindering precise arithmetic reasoning. Meanwhile, numerical embeddings, despite arithmetic precision, rely on context-agnostic substitution that disregards the semantic role of numbers as identifiers. To combine the complementary strengths, we propose \textbf{ANI (Adaptive Numerical Injection)}, a hybrid framework that governs the selective injection of numerical features based on the semantic context. By employing a context-aware gating mechanism, we selectively inject numerical embeddings (specifically FoNE) into the latent space, explicitly preserving nominal identifiers while enhancing quantitative operands. Through extensive evaluations across various LLMs, we demonstrate that ANI enhances MATH performance by 9.5 points over the official reference model, while maintaining robust performance on general linguistic benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ANI（Adaptive Numerical Injection）混合框架，通过上下文感知门控选择性地将数值嵌入（FoNE）注入潜空间，以提升大语言模型的数值推理能力。
AI.motivation: 文本分词常将数字切碎，阻碍精确算术推理；而数值嵌入虽能保证算术精度，却采用与上下文无关的替换，忽略了数字作为标识符的语义角色。
AI.method: 提出 ANI 框架，基于语义上下文对数值特征进行选择性注入；利用上下文感知门控机制，将 FoNE 等数值嵌入注入潜空间，在保留名义标识符的同时增强定量操作数。
AI.result: 在多种 LLM 上评估，ANI 相比官方参考模型在 MATH 上提升 9.5 分，同时在通用语言基准上保持稳健性能。
AI.conclusion: ANI 结合了文本分词与数值嵌入的互补优势，可有效提升数值推理并维持通用语言能力。

title: GeoGAT: Bidirectional Temporal Sampling Meets Hierarchical Graph Attention for Global Video Geo-localization
summary: Global video geo-localization aims to infer the geographic location of a video worldwide, evaluating performance across four geographic hierarchies: city, state/province, country, and continent. Existing methods typically employ one-way uniform sampling to process video frames and train independent classifiers for each hierarchy, which leads to the loss of key geographic cues and prediction conflicts between hierarchies, especially for complex multi-shot edited videos. To address these limitations, we propose GeoGAT, which integrates bidirectional temporal sampling with graph attention networks (GATs). Specifically, GeoGAT extracts forward and offset-reversed frame sequences to construct complementary spatiotemporal features. These fused features are then fed into a predefined geographical hierarchy graph, where GATs perform structure-aware message passing, while a dual-constraint mechanism prunes predictions to eliminate cross-hierarchy conflicts. We construct GeoGAT10k, comprising 9,720 multi-shot edited videos from 166 cities worldwide, specifically to benchmark generalization ability on complex video structures. Experimental results on CityGuessr68k and GeoGAT10k demonstrate that GeoGAT eliminates hierarchical conflicts entirely and achieves state-of-the-art performance across all four geographic hierarchies. On CityGuessr68k, GeoGAT outperforms the strongest baseline, evaluated under both classification and retrieval protocols, by 2.6 percentage points at the city level. On the more challenging GeoGAT10k with multi-shot edited videos, the accuracy improvement exceeds 24 percentage points, validating strong generalization to complex real-world scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GeoGAT，结合双向时间采样与图注意力网络，解决全球视频地理定位中关键线索丢失和层级预测冲突的问题，并在多个数据集上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通常采用单向均匀采样处理视频帧，并为每个地理层级训练独立分类器，导致关键地理线索丢失以及层级间预测冲突，对多镜头编辑视频尤为严重。
AI.method: 提出GeoGAT：提取前向和偏移反转帧序列构建互补时空特征；将融合特征输入预定义地理层级图，利用GAT进行结构感知消息传递；采用双约束机制修剪预测以消除跨层级冲突。同时构建了包含166个城市9720个多镜头编辑视频的GeoGAT10k数据集。
AI.result: 在CityGuessr68k和GeoGAT10k上，GeoGAT完全消除了层级冲突，并在四个地理层级上均达到最优性能。在CityGuessr68k上，城市级分类和检索协议下比最强基线提升2.6个百分点；在更具挑战的GeoGAT10k上，准确率提升超过24个百分点。
AI.conclusion: GeoGAT有效解决了现有方法的局限，并在复杂多镜头编辑视频场景中展现出强大的泛化能力。

title: Perceptual Color Difference Modeling Using Machine Learning and Human Similarity Judgments
comment: This manuscript has been submitted to IEEE Access for consideration
summary: Accurate assessment of color differences is essential for applications ranging from digital design to quality control. While existing color difference metrics, such as CIEDE2000, aim to approximate human perception, they may still exhibit inconsistencies with perceptual judgments. In this study, we investigate a data-driven approach to color-difference estimation based directly on human evaluations. We collect similarity judgments for 2,000 systematically generated color pairs, each rated by seven observers using a four-point ordinal scale. These judgments are then used to train regression models using different color representations, including RGB channel differences, HSI differences, and COLIBRI fuzzy linguistic categories. Experiments with five regression algorithms show that the choice of color model has a greater influence on prediction performance than the choice of regression algorithm. Using COLIBRI features alone, linear regression achieves an R2 of 0.595, outperforming RGB and HSI representations, which achieve R2 values of 0.479 and 0.493, respectively. The best performance is obtained by LightGBM using the combined representation, reaching an R2 of 0.703. The results indicate that human perceptual color differences are better captured when numerical color coordinates are complemented by graded perceptual categories, highlighting the potential of data-driven models for perceptually aligned color-difference estimation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究基于人类感知判断的数据驱动色差估计，利用2000对颜色的相似度评分训练回归模型，发现颜色表示比回归算法更关键，数值坐标结合分级感知类别能更好预测感知色差。
AI.motivation: 现有色差指标如CIEDE2000虽试图逼近人类感知，但仍可能与感知判断不一致，因此需要直接基于人类评价的数据驱动方法。
AI.method: 收集2000个系统生成颜色对的相似度判断，每对由7位观察者按四点有序量表评分；使用RGB通道差、HSI差和COLIBRI模糊语言类别等颜色表示，并采用五种回归算法训练模型。
AI.result: 颜色模型选择对预测性能影响大于回归算法选择。仅用COLIBRI特征时线性回归R2为0.595，优于RGB的0.479和HSI的0.493；LightGBM结合表示取得最佳R2为0.703。
AI.conclusion: 人类感知色差在数值颜色坐标之外补充分级感知类别时能被更好捕捉，表明数据驱动模型在感知对齐的色差估计方面具有潜力。

title: ECHO-G: Embodied Co-speech Humanoid mOtion Generation
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables. Project page: https://echo-g-project.github.io/
summary: Generating full-body co-speech motion for humanoid robots requires coordinating speech prosody, linguistic content, and embodiment-specific motion. To this end, we present ECHO-G, a framework jointly conditioned on speech audio and timed transcripts. Its Speech-Grounded Diffusion Transformer (SGDiT) combines frame-aligned acoustic features with token-level linguistic context, preserving their distinct granularities. Trained with rectified flow matching, it models one-to-many utterance-motion relationships directly in robot space. To support training and evaluation, we introduce a BEAT2-derived audio-text-robot dataset and a benchmark covering co-speech characteristics, robot-motion quality, and runtime efficiency. Comparative evaluation supports direct robot-space generation over the evaluated human-motion generation and retargeting pipelines, while modality ablations highlight the benefits of joint audio-text conditioning. We further demonstrate deployment on a physical humanoid robot. A complementary video-rating study also favors joint conditioning over the alternatives. The dataset and training, inference, and evaluation code are available through our project page.

AI.tldr: 提出 ECHO-G 框架，用于生成人形机器人全身共语动作；它同时以语音音频和带时间戳文本为条件，结合 SGDiT、rectified flow matching、数据集与基准，并验证了真机部署效果。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人共语动作生成需要协调语音韵律、语言内容和机器人自身形态动作；直接面向机器人空间生成可能比先做人动生成再重定向更合适。
AI.method: 设计 ECHO-G，其 Speech-Grounded Diffusion Transformer（SGDiT）将帧对齐声学特征与 token 级语言上下文结合并保持不同粒度；采用 rectified flow matching 训练，直接建模语音到机器人空间的一对多动作关系。构建 BEAT2 衍生的音频-文本-机器人数据集及涵盖共语特征、机器人动作质量和运行效率的基准。
AI.result: 对比评估表明，直接机器人空间生成优于所评估的人体动作生成与重定向流程；模态消融显示音频-文本联合条件带来收益；在实体人形机器人上完成部署；视频评分研究也偏好联合条件方案。
AI.conclusion: ECHO-G 表明，面向人形机器人共语动作生成时，联合语音与文本条件并直接在机器人空间建模是有效方案；数据集及训练、推理、评估代码已公开。

title: Better Supervision Is Nearby: Neighborhood On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) trains mathematical reasoning models using a privileged teacher that sees a reference solution and supervises student-sampled prefixes. Standard OPSD uses one fixed parameter setting at every state, but nearby settings may offer additional supervision. We find that local parameter perturbations reveal complementary reference-aligned corrections under the same reference context. Different experts supply these corrections at different reference positions. Their pool covers more such positions than the unperturbed privileged teacher. We introduce Neighborhood OPSD (N-OPSD) to turn these corrections into supervision at student-visited states. Offline, greedy selection builds a compact pool of frozen experts by rewarding filtered reference-token gains beyond the pool's current best at each position. The highest-peak expert need not provide the best training target. Online routing therefore separates the anchor direction from its level of support. MaxPeak selects the anchor token, and quantile selection chooses among experts whose top token matches it. The student learns from the chosen expert's full next-token distribution through the clipped forward-KL objective inherited from OPSD. We evaluate on AIME 2024, AIME 2025, and HMMT February 2025. Across three independent runs per method, Neighborhood OPSD improves the three-benchmark Average@12 over OPSD by 2.75, 1.67, and 1.94 points on Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, and 8B, respectively. Student-prefix continuations support using the pool beyond the reference trajectories used for selection. Matched ablations support filtered reference-token gains as a selection criterion. Accounting for overlap within the pool and routing by state further improve student accuracy. Inference uses only the distilled student.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Neighborhood OPSD（N-OPSD），通过局部参数扰动构建互补专家池，并在学生访问状态上路由选择专家监督，从而提升数学推理的 on-policy self-distillation 效果。
AI.motivation: 标准 OPSD 在每个状态只使用单一固定参数教师，但邻近参数设置可能提供额外监督；不同专家在不同参考位置提供互补的、与参考对齐的修正。
AI.method: 离线阶段用贪心选择构建紧凑的冻结专家池，奖励过滤后的参考 token 增益；在线阶段分离锚方向与支持度：MaxPeak 选择锚 token，分位数选择在 top token 匹配的专家中选专家，学生通过继承自 OPSD 的 clipped forward-KL 目标学习所选专家的完整下一 token 分布。
AI.result: 在 AIME 2024、AIME 2025、HMMT February 2025 上，每方法三次独立运行，N-OPSD 在 Qwen3-1.7B、4B、8B 上分别将三基准 Average@12 较 OPSD 提升 2.75、1.67、1.94 分；学生前缀续写和匹配消融支持专家池泛化与过滤增益选择准则。
AI.conclusion: 邻域参数扰动可提供额外互补监督，离线专家池构建与在线状态路由能有效提升学生数学推理准确率；推理阶段仅需蒸馏后的学生模型。

title: Drift Inspector: Exploring and Measuring Scientific Drift with Atomic Contribution Claims
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 System Demonstrations. 11 pages. Live demo, code and data: https://hamyrappy.github.io/drift-inspector
summary: Scientific abstracts mix contributions with background, motivation, and meta-language, so tools that read them as-is cannot separate what a field produces from what it discusses. We present Drift Inspector, an open-source system for measuring and exploring how a research field changes over time at the level of Atomic Contribution Claims (ACCs): decontextualized, contribution-bearing propositions an LLM extracts from each abstract before analysis. The system clusters these claims across years into an interactive map where every trend traces back to the claims and papers behind it. Applied to six years of EMNLP, it shows the field shifting away from classic NLP tasks toward LLM-era capabilities such as reasoning and multimodality -- a movement that keyword or whole-abstract counts blur. The released data extend beyond EMNLP: the same pipeline has processed the full ACL Anthology (346k claims, 80k abstracts, 423 venues). Extraction is human-validated and clustering checked against an external manually constructed taxonomy.

AI.tldr: 提出开源系统 Drift Inspector，通过从论文摘要中抽取“原子贡献主张”（ACCs）并聚类，按时间追踪研究领域变化。
AI.motivation: 科学摘要混合了背景、动机和元语言，直接分析难以区分领域真正产出的贡献与其讨论内容。
AI.method: 用 LLM 从每篇摘要中抽取去语境化的贡献性命题（ACCs），再按年份聚类，构建可交互的趋势地图，并支持回溯到具体主张和论文；在 EMNLP 六年的数据上应用，且将同一流程扩展到完整 ACL Anthology。
AI.result: EMNLP 显示领域从经典 NLP 任务转向 LLM 时代能力，如推理和多模态；这种变化在关键词或整摘要计数中会被模糊。系统已处理 ACL Anthology 的 346k 条主张、80k 篇摘要、423 个会议/期刊。
AI.conclusion: Drift Inspector 能更细粒度地测量和探索研究领域漂移；抽取经过人工验证，聚类也与外部人工构建的分类体系进行了对照。

title: Neuro-Symbolic Predicate Learning for Semantic Safe Robot Control
summary: As robots are increasingly deployed in everyday environments, ensuring their safety has become a central challenge. Existing methods often encode safety requirements as opaque mathematical/logical formulations or dense cost functions. While effective in specific tasks, they remain difficult to interpret, tightly coupled to individual tasks, and offer limited insight into why a robot action is considered safe or unsafe. To address this limitation, we propose ``Neuro-Symbolic Predicate Learning for Semantic Safe Robot Control'' (NEUPRO), which leverages a differentiable reasoner that can learn reusable safety representations from human-specified safety knowledge. NEUPRO allows practitioners to express task-related safety requirements as transparent symbolic rules, while enabling gradients to propagate through these rules to a feature extractor that maps raw observations to safety-relevant concepts. As a result, the learned feature extractor is (softly) grounded in human-understandable semantics, supports transparent constraint evaluation, and is transferable across tasks. By coupling interpretability with differentiability, NEUPRO moves beyond opaque cost design toward reusable safety reasoning. To evaluate NEUPRO's capability, we collect and release REASON, the first real robot benchmark dataset for interpretable robot safety specification. Experiments on REASON show that NEUPRO learns safety-critical features that generalize across tasks, mitigate the interpretability limitations of conventional black-box cost formulations, and provide explicit explanations of safety violation.

AI.tldr: 提出NEUPRO，一种用于语义安全机器人控制的神经符号谓词学习方法。它利用可微分推理器从人类指定的安全知识中学习可重用的安全表示，并发布了首个可解释机器人安全规范的真实机器人基准数据集REASON。
AI.motivation: 随着机器人在日常环境中日益普及，确保其安全成为核心挑战。现有方法通常将安全需求编码为不透明的数学/逻辑公式或密集代价函数，虽在特定任务中有效，但难以解释、与任务紧密耦合，且对机器人行为安全与否的原因洞察有限。
AI.method: NEUPRO允许从业者将任务相关的安全需求表达为透明的符号规则，并通过可微分推理器使梯度通过这些规则传播到特征提取器，将原始观测映射为安全相关概念。学习到的特征提取器（软性）扎根于人类可理解的语义，支持透明约束评估，并可跨任务迁移。此外，收集并发布了REASON数据集，这是首个用于可解释机器人安全规范的真实机器人基准数据集。
AI.result: 在REASON上的实验表明，NEUPRO学习到了可跨任务泛化的安全关键特征，缓解了传统黑箱代价公式的可解释性局限，并能提供安全违规的显式解释。
AI.conclusion: 通过将可解释性与可微性相结合，NEUPRO超越了不透明的代价设计，迈向可重用的安全推理。

title: Uncertainty-Aware Consistency Distillation for Few-Step Video Generation
summary: We study few-step video generation, i.e., distilling a multi-step video generator, which typically requires tens of sampling steps, incurring substantial latency and compute, into a few-step student. Consistency distillation is a common recipe, in which a multi-step teacher provides the consistency targets for a few-step student. However, these teacher-guided targets are not equally trustworthy, and the content is harder to learn where it varies rapidly over time, e.g., moving foliage shadows or flowing water. We observe that supervision reliability follows the local difficulty of the content rather than semantic complexity: regions that change little yield consistent endpoint predictions, whereas regions with large temporal variation produce larger discrepancies that coincide with the largest perceptual errors. Motivated by this observation, we propose Uncertainty-Aware Consistency Distillation (UACD), which reweights consistency supervision at each spatiotemporal region using a local, parameter-free uncertainty estimate. Specifically, we construct two independently perturbed teacher-guided consistency paths, whose student endpoint predictions provide a consensus target; the discrepancy between the student's direct prediction and this target is the uncertainty proxy. We then relax the consistency penalty on high-uncertainty regions through an exponential weight, while keeping the full penalty elsewhere, since the student cannot be expected to match targets that are hard to learn. To preserve perceptual quality under aggressive step reduction, we integrate feature-space adversarial training with semantic alignment. With parameter-efficient LoRA adaptation of the 50-step Wan model, our method achieves state-of-the-art 4-step generation on VBench 2.0 (0.556 mean score) and is preferred over competing methods in a user study.

AI.tldr: 论文研究少步视频生成，通过一致性蒸馏将需数十步采样的多步视频生成器压缩为少步学生模型，提出不确定性感知一致性蒸馏（UACD），在VBench 2.0上实现最优4步视频生成。
AI.motivation: 多步视频生成采样步数多、延迟与计算开销大。一致性蒸馏中教师提供的目标并非同等可靠：监督可靠性取决于局部内容难度而非语义复杂度，时间变化剧烈区域（如移动树影、流水）的学生预测与教师目标差异大，恰与最大感知误差重合。
AI.method: 提出UACD，在每个时空区域用局部、无参数的不确定性估计重新加权一致性监督。构造两条独立扰动的教师引导一致性路径，以学生端点预测的共识作为目标；学生直接预测与该目标的差异作为不确定性代理。对高不确定性区域用指数权重放松一致性惩罚，其余区域保持完整惩罚。同时结合特征空间对抗训练与语义对齐，并用参数高效LoRA适配50步Wan模型。
AI.result: 在VBench 2.0上取得最优4步生成效果，平均分0.556；用户研究中优于对比方法。
AI.conclusion: 根据局部内容难度自适应调整一致性监督权重，可在激进步数压缩下保持感知质量，实现高质量少步视频生成。

title: Feature-Aware Token Attack for Compression-Triggered Stealthy Failures in Large Vision-Language Models
comment: 29 pages including references and appendices, 10 figures. Submitted to ICLR 2027
summary: Visual-token compression improves the efficiency of large vision-language models, but can expose failures that full-token evaluation misses. We study adversarial images that preserve full-token correctness yet induce errors after compression, even when both inference paths succeed on the clean image. Creating such failures is challenging because perturbing token importance can also damage the visual content needed for full-token inference. We propose Feature-Aware Token Attack (FATA), which couples attention suppression with cosine-based feature preservation on a fixed set of salient clean-image tokens. In the primary LLaVA-1.5-7B setting, FATA uses only vision-encoder gradients, without access to the deployed compressor, token budget, or downstream task. Across four visually dependent task subsets and four compressors under a controlled reconstruction protocol, FATA achieves SR = 96.3% full-token accuracy retention and CBR = 22.1% conditional blinding, compared with 89.8% and 15.7% for CAA. Ablations support the role of both objectives in balancing compressed-path failure against full-token preservation. FATA also has the lowest measured detection rate among four attacks across three evaluated detectors at a 5% false-positive rate. These findings motivate assessing adversarial robustness jointly across full-token and compressed inference.

AI.tldr: 本文研究视觉token压缩下的大视觉语言模型对抗脆弱性，提出FATA攻击，使图像在完整token推理时仍正确，但在压缩推理后出错。
AI.motivation: 视觉token压缩虽提升大视觉语言模型效率，但可能暴露完整token评估无法发现的对抗失败；现有攻击难以同时保持完整token正确性并诱导压缩路径错误。
AI.method: 提出Feature-Aware Token Attack（FATA），在固定显著干净图像token上结合注意力抑制与基于余弦的特征保持；主要设置中仅使用视觉编码器梯度，不访问压缩器、token预算或下游任务。
AI.result: 在LLaVA-1.5-7B、四个视觉依赖任务子集和四个压缩器下，FATA达到SR=96.3%完整token准确率保持和CBR=22.1%条件致盲，优于CAA的89.8%和15.7%；消融支持两个目标的作用，且在三个检测器5%假阳性率下检测率最低。
AI.conclusion: 应联合评估完整token与压缩推理下的对抗鲁棒性，因为压缩会引入被传统评估忽略的安全风险。

title: WorkGenesis: Building the Worlds That Teach Agents to Work
summary: The ability of Large Language Model (LLM) agents to complete daily and professional work is receiving increasing attention. Training such agents requires realistic work scenarios. Expert-authored occupational work is costly and slow to produce, while unconstrained synthesis often yields tasks with weak factual grounding or internally inconsistent requirements. To bridge this gap, we introduce WorkGenesis, a framework that constructs executable occupational work from real-world artifacts through two core technical innovations: (1) Evidence-Based Work Construction, which grounds each unit of work in real-world evidence by retrieving public files guided by O*NET occupational knowledge and synthesizing the surrounding context, companion materials, work request, and itemwise rubric around them; and (2) Execution-Guided Consistency Verification, which renders a reference deliverable inside the constructed work, attributes every unsatisfied rubric item to the agent, the task, or the rubric, and uses task and rubric defects as feedback to iteratively repair the work until it passes the audit. Experimental results demonstrate that Fx-Work-35B, trained with simple supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on only 20K units of work synthesized by WorkGenesis, achieves the highest scores among all comparable-scale baselines on the five reported metrics across GDPvalAA-v2, APEX-Agents-AA, and JobBench (31.00 versus 24.79 average score), and even surpasses frontier models such as the 1.6T DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Preview. These results show that WorkGenesis provides scalable training data for working agents.

AI.tldr: 提出 WorkGenesis 框架，通过真实世界证据构建可执行职业工作数据，并用执行引导的一致性验证迭代修复任务，从而为 LLM 智能体生成可扩展的训练数据。
AI.motivation: 训练能完成日常和专业工作的 LLM 智能体需要真实工作场景，但专家编写成本高、速度慢，而无约束合成数据常存在事实基础薄弱或要求内部不一致的问题。
AI.method: WorkGenesis 包含两项核心技术：1）基于证据的工作构建，利用 O*NET 职业知识检索公开文件，并围绕其合成上下文、配套材料、工作请求和逐项评分标准；2）执行引导的一致性验证，在构建的工作中生成参考交付物，将未满足的评分项归因于智能体、任务或评分标准，并以任务和标准缺陷为反馈迭代修复，直至通过审计。
AI.result: 仅用 WorkGenesis 合成的 2 万条工作数据对 Fx-Work-35B 进行简单 SFT，在 GDPvalAA-v2、APEX-Agents-AA 和 JobBench 的五个指标上均取得同类规模基线最高分，平均分 31.00 对 24.79，甚至超过 1.6T 的 DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Preview 等前沿模型。
AI.conclusion: WorkGenesis 能为工作型智能体提供可扩展的训练数据，并显著提升模型在职业工作场景中的表现。

title: MiniRep: Robust Reputation-Based Aggregation for Multi-Agent Debate
summary:
Autonomous agents powered by large language models (LLMs) are rapidly evolving into an open agentic ecosystem. To support trustworthy collaboration, industry initiatives increasingly assess agent reputation from past behavior and provide performance leaderboards. However, reputation derived from past performance may not reliably predict an agent's behavior on new tasks, particularly when malicious agents can adapt their behavior and influence other agents during collaboration.
  We study reputation in multi-agent debate (MAD), where multiple agents answer the same query, debate to improve their answers, and aggregate them into a final output. We present MiniRep, a reputation-based aggregation system for MAD under malicious agents. To ground our threat model in established research, we construct an attack taxonomy drawing on reputation-system attacks and software-testing mutation operators, covering strategic exploitation of reputation and subtle corruption of agent proposals. Guided by this taxonomy, MiniRep evaluates agents based on both their behavior on the current task and their reputation over time, while preventing groups of agents with highly similar responses from dominating the final decision. We assess MiniRep across diverse tasks, LLM-agent compositions, corruption placements, and attack types drawn from our taxonomy. Our experimental results show that, MiniRep outperforms both conventional MAD aggregation and conventional reputation-based approaches on MATH no matter being attacked or not. Also, under a heterogeneous 10-agent setting on MATH, MiniRep outperforms all baselines in all 28 attack conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多智能体辩论（MAD）中恶意智能体下的声誉聚合问题，提出MiniRep系统。它结合智能体在当前任务上的行为与长期声誉，并防止高度相似响应群体主导决策。实验表明其在MATH任务上优于传统MAD聚合和传统声誉方法。
AI.motivation: LLM自主智能体正形成开放生态，行业通过历史行为评估声誉并提供排行榜以支持可信协作。但基于过去表现的声誉未必能可靠预测新任务中的行为，尤其当恶意智能体可适应行为并影响其他智能体时。
AI.method: 以多智能体辩论为场景，构建攻击分类法，综合声誉系统攻击与软件测试变异算子。提出MiniRep：依据智能体当前任务行为和随时间积累的声誉进行评估，同时防止响应高度相似的智能体群体主导最终决策。在多样任务、LLM智能体组合、污染位置和攻击类型下评估。
AI.result: 在MATH任务上，无论是否受到攻击，MiniRep均优于传统MAD聚合和传统声誉方法。在异构10智能体MATH设置下，MiniRep在全部28种攻击条件中均优于所有基线。
AI.conclusion: 声誉聚合需同时考虑当前任务行为与历史声誉，并避免同质智能体群体主导决策。MiniRep能提升MAD在恶意智能体环境下的鲁棒性和可信协作能力。

title: LatentHarness: Learning Latent Actions for Memory and Reasoning via Counterfactual Policy Distillation
summary: Long-context reasoning faces two complementary bottlenecks: retaining evidence across long inputs and sustaining computation across many reasoning steps. Existing approaches largely address them separately, with external memory extending access to distant evidence and latent reasoning compressing multi-step computation. We introduce LatentHarness, which unifies memory access and latent reasoning as sequential latent action selection. At each internal step, the model chooses THINK for further computation, RECALL from a fast-weight memory of input evidence and intermediate reasoning states, or EXIT to emit the next token. We train this policy with counterfactual policy distillation, which branches every action for one step and scores its effect on the emitted token. These gains teach the policy when memory is more useful than further reasoning, while gradients through counterfactual recall teach which intermediate states should be retained in memory for future use. Across six general and long-context reasoning benchmarks, LatentHarness at 1.4B improves on the strongest baselines by 2.8% and 10.0% relative, respectively, and runs 5.9x faster than the strongest long-context baseline.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 LatentHarness，将长上下文中的记忆访问与潜在推理统一为序列潜在动作选择，并用反事实策略蒸馏训练，在多个推理基准上提升性能并显著加速。
AI.motivation: 长上下文推理面临两个瓶颈：跨长输入保留证据和维持多步推理计算。现有方法分别处理：外部记忆扩展远距离证据访问，潜在推理压缩多步计算，但二者未统一。
AI.method: 将记忆访问和潜在推理统一为序列潜在动作选择：每步选择 THINK（继续计算）、RECALL（从输入证据和中间推理状态的快速权重记忆中召回）或 EXIT（输出下一 token）。用反事实策略蒸馏训练：分支每个动作一步并评估其对输出 token 的影响，梯度通过反事实召回学习应保留哪些中间状态。
AI.result: 在六个通用和长上下文推理基准上，1.4B 的 LatentHarness 比最强基线分别相对提升 2.8% 和 10.0%，并比最强长上下文基线快 5.9 倍。
AI.conclusion: 统一记忆与潜在推理的动作选择策略有效，能学习何时记忆比继续推理更有用，以及哪些中间状态应保留在记忆中，从而实现性能与效率提升。

title: Asking the World: Generalist Physical Reasoning through Agentic World Modeling and Probing
summary: Physical reasoning from video requires inferring latent physical properties and dynamics beyond direct observation. Direct VLM inference remains unreliable on complex physical tasks without explicit modeling and validation, while predefined tool pipelines rely on task- and domain-specific priors that limit generalization across materials, dynamics, and reasoning tasks. We introduce Asking the World (ATW), a generalist agent that constructs and interrogates task-relevant executable worlds through two adaptive stages: World Modeling calibrates a world from video, while World Probing queries, simulates, and intervenes on it to obtain question-relevant evidence. Rather than prescribing the operations in either stage, ATW determines how to model and probe according to the scene and question. We develop PolyWorld Engine, a lightweight and highly programmable Warp-based multiphysics simulator for constructing and probing worlds with rigid bodies, soft bodies, cloth, ropes, fluids, and their coupled interactions. CEM-based system identification recovers task-relevant dynamics during World Modeling. The resulting world becomes an active workspace for question-directed physical experiments rather than a predetermined downstream tool. We evaluate ATW on CLEVRER, ContPhy, and three real-world scenarios. Using Gemini-3-Flash as its base VLM, ATW achieves 80.82% overall per-question accuracy on CLEVRER, improving direct Gemini-3-Flash by 46.50 points, GPT-5.5 by 13.58 points, and PhysMind by 8.27 points. On ContPhy, it reaches 70.56% overall accuracy, surpassing Gemini-3-Flash by 28.10 points and GPT-5.5 by 3.53 points. Across the three real-world scenarios, ATW achieves 71.67% accuracy, 28.33 points above GPT-5.5. These results establish agentic world modeling and probing as an effective, execution-grounded approach to generalist physical reasoning.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Asking the World（ATW）通用智能体，通过从视频构建可执行世界并主动探测，完成物理推理，并在多个数据集和真实场景中显著优于现有 VLM 与专用方法。
AI.motivation: 直接从视频进行物理推理需要推断不可见的物理属性与动力学。直接使用 VLM 推理在复杂物理任务上不可靠，而预定义工具流程依赖任务和领域先验，难以泛化到不同材料、动力学和推理任务。
AI.method: ATW 包含两个自适应阶段：世界建模与世界探测。世界建模从视频校准任务相关世界，世界探测通过查询、仿真和干预获取问题相关证据。作者开发 PolyWorld Engine，一个基于 Warp 的轻量可编程多物理仿真器，支持刚体、软体、布料、绳索、流体及其耦合。世界建模中使用基于 CEM 的系统辨识恢复任务相关动力学。
AI.result: 以 Gemini-3-Flash 为基础 VLM，ATW 在 CLEVRER 上达到 80.82% 总体准确率，比直接 Gemini-3-Flash 高 46.50 分，比 GPT-5.5 高 13.58 分，比 PhysMind 高 8.27 分；在 ContPhy 上达到 70.56%，超过 Gemini-3-Flash 28.10 分、GPT-5.5 3.53 分；在三个真实场景中达到 71.67%，高于 GPT-5.5 28.33 分。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，智能体式的世界建模与探测是一种有效且以执行为基础的通用物理推理方法。

title: Text-to-3D Policy: Fine-Grained Language-Behavior Alignment for Unseen Specification Generalization
summary: 3D visuomotor policies provide a strong foundation for spatially precise manipulation, yet current text-to-3D policies struggle to follow unseen fine-grained behavioral specifications beyond those covered by demonstrations. We study this challenge as unseen specification generalization, where language specifies behaviorally significant variations, such as target position, displacement, or articulated state, that are absent from policy training. We find that pretrained language representations and conventional global behavior-language alignment capture coarse task semantics but often blur nearby specifications that require distinct behaviors. We introduce T3DP, a Text-to-3D Policy framework for fine-grained language-behavior alignment. Rather than compressing each instruction and demonstration into a single global embedding, T3DP preserves their local structures and establishes bidirectional token-level correspondence between linguistic elements and behavioral segments.
