This directly grounds subtle linguistic variations in the behavior components they affect, preventing closely related specifications from collapsing in the representation space. The resulting specification-sensitive language representation conditions a point-cloud-based 3D diffusion policy, enabling more precise control over unseen behavioral specifications without modifying the underlying policy architecture. Across Meta-World, ManiSkill, and RoboTwin, T3DP improves average held-out-specification success over global language-behavior alignment by +11.0-14.2 points, with gains on all 15 task families; on real-robot tasks, it further raises average success from 47.5% to 65.0% (+17.5 points). Representation and action-probe analyses show that fine-grained alignment better preserves specification geometry and action-relevant variation, linking local behavior grounding to downstream control.

AI.tldr: 论文研究文本到3D策略在未见细粒度行为规范上的泛化问题，提出T3DP框架，通过语言与行为片段的token级双向对齐，提升3D扩散策略对目标位置、位移、关节状态等细微规范变化的控制能力。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到3D策略虽能进行空间精确操作，但难以遵循训练演示未覆盖的细粒度行为规范。预训练语言表示和传统全局语言-行为对齐只能捕捉粗粒度任务语义，容易模糊相邻但需要不同行为的规范。
AI.method: 提出T3DP，一种面向细粒度语言-行为对齐的Text-to-3D Policy框架。它不将指令和演示压缩为单一全局嵌入，而是保留局部结构，并建立语言元素与行为片段之间的双向token级对应，使细微语言变化直接对应到受影响的行为组件，形成规范敏感的语言表示，用于条件化基于点云的3D扩散策略，且不修改底层策略架构。
AI.result: 在Meta-World、ManiSkill和RoboTwin上，T3DP相比全局语言-行为对齐，平均held-out规范成功率提升11.0-14.2个百分点，并在全部15个任务族上均有增益；在真实机器人任务上，平均成功率从47.5%提升到65.0%，提升17.5个百分点。表示分析和动作探针分析表明，细粒度对齐更好保留了规范几何和动作相关变化。
AI.conclusion: 细粒度语言-行为对齐能够将局部行为接地与下游控制联系起来，在不改变底层3D策略架构的情况下，显著提升对未见细粒度行为规范的泛化能力和操作成功率。

title: MemCodex: Self-Programming Hierarchical Memory for Language Agents
summary: Agent memory faces heterogeneous access needs: a single-hop question may require one piece of evidence, whereas a multi-hop question must combine evidence from multiple sources. Predefined memory workflows cannot adapt to these varying needs. Recent adaptive methods search or learn over memory components and their compositions, but the design space itself remains predefined. We introduce MemCodex, a self-evolving hierarchical memory system that organizes experience into executable memory programs for summaries, relational knowledge, reusable skills, and latent memory. Open-ended program evolution searches the open design space of layer programs by rewriting how each layer is constructed, indexed, retrieved, and routed, thereby adapting both within-layer implementations and cross-layer composition. At query time, reads traverse the hierarchy from coarse to fine and stop once sufficient evidence is found, descending to the original history when needed. We further develop MemArena, a unified runtime that places heterogeneous data and memory systems behind a common interface. MemCodex improves average task success by 10.1% relative to the strongest adaptive-memory baseline, while using 3.4x fewer context tokens and achieving 2.1x faster inference.

AI.tldr: 提出 MemCodex，一种自进化分层记忆系统，将经验组织为可执行的记忆程序，并通过开放式程序进化搜索各层的构建、索引、检索与路由方式；同时提出统一运行时 MemArena，在多种数据和记忆系统间提供公共接口。
AI.motivation: Agent 记忆面临异构访问需求：单跳问题只需一条证据，多跳问题需组合多源证据。预定义记忆工作流无法适应这种变化，而现有自适应方法虽可搜索或学习记忆组件及组合，但设计空间本身仍是预定义的。
AI.method: MemCodex 将经验组织为可执行记忆程序，涵盖摘要、关系知识、可复用技能和潜在记忆；通过开放式程序进化，重写每层的构建、索引、检索和路由方式，实现层内实现与跨层组合的自适应。查询时按粗到细遍历层级，证据足够即停止，必要时下沉至原始历史。还开发 MemArena 统一运行时，将异构数据和记忆系统置于公共接口之后。
AI.result: 相对最强的自适应记忆基线，MemCodex 平均任务成功率提升 10.1%，同时上下文 token 使用减少 3.4 倍，推理速度提升 2.1 倍。
AI.conclusion: MemCodex 通过自进化分层记忆程序和统一运行时，能够适应不同复杂度的记忆访问需求，在提升任务成功率的同时显著降低 token 开销并加速推理。

title: Explore-on-Graph: Hybrid Embedding-LLM Reasoning for Knowledge Graph Question Answering under Incompleteness
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly combined with knowledge graphs (KGs) to ground reasoning in structured evidence. However, most LLM-based KGQA methods rely on traversing existing graph edges and become unreliable when reasoning paths are broken by missing facts. Alternatives that ask LLMs to generate missing knowledge risk introducing hallucinated evidence. We introduce XoG (eXplore-on-Graph), a framework for multi-hop question answering over incomplete KGs that recovers missing reasoning paths from learned graph structure rather than LLM parametric knowledge. XoG combines type-level entity-relation statistics to identify candidate relations with KG embeddings to retrieve plausible missing entities, using the LLM as a semantic selector and reasoner. These mechanisms are integrated into an iterative planning-exploration-reasoning process. Experiments on WebQSP, CWQ, and the Wikidata-based BRINK benchmark show that XoG remains competitive on complete KGs and consistently outperforms comparable methods without task-specific KGQA training under KG incompleteness. These gains persist across multiple LLM backbones, indicating that stronger LLMs alone do not resolve missing graph evidence. XoG also reduces LLM token consumption by up to 33% compared with a closely related planning-based approach.

AI.tldr: 提出 XoG 框架，用于不完整知识图谱上的多跳问答，通过学习到的图结构恢复缺失推理路径，而非依赖 LLM 参数知识。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的 KGQA 方法多依赖遍历已有图边，当缺失事实导致推理路径断裂时会失效；而让 LLM 生成缺失知识又可能引入幻觉证据。
AI.method: XoG 结合类型级实体-关系统计来识别候选关系，并利用 KG 嵌入检索可能缺失的实体，将 LLM 作为语义选择器和推理器，集成到迭代式规划-探索-推理过程中。
AI.result: 在 WebQSP、CWQ 和 Wikidata 的 BRINK 基准上，XoG 在完整 KG 上保持竞争力，在 KG 不完整时持续优于无任务特定 KGQA 训练的同类方法，且跨多个 LLM 骨干有效；相比密切相关的规划方法，LLM token 消耗最多降低 33%。
AI.conclusion: 更强 LLM 本身无法解决缺失图证据问题；利用学习到的图结构恢复缺失推理路径，可提升不完整 KG 多跳问答的鲁棒性与效率。

title: Understanding as No-Arbitrage: Bounded Dutch Books as a Definition and Training Objective for Language Models
summary: Does a language model merely predict tokens, or does it understand what it says? We make this question measurable by defining "understanding" through the lens of no-arbitrage. A model understands a vocabulary to a certain degree if a computationally bounded trader cannot extract guaranteed profit by betting against the model's probabilities on logically related claims (a "Dutch book"). We establish three theoretical results: first, because full logical coherence is computationally intractable, understanding is inherently graded, not absolute. Second, we prove that the exact optimum of standard next-token prediction is inherently incoherent across different question formats; the flaw lies in the training objective, not the architecture. Third, we show that uncertainty accumulates predictably along reasoning chains, making unjustified overconfidence an arbitrage opportunity in itself. To address this, we introduce Arbitr, a training framework where an adversarial trader penalizes the model for logical inconsistencies, paired with a calibration anchor to prevent uninformative collapse. Across five pre-registered experiments on Qwen2.5 and Phi-3.5 models, we demonstrate that standard models are highly exploitable across different phrasings. Arbitr reduces this exploitability by orders of magnitude without sacrificing task accuracy, and the effect successfully transfers to unseen logical patterns and new model families. Crucially, we uncover a scaling illusion: at 7B parameters, near-zero measured incoherence often coincides with extreme, unjustified confidence. We conclude that while Arbitr enforces rigorous logical consistency, coherence is a necessary condition for knowledge, but not a sufficient one

AI.tldr: 论文将语言模型是否“理解”转化为可度量的无套利问题：若计算受限的交易者无法利用模型在逻辑相关命题上的概率下注获得无风险利润，则模型对该词表具有一定理解。作者提出 Arbitr 训练框架来惩罚逻辑不一致，并在 Qwen2.5 与 Phi-3.5 上验证其能显著降低可套利性且不损任务准确率。
AI.motivation: 核心动机是区分语言模型只是预测 token，还是真正理解内容。作者用无套利/Dutch book 视角定义理解，使该哲学问题可计算、可实验检验。
AI.method: 理论上分析完全逻辑一致性的计算不可行性、下一 token 预测目标在不同问法下的不一致性，以及推理链中不确定性累积导致的过度自信套利。方法上提出 Arbitr：用对抗性交易者惩罚逻辑不一致，并加入校准锚点防止模型退化为无信息输出。
AI.result: 在五个预注册实验中，标准模型在不同措辞下高度可被套利；Arbitr 将可套利性降低数个数量级，同时不牺牲任务准确率，并能迁移到未见逻辑模式和新的模型家族。还发现“缩放错觉”：在 7B 参数规模下，接近零的测得不一致性常与极端且不合理的自信并存。
AI.conclusion: Arbitr 能强制执行严格的逻辑一致性；但一致性是知识的必要条件而非充分条件。模型理解应被视为有程度的分级属性，而非绝对有无。

title: TO-mdiSPAs: Topology Optimization of multi-directional Soft Pneumatic Actuators
summary: Soft pneumatic actuators (SPAs) are highly promising and have been extensively explored within the field of soft robotics. Under pneumatic pressure loads, an SPA undergoes bending deformation to perform specific tasks. A multi- or omni-directional SPA can bend and move in any direction within a 3D space, leveraging its multiple degrees of freedom to realize various mechanical functions. This work presents a systematic methodology using topology optimization (TO) to achieve an optimized design for a multi-directional SPAs. To ensure manufacturing robustness, a three-field TO formulation considering blueprint, dilated, and eroded designs is implemented. Additionally, Darcy's law, incorporating a drainage term, is used to model the design-dependent nature of the pneumatic loading. A min-max optimization problem is formulated based on the target output deformations of the SPA unit and solved using the Method of Moving Asymptotes. The optimization yields a high-performing, unconventional geometric design. Finally, numerical simulations demonstrate that the optimized SPA successfully achieves versatile multi-directional movements.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于拓扑优化的系统化方法，用于设计多方向软体气动执行器（SPA），并通过数值仿真验证其多方向运动能力。
AI.motivation: SPA在软体机器人领域潜力巨大，但多方向或全方向SPA的设计仍具挑战，需兼顾气动载荷、制造鲁棒性和目标变形。
AI.method: 采用考虑blueprint、dilated和eroded设计的三场拓扑优化公式保证制造鲁棒性；利用带排水项的达西定律模拟气动载荷的设计依赖性；构建基于目标输出变形的min-max优化问题，并用移动渐近线法求解。
AI.result: 优化得到高性能且非传统的几何构型；数值仿真表明优化后的SPA能够成功实现多样的多方向运动。
AI.conclusion: 该拓扑优化方法可有效设计多方向SPA，并实现灵活的多方向变形与运动。

title: MVP-SLAM: Multi-Camera Visual-Inertial Floorplan-Prior SLAM
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures. Submitted to IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L)
summary: Indoor building construction sites are demanding environments for visual SLAM, where variable lighting and repetitive, low-textured structures make the system drift over long trajectories, though structural elements such as walls remain distinguishable despite these conditions. These buildings are constructed according to their as-planned floor plans, available from the design phase, and although the actual as-built site can differ from this design, floor plans still provide a metric reference, both to localize the system in the building and to correct drift. Existing methods often use the floor plan to correct an already-built trajectory offline, and those that instead correct it online typically rely on depth sensors. We instead present MVP-SLAM, an online visual-inertial SLAM on two opposite-facing fisheye cameras that corrects drift from cameras alone by matching walls detected in its map to the floor plan, through a drift-aware policy. A multi-stage integration then turns each matched pair incrementally into a persistent correction, so the trajectory stays corrected and localized within the floor plan as it is built. MVP-SLAM was validated on the multi-floor construction sites of the Hilti-Trimble SLAM Challenge 2026, ranking 2nd of 22 teams in the Localization task (0.29 m mean RMSE) and 5th of 62 teams in the SLAM task (0.24 m), the top-ranked one in both tasks among those that operate online, integrate the floor plan, and localize within it.

AI.tldr: MVP-SLAM 是一种在线视觉惯性 SLAM 系统，使用两个相对鱼眼相机，通过将地图中检测到的墙壁与楼层平面图匹配来在线校正漂移，并在 Hilti-Trimble SLAM Challenge 2026 中取得优秀排名。
AI.motivation: 室内建筑工地光照变化大、纹理重复且稀少，导致视觉 SLAM 长轨迹漂移，但墙壁等结构仍可区分。建筑按设计平面图建造，平面图可作为度量参考来定位和校正漂移，而现有方法多离线校正或依赖深度传感器在线校正。
AI.method: 提出 MVP-SLAM，在线视觉惯性 SLAM，仅用两个相对鱼眼相机。通过漂移感知策略将地图中检测到的墙壁与平面图匹配，多阶段集成将每个匹配对逐步转化为持久校正，使轨迹在构建过程中保持校正并定位在平面图内。
AI.result: 在 Hilti-Trimble SLAM Challenge 2026 的多层建筑工地验证：Localization 任务 22 支队伍中排名第 2（平均 RMSE 0.29 m），SLAM 任务 62 支队伍中排名第 5（0.24 m），在同时在线运行、集成平面图并定位的团队中两项均排名第一。
AI.conclusion: MVP-SLAM 验证了仅使用相机在线校正漂移的可行性，能够利用平面图实现建筑工地中的高精度定位与建图。

title: The Golden Path Hypothesis: Reusable Schedules in Diffusion Caching
summary: Diffusion caching accelerates generation by replacing transformer computation with cached or predicted features at selected denoising steps. We introduce the Golden Path Hypothesis (GPH): under fixed inference conditions, prompt-independent cache schedules can achieve final-output quality comparable to the best prompt-specific schedules across prompts. We investigate the GPH across ten caching methods, four image and video models, and three cache ratios. Prompt-adaptive methods repeatedly select a small number of schedules, and reusing their most frequent schedules on new prompts closely matches the quality of prompt-specific choices. Exhaustive evaluation of 1.4 million schedules on four examples further identifies prompt-independent schedules that remain competitive on unseen prompts. To explain this transfer, we analyze denoising trajectories and the accumulation of caching errors. Latent-state trajectories exhibit similar structures across datasets and seeds, while an exact error decomposition shows that accumulated effects of earlier errors predict final latent-state error better than local approximation errors. This motivates searching for end-to-end schedules using final-output quality. With only a small set of examples, the resulting golden paths transfer across prompts and datasets, and can be tuned to the desired quality objective, including reconstruction fidelity or perceptual similarity.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“黄金路径假设”（GPH）：在固定推理条件下，与提示无关的缓存调度可达到与最佳提示特定调度相当的质量。作者在多种缓存方法、模型和缓存比例上验证了该假设，并发现可利用频繁调度和端到端搜索得到可迁移的黄金路径。
AI.motivation: 扩散缓存通过缓存或预测特征替代部分去噪步的Transformer计算来加速生成，但缓存调度通常依赖具体提示或样本，需要为每个新提示重新调整。研究旨在探究是否存在提示无关的通用缓存调度，从而简化并泛化缓存加速。
AI.method: 在十种缓存方法、四个图像与视频模型、三种缓存比例上研究GPH。让提示自适应方法反复选择少量调度，并将其最频繁调度复用于新提示；在四个样本上穷举评估140万种调度以寻找提示无关调度。分析去噪轨迹与缓存误差累积，并进行精确误差分解，证明早期误差的累积效应比局部近似误差更能预测最终隐状态误差。基于最终输出质量进行端到端调度搜索。
AI.result: 提示自适应方法的最频繁调度在新提示上接近提示特定调度的质量；穷举搜索找到的提示无关调度在未见提示上仍具竞争力。隐状态轨迹在不同数据集和随机种子间结构相似。早期缓存误差的累积效应对最终隐状态误差的预测优于局部近似误差。仅用少量样本搜索得到的黄金路径可跨提示和数据集迁移，并可按重建保真度或感知相似度等目标调节。
AI.conclusion: GPH得到支持，提示无关的缓存调度可以取得与提示特定调度相当的质量，说明扩散缓存存在可迁移的黄金路径。这为无需逐提示调优的高效缓存提供了依据，也表明最终质量更受缓存误差累积影响，端到端搜索可针对不同质量目标生成通用调度。

title: When Can Text Replace Vision? Structural Bottlenecks in Diagram Reasoning
summary: Can structured text replace vision for diagram reasoning? A wrong answer after textualization can arise because the representation omits information the question needs, or because the solver fails to use information that is present. We introduce a diagnostic protocol to distinguish these explanations. Using the same solver model and generation settings, we compare three input conditions: the original image, question-blind structure extracted by a vision-language model, or gold structure derived from the diagram source. Validity-triggered recovery tests truncation and schema failure, question-relevant fidelity measures preservation of answer-critical structure, and matched edge interventions test the effect of error location. On a reserved holdout of 240 public FlowGen diagrams, evaluated under a frozen protocol, gold structure reaches 87% accuracy while direct vision and learned text both remain below 30%. The aggregate comparison includes source-derived relation labels that may not be printed in the image and uses different learned and gold graph encodings, so it does not isolate extraction error alone. Retrying only invalid extractions makes nearly every public representation schema-valid yet leaves accuracy essentially unchanged. The public learned-text deficit relative to gold more than doubles with structural difficulty. Question-relevant topology predicts correctness better than whole-graph topology. In an exposed intervention study, a single answer-relevant edge edit reduces the primary solver's original-answer accuracy to near zero, while matched irrelevant edits largely preserve it. Supplied structure requires fewer solving tokens than vision, but learned acquisition removes this advantage at single use. These comparisons motivate evaluating acquired text by the answer-relevant evidence it preserves and by the solver's ability to use that representation.

AI.tldr: 论文研究结构化文本能否替代视觉进行图表推理，并提出诊断协议区分“表示遗漏所需信息”与“求解器未使用已有信息”。在240个FlowGen图保留集上，金标结构准确率达87%，而原始视觉和VLM学得文本均低于30%。
AI.motivation: 文本化后答错可能源于表示遗漏问题所需信息，也可能源于求解器未能利用已存在的信息；需要区分这两种失败原因，并评估学得文本是否保留答案相关证据以及求解器能否有效使用该表示。
AI.method: 在同一求解器与生成设置下比较三种输入：原始图像、VLM问题盲提取结构、由图源得到的金标结构。采用有效性触发恢复测试截断与模式失败，问题相关保真度衡量答案关键结构保留，匹配边干预测试错误位置影响。在240个公开FlowGen图保留集上按冻结协议评估。
AI.result: 金标结构达到87%准确率，直接视觉与学得文本均低于30%。仅重试无效提取可使几乎全部公开表示模式有效，但准确率基本不变。学得文本相对金标的差距随结构难度增大而翻倍以上。问题相关拓扑比全图拓扑更能预测正确性。单条答案相关边编辑使主求解器原始答案准确率降至近零，匹配无关编辑基本保持。结构化输入比视觉使用更少求解token，但学得获取在单次使用时消除该优势。
AI.conclusion: 应依据学得文本保留的答案相关证据以及求解器利用该表示的能力来评估，而非仅看聚合准确率或模式有效性；简单文本化不能替代视觉，诊断需分离提取误差与求解器使用失败。

title: MindWorldBench: Evaluating Mental-State-to-Behavior Reasoning in Image-to-Video Generation
comment: 7 pages, 6 figures. Accepted by ACM Multimedia 2026
summary: Current image-to-video models achieve visual realism and physical plausibility, but reasoning about mental states remains unexplored. Actions are driven by belief, desire, and perception, requiring inference beyond explicit instructions. We introduce MindWorldBench to evaluate mental-state-conditioned video generation. We formalize this as mental-state-to-behavior reasoning, where models generate actions from a world state and latent variables without explicit action prompts. MindWorldBench utilizes Zero-Action Prompting and a counterfactual design with 744 prompts to isolate the causal effects of mental states. An automated pipeline evaluates video quality, commonsense plausibility, and mental-state consistency. Evaluations of 11 models show that despite visual fidelity and physical reasoning, models fail to align behaviors with latent mental states. We identify a failure mode, termed Omniscient Bias, where models default to the objective world state rather than human's subjective belief. These results demonstrate a disconnect between visual generation and cognitive reasoning, suggesting a need for explicit mental-state modeling in video generation systems. Project website: https://richard2049-lee.github.io/MindWorldBench/

AI.tldr: 论文提出 MindWorldBench，用于评估心理状态条件下的视频生成。其形式化为心理状态到行为的推理，采用 Zero-Action Prompting 和反事实设计（744 个提示）隔离心理状态的因果效应，并自动评估视频质量、常识合理性和心理状态一致性。对 11 个模型的评测显示，模型虽具视觉保真与物理推理能力，却无法让行为与潜在心理状态对齐；还发现“全知偏见”，即模型默认客观世界状态而非人的主观信念。
AI.motivation: 当前图像到视频模型在视觉真实感和物理合理性上表现良好，但尚未探索心理状态推理。人类行为由信念、欲望和感知驱动，因此模型需要超越显式指令进行推断。
AI.method: 引入 MindWorldBench 基准，将任务形式化为心理状态到行为的推理，即从世界状态和潜在变量生成动作，且不提供显式动作提示。采用 Zero-Action Prompting 与反事实设计，包含 744 个提示，以隔离心理状态的因果效应。使用自动流水线评估视频质量、常识合理性和心理状态一致性。
AI.result: 对 11 个模型的评估表明，尽管这些模型具备视觉保真度和物理推理能力，但仍无法使生成行为与潜在心理状态保持一致。研究识别出一种失败模式，称为“全知偏见”（Omniscient Bias），即模型倾向于默认客观世界状态，而不是人物的主观信念。
AI.conclusion: 结果揭示了视觉生成与认知推理之间的脱节，说明视频生成系统需要显式的心理状态建模。

title: Towards Agile Vision-Based Multi-UAV Flight: Revisiting State Estimation
comment: This work has been accepted to the IEEE for possible publication (IROS 2026)
summary: Agile multi-UAV flight requires accurate and low-latency onboard estimation of the kinematic states of neighboring UAVs for collision avoidance, motion coordination, etc. Most vision-based approaches rely on position-only measurements, inferring velocity and acceleration indirectly from displacement. We show that this introduces a fixed structural delay in the estimation of higher-order states, which limits the achievable agility. To address this, we propose to integrate tilt measurements, provided by a state-of-the-art visual detector, which inform about the thrust direction of co-planar multirotor UAVs. We benchmark four position-only and five pose-aware estimators, including a novel formulation of a linear thrust-constraining Kalman filter, on two real-world and one high-fidelity photorealistic simulated dataset over different levels of agility (3-21 m/s^2). In our setup, pose-aware estimation consistently reduces the average velocity and acceleration estimation errors by 40% and 57% across the three datasets with the proposed KF formulation outperforming the other estimators. Position-only filters exhibit a constant ~300 ms delay in acceleration step response independent of agility, whereas the tilt-constrained estimators operate near the physical response limit given by the camera frame-rate by observing the change in thrust direction before the displacement accumulates. In a closed-loop leader-follower simulated experiment with NMPC control, position-only estimation of the leader's state fails to facilitate stable hovering of the follower, while the proposed estimator enables tracking of lateral maneuvers exceeding 2g of acceleration.

AI.tldr: 论文指出仅依赖位置测量估计邻机运动状态会引入固定的结构延迟，限制多无人机敏捷飞行；提出融合倾斜/推力方向测量的姿态感知估计方法，并在真实与仿真数据集及闭环控制中验证其能显著降低速度、加速度估计误差并支持高敏捷跟踪。
AI.motivation: 敏捷多无人机飞行需要准确且低延迟地估计邻机运动状态，以支持避碰和运动协调。多数视觉方法仅使用位置测量，通过位移间接推断速度和加速度，这会引入高阶状态估计的固定结构延迟，从而限制可实现敏捷性。
AI.method: 利用先进视觉检测器提供的倾斜测量，获取共面多旋翼无人机的推力方向信息；基准测试4种仅位置估计器和5种姿态感知估计器，包括一种新的线性推力约束卡尔曼滤波器；在2个真实世界数据集和1个高保真照片级仿真数据集上评估，敏捷度为3至21 m/s²；并进行NMPC领航-跟随闭环仿真实验。
AI.result: 姿态感知估计在三个数据集上平均将速度估计误差降低40%、加速度估计误差降低57%，其中所提卡尔曼滤波公式优于其他估计器。仅位置滤波器在加速度阶跃响应中表现出约300 ms的恒定延迟，且与敏捷度无关；倾斜约束估计器接近相机帧率给出的物理响应极限，因为在位移累积前即可观察到推力方向变化。闭环领航-跟随仿真中，仅位置估计领导者状态无法使跟随者稳定悬停，而所提估计器可跟踪超过2g加速度的横向机动。
AI.conclusion: 融合倾斜/推力方向信息的姿态感知估计能消除仅位置测量带来的结构延迟，显著提高邻机速度与加速度估计精度，并支持更敏捷、稳定的多无人机编队飞行。

title: Stress-Testing LLM Lie Detectors: Role-Play Failures and Spurious Correlations
summary: Lie detection probes aim to predict from a language model's internal states whether its output is truthful or dishonest. However, role-play complicates what "truth" means for an LLM: language models can adopt a wide range of personas that take very different claims to be true, including personas whose beliefs clearly contradict reality, such as a conspiracy theorist. In this work, we investigate whether lie detection probes reliably flag falsehoods generated under such an anti-factual persona or whether they instead follow the persona's beliefs. We introduce a dataset of 8,916 human-reviewed, on-policy responses from three LLMs adopting anti-factual personas. Evaluating eight probes from prior work, we find that many fail in this setting, particularly when correct and incorrect answers are evaluated under the same persona prompt. To investigate why, we construct three novel confounder datasets in which truth is anti-correlated with a potential confounding concept. Our experiments reveal that many existing probes strongly track concepts that are spuriously correlated with truth in their training data, such as instruction compliance or response likelihood. Based on these findings, we introduce a simple linear probe that achieves the strongest overall performance on both the persona and confounder stress tests. Our results suggest that current lie detection probes are far from reliable and highlight the need for training data in which truth is decorrelated from confounding concepts.

AI.tldr: 该研究检验LLM内部状态谎言检测探针在反事实人格角色扮演下是否可靠，发现许多现有探针会失败，因为它们追踪的是与真值虚假相关的混杂概念；作者提出一个简单线性探针，在人格与混杂压力测试中总体表现最佳。
AI.motivation: 角色扮演使LLM的“真相”变得复杂：模型可采纳与现实现实相矛盾的反事实人格。研究动机是探究谎言检测探针究竟能标记虚假输出，还是会跟随角色人格的信念。
AI.method: 构建包含8,916个经人工审核、来自三个LLM采用反事实人格的on-policy响应数据集；评估八个已有探针；构造三个新混杂数据集，使真值与潜在混杂概念反相关；并基于发现提出一个简单线性探针。
AI.result: 许多现有探针在反事实人格设置下失败，尤其在同一人格提示下评估正确与错误答案时。实验表明，这些探针强烈追踪训练数据中与真值虚假相关的概念，如指令遵循程度或响应可能性。新提出的简单线性探针在人格和混杂压力测试中取得最强总体性能。
AI.conclusion: 当前谎言检测探针远不可靠；需要构建真值与混杂概念去相关的训练数据，以提升LLM谎言检测的鲁棒性。

title: On the Complexity of Preference-Based Bandits
summary: We study preference-based bandits with general reward function classes, where a learner sequentially selects pairs of arms and observes binary preference feedback governed by the Bradley--Terry model. This setting naturally arises in applications such as recommender systems, tournament ranking, and learning from human feedback, where relative preferences are easier to elicit than absolute rewards. The observation model inherits the logistic bandit challenge of handling the problem-dependent constant $κ$, which accounts for the non-linearity of the link function and can grow arbitrarily large. Moreover, prior work has predominantly focused on linear or kernelized reward models, precluding the use of richer function classes. To address these limitations, we consider general reward function classes and introduce the \emph{locally sensitive eluder dimension}, a novel complexity measure tailored to the logistic structure of preference feedback that yields fine-grained regret guarantees without unfavorable dependence on $κ$. Building on this notion, we propose \textbf{GINOP} (Generic INformative OPtimism), an algorithm that constructs log-loss confidence sets and jointly selects arm pairs to balance optimism and informative exploration. We establish a first-order regret bound that, in contrast with what previous results suggest, demonstrates that learning with preference feedback is as statistically efficient as learning from direct reward observation. Finally, we corroborate our theoretical findings with empirical evaluations against competitive baselines.

AI.tldr: 研究一般奖励函数类下的偏好赌博机，提出局部敏感eluder维度和GINOP算法，实现不依赖κ的一阶遗憾界，并通过实验验证。
AI.motivation: 偏好反馈在推荐、排名和人类反馈学习中更易获得，但现有研究多局限于线性或核奖励模型，且Bradley-Terry偏好模型继承了logistic赌博机中κ常数任意增大导致的问题。
AI.method: 针对偏好反馈的logistic结构定义局部敏感eluder维度；提出GINOP算法，构建对数损失置信集，并联合选择臂对以平衡乐观与信息探索。
AI.result: 建立一阶遗憾界，避免了先前结果对κ的不利依赖，表明偏好反馈学习在统计效率上可与直接奖励观测相当；实验显示优于竞争基线。
AI.conclusion: 一般奖励函数类下的偏好赌博机可以高效学习，所提出的复杂度度量与GINOP算法有效解决了κ依赖和函数类受限问题。

title: Autoresearch in Mixed-Integer Linear and Nonlinear Programming
summary: Despite recent progress in autoresearch, applying it to practical operations research problems, typically formulated as NP-hard mixed-integer linear or nonlinear programs (MILPs or MINLPs), remains challenging because effective research requires systematically managing competing ideas and long-horizon experimental trajectories. We introduce AutoMIP, a reusable agent skill for organizing long-horizon autoresearch in mixed-integer programming through idea pooling and algorithm tree search. AutoMIP maintains a persistent pool of complementary candidate ideas while organizing executable experiments into an algorithm tree, enabling the agent to preserve unexplored hypotheses, refine promising algorithms, and switch to alternative methodological directions based on historical states. On MILP and MINLP benchmark cohorts, AutoMIP achieves the highest final success rates among the evaluated autoresearch frameworks. On MIPLib, AutoMIP discovers new best solutions for 31 of 60 instances, surpassing existing autoresearch frameworks. On MINLPLib, it achieves new best solutions for 52 of 60 instances. Ablation studies further demonstrate the complementary contributions of idea pooling and algorithm tree search, highlighting the importance of jointly maintaining diverse research ideas and structured experimental trajectories for long-horizon autoresearch.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AutoMIP，一种用于混合整数规划长周期自动研究的可复用智能体技能，通过想法池与算法树搜索来组织研究过程，并在 MILP/MINLP 基准上取得优于现有自动研究框架的结果。
AI.motivation: 将自动研究应用于实际运筹优化问题仍很困难，因为 MILP/MINLP 通常是 NP-hard，且有效研究需要系统管理相互竞争的想法和长周期实验轨迹。
AI.method: AutoMIP 维护一个持续更新的候选想法池，并将可执行实验组织为算法树，使智能体能够保留未探索假设、改进有前景算法，并根据历史状态切换到其他方法方向。
AI.result: 在 MILP 和 MINLP 基准测试中，AutoMIP 取得最高最终成功率；在 MIPLib 上为 60 个实例中的 31 个发现新最优解，在 MINLPLib 上为 60 个实例中的 52 个发现新最优解，均超过现有自动研究框架。
AI.conclusion: 消融实验表明想法池和算法树搜索具有互补贡献，说明在长周期自动研究中同时维护多样研究想法与结构化实验轨迹非常重要。

title: Prediction is Better than Detection: Traffic Congestion Control using Drones
summary: A central question in deploying teams of mobile robots for persistent monitoring is how task performance scales with fleet size, and whether this scaling holds once sensing drives downstream action rather than mere observation. We study this question for a team of drones performing traffic-jam detection and prediction in a simulated road network, whose reports drive an adaptive traffic-signal controller in closed loop. We build a multi-agent simulation, with vehicles following Nagel-Schreckenberg cellular-automaton dynamics and drones patrolling junctions via a round-robin policy, and sweep fleet size, traffic level, and network size to evaluate detection rate, detection delay, and prediction rate. We show how performance plateaus for fleet size approximating the number of junctions being monitored, and offer a general fleet-provisioning rule for persistent-monitoring deployments. More significantly, adapting the signal on a predicted jam, rather than a detected one, roughly doubles the resulting reduction in jam duration, showing that the value of onboard prediction in a sensing-to-action pipeline can exceed the value of adding more robots. Prediction accuracy, not sensing coverage, is now the binding constraint on further improvement, pointing to onboard inference, not fleet size, as the more promising direction for future work.

AI.tldr: 研究无人机队规模对交通拥堵检测与预测性能的缩放规律，并评估预测驱动信号控制闭环中的价值。
AI.motivation: 部署移动机器人团队进行持续监测时，需了解任务性能如何随车队规模扩展，以及当感知驱动下游行动而非仅观测时该规律是否仍然成立。
AI.method: 构建多智能体仿真，车辆采用Nagel-Schreckenberg元胞自动机，无人机按轮询策略巡逻路口，扫描车队规模、交通水平和路网规模，评估检测率、检测延迟和预测率。
AI.result: 性能在车队规模接近监测路口数量时趋于平台；基于预测拥堵调整信号比基于检测拥堵约使拥堵持续时间减少量翻倍；预测精度而非感知覆盖成为进一步改进的瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 在感知到行动的闭环中，机载预测的价值可超过增加机器人数量；未来方向应侧重机载推理而非扩大车队规模，并给出持续监测部署的车队配置规则。

title: TripleFlow: Training-Free Video Object Removal by Bridging Residual Editing and Native Generation
summary: Video object removal presents a uniquely difficult editing challenge. Because a removal prompt specifies only what to erase rather than what to generate, the model must infer and reconstruct a highly specific occluded background entirely from the surrounding context. Existing training-free methods struggle with this because their editing mechanisms act primarily as localized erasers. They fail to actively synthesize the missing background details and often leave behind ghosting artifacts. To solve this, we propose TripleFlow, a training-free framework that tightly couples erasure and generation. It coordinates a source flow, a residual flow, and a synthesis flow throughout the entire process. By reusing a single target prediction, the residual flow isolates and suppresses the object, while the synthesis flow independently reconstructs the occluded background. Crucially, TripleFlow injects this newly synthesized background back into the editing trajectory at every step. This continuous feedback loop ensures that the generated structures actively guide the removal process, achieving seamless completion that is spatiotemporally consistent with the unedited scene. Extensive evaluations across five challenging benchmarks demonstrate that TripleFlow establishes a new state-of-the-art, significantly outperforming existing baselines in both reconstruction fidelity and temporal consistency.

AI.tldr: 提出一种免训练的视频物体移除框架TripleFlow，通过紧密耦合擦除与生成，实现高质量、时序一致的背景重建。
AI.motivation: 视频物体移除仅指定要擦除的内容而非生成内容，模型需从周围上下文推断并重建被遮挡的背景。现有免训练方法主要充当局部擦除器，无法主动合成缺失背景细节，常留下鬼影伪影。
AI.method: 提出TripleFlow免训练框架，协调源流、残差流和合成流。复用单一目标预测，残差流隔离并抑制物体，合成流独立重建被遮挡背景，并在每一步将新合成背景注入编辑轨迹，形成连续反馈回路。
AI.result: 在五个挑战性基准上评估，TripleFlow在重建保真度和时序一致性上均显著优于现有基线，达到新的最先进水平。
AI.conclusion: TripleFlow通过生成与擦除的紧密耦合及连续反馈，实现了与未编辑场景时空一致的无缝补全，验证了主动合成背景对视频物体移除的有效性。

title: EHR-RobustGym: Benchmarking and Training Agents for Robust Clinical Reasoning
summary: In hospital workflows, electronic health records (EHRs) are often noisy, and may not contain the evidence needed to confirm events or measurements referenced in a clinical query. Even when database retrieval succeeds, clinical agents can overlook such discrepancies and return plausible but unsupported answers. We introduce EHR-RobustGym, a scalable and interactive environment for evaluating and training robust clinical agents grounded in noisy EHRs. Built on MIMIC-IV hospital records (365K patients, 31 tables, and over 500M records), EHR-RobustGym comprises 5,486 Clean-Noise pairs spanning six clinical intents and both patient-level and population-level queries. The pairs test robustness to Record-level, Value-level, and Query-level noise, while interactive SQL/Python execution and outcome verification support trajectory collection and training. Evaluating multiple LLMs reveals substantial robustness gaps: average task success across proprietary and large-scale open-weight models drops from 62.2% on Clean questions to 37.9% on Noise questions. At k=4, pass^k consistency falls below 50% for most evaluated models, exposing instability in clinical task completion. Supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning in EHR-RobustGym improve performance, with gains generalizing to five external EHR benchmarks. Together, these results position EHR-RobustGym as a testbed for evaluating and improving the evidence-grounded robustness of clinical agents.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 EHR-RobustGym，一个基于 MIMIC-IV 的可扩展交互环境，用于评估和训练在噪声电子健康记录（EHR）中稳健的临床智能体。
AI.motivation: 医院工作流中的 EHR 常含噪声，可能缺少确认临床查询所需证据；即使数据库检索成功，临床智能体也可能忽略差异并给出看似合理但无依据的答案。
AI.method: 构建 EHR-RobustGym，基于 MIMIC-IV（36.5万患者、31张表、超5亿记录），包含5,486个 Clean-Noise 配对，覆盖六类临床意图及患者级和人群级查询，测试记录级、值级和查询级噪声；支持交互式 SQL/Python 执行与结果验证，用于轨迹收集和训练。
AI.result: 评估多个 LLM 发现显著稳健性差距：平均任务成功率从 Clean 问题的62.2%降至 Noise 问题的37.9%；k=4 时多数模型 pass^k 一致性低于50%。在 EHR-RobustGym 中进行监督微调和强化学习可提升性能，且增益可泛化到五个外部 EHR 基准。
AI.conclusion: EHR-RobustGym 可作为评估和改进临床智能体基于证据的稳健性的测试平台。

title: OP-CAD: On-Policy Clean-Audio Distillation for Robust Audio-Visual Reasoning
summary: Omni-modal large language models deployed in real-world environments encounter external noise that can interfere with their perception and understanding of multimodal inputs. We study their robustness in audio-visual understanding, focusing on question answering under environmental noise and competing speech. The challenge is to resist acoustic interference while preserving useful audio evidence. On-policy distillation provides dense teacher feedback on student-generated responses, but uniform token weighting does not explicitly prioritize positions affected by acoustic interference. We introduce OP-CAD (On-Policy Clean-Audio Distillation), a curriculum-based privileged self-distillation framework for robust audio-visual understanding. Training progresses from mild to severe environmental noise and competing speech, with selective token-level supervision at each stage. The student generates responses from corrupted audio-visual input, while a frozen teacher uses clean audio and the verified answer to supervise the same response prefixes. To allocate this supervision, OP-CAD compares teacher predictions under clean, corrupted, and visual-only contexts without revealing the answer. These matched comparisons measure sensitivity to audio removal and corruption; a bounded weighting rule emphasizes positions identified by either signal while retaining supervision throughout the response. OP-CAD outperforms the compared methods across all evaluated noise conditions. Paired analyses further show improved preservation of clean-correct answers under strong interference, with no observed aggregate clean-accuracy penalty. These results demonstrate the value of directing clean-teacher supervision toward acoustically sensitive predictions for robust audio-visual reasoning.

AI.tldr: 论文研究全模态大模型在环境噪声与竞争语音下的音视频理解鲁棒性，提出 OP-CAD：一种基于课程学习的特权自蒸馏框架，通过选择性 token 监督提升抗噪能力。
AI.motivation: 真实环境中的外部噪声会干扰全模态大模型对多模态输入的感知与理解；现有 on-policy 蒸馏虽提供密集反馈，但均匀 token 加权未能优先关注受声学干扰影响的位置。
AI.method: 提出 OP-CAD（On-Policy Clean-Audio Distillation）。训练课程从轻度到重度环境噪声和竞争语音推进，并在各阶段进行选择性 token 级监督。学生模型基于受损音视频输入生成回答，冻结教师模型使用干净音频和已验证答案监督相同回答前缀。方法通过比较教师模型在干净、受损和纯视觉上下文下的预测，在不泄露答案的情况下测量对音频移除和损坏的敏感性，并用有界加权规则强调由任一信号识别的位置，同时保留整段回答的监督。
AI.result: OP-CAD 在所有评估噪声条件下均优于对比方法。配对分析进一步表明，在强干扰下能更好保留原本干净条件下正确的答案，且未观察到总体干净准确率损失。
AI.conclusion: 将干净教师监督引导至对声学干扰敏感预测的位置，有助于实现鲁棒的音视频推理。

title: Synthetic Pre-pretraining Survives Scale, but Not as a Grammatical Prior
summary: Pre-pretraining (PPT) on synthetic non-natural language data improves token efficiency during language model pre-training (PT). Prior work attributes this gain to a grammatical prior, i.e., a structural inductive bias learned during PPT that transfers to natural language grammar. However, PPT has only been tested on models of at most 1B parameters and PT budgets below 2B tokens on predominantly web text. It is unknown whether PPT is effective at larger scales and under more realistic PT data mixtures that combine diverse sources (e.g., code and math). We therefore present a comprehensive study on PPT spanning five PPT tasks, four PT data mixtures, four parameter scales (500M to 7B), and PT budgets of up to 100B tokens. Our results demonstrate that the downstream performance and token efficiency gains of PPT persist at scale, e.g., saving at least 21B PT tokens at the 3B scale. However, in contrast to prior work, we find no consistent evidence that these gains stem from a grammatical prior. Downstream performance does not consistently align with grammatical acceptability across model sizes. Instead, we find that downstream gains arise from PPT tasks that improve long-range retrieval. Finally, PPT performance gains are robust to how PT data mixtures are composed and diminish only when web text is absent. Overall, PPT is a low-cost addition to PT, and future PPT task design should target long-range retrieval rather than natural language grammar.

AI.tldr: 本文对预预训练（PPT）进行大规模综合研究，发现其提升语言模型预训练token效率的增益可扩展到更大规模，但并非源于语法先验，而是来自改善长程检索的PPT任务。
AI.motivation: 先前PPT仅在不超过1B参数、预训练预算低于2B token且以网页文本为主的设置下验证，并将其增益归因于语法先验；尚不清楚在更大规模、更真实的多源预训练数据混合下PPT是否仍有效及其机制。
AI.method: 开展覆盖5种PPT任务、4种预训练数据混合、4种参数规模（500M至7B）以及最高100B token预训练预算的综合实验。
AI.result: PPT的下游性能和token效率增益随规模持续存在，例如在3B规模至少节省21B预训练token；但未发现一致证据表明增益源于语法先验，下游性能与语法可接受性在不同规模下不一致；增益主要来自改善长程检索的PPT任务；PPT效果对预训练数据混合方式稳健，仅在缺少网页文本时减弱。
AI.conclusion: PPT是预训练的低成本补充；未来PPT任务设计应针对长程检索，而非自然语言语法。

title: When a Kindergartener Solves Calculus: Measuring Capability Leakage in Role-Prompted Reasoning Models
summary: We investigate the problem of role-capability leakage (RCL), in which a role-prompted reasoning model generates convincing in-role text while continuing to exhibit capabilities on benchmarks that exceed those implied by the assigned role. For example, when a model is prompted to assume the role of a kindergarten student, one might expect its performance on a mathematics benchmark to reflect kindergarten-level ability rather than expert-level proficiency in solving calculus problems. We introduce RoleCapBench, a curriculum-grounded benchmark for evaluating RCL across six educational roles and four assessment levels spanning elementary school through A-level, and use it to evaluate three open-weight reasoning models. We find that although the models can generate stylistically convincing in-role responses, they consistently fail to align their underlying capabilities with their assigned roles. Naive role prompting yields strong role-voice scores of 1.218--1.389 while retaining above-role accuracy of 0.811--0.898. RCL persists across a range of prompting conditions, including prompts that explicitly instruct the model to match the role's capability level. To mitigate this problem, we propose Injection, an inference-time intervention that combines explicit, role-specific capability guidelines with a guiding prefilled response prefix. Injection improves role-capability alignment across models, reducing above-role accuracy by up to 0.562 while preserving in-role accuracy with a marginal drop of less than 0.058 across most models. All artifacts, including scripts and evaluation data, will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 论文研究“角色-能力泄漏”（RCL）问题：角色提示的推理模型能生成符合角色风格的文本，但在基准测试中仍表现出超出所设定角色的能力。作者提出RoleCapBench基准进行评估，并发现该问题普遍存在，进而提出推理时干预方法Injection以缓解。
AI.motivation: 现有推理模型在被提示扮演特定角色时，可能只是在语言风格上模仿角色，而底层能力并未与角色匹配，例如扮演幼儿园学生却仍能解微积分。这种角色与能力不一致会削弱角色提示的可信度和可控性，因此需要系统评估并缓解。
AI.method: 构建RoleCapBench基准，覆盖六个教育角色和四个评估层级（从小学到A-level），用于评估角色-能力泄漏。对三个开放权重推理模型进行评测，并测试多种提示条件。提出Injection推理时干预方法，结合角色特定的能力指南和引导性预填充回答前缀。
AI.result: 朴素角色提示下，模型角色语气得分较高（1.218–1.389），但仍保持超角色准确率（0.811–0.898），即使明确要求匹配角色能力水平，RCL依然存在。Injection能改善角色-能力对齐，将超角色准确率最多降低0.562，同时在多数模型上仅使角色内准确率轻微下降（小于0.058）。
AI.conclusion: 角色提示并未真正限制模型能力，RCL是当前推理模型中的普遍问题。通过Injection等推理时干预，可以在较小损害角色内表现的情况下提升角色与能力的一致性。所有脚本和评估数据将在论文被接收后发布。

title: From Local Whole-Body VLA Behaviors to Scene-Scale Aerial Manipulation
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models enable task-conditioned interaction, but extending them to scene-scale aerial manipulation remains challenging due to costly whole-body demonstrations, latency-induced action-state misalignment, and cross-site behavior composition. We present a unified framework for synthetic policy training and scene-scale execution on articulated uncrewed aerial manipulators (UAMs). A scene-reconfigurable pipeline synthesizes task-conditioned, kinodynamically feasible trajectories and synchronized multiview observations for VLA training without physical-platform demonstrations. Measured-progress-aligned realization (MPAR) aligns asynchronously returned action chunks with measured execution progress and realizes them as continuous, dynamically feasible trajectories. A relational Scene Graph grounds language goals to object instances and feasible interaction regions, while topology-guided transfer connects local behaviors across sites. Local VLA skills achieve 39/60 successes (65.0%) in simulation under oracle target and feasible-handoff conditions. Under 500-ms added latency, with and without a transient command-update stall, MPAR reduces median takeover phase error by 0.212 s over nominal-time alignment. The complete system completes 21/50 simulated multi-site missions (42.0%) and is further validated on a physical articulated UAM.

AI.tldr: 提出面向关节式无人机操作臂（UAM）的场景级空中操作统一框架，涵盖合成策略训练与实机执行，无需物理平台演示。
AI.motivation: VLA模型难以扩展到场景级空中操作，主要受限于全身演示成本高、延迟导致动作-状态错位以及跨场地行为组合困难。
AI.method: 场景可重构流水线合成任务条件、动力学可行轨迹与同步多视角观测；实测进度对齐（MPAR）将异步返回动作块与执行进度对齐并生成连续可行轨迹；关系场景图将语言目标接地到物体与可行交互区域；拓扑引导迁移实现跨场地局部行为连接。
AI.result: 仿真中局部VLA技能在oracle目标与可行交接下成功率65.0%（39/60）；500ms额外延迟下MPAR将中位接管相位误差较名义时间对齐降低0.212s；完整系统完成42.0%（21/50）多站点任务，并在实体关节式UAM上验证。
AI.conclusion: 该框架无需物理演示即可训练VLA并实现场景级执行，可有效缓解延迟错位并支持跨站点任务组合。

title: MEND: Label-Free Detection, Localisation, and Correction of Latent Hallucination in World Models
comment: Accepted at DICTA 2026 (International Conference on Digital Image Computing: Techniques and Applications). Camera-ready version
summary: World Models are appearing as the next major frontier in computer vision. However, their robustness is currently largely unexplored. We identify the phenomenon of hallucination in latent World Models: given a state and an action, the predicted next latent can decode to a scene that never occurs. Because the prediction is statistically ordinary and is fed back autoregressively by the model, the error is both silent and compounding. We study whether such latent hallucination can be detected, localised, and corrected at inference time, on a frozen self-supervised world model in the absence of ground-truth error labels. We introduce Masked Empirical-Bayes Neural Denoising (MEND), a single conditional score network trained by denoising score matching on real transitions, whose score field serves three roles: its magnitude detects hallucination, its per-token field localises it to specific image patches, and it defines an inference-time correction direction. On two navigation environments MEND detects hallucination with an AUROC of up to 0.80 without using actions, exceeding a single-Gaussian density baseline while also localising the error (per-token AUPRC up to 0.87) and correcting it, all from one score field. Our correction reliably reduces single-step latent error and improves predictions. We identify that a part of the error is tangent to the data manifold, hence, we focus on detection and localisation while highlighting promises of the correction.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究潜在世界模型中的幻觉现象：给定状态和动作，预测的下一潜在表示可能解码为从未出现的场景，且误差隐蔽并会自回归累积。作者提出MEND方法，在冻结的自监督世界模型上无需真实误差标签，尝试在推理时检测、定位并修正潜在幻觉。
AI.motivation: 世界模型正成为计算机视觉的重要前沿，但其鲁棒性尚未被充分探索。潜在世界模型会生成统计上普通但实际不存在的场景，导致隐蔽且累积的预测错误，因此需要研究能否在推理阶段检测、定位和修正此类幻觉。
AI.method: 提出Masked Empirical-Bayes Neural Denoising (MEND)，一个在真实转场上通过去噪分数匹配训练的条件分数网络。其分数场有三种用途：分数大小用于检测幻觉，逐token分数场用于将幻觉定位到具体图像块，并定义推理时的修正方向。
AI.result: 在两个导航环境中，MEND不使用动作即可检测幻觉，AUROC最高达0.80，超过单高斯密度基线；逐token定位AUPRC最高达0.87；同时能进行修正。修正可稳定降低单步潜在误差并改善预测。
AI.conclusion: 潜在世界模型中的幻觉可以被检测和定位，部分误差与数据流形相切，因此作者重点强调检测与定位，并指出修正方向具有前景但仍需进一步研究。

title: Making Waves: A Membrane-Coupled Delta Array for Manipulating Objects Below the Actuator Spacing
summary: Distributed manipulator systems manipulate objects through the coordinated motion of many actuators. However, an object must be supported by several actuators at once, so the centre-to-centre actuator spacing imposes a hard lower bound on manipulable object size. We remove this bound by coupling the end-effectors of an 8 x 8 array of three degrees-of-freedom delta robots with a stretchable fabric, turning 64 discrete contacts into a continuous surface capable of manipulating objects smaller than the actuator spacing. Viewing the array as a displacement field over that surface, we investigate local quasi-static and cyclic fields as manipulation primitives. These primitives can be applied globally across the array or locally confined around each tracked object to independently manipulate several objects in parallel. We then train a policy acting on low-order discrete cosine transform coefficients: at equal action dimension, commanding a nineteen-delta neighbourhood halves the placement error of commanding the whole array. The policy transfers to hardware without adaptation at 76% success. The platform manipulates objects from 15mm-90mm, a six-fold range spanning both sides of the actuator spacing, 43.3mm, on a single surface.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用8×8个三自由度Delta机器人端执行器与可拉伸织物耦合，将离散接触变为连续表面，从而突破执行器间距对可操作物体尺寸下限的限制，并实现多物体并行操作与策略迁移。
AI.motivation: 分布式机械臂系统需要多个执行器同时支撑物体，执行器中心间距因此构成可操作物体尺寸的硬性下限；作者希望消除这一限制，使同一表面能操作小于执行器间距的物体。
AI.method: 将8×8 Delta机器人阵列视为织物表面上的位移场，研究局部准静态场和循环场作为操作基元；这些基元可全局施加，也可围绕每个被跟踪物体局部施加以并行操作多个物体。随后训练策略作用于低阶离散余弦变换系数，并比较不同作用范围。
AI.result: 在相同动作维度下，命令19个Delta机器人邻域可将放置误差比命令整个阵列减半；策略无需适配即可迁移到硬件，成功率为76%。平台在单一表面上可操作15mm–90mm物体，覆盖执行器间距43.3mm两侧的六倍尺寸范围。
AI.conclusion: 通过可拉伸织物将离散执行器阵列耦合为连续操作表面，并结合局部位移场基元与低阶DCT策略，能够突破执行器间距限制，实现跨尺度、多目标且可迁移的分布式操作。

title: Experimental Experience Modeling for Autonomous Research
summary: Autonomous research agents can generate hypotheses and conduct experiments, but experimentation remains a major source of computational cost. A fundamental challenge is deciding which experiments are worth running, particularly when prior evidence is insufficient to resolve uncertainty. Yet current research agents lack a systematic way to leverage experimental experience when making such decisions. We introduce Experimental Experience Modeling (EEM), a framework for making informed experimental decisions by acquiring, reusing, and accumulating experimental experience. EEM extracts decision-relevant records from earlier experimental trajectories, distills them into reusable experience, and organizes them in an experience library. For a new experimental decision, EEM retrieves relevant historical experience and assesses whether it provides sufficient support for deciding whether a candidate direction warrants further investment. When historical experience is insufficient, EEM conducts a targeted, low-cost pilot experiment to acquire the missing decision-relevant experience on demand. It then combines this newly acquired experience with retrieved historical experience to determine whether the direction warrants full-scale evaluation, which requires substantial resources. The resulting experimental outcomes are further distilled into reusable experience, allowing the library to continually grow through iterative accumulation. Experiments on autonomous research benchmarks show that EEM improves research performance while reducing model interaction overhead, demonstrating the value of reusing accumulated experience and acquiring additional experience only when needed.

AI.tldr: 提出实验经验建模（EEM）框架，通过获取、复用和积累实验经验来优化自主研究智能体的实验决策，在提升研究性能的同时降低模型交互开销。
AI.motivation: 自主研究智能体虽能生成假设并开展实验，但实验计算成本高昂；核心挑战在于先验证据不足时判断哪些实验值得执行，而现有智能体缺乏系统利用历史实验经验进行决策的机制。
AI.method: EEM从历史实验轨迹中提取决策相关记录，蒸馏为可复用经验并构建经验库；面对新决策时检索相关历史经验并评估其支持是否充分；若不足则按需执行低成本试点实验，结合新旧经验判断是否值得全面评估，并将结果继续蒸馏入经验库，实现迭代积累。
AI.result: 在自主研究基准测试中，EEM提升了研究表现，同时减少了模型交互开销。
AI.conclusion: 复用积累的经验并按需获取额外经验，能有效支持实验决策，展现了经验建模在自主研究中的价值。

title: SkillFM: Generating Skills for LLM Agents via Latent Flow Matching
summary: Textual skills provide reusable guidance for large language model agents, but existing approaches often rely on manually curated skill banks or reinforcement learning with indirect and delayed feedback. We introduce SkillFM (Skill Flow Matching), a generative framework that synthesizes task-conditioned textual skills directly without test-time skill retrieval. Our framework combines a codec for encoding and reconstructing textual skills in a continuous latent space with a conditional flow model trained using improved MeanFlow. At inference time, the learned velocity field enables single-step latent sampling, and an LLM-based decoder converts the sampled representation into textual guidance for a frozen downstream agent. We evaluate the framework on embodied tasks, question answering, and web shopping. On ALFWorld and Search-QA, our method achieves the best overall performance among the compared vector-based skill approaches. Our analyses further demonstrate that latent skill generation is an effective alternative to retrieval-based skill augmentation. Our code and training skill libraries are available at https://github.com/lulushang999/SkillFM.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 SkillFM（Skill Flow Matching），一种生成式框架，可直接合成任务条件下的文本技能，而无需测试时技能检索；它结合连续潜在空间编解码器与改进 MeanFlow 的条件流模型，并在推理时通过单步潜在采样和 LLM 解码器为冻结的下游智能体生成文本指导。
AI.motivation: 现有文本技能虽可为大语言模型智能体提供可复用指导，但通常依赖人工整理技能库，或使用反馈间接且延迟的强化学习；同时测试时技能检索也存在局限。
AI.method: 提出 SkillFM 框架：使用 codec 在连续潜在空间中编码与重建文本技能；训练条件流模型，并采用改进的 MeanFlow；推理时利用学习到的速度场进行单步潜在采样，再由基于 LLM 的解码器将采样表示转换为文本指导，供冻结的下游智能体使用。
AI.result: 在具身任务、问答和网络购物任务上评估。在 ALFWorld 和 Search-QA 上，该方法在基于向量的技能方法中取得最佳整体性能；分析表明潜在技能生成是检索式技能增强的有效替代方案。
AI.conclusion: SkillFM 能够有效生成任务条件文本技能，避免测试时检索，并在多个任务上优于对比的向量技能方法；代码与训练技能库已开源。

title: Cognitive Enhancement: Rethinking the Necessity of Role-Playing for Large Language Models
summary: Role-playing prompting has become a popular yet simple technique for improving LLM reasoning and output quality. However, whether it consistently boosts performance across diverse domains remains unclear, as systematic validation is lacking. To fill this gap, we run multi-model, cross-domain, and multilingual experiments on MMLU and MMLU-Redux. We find that gains from role-play prompting depend heavily on model capacity, knowledge domain, and prompt language. Drawing on metacognition theory, we propose the persona-related cognitive alignment hypothesis: role-play works only when the LLM correctly grasps the designated persona and its associated knowledge domain. We test this hypothesis through persona information richness ablation, layer-wise entropy divergence analysis, and latent thought-space deflection observation. To reduce persona cognitive bias and stabilize role-play performance, we propose \textbf{M}ixed-\textbf{L}anguage \textbf{C}oncatenate \textbf{P}rediction \textbf{(MLCP}), a simple, training-free, and efficient multilingual prompt concatenation strategy. It aggregates semantically equivalent role prompts to enrich complementary representational cues. Extensive experiments show that MLCP consistently outperforms vanilla role-play prompting across all tested LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文系统检验了角色扮演提示对LLM推理与输出质量的影响，发现其效果并不稳定，并提出混合语言拼接预测（MLCP）来提升角色扮演性能。
AI.motivation: 角色扮演提示虽流行且简单，但是否能在不同领域稳定提升LLM表现缺乏系统验证，因此需要探究其生效条件与机制。
AI.method: 在MMLU和MMLU-Redux上进行多模型、跨领域、多语言实验；基于元认知理论提出“角色相关认知对齐假设”，并通过角色信息丰富度消融、逐层熵散度分析和潜在思维空间偏转观察进行验证；提出无需训练的多语言提示拼接策略MLCP。
AI.result: 角色扮演提示的收益高度依赖模型能力、知识领域和提示语言；只有当LLM正确理解指定角色及其相关知识域时才有效；MLCP在所有测试LLM上均持续优于普通角色扮演提示。
AI.conclusion: 角色扮演提示并非普遍有效，需满足角色与知识域的认知对齐；MLCP能减少角色认知偏差、稳定并提升角色扮演表现，且简单、免训练、高效。

title: Aligning Thoughts with Answers: Probability Rewards to Tame Thinking Drift
summary: This paper studies \textbf{thinking--answer consistency} in vision-language models. We focus on Visual Intention Grounding, where a model infers a target object based on a human intention query and predicts a bounding box. We reveal that previous IoU-based reinforcement learning (RL) frameworks suffer from ``thinking drift'', where the model produces a correct bounding box, despite having an incorrect reasoning process pointing to a different target object. Thus, we propose \textbf{Rita} (\textit{ReInforcing Thinking--Answer consistency}) as a novel RL paradigm to tame the drift. Specifically, Rita introduces two reasoning-label-free RL rewards, constructed from the conditional probability of reference answers: a \textbf{thinking reward} and a \textbf{consistency reward}. It also adopts a difficulty-aware \textbf{data filtering} strategy that selects informative easy-to-medium samples for RL using rollout error rate and reward variance. Extensive experiments on EgoIntention and the new RefEgo-Int benchmarks show that Rita performs consistently superior to the supervised finetuning approaches and vanilla RL-finetuned frameworks.

AI.tldr: 本文研究视觉语言模型中的“思维-答案一致性”，针对视觉意图定位任务，提出一种新的强化学习范式Rita，以缓解仅依赖IoU奖励导致的“思维漂移”问题。
AI.motivation: 现有基于IoU的强化学习框架存在“思维漂移”：模型可能输出正确边界框，但其推理过程指向了错误的目标物体，即答案正确但思维过程不一致。
AI.method: 提出Rita（ReInforcing Thinking--Answer consistency）强化学习范式，引入两种无需推理标签的奖励：思维奖励和一致性奖励，二者基于参考答案的条件概率构建；同时采用难度感知的数据过滤策略，利用rollout错误率和奖励方差选择信息量较大的易到中等难度样本进行强化学习。
AI.result: 在EgoIntention和新建的RefEgo-Int基准上，Rita持续优于监督微调方法和普通强化学习微调框架。
AI.conclusion: 通过强化思维与答案的一致性，并配合难度感知数据筛选，可以有效缓解视觉意图定位中的思维漂移，提升视觉语言模型的推理与定位表现。

title: RoboCoach: World Models as Active Coaches for Compositional Robot Skills
summary: Long-horizon robot manipulation reuses skills across many task compositions, but improving these compositions with additional end-to-end demonstrations is costly. A practical self-improving system must decide both what to teach next and where to apply that supervision. We present ROBOCOACH, a world-model-guided coaching framework that uses imagined failures to guide demonstration requests and expert updates. Its Route-Imagine-Diagnose-Improve (RIDI) loop executes reusable skill experts inside COACHWORLD, our shared action-conditioned world model, and uses a progress judge to record the first subtask that fails to complete. Aggregated records select which subtask demonstrations to acquire and which expert adapters to update. Across two simulation suites and two real-robot platforms, imagined and deployed success correlate over 22 task-policy pairs (rho = 0.840). Controlled comparisons show that our coaching method outperforms matched baselines under matched data budgets and update schedules. With only 150 additional subtask demonstrations, success rises from 13.3% to 75.0% on Franka and from 40.0% to 83.8% on AgileX. The coached experts also transfer to four held-out compositions, achieving an average success of 35.0%, compared with 0% for a shared-policy baseline updated with uniformly acquired demonstrations. Together, these results show that world models can serve as active coaches, turning imagined failures into targeted supervision for modular policy improvement. Project Page: https://robocoach-ai.github.io/

AI.tldr: 提出ROBOCOACH世界模型引导的教练框架，利用想象失败决定下一步教什么以及更新哪个技能专家，从而低成本提升长时程机器人操作能力。
AI.motivation: 长时程机器人操作需要复用技能并应对多种任务组合，但用额外端到端演示来改进这些组合成本很高；实际的自改进系统必须同时决定接下来教什么以及在哪里施加监督。
AI.method: 提出Route-Imagine-Diagnose-Improve（RIDI）循环：在共享的动作条件世界模型COACHWORLD中执行可复用技能专家，并用进度判断器记录首个未完成的子任务；聚合失败记录后，选择需要采集哪些子任务演示以及更新哪些专家适配器。
AI.result: 在两个仿真套件和两个真实机器人平台上，想象成功率与部署成功率在22个任务-策略对上高度相关（rho=0.840）。在匹配数据预算和更新计划下，该方法优于基线。仅增加150条子任务演示，Franka成功率从13.3%升至75.0%，AgileX从40.0%升至83.8%。经教练更新的专家迁移到四个留出组合时平均成功率为35.0%，而均匀采集演示更新的共享策略基线为0%。
AI.conclusion: 世界模型可以作为主动教练，将想象失败转化为定向监督，从而推动模块化策略改进。

title: LLM Persona Unlearning
summary: Pre-training equips large language models (LLMs) with a broad repertoire of behavioral patterns associated with roles, styles, values, and goals. Post-training teaches conditional enactment and makes a helpful Assistant the default, but it does not erase alternative modes from the weights; explicit prompts can therefore elicit personas that repeatedly shape judgment, language, and action. In open-weight settings, runtime controls can be removed, motivating persona unlearning: a weight-level edit that makes a designated persona difficult to elicit and enact on unseen contexts. We introduce PersonaUnlearnBench, a model-specific paired benchmark spanning six LLMs from three families and five personas, with aligned forget/retain sets, held-out instruction paraphrases, and four-axis evaluation. The benchmark shows that standard unlearning methods cannot reliably erase the target persona without sacrificing meaningful generation or general utility. We therefore propose PaCE, which compares target and desirable responses to the same questions to locate an internal behavior direction, then trains target-prompt states away from the target mode and toward the matched desirable response. Experiments show that PaCE consistently suppresses target personas with high response quality and useful counterpart behavior, at moderate utility cost. These results establish persona unlearning as a distinct behavior-level editing problem and a practical route toward persistent control of latent LLM response policies.

AI.tldr: 论文提出人格遗忘（persona unlearning）任务，并发布 PersonaUnlearnBench 基准，发现标准遗忘方法难以在不损害生成质量与通用效用的情况下可靠擦除指定人格；为此提出 PaCE，通过定位内部行为方向并训练目标提示状态远离目标人格、靠近理想回应，从而有效抑制指定人格。
AI.motivation: 预训练使大语言模型具备多种角色、风格、价值观和目标相关的行为模式；后训练只是让 helpful Assistant 成为默认模式，并未从权重中消除其他模式，显式提示仍可诱发人格。开放权重场景下运行时控制可被移除，因此需要权重级的人格遗忘，使指定人格在未见情境中难以被诱发和执行。
AI.method: 构建 PersonaUnlearnBench：覆盖 3 个模型家族、6 个 LLM 和 5 种人格，包含对齐的 forget/retain 集、留出指令改写和四轴评估。提出 PaCE：对同一问题比较目标回应与理想回应，定位内部行为方向，然后训练目标提示状态远离目标模式并朝向匹配的理想回应。
AI.result: 基准显示，标准遗忘方法无法可靠擦除目标人格而不牺牲有意义的生成或通用效用。PaCE 能持续抑制目标人格，同时保持较高回应质量和有用的对应行为，通用效用仅有中等代价。
AI.conclusion: 结果将人格遗忘确立为一种独特的行为级编辑问题，并为持久控制大语言模型潜在响应策略提供了一条实用路径。

title: Can Computation from Earlier Problems Help LLMs Solve New Ones?
summary: Large language models often solve independent problems in the same conversation. Can computation from earlier problems help them solve new ones? To answer this question, we first conduct preliminary experiments showing that retained history can raise or lower later-turn accuracy, even within the same domain. To understand these effects, we use controlled replay to isolate internal state changes specific to each problem-history pairing. Across different histories, these changes preserve similar relationships among current problems. To improve reasoning under retained history, we introduce STAIR (Stale-Token Attention for Inter-query Reuse). STAIR captures keys and values from earlier response generation in a fixed bank. It learns to redirect current queries when they read this bank during prompt processing. The base model remains frozen; only 12,288 parameters are trained. Across three Qwen models and four benchmarks, STAIR improves average later-turn accuracy by up to 11.67 percentage points over the unmodified model with history.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究同一对话中历史问题计算对后续问题求解的影响，并提出STAIR方法，通过复用早期生成的键值来提升多轮推理准确率。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型常在同一对话中解决多个独立问题，但先前问题的计算是否以及如何帮助后续问题尚不明确。初步实验表明保留历史可能提高也可能降低后续轮次准确率，即使在同一领域内也是如此。
AI.method: 作者首先用受控回放隔离每个问题-历史配对引起的内部状态变化。随后提出STAIR（Stale-Token Attention for Inter-query Reuse），将早期响应生成中的键和值存入固定银行，并学习在当前查询处理提示时读取该银行并重定向注意力。基础模型保持冻结，仅训练12,288个参数。
AI.result: 在三个Qwen模型和四个基准上，STAIR相比带历史的未修改模型，将后续轮次平均准确率最高提升11.67个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 历史计算对后续问题的影响可通过内部状态变化来理解；STAIR能以极少训练参数有效利用历史中的陈旧键值信息，提升多轮推理表现。

title: Fiber-Resolved Microstructure Quantification from Multi-Shell Diffusion MRI using Detection Transformers
comment: 12 pages, 4 figures, 1 table; Accepted at MICCAI 2026 Workshop CDMRI; Code: https://github.com/Marcus02W/Diffusion-DETR
summary: Fiber orientation and compartmental microstructure are central to the characterization of white matter tissue in diffusion MRI, yet existing methods either resolve fiber orientations without quantifying microstructure, or quantify microstructure while assuming a fixed number of compartments and a single fiber direction. Nonparametric approaches that recover both require tensor-valued diffusion encoding and computationally expensive Monte-Carlo inversion of an ill-posed inverse Laplace transform. We propose to reframe this problem as an object detection-like task, adopting the Detection Transformer (DETR) architecture to jointly predict mean diffusivity (MD), fractional anisotropy (FA), main fiber direction, and signal fraction for a variable number of compartments per voxel from standard multi-shell diffusion MRI with linear encoding. Hungarian matching during training resolves permutation invariance across compartments. We introduce mean Average Precision as a reproducible benchmark metric. Evaluated on synthetic test data with up to five compartments per voxel, our model achieves $R^2=0.95$ for MD, $R^2=0.88$ for FA, and a median angular error of 4.2°, with performance scaling naturally with compartmental signal fraction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将扩散MRI中纤维方向与区室微结构联合估计问题重构为类似目标检测的任务，采用DETR架构从标准多壳线性编码扩散MRI中联合预测每个体素可变数量区室的MD、FA、主纤维方向和信号分数。
AI.motivation: 现有方法要么只解析纤维方向而不量化微结构，要么在固定区室数量和单一纤维方向假设下量化微结构；能同时恢复两者的非参数方法依赖张量值扩散编码和昂贵的蒙特卡洛反演，且反问题病态。
AI.method: 采用Detection Transformer (DETR)架构，将区室预测视为集合预测问题，通过匈牙利匹配解决区室排列不变性；输入为标准多壳扩散MRI线性编码；联合预测MD、FA、主纤维方向及信号分数；并引入mAP作为可复现基准指标。
AI.result: 在每体素最多五个区室的合成测试数据上，模型达到MD的R^2=0.95、FA的R^2=0.88，中位角度误差4.2°，性能随区室信号分数自然缩放。
AI.conclusion: 该方法表明可用目标检测式架构高效实现白质纤维方向与区室微结构的联合非参数估计，避免昂贵的张量值扩散编码和蒙特卡洛反演，并为该任务提供mAP基准。

title: Beyond Policy Alignment: Closing the Planning-Learning Loop for Robot Control with Learned World Models
summary: Planning with learned world models combines online trajectory optimization with learned value and policy functions for high-dimensional control. Because the planner determines the experience used for learning, while the learned critic and actor in turn score and propose future plans, planning and learning form a closed feedback loop. TD-MPC is a prominent instance of this design. Recent policy-constrained variants strengthen one part of the loop by aligning the learned policy with planner behavior. We introduce PL-MPC (Planning-Learning MPC), which additionally modifies critic supervision and planner terminal-value estimation. Hybrid multi-step TD targets expose critic updates to more realized rewards before bootstrapping; disagreement-aware terminal estimates reduce the influence of uncertain critic values during MPPI planning; and return-weighted actor distillation emphasizes planner-executed actions from high-return episodes. The world-model architecture and MPPI optimizer are otherwise unchanged. On HumanoidBench, the largest gains occur on \texttt{balance-hard}, where Total Average Return (TAR) increases from $98\pm18$ to $387\pm255$, and \texttt{hurdle}, from $199\pm13$ to $466\pm200$; performance across the broader benchmark remains task dependent, and PL-MPC remains competitive on DMControl. Controlled ablations show different component interactions across the two tasks. We further demonstrate zero-shot sim-to-real transfer on wrench-nut alignment with a 7-DoF KUKA IIWA14, obtaining higher observed success than TD-M(PC)^2 on the training object size and two unseen sizes. Code and data will be available at: https://pl-mpc-humanoid.github.io.

AI.tldr: 提出 PL-MPC，在 TD-MPC 框架上改进规划与学习闭环，通过修改 critic 监督、规划终端价值估计和 actor 蒸馏，提升高维控制与 sim-to-real 表现。
AI.motivation: 规划器决定学习经验，而学习到的 critic 和 actor 又反过来评价和提出规划，形成闭环。现有策略约束变体只强化策略对齐，仍需改进 critic 监督和终端价值估计。
AI.method: PL-MPC 保留世界模型与 MPPI 优化器不变，引入混合多步 TD 目标增强 critic 更新；采用分歧感知的终端价值估计降低不确定 critic 值在 MPPI 规划中的影响；并使用回报加权 actor 蒸馏，强调高回报回合中规划器执行的动作。
AI.result: 在 HumanoidBench 上，balance-hard 的 TAR 从 98±18 提升至 387±255，hurdle 从 199±13 提升至 466±200；整体基准仍依赖任务，在 DMControl 上保持竞争力。消融显示两个任务中组件交互不同。在 7-DoF KUKA IIWA14 的 wrench-nut 对齐任务上实现零样本 sim-to-real，训练物体尺寸和两个未见尺寸的成功率均高于 TD-M(PC)^2。
AI.conclusion: PL-MPC 通过同时改进 critic 监督、终端价值估计和 actor 蒸馏，增强了规划-学习闭环，并在部分高维任务和真实机器人零样本迁移上取得优势，代码与数据将公开。

title: OPSRD: On-Policy Self-Role Distillation
summary: Role prompting elicits specialized behavior from large language models through an expert identity, offering a lightweight way to guide reasoning on demanding tasks. However, evaluating or distilling complete role-prompted answers can miss useful next-token preferences when the sampled solution remains incorrect. Transferring these preferences also requires an objective that reaches alternatives the student rarely predicts. We introduce OPSRD, which uses a fixed expert role as privileged teaching context for on-policy self-distillation without reference solutions. A role-free student generates a trajectory, and a frozen instance of the same base model supplies role-conditioned distributions on its exact prefixes, exposing alternatives beyond the sampled continuation. Teacher-weighted forward KL targets alternatives the student underestimates, with clipping to limit individual vocabulary contributions. Supervision is restricted to the highest-entropy half of student positions, concentrating learning where predictions are uncertain. Experiments on three competition-math benchmarks with Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, and 8B show improvements over the base models without role prompts at inference. Forward KL achieves the highest macro-averaged accuracy among the three evaluated divergences at every scale. Code is available at https://github.com/zhansan114514/OPSRD.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 OPSRD，一种利用固定专家角色作为特权教学上下文、无需参考答案的在线自蒸馏方法，将角色提示中的下一 token 偏好迁移给无角色学生模型，提升数学推理能力。
AI.motivation: 角色提示能激发大模型专家行为，但仅评估或蒸馏完整角色提示答案，会忽略采样答案错误时仍有用的下一 token 偏好；同时迁移这些偏好需要目标函数能覆盖学生很少预测的替代选项。
AI.method: OPSRD 让无角色的学生模型生成轨迹，并用同一基础模型的冻结实例在相同前缀上提供角色条件分布，从而暴露采样续写之外的替代 token。采用教师加权的前向 KL 目标，关注学生低估的替代项，并通过裁剪限制单个词表贡献。监督仅限制在学生位置中熵最高的前一半，聚焦不确定预测。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-1.7B、4B、8B 上，三个竞赛数学基准实验中，OPSRD 相比无角色提示的基础模型均有提升；在三种评估散度中，前向 KL 在每个规模上都取得最高宏平均准确率。
AI.conclusion: OPSRD 表明，利用固定专家角色进行在线自蒸馏、无需参考答案，可有效迁移角色提示中的细粒度偏好，并提升无角色推理时的数学表现。

title: ChunkTrust: Adapting Execution Horizons for Robot Policies with Action-Expert Evidence
summary: Robot foundation policies predict action chunks, but how many actions to execute before replanning depends on the current task phase. We introduce ChunkTrust, which treats the execution horizon as a latent variable inferred from action-expert evidence rather than a fixed hyperparameter. Its training-free Action-aware Horizon Selector (AHS) combines intra-chunk spectral stability of generation traces with inter-chunk continuity between executed history and predicted actions. An online Beta posterior with kernel forgetting tracks horizon preferences across replans. A lightweight Query-based Horizon Adapter (QHA) optionally learns a context-conditioned dense prior from complementary evidence, fused with current evidence and episode-local Beta memory while the base policy remains frozen. Across RoboTwin2.0 and RoboCasa GR1 Tabletop, AHS improves overall task-averaged success for each evaluated base-policy configuration, including gains of +6.80 percentage points on $π_{0.5}$ over all 50 RoboTwin2.0 tasks and +9.67 percentage points on Qwen3GR00T in RoboCasa. AHS+QHA raises the gain over Base to +9.44 percentage points on the eight-task $π_{0.5}$ evaluation. On four real-world household tasks, AHS improves the equal-task mean normalized process score from 50.4% to 57.5%. Ablations examine the contributions of both evidence terms, temporal memory, and the learned prior. Project page is https://hf618.github.io/ChunkTrust.github.io/

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ChunkTrust，将机器人基础策略中动作块的执行长度视为可从专家证据推断的潜变量，而非固定超参数，从而动态决定执行多少动作后再重新规划。
AI.motivation: 动作块策略通常预测一段动作，但每次执行多少动作取决于当前任务阶段，固定执行视界并不合适。
AI.method: 提出无训练的 Action-aware Horizon Selector（AHS），融合块内生成轨迹的谱稳定性与已执行历史到预测动作的块间连续性；用带核遗忘的在线 Beta 后验跟踪重规划间的视界偏好。可选 Query-based Horizon Adapter（QHA）在冻结基础策略下学习上下文条件化稠密先验，并与当前证据及回合局部 Beta 记忆融合。
AI.result: 在 RoboTwin2.0 与 RoboCasa GR1 Tabletop 上，AHS 对每个评估的基础策略配置均提升任务平均成功率：π0.5 在全部 50 个 RoboTwin2.0 任务上 +6.80 个百分点，Qwen3GR00T 在 RoboCasa 上 +9.67 个百分点；AHS+QHA 在八任务 π0.5 评估中相对 Base 提升 +9.44 个百分点。四个真实家庭任务中，等任务平均归一化过程分数从 50.4% 提升到 57.5%。消融分析考察两项证据、时间记忆与学习先验的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 执行视界应被动态推断而非固定设置；ChunkTrust 无需训练即可提升多种基础策略表现，可选 QHA 还能带来额外增益。

title: Uruqi: Learning Spatial Cognition from Visual Experience
summary: Spatial intelligence requires maintaining a coherent understanding of the world as the embodied agent moves. Like humans, the agent must use its own motion to interpret changes across observations and update object locations and spatial relations accordingly. Despite spatial post-training having substantially broadened the spatial intelligence of vision-language models (VLMs), they still struggle with two atomic spatial capabilities: tracking self-motion and mapping the surrounding world during motion. To address this gap, we provide dense multi-turn supervision over interleaved atomic capabilities within each training episode, mimicking the visual experience of a continuously moving agent that reasons as it observes. To scale this up, we synthesize 11,738 motif-driven camera trajectories over a broad range of 3D scenes, supporting self-motion tracking, persistent object mapping, and rich spatial operations within each visual experience. By training models to reason over these atomic questions, our URUQI$_{\mathrm{Syn}}$-8B improves accuracy from 15.84% to 47.73% on our Uruqi benchmark comprising 52k questions across 2.7k episodes. URUQI-SI-Mix-8B further reaches 50.41%, comparable to the 50.08% achieved by GPT-6 Astra. Trained solely on our synthesized data, URUQI$_{\mathrm{Syn}}$-8B achieves an average relative accuracy improvement of 17.13% over its InternVL3-8B backbone across three external spatial benchmarks. These results highlight continuous visual experience as a scalable source of supervision for developing spatial cognition in VLMs.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出通过连续视觉体验的密集多轮监督，提升视觉语言模型的自运动跟踪和世界映射等空间智能，并合成大量相机轨迹数据训练模型，在多个基准上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 空间智能要求具身智能体在移动时保持对世界的一致理解，但现有视觉语言模型在跟踪自运动和运动时映射周围世界这两个原子空间能力上仍存在困难。
AI.method: 提供密集多轮监督，在每个训练回合内对交错的原子能力进行监督，模仿连续移动智能体的视觉体验；合成11,738个主题驱动的相机轨迹，覆盖广泛的3D场景，支持自运动跟踪、持久对象映射和丰富的空间操作；训练模型对这些原子问题进行推理。
AI.result: URUQI_Syn-8B在Uruqi基准（52k问题、2.7k回合）上准确率从15.84%提升至47.73%；URUQI-SI-Mix-8B达到50.41%，与GPT-6 Astra的50.08%相当；仅用合成数据训练的URUQI_Syn-8B在三个外部空间基准上相对InternVL3-8B平均相对准确率提升17.13%。
AI.conclusion: 连续视觉体验是开发视觉语言模型空间认知的可扩展监督来源。

title: Advancing Entropy-Level Credit Assignment in RLVR via Proximal Entropy Policy Optimization
summary: Value-model-free RLVR methods such as GRPO assign uniform advantages to all tokens in a rollout, ignoring that tokens contribute unequally. Recent methods use token entropy as an importance proxy but compute it globally across the batch, conflating importance with prompt difficulty and positional trends. We argue that importance should instead be measured relative to the local context of each token. We introduce proximal entropy, a local measure of token importance relative to neighboring tokens, and prove it is invariant to both confounders. Proximal Entropy Policy Optimization (PEPO) uses it to weight per-token advantages and outperforms GRPO and entropy-based baselines on mathematical reasoning across Qwen3-1.7B, Qwen3-4B, and Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct. We also show the formulation generalizes to other algorithms where substituting proximal entropy into existing methods improves, and applying it to single-stream RL succeeds where global entropy fails.

AI.tldr: 论文指出GRPO等无价值模型的RLVR方法对所有token分配相同优势，忽略了token贡献差异；提出相对局部上下文的近端熵（proximal entropy）作为token重要性度量，并构建PEPO方法，在多个模型和数学推理任务上优于GRPO及基于熵的基线。
AI.motivation: 现有方法使用token熵作为重要性代理，但在batch全局计算，混合了提示难度和位置趋势等混杂因素；作者认为重要性应相对于每个token的局部上下文来度量。
AI.method: 提出近端熵，一种相对于邻近token的局部token重要性度量，并证明其对提示难度和位置趋势不变；基于该度量提出Proximal Entropy Policy Optimization（PEPO），用近端熵加权每个token的优势值。
AI.result: PEPO在Qwen3-1.7B、Qwen3-4B和Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct的数学推理任务上超过GRPO和基于熵的基线；该公式可推广到其他算法，替换近端熵可带来改进；在单流RL中应用成功，而全局熵失败。
AI.conclusion: 相对局部上下文的近端熵能更准确地衡量token重要性，避免全局熵的混杂问题；PEPO有效提升RLVR性能，并具有跨算法和单流RL的泛化能力。

title: The Concrete-Arbitrary Gap: Kinship Reasoning in LLMs Is Not Indifferent to Presentation
summary: We test whether large language models solve formally matched kinship problems equally well when relations are expressed in familiar vocabulary or by explicitly defined nonce predicates. Across 500 paired graphs, concrete accuracy exceeds arbitrary accuracy by 35.6 percentage points in local Qwen3.8-27B, 26.6 in Gemma 4 26B-A4B, 12.0 in Gemma 4 31B, and 5.4 in Qwen3.8-Max. All four paired gaps are statistically resolved. Reasoning budgets and prompt-language interventions can substantially reduce the difference, showing that it is modifiable rather than a fixed incapacity. The minimal conclusion is behavioral: on these tasks, the models' manifested relational competence is not indifferent to presentation. Explicit definitions provide the formal relations but do not make nonce predicates as usable as familiar vocabulary embedded in learned linguistic associations.

AI.tldr: 该研究测试大语言模型在面对形式匹配的亲属关系问题时，是否会对熟悉词汇与非词谓词（nonce predicates）表现出同等能力，发现模型在熟悉词汇下准确率显著更高，但差距可通过推理预算和提示语言干预缩小。
AI.motivation: 探究大语言模型的关系推理能力是否真正基于形式结构，还是受表面表达方式与词汇熟悉度影响。
AI.method: 构建500对形式匹配的亲属关系图，分别用熟悉词汇和显式定义的非词谓词表达；在多个模型（本地Qwen3.8-27B、Gemma 4 26B-A4B、Gemma 4 31B、Qwen3.8-Max）上比较准确率，并测试推理预算与提示语言干预的效果。
AI.result: 熟悉词汇准确率分别高出非词谓词35.6、26.6、12.0和5.4个百分点，四个配对差距均具统计显著性；推理预算和提示语言干预可大幅缩小差距。
AI.conclusion: 模型表现出的关系推理能力并非与呈现方式无关；显式定义虽提供形式关系，但不足以使非词谓词像嵌入语言联想的熟悉词汇一样可用。该差异是可调整的行为现象，而非固定能力缺陷。

title: DC-SAE: Deep Compression Semantic Autoencoder for Faster Diffusion Convergence
summary: High-compression tokenizers are essential for scaling latent image generative models. However, aggressive compression creates a fundamental tradeoff between reconstruction fidelity and generation efficiency: high compression image encoder always increases the learning difficulty of diffusion training, resulting in slow model convergence. Recent representation autoencoders speed up the diffusion training by improving the latent feature's expressive capability by replacing VAE encoders with pretrained semantic encoders, yet they are typically limited to moderate compression and lose pixel-level details necessary for faithful reconstruction. To achieve both high compression and fast diffusion training, we propose DC-SAE, a Decoupled Compact Semantic Autoencoder designed for high-compression image generation with accelerated diffusion model convergence. DC-SAE consists of two key components: (1) a macro-level architecture design that leverages semantic encoders to enable higher compression ratios, and (2) a pixel-level encoder that preserves low-level details, ensuring high-fidelity image reconstruction. We empirically demonstrate that DC-SAE performs strongly on image generation tasks, achieving both compact latent representations and efficient training dynamics. Specifically, on the ImageNet dataset with $512 \times 512$ resolution, DC-SAE achieves $32\times$ spatial compression, with 29.79 PSNR and 3.37 gFID, substantially outperforming the previous state-of-the-art high-compression tokenizer baselines DC-AE by 13.5% and 54.9% on PSNR and gFID, respectively, maintaining comparable throughput and faster diffusion model training convergence. Beyond class-conditional generation, a $1.6$B-parameter DiT using DC-SAE achieves 0.84 on GenEval and 86.007 on DPG-Bench for text-to-image generation at $1024\times1024$ resolution.

AI.tldr: 提出DC-SAE，一种解耦紧凑语义自编码器，用于高压缩图像生成并加速扩散模型收敛，兼顾高压缩率、高保真重建和快速训练。
AI.motivation: 高压缩tokenizer对扩展潜空间图像生成模型至关重要，但高压缩会牺牲重建保真度并增加扩散训练难度，导致收敛慢；现有语义自编码器虽能加速训练，却多限于中等压缩并丢失像素级细节。
AI.method: DC-SAE采用解耦架构：宏观层面利用语义编码器实现更高压缩比，像素级编码器保留低层细节，从而在紧凑潜表示下保证高保真重建，并加速扩散模型训练。
AI.result: 在ImageNet 512×512上实现32倍空间压缩，PSNR 29.79，gFID 3.37，较DC-AE分别提升13.5%和54.9%，吞吐相当且扩散训练收敛更快；在1024×1024文生图任务中，1.6B DiT使用DC-SAE取得GenEval 0.84和DPG-Bench 86.007。
AI.conclusion: DC-SAE能同时实现高压缩潜表示与高效扩散训练，在类条件生成和文本到图像生成上均表现优异，验证了解耦语义与像素细节设计的有效性。

title: Inferring Causal Relations between Two Sequences of Events with Language Models
summary: Causal AI is a branch of Artificial Intelligence which helps understand and reason about cause and effect relationships, not just patterns or correlations. Causal discovery aims to infer elements of the underlying causal structure--often represented as a directed graph--from observational and, when available, interventional data. While causal discovery is the fundamental step for moving beyond mere associations toward genuine understanding, and thus the basic building block of causal AI, it becomes intrinsically difficult when causal relations must be inferred from single observations. In such situations, standard causal discovery methods cannot be used and one has to identify causal relations from limited amount of information. This is typically the case for, e.g., sequences of events produced by different alarms which need to be analyzed on the fly to detect abnormal phenomena, which are usually rare. We show in this study that it is possible to leverage the predictive power of Large Language Models (LLMs) to infer causal relations between only two sequences of events. This approach, which is validated on both synthetic and real data, provides better results than standard causal discovery algorithms on several time series data, even though these data were converted into smaller, single observed sequences.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用大语言模型（LLM）的预测能力，在仅有两条事件序列的极端有限观测下推断因果关系，并在合成与真实数据上验证其优于传统因果发现算法。
AI.motivation: 因果发现通常需要大量观测或干预数据，但在单次观测、稀有异常告警序列需实时分析等场景中，标准因果发现方法难以使用，因此需要从极少信息中识别因果关系。
AI.method: 借助大语言模型对事件序列进行推理，仅利用两条事件序列来推断它们之间的因果关系，并在合成数据和真实数据上验证；同时将多个时间序列转换为更小的单次观测序列，与传统因果发现算法进行比较。
AI.result: 该方法在多个时间序列数据上取得了比标准因果发现算法更好的效果，即使这些数据被转换为更小的单次观测序列。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，大语言模型可用于从有限信息中辅助因果发现，为实时分析稀有异常事件和突破传统因果发现的数据限制提供了新思路。

title: Beyond the Shadows of Plato's Cave: Evaluating False Memory in Autonomous Agents via Counterfactual Reasoning
summary: Autonomous agents increasingly rely on memory to generalize beyond their training environments. However, agents are bounded by what they have seen and believed, and leveraging such memories in unseen environments can introduce biases into their internal beliefs. We formalize this phenomenon as \textit{false memory}, which can arise from spurious correlations, environment shifts, and knowledge conflicts. Despite its importance, false memory is difficult to evaluate because it stems from agent internal beliefs and is easily confounded with ordinary generalization failures. Therefore, we propose FAME, a training-free framework that evaluates false memory through the evolution of agent beliefs under counterfactual reasoning. Specifically, counterfactual scenarios reveal how beliefs change as the latent concept of memory shifts under hypothetical interventions; thus, measuring the resulting concept drift provides a signal for distinguishing faithful versus false memory. Such concepts can be estimated from agent hidden states before answer generation, avoiding the need for reward design or answer sampling. Empirical experiments reveal that simply monitoring answers often fails to detect false memory, while FAME achieves AUROCs of 76.2% - 96.7% across false-memory settings, and outperforms the best baseline by 3.4% - 23.3% across realistic benchmarks, spanning math reasoning (GSM-Symbolic), code generation (GitChameleon), and complex reasoning (BigBench-Hard). We further release corresponding counterfactual templates and facilitate future research on false memory.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出‘虚假记忆’概念，并设计了无需训练的评估框架FAME，通过反事实推理下智能体信念演化来检测虚假记忆。
AI.motivation: 自主智能体依赖记忆泛化到新环境，但记忆可能因虚假相关、环境偏移和知识冲突而引入偏见，形成难以评估的虚假记忆；其与普通泛化失败易混淆，且源于内部信念，现有方法难以有效检测。
AI.method: FAME利用反事实场景观察记忆潜在概念在假设干预下的变化，通过测量概念漂移区分真实记忆与虚假记忆；概念从生成答案前的智能体隐藏状态估计，无需奖励设计或答案采样。
AI.result: 实验表明仅监控答案常无法检测虚假记忆；FAME在虚假记忆设置下AUROC达76.2%–96.7%，在数学推理、代码生成和复杂推理等真实基准上比最佳基线高3.4%–23.3%。
AI.conclusion: FAME能有效评估虚假记忆，并发布了相应反事实模板以促进未来研究。

title: Emergent Multi-View Geometry Through Self-Distillation
