We contribute (1) a human-in-the-loop paradigm that recasts the human from labeler to structural guide, (2) the JuryFlow framework operationalizing it through a disagreement graph, focal re-evaluation, and closed-loop rubric induction, and (3) an evaluation protocol with ablations that isolate where the gains originate.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 JuryFlow，一种以评审分歧为引导、人在回路中的多智能体评估框架。它将评委间分歧视为定位评估不确定性的细粒度信号，通过分歧图、焦点重评、沿图传播与规则归纳，提升对 AI 生成内容评估的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 自动评审中，单个评委不可靠，多评委投票在分歧时只是丢弃冲突，而非真正解决分歧，导致评估仍存在难以消除的偏差。
AI.method: JuryFlow 将候选回答拆解为原子主张，由异构评委团逐项判定；构建分歧图，节点用判定熵评分，边表示主张间结构相似性；人类作为结构引导者，仅选择需解决的分歧进行最小干预，随后重评焦点主张，并将修正沿图边和相似历史案例传播，最终固化为可复用的评分规则。实验采用自动配置，以熵排序选择焦点，在 MT-Bench 和 LLMBar 上评估。
AI.result: 在 MT-Bench 和 LLMBar 上，JuryFlow 相比单评委和多数投票评审基线，与金标签的一致性更高；消融实验证明，针对分歧的重评、传播和规则归纳各自均有贡献。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提出一种将人类从标注者转变为结构引导者的人在回路范式，并通过分歧图、焦点重评和闭环规则归纳实现该范式，同时提供可复现的评估协议与消融分析，说明性能提升来源。

title: AVERT-VLN: Abstention-aware Visual Error Recovery and Training for Vision-and-Language Navigation
summary: Deploying vision-and-language navigation (VLN) agents in unseen environments remains challenging because unfamiliar layouts and visual conditions can cause execution to go off track. Rather than relying on continuous human supervision, a practical strategy is to selectively request corrective guidance, recover the ongoing task, and reuse corrective interactions to improve subsequent navigation. We propose Abstention-aware Visual Error Recovery and Training for Vision-and-Language Navigation (AVERT-VLN), a closed-loop framework that uses a plug-in vision-language Monitor for online human-assisted recovery and offline preference learning. The Monitor operates separately from navigation decision generation and assesses instruction-execution consistency from the instruction, visual history, and current observation. To train the Monitor for deviation recognition, we construct LOSTNAV DATASET with 20K counterfactual risk trajectories and rule-based deviation labels. The Monitor is first fine-tuned on 40K normal trajectories to assess instruction progress and then jointly fine-tuned on normal and risk trajectories to recognize semantic deviations. At runtime, Asynchronous Sidecar Monitoring evaluates execution alongside the navigation model. When the controller accepts a LOST verdict, it suspends autonomous execution and requests human guidance for recovery. For offline policy improvement, Trajectory-Anchored Preference Learning converts deviation-associated failures into decision-level preference pairs under shared decision contexts, restricting supervision to the decisions targeted for correction. Under human-assisted evaluation, the full AVERT-VLN system achieves success rates of 76.2% and 66.3% on the val-unseen splits of R2R-CE and RxR-CE, respectively. The same monitoring and human-assisted recovery interface also improves success rates across the three evaluated navigation architectures.

AI.tldr: 提出AVERT-VLN闭环框架，通过插件式视觉语言监控器实现选择性人工干预恢复与离线偏好学习，显著提升未见环境下的视觉语言导航成功率。
AI.motivation: VLN智能体在未知环境中易因布局和视觉条件变化而偏离任务，持续人工监督不现实，需选择性请求纠正并复用交互来改进后续导航。
AI.method: 构建含20K反事实风险轨迹和规则偏差标签的LOSTNAV数据集；监控器先在40K正常轨迹上微调评估指令进度，再在正常与风险轨迹上联合微调识别语义偏差。运行时异步边车监控，接受LOST判定后暂停自主执行并请求人工恢复；离线用轨迹锚定偏好学习将失败转为决策级偏好对。
AI.result: 人工辅助评估下，R2R-CE和RxR-CE的val-unseen成功率分别达76.2%和66.3%；同一监控与恢复接口在三种导航架构上均提升成功率。
AI.conclusion: 选择性人工纠正与离线偏好学习结合可有效恢复并改进VLN，且具备跨架构通用性。

title: EgoTools: Towards Tool-Centric Reasoning in Real-World Egocentric Videos
summary: Real-world embodied tasks, from everyday activities to professional procedures, require agents to act under physical constraints while tracking evolving object and task states. Tool use sits at the heart of such tasks, as many everyday and professional activities are tool-mediated. Understanding them requires reasoning about affordances, hand-tool-object geometry, procedural progress, and causal effects on target objects. Yet despite strong performance on perception-oriented video tasks such as captioning and general video QA, current multimodal video models remain limited in this form of tool-centric embodied reasoning. Progress in this direction has been limited by the lack of real-world egocentric data and diagnostic benchmarks. To address this gap, we introduce EgoTools, the first comprehensive suite for egocentric tool-use understanding. It consists of two complementary components: EgoTools-Data, a large-scale corpus of 100 hours of tool-centric egocentric recordings with synchronized audio, dense captions, reasoning-heavy narrations, and supplementary 3D information; and EgoTools-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark of 1,000 QA pairs across four tracks that cover tool-use understanding from perception and geometry to procedure and causal reasoning. Experimental results show that current models still struggle to ground tool use in visual evidence: Gemini-3.1-Pro achieves 66.9% overall accuracy but only 51.7% on Perception & Grounding. Beyond evaluation, we validate EgoTools-Data as a training resource. On the full 1,000-question benchmark, full supervised fine-tuning improves Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct from 50.0% to 60.9%, under strict source-video separation. Together, these results establish EgoTools as a unified resource for both training and diagnostic evaluation of real-world egocentric tool-use understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EgoTools，首个面向第一人称工具使用理解的综合套件，包含大规模数据集与诊断基准，用于训练和评估。
AI.motivation: 现实具身任务中工具使用普遍，需推理可供性、手-工具-物体几何、程序进展和因果效应，但现有多模态视频模型在此类工具中心推理上受限，且缺乏真实第一人称数据与诊断基准。
AI.method: 构建EgoTools-Data（100小时工具中心第一人称记录，含同步音频、密集描述、推理叙述和3D信息）与EgoTools-Bench（1000个QA对，覆盖感知、几何、程序、因果推理四赛道），并验证数据作为训练资源进行监督微调。
AI.result: 当前模型难以将工具使用扎根于视觉证据：Gemini-3.1-Pro总体准确率66.9%，但感知与扎根仅51.7%。全量SFT使Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct从50.0%提升至60.9%（严格源视频分离）。
AI.conclusion: EgoTools为真实第一人称工具使用理解提供了统一的训练与诊断评估资源。

title: When Instructions Retrieve Trajectories: Diagnosing and Mitigating Generalization Failures in VLA Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models can exceed 90% success on in-distribution tasks and withstand nuisance changes that preserve the required action, yet fail under counterfactual changes that demand a different action. Aggregate robustness scores can therefore conceal a more specific failure, in which a policy responds to both language and vision yet does not combine them to select the action the task requires. We call this failure instruction-action binding. Instructions cue familiar trajectory families, and visual feedback adjusts their execution. Behavioral analyses of fine-tuned $π_{0.5}$ and GR00T-N1.7 policies reveal that failed rollouts often retain the source behavior or switch to another demonstrated task. These switches show that language is not simply ignored. Readouts and interventions connect these choices to task-conditioned internal states. Our analysis of the imitation objective shows how narrow conditional action support can leave grounded and instruction-keyed solutions indistinguishable on the demonstrations. This motivates Equivariant Counterfactual Training (ECT), which acts at two levels. ECT data supply valid demonstrations in which the same instruction requires different actions in distinguishable scenes, while the ECT loss trains each demonstration with its counterpart in the same update. In a controlled LIBERO-PRO comparison, full ECT raises $π_{0.5}$'s mean position-swap success from 36% to 59%. On CALVIN, where counterparts already occur in the original data, the ECT loss improves five-task completion without new demonstrations. On a real UR5e under a fixed demonstration budget, full ECT raises unseen-position success from 8% to 88%.

AI.tldr: 论文研究视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在反事实变化下的失败，提出“指令-动作绑定”问题，并给出等变反事实训练（ECT）方法提升鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: VLA模型在分布内任务成功率可超90%，也能适应不改变所需动作的干扰，但在需要不同动作的反事实变化下失败。总体鲁棒性分数会掩盖更具体的失败：策略虽同时响应语言和视觉，却不能将二者结合以选择任务所需动作，即指令-动作绑定失败。
AI.method: 对微调的π0.5和GR00T-N1.7策略进行行为分析，发现失败轨迹常保留源行为或切换到其他已演示任务；通过读出与干预将选择关联到任务条件内部状态；分析模仿目标，指出窄条件动作支持会使接地解与指令键控解在演示上不可区分。据此提出两级等变反事实训练（ECT）：数据层面提供同一指令在可区分场景中要求不同动作的有效演示，损失层面在同一次更新中用对应样本训练每个演示。
AI.result: 在LIBERO-PRO受控比较中，完整ECT将π0.5的平均位置交换成功率从36%提升到59%。在CALVIN上，由于对应样本已存在于原始数据中，ECT损失无需新演示即可提升五任务完成度。在固定演示预算的真实UR5e上，完整ECT将未见位置成功率从8%提升到88%。
AI.conclusion: 窄条件动作支持会导致模仿学习中接地解与指令键控解难以区分，从而造成指令-动作绑定失败；ECT通过数据与损失层面的反事实对应训练，可有效提升VLA模型在反事实变化和未见位置上的动作选择与鲁棒性。

title: OverdoseMoE: A Multi-Expert Framework for Opioid Overdose Risk Prediction
summary: Opioid overdose remains a major clinical and public health burden, highlighting the need for scalable approaches to identify patients at high risk. Here, we investigate diagnosis-specific adaptation for 180-day opioid overdose risk prediction from patients' preceding one-year longitudinal ICD histories. We develop OODMAMBA and OODQWEN through continued pretraining on longitudinal diagnostic sequences followed by task-specific fine-tuning. Building on the stronger Qwen-based predictors, we further propose OVERDOSEMOE, a multi-expert framework that integrates models of different scales using complementary expert-weighting strategies. Diagnosis-specific adaptation consistently improved predictive performance over general-purpose language-model baselines, with OODQWEN achieving an AUPRC of 24.47 and an AUROC of 68.56. OVERDOSEMOE further improved discrimination and precision, achieving an AUPRC of 25.17 and an AUROC of 69.49 while outperforming the strongest single-model baselines. Among patients ranked in the top 5% of predicted risk, OVERDOSEMOE identified substantially enriched overdose risk, achieving a PPV of 25.38% while retaining meaningful recall. Evaluation on an independent MIMIC-IV cohort further demonstrated cross-cohort robustness, with complementary weighting strategies showing advantages across different performance measures. These findings demonstrate that diagnosis-specific language-model adaptation combined with multi-expert integration can improve opioid overdose risk stratification and support more robust prediction across heterogeneous electronic health record populations.

AI.tldr: 本文针对阿片类药物过量风险预测，提出基于诊断序列的语言模型适应方法，并构建多专家框架OVERDOSEMOE，在180天风险预测中取得优于基线的性能。
AI.motivation: 阿片类药物过量是重大临床与公共卫生负担，亟需可扩展的高风险患者识别方法。
AI.method: 利用患者前一年纵向ICD诊断历史，进行诊断特异性适应以预测180天阿片过量风险。通过对纵向诊断序列继续预训练和任务微调，开发OODMAMBA和OODQWEN模型；基于较强的Qwen模型，提出多专家框架OVERDOSEMOE，采用互补专家加权策略整合不同规模模型。
AI.result: 诊断特异性适应持续优于通用语言模型基线，OODQWEN达到AUPRC 24.47、AUROC 68.56；OVERDOSEMOE进一步提升至AUPRC 25.17、AUROC 69.49，优于最强单模型基线。在预测风险前5%患者中，PPV达25.38%并保持有意义的召回率。在独立MIMIC-IV队列上验证了跨队列稳健性，互补加权策略在不同指标上展现优势。
AI.conclusion: 诊断特异性语言模型适应结合多专家集成可改善阿片过量风险分层，并支持在异构电子健康记录人群中更稳健的预测。

title: ChronoGraph: Functional 4D Scene Graphs with Vision-Language Models for Interaction Understanding and Grounded Planning
summary: Embodied agents must determine where to act, anticipate the resulting scene changes, and interpret observed outcomes to guide subsequent actions. This requires connecting 4D interaction understanding, which explains how past actions changed the scene, with spatially grounded planning, which determines how and where to act toward a goal and anticipates the resulting scene changes. We introduce ChronoGraph, a functional 4D scene graph that links actions on affordance parts to semantic and geometric state changes. By representing observed and anticipated transitions in the same form, it provides a shared basis for understanding and planning. We construct ChronoGraphBench through an automatic data engine that converts human-interaction videos and simulated robot trajectories into graph-annotated questions for training and evaluating Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on both tasks. Using these annotations, we train ChronoGraphVLM by adapting pretrained VLMs in two stages. Graph-as-Chain-of-Thought supervised fine-tuning teaches the models to reconstruct observed transitions and predict future ones as graph traces before answering. Subsequent joint 4D graph reinforcement learning directly rewards graph properties and answer correctness. Experiments across model scales show improvements over the corresponding pretrained baselines and zero-shot transfer to VLM4D. Real-world demonstrations further show that graph-based planning and affordance grounding support mobile manipulation through existing robot skills without additional fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 提出 ChronoGraph——一种功能性 4D 场景图，将动作（作用在可供性部件上）与语义和几何状态变化关联起来，统一表示已观察和预期的场景转换，从而连接 4D 交互理解与空间规划。基于自动数据引擎构建 ChronoGraphBench，并训练 ChronoGraphVLM 完成两项任务。
AI.motivation: 具身智能体需要决定在哪里行动、预判场景变化并解释观察结果以指导后续动作。这要求将解释过去动作如何改变场景的 4D 交互理解，与决定如何及在哪里行动并预判变化的空间规划结合起来，但现有方法缺乏统一表示。
AI.method: 构建 ChronoGraph 功能性 4D 场景图，将作用于可供性部件的动作与语义、几何状态变化关联。通过自动数据引擎将人类交互视频和模拟机器人轨迹转为图标注问答，形成 ChronoGraphBench。训练 ChronoGraphVLM 分两阶段：图作为思维链的监督微调，让模型先以图轨迹重建观察到的转换并预测未来转换；随后联合 4D 图强化学习，直接奖励图属性和答案正确性。
AI.result: 在不同模型规模上，ChronoGraphVLM 相较对应预训练基线均有提升，并能零样本迁移到 VLM4D。真实世界演示表明，基于图的规划与可供性 grounding 可借助现有机器人技能支持移动操作，且无需额外微调。
AI.conclusion: ChronoGraph 通过统一的 4D 图表示有效连接交互理解与空间规划，配合图思维链监督和 4D 图强化学习，提升了 VLM 的 4D 理解与规划能力，并具备零样本迁移和真实机器人操作应用潜力。

title: InfoAgent: Traceable Generation and Repair of Evidence-Grounded Infographics
summary: Reliable infographic generation requires facts, symbols, and visual relations to remain consistent through rendering and revision. Correcting one element also requires tracking its supporting evidence and the dependencies affected by the change. We present \textbf{InfoAgent}, a training-free framework for \emph{evidence-bound visual-symbolic program synthesis}. Its Infographic Visual Description (IVD) records factual payloads, evidence provenance, execution routes, and verification obligations in a typed dependency graph. Retrieved design priors guide compilation, and layered execution combines raster synthesis with editable symbolic and binding objects while retaining their traces. Dependency-aware repair localizes corrections, rechecks affected dependencies, and requires protected obligations to remain satisfied under the declared checkers. Unresolved obligations remain explicit. On IGenBench, InfoAgent achieves 93.0 Q-ACC and 59.0 I-ACC. We also introduce InfoGraphicBench-Evidence, where complete-checklist pass rates on 200 test requests increase from 21.5\% for Same-IVD Prompt to 23.5\% for the initial layered output and 28.5\% after repair, using the same evidence and initial IVD. On 120 audited repair cases, localized repair edits 12.4\% of the canvas on average, compared with 67.3\% for global regeneration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 InfoAgent，一个无需训练的证据绑定视觉-符号程序合成框架，用类型化依赖图记录事实、证据来源、执行路径和验证义务，并通过分层执行与依赖感知修复提升信息图生成与修订的一致性和局部修复效率。
AI.motivation: 可靠的信息图生成需要在渲染和修订过程中保持事实、符号与视觉关系一致；修正一个元素还需追踪其支持证据以及受影响的依赖关系，因此需要一种能绑定证据并管理依赖的生成与修复机制。
AI.method: InfoAgent 是 training-free 框架，核心是 Infographic Visual Description（IVD），在类型化依赖图中记录 factual payloads、evidence provenance、execution routes 和 verification obligations。检索到的 design priors 指导编译；分层执行结合栅格合成与可编辑的符号及绑定对象，并保留其 traces。依赖感知修复定位修改、重查受影响依赖，并要求受保护义务在声明的 checkers 下保持满足；未解决的义务会被显式保留。
AI.result: 在 IGenBench 上，InfoAgent 达到 93.0 Q-ACC 和 59.0 I-ACC。作者还提出 InfoGraphicBench-Evidence，在 200 个测试请求上，完整 checklist 通过率从 Same-IVD Prompt 的 21.5% 提升到初始分层输出的 23.5%，修复后达到 28.5%，且使用相同证据和初始 IVD。在 120 个审计修复案例中，局部修复平均仅编辑 12.4% 的画布，而全局重新生成为 67.3%。
AI.conclusion: InfoAgent 通过证据绑定、视觉-符号程序合成和依赖感知局部修复，能够在保持依赖与验证义务明确的前提下提升信息图生成质量，并显著减少修复所需的画布修改范围。

title: EWAM: Emergent Depth-Wise Specialization in a Unified Embodied Model -- From Semantic Understanding through Visual Foresight to Action
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies emphasize semantic understanding, whereas world-action models (WAMs) learn predictive representations of environment dynamics. Systems that expose a policy to both sources often still concentrate action computation on a single expert. We present EWAM, an action-centric unified embodied model whose asymmetric joint attention lets action tokens read semantic, current-visual, predicted-future, and action information at every layer while the perceptual experts retain their distinct roles. Without layer-wise supervision, EWAM develops an emergent depth-wise specialization: action queries attend mainly to vision-language features in shallow layers, to predicted future frames in intermediate layers, and to action tokens themselves in deep layers. This handoff replicates across tasks and is stable across denoising steps. Checkpoint tracking and causal interventions show that it is learned and that action generation depends on it. EWAM is pretrained in two separate regimes, one on cross-embodiment robot trajectories and one on human egocentric video. In simulation and real-robot experiments, it surpasses existing VLA, WAM, and hybrid baselines. Human egocentric data improve both cross-embodiment transfer and real-robot robustness, and subtask-phase supervision improves long-horizon completion. Together, these results suggest that unified embodied learning can induce an ordered internal progression from semantic understanding, through visual foresight, to action formation.

AI.tldr: 提出EWAM，一种以动作为中心的统一具身模型。它通过非对称联合注意力让动作令牌在各层读取语义、当前视觉、预测未来和动作信息，并自发形成从语义到视觉预见再到动作生成的深层专门化，在仿真和真实机器人任务上优于VLA、WAM及混合基线。
AI.motivation: VLA策略侧重语义理解，WAM侧重环境动态预测；已有系统虽同时利用两类信息，但动作计算仍集中在单一专家上，缺乏真正统一的动作中心建模。
AI.method: 设计EWAM，采用非对称联合注意力，使动作令牌在每一层都能访问语义、当前视觉、预测未来帧和动作信息，同时保留感知专家的独立角色；无需逐层监督，分两种范式预训练：跨具身机器人轨迹和人类自我中心视频；并通过检查点跟踪与因果干预分析其内部机制。
AI.result: EWAM无需逐层监督即出现稳定的深度专门化：浅层动作查询主要关注视觉语言特征，中层关注预测未来帧，深层关注动作令牌；该交接跨任务稳定且跨去噪步骤稳定，因果干预表明动作生成依赖该机制。仿真和真实机器人实验中，EWAM超过现有VLA、WAM和混合基线；人类自我中心数据提升跨具身迁移和真实机器人鲁棒性，子任务阶段监督提升长时程完成率。
AI.conclusion: 统一具身学习可诱导模型形成有序的内部推进过程：从语义理解，经过视觉预见，最终到动作形成。

title: Multi-Link Safety Filtering for VLA Policies Around Moving Hazards
summary: A vision-language-action (VLA) policy can finish a manipulation task while knocking over objects unrelated to it, so task success alone does not show that the policy is safe to deploy in clutter. We study how to keep a pretrained VLA policy clear of such hazards at run time without retraining it, which requires guarding more of the arm than the end effector, following the hazard as it moves, and sharing onboard compute with the policy. Our training-free shield covers the gripper, wrist, and forearm with five ellipsoids and filters every commanded motion through one barrier program against a keep-out ellipsoid fitted from RGB-D perception at reset. Sparse optical flow then carries that ellipsoid's center along with the hazard, with no repeated detection or refitting. Over six simulated hazard-motion conditions, the shield lowers collision from $65.62\%$ to $27.27\%$ and raises safe-success, task completion without collision, from $29.35\%$ to $50.43\%$. Ablations show that guarding the arm links protects beyond end-effector shielding, and that tracking recovers most of the protection lost when the hazard estimate is frozen at reset. On heterogeneous edge hardware, the five-ellipsoid barrier runs on the CPU in $2.2$~ms at the 99th percentile, and trimming the vision--language prefix and taking fewer flow-matching steps shortens each $π_{0.5}$ policy call on the integrated GPU from $343$ to $177.3$~ms. On a physical SO-101 arm across four tasks, the arm touched the hazard in 3 of 16 shielded episodes versus 11 of 16 unshielded ones. Project page: https://yathag.github.io/multilink-safety-filter/

AI.tldr: 论文研究如何在不对预训练VLA策略进行再训练的情况下，于运行时避免机械臂碰撞无关物体，提出一种无训练的防护罩方法，在仿真和真实机械臂上均降低了碰撞并提升了安全成功率。
AI.motivation: VLA策略即使成功完成任务，也可能碰倒无关物体，因此仅凭任务成功率不能说明其在杂乱环境中可安全部署；需要在运行时保护整条机械臂，并跟踪移动危险物，同时与策略共享机载算力。
AI.method: 提出无训练防护罩：用五个椭球覆盖夹爪、手腕和前臂，并在复位时通过RGB-D感知拟合禁入椭球，将每个指令运动经由一个障碍函数程序过滤；再用稀疏光流随危险物移动该椭球中心，避免重复检测与拟合。还在异构边缘硬件上优化五椭球障碍函数与π0.5策略调用。
AI.result: 在六种仿真危险物运动条件下，碰撞率从65.62%降至27.27%，安全成功率从29.35%升至50.43%。消融表明保护臂段优于仅保护末端执行器，跟踪可恢复复位后冻结估计所损失的大部分保护。五椭球障碍函数在CPU上99百分位约2.2 ms；通过裁剪视觉语言前缀和减少流匹配步数，π0.5单次调用在集成GPU上从343 ms降至177.3 ms。在真实SO-101机械臂的四项任务中，防护后有3/16次触及危险物，未防护为11/16次。
AI.conclusion: 该无训练运行时防护方法能有效减少VLA策略在杂乱环境中的碰撞，并具备边缘部署可行性；保护整条臂与动态跟踪危险物是关键，真实机械臂实验也初步验证了其有效性。

title: Why Do Conventional World Models Fail to Learn Cellular Automata?
comment: 35 pages, 18 figures. Code and reproduction materials: https://github.com/guoshaoyang-pku/momentum-induction
summary: Although conventional world models - auto-regressive or diffusion models based on transformers or convolutional networks - may learn surface statistics of world dynamics, can they learn the exact world dynamics from its observed history? Leveraging cellular automata as a simple testbed, we find the answer to be no in many cases. Conventional architectures predict most pixels correctly yet rarely complete a rollout: a CNN predicts 96.3% of cells but completes 18.9% of rollouts; a joint diffusion model completes none. We trace the gap to three failure modes of these world models - namely, they fail to exactly capture spatial locality, temporal locality or temporal stability. Simple changes repair each: (1) for spatial locality, two-dimensional rotary positions lift a transformer from 39.1% to 100% on the Game of Life; (2) for temporal locality, handing each token its cell's previous-frame neighbourhood lifts the same transformer from 25.8% to 99.9% on unseen rules; (3) for temporal stability, causal freezing lifts the same diffusion weights from 42.2% to 99.9%. None of the three changes touches the architectural backbone; each only modifies the information flow within it. We also compare joint and ordered sampling on billiards and, in an exploratory study, on a simulated Burgers equation.

AI.tldr: 该论文以元胞自动机为测试平台，考察常规世界模型能否从历史中学习精确动力学；发现它们虽像素预测准确，却难以完成完整推演，并指出三类失败模式及轻量修复方法。
AI.motivation: 作者质疑基于Transformer或卷积网络的自回归/扩散世界模型是否只学到表面统计，而无法学习精确世界动力学，因此需要简单可控的测试环境来验证。
AI.method: 使用元胞自动机作为测试平台，评估CNN、Transformer、联合扩散模型等；分析空间局部性、时间局部性和时间稳定性三类失败模式，并分别引入二维旋转位置编码、上一帧邻域信息和因果冻结等仅改变信息流的修改。
AI.result: 常规模型常能预测多数像素但很少完成推演：CNN预测96.3%元胞但仅完成18.9%推演，联合扩散模型完成0%。修复后：二维旋转位置将Transformer在生命游戏中从39.1%提升至100%；提供上一帧邻域将同一Transformer在未见规则上从25.8%提升至99.9%；因果冻结将扩散模型从42.2%提升至99.9%。
AI.conclusion: 精确世界动力学需要恰当的空间/时间局部性与稳定性信息流，而非仅靠更强骨干网络；仅修改信息流即可大幅提升完整推演能力，并在台球和Burgers方程上初步比较联合与有序采样。

title: Persistent Context Graphs for Efficient Memory Compaction in LLM Agents
summary: As LLM capabilities advance, agents are tackling increasingly complex tasks over longer horizons. Their growing interaction histories make memory compaction essential for staying within context windows and reducing prefill cost. Existing methods summarize the history or compress its KV cache, often adding model computation to preserve information for future requests. A new user request can change which history matters, but reassessing that history with the model requires re-encoding it if the KV cache has expired. Past attention provides signals of historical importance and dependencies between messages, while relevance to the current task must be assessed using the new user request. We introduce ReCAP, a memory compaction method that stores attention-derived importance scores and dependency links in a lightweight, persistent context graph. For each new request, ReCAP combines stored importance with relevance cues from the request and follows dependency links to select messages and their supporting context, without additional model calls for selection. Compared with Codex's default summarization-based compaction, ReCAP reduces estimated latency for compaction and cold restoration by approximately 95% on both Qwen3-Coder and gpt-oss. It also roughly halves the historical context per call on SWE-Together at comparable task quality and improves accuracy on the code tasks of Lost-in-Conversation over full history by 19.8 and 41.2 points.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ReCAP，一种基于注意力重要性评分和消息依赖链接的持久上下文图记忆压缩方法，可按新请求选择相关历史，显著降低延迟和上下文长度。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体交互历史越来越长，需要记忆压缩以适应上下文窗口并降低预填充成本。现有摘要或 KV 缓存压缩常需额外模型计算；且新请求会改变历史重要性，KV 缓存过期后重新评估历史又需重新编码。
AI.method: ReCAP 将注意力导出的重要性分数与消息间依赖链接存入轻量、持久的上下文图。每个新请求到来时，它结合存储的重要性与请求相关性线索，并沿依赖链接选择消息及其支撑上下文，选择过程无需额外模型调用。
AI.result: 相比 Codex 默认的摘要式压缩，ReCAP 在 Qwen3-Coder 和 gpt-oss 上将压缩与冷恢复的估计延迟降低约 95%；在 SWE-Together 上每次调用历史上下文约减半且任务质量相当；在 Lost-in-Conversation 代码任务上，准确率比使用完整历史分别提高 19.8 和 41.2 点。
AI.conclusion: 结合注意力信号与当前请求相关性，可以高效选择关键历史，实现低延迟、低上下文开销的记忆压缩，并在部分代码任务上提升准确率。

title: PCB-MC: Missing Component Analysis in Printed Circuit Boards
summary: Detecting missing components on printed circuit boards (PCBs) differs fundamentally from conventional object detection, as the model must localize components that are not present. We introduce PCB-MC, a curated dataset for missing component detection with footprint level annotations built on top of the RF100 dataset. The dataset contains 197 distinct board types, each corresponding to a unique PCB design, with multiple augmented samples per type. We also provide benchmark results on PCB-MC by evaluating a diverse set of supervised and unsupervised methods. To ensure fair evaluation, we propose board type aware cross validation splits that prevent layout leakage between training and test sets. Supervised models showcase high false negative rates on unseen board designs, and unsupervised anomaly detection methods fail entirely due to the lack of spatial alignment with a board specific reference. These results confirm that missing component detection on diverse PCB layouts remains an open challenge. We release PCB-MC and all training protocols to support reproducible research on structural absence detection in industrial inspection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PCB-MC 数据集，用于印刷电路板（PCB）缺失元件检测，并提供基准评测与评估协议，表明该任务在多样布局下仍是公开挑战。
AI.motivation: 缺失元件检测与传统目标检测不同，模型需要定位“不存在”的元件；工业检测中缺乏专门数据集和公平评估协议，因此需要构建数据集并系统评测现有方法。
AI.method: 基于 RF100 构建 PCB-MC 数据集，包含 197 种不同板型及每类多个增强样本，提供 footprint 级标注；评估多种监督与无监督方法；提出按板型划分的交叉验证，防止训练集与测试集之间布局泄漏。
AI.result: 监督模型在未见板型上假阴性率高；无监督异常检测方法因缺乏与板型特定参考的空间对齐而完全失效。
AI.conclusion: 在多样 PCB 布局上进行缺失元件检测仍是未解决问题；作者发布 PCB-MC 及训练协议，以支持工业检测中结构缺失检测的可复现研究。

title: On the (In)effectiveness of AMR Augmentation for Large Language Models
comment: 23 pages, 6 figures, 18 tables, accepted at EMNLP 2026
summary: While Abstract Meaning Representation (AMR) has historically improved performance on a range of NLP tasks, the benefit---or lack thereof---of AMR augmentation for modern LLMs is thus far unclear. In this paper, we attempt to reproduce recent work that reported substantial downstream gains from AMR augmentation, finding that these are likely due to specific choices in the experimental settings used: using a consistent and unified protocol for hyperparameter selection, we observe that text-only baselines consistently match or exceed the performance of AMR-augmented models. To investigate this null result, we introduce a perplexity-based probe measuring the degree to which AMR provides an LLM with supplemental relational knowledge not already available to the model. We find that AMR augmentation does not help LLMs improve their understanding of relational content in the sentence, indicating that augmenting these models with AMR offers no clear benefit on downstream tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文复现AMR增强对现代LLM的下游任务增益，发现原先报告的提升可能源于实验设置差异；在统一超参数选择下，纯文本基线不逊于甚至优于AMR增强模型，且AMR未提供额外关系知识。
AI.motivation: AMR在历史上提升了多种NLP任务性能，但其对现代LLM是否仍有增益尚不明确，因此需要复现近期声称AMR增强带来显著下游提升的工作。
AI.method: 采用统一一致的超参数选择协议进行复现实验，对比纯文本基线与AMR增强模型，并引入基于困惑度的探针，衡量AMR是否为LLM提供其尚未掌握的关系知识。
AI.result: 原先报告的AMR增强增益很可能来自特定实验设置；统一协议下，纯文本基线持续匹配或超过AMR增强模型；探针显示AMR增强未能提升LLM对句子中关系内容的理解。
AI.conclusion: AMR增强对现代LLM在下游任务上没有明显益处，用AMR增强这些模型未带来清晰收益。

title: Identifiable Decomposition of Submovements in Human Hand Trajectories
summary: Voluntary movements have long been hypothesised to be comprised of discrete primitives called submovements, as a descriptive model of human motor behaviour. However, existing methods scale poorly, and no principled method exists to determine whether a decomposition is informative. We propose a spatiotemporal kernel correlation between primitive pairs as an identifiability criterion. Submovement-Identifiable Decomposition (Sub-ID) embeds this criterion in its adaptive-ridge regularisation, biasing the optimiser toward low-correlation solutions. Identifiability is lost when primitives become collinear and recovered when they diverge spatially. On synthetic data, Sub-ID recovers ground-truth parameter distributions where existing methods fail; furthermore, when primitives overlap too heavily to be distinguished, the method explicitly detects this ambiguity rather than outputting misleading results. Sub-ID extracts submovements from real three-dimensional, long-horizon movements, a regime no prior method addresses. This method has the potential to identify physiologically grounded primitives for motor control research and imitation learning.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Sub-ID 方法，将时空核相关作为可识别性准则，通过自适应岭正则化分解运动为子运动基元，并在合成与真实三维长时运动数据上验证。
AI.motivation: 自愿运动被认为由离散子运动基元组成，但现有分解方法扩展性差，且缺乏原则性标准判断分解是否有信息量。
AI.method: 提出以基元对之间的时空核相关作为可识别性准则，并将其嵌入自适应岭正则化中，使优化器偏向低相关解；当基元过于重叠时显式检测歧义。
AI.result: 在合成数据上，Sub-ID 能恢复真实参数分布，而现有方法失败；在不可区分时能检测歧义而非输出误导结果；并能从真实三维长时运动中提取子运动。
AI.conclusion: Sub-ID 有望为运动控制研究和模仿学习识别具有生理基础的基元。

title: A helps B while B hurts A: directed transfer in instruction-tuning mixture
summary: Adapting a language model to a specialized corpus means choosing which instruction-tuning tasks to train on under a fixed budget, and testing one choice costs a fine-tuning run. Common heuristics add more source tasks or pick sources similar to the target. The first assumes transfer is never negative; the second, that it is symmetric. We show that both assumptions fail: task $A$ can help task $B$ while $B$ hurts $A$, so helpfulness is a signed property of ordered source--target pairs. We introduce the transfer map, a signed estimate of how much each source helps or hurts each held-out target. We fit the map in hundreds of fine-tuning runs on Qwen3 and Mistral models from 0.6B to 32B parameters, with all sources drawn from one corpus and no training examples from the target. The map predicts a held-out target's accuracy on unseen mixtures: recorded before those runs, its predictions have less than half the error of a mixture-agnostic baseline. The map is specific to its target and corpus but transfers across model scale: a mixture selected in advance at one size beats training on all source tasks at every other size we tested. Transfer is thus a property of the data. The map selects the tasks that help and drops the one that interferes: accuracy on the reasoning targets (causal explanation, multi-hop questions and methodological critique) rises by up to 14 percentage points over training on all source tasks.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“迁移图”（transfer map），用于估计不同源任务对每个留出目标任务的带符号帮助或损害，并据此选择指令微调任务。
AI.motivation: 在固定预算下为专用语料适配语言模型时，需要选择训练哪些指令任务；常见启发式假设迁移永不为负或迁移是对称的，但作者发现这两个假设都不成立。
AI.method: 作者在Qwen3和Mistral模型上进行数百次微调实验，模型规模从0.6B到32B参数，所有源任务来自同一语料且不使用目标任务训练样本，拟合源-目标有序对的带符号迁移估计。
AI.result: 迁移图能预测留出目标在未见混合任务上的准确率，误差不到混合无关基线的一半；它虽特定于目标和语料，但可跨模型规模迁移，预先选出的混合任务在一个规模上选择后，在其他规模上也优于训练所有源任务。
AI.conclusion: 迁移是数据的一种属性，且是有符号、有序的源-目标关系；迁移图能选出有帮助的任务并排除干扰任务，使推理类目标（因果解释、多跳问题和方法论批判）准确率最高提升14个百分点。

title: Values as Style: Disentangling Values from Semantics with One-Way Mixing for Low-Damage LLM Steering
summary: Value steering should change an LLM's normative priorities while preserving the scenario, facts, and task constraints underlying its answer. Conventional activation edits often change both. We introduce an editable semantic-value interface on frozen residual states, with a one-way semantic-to-value pathway that grounds value recognition in context. Stop-gradient blocks feedback through this pathway; swap consistency, topic de-confounding, and decorrelation encourage selective codes. At inference, editing the value code produces a residual delta while holding the semantic code fixed. On two instruction-tuned backbones, this interface improves semantic preservation and reduces benign refusals at comparable value alignment. A matched mixing-by-gating ablation separates representation learning from selective edit activation, and dimension-matched probes establish improved code selectivity. Against validation-selected prompting on LLaMA-3.1-8B, the method achieves comparable alignment (0.750 vs. 0.748), higher BERTScore (0.938 vs. 0.923), and fewer contradictions (5.1% vs. 7.6%). Human ratings and cross-taxonomy controls provide complementary evidence for low-damage value steering.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种在冻结残差状态上的可编辑语义-价值接口，实现LLM价值引导时保持场景、事实和任务约束不变。
AI.motivation: 传统激活编辑在改变LLM规范优先级时，往往同时改变答案所依赖的场景、事实和任务约束，无法实现选择性价值引导。
AI.method: 在冻结残差状态上构建单向语义到价值的通路，通过停止梯度阻断反馈，并利用交换一致性、主题去混淆和去相关来鼓励选择性编码；推理时固定语义编码，仅编辑价值编码产生残差增量。
AI.result: 在两个指令微调主干模型上，该方法在价值对齐相当的情况下提升了语义保持并减少了良性拒绝。在LLaMA-3.1-8B上与验证集选择的提示方法相比，对齐度相当（0.750 vs. 0.748），BERTScore更高（0.938 vs. 0.923），矛盾更少（5.1% vs. 7.6%）。人类评分和跨分类控制提供了补充证据。
AI.conclusion: 该接口实现了低损伤的价值引导，能够选择性地改变价值而不破坏语义信息。

title: Debias It Yourself: Teaching LLMs Cognitive Bias Mitigation Interventions
summary: Bias has long been studied in social psychology and cognitive science, where decades of research have produced a body of validated interventions that reduce stereotypical thinking and prejudiced responses in humans. We propose Debias It Yourself (DIY), a cognitively grounded framework that translates five such interventions into debiasing procedures for large language models and delivers them through three established paradigms: Show (in-context examples), Train (instruction tuning), and Revise (guided self-revision). Across three models, five bias benchmarks, eleven debiasing baselines, and three reasoning benchmarks, Train+Revise and Revise alone attain the top two average ranks, lead the bias-reasoning tradeoff (mean bias as low as 2% at 90% reasoning accuracy), and reduce bias on unseen dimensions by up to 14.8%. Our code and data are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Debias It Yourself（DIY）框架，将五种经心理学验证的去偏见干预方法转化为大语言模型的去偏见流程，并通过Show、Train、Revise三种范式实现。在多个模型、偏见基准、基线和推理基准上，Train+Revise与Revise表现最佳，能有效降低偏见并保持推理能力。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型存在偏见问题，而社会心理学和认知科学已有数十年研究，积累了大量可减少人类刻板印象与偏见的有效干预方法，因此作者希望将这些方法迁移到LLM去偏见中。
AI.method: 提出认知基础驱动的DIY框架，把五种去偏见干预方法转化为LLM去偏见程序，并通过三种范式交付：Show（上下文示例）、Train（指令微调）、Revise（引导式自我修正）。
AI.result: 在3个模型、5个偏见基准、11个去偏见基线和3个推理基准上，Train+Revise和单独Revise取得最高的两个平均排名，在偏见-推理权衡上领先，平均偏见低至2%且推理准确率达90%，并在未见偏见维度上最多降低14.8%的偏见。
AI.conclusion: DIY框架能有效将人类去偏见干预迁移到大语言模型，在显著降低偏见的同时保持推理性能，并具备对未见偏见维度的泛化能力。代码和数据已公开。

title: CAST: Causal Advantage-Structured Training with Spatially Grounded Compositional Rewards for Diffusion Models
summary: Online reinforcement learning has been extended to flow matching for diffusion model (DM) image generation. However, this paradigm faces three limitations: (1) Window selection. Existing methods manually set the stochastic differential equation (SDE) sampling window, i.e., the denoising steps where exploration noise is injected. We instead determine it from each model's denoising trajectory. (2) Reward saturation. Current methods rely on scoring models trained on human annotations; we find that such scores are extremely high and nearly indistinguishable on the latest SOTA open-source DMs, making advantage estimation largely ineffective. (3) Sample inefficiency. A single scalar reward collapses different failure modes into almost identical scores, leaving minimal gradient guidance for targeted improvement. To address these issues, we propose CAST (Causal Advantage-Structured Training), an RL fine-tuning method for pretrained DMs, which (1) identifies the denoising step at which each model fixes the objects and their spatial arrangement in the image and uses that timing to set the SDE window, (2) decomposes each prompt via Causal Scene Graphs (CSG) into verifiable-atoms, i.e., minimal semantic units such as an object, count, attribute, or spatial relation that can each be checked independently, and rewards each atom separately, and (3) projects the signed atom-level advantages into pixel space through teacher-forced attention and uses them to spatially weight the SDE policy objective. We fine-tune two of the strongest open-source DMs, FLUX.2-dev and Qwen-Image-2512, with CAST, and evaluate them on GenEval 2, a compositional benchmark, and on Qwen-Image-Bench for overall quality. Within almost the same training budget, CAST's improvement over the base model on the most challenging GenEval 2 prompts is up to 3.07x that of Flow-GRPO, while overall generation quality also improves.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 CAST（Causal Advantage-Structured Training），一种针对预训练扩散模型的强化学习微调方法，用于在线流匹配图像生成，通过自适应确定 SDE 采样窗口、基于因果场景图的原子级奖励分解以及将优势投影到像素空间进行空间加权，提升组合生成能力与整体质量。
AI.motivation: 现有将在线强化学习扩展到流匹配扩散模型图像生成的范式存在三大局限：(1) 窗口选择——现有方法手动设置注入探索噪声的 SDE 采样窗口；(2) 奖励饱和——基于人工标注训练的评分模型在最新 SOTA 开源扩散模型上得分极高且几乎无法区分，导致优势估计几乎失效；(3) 样本低效——单一标量奖励将不同失败模式压缩为近乎相同的分数，梯度指导微弱，难以针对性改进。
AI.method: 提出 CAST 方法，包含三部分：(1) 识别每个模型在去噪轨迹中固定物体及其空间布局的去噪步，并据此设置 SDE 窗口；(2) 通过因果场景图（CSG）将提示分解为可验证原子（物体、数量、属性、空间关系等最小语义单元），对每个原子独立奖励；(3) 通过教师强制注意力将带符号的原子级优势投影到像素空间，并用其空间加权 SDE 策略目标。在 FLUX.2-dev 和 Qwen-Image-2512 两个最强开源扩散模型上进行微调。
AI.result: 在组合基准 GenEval 2 和整体质量基准 Qwen-Image-Bench 上评估。在几乎相同的训练预算下，CAST 在最具挑战性的 GenEval 2 提示上相对基座模型的提升最高可达 Flow-GRPO 的 3.07 倍，同时整体生成质量也有所提升。
AI.conclusion: CAST 有效解决了窗口选择、奖励饱和与样本低效问题，在相近训练预算下显著提升扩散模型的组合生成能力和整体质量，优于 Flow-GRPO。

title: Tactile Curiosity Drives Robot Interaction
comment: 16 pages, 6 figures, 1 table. Preprint, under review
summary: Mastering robot manipulation skills via reinforcement learning (RL) remains largely sample-inefficient. The most common RL algorithms rely on random action sampling to discover new strategies, resulting in agents that allocate most of their training budget to motions in free space, away from the contacts from which manipulation skills emerge. Existing intrinsic motivation methods based on model disagreement or epistemic uncertainty improve on isotropic noise, but they can also reward uncertainty in functionally irrelevant transitions, such as erratic motions in free space. In this work, we argue that tactile feedback provides a natural signal for exploration, and introduce TacEx, a framework that incorporates touch into epistemic uncertainty-driven exploration by decomposing model uncertainty across sensory modalities and directing curiosity toward the tactile channel. By anchoring curiosity to the sense of touch, TacEx drives the robot to discover complex contact dynamics, learning to manipulate and grasp objects without task rewards or expert demonstrations during exploration. The interaction-dense dataset collected through this tactile-driven curiosity supports offline learning of downstream pick-and-place policies without additional environment interaction. We further use tactile-driven exploration to post-train vision-language-action (VLA) models. Although the VLAs are initially pre-trained without tactile feedback, post-training with TacEx substantially improves downstream performance while remaining highly sample-efficient.

AI.tldr: 提出 TacEx 框架，将触觉反馈引入基于认知不确定性的探索，通过分解多模态模型不确定性并把好奇心导向触觉通道，提升机器人操作学习的样本效率。
AI.motivation: 强化学习在机器人操作中样本效率低。随机动作采样使大量训练预算浪费在自由空间运动上，而操作技能往往来自接触。现有基于模型分歧或认知不确定性的内在动机虽优于各向同性噪声，但仍可能奖励功能无关的不确定性，例如自由空间中的乱动。
AI.method: TacEx 将触觉纳入认知不确定性驱动的探索：按感官模态分解模型不确定性，并将探索好奇心定向到触觉通道。该方法让机器人在探索阶段无需任务奖励或专家演示即可发现复杂接触动力学，并学习操作与抓取。通过触觉驱动好奇心收集交互密集数据集，用于下游 pick-and-place 策略的离线学习；还用触觉驱动探索对 VLA 模型进行后训练。
AI.result: TacEx 使机器人无需任务奖励和专家演示即可学习操作和抓取；收集的交互密集数据支持无需额外环境交互的离线 pick-and-place 学习；对初始未使用触觉反馈预训练的 VLA 模型进行后训练后，下游性能显著提升，且保持高样本效率。
AI.conclusion: 触觉反馈可作为机器人强化学习探索的自然信号。将好奇心锚定到触觉通道、并用认知不确定性驱动探索，能有效发现接触动力学、提升操作学习与 VLA 后训练的样本效率和下游表现。

title: Dream4ACT: A Shared Visual Action Interface for Multi-Embodiment Video-Action Modeling
summary: Video generation models (VGMs) offer strong spatiotemporal priors for embodied observation--action modeling. However, joint-space action vectors lack explicit image-space structure and vary in dimensionality and semantics across embodiments, making it challenging to directly leverage the rich spatiotemporal priors of VGMs. End-effector visualizations provide an alternative but do not specify the full articulated configuration needed for robot execution. We present Dream4ACT, a world model built for joint video-action modeling across embodiments. To unify action representations across embodiments, we introduce a shared visual action interface, called action views, which render target joint configurations from four prescribed virtual cameras using URDF-based forward kinematics. This shared visual representation preserves embodiment-specific articulated geometry while allowing observation and action sequences to share a video autoencoder and diffusion transformer. Through masked flow-matching, our model supports forward dynamics, inverse dynamics, and joint observation--action generation within a single jointly trained model by varying which future sequences are corrupted. To recover executable action sequences from predicted action views, we propose a training-free, URDF-constrained multiview recovery mechanism, without a learned embodiment-specific decoder. Dream4ACT achieves an average success rate of 88.98\% on RoboTwin~2.0 and an overall score of 65.66 on TriWorldBench, supporting effective closed-loop manipulation and competitive action-conditioned multiview prediction through the visual action interface.

AI.tldr: 提出 Dream4ACT，一个面向跨具身关节视频-动作建模的世界模型，通过共享视觉动作接口 action views 统一动作表示，并用掩码流匹配在同一模型中支持正/逆向动力学与联合观测-动作生成。
AI.motivation: 视频生成模型具备强时空先验，但关节空间动作向量缺乏图像空间结构，且不同具身的维度与语义不一致，难以直接利用这些先验；末端执行器可视化虽直观，却无法提供机器人执行所需的完整关节配置。
AI.method: 引入基于 URDF 正运动学的 action views：从四个预设虚拟相机渲染目标关节配置，作为跨具身共享视觉动作接口。观测与动作序列共享视频自编码器和扩散 Transformer。通过掩码流匹配，按损坏未来序列的方式统一训练前向动力学、逆向动力学和联合观测-动作生成。推理时使用免训练、URDF 约束的多视角恢复机制，从预测的 action views 恢复可执行动作序列，无需学习具身特定解码器。
AI.result: 在 RoboTwin 2.0 上平均成功率达 88.98%，在 TriWorldBench 上总体得分为 65.66，支持有效闭环操作，并能通过视觉动作接口进行有竞争力的动作条件多视角预测。
AI.conclusion: Dream4ACT 表明，通过共享视觉动作接口和单一联合训练的视频-动作世界模型，可有效统一跨具身动作表示，并兼顾闭环操作与多视角动作条件预测。

title: Index-Translate: A Multilingual Translation Model Family -- Text, Speech, Controlled Dubbing, and Long-Document Translation
comment: 27 pages. Project: https://index-translate.bilibili.com ; Code and models: https://github.com/bilibili/Index-Translate
summary: We introduce Index-Translate, a multilingual translation model family that combines a shared multilingual foundation with specialized training for general translation, instruction following, speech translation, controlled dubbing, and long-document translation. It includes three model sizes, 2B, 9B, and 35B-A3B, and supports translation in 150 languages, with multilingual instruction following. Evaluations on general translation and complex translation instructions show that Index-Translate outperforms translation models of comparable size and achieves performance comparable to 100B-scale translation models and frontier models. Index-Echo provides end-to-end speech-to-text and speech-to-speech translation, outperforming existing end-to-end models and achieving performance comparable to frontier omni models. Index-Homura extends the family to syllable-controlled dubbing. Index-NativeLong introduces native long-document translation with a dedicated task formulation and benchmark. These capabilities support diverse translation tasks, including multilingual content production.

AI.tldr: 该论文介绍了 Index-Translate 多语言翻译模型家族，包含 2B、9B、35B-A3B 三种规模，支持 150 种语言及多语言指令跟随，并扩展出语音翻译、音节控制配音和长文档翻译等能力。
AI.motivation: 为满足通用翻译、复杂翻译指令、语音翻译、可控配音和长文档翻译等多样化多语言翻译需求，并提升不同规模模型的翻译性能与任务覆盖范围。
AI.method: 采用共享多语言基础模型，并针对通用翻译、指令跟随、语音翻译、可控配音和长文档翻译进行专门训练；构建 Index-Translate、Index-Echo、Index-Homura、Index-NativeLong 等模型或能力，支持 150 种语言，并提供长文档翻译的任务形式与基准。
AI.result: Index-Translate 在通用翻译和复杂翻译指令上优于同规模翻译模型，性能可与 100B 级翻译模型及前沿模型相比；Index-Echo 在端到端语音到文本和语音到语音翻译上优于现有端到端模型，并可与前沿 omni 模型相比；Index-Homura 扩展到音节控制配音，Index-NativeLong 引入原生长文档翻译。
AI.conclusion: 该模型家族支持多样化翻译任务，可服务于多语言内容生产等应用场景。

title: ArchitectureIQ: On the Measure of Training Intuition
comment: 29 pages, 10 figures. Code and reproduction materials: https://github.com/renrua52/ArchitectureIQ
summary: Top researchers have good intuition, but do language models have as good intuition about model training as top AI researchers? To measure model intuition of LLMs and humans, we introduce the ArchitectureIQ benchmark. Each question presents a synthetic dataset and several training recipes, and the test-taker is asked to predict the recipe yielding the best test metric. Overall, we find that LLMs' model intuition is good but has four limitations: (1) The intuition is imperfect, or even sub-human in some cases. Frontier models achieve around 76% accuracy (random choice 33%) vs best human researcher (66.0%), yet remain far from perfect. For architecture-only questions, best human achieves 65% while GPT-6 Astra only has 38%. (2) The intuition is empirical, not structured, supported by the fact that more CoT compute does not lead to substantial improvement. Unlike math, we still lack a "Science of AI" language that enables structured reasoning on AI. (3) The intuition is not maximally condensed, and can be further compressed into a knoledge base. Our constructed knowledge base with only 20 items yields large gains for weak models: GPT-4o equipped with the accumulated knowledge almost matches the performance of Claude Opus 5. (4) The intuition is insensitive to dataset properties, but the best model should in general depend on data properties. This suggests that data is the real "dark matter" in AI -- LLMs (so do human researchers) understand too little about data, even less than model architectures.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ArchitectureIQ 基准，用合成数据集和多种训练配方让 LLM 与人类研究者预测最佳测试指标，以衡量其对模型训练的直觉。
AI.motivation: 顶尖研究者有良好直觉，但尚不清楚语言模型是否也具备类似顶尖 AI 研究者的训练直觉，因此需要量化评估 LLM 与人类的模型训练直觉。
AI.method: 构建 ArchitectureIQ 基准：每题给出一个合成数据集和若干训练配方，要求受试者预测哪个配方能取得最佳测试指标；并比较 LLM 与人类研究者表现，同时考察 CoT 计算量、知识库压缩及数据属性敏感性。
AI.result: LLM 的模型直觉总体较好但有四个局限：1）直觉不完美，部分场景低于人类；前沿模型约 76% 准确率，随机为 33%，最佳人类为 66.0%，但远未完美；仅架构题中最佳人类 65%，GPT-6 Astra 仅 38%。2）直觉是经验性的而非结构化的，增加 CoT 计算量没有显著提升，说明仍缺乏可用于结构化推理的“AI 科学”语言。3）直觉未最大程度压缩，仅 20 条知识库即可大幅提升弱模型，GPT-4o 配合积累知识几乎匹敌 Claude Opus 5。4）直觉对数据集属性不敏感，但最佳模型通常应依赖数据属性，表明数据是 AI 的真正“暗物质”，LLM 和人类研究者对数据的理解都太少，甚至不如对模型架构的理解。
AI.conclusion: LLM 已具备一定模型训练直觉，但在准确性、结构化推理、知识压缩和数据理解方面仍有明显不足；未来需要发展“AI 科学”语言、构建可压缩知识库，并更深入理解数据属性对模型选择的影响。

title: Towards Trustworthy AI for Glioma Diagnosis: A Task-Aware Evaluation of Uncertainty Quantification
comment: Accepted for publication at the Journal of Machine Learning for Biomedical Imaging (MELBA) https://melba-journal.org/2026:033
summary: Uncertainty Quantification (UQ) is a key requirement for trustworthy AI in high-stakes medical image analysis. In this work, we evaluate UQ in a multi-task Deep Learning framework for MRI-based glioma diagnosis that performs tumor segmentation and predicts IDH mutation status, 1p/19q co-deletion status, and tumor grade. Monte Carlo Dropout (MCD) is used for a detailed task-aware analysis of predictive, aleatoric, and epistemic uncertainty. We assess MC sample convergence, calibration, error detection, selective prediction, associations with segmentation performance, and the effect of voxel-wise uncertainty aggregation on case-level reliability. We also compare MCD with Deep Ensembles (DE) and Monte Carlo Deep Ensembles (MCDE), examine interactions between segmentation quality and classification, and evaluate a composite trust score integrating segmentation and classification uncertainty. Across tasks, uncertainty estimates supported meaningful error detection, while calibration depended on the dropout rate, with moderate rates yielding the most reliable probabilities. Uncertainty decomposition provided task-dependent interpretability but did not consistently improve error detection over predictive uncertainty alone. DE and MCDE showed comparable operational utility, with no method consistently dominating across tasks and metrics. The composite trust score did not consistently outperform classification uncertainty for selective prediction. Overall, our results provide a task-aware evaluation strategy and practical guidance for the development of trustworthy AI for glioma diagnosis.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了多任务深度学习框架中用于MRI胶质瘤诊断的不确定性量化（UQ），该框架同时进行肿瘤分割和预测IDH突变、1p/19q共缺失及肿瘤分级。使用蒙特卡洛Dropout（MCD）进行任务感知的预测、偶然和认知不确定性分析，并与深度集成（DE）和蒙特卡洛深度集成（MCDE）比较。结果表明不确定性估计支持错误检测，校准受dropout率影响，分解提供任务相关可解释性但未一致提升错误检测，组合信任分数未持续优于分类不确定性。总体提供了任务感知的评估策略和实用指导。
AI.motivation: 在高风险医学图像分析中，不确定性量化（UQ）是可信AI的关键要求。本研究旨在评估多任务深度学习框架中UQ在MRI胶质瘤诊断中的表现。
AI.method: 在多任务DL框架中，同时进行肿瘤分割和预测IDH突变、1p/19q共缺失和肿瘤分级。使用MCD进行任务感知的预测、偶然和认知不确定性分析。评估MC样本收敛、校准、错误检测、选择性预测、与分割性能的关联、体素级不确定性聚合对病例级可靠性的影响。比较MCD与DE和MCDE，检查分割质量与分类的交互，评估整合分割和分类不确定性的组合信任分数。
AI.result: 不确定性估计支持有意义的错误检测；校准取决于dropout率，中等速率最可靠；不确定性分解提供任务相关可解释性，但未一致优于仅用预测不确定性进行错误检测；DE和MCDE操作效用相当，无方法在所有任务和指标上持续占优；组合信任分数在选择性预测中未持续优于分类不确定性。
AI.conclusion: 结果提供了任务感知的评估策略和开发可信AI用于胶质瘤诊断的实用指导。

title: Provably Tractable NFA-Constrained Language Generation via HMMs
summary: Constrained generation aims to sample from language models (LMs) conditioned on hard constraints. Existing constrained-generation techniques for nondeterministic finite automaton (NFA) constraints either distort the distribution or sacrifice efficiency. Theoretically, this task reduces to counting the length-$n$ sequences accepted by an NFA (#NFA), and the exact #NFA problem is #P-complete. Recent work has shown that #NFA admits a fully polynomial randomized approximation scheme (FPRAS). Inspired by this result, we propose NFA-LM, a polynomial-time engine for NFA-constrained generation with theoretical guarantees under mild assumptions. Experiments show that NFA-LM efficiently generates high-quality outputs with theoretically bounded approximation error.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 NFA-LM，一种用于 NFA 约束生成的多项式时间引擎，能在温和假设下提供理论保证，并通过实验实现高效、高质量且近似误差有界的生成。
AI.motivation: 现有 NFA 约束生成方法要么扭曲语言模型的概率分布，要么牺牲效率；理论上该问题可归约为 #NFA 计数问题，而精确 #NFA 是 #P 完全的，因此需要近似方法。
AI.method: 受 #NFA 存在 FPRAS 的近期结果启发，提出 NFA-LM，用于在 NFA 硬约束下从语言模型中进行多项式时间采样，并在温和假设下给出理论保证。
AI.result: 实验表明，NFA-LM 能高效生成高质量输出，并且具有理论上界定的近似误差。
AI.conclusion: NFA-LM 为 NFA 约束生成提供了一种兼顾效率与理论保证的可行方案。

title: ResARC: Residual-Aware AutoRegressive Coding for Ultra-Low Bitrate Image Compression
summary: Progressive autoregressive image codecs provide an appealing paradigm for generative compression by quantizing continuous latents into discrete tokens, transmitting coarse-to-fine prefix tokens and generating the remaining suffix tokens at the decoder. However, their reconstruction quality is fundamentally limited by two residuals introduced along this pipeline: the quantization residual, arising from information loss during discrete tokenization, and the generation residual, resulting from imperfect autoregressive generation of the suffix tokens. To address these limitations, we introduce ResARC, a residual-aware autoregressive codec that explicitly compensates for both residuals at the decoder. Specifically, we generate the quantization residual with a diffusion transformer conditioned on the autoregressive decoding context, while requiring no additional side information. In parallel, we compute the generation residual at the encoder and employ a learned Generation Residual Codec to efficiently compress and transmit it for decoder-side correction. The recovered residuals are then integrated with the reconstructed latent representation and decoded through an adapted VAE decoder. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ResARC achieves competitive perceptual similarity while substantially improving distributional fidelity over leading generative codecs across the ultra-low bitrate regime. Code and models will be released soon.

AI.tldr: 提出 ResARC，一种残差感知的自回归图像编解码器，在解码端显式补偿量化残差和生成残差，从而提升生成式压缩的保真度。
AI.motivation: 渐进式自回归图像编解码器通过粗到细传输前缀 token 并在解码端生成后缀 token 来实现生成式压缩，但其重建质量受两类残差限制：离散化带来的量化残差，以及后缀 token 自回归生成不完美带来的生成残差。
AI.method: ResARC 在解码端补偿两种残差：量化残差由扩散 Transformer 基于自回归解码上下文生成，无需额外边信息；生成残差在编码端计算，并通过学习到的 Generation Residual Codec 压缩传输以供解码端校正。恢复的残差与重建的 latent 表示融合后，送入适配的 VAE 解码器生成图像。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，在超低码率场景下，ResARC 在保持有竞争力的感知相似度的同时，显著优于领先的生成式编解码器在分布保真度上的表现。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模并补偿量化残差与生成残差，可有效缓解渐进式自回归生成压缩中的信息损失和生成误差，提升超低码率下的重建质量与分布保真度。

title: Rethinking Legibility in Social Robot Hallway Navigation: Impact of Intent Representation and Human Distraction
summary: We focus on legible robot motion generation in social navigation settings. Legibility in human-robot interaction (HRI) is often described as the property of robot motion that enables an observer to confidently infer the robot's intent. While mature frameworks exist for generating legible motion in front of static observers, social robot navigation presents a new challenge: the robot must clearly convey its intent while ensuring human safety in dynamic pedestrian environments where human attention is often divided. With the goal of enabling robots to generate legible motion in dynamic and constrained spaces, we investigate how the choice of representation and the level of human attention shape navigation performance and human impressions. Focusing on the ubiquitous and demanding scenario of hallway navigation, we conduct two controlled user studies involving alternative legibility formulations implemented within a shared model predictive control framework. Study 1 (N = 45) investigates the role of intent representation, showing that passing-side legibility, particularly when adaptively updated, leads to smoother human motion and is perceived as more competent and less mentally and physically demanding than destination-based and non-legible baselines. Study 2 (N = 45) examines the effect of pedestrian attention, demonstrating that legible motion allows for smooth human motion even under distraction, even if this is not consistently reflected in subjective ratings. Together, these findings suggest that effective legible motion in social robot navigation benefits from interaction-level intent representations that support coordination, with some effects persisting even when human attention is divided. Code is available at https://github.com/fluentrobotics/Legible_MPPI.

AI.tldr: 该研究关注社交导航中的机器人可读运动生成，围绕走廊导航场景，通过两个用户实验比较不同可读性表示与行人注意力水平对导航表现和人类感受的影响，并发现基于交互层面的意图表示更能促进协调。
AI.motivation: 现有可读运动框架多面向静态观察者，而社交机器人导航需要在动态、拥挤且行人注意力分散的环境中清晰传达意图，同时保证人类安全，因此需要研究意图表示方式和人类注意力水平如何影响导航表现与人机交互印象。
AI.method: 在共享模型预测控制框架下实现多种可读性公式，并以走廊导航为典型场景开展两个受控用户研究。研究1（N=45）考察意图表示的作用，比较基于目的地、基于通过侧以及自适应更新的可读性等基线；研究2（N=45）考察行人注意力分散的影响。
AI.result: 研究1表明，通过侧可读性（尤其是自适应更新版本）能带来更平滑的人类运动，并被感知为更有能力、心理和身体负担更低，优于基于目的地和非可读基线。研究2表明，即使行人注意力分散，可读运动也能促进平滑的人类运动，尽管这一点未始终反映在主观评分中。
AI.conclusion: 社交机器人导航中的有效可读运动受益于交互层面的意图表示，这种表示有助于人机协调；并且部分效果在人类注意力分散时仍然存在。

title: Trust Is Not a Score: Runtime Assurance Contracts for High-Risk AI Agents
comment: 16 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables. Ancillary files: decision log, executable transition model, LLM-labelled synthetic holdout. Synthetic mechanism study; no deployment claim
summary: Benchmarks, audits, and agent protocols describe performance, permissions, and repair, but not how observed evidence should change an agent's authority during a consequential task. We call this the assurance-transition gap. We propose a Runtime Assurance Contract (RAC), a policy-level formal schema binding autonomy boundaries, component eligibility, evidence state, transition policy, human-review capacity, and non-compensatory gates. Under RAC, soft metrics may inform routing, whereas a failed or unknown mandatory gate forces retry, switch, escalation, deferral, or stop; aggregate performance cannot authorize action. We define the contract, an evidence record, a permission rule, and five invariants, and illustrate them in clinical, industrial, and judicial failure probes. We then report a deterministic failure-injection study in agentic coding: 280 constructed cases evaluated by a gate conjunction, a score-only rule, and a restricted protocol baseline. At the published example weights and threshold, the score rule admits 80 of 100 block-required injections and all 40 review-required injections. Tuned in hindsight, it matches the conjunction on this corpus. For positive weights, a positive threshold, binary risk signals, zero-signal controls, and an injected case firing each signal alone, we show that exact agreement holds if and only if the threshold does not exceed the smallest weight. A separate set of 18 hand-authored traces checks version-pinned evidence and review transitions against simpler policy variants. In a further prospective synthetic holdout of 24 episodes, two blinded LLM judges assign identical labels to all 72 action attempts; RAC and a separately implemented full stateful baseline both match these labels. These studies test mechanisms on synthetic cases; they establish neither deployed safety nor cross-domain effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“运行时保证契约”（RAC），用于在关键任务中根据证据状态动态约束智能体权限，以弥补基准、审计和协议未能覆盖的“保证-转换鸿沟”。
AI.motivation: 现有基准、审计和智能体协议能描述性能、权限与修复，但未说明观察到的新证据应如何改变智能体在关键任务中的授权，即保证-转换鸿沟。
AI.method: 提出RAC政策级形式化模式，绑定自主边界、组件资格、证据状态、转换策略、人工审查容量和非补偿性门控；定义契约、证据记录、许可规则和五个不变量。用临床、工业、司法失败探针说明，并开展智能体编码的确定性故障注入研究：280个构造案例，比较门控合取、仅分数规则和受限协议基线；证明正权重等条件下精确一致的条件；另用18条手工轨迹检查版本固定证据与审查转换；再用24个前瞻性合成保留集，由两名盲法LLM评审对72次动作尝试标注，并比较RAC与完整状态基线。
AI.result: 在已公布示例权重和阈值下，仅分数规则放行100个需阻止注入中的80个，以及全部40个需审查注入；事后调参可在该语料上与合取门控一致。对于正权重、正阈值、二元风险信号等条件，精确一致当且仅当阈值不超过最小权重。18条手工轨迹验证了版本固定证据与审查转换。24个合成保留集中，两名盲法LLM评审对72次动作尝试标签完全一致，RAC与单独实现的完整状态基线均匹配这些标签。
AI.conclusion: RAC通过非补偿性门控和证据状态转换来弥补保证-转换鸿沟，但这些研究仅在合成案例上检验机制，既未证明部署安全性，也未证明跨域有效性。

title: SCB: SpeechConversationBench for Evaluating Multi-Turn Reasoning in Speech-to-Speech Models
comment: Conducted during a 2024 internship at SCBX R&D
summary: Speech-to-speech systems must solve tasks whose requirements emerge across conversational turns. We introduce SpeechConversationBench (SCB), a focused evaluation of spoken mathematical reasoning using 103 sharded GSM8K problems. The framework compares the original problem delivered in one turn (full), its concatenated information shards delivered together (concat), and incremental spoken disclosure across turns (sharded). We report final-answer accuracy for four commercial speech systems and LEGO, a proprietary speech pipeline developed internally by the SCBX Innovation Lab team with explicit conversational context management. Relative to concat, sharded accuracy decreases by 5.0-25.3 percentage points across the four commercial systems. LEGO achieves 77.5 percent accuracy in all three conditions, compared with 76.6 percent sharded accuracy for GPT-4o Realtime. The two single-turn baselines distinguish sensitivity to problem reformulation from the additional challenges introduced by incremental spoken interaction.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 SpeechConversationBench（SCB），用103个分片 GSM8K 问题评估口语数学推理，比较完整、拼接和跨轮增量口述三种条件，并测试四个商用语音系统和内部 LEGO 流程。
AI.motivation: 语音到语音系统需要处理跨对话轮次逐步出现的信息和任务要求，因此需要专门评估增量口语交互带来的挑战。
AI.method: 构建 SCB 基准，将 GSM8K 问题分片，设置 full、concat、sharded 三种呈现方式；以最终答案准确率为指标，测试四个商用语音系统及具有显式对话上下文管理的 LEGO 流程。
AI.result: 相对于 concat，四个商用系统在 sharded 条件下准确率下降 5.0 至 25.3 个百分点。LEGO 在三种条件下均达到 77.5% 准确率，GPT-4o Realtime 在 sharded 条件下为 76.6%。两个单轮基线可区分问题重述敏感性与增量口语交互的额外挑战。
AI.conclusion: 增量口语披露会显著增加商用语音系统的推理难度，而显式对话上下文管理有助于保持性能稳定；SCB 能分离问题重述与跨轮交互因素。

title: DensePed-Lite: Quality-Aware Adaptive Detection for Dense Pedestrians under Occlusion
summary: Pedestrian detection plays a crucial role in computer vision with applications in autonomous driving, surveillance, and public safety. However, real-world dense scenes bring severe challenges, including heavy occlusion, drastic scale variations, and strict real-time requirements. Existing lightweight detectors struggle to balance accuracy and efficiency while often neglecting quality-aware feature modeling and consistency between classification and localization, leading to unstable performance under crowded conditions. To address these issues, we propose DensePed-Lite, a unified framework built on a single principle: under occlusion the network should adapt its behavior to the quality of what it observes rather than assume complete information. This principle is realized at three points where occlusion does the most damage: unreliable confidence scoring (UQE), fragmented spatial coverage (MPSC), and incoherent multi-scale fusion (CTDM). The three mechanisms reinforce one another instead of acting in isolation, all without significantly increasing complexity. Experiments on CityPersons and CrowdHuman validate that DensePed-Lite achieves a superior accuracy-efficiency trade-off compared with recent state-of-the-art lightweight methods, making it suitable for real-time deployment in dense pedestrian scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出DensePed-Lite，一个用于密集行人检测的轻量级统一框架，通过UQE、MPSC、CTDM三个机制应对遮挡、尺度变化和实时性挑战，在CityPersons和CrowdHuman上实现优越的精度-效率权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有轻量级检测器难以平衡精度与效率，且忽视质量感知特征建模和分类-定位一致性，导致密集场景下性能不稳定。
AI.method: 基于“网络应根据观测质量自适应调整”的原则，设计三个模块：UQE（不可靠置信度评分）、MPSC（碎片化空间覆盖）、CTDM（不一致的多尺度融合），三者协同且不显著增加复杂度。
AI.result: 在CityPersons和CrowdHuman数据集上，与近期最先进的轻量级方法相比，DensePed-Lite取得了更优的精度-效率权衡，适合密集行人场景的实时部署。
AI.conclusion: DensePed-Lite能有效应对密集场景中的遮挡、尺度变化和实时性要求，实现轻量级实时行人检测。

title: From Wrecks to Wisdom: Recovering Crash Mechanics from Real-World Multi-View Photos
summary: Estimating accident mechanics from real-world crashes is important for vehicle-safety analysis, injury modeling, crash-severity prediction, and operational workflows such as insurance claim triage. In standard crash records, key metadata such as impact configuration, principal direction of force, and change in velocity ($ΔV$) may be missing, delayed, or corrupted, while post-crash photographs are widely available and contain rich visual evidence of deformation. We study how much crash-mechanics information can be recovered directly from vehicle photos when structured signals are absent. We formulate crash understanding as supervised prediction from per-case multi-view photo sets. Targets include six Collision Deformation Classification (CDC) descriptors and the longitudinal and lateral components of reconstructed $ΔV$. Each photo is encoded by a shared visual backbone, and the resulting view-level features are fused into a case-level representation from which target-specific heads predict crash descriptors. Using 15.2k training cases from the Crash Investigation Sampling System, drawn from about 1.5M photos before filtering, together with 1.15k validation and 1.15k test cases, we define an evaluation protocol for vision-based crash descriptor estimation from incomplete multi-view evidence. Post-crash imagery alone provides usable signal for several non-trivial crash-mechanics descriptors, while weakly observable and long-tailed targets remain challenging. Within the compared training regimes, the selected joint-training recipe reduces mean absolute angular error for principal direction of force from 20.1 to 14.05 degrees and longitudinal $ΔV$ MAE from 8.04 to 7.45 km/h. Our work provides a reference point for future multimodal fusion with structured crash metadata.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨仅凭碰撞后车辆照片，在缺乏结构化碰撞元数据时能恢复多少碰撞力学信息，并将其建模为基于多视角照片集的监督预测任务。
AI.motivation: 真实世界碰撞记录中，碰撞构型、主受力方向和速度变化（ΔV）等关键元数据常缺失、延迟或损坏，而碰撞后照片广泛可得且包含车辆变形等丰富视觉证据，因此希望直接从照片中估计碰撞力学信息，用于车辆安全、损伤建模、碰撞严重度预测和保险理赔等场景。
AI.method: 将碰撞理解形式化为逐案例多视角照片集的监督预测。预测目标包括6个碰撞变形分类（CDC）描述符以及重建ΔV的纵向和横向分量。每张照片由共享视觉骨干编码，视图级特征融合为案例级表示，再由目标特定预测头输出碰撞描述符。使用Crash Investigation Sampling System数据，约150万张照片筛选后得到15.2k训练、1.15k验证和1.15k测试案例，并定义基于不完整多视角证据的视觉碰撞描述符估计评估协议。
AI.result: 仅凭碰撞后图像即可为多个非平凡碰撞力学描述符提供可用信号，但弱可观测和长尾目标仍具挑战。在比较的训练方案中，所选联合训练方法将主受力方向的平均绝对角度误差从20.1度降至14.05度，并将纵向ΔV的MAE从8.04 km/h降至7.45 km/h。
AI.conclusion: 碰撞后照片本身可提供有用的碰撞力学估计信号，但并非所有目标都容易预测。该工作为未来结合结构化碰撞元数据的多模态融合提供了参考基准。

title: PrefPI: Preference-Guided Steering into Out-of-Distribution Behaviors
summary: We present PrefPI (Preference-Guided Policy Iteration), an iterative framework for steering pretrained generative robot policies using only relative preferences over self-generated trajectories. Unlike prior preference-learning methods that primarily sharpen modes already represented by the policy, we study steering beyond the initial effective support, where desired behaviors are rarely or never observed under the initial policy. Our key idea is to formulate preference learning as preference-conditioned generative modeling: preferred trajectories define a conditional distribution, whose density ratio with the broader behavior prior provides an implicit preference signal amplified by classifier-free guidance (CFG). Repeating this preference-conditioned modeling and guidance step yields a form of preference-guided policy iteration, turning incremental improvements toward previously inaccessible behaviors. Across diffusion policies and the PI0.5 flow- matching VLA in simulation and the real world, PrefPI produces substantial behavioral shifts with limited feedback. In particular, PrefPI increases object transport height from 10.7 cm to 19.8 cm on real hardware with only 150 preference-labeled trajectories.

AI.tldr: PrefPI是一个利用相对偏好对自生成轨迹进行迭代引导的框架，可在少量偏好反馈下，将预训练生成式机器人策略引导到初始策略覆盖范围之外的新行为。
AI.motivation: 已有偏好学习方法多只是强化策略已覆盖的模式，难以获得初始策略很少或从未表现出的目标行为；因此需要研究如何超越初始有效支持范围来引导策略。
AI.method: 将偏好学习建模为偏好条件生成建模：偏好轨迹定义条件分布，其与更广行为先验的密度比提供隐式偏好信号，并用无分类器引导（CFG）放大；重复该偏好条件建模与引导步骤，形成偏好引导的策略迭代。
AI.result: 在扩散策略和PI0.5 flow-matching VLA上，于仿真和真实世界中均取得显著行为转变且反馈有限；真实硬件上仅用150条偏好标注轨迹，将物体搬运高度从10.7 cm提升到19.8 cm。
AI.conclusion: PrefPI表明，通过偏好条件生成建模与引导迭代，可以用有限相对偏好反馈有效引导预训练生成式机器人策略，实现超出初始策略覆盖范围的行为改进。

title: OverForge: Reasoning Through Strategies and Tactics Helps Cooperative Lifelong Adaptation
summary: Cooperative language-model agents must coordinate over long horizons and adapt to changing environments and to partners with unfamiliar conventions, yet existing agents map observations to actions without separating persistent coordination strategies from their tactical execution. We introduce OverForge, a training-free hierarchical architecture that separates strategic reasoning over roles and divisions of labour from tactical reasoning over actions within each agent's private, partner-conditioned world model. A metacognitive Prefrontal Cortex Module couples the two levels by forming strategy-action branches, imagining their consequences with a forward model, and committing when confident. In OvercookedV2, OverForge delivers 7 soups in a connected kitchen versus 3 for each flat LLM baseline, retains agreed roles, and adopts roles proposed by unfamiliar partners. Ablations and a fixed-strategy probe show that persistent strategies guide tactical adaptation while each reasoning level contributes to coordination. Memory restarts show that cross-episode partner knowledge supports task performance and partner prediction, linking the hierarchy to continual adaptation.

AI.tldr: 提出OverForge，一种免训练的分层架构，将战略推理与战术执行分离，用于合作语言模型智能体的长期协调与适应。
AI.motivation: 现有合作语言模型智能体将观测直接映射为动作，未区分持久协调策略与战术执行，难以在长期任务中适应变化环境和陌生伙伴的约定。
AI.method: OverForge为免训练分层架构，战略层推理角色与分工，战术层在每个智能体私有的、以伙伴为条件的世界模型中推理动作；元认知前额叶皮层模块通过形成策略-动作分支、用前向模型想象后果并在有把握时提交，耦合两层。
AI.result: 在OvercookedV2中，OverForge在连通厨房中完成7份汤，而每个扁平LLM基线仅3份；能保持约定角色，并采纳陌生伙伴提出的角色。消融与固定策略探测表明持久策略引导战术适应，且两层推理均对协调有贡献。记忆重启实验表明跨回合伙伴知识支持任务表现与伙伴预测，将分层结构与持续适应联系起来。
AI.conclusion: 分层分离持久策略与战术执行，结合跨回合伙伴知识，可提升合作智能体的协调、角色适应与持续适应能力。

title: OmniReasoning: Pushing the Limits of Audio-Visual Joint Reasoning
summary: Recent advances have enabled unified omni-modal models in understanding audio, vision, and language. However, existing benchmarks, training data, and learning methods largely treat the modalities independently, leaving the capability of audio-visual joint reasoning poorly evaluated and insufficiently elicited. We address this gap with a benchmark, data engine, and learning method. First, we introduce OmniReasoningBench, a benchmark where both audio and visual evidence are indispensable. It comprises 1,150 multiple-choice and open-ended questions across two tasks, reasoning over video and reasoning beyond video. Second, we develop a data engine OmniQA. It automatically constructs evidence-grounded QA pairs that explicitly necessitate audio-visual joint reasoning, together with time-stamped clue chains that guide the annotation of thinking process. Besides our benchmark, this engine produces training data OmniReasoning-SFT-112K and OmniReasoning-RL-19K. Finally, we propose an on-policy self-distillation method Modality-Factored Self-Distillation (MFSD). It evaluates each sampled response under modality-specific clue contexts, disentangling the contributions of individual clues and their cross-modal interactions for token-level credit assignment. With our training data and learning method, our model OmniReasoning-30B-A3B achieves 50.0% on OmniVideoBench and 42.5% on OmniReasoningBench, improving the base model Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Thinking by 12.8 and 9.3 percentage points, respectively. Moreover, it delivers substantial gains on general and long-video benchmarks, including Video-MME-v2. We hope our work offers a solid step for facilitating future research in omni-modal joint reasoning.

AI.tldr: 该工作针对音视频联合推理能力评估不足与激发不充分的问题，提出了OmniReasoningBench基准、OmniQA数据引擎以及MFSD学习方法，并训练出OmniReasoning-30B-A3B模型，在多个基准上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有全模态模型虽能统一理解音频、视觉和语言，但基准、训练数据和学习方法大多独立处理各模态，导致音视频联合推理能力缺乏有效评估和充分激发。
AI.method: 提出OmniReasoningBench基准，包含1150道需音视频证据共同参与的选择题和开放题；开发OmniQA数据引擎，自动构建基于证据且必须音视频联合推理的问答对及时间戳线索链；提出Modality-Factored Self-Distillation（MFSD）在线自蒸馏方法，在模态特定线索上下文中评估响应，解耦单线索贡献与跨模态交互，实现token级信用分配。
AI.result: OmniReasoning-30B-A3B在OmniVideoBench达到50.0%，在OmniReasoningBench达到42.5%，分别比基座Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Thinking提升12.8和9.3个百分点，并在通用及长视频基准如Video-MME-v2上取得显著增益。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过基准、数据引擎和学习方法为全模态联合推理研究提供了坚实基础，有助于推动未来相关研究。

title: Social-WM: Safety-Aware Latent World Models for Robot Social Navigation
comment: 9 pages, 5 figures. Submitted to IEEE ICRA 2027
summary: Safe social navigation requires a robot to anticipate not only the future consequences of its actions, but also whether a nominal action can actually be executed under surrounding physical and social constraints. We present Social-WM, an efficient latent world-model planning framework trained from egocentric RGB video sequences. Our key observation is that social-navigation experience contains a systematic discrepancy between the nominal action and the realizable action: a nominal forward action may be fully executed in free space, but needs to be constrained when heading towards a pedestrian or obstacle. Social-WM learns these safety-relevant consequences directly through action-conditioned future prediction, where the target is the actual observed future following each command. We further introduce a realizable inverse-dynamics objective that associates observed latent transitions with the action actually realized rather than the nominal one. At deployment, candidate actions are imagined through the latent world model, and the inverse dynamics model estimates their realizability; nominal--realizable discrepancy then provides a safety signal before execution. The learned dynamics and realizability model remain goal-independent and support both position- and image-goal navigation. On Social-HM3D, Social-WM achieves 63.77% success while reducing human collisions to 21.67%, and maintains strong performance under zero-shot transfer to Social-MP3D, without explicit pedestrian tracking, privileged human state, or online reinforcement learning.

AI.tldr: Social-WM 是一个基于自中心 RGB 视频训练的高效潜在世界模型规划框架，用于安全社交导航，通过学习名义动作与实际可执行动作之间的差异来提供安全信号。
AI.motivation: 安全社交导航要求机器人不仅预测动作的未来后果，还要判断名义动作在周围物理与社交约束下是否真正可执行；朝向行人或障碍物时，名义前进动作需要被约束。
AI.method: 该方法从自中心 RGB 视频序列训练潜在世界模型，利用动作条件未来预测学习安全相关后果，并以真实观测到的未来为目标；同时引入可实现的逆动力学目标，将观测到的潜在状态转移与真实执行的动作而非名义动作关联。部署时，候选动作通过潜在世界模型想象，逆动力学模型估计其可实现性，名义动作与可实现动作之间的差异作为执行前安全信号。
AI.result: 在 Social-HM3D 上，Social-WM 达到 63.77% 成功率，并将人类碰撞降至 21.67%；在零样本迁移到 Social-MP3D 时仍保持较强性能，且无需显式行人跟踪、特权人类状态或在线强化学习。
AI.conclusion: 学习到的动力学与可实现性模型具有目标无关性，支持位置目标和图像目标导航，并能在未见环境中实现较强零样本迁移，为安全社交导航提供了一种有效框架。

title: Safety of Latent Communication in Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Latent communication enables multi-agent systems to exchange information directly in internal representation space, reducing the token, computation, and latency overhead of text-based communication. To this end, lightweight trainable links are introduced to map the sender's representations into the receiver's input space. In this work, we show that even benign link training can increase harmful compliance relative to text-based communication while the underlying safety-aligned agents remain unchanged. An attacker can amplify this effect by optimizing the links on harmful query--response pairs or poisoning otherwise benign training data. We further develop a reinforcement-learning attack that rewards harmful compliance alongside benign task performance without requiring harmful target responses. Across three communication topologies and four safety benchmarks, this attack raises the mean harmful-compliance score from 27.9 with benignly trained links to 76.9. Compared with direct supervised optimization, it also achieves higher average accuracy on two benign utility benchmarks. Adapting the rewards toward safer behavior also enables repair of compromised links, substantially reducing harmful compliance across all evaluated attacks without updating the agents. Overall, our results show that safety alignment requires considering the multi-agent system as a whole.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多智能体潜在通信中的可训练链接对安全对齐的威胁，发现即使良性训练也可能增加有害请求的顺从，并可用强化学习攻击放大；同时可通过调整奖励修复受损链接。
AI.motivation: 潜在通信能降低多智能体文本通信的开销，但发送方表示到接收方输入空间的可训练链接可能改变系统整体安全行为，即使底层智能体本身仍安全对齐。
AI.method: 引入轻量可训练链接实现潜在通信；分析良性链接训练的影响；通过有害查询-响应对优化链接或污染训练数据；提出一种强化学习攻击，奖励有害顺从与良性任务表现，无需有害目标响应；在三种通信拓扑和四个安全基准上评估，并在两个良性效用基准上比较；还尝试调整奖励以修复受损链接。
AI.result: 该强化学习攻击将平均有害顺从分数从良性训练链接的27.9提升至76.9；相比直接监督优化，在两个良性效用基准上平均准确率更高；调整奖励可修复受损链接，在评估攻击中大幅降低有害顺从，且无需更新智能体。
AI.conclusion: 安全对齐必须将多智能体系统视为整体，潜在通信中的链接训练与攻击可绕过个体智能体的安全对齐，需系统级安全考虑与修复机制。

title: Linguistic Loopholes in LLM Unlearning: From a 174-Language Benchmark to Coverage-Aware Unlearning
summary: Unlearning a fact in one language does not guarantee its removal in others as changing the query or even the requested answer language can reopen seemingly forgotten knowledge -- a cross-lingual loophole. The most straightforward solution to this challenge -- unlearning in all languages -- is neither scalable nor desirable as it amplifies damage to unrelated model capabilities. We introduce the task of language budgeted multilingual unlearning where the goal is to select a subset of languages that maximizes cross-lingual erasure. To study this task we introduce the Cross-Lingual Unlearning Tensor, an unlearning benchmark that spans 174 language--script pairs and 25 atomic paraphrase types to examine when forgetting generalizes across linguistic expressions of the same knowledge. We further propose COVER, which selects source languages to maximize predicted COVERage of languages receiving no forget supervision, enabling unlearning on a language budget. Surprisingly, we find naively selecting strong individual sources does not reliably compose into strong source sets motivating our development of COVER. At deployment COVER only requires benign calibration data and access to the frozen model. Across three model families and two disjoint forget sets, COVER reduces mean held-out residual access by 7.8--27.3% relative to uniform source selection. We find these gains extend beyond synthetic benchmarks to real news documents in low-resource language settings using human translated data from the Low Resource Languages for Emergent Incidents (LORELEI) corpus.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出语言预算多语言遗忘任务，构建跨语言遗忘张量基准，并提出COVER方法，在有限语言预算下选择源语言以最大化跨语言遗忘效果。
AI.motivation: 在一种语言中遗忘事实并不能保证其他语言中也遗忘，更换查询或回答语言可能重新激活已遗忘知识，形成跨语言漏洞。而在所有语言中遗忘不可扩展，且会损害无关模型能力。
AI.method: 定义语言预算多语言遗忘任务；构建Cross-Lingual Unlearning Tensor基准，覆盖174个语言-文字对和25种原子释义类型；提出COVER，利用良性校准数据和冻结模型，选择源语言以最大化对无遗忘监督语言的预测覆盖。
AI.result: COVER在三个模型家族和两个不相交遗忘集上，将平均留出残余访问量相对均匀源选择降低7.8%–27.3%；增益从合成基准扩展到低资源语言的真实新闻文档，使用LORELEI语料的人工翻译数据。
AI.conclusion: 跨语言遗忘需要策略性选择源语言，而非简单在所有语言中遗忘或选择强单语言源；COVER能在语言预算下有效提升跨语言遗忘泛化，并适用于真实低资源场景。

title: Comparison of techniques for fine-tuning open-weight models for entity extraction from radiology reports
summary: Converting free-text radiology reports into structured labels supports cohort building, quality assurance, and monitoring of clinical imaging models, but the strongest label extractors are hosted proprietary models whose use raises privacy, cost, and reproducibility concerns. We asked whether a fine-tuned open-weight model (Gemma-3-12B) can match GPT-4o at multi-label intracranial hemorrhage (ICH) acuity extraction from non-contrast head-CT reports, and which ingredients matter. Using a 2x2 design, we crossed two adaptation strategies (a discriminative classification head, CH; generative instruction fine-tuning, IFT) with two training-data sources (distillation of real GPT-4o-labeled reports; synthetic reports generated by GPT-4o from real exemplars), across five training sizes, benchmarked on 100 expert-adjudicated reports against GPT-4o and the un-tuned open-weight base. The distilled instruction-tuned model (DIFT) matched GPT-4o (macro-F1 0.845 vs 0.850; p = 1.000) and exceeded the base model by 0.178. The decisive factor was the training-data source, not the fine-tuning method: both synthetic-data models failed to exceed the un-tuned open-weight base at any training size and underperformed the distilled models across all acuity classes. Fine-tuning and inference fit within the memory envelope of a single 24 GB consumer GPU. For narrow, high-value clinical label-extraction tasks, distilling real reports, rather than generating synthetic ones, is what closes the gap to a hosted model, enabling a private, low-cost, version-stable on-premises alternative.

AI.tldr: 研究评估微调开放权重模型 Gemma-3-12B 能否在非增强头颅 CT 报告的多标签颅内出血急迫性抽取任务上匹配 GPT-4o，并分析微调方法与训练数据来源的影响。
AI.motivation: 将自由文本放射报告转为结构化标签有助于队列构建、质量保证和临床影像模型监测，但最强抽取器多为专有托管模型，存在隐私、成本和可复现性问题。因此作者希望找到隐私、低成本、版本稳定的本地开放权重替代方案。
AI.method: 采用 2x2 设计：两种适配策略（判别式分类头 CH、生成式指令微调 IFT）× 两种训练数据来源（蒸馏真实 GPT-4o 标注报告、由 GPT-4o 基于真实样例生成合成报告），覆盖五种训练规模；在 100 份专家裁定报告上评估 Gemma-3-12B，并与 GPT-4o 及未调优开放权重基座对比。
AI.result: 蒸馏+指令微调模型 DIFT 匹配 GPT-4o（macro-F1 0.845 vs 0.850；p=1.000），并比未调优基座高 0.178。决定性因素是训练数据来源而非微调方法：合成数据模型在任何训练规模下均未超过未调优基座，且在所有急迫性类别上均低于蒸馏模型。微调与推理可在单张 24 GB 消费级 GPU 内存内完成。
AI.conclusion: 对于窄范围、高价值的临床标签抽取任务，蒸馏真实报告而非生成合成报告，是缩小与托管模型差距的关键，可实现隐私、低成本、版本稳定的本地部署替代方案。

title: Learning Steganography Is Easy, Learning Steganographic Reasoning Is Hard
comment: Accepted as an oral at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Trustworthy AI for Good (AI4GOOD). 41 pages. Code: https://github.com/stegano-ai/steg-reasoning-is-hard
summary:
Chain-of-thought monitoring as an approach for AI oversight and control is threatened by the possibility of steganographic reasoning, where LLMs conceal their reasoning inside innocuous-looking text. Two neighbouring capabilities, steganographic messaging (passing a concealed message) and encoded reasoning (reasoning in an illegible but unconcealed format), have already been shown to emerge under training pressures that occur in real pipelines, such as reinforcement learning against monitors. This suggests that steganographic reasoning too might arise as an unintended side effect of training. Here, we compare how easily models learn steganographic reasoning and these two neighbouring capabilities across three elicitation methods: reinforcement learning, in-context learning, and supervised fine-tuning (SFT).
  For most tasks, models learn steganographic reasoning only under SFT, while they learn steganographic messaging and encoded reasoning under all three elicitation methods. Even under SFT, steganographic reasoning requires at least twice as much training as messaging, and for several model-task combinations it is not learned at all. However, on a cover task that makes hiding information especially convenient, steganographic reasoning can be successfully learned under all three elicitation methods. Steganographic reasoning is thus much harder than steganographic messaging and encoded reasoning, and learning the latter two does not imply learning the former. Yet it lies within reach: an easy version is learned under every elicitation method, when the cover task is convenient for hiding information.

AI.tldr: 论文比较了LLM中隐写推理、隐写消息传递和编码推理三种能力在不同诱导方法下的学习难度。结果表明，隐写推理比另外两种能力更难学会，但在合适的掩护任务下仍可能被学会。
AI.motivation: 链式思维监控是AI监督与控制的重要手段，但可能受到隐写推理的威胁：模型把推理隐藏在看似无害的文本中。已有研究显示，隐写消息传递和编码推理可在真实训练流程中出现，因此需要探究隐写推理是否也会作为训练副产物出现。
AI.method: 论文在三种诱导方法下比较模型学习隐写推理、隐写消息传递和编码推理的难易程度：强化学习、上下文学习和监督微调（SFT）。
