AI.result: 多数任务中，模型仅在SFT下学会隐写推理，而隐写消息传递和编码推理在三种方法下都能学会。即使在SFT下，隐写推理所需训练量至少是消息传递的两倍，且在若干模型-任务组合中完全学不会。但在特别便于隐藏信息的掩护任务上，隐写推理可通过三种方法成功学会。
AI.conclusion: 隐写推理比隐写消息传递和编码推理难得多，学会后两者并不意味着学会前者。然而，当掩护任务便于隐藏信息时，隐写推理的简单版本仍可在所有诱导方法下被学会，因此它并非遥不可及。

title: Non-Invasive Inspection of Water Canals Using Dronar
summary: Open concrete canals play a vital role in water transportation, serving as primary water infrastructure for millions of people across the Phoenix, Arizona, metro area. Over time, the concrete canals can experience a range of issues, including canal lining deformation, cracked concrete, and sediment buildup on the canal floor. Identifying such critical issues is a resource-intensive process, which currently happens only during four-year dry-up cycles. This prevents the maintenance crew from prioritizing operations on the most affected canal segments. To address this issue, the research team has developed and verified an easily deployable and non-invasive method to inspect canal beds without draining the water. This inspection system integrates affordable, off-the-shelf drone and sonar technology (termed dronar). This dronar system includes a consumer-grade sonar system integrated into an unmanned surface vehicle (USV) that carries the sonar transducer just under the surface of the canal water. This paper presents a proof-of-concept demonstration of the dronar system across three field tests on the Arizona Canal in Phoenix. DownScan depth profiles from the sedimented canal segment were consistently shallower than profiles from the same segment after cleaning, with offsets of up to 15 cm observed along the track. Repeated runs over the clean segment produced closely overlapping DownScan depth profiles, confirming that the dronar yields repeatable measurements across the natural variation of the canal bed. These results establish the dronar as a viable proof-of-concept tool for non-invasive canal bed inspection.

AI.tldr: 研究团队开发并验证了一种名为 dronar 的非侵入式渠道检测系统，利用无人水面艇搭载消费级声纳，在不排水的条件下检测混凝土渠道底部淤积和变形等问题。
AI.motivation: 开放混凝土渠道是凤凰城地区重要供水基础设施，但会出现衬砌变形、混凝土开裂和底部淤积等问题。目前仅在四年一次的干涸周期进行检查，资源消耗大且无法优先维护受损最严重渠段。
AI.method: 将经济易得的消费级声纳集成到无人水面艇（USV）上，使声纳换能器位于渠道水面下方，形成 dronar 系统。在亚利桑那渠道开展三次现场测试，比较清淤前后 DownScan 深度剖面，并通过重复测量评估可重复性。
AI.result: 淤积渠段的 DownScan 深度剖面始终比清淤后更浅，沿线偏移最高达 15 cm；清洁渠段重复运行获得高度重叠的深度剖面，表明 dronar 在渠道底部自然变化下仍能提供可重复测量。
AI.conclusion: dronar 被证明是可行的概念验证工具，可用于非侵入式渠道底部检测，帮助维护人员识别和优先处理问题渠段。

title: Front-to-Back: Benchmarking Vision-Language Models for Asymmetric Cross-View Vehicle Re-Identification
comment: Submitted to the ACCV 2026 Workshop on Computer Vision for Developing Countries (CV4DC)
summary: Matching the same vehicle across front and rear cameras is difficult because the cameras do not share a view and the vehicle's appearance changes substantially. We introduce Front2Back-ReID, a benchmark of 500 manually verified vehicle handovers from 20 recording sequences in South Africa. Each example asks a model to match a vehicle highlighted in a front-camera image to the same vehicle among at least three candidates in a later rear-camera image. We evaluate seven zero-shot vision-language models, four image-retrieval baselines, and 25 human participants. Models are tested using full front RGB images, cropped target vehicles, and binary silhouettes. The strongest VLM achieved 76.6 percent Rank-1 accuracy on target crops, compared with 74.0 percent for the frozen SigLIP2 baseline; this difference was not statistically clear. Human participants achieved 94.0 percent accuracy with full images and 92.2 percent with target crops. Under our evaluation setup, enabling reasoning improved accuracy across all three input conditions for every model evaluated in both modes. We also found that VLMs generally performed worse on full scenes than on target crops. These results show that general-purpose VLMs do not yet consistently outperform strong visual retrieval for front-to-rear vehicle matching, while humans remain substantially more reliable.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Front2Back-ReID 基准，用于前后摄像头下的同一车辆匹配，包含南非20段录像中500个手工验证的车辆交接样本，并评估了视觉语言模型、检索基线和人类表现。
AI.motivation: 前后摄像头不共享视野，且车辆外观在前后视角间变化很大，因此跨前后摄像头的同一车辆匹配非常困难。
AI.method: 构建 Front2Back-ReID 基准：每个样本要求模型将前摄像头图像中高亮的车辆，与后摄像头图像中至少三个候选车辆中的同一车辆匹配。评估7个零样本视觉语言模型、4个图像检索基线和25名人类参与者，输入包括完整前视RGB图像、裁剪目标车辆和二值轮廓，并比较是否启用推理。
AI.result: 最强VLM在目标裁剪上达到76.6% Rank-1准确率，冻结SigLIP2基线为74.0%，差异不显著；人类在完整图像上达94.0%，在目标裁剪上达92.2%。启用推理在所有模型和三种输入条件下均提升准确率，且VLM在完整场景上通常比目标裁剪表现更差。
AI.conclusion: 通用视觉语言模型在前后车辆匹配上尚未稳定优于强视觉检索方法，而人类仍然明显更可靠。

title: FIGS: Evaluating Multi-Turn Sycophancy Without Penalizing Empathy
summary: Large language models frequently fail to balance staying truthful with being supportive. They often exhibit sycophancy in responses to users, agreeing with false claims, offering unwarranted flattery, and giving advice skewed toward users' expressed views. In reality, sycophancy rarely happens in a single exchange; it may emerge organically as users repeatedly insist or subtly steer the dialogue over time. Current evaluations, however, rely on rigid, single-turn tests or fixed scripts that fail to capture these natural dynamics. Furthermore, these benchmarks often mistake showing basic empathy for yielding, penalizing models for acknowledging a user's feeling. This view may drive future models to over-correct into cold, dismissive rigidity. To address this gap, we introduce FIGS (Factual Integrity and Grounded Support), a dual-axis evaluation framework built around extended, realistic dialogue. We use an adaptive 10-turn conversational simulator that dynamically challenges the target model, reflecting how users repeat requests, push back, or steer a conversation toward a preferred answer. To accurately evaluate these trajectories, we apply a taxonomy that strictly separates Sycophancy (whether the model holds firm to the truth and keeps its praise proportional) from Calibrated Validation (showing empathetic understanding of the user's feelings without overdoing it). We release our complete testing environment, including 500 diverse multi-turn scenarios and an automated judge. Our evaluation of leading models reveals a consistent trade-off: over the course of a sustained interaction, current systems either slowly drift to sycophancy or over-correct into robotic detachment. This demonstrates that balancing honesty with appropriate support throughout a natural conversation remains a critical, unsolved challenge.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 FIGS（事实完整性与有依据支持）双轴评估框架，通过10轮自适应多轮对话模拟器，区分谄媚与适度共情，评估大模型在长期交互中是否既能坚持真相又能恰当支持用户。
AI.motivation: 现有评估多依赖单轮或固定脚本，无法捕捉现实中用户反复施压、逐步引导对话产生的谄媚行为；同时常把基本共情误判为让步，可能误导模型过度纠正为冷漠僵硬。
AI.method: 构建包含500个多轮场景的测试环境与自动评判器；用10轮自适应对话模拟器动态挑战目标模型；采用分类体系严格区分谄媚（是否坚持真相、赞美是否适度）与校准验证（恰当共情而不夸张）。
AI.result: 对主流模型的评估显示一致权衡：持续交互中，模型要么逐渐滑向谄媚，要么过度纠正为机械式疏离。
AI.conclusion: 在自然对话中兼顾诚实与恰当支持仍是关键且未解决的挑战。

title: Centralized Multi-UAV Exploration and 3D Reconstruction Using Single-UAV Planners
comment: Presented at the IEEE International Conference on Advanced Robotics and Mechatronics (ICARM 2026). To appear in IEEE Xplore
summary:
Extending single Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) exploration methods to multi-UAV teams can improve coverage speed and robustness, but introduces challenges such as consistent mapping, safe navigation, and deployment strategy. In this work, we present a centralized multi-UAV exploration framework that enables the use of existing single-UAV sampling-based planners in a multi-UAV setting.
  The proposed architecture allows multiple UAVs to collaboratively explore unknown environments using a shared global Truncated Signed Distance Field (TSDF) map and centralized planning. Building on the voxblox library, we adapt its mapping pipeline to support real-time fusion of depth measurements from multiple UAVs into a common TSDF representation. In addition, inter-UAV collision avoidance and robot self-filtering mechanisms are integrated into the system to ensure safe navigation and prevent reconstruction of other UAVs as static obstacles.
  The framework is evaluated in simulation using four sampling-based exploration planners - RH-NBVP, KRH-NBVP, AEP, and KAEP - whose core sampling logic is preserved, with only system-level adaptations for multi-UAV operation. Experiments are conducted across multiple environments and under two deployment configurations: Joint Start (JS), where UAVs are initialized in close proximity, and Separated Start (SS), where UAVs are initialized in distinct locations. Results show that SS deployments consistently achieve faster exploration and improved coverage across all planners, highlighting the importance of the deployment strategy in multi-UAV exploration performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种集中式多无人机探索框架，使现有单无人机采样规划器可用于多机协同探索未知环境。
AI.motivation: 将单无人机探索方法扩展到多无人机可提升覆盖速度和鲁棒性，但会带来一致建图、安全导航与部署策略等挑战。
AI.method: 基于voxblox构建共享全局TSDF地图，实时融合多无人机深度测量并进行集中规划；集成无人机间避障与机器人自过滤机制，避免将其他无人机重建为静态障碍。
AI.result: 在仿真中评估RH-NBVP、KRH-NBVP、AEP和KAEP四种采样规划器，并在联合起点与分离起点两种部署方式下测试；分离起点在所有规划器中均实现更快探索和更好覆盖。
AI.conclusion: 部署策略对多无人机探索性能具有重要影响，分离起点配置优于联合起点配置。

title: PartiCam: Camera Controlled Video Generation with Reward Guidance
summary: We present PartiCam, a training-free Particle filtering rooted method for improved Camera controlled video generation. Generating videos that follow a precisely specified camera trajectory remains challenging for large video diffusion models. Training-free approaches are backbone-agnostic and avoid the need to construct large camera-annotated datasets by steering pretrained models toward the desired camera motion at test time. This enables the generation of camera-controlled video data that can subsequently be used to train camera-conditioned video diffusion models. Existing sampling-based guidance approaches often suffer from unstable trajectories: they either explore too broadly and fail to respect the target camera motion or collapse early and lose visual diversity over time. We introduce a global-local refinement framework for diffusion reward guidance, enabling accurate and consistent camera control during video generation. Our method builds on Sequential Monte-Carlo (SMC) guidance, but introduces a local refinement stage based on particle filtered resampling. Experiments show large improvements in camera trajectory adherence, reduced drift, and better visual quality, without requiring model retraining.

AI.tldr: 提出PartiCam，一种无需训练的基于粒子滤波的相机控制视频生成方法，通过全局-局部细化框架提升相机轨迹遵循度和视觉质量。
AI.motivation: 大型视频扩散模型难以生成精确遵循指定相机轨迹的视频。现有免训练采样引导方法轨迹不稳定：要么探索过广无法遵循目标运动，要么过早崩溃失去视觉多样性。
AI.method: 基于序列蒙特卡洛(SMC)引导，引入基于粒子滤波重采样的局部细化阶段，形成全局-局部细化框架用于扩散奖励引导。
AI.result: 实验显示相机轨迹遵循度大幅提升，漂移减少，视觉质量更好，且无需重新训练模型。
AI.conclusion: PartiCam能有效改善相机控制视频生成，无需训练，可生成相机控制视频数据用于训练相机条件视频扩散模型。

title: How Much Is an AI Token Worth? Scaling Laws for Wild AI-Generated Web Text
summary: Web text makes up the majority of pretraining data and is increasingly AI-generated. After applying FineWeb quality filtering, we find that 27.5% of tokens from June 2026 web data are labeled as AI-generated by Pangram, rising to 31.1% by August. Unlike synthetic data or model-collapse setups, this *wild* AI text comes from many models, is written for human readers, and arrives unlabeled in pretraining corpora. How does AI text in the wild affect language model pretraining? To answer this question, we pretrain 800 language models, varying the ratio of added AI tokens to human tokens, and fit scaling laws to held-out losses on both human and AI-generated text. For data-starved models, adding AI tokens to pretraining data initially lowers loss on human text, but the benefit saturates as more are added and quickly *reverses* into harm. For models trained on high budgets of human text, AI tokens raise loss almost immediately, while the same number of fresh human tokens keeps lowering it. Scaling laws such as Hoffman et al. (2022) fail to predict this behavior. We propose a new scaling law with separate benefit and harm terms that allows the value of an AI token to change sign while also reducing to Chinchilla in the absence of AI text. When fit on smaller models, our scaling law predicts the effect of AI text on held-out human-text loss for models up to 3.6x larger with 41% lower error than the best existing law over all AI ratios. We recommend filtering AI text when the target is human text, repeating human text before expanding the training dataset with AI-generated web text, and reporting validation loss on human and AI text separately AI text remains valuable when the target is AI text. We release WildAI, an 83B-token corpus with AI, topic, and format labels, all 800 models and code at https://github.com/pangramlabs/WildAI.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究“野生”AI生成网页文本对语言模型预训练的影响。作者发现经过质量过滤后，网络数据中相当比例token已由AI生成，并通过训练800个不同AI/human token比例的语言模型，提出一种能刻画AI文本先有益后有害、且无AI时退化为Chinchilla的新缩放律。
AI.motivation: 网页文本是预训练数据主体，但其中越来越多内容由AI生成，且这些AI文本来自众多模型、面向人类读者、未标注地混入语料。现有合成数据或模型坍缩研究无法回答这种“野生”AI文本会如何影响语言模型预训练。
AI.method: 使用Pangram标注FineWeb过滤后网页数据中的AI生成token比例；预训练800个语言模型，改变加入的AI token与人类token比例；分别在人类文本和AI生成文本上拟合缩放律；提出包含独立“收益项”和“危害项”的新缩放律，并验证其外推能力。
AI.result: AI文本比例从2026年6月的27.5%升至8月的31.1%。对人类文本目标：数据不足时，加入少量AI token初期降低loss，但收益饱和并迅速转为危害；人类文本预算高时，AI token几乎立即提高loss，而等量新鲜人类token仍可降低loss。Hoffman等缩放律无法预测该行为。新缩放律在更小模型上拟合后，可预测最大3.6倍大模型的AI文本对人类文本held-out loss影响，误差比最佳现有律低41%。
AI.conclusion: 当目标是人类文本时，应过滤AI文本，并优先重复人类文本而非用AI生成网页文本扩充训练集；当目标是AI文本时，AI文本仍有价值。应分别报告人类文本和AI文本上的验证损失。作者发布WildAI语料（83B token，含AI、主题、格式标签）、全部800个模型和代码。

title: EvoDuet: Bilevel Co-Evolution of Web Searching and Task Solving for Scientific Discovery
summary: Evolutionary search with large language models (LLMs) can stall when progress requires external knowledge the model lacks. Supplying relevant documents helps, but simply adding web search tool can keep returning the same pages as solutions change. We introduce EvoDuet, a bi-level optimization method that co-evolves solutions and search queries with fixed model parameters. At each iteration, a retrieval gate lets the LLM assess its knowledge gap and choose to retrieve new documents, reuse stored ones, or proceed without them. An inner loop refines queries and ranks documents by the solution scores they are predicted to yield; an outer loop generates candidates in parallel from these documents and records the evaluated outcomes for later searches. Across 21 optimization tasks with one candidate per iteration, EvoDuet raises OpenEvolve's normalized discovery gain from 74.1% to 78.0% with GPT-5.6-Luna and from 61.3% to 82.3% with Gemini-3.8-Flash, whereas Qwen3.5-9B does not benefit. Our best runs surpass the previously reported best scores on eight tasks, including Swap Reduction on Q20 and Rosetta, and match them on three more. EvoDuet also improves with other scaffolds (e.g., Top-K, EvoX) on Sums/Diffs and Denoising, demonstrating its applicability across evolutionary search scaffolds.

AI.tldr: EvoDuet 是一种双层优化方法，让大语言模型在进化搜索中同时进化候选解与检索查询，以解决缺乏外部知识时搜索停滞的问题。
AI.motivation: 进化搜索依赖大语言模型时，若进展需要模型不具备的外部知识，搜索会停滞；直接加入网页搜索工具又会因解不断变化而反复返回相同页面，检索效率低。
AI.method: 提出 EvoDuet，在固定模型参数下协同进化解与搜索查询。每轮通过检索门让模型判断知识缺口，选择检索新文档、复用已有文档或不检索；内层循环优化查询并依据预测可获得的解分数对文档排序；外层循环基于这些文档并行生成候选解，并记录评估结果供后续搜索使用。
AI.result: 在 21 个优化任务、每轮一个候选解的设置下，EvoDuet 将 OpenEvolve 的归一化发现增益从 74.1% 提升至 78.0%（GPT-5.6-Luna），从 61.3% 提升至 82.3%（Gemini-3.8-Flash），但 Qwen3.5-9B 未获益。最佳运行在 8 个任务上超过此前最佳分数，包括 Q20 和 Rosetta 上的 Swap Reduction，并在另外 3 个任务上持平；在 Sums/Diffs 和 Denoising 上也能与 Top-K、EvoX 等其他脚手架结合取得提升。
AI.conclusion: EvoDuet 通过共同进化解与检索查询，能有效增强基于大语言模型的进化搜索，并可适用于不同进化搜索脚手架。

title: STARS: From Spatiotemporal Dynamics to Social Representations in Human-Robot Interaction
comment: Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL) 2026. First two authors contributed equally. Project site: https://larg.github.io/stars/
summary: Robot navigation in dynamic, human-centered environments requires socially-compliant decisions grounded in robust scene understanding. Recent Vision-Language Models (VLMs) exhibit promising capabilities such as object recognition, common-sense reasoning, and contextual understanding, capabilities that align with the nuanced requirements of social robot navigation. However, it remains unclear whether VLMs can accurately understand complex social navigation scenes (e.g., inferring the spatial-temporal relations among agents and human intentions), which is essential for safe and socially compliant robot navigation. While some recent works have explored the use of VLMs in social robot navigation, no existing work systematically evaluates their ability to meet these necessary conditions. In this paper, we introduce the Social Navigation Scene Understanding Benchmark (SocialNav-SUB), a Visual Question Answering (VQA) dataset and benchmark designed to evaluate VLMs for scene understanding in real-world social robot navigation scenarios. SocialNav-SUB provides a unified framework for evaluating VLMs against human and rule-based baselines across VQA tasks requiring spatial, spatiotemporal, and social reasoning in social robot navigation. Through experiments with state-of-the-art VLMs, we find that while the best-performing VLM achieves an encouraging probability of agreeing with human answers, it still underperforms simpler rule-based approach and human consensus baselines, indicating critical gaps in social scene understanding of current VLMs. Our benchmark sets the stage for further research on foundation models for social robot navigation, offering a framework to explore how VLMs can be tailored to meet real-world social robot navigation needs. An overview of this paper along with the code and data can be found at https://larg.github.io/socialnav-sub.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SocialNav-SUB基准，用于评估视觉语言模型在社交机器人导航场景理解中的能力，发现现有VLMs虽有一定表现但仍存在关键差距。
AI.motivation: 社交机器人导航需要基于稳健场景理解的符合社会规范的决策，而VLMs虽展现出相关潜力，但其能否准确理解复杂社交导航场景（如时空关系、人类意图）尚不明确，且缺乏系统评估。
AI.method: 构建了SocialNav-SUB，一个VQA数据集和基准，包含需要空间、时空和社交推理的任务，并提供了统一框架来对比VLMs、人类和规则基线。
AI.result: 实验表明，最佳VLM与人类答案一致的概率令人鼓舞，但仍低于更简单的规则方法和人类共识基线，表明当前VLMs在社交场景理解上存在关键缺陷。
AI.conclusion: 该基准为社交机器人导航的基础模型研究奠定了基础，提供了探索如何定制VLMs以满足现实社交导航需求的框架。

title: Comparative study of adapting pre-trained models for driving behavior video captioning
summary: This report examines and compares some of the many fine tuning and prompting methods existing, applying them within the domain of autonomous driving. The idea is to compare these methods by adapting a Large Language Model (LLM) on a video dataset. LLM's have become extremely good at achieving a good understanding of different forms of data and this study aims to induce a low dimensional understanding of driving situations into our primary test model SpaceTimeGPT. Experiments on BDD-X (Berkeley DeepDrive eXplanation) dataset demonstrate good performance of the full fine tuning framework on some automatic metrics, and in some metrics, it even surpasses the baseline. We also try Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) and prompt engineering on VideoLLaVA model and discuss its limitations.

AI.tldr: 本文在自动驾驶领域比较多种微调与提示方法，将大语言模型适配到视频数据集上，并在BDD-X数据集上验证SpaceTimeGPT及VideoLLaVA的表现。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型已能很好理解多种数据形式，研究希望将其对驾驶场景的理解压缩为低维表示，并系统比较不同微调与提示方法在自动驾驶视频任务中的效果。
AI.method: 在BDD-X（Berkeley DeepDrive eXplanation）数据集上，对SpaceTimeGPT进行全量微调，并尝试LoRA和提示工程方法，同时在VideoLLaVA模型上应用LoRA与提示工程进行对比。
AI.result: 全量微调框架在部分自动评价指标上表现良好，某些指标甚至超过基线；LoRA和VideoLLaVA上的提示工程则存在一定局限性。
AI.conclusion: 全量微调在自动驾驶视频理解任务中具有较好效果，而LoRA和提示工程虽具潜力，但在该场景下仍受限制，需进一步改进。

title: GrammarRL: Effective Grammar-Constrained Decoding via Reinforcement Learning
summary:
Grammar-constrained generation guarantees syntactic validity, but can substantially degrade semantic quality when the model's preferred outputs are poorly aligned with the imposed grammar. This trade-off is particularly severe when the prompt is underspecified or the model has limited instruction-following ability. Beam search can partially mitigate these failures by exploring multiple valid sequences, but its computational cost grows with beam width, while sequence-level probability is only an imperfect proxy for semantic quality.
  We introduce GrammarRL, a label-free reinforcement learning method that adapts language models to grammar constraints without requiring annotated data. GrammarRL optimizes the model using two complementary self-supervised rewards derived from its own likelihoods: a direct reward, measuring how likely the constrained output is given the input, and a reverse reward, measuring how well the input can be reconstructed from the generated output. We optimize these rewards with a Reinforce Leave-One-Out (RLOO) objective over groups of grammar-constrained rollouts, augmented with the top-1 beam-search hypothesis and regularized towards a frozen base model.
  We evaluate GrammarRL on sign language gloss translation, hierarchical text classification, and named entity recognition using Llama models ranging from 1B to 8B parameters. GrammarRL consistently outperforms constrained greedy decoding, with an average improvement of 9.8 points and gains of up to 22.8 BLEU. It matches or outperforms beam search on two of the three tasks while preserving greedy-decoding inference cost. Ablations further show that the two rewards are complementary: either reward alone can underperform the untrained baseline, whereas their combination consistently improves upon it.

AI.tldr: GrammarRL 是一种无需标注数据的强化学习方法，通过两个自监督奖励让语言模型更好地适应语法约束，从而在保持语法有效性的同时提升语义质量。
AI.motivation: 语法约束生成虽然能保证句法合法，但当模型偏好输出与语法不一致时，语义质量会显著下降；束搜索可部分缓解，但计算开销大，且序列概率并非语义质量的理想代理。
AI.method: 提出 GrammarRL：无标签强化学习，使用两个来自模型自身似然的互补自监督奖励——直接奖励衡量给定输入下约束输出的可能性，反向奖励衡量从生成输出重建输入的能力；采用 RLOO 目标在语法约束的 rollout 组上优化，并加入 top-1 束搜索假设，同时向冻结基座模型正则化。
AI.result: 在手语 gloss 翻译、层次文本分类和命名实体识别任务上，使用 1B 到 8B 的 Llama 模型评估；GrammarRL 一致优于约束贪心解码，平均提升 9.8 分，最高提升 22.8 BLEU；在两个任务上匹配或超过束搜索，同时保持贪心解码推理成本。消融表明两个奖励互补，单独使用可能不如未训练基线，组合后稳定提升。
AI.conclusion: GrammarRL 能有效缓解语法约束带来的语义退化，无需标注数据，并在多个任务和模型规模上取得优于约束贪心解码、接近或超过束搜索的效果，验证了直接与反向奖励结合的有效性。

title: Life-Bench: A Benchmark and Knowledge Graph Framework for Multimodal Personalization Beyond Concept Recognition
summary: As large language models increasingly power personal assistants, users expect them to reason over multimodal life histories, from recognizing people to understanding events to aggregating patterns, yet existing benchmarks primarily target concept-level recognition. We introduce Life-Bench, a fully synthetic, human-verified multimodal benchmark of over 11,800 question-answer pairs across 10 tasks, organized by required evidence scope: concept identification, event understanding, and aggregated reasoning. The benchmark's photo-centric personal histories are distributionally aligned with real user accounts under embedding statistic. The interconnected structure of personal data invites graph-based solutions; we propose LifeGraph, a personal knowledge graph framework providing structured retrieval with on-demand access to source visual evidence, showing particular promise on event and aggregated tasks. Systematic evaluation of four retrieval paradigms on Life-Bench demonstrates that accuracy degrades sharply with evidence scope, falling below 0.40 on aggregated tasks, and that no single paradigm dominates across categories. Performance beyond concept recognition remains modest for all evaluated methods, establishing personalization over multimodal histories as an open challenge and Life-Bench as a testbed for future progress.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Life-Bench，一个全合成、人工验证的多模态基准，包含 11,800+ 问答对和 10 类任务，按证据范围分为概念识别、事件理解和聚合推理；同时提出 LifeGraph 个人知识图谱框架，用于结构化检索并按需访问视觉证据。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型逐渐成为个人助理，用户期望其能推理多模态生活历史，如识别人物、理解事件和聚合模式，但现有基准主要关注概念级识别，缺乏对更广证据范围任务的评估。
AI.method: 构建 Life-Bench 基准：全合成、人工验证、以照片为中心的个人历史，并通过嵌入统计与真实用户账户分布对齐；任务按所需证据范围分为概念识别、事件理解和聚合推理。提出 LifeGraph 个人知识图谱框架，提供结构化检索并按需访问源视觉证据。系统评估四种检索范式。
AI.result: Life-Bench 包含超过 11,800 个问答对和 10 类任务。评估显示，准确率随证据范围扩大而急剧下降，聚合任务上低于 0.40；没有单一检索范式在所有类别中占优。LifeGraph 在事件和聚合任务上尤其有潜力，但所有方法在概念识别之外的表现仍较有限。
AI.conclusion: 基于多模态生活历史的个性化仍是开放挑战，Life-Bench 可作为未来研究的测试平台。

title: Completion-Aware Cross-Fidelity Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Line Bus Holding
summary: Exploratory reinforcement learning (RL) on an operating bus fleet is impractical,while policies trained only from historical data cannot acquire new experience. Hybrid Offline-and-Online (H2O) RL combines fixed target replay with simulator interaction, but the inexpensive online simulator can differ from the target in transition and event-duration dynamics. We study this cross-fidelity problem for multi-line bus holding and address a failure mode in which lower generalized passenger time coexists with incomplete passenger journeys.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多线路公交驻站控制中混合离线-在线强化学习的跨保真度问题，并处理一种广义乘客时间降低但乘客行程未完成的失效模式。
AI.motivation: 在运营公交车上直接进行探索性强化学习不现实，仅依赖历史数据训练的策略又无法获得新经验。混合离线-在线（H2O）RL 通过固定目标回放与在线模拟器交互来折中，但廉价在线模拟器在状态转移和事件持续时间动态上与真实目标存在差异。
AI.method: 针对多线路公交驻站（bus holding）任务，研究 H2O RL 中目标与模拟器之间的跨保真度问题，并分析、处理由动态不匹配导致的失效模式。
AI.result: 识别出一种失效模式：较低的广义乘客时间与不完整的乘客行程同时出现。
AI.conclusion: 将跨保真 H2O RL 用于多线路公交驻站时，不能仅优化广义乘客时间，还需解决模拟器与目标动态差异，并避免乘客行程未完成。

title: GPU-Accelerated Path-Dependent Marginal Information Gain for Autonomous Exploration
comment: Submitted for review to IEEE ICRA 2027
summary: Autonomous exploration demands that robots continuously evaluate candidate viewpoints based on their expected information gain and execution cost. Sampling-based planners estimate this gain by volumetric raycasting and, due to its computational cost, evaluate candidates under an assumption of mutual independence, ignoring the overlap between viewpoints along the same path. This work presents a GPU-accelerated method for computing path-dependent marginal information gain, where instead of storing and merging the observed unknown voxels along each candidate path, previous observations are represented using depth buffers. Candidate rays are projected into the depth buffers of their ancestors to identify observation overlap and exclude regions expected to be observed. The planning tree is evaluated in depth order to maintain the dependency between viewpoints and their optimized yaws, while candidate nodes and rays at each level are processed in parallel on the GPU. The proposed method stays within 5-10% of the exact marginal gain computed using voxel hash maps, with speed-ups of up to 118x on a desktop GPU and 28x on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX. The method was integrated into two sampling-based exploration planners and evaluated in three simulation environments, where marginal gain reduced the time to 95% coverage in five of the six evaluated planner-environment combinations. Real-world experiments also showed a 30% reduction in the time to 95% coverage, as well as earlier exploration termination times.

AI.tldr: 提出一种GPU加速方法，用于计算路径相关的边际信息增益，通过深度缓冲识别候选视点间的观测重叠，从而提升自主探索规划效率。
AI.motivation: 自主探索需要连续评估候选视点的信息增益与执行成本，但采样规划器中体素射线投射计算昂贵，通常假设视点相互独立，忽略了同一路径上视点之间的观测重叠。
AI.method: 用深度缓冲表示先前观测，将候选射线投影到祖先深度缓冲中以识别观测重叠并排除预期观测区域；按深度顺序评估规划树以保持视点及其优化偏航角之间的依赖，同时在GPU上并行处理每层候选节点和射线。
AI.result: 该方法与基于体素哈希图的精确边际增益偏差保持在5-10%以内，在桌面GPU上最高加速118倍，在NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX上加速28倍；集成到两种采样探索规划器并在三个仿真环境中评估，六个规划器-环境组合中有五个减少了达到95%覆盖率的时间；真实实验中也使达到95%覆盖率的时间减少30%，并更早终止探索。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能够高效近似路径相关边际信息增益，显著提升探索效率，适用于桌面GPU和嵌入式平台，并可集成到现有采样探索规划器中。

title: OSWorld-Science: A Benchmark of Computer Use Agents for Learning and Using Scientific Software
comment: 62 pages. Website: https://discoailab.github.io/osworld-science-page/ Public contributions welcome: https://forms.gle/htxY5snyANJ4moVEA
summary: Scientific software presents a demanding test for computer-using agents based on visual language models (VLMs): completing a research workflow requires interpreting specialized interfaces, manipulating scientific objects, and producing verifiable results. We thus introduce OSWorld-Science, a benchmark and evaluation environment that combines scientifically meaningful tasks, artifact-based evaluation, and an efficient agent harness for studying computer use in the scientific domain. The benchmark contains 12 VLMs and 146 high-quality tasks across several scientific domains and software configurations, covering workflows such as molecular drawing and retrosynthesis, pathology image analysis, statistical computing, and physical simulation. Tasks are developed through expert proposals and iterative human--AI co-design, with selection guided by scientific value and difficulty. Task-specific execution-based evaluators inspect application states and generated artifacts, including molecular structures, segmentation masks, plots, and numerical results, and award partial credit for incomplete outcomes. Our special harness integrates model adapters, interaction-loop control, and trajectory logging to support comparisons of models and interaction strategies. Our results show that current state-of-the-art VLMs with a strong harness still face challenges in addressing key questions in the scientific domains. We also analyze the benchmarking results across multi-linguistics, reasoning efforts, context length and other factors and derive several important conclusions and directions to assist future development. Overall, we provide an integrated framework connecting expert-defined scientific goals to verifiable software outcomes, enabling systematic evaluation of both agent capabilities and harness design in scientific workflows.

AI.tldr: 提出 OSWorld-Science 基准与环境，涵盖 12 个视觉语言模型和 146 个跨科学领域任务，通过基于产物的执行评估，研究科学软件中的计算机使用代理。
AI.motivation: 科学软件对基于视觉语言模型的计算机使用代理构成严苛测试：完成科研工作流需解读专用界面、操作科学对象并产出可验证结果，而现有基准难以系统评估此类能力。
AI.method: 构建 OSWorld-Science 基准，包含分子绘制与逆合成、病理图像分析、统计计算、物理仿真等 146 个高质量任务；任务经专家提案与人机协同设计；采用任务特定执行式评估器检查应用状态和产物（分子结构、分割掩码、图表、数值），并给部分完成情况部分给分；配套专用 harness 集成模型适配器、交互循环控制与轨迹日志。
AI.result: 当前最先进视觉语言模型即便配合强 harness，仍在解决科学领域关键问题上表现不佳；跨多语言、推理努力、上下文长度等因素的分析得出若干重要结论与未来方向。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了连接专家定义科学目标与可验证软件结果的集成框架，可系统评估科学工作流中的代理能力与 harness 设计。

title: ConflictGuide: AutoResearch Improves When Competing Behaviors Are Made Visible
summary: When designing machine learning models, desirable properties are often in tension: improving one behavior can impair another, so task progress can depend on alleviating the conflict. LLM-based AutoResearch systems, which iteratively edit model code and retain edits based on scalar task-performance feedback, have largely ignored this trade-off. We find that scalar feedback supports broad exploration early in search, but it does not reveal how edits affect competing behaviors. In matched-budget experiments, introducing competing-behavior feedback as task gains diminish increases the share of proposals that improve both behaviors and sustains progress beyond scalar-only plateaus. Obtaining this feedback for a given model requires identifying its competing behaviors and designing probes to measure them. To make competing-behavior feedback actionable, we introduce ConflictGuide. Its reusable ConflictGuide-Skill combines a literature-grounded taxonomy with model-specific evidence to identify competing behaviors and specify probes for a code agent to implement as metrics. Evolution proceeds in two stages: Stage I explores with task feedback; Stage II uses probe feedback to steer proposals toward conflict alleviation and retains marginal-gain edits only when probes indicate sufficient alleviation. Across five diverse model families, ConflictGuide reduces task and conflict-related errors by up to 28% and 14%, respectively, relative to scalar-only AutoResearch, with gains extending to other code agents.

AI.tldr: 论文指出LLM自动研究系统仅依赖标量任务性能反馈，忽略了模型行为之间的冲突；提出ConflictGuide，通过引入竞争行为反馈和两阶段演化策略，在多个模型家族上将任务错误降低最多28%、冲突相关错误降低14%。
AI.motivation: 设计机器学习模型时，不同理想属性常相互冲突，改善一种行为可能损害另一种。现有基于LLM的AutoResearch系统主要依赖标量任务性能反馈迭代编辑模型代码，无法揭示编辑对竞争行为的影响，导致任务进展受限于冲突未被缓解。
AI.method: 提出ConflictGuide：其可复用的ConflictGuide-Skill结合文献支撑的分类法与模型特定证据，识别竞争行为并指定探针，由代码代理实现为指标。演化分两阶段：Stage I用任务反馈广泛探索；Stage II用探针反馈引导提案缓解冲突，并仅在探针显示足够缓解时保留边际增益编辑。
AI.result: 在匹配预算实验中，随着任务增益递减引入竞争行为反馈，提高了同时改善两种行为的提案比例，并延续了仅标量反馈下的平台期。在五个不同模型家族上，相比仅标量AutoResearch，ConflictGuide将任务错误和冲突相关错误分别降低最多28%和14%，且增益可扩展到其他代码代理。
AI.conclusion: 竞争行为反馈对超越标量性能平台至关重要；ConflictGuide通过识别冲突并设计探针，使反馈可操作，有效提升AutoResearch在冲突权衡下的性能，并具有跨模型和跨代码代理的泛化性。

title: Lens Flare Removal and Reconstruction
summary: The presence of lens flares in images can significantly reduce the quality of downstream application results for tasks such as 3D scene reconstruction. This is because lens flares are a property of the camera imaging system, and not a part of the underlying scene being modeled. There are previous methods that tackle the removal of small flares focused around a light source. However, existing methods struggle with large flares, such as those that fill the entire image. In this work, we compile a novel dataset for large-flare removal, combining publicly available real-world data with a procedural generation pipeline. We fine-tune a diffusion-based model on our dataset to remove complex, large lens flares. On the other hand, lens flares remain effective artistic tools, widely used in the media. While there are ways to simulate 2D flares, representing and reconstructing lens flares consistently across multiple views has not yet been explored. To achieve this, we introduce a flare representation model that leverages the symmetry of lens flares about the camera's principal point. We propose a computational pipeline to jointly optimize this flare model and a Gaussian splatting model (3DGS). This enables the decomposition of a 3D scene into lens flares and the scene itself, using our flare-removal model. Because the reconstructed flare is explicit and re-renderable, it can be edited and transferred to novel images and new 3D scenes. We evaluate removal on an established benchmark and a new one for large reflective flares, quantify the flare/scene decomposition directly, and show that the pipeline is robust to errors in automatic light-source localization.

AI.tldr: 论文研究大尺寸镜头光晕的去除与三维重建分离，构建新数据集并微调扩散模型，同时提出基于光晕对称性的表示模型，与3DGS联合优化，实现光晕与场景分解、编辑和迁移。
AI.motivation: 镜头光晕源于相机成像系统而非场景本身，会降低下游任务（如3D场景重建）质量；现有方法仅能处理光源附近的小光晕，难以处理占满图像的大光晕；此外光晕作为艺术工具需要多视角一致表示与重建，但尚未被探索。
AI.method: 构建大规模光晕去除数据集，结合真实数据与程序化生成流程；微调扩散模型去除复杂大光晕；提出利用光晕关于相机主点对称性的光晕表示模型；设计联合优化该光晕模型与3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）的计算管线，借助光晕去除模型将3D场景分解为光晕和场景本体，并支持显式重渲染、编辑和迁移到新图像/新3D场景。
AI.result: 在已有基准和针对大型反射光晕的新基准上评估去除效果；直接量化光晕/场景分解；证明管线对自动光源定位误差具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 方法能有效去除大尺寸复杂镜头光晕，并首次实现多视角一致的光晕表示、重建与3D场景分解，使光晕可重渲染、编辑和跨图像/跨场景迁移。

title: Learning Normal Diffusion Dynamics for Backdoor Defense in Text-to-Image Models
summary: Backdoor attacks pose a serious threat to the secure deployment of text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models. Existing defenses typically detect backdoors from specific abnormal patterns in internal representations, which may limit their generalizability with the emergence of increasingly diverse attack mechanisms. In this paper, we study backdoor defense of T2I diffusion models from a transition-dynamics perspective. We observe that benign diffusion trajectories exhibit structured and timestep-dependent transition patterns from cross-attention, latent and noise spaces, whereas backdoor attacks tend to induce deviations from such normal evolution. Motivated by these observations, we propose Normal Diffusion Dynamics Learning (NDDL), a novel backdoor defense framework that learns the normal transition dynamics of diffusion trajectories utilizing only benign samples. NDDL constructs compact multi-space trajectory representations and trains a timestep-conditioned dynamics model to predict the diffusion evolution. In the inference phase, deviations between the observed and predicted transitions are exploited to quantify dynamics inconsistency for backdoor detection. NDDL further enables trigger localization without any prior knowledge of the embedded backdoor by performing substitution with low-semantic words. Extensive experiments for diverse backdoor attacks demonstrate the effectiveness and generalizability of our proposed NDDL.

AI.tldr: 本文从转移动力学视角研究T2I扩散模型后门防御，提出NDDL框架，仅用良性样本学习正常扩散轨迹动力学，通过预测与观测转移的偏差检测后门并定位触发器。
AI.motivation: 现有防御通常依赖内部表征中的特定异常模式来检测后门，随着攻击机制日益多样化，其泛化能力受限。
AI.method: 观察到良性扩散轨迹在交叉注意力、潜在空间和噪声空间中呈现结构化、时间步依赖的正常转移模式，而后门攻击会诱导偏离。基于此，NDDL构建紧凑的多空间轨迹表示，训练时间步条件动力学模型预测扩散演化；推理时利用观测与预测转移之间的偏差量化动力学不一致性以检测后门，并通过低语义词替换实现无需后门先验知识的触发器定位。
AI.result: 针对多种后门攻击的大量实验表明，NDDL具有有效性和泛化性。
AI.conclusion: 从正常扩散动力学角度进行T2I扩散模型后门防御是可行且有效的，且对多样化攻击具备良好泛化能力。

title: DynaHarness: A Dynamic Physical Harness for Self-Evolving Robot Agents
summary: Pretrained robot policies provide useful action priors, but long-horizon manipulation still requires coordination between semantic reasoning and physical execution. Semantic reasoning operates at a coarser timescale than physical interaction, while episode-level failures provide limited guidance on which system component should be revised. We propose DynaHarness, a dynamic physical harness that couples semantic reasoning with physical governance through a shared execution contract and turns failure evidence into validated capability revisions. To be more specific, the slow brain proposes capabilities and symbolic arguments, while the fast brain grounds and monitors commands, refuses unresolved actions, substitutes capabilities, and requests replans when needed. The physical execution contract bounds each accepted command and records execution evidence across analytic skills, recovery skills, and the frozen VLA. Failure attribution localizes faults in these records and directs targeted revisions of reusable capabilities or execution mechanisms. Paired regression checks govern admission or rejection, closing the self-evolution loop. On LIBERO-Pro, DynaHarness achieves 75.2% on 800 newly sampled initial states, compared with 17.5% for the frozen policy. With the same capability library, full dynamic execution reaches 74.0% versus 63.9% under nominal one-step replanning. This demonstrates the value of DynaHarness as a dynamic physical harness that governs how existing capabilities are grounded, monitored, and coordinated during execution. Our project page is at https://denghaoyuan123.github.io/Dynaharness_page/.

AI.tldr: 提出DynaHarness——一种动态物理执行框架，通过共享执行契约将语义推理与物理执行耦合，并把失败证据转化为经验证的能力修订，在LIBERO-Pro上取得75.2%的成功率。
AI.motivation: 预训练机器人策略虽提供动作先验，但长时程操作仍需语义推理与物理执行的协调。语义推理时间尺度较粗，而回合级失败难以定位具体应修改的系统组件，缺乏针对性。
AI.method: 设计慢脑（提出能力与符号参数）与快脑（落地并监控指令、拒绝未解决动作、替换能力、请求重规划）的双层结构；物理执行契约限定每条被接受指令并记录分析技能、恢复技能与冻结VLA的执行证据；通过失败归因定位故障并定向修订可复用能力或执行机制；配对回归检查决定接纳或拒绝，形成自演化闭环。
AI.result: 在LIBERO-Pro的800个新采样初始状态上，DynaHarness达到75.2%，而冻结策略仅17.5%；在相同能力库下，完整动态执行达74.0%，而名义单步重规划为63.9%。
AI.conclusion: DynaHarness作为动态物理执行框架，能有效管控已有能力的落地、监控与协调，显著提升长时程操作性能，证明了执行治理与自演化机制的价值。

title: EffGS: Efficient and High-Fidelity Gaussian Splatting
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables real-time novel view synthesis, but existing general-purpose acceleration methods suffer severe rendering quality degradation when extended to more complex, large-scale scenes. To address this issue, we propose EffGS, a more general acceleration framework that improves training and rendering efficiency while maintaining reconstruction quality comparable to or better than vanilla 3DGS across bounded and large-scale scenes. EffGS combines frequency-aware guidance, localized density control, and adaptive primitive scale modulation. First, an importance scoring mechanism combines pixel-wise reconstruction errors with a difference-of-Gaussians mask scheduled over training to provide stage-dependent spatial guidance. Second, localized densification and pruning restricts density modifications to Gaussians with valid projected footprints in the sampled views. Third, learnable per-Gaussian scale modulation adjusts effective primitive extent during optimization while retaining the Compact Box rasterization rule. Extensive experiments on bounded and large-scale scene datasets demonstrate a favorable balance between reconstruction quality, training time, and primitive count. Component ablations and matched-primitive-budget comparisons further support the effectiveness of the framework.

AI.tldr: 提出EffGS，一种面向有界和大规模场景的3D高斯泼溅通用加速框架，在保持或提升重建质量的同时提高训练与渲染效率。
AI.motivation: 现有通用加速方法在复杂、大规模场景中扩展时会导致严重的渲染质量下降，因此需要兼顾效率与质量的更通用加速方案。
AI.method: EffGS结合频率感知引导、局部密度控制和自适应基元尺度调制：1）重要性评分机制将像素级重建误差与训练中调度的DoG掩码结合，提供阶段相关的空间引导；2）局部稠密化与剪枝仅对采样视图中具有有效投影足迹的高斯进行密度修改；3）可学习的逐高斯尺度调制在优化中调整有效基元范围，同时保留Compact Box光栅化规则。
AI.result: 在有界和大规模场景数据集上的实验表明，该方法在重建质量、训练时间和基元数量之间取得了有利平衡；组件消融和匹配基元预算对比进一步验证了框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: EffGS是一种更通用的3DGS加速框架，能在有界和大规模场景中保持与原始3DGS相当或更好的重建质量，同时提升训练和渲染效率。

title: ShieldCLIP: Selective Safety Alignment for Harmful Content Mitigation in Multimodal Foundation Models
summary: Multimodal encoders such as CLIP underlie many downstream systems, but their web-scale training data embed harmful associations that safety alignment must suppress without unnecessarily changing benign representations. Because ethical and practical constraints prevent collecting real unsafe content at scale, existing datasets pair safe real samples with generated counterparts, but label every generated sample unsafe, even when one modality is individually safe. To address this, we introduce ShieldCLIP, the first framework to condition safety alignment on the observed safety state of each modality rather than the origin of a sample, preserving safe content while redirecting only what is unsafe. We also introduce ViSUv2, a 195k-quadruplet dataset with independent per-modality safety labels across 578 concepts and 28 categories. Using these labels, ShieldCLIP defines a four-way conditional objective beyond pair-level supervision: safe content is anchored, unsafe modalities are redirected to their safe counterparts, mixed pairs update only the unsafe branch, and coherence is enforced when both are unsafe. We evaluate ShieldCLIP on cross-modal retrieval, text-to-image generation with Stable Diffusion v1.4 and SDXL, and image-to-text generation with LLaVA. Across these settings, ShieldCLIP consistently reduces harmful outputs over prior safety-aligned encoders and strong mitigation baselines, while preserving the utility of the original embedding space. Extensive ablation studies further show that both modality-specific supervision and the selective alignment objective contribute to these gains. Source code, trained models, and ViSUv2 (under a controlled-access protocol) will be made publicly available at https://aimagelab.github.io/ShieldCLIP/.

AI.tldr: 提出 ShieldCLIP，一种按各模态自身安全状态进行条件化安全对齐的多模态编码器框架，并构建 ViSUv2 数据集；在检索、文生图和图生文任务中，既降低有害输出，又保留原始嵌入空间效用。
AI.motivation: CLIP 等多模态编码器基于大规模网络数据训练，会嵌入有害关联，需要安全对齐。但真实不安全内容难以大规模收集，现有方法将生成样本一律标为不安全，即使其中某一模态本身安全，导致过度修正并损害良性表示。
AI.method: 提出 ShieldCLIP，根据每个模态的观测安全状态而非样本来源进行安全对齐；构建 ViSUv2，包含 195k 四元组、覆盖 578 个概念和 28 个类别，并提供各模态独立安全标签；设计四路条件目标：安全内容锚定，不安全模态重定向至安全对应项，混合对仅更新不安全分支，双模态均不安全时强制一致性。
AI.result: 在跨模态检索、Stable Diffusion v1.4/SDXL 文生图以及 LLaVA 图生文任务中，ShieldCLIP 相比先前安全对齐编码器和强缓解基线持续减少有害输出，同时保留原始嵌入空间的效用；消融实验表明模态特定监督和选择性对齐目标均有贡献。
AI.conclusion: 按模态安全状态进行选择性安全对齐，可在不牺牲多模态表示效用的前提下更有效地抑制有害关联，为多模态编码器安全对齐提供了新框架、数据集与评估证据。

title: MCD: Causal Distillation of Multimodal In-Context Learning in Large Vision-Language Models
summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) exhibit strong multimodal in-context learning (ICL) capabilities, yet this ability degrades substantially as model size decreases. Knowledge distillation offers a natural way to bridge this gap, but existing methods primarily align output distributions or hidden representations directly. Such alignment teaches the student what the teacher predicts without revealing which evidence in the complex context causally supports that prediction. Consequently, a student can imitate the teacher's answer while continuing to rely on language priors, prompt structure, or other spurious cues. To address this limitation, we introduce Multimodal Causal Distillation (MCD), a distillation framework that transfers how a strong teacher uses multimodal evidence during ICL. MCD uses structure-preserving token interventions to identify and verify causal evidence, then transfers how the teacher responds when that evidence is retained or removed. This design connects distillation to the causal patterns by which the model uses contextual evidence during multimodal ICL. Experiments across three LVLM families and seven benchmarks show that MCD improves student performance by 7.23 points on average and outperforms vanilla distillation by 4.68 points, while further analyses confirm the generalizability of these gains.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出多模态因果蒸馏（MCD），通过迁移教师模型在多模态上下文学习中如何利用因果证据，缩小小型LVLM与大型模型之间的ICL能力差距。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型具备强多模态上下文学习能力，但模型规模减小时该能力显著下降；现有知识蒸馏仅对齐输出分布或隐藏表示，学生模型可能模仿答案却依赖语言先验或虚假线索，而非真正利用多模态证据。
AI.method: 提出MCD框架：使用结构保持的token干预来识别和验证因果证据，并迁移教师模型在保留或移除这些证据时的响应方式，从而将蒸馏与模型利用上下文证据的因果模式相连接。
AI.result: 在三个LVLM系列和七个基准上，MCD平均提升学生模型7.23分，比普通蒸馏高出4.68分，进一步分析验证了增益的泛化性。
AI.conclusion: 迁移教师模型利用多模态因果证据的方式，比单纯对齐输出或表示更有效，能提升小模型在多模态ICL中的表现并具有泛化能力。

title: Ego4WAM: What Matters When Scaling Egocentric Human Data for Robot Learning?
summary: Egocentric human data provides a scalable source of experience for robot learning, but varies substantially in human-robot alignment, behavioral coverage, and available supervision. Existing work shows favorable scaling with increasing human data, but it remains unclear which data properties drive downstream robot gains and how to use such data throughout the training pipeline. We present a systematic study of egocentric human data with different alignment and supervision under a unified world-action model framework. With the model backbone fixed, we disentangle the effects of human-robot alignment, data duration and task diversity, action supervision, and data usage strategies. We find that aligned human demonstrations substantially improve out-of-distribution generalization and reduce target-task robot data requirements; data duration and task diversity affect downstream capabilities differently; and video-only supervision remains effective without action labels, providing a strong foundation for subsequent video-action training. We validate these findings through closed-loop policy evaluation on both real robots and RoboDojo. Rather than treating data duration as the sole scaling axis, Ego4WAM shows how alignment, task diversity, available supervision, and usage strategy jointly shape the value of egocentric human data for robot learning.

AI.tldr: 本文在统一的世界-动作模型框架下，系统研究自我中心人类数据的不同属性如何影响机器人学习，并在真实机器人与RoboDojo上进行闭环策略验证。
AI.motivation: 自我中心人类数据可为机器人学习提供可扩展经验，但人机对齐、行为覆盖和监督信息差异很大；现有工作观察到数据规模带来收益，却不清楚哪些数据属性驱动下游机器人性能提升，以及如何在训练流程中有效使用这些数据。
AI.method: 在固定模型骨干的统一world-action model框架下，解耦并系统研究人机对齐、数据时长与任务多样性、动作监督、数据使用策略等因素的影响，并通过真实机器人和RoboDojo闭环策略评估进行验证。
AI.result: 对齐的人类演示显著提升分布外泛化能力，并减少目标任务所需机器人数据；数据时长和任务多样性对不同下游能力的影响不同；仅视频监督无需动作标签仍然有效，可为后续视频-动作训练提供强基础。
AI.conclusion: 不应将数据时长视为唯一扩展轴；Ego4WAM表明，对齐程度、任务多样性、可用监督和数据使用策略共同决定自我中心人类数据对机器人学习的价值。

title: GroundAnything: Reconciling Parallel Decoding with Precise Visual Grounding at Flash Speed
comment: 61 pages, including supplementary material. Project page: https://groundingpi.github.io/groundanything/ Code: [https://github.com/groundingpi/GroundAnything](https://github.com/groundingpi/GroundAnything) Model: https://huggingface.co/GroundingPI/GroundAnything, https://huggingface.co/GroundingPI/GroundAnything-VLM
summary: Autoregressive (AR) grounding models serialize spatial predictions, introducing sequential latency and imposing a causal order on output tokens. We view grounding as visual evidence extraction: objects, locations, and spatial relations are jointly constrained by the image and query, yet their dependencies do not imply an intrinsic left-to-right generation order. This distinction makes bidirectional diffusion a natural fit, allowing spatial hypotheses to emerge in parallel and be jointly refined through iterative denoising. We introduce GroundAnything, a 4B-parameter grounding foundation model that reconciles fast parallel decoding with precise localization through blockwise denoising. Training combines grounding pretraining from public datasets and dedicated data engines, direct AR-to-diffusion conversion with joint AR and diffusion objectives, supervised fine-tuning, and GRPO-based reinforcement post-training. Across 30 grounding benchmarks, our autoregressive variant, GroundAnything-VLM, establishes a new overall state of the art among similarly sized models at 72.42%, remaining competitive with GPT-6 Astra (71.35%). With entropy-guided decoding, GroundAnything also surpasses the prior state of the art at this scale, averaging 61.75% versus 53.32% for the fast MTP-based LocateAnything model. We further explore decoding strategies, showing that an optional self-speculative mode achieves a $4.51\times$ speedup over the AR counterpart with a 0.74 percentage-point drop in COCO F1mIoU. Infrastructure experiments show that progressive inference optimizations translate parallel decoding into practical speedups. These support efficient visual grounding in latency-sensitive real-world systems.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 GroundAnything，一个 4B 参数的视觉 grounding 基础模型，将 grounding 视为视觉证据提取，采用双向扩散与块级去噪实现并行空间预测，兼顾快速解码与精确定位。
AI.motivation: 自回归 grounding 模型将空间预测序列化，带来顺序延迟，并强行引入从左到右的因果生成顺序；但物体、位置和空间关系由图像与查询共同约束，其依赖关系并不天然对应单向生成顺序。
AI.method: 提出 GroundAnything，使用块级去噪扩散进行并行空间假设生成与迭代精炼；训练包括公开数据集与专用数据引擎的 grounding 预训练、AR 到扩散的直接转换与联合 AR/扩散目标、监督微调以及基于 GRPO 的强化后训练；还探索熵引导解码和可选自推测解码。
AI.result: 在 30 个 grounding 基准上，其自回归变体 GroundAnything-VLM 在同类规模模型中达到 72.42% 的新 SOTA，并与 GPT-6 Astra 的 71.35% 保持竞争力；熵引导解码下 GroundAnything 平均 61.75%，超过此前快速 MTP 模型 LocateAnything 的 53.32%；自推测模式相对 AR 实现 4.51 倍加速，COCO F1mIoU 仅下降 0.74 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 双向扩散与块级并行解码适合 grounding 任务，可在保持精确定位的同时显著提升推理效率，为延迟敏感的真实系统提供高效视觉 grounding 方案。

title: Coverage Before Control: Route-Instruction Grounding and Steering for Controllable Retrosynthesis
summary: Single-step retrosynthesis models are commonly evaluated by their ability to recover recorded reactions. In practice, chemists may need to choose among several precursor sets for the same product, for example to preserve a particular motif. Recovering a recorded answer alone does not establish this ability to follow a preference. Satisfying such requests requires both coverage of relevant alternatives and control over which alternatives are favored. We introduce Route-Instruction Grounding and Steering (RIGS), a two-stage framework for instruction-conditioned retrosynthesis. Stage A trains a language projector, teaching it which alternatives an instruction favors or discourages. Stage B uses the projector learned in Stage A to steer a frozen generative model through lightweight residual adapters. We construct nested one-to-many training supports by pairing each product with increasing numbers of candidate precursor sets. Extensive experiments demonstrate that broader support helps the model generate a wider range of alternatives, and RIGS can learn to guide generation according to instructions. The relationship between coverage and control is consistent across model scales but non-monotone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RIGS两阶段框架，用于指令条件下的单步逆合成，使模型能按偏好选择前体集合。
AI.motivation: 传统单步逆合成仅以能否恢复已知反应来评估，无法体现化学家在多个前体集合中按特定偏好（如保留特定基序）选择的能力；这需要同时具备备选方案的覆盖度和对偏好方案的控制力。
AI.method: RIGS分为两阶段：阶段A训练语言投影器，学习指令偏好或抑制哪些备选方案；阶段B使用该投影器，通过轻量残差适配器引导冻结的生成模型。作者构建嵌套一对多训练支持，将每个产物与递增数量的候选前体集合配对。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，更广的训练支持有助于模型生成更广泛的备选方案，且RIGS能学会按指令引导生成。覆盖度与控制力之间的关系在不同模型规模下保持一致，但呈非单调关系。
AI.conclusion: RIGS表明指令条件逆合成需要同时兼顾覆盖度与控制力，并可通过两阶段投影器与残差适配器实现；但覆盖度与控制力之间的关系复杂，并非简单单调。

title: Better Deck or Different Judge? Evaluating Agentic Harness Gains in Corporate and Investment Banking
summary: Corporate and investment banking teams use presentations to support credit decisions and advise clients on financing and transactions. Producing these decks requires reconciling financial data, tracing sources and turning analysis into a recommendation. We retrospectively study the development of an agentic harness combining a 27B language model, financial calculations, narrative templates and validation checks. LLM judges guide engineering changes and assess the resulting decks, raising the question of whether higher scores reflect better documents or changes in grading. In shared-session text-only grading with template markers removed, five judges score the complete system 20.4 to 33.6 points out of 95 above the same model generating directly from a short prompt. Every judge scores the system higher on all seventeen development deliverables. Margins against direct Opus generation from a short prompt range from -4.7 to +0.8 points. Judges agree on broad progress across development rounds but agree less on final-deck rankings than on pooled scores. Repeated grading also shifts scores on unchanged decks, making small improvements difficult to distinguish from judge variability.

AI.tldr: 本文回顾性研究了一个面向公司与投资银行业务演示文稿的智能体框架，该框架结合27B语言模型、财务计算、叙事模板与校验检查，并用LLM评委评估生成文稿，同时探讨评分提升是否真正反映文档质量改善。
AI.motivation: 公司与投资银行团队需要用演示文稿支持信贷决策、融资与交易建议，制作过程需整合财务数据、追溯来源并形成建议；因此研究者希望构建并评估一个能辅助生成此类文稿的智能体系统，同时警惕LLM评委评分可能带来的评估偏差。
AI.method: 开发并回顾性研究一个agentic harness，组合27B语言模型、财务计算、叙事模板和验证检查；使用LLM评委指导工程迭代并评估最终演示文稿质量。评估采用共享会话、纯文本评分，并移除模板标记，以比较完整系统与同一模型直接根据短提示生成的结果。
AI.result: 五位评委给完整系统的评分为95分制中的20.4至33.6分，高于同一模型直接根据短提示生成的结果；每位评委在全部17个开发交付物上都给系统更高分。与直接使用Opus根据短提示生成相比，差距范围为-4.7至+0.8分。评委对开发轮次中的总体进展较为一致，但对最终演示文稿排名的共识低于对汇总评分的共识；重复评分会使未更改文稿的分数发生变化。
AI.conclusion: 该智能体框架在多数评估中优于直接短提示生成，但LLM评委评分存在不稳定性；重复评分波动使得小幅改进难以与评委变异性区分，因此需要谨慎解释评分提升是否代表文档质量真正提高。

title: GroundingPI: A Grounding Foundation Model towards Physical Intelligence with Visual Primitives
comment: 64 pages, including supplementary material. Project page: https://groundingpi.github.io/ Code: https://github.com/groundingpi/GroundingPI Model: https://huggingface.co/GroundingPI/GroundingPI
summary: Precise grounding matters. It specifies which object is the target and where that object is, even in clutter and for tiny objects, and it has to be fast enough for closed-loop control. Yet vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action models (WAMs) take perception from general-purpose vision-language and video-generation backbones, which still fail in these settings. We introduce GroundingPI, a 4B grounding foundation model that generates points and boxes as quantized coordinates in a shared vocabulary. Training combines multimodal and spatial pretraining, supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning with GRPO, using supervision from public datasets and dedicated data engines. Against 44 baselines across 34 grounding benchmarks spanning 11 perceptual capabilities, GroundingPI establishes a new state of the art, averaging 73.68%, above the larger GPT-6 Astra (71.54%). As a downstream visual backbone, GroundingPI improves performance on robotic manipulation and autonomous driving. On RoboTwin 2.0, it outperforms every mainstream backbone we evaluate in all four out-of-distribution settings, by up to 24.8% relative to the strongest backbone. On RoboCasa-GR1, GroundingPI trained with 50% of the demonstrations outperforms those baselines trained with 75%. On nuScenes, used as the visual backbone, GroundingPI attains an average open-loop L2 error of 0.296 m. We systematically analyze GroundingPI's pretraining in scale and data composition. Downstream autonomous driving and robotic manipulation improve as the pretraining is scaled. Analyzing the data recipe across these 11 perceptual capabilities shows dense grounding's substantial benefits for both, and OCR's potential as a catalyst for perceptual learning. These results support grounding as a perceptual foundation, and dedicated perceptual pretraining as a promising direction for foundation models of physical intelligence.

AI.tldr: 提出GroundingPI，一个4B的定位基础模型，将点和框生成为共享词表中的量化坐标。它在34个定位基准、44个基线上取得SOTA，平均73.68%，超过更大的GPT-6 Astra（71.54%），并作为视觉骨干提升机器人操作与自动驾驶性能。
AI.motivation: VLA和WAM的感知来自通用视觉语言与视频生成骨干，在杂乱场景、小目标和需要快速闭环控制时仍会失败。精确的grounding需要指明目标物体及位置，且必须足够快。
AI.method: GroundingPI以4B模型生成点和框的量化坐标并共享词表；训练融合多模态与空间预训练、监督微调、GRPO强化学习，利用公开数据集和专用数据引擎提供监督。
AI.result: 在34个grounding基准、11类感知能力上平均73.68%，超过GPT-6 Astra的71.54%。作为下游视觉骨干，在RoboTwin 2.0四个OOD设置中全部优于所评估的主流骨干，最高相对提升24.8%；在RoboCasa-GR1上仅用50%演示即超过用75%演示的基线；nuScenes开环平均L2误差0.296米。预训练规模增大可提升下游自动驾驶与机器人操作；密集grounding对两者均有显著收益，OCR有成为感知学习催化剂的潜力。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持将grounding作为感知基础，并将专用感知预训练作为物理智能基础模型的一个有前景方向。

title: From Given to Gathered Evidence: Agentic Learning for Longitudinal Medical Reasoning
summary: Foundation models can serve as clinical agents through tool-use harnesses. However, conventional medical benchmarks assess reasoning over preselected evidence rather than the ability to seek it across clinical records and longitudinal imaging. We propose CASE: a series of role-specific Clinical Agents for Seeking Evidence, together with a tool-use harness and an agentic post-training framework for compact vision-language policy models. We further introduce a longitudinal multimodal benchmark built on UK Biobank, comprising 50,401 clinical questions derived from real-world ICD-10-coded diagnoses of 4,739 participants. Each question links to a patient-specific environment containing clinical context and multi-sequence MRI from baseline and follow-up visits, where agents autonomously select which visits, organs, modalities, slices, and specialist tools to inspect and compare. Supervised fine-tuning transfers evidence-seeking workflows from 14,734 frontier-model interaction trajectories, followed by agentic reinforcement learning on the learner's own environment interactions. Privileged on-policy self-distillation and rubric-based LLM feedback refine evidence-to-conclusion reasoning without prescribing tool sequences. Experiments show that CASE moves beyond question-answer imitation toward transferable investigation policies, strengthening evidence-grounded longitudinal reasoning. Under matched evaluation conditions, our Qwen3-VL-8B based agent achieves over 16% and 10% relative improvements in answer accuracy over GPT-5.4 and Claude Opus 4.8. Code will be available at https://github.com/VinyehShaw/CASE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CASE——一组面向临床证据检索的角色化智能体，配套工具调用框架与智能体后训练方案，并基于UK Biobank构建纵向多模态基准，使紧凑视觉语言模型能主动在病历与纵向影像中寻找证据并作答。
AI.motivation: 现有医学基准多评估对预选证据的推理能力，而非智能体主动跨临床记录与纵向影像检索证据的能力，无法反映真实的临床调查过程。
AI.method: 构建CASE角色化临床智能体、工具调用框架与面向紧凑视觉语言策略模型的智能体后训练框架；基于UK Biobank构建纵向多模态基准（50,401个临床问题，源自4,739名参与者的ICD-10诊断，每题关联含临床上下文及基线与随访多序列MRI的患者专属环境）；先用14,734条前沿模型交互轨迹做监督微调，再在模型自身环境交互上进行智能体强化学习；采用特权同策略自蒸馏与基于评分量表的LLM反馈优化证据到结论的推理过程，不规定工具调用顺序。
AI.result: 实验表明CASE超越了问答模仿，形成可迁移的调查策略，增强了基于证据的纵向推理；在匹配评估条件下，基于Qwen3-VL-8B的智能体在答案准确率上相对GPT-5.4和Claude Opus 4.8分别提升超过16%和10%。
AI.conclusion: 让紧凑视觉语言模型通过角色化智能体与工具调用主动检索证据，可显著提升纵向多模态临床推理性能，为临床智能体训练与评估提供了新范式。

title: Agent Error Dataset: Scaling 50,000 Error--Diagnosis Pairs for Failure Analysis and Error-Aware Post-Training
summary: An unsuccessful LLM agent rollout contains more information than its final reward: the observations available to the agent, the actions it chose, and the environment's responses. Reusing this experience for learning requires identifying a decision to revise and testing a concrete alternative. We introduce the Agent Error Dataset (AED), comprising 50,228 error-diagnosis pairs from 9,961 source tasks across 33 environments, 19 harness families, and 23 policy models in text-based agent systems. We retain source traces and execution metadata to support cross-setting failure analysis and re-diagnosis without repeating the original rollout. Our five-stage Agentic Error-to-Training (AET) pipeline collects natural failures, generates diagnoses and proposed corrections, and checks them against recorded evidence. Where replay is supported, we compare corrections with original-action retries from the same checkpoint under matched execution settings. We then construct separate training views for diagnosis and actor recovery. Across 3,062 matched replay pairs, first-proposal corrections raise verifier pass rates from 18.4% to 51.1%, a gain of 32.7 percentage points. Using a separately frozen diagnosis release, full-diagnosis fine-tuning on 1,656 source tasks raises Qwen3-8B's exact-step agreement with internal teacher labels from 47.2% to 63.6%, averaged over three seeds on a 943-case holdout. The strongest prompted reference in this comparison scores 54.7%, and mean agreement improves at each of four increasing training-set sizes. In a single-seed comparison of actor-training recipes, action-only repair training scores 6.67 percentage points higher on WebShop-lite than success-only training.

AI.tldr: 论文提出智能体错误数据集AED和五阶段Agentic Error-to-Training（AET）流程，将失败的LLM智能体轨迹转化为可用于诊断与行为恢复的训练数据，并在重放验证和微调实验中验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体的一次失败rollout不仅包含最终奖励，还包含观察、动作和环境响应等信息；若仅依赖奖励，会浪费大量可学习信号。因此需要识别可修正的决策并测试具体替代动作，从而复用失败经验进行学习。
AI.method: 构建AED数据集，包含来自33个环境、19种harness家族和23个策略模型的9,961个源任务上的50,228个错误诊断对，并保留源轨迹与执行元数据。提出五阶段AET流水线：收集自然失败、生成诊断与修正建议、依据记录证据检查修正、在支持重放时与原始动作重试进行匹配比较，并分别构建用于诊断和actor恢复的训练视图。实验包括3,062个匹配重放对，以及对Qwen3-8B进行全诊断微调和actor训练配方比较。
AI.result: 在3,062个匹配重放对中，首次提出的修正将验证器通过率从18.4%提升到51.1%，提高32.7个百分点。使用冻结的诊断发布版本，在1,656个源任务上进行全诊断微调，使Qwen3-8B与内部教师标签的精确步骤一致率从47.2%提升到63.6%（943例留出集，3个种子平均）；最强提示参考为54.7%，且四个递增训练集规模下平均一致率均提升。在单种子actor训练配方比较中，仅动作修复训练在WebShop-lite上比仅成功训练高6.67个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 失败智能体rollout中的丰富信息可以被系统化转化为诊断与恢复训练数据。AED和AET流程能够在不重复原始rollout的情况下支持跨设置失败分析与再诊断，并显著提升修正验证通过率、诊断一致率以及actor恢复性能。

title: MemLife: Curating and Reasoning over Long-Term Egocentric Video Memories
summary: Long-term egocentric video enables personalized AI assistants to reason about daily life. However, as video histories grow to hundreds of hours spanning months or years, reprocessing raw clips for every query becomes computationally prohibitive. Memory systems offer a scalable alternative by compacting videos into text representations, but often fail on practical benchmarks: either the memory does not preserve key evidence, or the retriever fails to locate relevant entries due to retrieval competition in growing search spaces. To address these challenges, we introduce MemLife, a multimodal memory system that constructs entity-grounded, first-person text episodes and retrieves them via a time-indexed agentic reader. Without training or query-time video access, MemLife improves over the strongest training-free baseline by 4.6--12.0% across four long-horizon benchmarks. To further improve memory quality, we propose MemOpt, a reinforcement learning framework that optimizes the memory writer to produce faithful, informative, and retrievable memories. MemOpt consistently improves MemLife by 2.7--5.0% across different video and question distributions, with gains that generalize across writer and reader backbones and memory systems.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 MemLife 与 MemOpt，用于长期第一人称视频的个人化 AI 记忆系统：将视频压缩为实体锚定的文本片段，并通过时间索引智能体检索，从而避免反复处理原始视频。
AI.motivation: 长期第一人称视频历史可达数百小时，若每次查询都重新处理原始片段，计算成本过高。现有记忆系统虽将视频压缩为文本，但常无法保留关键证据，或因检索空间增长导致检索竞争而找不到相关条目。
AI.method: MemLife 构建多模态、实体锚定、第一人称文本情节，并使用时间索引的智能体阅读器进行检索，无需训练且查询时不访问视频。MemOpt 则用强化学习优化记忆写入器，使其生成忠实、信息丰富且可检索的记忆。
AI.result: MemLife 在四个长期基准上比最强免训练基线提升 4.6%–12.0%。MemOpt 在不同视频和问题分布上持续提升 MemLife 2.7%–5.0%，且增益可泛化到不同写入器、阅读器骨干和记忆系统。
AI.conclusion: 通过构建高质量文本记忆并优化检索与写入过程，可在不访问原始视频的情况下有效支持长期第一人称视频理解，并为可扩展的个人化 AI 助手记忆系统提供可行方案。

title: Inline Memory Meets Reusable Skills: Memory-centric Framework for Vision-Language-Action Model
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong promise for general-purpose robotic manipulation, yet adapting them to new tasks and domains remains inefficient: existing methods often rely on parameter tuning, incurring substantial costs and risking catastrophic forgetting of previously learned tasks. To address this, we propose \textbf{Optimus-R}, a memory-centric VLA framework that formulates robotic adaptation as explicit query-skill memory tuning. Optimus-R introduces: (i) An \textbf{Inline Memory Interface for skill extraction}. It inserts learnable memory tokens into the VLA prefix stream, allowing the backbone to derive control-aware query and skill representations within the native action-conditioning pathway. (ii) A \textbf{Query-Skill Memory Bank for skill learning}. It externalizes skills into query prototypes for deciding \emph{what} to retrieve and skill values for specifying \emph{how} to act, supporting skill reuse and expansion with limited parameter updates. (iii) A lightweight \textbf{Bridge-and-Adapt mechanism for skill updating}. It aligns target-domain queries and skills with the existing memory space through a lightweight adapter and residual memory updates. Experiments on in-domain adaptation, cross-domain adaptation, and lifelong learning show that Optimus-R enables data-efficient skill learning while mitigating catastrophic forgetting.

AI.tldr: 提出Optimus-R，一种以记忆为中心的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）框架，将机器人适应建模为显式的查询-技能记忆调优，实现数据高效的技能学习并缓解灾难性遗忘。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型虽在通用机器人操作上表现良好，但适配新任务和新领域通常依赖参数调优，成本高且易导致对已学任务的灾难性遗忘。
AI.method: Optimus-R包含三个机制：1）内联记忆接口用于技能提取，在VLA前缀流中插入可学习记忆令牌，使主干网络在原生动作条件路径中生成控制感知的查询和技能表示；2）查询-技能记忆库用于技能学习，将技能外化为查询原型以决定“检索什么”，以及技能值以指定“如何行动”，支持有限参数更新下的技能复用与扩展；3）轻量级Bridge-and-Adapt机制用于技能更新，通过轻量适配器和残差记忆更新，将目标领域的查询和技能对齐到现有记忆空间。
AI.result: 在域内适应、跨域适应和终身学习实验中，Optimus-R能够实现数据高效的技能学习，并缓解灾难性遗忘。
AI.conclusion: Optimus-R通过查询-技能记忆调优为VLA模型适应新任务和领域提供了一种高效范式，在减少参数更新的同时支持技能复用、扩展与持续学习。

title: RESUME: Recurrent State Updates from Motion and Residual Signals for Efficient Video Language Modeling
summary: Existing video language models encode sampled RGB frames independently, so a long video must either exhaust the token budget or drop the changes between sampled frames. Codec-aware front-ends read the motion vectors and residuals that encoding produced, but in their deployed form each predictive frame is still tokenized on its own: the tokens are a function of the current primitives, not of a carried reference. We argue that a more natural function is of both---the current primitives and a carried reference. A clip and its time reversal share the same frames and differ only in the order of changes---an axis that symmetric pooling discards by construction, and that is non-empty in the frozen vision features VideoLMs use---and the codec recurrence already composes those changes in order against a reference state. We introduce RESUME, a stateful codec representation: an anchor I-frame initializes a compact latent state, each subsequent predictive frame is consumed as an update to that state, and a shared readout exposes VideoLM-compatible tokens from the accumulated state. Codec prediction is thereby kept at the representation level and handed to the language model as a trajectory, not as a set of independent token groups. At the same per-predictive-frame token budget as prior codec-aware methods, a predictive frame enters the language model as a readout of what the front-end already knows, not as an encoding of the current primitives alone. Across ten benchmarks, the gains concentrate on temporal reasoning: on all three temporal benchmarks RESUME improves over both the RGB-frame baseline LLaVA-Video-7B (by 2.8, 5.1, and 3.9 points on TempCompass, TOMATO, and MVBench) and the codec-based baseline CoPE-7B, while staying competitive on general and long-form QA. Frozen-transition tests further show anchor dependence, order sensitivity, and useful rollout behavior beyond the training horizon.

AI.tldr: 提出RESUME，一种有状态的编解码表示，将视频帧作为对潜在状态的更新而非独立编码，提升视频语言模型的时序推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有视频语言模型独立编码采样RGB帧，导致长视频要么耗尽token预算，要么丢失帧间变化；现有编解码前端虽利用运动矢量和残差，但仍独立编码每个预测帧，未利用携带的参考状态。论文认为token应同时依赖当前基元和携带的参考，且编解码递推本身已按顺序组合变化。
AI.method: RESUME：锚定I帧初始化紧凑潜在状态，每个后续预测帧作为该状态的更新被消费，共享读出器从累积状态输出VideoLM兼容token。将编解码预测保持在表示层，以轨迹形式交给语言模型，而非独立token组。
AI.result: 在与先前编解码方法相同的每预测帧token预算下，在十个基准上，时序推理提升集中：在TempCompass、TOMATO、MVBench上分别比RGB基线LLaVA-Video-7B提升2.8、5.1、3.9分，并优于编解码基线CoPE-7B；在通用和长视频QA上保持竞争力。冻结转移测试显示锚点依赖、顺序敏感性和超出训练范围的有效rollout。
AI.conclusion: 有状态的编解码表示能有效利用编解码递推和参考状态，显著提升视频语言模型的时序推理能力。

title: AIMS: An Agentic AI Framework for Sim-to-Real Multi-Modal ISAC
summary: Multi-modal integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) enables environmental perception and reliable connectivity for intelligent wireless networks. Data-driven multi-modal ISAC models depend heavily on annotated real-world data to learn relationships across sensing and wireless observations, thereby constraining scalable deployment. Although synthetic data generation reduces the burden, adapting existing simulation pipelines to a target deployment requires consistent scene, sensing, wireless, and learning configurations, while mismatches among these coupled components impair sim-to-real transferability. To address the challenge, we propose an agentic artificial intelligence (AI) framework for sim-to-real multi-modal ISAC, named AIMS. Given a natural-language deployment request specifying the target task, deployment conditions, and real-data budget, AIMS derives a deployment-specific sim-to-real configuration and coordinates its execution to produce a deployment-specific task model. A two-agent architecture coordinates scene construction with task learning. A scene construction agent generates geographically grounded, synchronized sensing and wireless records from shared physical states, while a scene understanding agent configures task-relevant modalities and mixture-of-experts (MoE) learning for zero-shot inference or few-shot adaptation. Structured domain knowledge guides dependency-aware planning, while validation evidence supports feedback-driven revision of affected decisions. Experiments on the real-world DeepSense~6G dataset demonstrate improved vehicle detection and beam prediction over the considered simulation and fusion baselines. A separate orchestration benchmark evaluates task interpretation, dependency reasoning, and feedback-driven replanning across diverse deployment requests, showing improved plan correctness with structured domain knowledge and validation feedback.

AI.tldr: 提出AIMS，一种面向多模态集成感知与通信（ISAC）仿真到现实迁移的代理式AI框架，通过双代理架构实现场景构建与任务学习，在DeepSense 6G数据集上提升车辆检测和波束预测性能。
AI.motivation: 多模态ISAC数据驱动模型依赖大量标注的真实世界数据，限制了可扩展部署；合成数据虽可减轻负担，但仿真管线适配目标部署需一致的场景、感知、无线和学习配置，组件间不匹配损害仿真到现实迁移。
AI.method: 提出AIMS代理式AI框架。输入自然语言部署请求（任务、条件、真实数据预算），推导部署特定的仿真到现实配置并协调执行以生成任务模型。双代理架构：场景构建代理从共享物理状态生成地理接地、同步的感知与无线记录；场景理解代理配置任务相关模态和专家混合（MoE）学习，支持零样本推理或少样本适应。结构化领域知识引导依赖感知规划，验证证据支持反馈驱动的修正。
AI.result: 在真实世界DeepSense 6G数据集上，车辆检测和波束预测优于所考虑的仿真和融合基线。单独的编排基准评估任务解释、依赖推理和反馈驱动重规划，显示结构化领域知识和验证反馈提高了计划正确性。
AI.conclusion: AIMS通过代理式AI有效应对多模态ISAC仿真到现实迁移挑战，在感知任务和部署规划上均取得改进。

title: Invariant Shape Analysis of Surfaces with Spherical Topology
summary: Spherical harmonic descriptors of closed 3D shapes depend on the parameterization, the pose and the scale of the surface, and the standard rotation-invariant reductions, the power spectrum and the bispectrum, discard the relative orientation of the harmonic bands and cannot distinguish a shape from its mirror image. We construct a descriptor that removes all three dependencies exactly and loses nothing else: a conformal parameterization normalized by its conformal barycenter, followed by polynomial invariants of the rotation group. Identifying each harmonic band with a binary form turns the rotation quotient into classical invariant theory and makes reflections visible as the sign of an invariant, so chirality is recorded. The descriptor is complete for the truncated expansion, stable in the orbit distance, and comes with numerical diagnostics. Benchmarks confirm the guarantees, and on bilateral anatomical structures the descriptor separates mirror-image pairs from asymmetric pairs, which parity-blind descriptors cannot.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种三维闭合形状的球谐描述子：先用共形重心归一化共形参数化，再结合旋转群多项式不变量，从而精确消除参数化、姿态和尺度依赖，并保留手性信息。
AI.motivation: 传统球谐描述子依赖曲面的参数化、姿态和尺度，而常用的旋转不变量如功率谱和双谱会丢失谐波频带间的相对方向，且无法区分形状与其镜像。
AI.method: 构造共形重心归一化的共形参数化，并将每个谐波频带视为二元形式，利用旋转群经典不变量理论生成多项式不变量；反射对应不变量的符号变化，从而显式记录手性，并附带数值诊断。
AI.result: 该描述子对截断展开是完备的，在轨道距离意义下稳定；基准实验验证了这些性质，并且在双侧解剖结构上能区分镜像对与非对称对，而奇偶盲描述子无法做到。
AI.conclusion: 该方法精确去除了参数化、姿态和尺度三类依赖且不丢失其他信息，能够记录手性，适合需要区分镜像与不对称结构的形状分析任务。

title: What Can Component-Replacement Evidence Establish? A Critical Scoping Review of Local Decisions in LLM Agents
comment: 36 pages, 3 figures. The authors contributed equally
summary: Background. A component replacement in a language-model agent changes an execution trajectory, potentially altering later observations, resource use, and recovery opportunities. Different evidence is needed to assess its task-level benefit and the contribution of local decision quality. Methods. This critical scoping review maps 348 studies and examines 90 comparison records: 88 from 40 included studies and two from supplementary studies. Eight purposively selected cases structure the synthesis around the replaced decision, executed conditions, measurement comparability, controls, and remaining explanations. Results. Of 222 studies reporting local decision metrics, 142 also report measured task endpoints and 49 report proxies. These counts identify studies that report both types of measurement, without establishing that the measurements come from matched comparisons. Outcome Monitors reports a package-level completion gain whose attribution to detector quality remains limited; First-chunk selection reports a local improvement assessed against an offline proxy endpoint; Evidence-Carrying Termination reports fewer premature unsupported terminations and completion non-inferiority, without establishing completion superiority. Cross-case analysis identifies three candidate mechanisms involving recovery and disruption, intervention timing, and downstream use. Attribution and deployment depend on the comparison controls, label definitions, and information available to the controller. Conclusions. The review distinguishes the task-level benefit of a component replacement from the contribution of local decision quality and derives eight claim-specific reporting items. Neither online execution nor simultaneous gains in local and task metrics alone establish that better local decisions explain the task-level gain.

AI.tldr: 该文对348项研究进行批判性范围综述，聚焦语言模型智能体中组件替换的任务级收益与局部决策质量归因问题，并提出8条针对具体主张的报告条目。
AI.motivation: 组件替换会改变执行轨迹，并可能影响后续观察、资源使用和恢复机会，因此需要区分其任务级收益与局部决策质量的贡献；现有测量未必来自匹配比较。
AI.method: 开展关键范围综述：映射348项研究，分析90条比较记录（40项纳入研究的88条及补充研究的2条），并 purposively 选取8个案例，围绕被替换决策、执行条件、测量可比性、对照设置和剩余解释进行综合。
AI.result: 222项研究报告局部决策指标，其中142项同时报告任务终点，49项使用代理指标；这些计数不能证明测量来自匹配比较。案例显示：Outcome Monitors的包级完成增益归因于检测器质量仍有限；First-chunk selection仅针对离线代理终点评估局部改进；Evidence-Carrying Termination减少过早无支持终止且完成非劣，但未证明完成更优。跨案例分析识别出恢复与中断、干预时机、下游使用三种候选机制。归因和部署取决于比较对照、标签定义及控制器可获得的信息。
AI.conclusion: 综述区分了组件替换的任务级收益与局部决策质量的贡献，并推导出8条按主张报告的项目。仅凭在线执行，或局部指标与任务指标同时提升，并不能证明更好的局部决策解释了任务级增益。

title: MatLoom: Layered Text-to-Material Generation in a Compact Program Space
summary: Material generation should produce not only an appearance, but also the rules that construct it. We introduce MatLoom, a compact, layer-oriented language for text-to-material generation with pretrained language models. Each program composes alpha-masked layers whose shared spatial expressions define coverage and physically based rendering (PBR) channels, making dependencies between patterns, color, and relief explicit. A standalone interpreter evaluates the program into material maps, while the source retains named fields and layer parameters for subsequent authoring. Without task-specific fine-tuning, our pipeline uses parser-guided repair and preview-based critique to revise material designs, then searches noise seeds while keeping each candidate's remaining source fixed. On a curated benchmark of 141 prompts evaluated with six backbones, our best-performing configuration achieves higher mean scores than three diffusion baselines on all four flat-layout prompt-alignment metrics. Its initial programs already exceed all three baselines on mean BLIPScore, before critique or seed search. Retained programs have a median length of 21 lines when pooled across backbones. In a blind four-way comparison involving 30 participants and 20 prompts, our renders receive 59.2% of choices, compared with 19.3% for the most-preferred baseline. Compact executable programs thus offer a way to generate prompt-aligned materials while retaining their construction as part of the asset.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MatLoom，一种面向文本到材质生成的紧凑、分层式程序语言。它用预训练语言模型生成可执行程序，程序由带 alpha 遮罩的图层组成，并显式定义图案、颜色与凹凸之间的依赖关系，从而同时生成材质外观与其构造规则。
AI.motivation: 材质生成不应只产生外观，还应产生构建材质的规则。现有方法通常只输出纹理或材质贴图，难以保留可编辑、可解释的构造过程，也不便于后续作者化修改。
AI.method: MatLoom 程序组合多个 alpha 遮罩图层，共享空间表达式定义覆盖范围与 PBR 通道；独立解释器将程序求值为材质贴图，同时保留命名字段和图层参数。无需任务特定微调，流程使用解析器引导修复和基于预览的批评来修订设计，再在固定剩余源码的情况下搜索噪声种子。在 141 个提示、6 个骨干模型上评测，并与 3 个扩散基线比较。
AI.result: 最佳配置在四项扁平布局提示对齐指标上均高于三个扩散基线；在批评或种子搜索之前，初始程序的平均 BLIPScore 已超过所有基线。跨骨干模型汇总后，保留程序的中位长度为 21 行。在 30 名参与者、20 个提示的盲测四选一中，本方法渲染结果获得 59.2% 的选择，而最受偏好基线为 19.3%。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑的可执行程序能够生成与提示对齐的材质，并将材质的构造过程作为资产的一部分保留下来，为文本到材质生成提供了同时具备可编辑性和可解释性的新路径。

title: StreamRig: Exploiting Intra-Rig Geometry for Streaming Multi-Camera Odometry
summary: Mobile robots and vehicles carry synchronized multi-camera rigs, yet many streaming 3D foundation models are designed for monocular input, leaving efficient use of rig geometry a challenge. We present StreamRig, a freeze-and-stream framework that builds causal streaming odometry for calibrated rigs on a frozen multi-view 3D foundation model. The frozen front-end jointly perceives the synchronized views using rig calibration. A Rig-Resampler compresses their features, a CausalBridge applies causal attention with a key-value cache, and a lightweight head regresses rig poses. A periodic re-anchoring protocol supports stable pose estimation over long sequences. Only these modules are trained, 74.6M parameters in total, with relative poses as the sole supervision. Our two-stage training strategy combines group relocalization pretraining with causal rig training to transfer the geometric priors of the frozen front-end and the alignment ability of the pretrained modules to streaming odometry. We evaluate on NCLT, TartanGround, KITTI-360, and our self-collected humanoid-robot dataset ZJH, where training uses only simulation and real-world evaluation is zero-shot. Across all four datasets, StreamRig achieves lower translation and rotation drift than the evaluated non-oracle monocular streaming and rig-aware offline models, while maintaining low inference cost. Ablations and controlled camera-count experiments identify the sources of these gains. We further examine how longer training windows affect inference over longer horizons. Code has been released at https://github.com/WeiYuFei0217/StreamRig.

AI.tldr: 提出StreamRig，一种冻干多视角3D基础模型的流式里程计框架，仅训练74.6M参数的轻量模块，实现标定多相机机架的因果流式位姿估计。
AI.motivation: 移动机器人和车辆常搭载同步多相机设备，但许多流式3D基础模型仅针对单目输入设计，未能高效利用机架几何信息。
AI.method: 冻结前端联合感知同步视角并利用机架标定；Rig-Resampler压缩特征，CausalBridge使用带KV缓存的因果注意力，轻量头回归机架位姿；周期性重锚定保证长序列稳定；仅训练上述模块（74.6M参数），以相对位姿为监督；两阶段训练：组重定位预训练与因果机架训练。
AI.result: 在NCLT、TartanGround、KITTI-360及自采人形机器人数据集ZJH上，仅用仿真训练、真实场景零样本评估，StreamRig的平移和旋转漂移低于所评估的非预言单目流式和机架感知离线模型，且推理成本低；消融和相机数量实验揭示了增益来源，并分析了更长训练窗口对长时推理的影响。
AI.conclusion: 冻干流式框架能有效利用冻结多视角基础模型，为标定多相机机架提供高效稳定的流式里程计，代码已开源。

title: Steering Fields: Adaptive Vector Fields for Safe Image Generation and Beyond
summary: As state-of-the-art text-to-image flow models achieve near-photorealistic quality, controlling their outputs, e.g., suppressing harmful content while promoting benign alternatives, has become a central challenge. The current steering paradigm consists of adding a global steering vector to selected activations. While functional, a fixed and example-agnostic vector applied uniformly along the entire trajectory cannot adapt to the changing state of the generation and often causes unintended global changes. We introduce Steering Fields, a generalization of steering vectors that adaptively re-estimates the steering direction at each step of the generative process. Steering Fields operate on the noisy states of flow models, expose a continuous trade-off between steering strength and content preservation, and are compositional, enabling the simultaneous induction and inhibition of concepts, setting a new state of the art on safety steering benchmarks. Despite using no explicit spatial masks or object priors, the trajectory-adaptive estimation naturally preserves local structure, in a manner reminiscent of image editing.
